name: Book of Combos 1
description: An introductory text for first- time combiners. Improves your combination success rate.
description_de: Einführung für erstmalige Kombinierer. Verbessert deine Kombinier-Erfolgsrate.
description_fr: Livre d'introduction. Augmente le taux de réussite lorsque vous combinez des objets.
description_es: Texto introductorio para nuevos combinadores. Da mejores opciones de éxito.
description_it: Testo introduttivo sulle combinazioni. Aumenta le probabilità di successo.
description_zh: An introductory text for first- time combiners. Improves your combination success rate.

name: Book of Combos 2
description: An entry-level text. Owning Book 1 and this improves your combination success rate.
description_de: Grundlagen. Zusammen mit Buch 1 verbessert es deine Kombinier-Erfolgsrate.
description_fr: Livre de base. Augmente le taux de réussite si vous possédez le tome 1.
description_es: Texto básico. Junto con el primer tomo, mejora las opciones de éxito al combinar.
description_it: Testo di base. Insieme al volume 1, aumenta le probabilità di successo.
description_zh: An entry-level text. Owning Book 1 and this improves your combination success rate.

name: Book of Combos 3
description: An intermediate text. Owning Books 1, 2, and this improves your combination success rate.
description_de: Mittelschwer. Mit Buch 1 und 2 verbessert es deine Kombinier-Erfolgsrate.
description_fr: Livre de niveau moyen. Augmente le taux de réussite si vous possédez les tomes 1 et 2.
description_es: Texto intermedio. Junto con los dos tomos anteriores, mejora las opciones de éxito.
description_it: Testo intermedio. Insieme ai volumi 1 e 2, aumenta le probabilità di successo.
description_zh: An intermediate text. Owning Books 1, 2, and this improves your combination success rate.

name: Book of Combos 4
description: An advanced text. Owning Books 1-3 and this improves your combination success rate.
description_de: Fortgeschritten. Mit Buch 1, 2 und 3 verbessert es deine Kombinier-Erfolgsrate.
description_fr: Livre de niveau avancé. Augmente le taux de réussite si vous possédez les tomes 1 à 3.
description_es: Texto avanzado. Junto con los tres tomos anteriores, mejora las opciones de éxito.
description_it: Testo avanzato. Con i volumi 1, 2 e 3 aumenta le probabilità di successo.
description_zh: An advanced text. Owning Books 1-3 and this improves your combination success rate.

name: Book of Combos 5
description: A pro-level text. Owning Books 1-4 and this improves your combination success rate.
description_de: Für Profis. Mit Buch 1 bis 4 verbessert es deine Kombinier-Erfolgsrate.
description_fr: Livre pour experts. Augmente le taux de réussite si vous possédez les tomes 1 à 4.
description_es: Texto profesional. Junto con los cuatro tomos anteriores, mejora las opciones de éxito.
description_it: Per professionisti. Con 1, 2, 3 e 4 aumenta le probabilità di successo.
description_zh: A pro-level text. Owning Books 1-4 and this improves your combination success rate.

name: Organizer Guide
description: An issue of "Hunting Life" magazine which tells how to maximize Item/Palico Boxes.
description_de: Ausgabe von "Jagen heute". Zeigt, wie man Platz in der Objekt-/Kameradenbox schafft.
description_fr: Numéro spécial "Vie de chasse" consacré au rangement des objets et des Palicos.
description_es: Edición de la revista "Vida de caza" que explica cómo usar las cajas objeto/camarada.
description_it: Testo base che ti aiuterà a creare più spazio nelle casse oggetti/compagni.
description_zh: An issue of "Hunting Life" magazine which tells how to maximize Item/Palico Boxes.

name: Pack Rat Guide
description: An issue of "Hunting Life" magazine containing advanced item-cramming techniques.
description_de: Ausgabe von "Jagen heute", die Techniken zum Packen von Objekten erklärt.
description_fr: Numéro spécial "Vie de chasse" consacré à l'optimisation du rangement.
description_es: Edición de la revista "Vida de caza", con un artículo sobre el transporte de objetos.
description_it: Testo avanzato che ti aiuterà a creare più spazio nelle casse oggetti/compagni.
description_zh: An issue of "Hunting Life" magazine containing advanced item-cramming techniques.

name: Binoculars
description: Allow you to see farther and observe from a distance.
description_de: Mit diesem feinen Objekt kannst du das Geschehen aus der Ferne beobachten.
description_fr: Vous permettent de regarder au loin.
description_es: Te permiten observar desde lejos.
description_it: Ti consente di osservare lontano.
description_zh: Allow you to see farther and observe from a distance.

name: Potion
description: Restores a small amount of Health.
description_de: Stellt einen kleinen Teil der Gesundheit wieder her.
description_fr: Restaure une petite quantité de vie.
description_es: Restablece ligeramente el nivel de salud.
description_it: Ripristina una modesta quantità di vita.
description_zh: Restores a small amount of Health.

name: Mega Potion
description: Restores a moderate amount of Health.
description_de: Stellt einen mäßigen Teil der Gesundheit wieder her.
description_fr: Restaure une quantité modérée de vie.
description_es: Restablece moderadamente el nivel de salud.
description_it: Ripristina una notevole quantità di vita.
description_zh: Restores a moderate amount of Health.

name: Nutrients
description: Very slightly increases your maximum Health level.
description_de: Erhöht die maximale Gesundheitsstufe sehr geringfügig.
description_fr: Augmentent très légèrement la jauge de vie.
description_es: Aumentan ligeramente el nivel de salud.
description_it: Aumentano la barra vita di una piccolissima porzione.
description_zh: Very slightly increases your maximum Health level.

name: Mega Nutrients
description: Slightly increases your maximum Health level.
description_de: Erhöht die maximale Gesundheitsstufe geringfügig.
description_fr: Augmentent légèrement la jauge de vie.
description_es: Aumentan ligeramente el nivel máximo de salud.
description_it: Aumentano la barra vita di una piccola porzione.
description_zh: Slightly increases your maximum Health level.

name: Antidote
description: Removes all traces of poison from your system.
description_de: Entfernt alle Giftstoffe aus deinem Körper.
description_fr: Neutralise les effets nocifs du poison.
description_es: Elimina de forma eficaz cualquier rastro de veneno en tu organismo.
description_it: Elimina efficacemente ogni traccia di veleno dal tuo organismo.
description_zh: Removes all traces of poison from your system.

name: Immunizer
description: Boosts your natural ability to heal.
description_de: Steigert deine natürlichen Heilkräfte.
description_fr: Améliore la capacité naturelle de la récupération de vie.
description_es: Medicina que aumenta la capacidad natural de recuperación.
description_it: Potenzia la tua capacità curativa naturale.
description_zh: Boosts your natural ability to heal.

name: Dash Juice
description: Lets you run without tiring for a short period of time.
description_de: Ermöglicht es dir, eine kurze Zeit lang zu rennen, ohne zu ermüden.
description_fr: Permet de courir sans consommer la jauge de stamina.
description_es: Te permite correr sin cansarte durante cierto período de tiempo.
description_it: Ti consente di correre senza stancarti per un certo periodo di tempo.
description_zh: Lets you run without tiring for a short period of time.

name: Mega Dash Juice
description: Lets you run without tiring for longer than regular Dash Juice does.
description_de: Ermöglicht es dir, länger als mit dem Sprintsaft zu rennen, ohne zu ermüden.
description_fr: Version améliorée de la potion de vitalité. L'effet dure plus longtemps.
description_es: Te permite correr sin cansarte más tiempo que el zumo de poder.
description_it: Ti fa correre senza fatica per un periodo più lungo rispetto al supersucco.
description_zh: Lets you run without tiring for longer than regular Dash Juice does.

name: Demondrug
description: Boosts your Attack by filling you with -- guess what? -- demonic strength.
description_de: Verbessert deinen Angriff und füllt dich mit - na was wohl? - Dämonenkraft.
description_fr: Augmente votre attaque en vous conférant la force d'un démon.
description_es: Aumenta el ataque al otorgar la fuerza de un demonio al que la toma.
description_it: Aumenta il potere d'attacco conferendo una forza demoniaca.
description_zh: Boosts your Attack by filling you with -- guess what? -- demonic strength.

name: Mega Demondrug
description: Boosts your Attack even more than a regular Demondrug.
description_de: Verbessert deinen Angriff noch mehr als das Dämonenmittel.
description_fr: Version améliorée de la potion du démon. Augmente grandement votre attaque.
description_es: Aumenta el ataque aún más que la droga demoníaca.
description_it: Aumenta il potere d'attacco. Più efficace della mistura demoniaca normale.
description_zh: Boosts your Attack even more than a regular Demondrug.

name: Might Pill
description: Temporarily endows you with the strength of a mighty god. Potent!
description_de: Verleiht dir vorübergehend die Kraft eines mächtigen Gottes. Sehr wirksam!
description_fr: Confère temporairement la puissance d'un dieu redoutable.
description_es: Una píldora fortalecedora que te otorga el poder de un dios feroz.
description_it: Pillola energetica che rende temporaneamente fortissimi.
description_zh: Temporarily endows you with the strength of a mighty god. Potent!

name: Armorskin
description: Boosts your Defense by turning your skin as hard as rock.
description_de: Verbessert die Verteidigung, indem sie deine Haut hart wie Stein werden lässt.
description_fr: Augmente votre défense en rendant votre peau aussi dure que de la pierre.
description_es: Aumenta la defensa al endurecer la piel como una armadura de piedra.
description_it: Aumenta la difesa e rende la pelle dura come il ferro.
description_zh: Boosts your Defense by turning your skin as hard as rock.

name: Mega Armorskin
description: Boosts your Defense even more than a regular Armorskin.
description_de: Verbessert die Verteidigung noch mehr als die normale Panzerhaut.
description_fr: Version améliorée de la potion de pierre. Augmente grandement votre défense.
description_es: Aumenta la defensa más incluso que la piel de armadura.
description_it: Aumenta la difesa più della mistura ferrosa normale.
description_zh: Boosts your Defense even more than a regular Armorskin.

name: Adamant Pill
description: Temporarily makes your skin as hard as adamant. Potent!
description_de: Eine Pille, die deine Haut vorübergehend diamanthart macht. Sehr wirkungsvoll!
description_fr: Votre peau devient temporairement aussi résistante que le métal.
description_es: Una píldora que aporta temporalmente a tu piel la fortaleza del metal.
description_it: Pillola che rende la tua pelle temporaneamente durissima.
description_zh: Temporarily makes your skin as hard as adamant. Potent!

name: Cool Drink
description: Provides temporary relief from extreme heat.
description_de: Schützt dich vorübergehend vor extremer Hitze.
description_fr: Confère une résistance temporaire à la chaleur extrême.
description_es: Bebida que otorga una resistencia temporal al calor extremo.
description_it: Bevanda che aumenta temporaneamente la resistenza a forti calori.
description_zh: Provides temporary relief from extreme heat.

name: Hot Drink
description: Provides temporary relief from extreme cold.
description_de: Schützt dich vorübergehend vor extremer Kälte.
description_fr: Confère une résistance temporaire au froid extrême.
description_es: Bebida que otorga una resistencia temporal al frío extremo.
description_it: Bevanda che aumenta temporaneamente la resistenza al freddo.
description_zh: Provides temporary relief from extreme cold.

name: Cleanser
description: Immediately removes any ice or webbing on your body. Clean as a whistle!
description_de: Entfernt sofort Eis oder Gewebe vom Körper. Blitzsauber!
description_fr: Élimine aussitôt la glace et les bulles de votre corps. Propre comme un sou neuf !
description_es: Elimina toda la nieve y burbujas de tu cuerpo. ¡Sencillamente limpio!
description_it: Rimuove all'istante il ghiaccio o le ragnatele sul tuo corpo. Pulito garantito!
description_zh: Immediately removes any ice or webbing on your body. Clean as a whistle!

name: Psychoserum
description: Temporarily sharpens your sixth sense and attunes you to the ways of monsters.
description_de: Schärft vorübergehend deinen sechsten Sinn und passt dich ans Denken von Monstern an.
description_fr: Aiguise temporairement votre sixième sens pour sentir la présence des monstres.
description_es: Mejora temporalmente tu sexto sentido para detectar monstruos.
description_it: Sviluppa temporaneamente il tuo sesto senso e potrai rilevare i mostri.
description_zh: Temporarily sharpens your sixth sense and attunes you to the ways of monsters.

name: Herbal Medicine
description: Removes all traces of poison and restores a slight amount of Health.
description_de: Entfernt alle Giftstoffe und stellt Gesundheit geringfügig wieder her.
description_fr: Guérit les effets du poison et restaure un peu de vie.
description_es: Cura de forma eficaz el veneno y restablece ligeramente la salud.
description_it: Cura dal veleno e ripristina una piccola porzione di vita.
description_zh: Removes all traces of poison and restores a slight amount of Health.

name: Max Potion
description: Fully restores Health and maximizes the size of your Health Gauge.
description_de: Stellt Gesundheit vollständig wieder her und maximiert ihren Balken.
description_fr: Restaure toute la vie et augmente la jauge de vie au maximum.
description_es: Aumenta el indicador de salud al máximo y recupera toda tu salud.
description_it: Porta la barra vita al massimo livello curandoti completamente.
description_zh: Fully restores Health and maximizes the size of your Health Gauge.

name: Ancient Potion
description: Fully restores Health and maximizes the size of your Health and Stamina Gauges.
description_de: Stellt Gesundheit sowie Ausdauer wieder her und maximiert deren Balken.
description_fr: Restaure toute la vie et augmente les jauges de vie et de stamina au maximum.
description_es: Restablece salud al máximo y aumenta los indicadores de salud y resistencia.
description_it: Ripristina le barre vita e resistenza e ne aumenta il livello al massimo.
description_zh: Fully restores Health and maximizes the size of your Health and Stamina Gauges.

name: Energy Drink
description: A Guild-approved beverage that boosts your Stamina. Helps shake off sleep, too!
description_de: Ein von der Gilde geprüftes Getränk, das die Ausdauer stärkt. Gut gegen Müdigkeit!
description_fr: Boisson certifiée qui restaure de la stamina. Idéale pour vous réveiller !
description_es: Bebida del gremio que sube tu resistencia. ¡Ayuda a quitar el sueño!
description_it: Bevanda della Gilda che aumenta la resistenza. Aiuta a svegliarsi dal sonno!
description_zh: A Guild-approved beverage that boosts your Stamina. Helps shake off sleep, too!

name: Lifepowder
description: Medicine made from compounded Lifecrystals. Heals those within range with a single touch.
description_de: Lebenskristall-Kombination, die als Heilmittel verwendet wird. Heilt durch Berührung.
description_fr: Combinaison de cristaux de vie. Guérit ceux à proximité d'un simple contact.
description_es: Medicina hecha de cristales de vida. Cura de un toque a todos aquellos a su alcance.
description_it: Medicina creata combinando i cristalli vitali. Cura anche i compagni vicini.
description_zh: Medicine made from compounded Lifecrystals. Heals those within range with a single touch.

name: Dust of Life
description: A medicine with strong curative properties. Studied in secret, it is said to restore youth.
description_de: Medizin mit starker Heil- wirkung. Heimlich erforscht. Soll ewige Jugend spenden.
description_fr: Médicament au fort pouvoir de guérison. Serait source de jeunesse.
description_es: Medicina con propiedades curativas. Se dice que es la fuente de la juventud.
description_it: Medicina dalle proprietà curative; studiata in segreto, pare che faccia ringiovanire.
description_zh: A medicine with strong curative properties. Studied in secret, it is said to restore youth.

name: Hunter's Drink
description: A beverage that temporarily makes it easier to fill the Hunter Arts Gauge.
description_de: Hilft vorübergehend beim Füllen des Technikbalkens.
description_fr: Boisson qui facilite temporairement le remplissage de la jauge d'arts.
description_es: Bebida que ayuda a rellenar temporalmente el indicador de técnicas de caza.
description_it: Bevanda che accelera per un periodo la ricarica della barra delle arti di caccia.
description_zh: A beverage that temporarily makes it easier to fill the Hunter Arts Gauge.

name: Catalyst
description: Works with other materials to enhance their effects. Cannot be used by itself.
description_de: Erhöht die Wirkung anderer Materialien. Kann nicht allein benutzt werden.
description_fr: Se mélange à d'autres matériaux pour améliorer leur effet. Inutile seul.
description_es: Se mezcla con materiales para mejorar el efecto. No se puede usar solo.
description_it: Usato con altri materiali ne migliora l'effetto. Solo per combinazioni.
description_zh: Works with other materials to enhance their effects. Cannot be used by itself.

name: Gunpowder
description: A dangerous substance that explodes when struck or heated.
description_de: Eine gefährliche Substanz, die bei Erschütterung oder Erhitzung explodiert.
description_fr: Produit dangereux qui explose lorsqu'il est frappé ou chauffé.
description_es: Peligrosa sustancia que explota al golpearla o calentarla.
description_it: Una sostanza pericolosa che può esplodere se colpita o riscaldata.
description_zh: A dangerous substance that explodes when struck or heated.

name: Lifecrystals
description: Mysterious crystals long worshipped as a source of life.
description_de: Rätselhafte Kristalle, die man seit Langem als Lebensquelle verehrt.
description_fr: Cristaux mystérieux longtemps vénérés comme une source de vitalité.
description_es: Misteriosos cristales adorados como fuente de vida.
description_it: Misteriosi cristalli venerati per intere generazioni come fonte di vita.
description_zh: Mysterious crystals long worshipped as a source of life.

name: Tranquilizer
description: Medicine that works as an anesthetic when combined.
description_de: Medizin, die kombiniert als Narkosemittel benutzt wird.
description_fr: Médicament utilisé comme anesthésiant lorsqu'il est combiné.
description_es: Medicina que se usa como anestésico cuando se combina.
description_it: Medicina che può essere combinata per creare un anestetico.
description_zh: Medicine that works as an anesthetic when combined.

name: Yukumo Egg
description: A popular dish from Yukumo Village. Known for its rich yolk and how it melts in the mouth.
description_de: Ein beliebtes Gericht aus Yukumo. Berühmt für seinen Eiweißgehalt.
description_fr: Spécialité du village Yukumo. Un jaune d'œuf délicieux et un fondant en bouche légendaire.
description_es: Plato típico de Yukumo. Famoso por su sabrosa yema que se deshace en la boca.
description_it: Pietanza di Yukumo nota per il suo gusto deciso e la consistenza soffice.
description_zh: A popular dish from Yukumo Village. Known for its rich yolk and how it melts in the mouth.

name: Tanzia Chips
description: A nutritious snack made with ingredients caught in Tanzian waters. Tastes like seafood.
description_de: Nahrhafter Snack mit Zutaten aus den Gewässern um Tanzia. Schmeckt wie Meeresfrüchte.
description_fr: Collation fabriquée à partir d'ingrédients issus des eaux de Tanzia. Goût fruits de mer.
description_es: Nutritivo aperitivo hecho con productos de las aguas de Tanzia. Saben a marisco.
description_it: Spuntino nutriente con ingredienti delle acque di Tanzia; sa di pesce.
description_zh: A nutritious snack made with ingredients caught in Tanzian waters. Tastes like seafood.

name: Powercharm
description: An amulet that raises Attack. Just carrying this gives you demonic strength.
description_de: Stärkt den Angriff und verleiht dem Träger die Kraft eines Dämons.
description_fr: Amulette qui augmente l'attaque. La porter confère la force d'un démon.
description_es: Amuleto que aumenta el poder de ataque. Otorga la fuerza de un demonio.
description_it: Amuleto che aumenta il potere d'attacco. Infonde una forza demoniaca.
description_zh: An amulet that raises Attack. Just carrying this gives you demonic strength.

name: Powertalon
description: A powerful amulet that raises Attack. Made with a Deviljho Talon.
description_de: Amulett zur Stärkung des Angriffs. Gemacht aus einer Dämonjho-Kralle.
description_fr: Amulette puissante qui augmente l'attaque. Faite en griffe de Deviljho.
description_es: Amuleto que aumenta el ataque. Hecho con la garra de un Deviljho.
description_it: Amuleto che aumenta il potere d'attacco. È fatto con uno sperone di Deviljho.
description_zh: A powerful amulet that raises Attack. Made with a Deviljho Talon.

name: Armorcharm
description: An amulet that raises Defense. Just carrying this hardens your skin like stone.
description_de: Stärkt die Verteidigung und macht deine Haut so hart wie Stein.
description_fr: Amulette qui augmente la défense. La peau devient dure comme la pierre.
description_es: Amuleto que aumenta la defensa. Endurece la piel como una piedra.
description_it: Amuleto che aumenta la difesa. Rende la pelle dura come la pietra.
description_zh: An amulet that raises Defense. Just carrying this hardens your skin like stone.

name: Armortalon
description: A powerful amulet that raises Defense. Made with a Deviljho Talon.
description_de: Amulett zur Stärkung der Verteidigung. Gemacht aus einer Dämonjho-Kralle.
description_fr: Amulette puissante qui augmente la défense. Faite en griffe de Deviljho.
description_es: Amuleto que aumenta la defensa. Hecho con la garra de un Deviljho.
description_it: Potente amuleto che aumenta la difesa. È fatto con uno sperone di Deviljho.
description_zh: A powerful amulet that raises Defense. Made with a Deviljho Talon.

name: BBQ Spit
description: Just what you need to cook meat. A must-have item for any hungry hunter.
description_de: Damit lässt sich Fleisch zubereiten. Ein Muss für jeden hungrigen Jäger.
description_fr: Permet de cuire la viande. Outil essentiel pour tout chasseur affamé.
description_es: Objeto imprescindible para todo cazador. Sirve para cocinar la carne.
description_it: Un oggetto indispensabile per qualsiasi cacciatore. Serve a cuocere la carne.
description_zh: Just what you need to cook meat. A must-have item for any hungry hunter.

name: Raw Meat
description: Meat carved from a monster. Can be cooked, combined, or used to set a trap.
description_de: Fleisch eines Monsters. Kann zubereitet, kombiniert oder für Fallen verwendet werden.
description_fr: Viande obtenue en dépeçant un monstre. A de nombreux usages.
description_es: Carne obtenida al despiezar a un monstruo. Tiene diversos usos.
description_it: Carne ottenuta affettando un mostro. Ha molti usi.
description_zh: Meat carved from a monster. Can be cooked, combined, or used to set a trap.

name: Poisoned Meat
description: Raw Meat that poisons whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.
description_de: Führt bei Verzehr zu ernsten Vergiftungen. Perfekt als Köder für Fallen geeignet.
description_fr: Viande crue empoisonnée. Utilisée comme appât pour les pièges.
description_es: Carne cruda envenenada. Se usa como cebo en trampas.
description_it: Carne cruda che avvelena se mangiata. Usata come trappola.
description_zh: Raw Meat that poisons whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.

name: Tinged Meat
description: Raw Meat that paralyzes whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.
description_de: Lähmt bei Verzehr. Perfekt als Köder für Fallen geeignet.
description_fr: Viande crue paralysante. Utilisée comme appât pour les pièges.
description_es: Carne cruda paralizante. Se usa como cebo en trampas.
description_it: Carne cruda che paralizza se mangiata. Usata come trappola.
description_zh: Raw Meat that paralyzes whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.

name: Drugged Meat
description: Raw Meat that puts whatever eats it to sleep. Makes great bait for traps.
description_de: Führt bei Verzehr zu Schläfrigkeit. Perfekt als Köder für Fallen geeignet.
description_fr: Viande crue somnifère. Utilisée comme appât pour les pièges.
description_es: Carne cruda somnífera. Se usa como cebo en trampas.
description_it: Carne cruda che addormenta se mangiata. Usata come trappola.
description_zh: Raw Meat that puts whatever eats it to sleep. Makes great bait for traps.

name: Rare Steak
description: Provides a small boost to your Stamina. This one's still red in the middle.
description_de: Geringe Steigerung der Ausdauer. Das Fleisch ist noch rot in der Mitte.
description_fr: De la viande saignante. Augmente un peu la jauge de stamina.
description_es: Carne poco hecha. Aumenta ligeramente la resistencia.
description_it: Carne cotta al sangue. Aumenta leggermente la barra resistenza.
description_zh: Provides a small boost to your Stamina. This one's still red in the middle.

name: Well-done Steak
description: Provides a moderate boost to your Stamina. Meat done right!
description_de: Mittlere Steigerung der Ausdauer. Gut durchgebratenes Fleisch.
description_fr: Une viande à point ! Augmente la jauge de stamina.
description_es: Carne bien hecha. Aumenta medianamente la resistencia.
description_it: Carne ben cotta. Aumenta moderatamente la barra resistenza.
description_zh: Provides a moderate boost to your Stamina. Meat done right!

name: Burnt Meat
description: Meat that has been burnt to a crisp. It might boost your Stamina, or it might drain it...
description_de: Das Fleisch ist verbrannt. Kann die Ausdauer erhöhen oder dich schwächen.
description_fr: De la viande calcinée. Peut augmenter la jauge de stamina ou la diminuer...
description_es: Carne quemada. Tan posible es que aumente tu resistencia como que te debilite.
description_it: Carne carbonizzata. Può aumentare la resistenza, ma può anche indebolirti.
description_zh: Meat that has been burnt to a crisp. It might boost your Stamina, or it might drain it...

name: Chilled Meat
description: Meat that cools the body, wards off heat, and restores a moderate amount of Stamina.
description_de: Kühlt den Körper, weist die Hitze ab und verleiht etwas mehr Ausdauer.
description_fr: De la viande qui protège de la chaleur et augmente un peu la jauge de stamina.
description_es: Carne refrescante que combate el calor y aumenta la resistencia.
description_it: Mangiarla rinfresca il corpo, scaccia il caldo e fa recuperare resistenza.
description_zh: Meat that cools the body, wards off heat, and restores a moderate amount of Stamina.

name: Hot Meat
description: Meat that warms the body, wards off the cold, and restores a moderate amount of Stamina.
description_de: Wärmt den Körper, vertreibt die Kälte und verleiht etwas mehr Ausdauer.
description_fr: De la viande qui protège du froid et augmente un peu la jauge de stamina.
description_es: Carne que sirve para entrar en calor, combatir el frío y aumentar la resistencia.
description_it: Mangiarla scalda il corpo, scaccia il freddo e fa recuperare resistenza.
description_zh: Meat that warms the body, wards off the cold, and restores a moderate amount of Stamina.

name: Mosswine Jerky
description: Dried Mosswine meat. The more you chew it, the more flavorful and juicy it becomes.
description_de: Getrocknetes Mosswinefleisch. Wird beim Kauen stetig schmackhafter.
description_fr: Viande séchée. Plus on la mâche, plus elle est savoureuse et succulente.
description_es: Carne seca de Mosswine, cuanto más la masticas, más sabrosa y jugosa se vuelve.
description_it: Carne essiccata di Mosswine. Più la mastichi, più diventa saporita e succosa.
description_zh: Dried Mosswine meat. The more you chew it, the more flavorful and juicy it becomes.

name: Kingmeat
description: Like its name implies, it's the King of Meats. Doesn't get any juicier than this!
description_de: Wie der Name schon sagt... Der König des Fleisches. Saftiger geht es nicht!
description_fr: Comme son nom l'indique. Plus savoureux que cette viande, ça n'existe pas !
description_es: Como su nombre sugiere, es la reina de las carnes. No la hay más sabrosa.
description_it: Come implica il nome, è la regina delle carni. Non ne esiste di più appetitosa!
description_zh: Like its name implies, it's the King of Meats. Doesn't get any juicier than this!

name: Whetstone
description: A standard-sized Whetstone. Use it to restore a weapon's Sharpness.
description_de: Ein Standard-Schleifstein. Verwende ihn, um Waffen zu schärfen.
description_fr: Pierre à aiguiser standard. Restaure le tranchant des armes.
description_es: Piedra de afilar estándar. Al pulir armas con ella se restablece el afilado.
description_it: Pietra portatile usata per affilare le armi. Ridona acutezza.
description_zh: A standard-sized Whetstone. Use it to restore a weapon's Sharpness.

name: Old Pickaxe
description: A cheap pickaxe with an easily nicked blade.
description_de: Eine billige Spitzhacke mit einer Klinge, die sich leicht abnutzt.
description_fr: Pioche bon marché. Elle s'ébrèche facilement.
description_es: Pico barato. Su hoja se rompe fácilmente.
description_it: Un piccone economico con una lama che si intacca facilmente.
description_zh: A cheap pickaxe with an easily nicked blade.

name: Iron Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe with a reasonably strong blade.
description_de: Eine Spitzhacke mit einer recht starken Klinge.
description_fr: Pioche de bonne qualité. Elle est assez résistante.
description_es: Pico de hierro con una hoja resistente.
description_it: Un piccone in ferro con una lama forte.
description_zh: A pickaxe with a reasonably strong blade.

name: Mega Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe tempered with steel. This one won't nick easily.
description_de: Eine mit Stahl verstärkte Spitzhacke, die sich kaum abnutzt.
description_fr: Pioche en acier trempé. Elle est difficile à briser.
description_es: Pico de acero reforzado difícil de romper.
description_it: Un piccone rinforzato in acciaio che è difficile intaccare.
description_zh: A pickaxe tempered with steel. This one won't nick easily.

name: Old Bug Net
description: A cheap net for catching bugs. It tears easily.
description_de: Ein billiges Netz zum Fangen von Käfern. Es reißt leicht.
description_fr: Filet pour attraper les insectes. Se déchire facilement.
description_es: Útil para atrapar bichos, aunque poco resistente.
description_it: Retino economico per catturare gli insetti. Si strappa facilmente.
description_zh: A cheap net for catching bugs. It tears easily.

name: Bug Net
description: A durable net for catching bugs.
description_de: Ein haltbares Netz zum Fangen von Käfern.
description_fr: Filet pour attraper les insectes. Assez résistant.
description_es: Útil para atrapar bichos y duradero.
description_it: Retino robusto per catturare gli insetti.
description_zh: A durable net for catching bugs.

name: Mega Bug Net
description: An extremely durable net for catching bugs. This one is made to last.
description_de: Ein extrem haltbares Netz zum Fangen von Käfern. Sehr strapazierfähig.
description_fr: Filet pour attraper les insectes. Très résistant.
description_es: Útil para atrapar bichos y muy duradero.
description_it: Retino molto resistente per catturare gli insetti.
description_zh: An extremely durable net for catching bugs. This one is made to last.

name: Boomerang
description: An unusually-shaped weapon from abroad that returns to its user when thrown.
description_de: Eine ungewöhnlich geformte, fremdländische Waffe, die zu ihrem Werfer zurückkehrt.
description_fr: Projectile étrange d'origine aborigène. Une fois lancée, elle revient au lanceur.
description_es: Arma increíblemente afilada traída del extranjero que vuelve tras ser lanzada.
description_it: Arma dalla forma insolita che torna al suo portatore quando viene lanciata.
description_zh: An unusually-shaped weapon from abroad that returns to its user when thrown.

name: Throwing Knife
description: A standard throwing knife. Flies straight and true. (Supply Item)
description_de: Standardwurfmesser. Fliegt präzise. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Couteau de lancer standard. Trajectoire rectiligne et précise. (Fourniture)
description_es: Arma arrojadiza estándar. De vuelo recto y certero. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Coltello da lancio standard. Vola dritto al bersaglio. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A standard throwing knife. Flies straight and true. (Supply Item)

name: Poison Knife
description: A throwing knife with a venom- coated blade. Poisons targets. (Supply Item)
description_de: Mit Gift überzogenes Wurfmesser. Vergiftet Ziele. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Couteau de lancer enduit de venin. Empoisonne la cible. (Fourniture)
description_es: Arma arrojadiza con veneno. Envenena al objetivo. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Coltello da lancio con lama tossica. Avvelena i nemici. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A throwing knife with a venom- coated blade. Poisons targets. (Supply Item)

name: Sleep Knife
description: A throwing knife that has been dusted with sleeping agents. (Supply Item)
description_de: Wurfmesser mit Schlafmittel auf seiner Klinge. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Couteau de lancer enduit de somnifères. Endort la cible. (Fourniture)
description_es: Cuchillo arrojadizo de propiedades somníferas. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Coltello da lancio intriso di polvere soporifera. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A throwing knife that has been dusted with sleeping agents. (Supply Item)

name: Paralysis Knife
description: A throwing knife coated with toxins that paralyze a target. (Supply Item)
description_de: Wurfmesser, mit lähmenden Giften überzogen. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Couteau de lancer enduit de toxines. Paralyse la cible. (Fourniture)
description_es: Cuchillo arrojadizo con toxinas paralizantes. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Coltello da lancio intriso di tossina paralizzante. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A throwing knife coated with toxins that paralyze a target. (Supply Item)

name: Tranq Knife
description: A throwing knife used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. (Supply Item)
description_de: Wurfmesser zum Fangen von Monstern in Fallen. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Couteau de lancer enduit de sédatifs. Capture la cible. (Fourniture)
description_es: Cuchillo arrojadizo para capturar bestias atrapadas. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Coltello usato per catturare i mostri intrappolati. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A throwing knife used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. (Supply Item)

name: Bomb Casing
description: A base material for making hand-thrown bombs.
description_de: Grundmaterial zum Herstellen von Wurfbomben.
description_fr: Ingrédient de base pour créer des bombes lancées à la main.
description_es: Ingrediente básico para hacer bombas de mano.
description_it: Materiale base per creare le bombe a mano.
description_zh: A base material for making hand-thrown bombs.

name: Paintball
description: Toss this scented paint at a monster to mark it, allowing you to track its position.
description_de: Kann auf Monster geworfen werden, um die Verfolgung zu erleichtern.
description_fr: Peut être lancé sur un monstre pour le marquer et le suivre facilement.
description_es: Se puede lanzar al monstruo para marcarlo y seguirle la pista.
description_it: Può essere lanciata su un mostro per contrassegnarlo e seguirlo facilmente.
description_zh: Toss this scented paint at a monster to mark it, allowing you to track its position.

name: Flash Bomb
description: Flashes brightly on impact. Toss this right under a monster's nose to blind it.
description_de: Blitzt bei Kontakt hell auf. Wirf sie Monstern in die Fratze, um sie zu blenden.
description_fr: Émet un flash lumineux qui aveugle les monstres sensibles à la lumière.
description_es: Bomba que da un brillante fogonazo al impactar. Causa ceguera.
description_it: Bomba che emana una forte luce all'impatto. Lanciala sui mostri per accecarli.
description_zh: Flashes brightly on impact. Toss this right under a monster's nose to blind it.

name: Sonic Bomb
description: A grenade-like item that emits a high-frequency blast of sound on detonation.
description_de: Granatenartiges Objekt, das bei Detonation einen Hochfrequenzton abgibt.
description_fr: Émet une impulsion sonore qui assourdit les monstres sensibles aux sons à haute fréquence.
description_es: Emite un potente sonido de alta frecuencia al detonar.
description_it: Quando esplode emette un potente suono ad alta frequenza.
description_zh: A grenade-like item that emits a high-frequency blast of sound on detonation.

name: Tranq Bomb
description: A hand grenade used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. Can be slammed against the ground.
description_de: Handgranate zum Fangen von Monstern in Fallen. Kann auf Boden geworfen werden.
description_fr: Grenade servant à capturer les monstres piégés. Peut être projetée contre le sol.
description_es: Para dominar y capturar a monstruos atrapados. Lánzala contra el suelo.
description_it: Bomba a mano che cattura i mostri intrappolati. Può essere scagliata a terra.
description_zh: A hand grenade used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. Can be slammed against the ground.

name: Deodorant
description: An item that cures Stench. Releases a puff of deodorizing smoke when thrown down.
description_de: Hilft gegen Gestank. Nach dem Wurf breitet sich eine wohlriechende Wolke aus.
description_fr: Objet guérissant la puanteur. Libère une fumée déodorante lorsqu'il est jeté.
description_es: Objeto para curar el hedor. Pulveriza humo desodorizante cuando se lanza.
description_it: Oggetto che cura fetore sprigionando uno sbuffo di fumo deodorante.
description_zh: An item that cures Stench. Releases a puff of deodorizing smoke when thrown down.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Creates a large cloud of smoke wherever it lands.
description_de: Erzeugt eine große Rauch- wolke im Aufprallbereich.
description_fr: Crée un large nuage de fumée.
description_es: Crea una gran nube de humo en la zona donde cae.
description_it: Crea una grossa nube di fumo nella zona in cui esplode.
description_zh: Creates a large cloud of smoke wherever it lands.

name: Poison Smoke Bomb
description: Contains a toxic chemical. Also popular as a household bug bomb.
description_de: Rauchbombe mit Gift. Wird gerne gegen Ungeziefer im Haushalt eingesetzt.
description_fr: Contient un gaz toxique. Utilisée aussi pour la fumigation.
description_es: Bomba de humo que contiene un componente tóxico. Puede usarse como insecticida.
description_it: Contiene un agente tossico. Si usa spesso per scacciare gli insetti dalle case.
description_zh: Contains a toxic chemical. Also popular as a household bug bomb.

name: Farcaster
description: Instantly transports you back to base camp.
description_de: Befördert dich umgehend zurück ins Basislager.
description_fr: Vous ramène instantanément au camp de base.
description_es: Te transporta al instante al campamento base.
description_it: Ti riporta istantaneamente al campo base.
description_zh: Instantly transports you back to base camp.

name: Dung Bomb
description: When thrown, releases a strong odor which certain monsters find repulsive.
description_de: Gibt beim Werfen einen starken Geruch ab, der manche Monster abstößt.
description_fr: Une fois lancée, diffuse une odeur horrible repoussant certains monstres.
description_es: Al lanzarlo, desprende un fuerte olor repulsivo para ciertos monstruos.
description_it: Quando viene lanciata emette un odore intenso. Funge da repellente per certi mostri.
description_zh: When thrown, releases a strong odor which certain monsters find repulsive.

name: Dung
description: That's right: monster poop. The odor reveals (too) much about the monster's diet.
description_de: Richtig: Monsterkot. Der Geruch verrät (zu) viel über die Ernährung des Monsters.
description_fr: Et oui, du caca de monstre. Son odeur en dit long sur ses habitudes alimentaires.
description_es: Excremento de monstruo. Su olor revela de qué se alimenta el monstruo.
description_it: Sì... è cacca di mostro e dall'odore si capisce (fin troppo) cosa ha mangiato.
description_zh: That's right: monster poop. The odor reveals (too) much about the monster's diet.

name: Trap Tool
description: A must-have item for putting together Pitfall Traps and other kinds of traps.
description_de: Ein essentielles Hilfsmittel zum Aufstellen von Fallen, wie etwa Fallgruben.
description_fr: Outil requis pour installer différents pièges, comme le piège à fosse.
description_es: Herramienta necesaria para colocar la trampa escollo u otras trampas.
description_it: Necessario per piazzare vari tipi di trappole, come la trappola coperta.
description_zh: A must-have item for putting together Pitfall Traps and other kinds of traps.

name: Spider Web
description: A very sticky web.
description_de: Ein sehr klebriges Netz.
description_fr: De la fibre de soie très gluante.
description_es: Tela de araña. Es muy pegajosa.
description_it: Una ragnatela molto appiccicosa.
description_zh: A very sticky web.

name: Net
description: A sturdy net able to support a certain amount of weight without breaking.
description_de: Ein starkes Netz, das einem bestimmten Gewicht standhalten kann.
description_fr: Filet solide capable de supporter un grand poids sans se déchirer.
description_es: Potente red capaz de soportar bastante peso.
description_it: Una rete robusta in grado di reggere un certo peso senza rompersi.
description_zh: A sturdy net able to support a certain amount of weight without breaking.

name: Pitfall Trap
description: A trap for catching certain large monsters. It is tripped by a heavy weight.
description_de: Zum Fangen bestimmter Monster. Schnappt durch ein schweres Gewicht zu.
description_fr: Le monstre tombe dans un grand trou. À utiliser pour capturer certains monstres.
description_es: Trampa para atrapar grandes monstruos. Se activa con grandes pesos.
description_it: Trappola per catturare alcuni grandi mostri. Si aziona con un grosso peso.
description_zh: A trap for catching certain large monsters. It is tripped by a heavy weight.

name: Shock Trap
description: A trap that immobilizes a target. Use it to capture monsters.
description_de: Die Schockfalle macht Ziele bewegungsunfähig und erlaubt es, Monster zu fangen.
description_fr: Le monstre est temporairement paralysé. À utiliser pour capturer certains monstres.
description_es: Trampa que inmoviliza al objetivo. Se usa para capturar monstruos.
description_it: Una trappola che può immobilizzare un mostro. Usata per la cattura.
description_zh: A trap that immobilizes a target. Use it to capture monsters.

name: Barrel Lid
description: A small barrel lid. There appears to be a drawing on it.
description_de: Kleiner Fassdeckel, auf dem sich eine Zeichnung zu befinden scheint.
description_fr: Un petit couvercle de baril. On dirait qu'il y a un dessin dessus.
description_es: La tapa de un barril pequeño. Parece que tiene un dibujo.
description_it: Coperchio di una piccola botte. Pare che sopra ci sia un disegno.
description_zh: A small barrel lid. There appears to be a drawing on it.

name: Small Barrel
description: A small, empty barrel.
description_de: Ein kleines, leeres Fass.
description_fr: Petit baril vide.
description_es: Barril pequeño vacío.
description_it: Piccola botte vuota.
description_zh: A small, empty barrel.

name: Large Barrel
description: A large, empty barrel.
description_de: Ein großes, leeres Fass.
description_fr: Grand baril vide.
description_es: Barril grande vacío.
description_it: Grande botte vuota.
description_zh: A large, empty barrel.

name: Barrel Bomb S
description: A small time bomb.
description_de: Eine kleine Zeitbombe.
description_fr: Petite bombe à retardement.
description_es: Bomba de relojería pequeña.
description_it: Piccola bomba a orologeria.
description_zh: A small time bomb.

name: Barrel Bomb L
description: A powerful bomb triggered by external physical impact.
description_de: Eine starke Bombe, die durch äußeren physischen Kontakt ausgelöst wird.
description_fr: Bombe puissante qui explose après un impact.
description_es: Potente bomba que se activa con un impacto físico externo.
description_it: Potente bomba azionata da un impatto fisico esterno.
description_zh: A powerful bomb triggered by external physical impact.

name: Barrel Bomb L+
description: Upgraded Large Barrel Bomb. Effective against large monsters.
description_de: Eine verbesserte Große Fassbombe, die sehr wirksam gegen riesige Monster ist.
description_fr: Version améliorée de la grande bombe baril. Efficace contre les grands monstres.
description_es: Bomba de barril grande mejorada. Efectiva contra grandes monstruos.
description_it: Grande bomba-botte potenziata. Efficace contro grandi mostri.
description_zh: Upgraded Large Barrel Bomb. Effective against large monsters.

name: Bounce Bomb
description: Launches into the air when set. This modified bomb requires skill to use.
description_de: Steigt in die Luft. Diese modifizierte Bombe erfordert geschickte Hände.
description_fr: Vole dans les airs après sa mise en place. Difficile à utiliser.
description_es: Se eleva al activarse. Se necesita habilidad para usar esta bomba modificada.
description_it: Bomba modificata. Vola in aria quando è innescata. Occorre abilità per usarla.
description_zh: Launches into the air when set. This modified bomb requires skill to use.

name: Bounce Bomb+
description: An improved version of the Bounce Bomb. Requires some skill to use.
description_de: Verbesserte Version der Abprallbombe. Erfordert viel Geschick.
description_fr: Version améliorée de la bombe artifice. Difficile à utiliser.
description_es: Versión mejorada de la bomba de rebote. Requiere cierta habilidad.
description_it: Versione migliorata della bomba-missile. Occorre abilità per usarla.
description_zh: An improved version of the Bounce Bomb. Requires some skill to use.

name: Affinity Oil
description: A red oil for the Sword & Shield. Once applied, it greatly increases Affinity.
description_de: Rotes Öl für Schwert & Schild, dessen Anwendung die Affinität deutlich steigert.
description_fr: Huile rouge pour l'épée & bouclier. Améliore grandement l'affinité.
description_es: Aceite rojo para espadas y escudos. Una vez aplicado, incrementa mucho la afinidad.
description_it: Olio rosso per spada e scudo. Una volta applicato, aumenta molto l'affinità.
description_zh: A red oil for the Sword & Shield. Once applied, it greatly increases Affinity.

name: Destroyer Oil
description: A green oil for the Sword and Shield. Makes it easier to stagger your target.
description_de: Grünes Öl für Schwert & Schild. Bringt Gegner leichter ins Taumeln.
description_fr: Huile verte pour l'épée & bouclier. Fait vaciller votre cible plus facilement.
description_es: Aceite verde para espadas y escudos. Ayuda a hacer tambalear al objetivo.
description_it: Olio verde per spada e scudo. Rende più agevole indurre l'avversario al vacillamento.
description_zh: A green oil for the Sword and Shield. Makes it easier to stagger your target.

name: Stamina Oil
description: A blue oil for the Sword & Shield. Once applied, it will drain monsters' stamina.
description_de: Blaues Öl für Schwert & Schild. Es senkt die Ausdauer von Monstern.
description_fr: Huile bleue pour l'épée & bouclier. Draine la stamina du monstre.
description_es: Aceite azul para espadas y escudos. Al usarlo, se reduce la resistencia de los monstruos.
description_it: Olio blu per spada e scudo. Una volta applicato, riduce la resistenza dei mostri.
description_zh: A blue oil for the Sword & Shield. Once applied, it will drain monsters' stamina.

name: Mind's Eye Oil
description: A white oil for the Sword & Shield. Once applied, your attacks cannot be deflected.
description_de: Weißes Öl für Schwert & Schild. Verhindert das Ablenken deiner Angriffe.
description_fr: Huile blanche pour l'épée & bouclier. Vos attaques ne sont plus déviées.
description_es: Aceite blanco para espadas y escudos. Al usarlo, tus ataques no se podrán rechazar.
description_it: Olio bianco per spada e scudo. Impedisce che i tuoi attacchi siano respinti.
description_zh: A white oil for the Sword & Shield. Once applied, your attacks cannot be deflected.

name: Huskberry
description: A berry that is hollow on the inside. Tough enough to grow just about anywhere.
description_de: Diese Beere ist innen hohl. Sie ist zäh genug, um prak- tisch überall zu wachsen.
description_fr: Baie creuse à l'intérieur. Assez résistante pour pousser à peu près partout.
description_es: Baya que está hueca por dentro. Tan resistente que crece en cualquier sitio.
description_it: Una bacca con l'interno cavo. È talmente resistente che può crescere ovunque.
description_zh: A berry that is hollow on the inside. Tough enough to grow just about anywhere.

name: Bone Husk
description: Used as a bone ammo casing. Produces sturdier results than a Huskberry.
description_de: Wird benutzt als Knochen- Patronenhülse. Robuster als die Hülse der Hülsenbeere.
description_fr: Sert de douille aux munitions. Plus résistante que la baie-coque.
description_es: Cáscara de munición de hueso. Más fuerte que la baya hueca.
description_it: Usato come copertura per proiettili, dà maggiore durezza del guscio di bacca.
description_zh: Used as a bone ammo casing. Produces sturdier results than a Huskberry.

name: Normal S Lv1
description: Ammo for novices. Cheap, but don't expect much. Unlimited shots.
description_de: Preiswerte Munition für Anfänger. Erwarte nicht zu viel. Unbegrenzte Schüsse.
description_fr: Munition bon marché mais peu puissante. Les munitions sont illimitées.
description_es: Munición barata para novatos, aunque no demasiado potente. Disparos ilimitados.
description_it: Proiettili non specializzati per cacciatori alle prime armi. Colpi illimitati.
description_zh: Ammo for novices. Cheap, but don't expect much. Unlimited shots.

name: Normal S Lv2
description: Non-specialized ammo. More powerful than Lv1. Capacity: 99
description_de: Nicht spezialisierte Munition. Stärker als Stufe 1. Kapazität: 99.
description_fr: Munition plus puissante que celle de niveau 1. (max 99)
description_es: Munición normal más potente que la de nv1. Capacidad máxima: 99.
description_it: Proiettili non specializzati e più potenti dei normali lv1. Max 99 colpi.
description_zh: Non-specialized ammo. More powerful than Lv1. Capacity: 99

name: Normal S Lv3
description: Non-specialized ammo that ricochets, resulting in high damage. Capacity: 99
description_de: Nicht spezialisierte Munition, die durch Abprallen schadet. Kapazität: 99.
description_fr: Munition qui ricoche et inflige plus de dégâts. (max 99)
description_es: Munición normal que rebota para causar más daño. Capacidad máxima: 99.
description_it: Proiettili non specializzati, efficaci anche di rimbalzo. Max 99 colpi.
description_zh: Non-specialized ammo that ricochets, resulting in high damage. Capacity: 99

name: Pierce S Lv1
description: Armor-piercing ammo that deals multiple hits to some monsters. Capacity: 60
description_de: Durchschussmunition für Mehrfachtreffer auf einige Monster. Kapazität: 60.
description_fr: Munition qui perce les cuirasses épaisses, causant plusieurs impacts. (max 60)
description_es: Disparo perforante con impacto múltiple en ciertos monstruos. Capacidad máxima: 60.
description_it: Proiettili perforanti che provocano ferite multiple. Max 60 colpi.
description_zh: Armor-piercing ammo that deals multiple hits to some monsters. Capacity: 60

name: Pierce S Lv2
description: High-grade armor-piercing ammo. Deals more hits than Lv1. Capacity: 60

description_de: Unter Kinsekten beliebter Nektar. Erhöht die Stärke ihres Elements Feuer.
description_fr: Nectar sucré pour kinsectes. Augmente l'élément feu.
description_es: Los kinsectos aman este néctar dulce; mejora la fuerza del elemento fuego.
description_it: Nettare dolce adorato dai Kinsetti. Ne aumenta la forza dell'elemento fuoco.

name: Power Jelly+
description: Thick tree sap loved by Kinsects. Perfect for growing strong and healthy Kinsects!
description_de: Unter Kinsekten beliebter Baumsaft. Ideal zur Aufzucht starker, gesunder Kinsekten.
description_fr: Sève épaisse pour kinsectes. Pour le plein de force et de santé !
description_es: Los kinsectos aman esta savia espesa, que les hace crecer fuertes y sanos.
description_it: Linfa densa di cui sono ghiotti i Kinsetti e che li fa crescere forti e sani!
description_zh: Thick tree sap loved by Kinsects. Perfect for growing strong and healthy Kinsects!

name: Heavy Jelly+
description: Thick tree sap loved by Kinsects. Perfect for aiding robust Kinsect development!
description_de: Unter Kinsekten beliebter Baumsaft. Ideal zur Aufzucht robuster Kinsekten.
description_fr: Sève épaisse pour kinsectes. Excellente pour la croissance et la musculature !
description_es: Los kinsectos aman esta savia espesa, que les hace crecer más robustos.
description_it: Linfa densa di cui sono ghiotti i Kinsetti e che ne favorisce un sano sviluppo!
description_zh: Thick tree sap loved by Kinsects. Perfect for aiding robust Kinsect development!

name: Speed Jelly+
description: Thick tree sap loved by Kinsects. Perfect for aiding rapid Kinsect development!
description_de: Unter Kinsekten beliebter Baumsaft. Ideal zur Aufzucht schnellerer Kinsekten.
description_fr: Sève épaisse pour kinsectes. Assure la croissance rapide des kinsectes !
description_es: Los kinsectos aman esta savia espesa, que les vuelve más veloces.
description_it: Linfa densa di cui sono ghiotti i Kinsetti e che ne accelera lo sviluppo!
description_zh: Thick tree sap loved by Kinsects. Perfect for aiding rapid Kinsect development!

name: Power Jelly++
description: Very thick tree sap loved by Kinsects. Perfect for growing strong and healthy Kinsects!
description_de: Extradicker Baumsaft für Kinsekten. Ideal zur Aufzucht starker, gesunder Kinsekten.
description_fr: Sève très épaisse pour kinsectes. Pour le plein de force et de santé !
description_es: Los kinsectos aman esta savia muy espesa, que les hace crecer fuertes y sanos.
description_it: Linfa molto densa di cui sono ghiotti i Kinsetti e che li fa crescere forti e sani!
description_zh: Very thick tree sap loved by Kinsects. Perfect for growing strong and healthy Kinsects!

name: Fire Ambrosia+
description: A sweet nectar loved by Kinsects; greatly increases Fire Element strength.
description_de: Süßer Nektar für Kinsekten. Erhöht die Stärke ihres Elements Feuer deutlich.
description_fr: Nectar sucré pour kinsectes. Augmente fortement l'élément feu.
description_es: Los kinsectos aman este néctar dulce; mejora mucho su elemento fuego.
description_it: Nettare dolce adorato dai Kinsetti. Ne aumenta molto la forza dell'elemento fuoco.
description_zh: A sweet nectar loved by Kinsects; greatly increases Fire Element strength.

name: Water Ambrosia+
description: A sweet nectar loved by Kinsects; greatly increases Water Element strength.
description_de: Süßer Nektar für Kinsekten. Erhöht die Stärke ihres Elements Wasser deutlich.
description_fr: Nectar sucré pour kinsectes. Augmente fortement l'élément eau.
description_es: Los kinsectos aman este néctar dulce; mejora mucho su elemento agua.
description_it: Nettare dolce adorato dai Kinsetti. Ne aumenta molto la forza dell'elemento acqua.
description_zh: A sweet nectar loved by Kinsects; greatly increases Water Element strength.

name: Douse Ambrosia
description: A sour nectar that reduces Fire Element strength and increases Dragon.
description_de: Ein saurer Nektar, der das Element Feuer schwächt und Drache verbessert.
description_fr: Nectar aigre pour kinsectes. Diminue l'élément feu mais augmente l'élément dragon.
description_es: Reduce en el kinsecto la potencia del elemento fuego y aumenta la de draco.
description_it: Nettare aspro adorato dai Kinsetti. Riduce l'elemento fuoco e aumenta drago.
description_zh: A sour nectar that reduces Fire Element strength and increases Dragon.

name: Drought Ambrosia
description: A sour nectar that reduces Water Element strength and increases Fire.
description_de: Ein saurer Nektar, der das Element Wasser schwächt und Feuer verbessert.
description_fr: Nectar aigre pour kinsectes. Diminue l'élément eau mais augmente l'élément feu.
description_es: Reduce en el kinsecto la potencia del elemento agua y aumenta la de fuego.
description_it: Nettare aspro adorato dai Kinsetti. Riduce l'elemento acqua e aumenta fuoco.
description_zh: A sour nectar that reduces Water Element strength and increases Fire.

name: Resistor Ambrosia
description: A sour nectar that reduces Thunder Element strength and increases Water.
description_de: Ein saurer Nektar, der das Element Donner schwächt und Wasser verbessert.
description_fr: Nectar aigre pour kinsectes. Diminue l'élément foudre mais augmente l'élément eau.
description_es: Reduce en el kinsecto la potencia del elemento rayo y aumenta la de agua.
description_it: Nettare aspro adorato dai Kinsetti. Riduce l'elemento tuono e aumenta acqua.
description_zh: A sour nectar that reduces Thunder Element strength and increases Water.

name: Melt Ambrosia
description: A sour nectar that reduces Ice Element strength and increases Thunder.
description_de: Ein saurer Nektar, der das Element Eis schwächt und Donner verbessert.
description_fr: Nectar aigre pour kinsectes. Diminue l'élément glace mais augmente l'élément foudre.
description_es: Reduce en el kinsecto la potencia del elemento hielo y aumenta la de rayo.
description_it: Nettare aspro adorato dai Kinsetti. Riduce l'elemento gelo e aumenta tuono.
description_zh: A sour nectar that reduces Ice Element strength and increases Thunder.

name: De-wyrm Ambrosia
description: A sour nectar that reduces Dragon Element strength and increases Ice.
description_de: Ein saurer Nektar, der das Element Drache schwächt und Eis verbessert.
description_fr: Nectar aigre pour kinsectes. Diminue l'élément dragon mais augmente l'élément glace.
description_es: Reduce en el kinsecto la potencia del elemento draco y aumenta la de hielo.
description_it: Nettare aspro adorato dai Kinsetti. Riduce l'elemento drago e aumenta gelo.
description_zh: A sour nectar that reduces Dragon Element strength and increases Ice.

name: Reverse Ambrosia
description: A nectar made by a Kinsect breeder; causes them to lose all of their Element strengths.
description_de: Im Kinsektenbrüter erzeugter Nektar. Führt zum Verlust der Elementstärken.
description_fr: Nectar concocté par un éleveur de kinsectes. Annule les éléments.
description_es: Néctar hecho por un criador de kinsectos; les anula todo poder elemental.
description_it: Prodotta da un allevatore di Kinsetti. Li priva di tutte le loro forze elementali.
description_zh: A nectar made by a Kinsect breeder; causes them to lose all of their Element strengths.

name: Alchemy Barrel
description: A hunting tool used by Alchemy Style Hunters. You can shake it to create new items.
description_de: Hilfsmittel für Anhänger des Alchemiestils. Erzeugt durch Schütteln Alchemie-Objekte.
description_fr: Objet utilisé par les adeptes du style Alchimiste. Remuez-le pour fabriquer des objets.
description_es: El utensilio básico de todo alquimista. Agítalo para crear nuevos objetos.
description_it: Strumento per cacciatori usato nello stile alchemico. Scuotendola, puoi creare oggetti nuovi.
description_zh: A hunting tool used by Alchemy Style Hunters. You can shake it to create new items.

name: Alchemy Food
description: Eat to restore some Stamina. It goes down a treat, but does leave you a bit thirsty.
description_de: Füllt beim Verzehr etwas Ausdauer auf. Guter Snack, verursacht aber großen Durst.
description_fr: Avalez ceci pour récupérer un peu de stamina. A plutôt bon goût, mais a tendance à donner soif.
description_es: Restablece ligeramente la resistencia. Es ligera y digestible, pero da mucha sed.
description_it: Fa recuperare un po' di resistenza. Ha un buon sapore, ma ti lascia una gran sete!
description_zh: Eat to restore some Stamina. It goes down a treat, but does leave you a bit thirsty.

name: Alchemy Immunizer
description: Eat this and your Health will gradually restore for a short time. It even smells healthy!
description_de: Stellt eine Zeit lang Gesundheit wieder her. Schmeckt wie alles Gesunde eher mäßig.
description_fr: Restaure progressivement la vie pendant un court laps de temps. Un concentré de santé !
description_es: Recupera salud gradualmente durante un tiempo. Huele que alimenta.
description_it: Ripristina gradualmente la vita per un determinato periodo. Il cibo sano dei campioni!
description_zh: Eat this and your Health will gradually restore for a short time. It even smells healthy!

name: Alchemy Earplugs
description: These earplugs protect your delicate ears from loud monster roars...once. Talk about fragile.
description_de: Verhindern ein einziges Mal den Effekt eines Gebrülls, aber werden dabei zerstört.
description_fr: Ces protège-tympans à usage unique vous rendent insensible aux rugissements des monstres.
description_es: Protegen los oídos de los rugidos, pero se rompen tras un solo uso. Ya no los hacen como antaño...
description_it: Resistono agli effetti del ruggito dei mostri, ma si rompono dopo il primo ruggito.
description_zh: These earplugs protect your delicate ears from loud monster roars...once. Talk about fragile.

name: Alchemy Slick
description: Crystallized Alchemy Barrel contents. Why not try combining it with other Alchemy Items?
description_de: Im Fass entstandene Kristalle. Kann mit bestimmten Alchemie- Objekten kombiniert werden.
description_fr: Contenu cristallisé d'un Tonneau d'alchimie. Si vous le combiniez avec un autre objet d'alchimie ?
description_es: Residuo cristalizado. ¿Y si pruebas a usarlo sobre otros objetos de alquimista?
description_it: Contenuto delle botti alchemiche cristallizzato. Prova a combinarlo con altri oggetti alchemici...
description_zh: Crystallized Alchemy Barrel contents. Why not try combining it with other Alchemy Items?

name: Alchemy Cheer
description: Fills up some of your (and nearby allies') Arts Gauge and/or Support Gauge.
description_de: Jubelkugel, die Technik-/Unter- stützungsbalken aller Mitstreiter in der Umgebung teilweise füllt.
description_fr: Remplit partiellement les jauges d'arts et/ou Miaroudeur du joueur et des alliés proches.
description_es: Sube el indicador de técnicas y/o la barra de apoyo. Te afecta a ti y a los aliados cercanos.
description_it: Aumenta la barra delle arti e la barra di supporto per te e gli alleati vicini.
description_zh: Fills up some of your (and nearby allies') Arts Gauge and/or Support Gauge.

name: Alchemy Whetstone
description: Use this to restore your weapon's Sharpness and have your Arts Gauge fill faster for a while.
description_de: Stellt Waffenschärfe wieder her und der Technikbalken füllt sich eine Zeit lang schneller.
description_fr: Rendez son tranchant d'origine à votre arme et accélérez le remplissage de la jauge d'arts.
description_es: Restaura el afilado del arma y el indicador de técnicas se llenará más rápido durante un tiempo.
description_it: Ripristina l'acutezza delle armi. Riempie più velocemente la barra delle arti per un certo periodo.
description_zh: Use this to restore your weapon's Sharpness and have your Arts Gauge fill faster for a while.

name: Alchemy Bullet
description: Alchemy-created ammo that fills your Arts Gauge faster (when it hits, that is). Capacity: 30
description_de: Füllt bei Treffern den Technikbalken schneller. Kapazität: 30.
description_fr: Cartouche spéciale accélérant le remplissage de la jauge d'arts. (max 30)
description_es: Munición especial que llena el indicador de técnicas más rápido al impactar. Capacidad: 30.
description_it: Quando la pallottola va a segno, fa riempire velocemente la barra delle arti. Massimo 30 pallottole.
description_zh: Alchemy-created ammo that fills your Arts Gauge faster (when it hits, that is). Capacity: 30

name: Alchemy Coating
description: Works with any Bow, and fills up your Arts Gauge a bit quicker. Capacity: 20
description_de: Für alle Bogen verwendbar. Füllt den Technikbalken schneller. Kapazität: 20.
description_fr: Accélère le remplissage de la jauge d'arts, utilisable avec tous les arcs. (max 20)
description_es: Funciona con cualquier arco. Llena el indicador de técnicas más rápido. Capacidad: 20.
description_it: Fa riempire più velocemente la barra delle arti. Può essere usata con qualsiasi arco. Max 20 frecce.
description_zh: Works with any Bow, and fills up your Arts Gauge a bit quicker. Capacity: 20

name: Alchemy Sonic Bomb
description: Launches a bird-like puppet that emits a screech that small monsters can't stand.
description_de: Bringt eine Puppe hervor, die für kleine Monster unangenehme Hochfrequenz-Töne ausstößt.
description_fr: Lance une poupée émettant un cri strident insupportable aux oreilles des petits monstres.
description_es: Muñeco que provoca ondas sónicas y asusta a monstruos pequeños.
description_it: Lancia un pupazzo che emette una potente frequenza e un suono insopportabile per i mostri piccoli.
description_zh: Launches a bird-like puppet that emits a screech that small monsters can't stand.

name: Alchemy Booster
description: This liquid of purest Alchemy allows your Alchemy Gauge to fill more quickly for a while.
description_de: Stinkender Klumpen aus dem Fass. Der Alchemie-Balken füllt sich einige Zeit lang schneller.
description_fr: Votre jauge d'alchimie se remplit plus rapidement pendant un moment.
description_es: Bebida que acelera el proceso de creación de objetos alquímicos.
description_it: Liquido alchemico che fa riempire più in fretta la barra alchemica per un determinato periodo.
description_zh: This liquid of purest Alchemy allows your Alchemy Gauge to fill more quickly for a while.

name: Alchemy Fireball
description: This fireball blasts out of your Alchemy Barrel and explodes on impact.
description_de: Das Fass feuert im hohen Bogen ein Geschoss ab, das am Einschlagspunkt detoniert.
description_fr: Boule de feu qui jaillit de votre Tonneau d'alchimie et explose à l'impact.
description_es: Lanza una bola de fuego del barril alquímico que explota al impactar.
description_it: Dalla botte alchemica viene lanciata una sfera infuocata che esplode al momento dell'impatto.
description_zh: This fireball blasts out of your Alchemy Barrel and explodes on impact.

name: Alchemy Remedy
description: Restores some Health and removes status afflictions from you and nearby allies.
description_de: Verströmt Wirkstoffe, die eigene Statusveränderungen und die naher Mitstreiter heilen.
description_fr: Restaure une partie de la vie et lève les altérations d'état du joueur et des alliés à proximité.
description_es: Restaura parcialmente la salud y elimina tus estados anormales y los de tus aliados cercanos.
description_it: Ripristina una parte della barra della vita e rimuove le alterazioni di status per te e gli alleati vicini.
description_zh: Restores some Health and removes status afflictions from you and nearby allies.

name: Worm
description: A fishing lure. Wriggles underwater, enticing those fishies to bite.
description_de: Ein Angelköder. Zappelt unter Wasser und verführt die Fische so zum Anbeißen.
description_fr: Un appât. Se tortille sous l'eau, incitant les poissons à mordre.
description_es: Cebo de pesca. Se retuerce debajo del agua y así incita a los peces a picar.
description_it: Un'esca per la pesca. Agitandola sott'acqua, i pesci abboccano.
description_zh: A fishing lure. Wriggles underwater, enticing those fishies to bite.

name: Mega Fishing Fly
description: A fly lure that causes a feeding frenzy no matter what fish is biting.
description_de: Fliegenköder, der ein Fressgelage auslöst. Wirkt bei allen Fischen.
description_fr: Leurre en forme de mouche sur lequel se jetteront tous les poissons.
description_es: Cebo volador que hará saltar al instante a cualquier tipo de pez.
description_it: Un'esca a mosca su cui ogni tipo di pesce si avventerà voracemente.
description_zh: A fly lure that causes a feeding frenzy no matter what fish is biting.

name: Frog
description: A fishing lure. The ideal bait for certain aquatic monsters.
description_de: Ein Angelköder, der sich ideal für bestimmte Monster im Wasser eignet.
description_fr: L'appât idéal pour certains monstres aquatiques.
description_es: Cebo de pesca. Ideal para ciertos monstruos acuáticos.
description_it: Un'esca per la pesca. Ideale per attirare alcuni mostri acquatici.
description_zh: A fishing lure. The ideal bait for certain aquatic monsters.

name: Sushifish Bait
description: A nugget-shaped fishing lure that makes Sushifish go "mmm."
description_de: Klumpenförmiger Angel- köder. Sushifische lieben ihn über alles.
description_fr: Un appât en forme de pépite auquel le Sushipoisson ne peut pas résister.
description_es: Señuelo con forma de nuez que vuelve loco al pez sushi.
description_it: Un'esca a forma di pepita che manderà in sollucchero qualsiasi pesce-sushi.
description_zh: A nugget-shaped fishing lure that makes Sushifish go "mmm."

name: Burst Bait
description: A fishing lure with chum that makes fish that rupture upon death go "mmm."
description_de: Ein Angelköder aus Fisch- abfällen, nach dem explosive Fische lechzen. Mmmhh...
description_fr: L'appât préféré des poissons qui éclatent en mourant. Miam !
description_es: Cebo de pesca delicioso que hace que los peces revienten de gusto.
description_it: La pastura preferita dai pesci che, quando muoiono, esplodono.
description_zh: A fishing lure with chum that makes fish that rupture upon death go "mmm."

name: Goldenfish Bait
description: A nugget-shaped fishing lure that makes Goldenfish and Brocadefish go "mmm."
description_de: Klumpenförmiger Angelköder. Goldenfisch und Brokatfisch lieben ihn über alles.
description_fr: Un appât en forme de pépite auquel le poisson d'or et le koï ne peuvent pas résister.
description_es: Señuelo con forma de nuez que vuelve loco al pez dorado y al pez brocado.
description_it: Un'esca a forma di pepita che manderà in sollucchero pesci-dorati e pesci-baleno.
description_zh: A nugget-shaped fishing lure that makes Goldenfish and Brocadefish go "mmm."

name: Field Horn
description: Used to attract certain monsters -- blow at your own risk. May break when used.
description_de: Zum Anlocken bestimmter Monster. Benutzung auf eigene Gefahr. Zerbrechlich.
description_fr: Utilisé pour attirer certains monstres. Peut se briser aléatoirement.
description_es: Peligroso dispositivo para atraer ciertos monstruos. Puede romperse al usarse.
description_it: Strumento pericoloso che attira alcuni mostri. Con l'uso si può rompere.
description_zh: Used to attract certain monsters -- blow at your own risk. May break when used.

name: Health Flute
description: Restores Health to those who hear it. May break when used.
description_de: Stellt die Gesundheit der Zuhörer wieder her. Geht leicht kaputt.
description_fr: Restaure la vie de ceux qui l'entendent. Peut se briser aléatoirement.
description_es: Restablece la salud de quienes lo escuchan. Puede romperse al usarse.
description_it: Ripristina la barra vita di chi lo ascolta. Con l'uso si può rompere.
description_zh: Restores Health to those who hear it. May break when used.

name: Antidote Flute
description: Eliminates poison in the blood of those who hear it. May break when used.
description_de: Entgiftet das Blut der Zuhörer. Geht leicht kaputt.
description_fr: Guérit le poison de ceux qui l'entendent. Peut se briser aléatoirement.
description_es: Elimina el veneno de la sangre de quienes lo escuchan. Puede romperse al usarse.
description_it: Elimina il veleno dal sangue di chi lo ascolta. Con l'uso si può rompere.
description_zh: Eliminates poison in the blood of those who hear it. May break when used.

name: Demon Flute
description: Increases the strength of those who hear it. May break when used.
description_de: Erhöht die Stärke der Zuhörer. Geht leicht kaputt.
description_fr: Augmente la force de ceux qui l'entendent. Peut se briser aléatoirement.
description_es: Aumenta la fuerza de quienes lo escuchan. Puede romperse al usarse.
description_it: Aumenta la forza di chi lo ascolta. Con l'uso si può rompere.
description_zh: Increases the strength of those who hear it. May break when used.

name: Armor Flute
description: Bolsters the defenses of those who hear it. May break when used.
description_de: Verbessert die Verteidigung der Zuhörer. Geht leicht kaputt.
description_fr: Augmente la défense de ceux qui l'entendent. Peut se briser aléatoirement.
description_es: Aumenta la defensa de quienes lo escuchan. Puede romperse al usarse.
description_it: Aumenta la difesa di chi lo ascolta. Con l'uso si può rompere.
description_zh: Bolsters the defenses of those who hear it. May break when used.

name: Garbage
description: Junk created when a combination attempt fails.
description_de: Müll, der entsteht, wenn Kombinierversuche fehlschlagen.
description_fr: Déchet produit lorsqu'une tentative de combinaison a échoué.
description_es: Desperdicios que se crean cuando no se logra hacer una combinación.
description_it: Robaccia che si crea quando un tentativo di combinazione fallisce.
description_zh: Junk created when a combination attempt fails.

name: Honey
description: Sweet, golden honey. High in nutritional value.
description_de: Süßer, goldener Honig mit hohem Nährwert.
description_fr: Du bon miel doré à haute valeur nutritive.
description_es: Miel, dulce miel. Con alto valor nutritivo.
description_it: Miele dolce e dorato. Alto valore nutritivo.
description_zh: Sweet, golden honey. High in nutritional value.

name: Herb
description: Restores a very small amount of Health. Not very flavorful.
description_de: Stellt einen sehr geringen Teil der Gesundheit wieder her, schmeckt aber mies.
description_fr: Restaure un peu de vie, mais au goût assez fade.
description_es: Planta que restablece ligeramente la salud. Es algo insípida.
description_it: Ripristina una minima porzione di vita, ma il sapore non è un granché.
description_zh: Restores a very small amount of Health. Not very flavorful.

name: Antidote Herb
description: A plant used in antidotes. It sometimes cures poison when eaten by itself.
description_de: Wird für Gegengifte verwendet. Entfernt auch bei Verzehr manchmal Gifte.
description_fr: Plante utilisée pour les antidotes. Soigne parfois le poison quand on la mange.
description_es: Planta usada en antídotos. Cura el envenenamiento a veces si se ingiere cruda.
description_it: Una pianta usata per gli antidoti. Può guarire dal veleno se assunta da sola.
description_zh: A plant used in antidotes. It sometimes cures poison when eaten by itself.

name: Fire Herb
description: A wondrous, flammable plant.
description_de: Eine erstaunliche, entflammbare Pflanze.
description_fr: Plante superbe aux propriétés inflammables.
description_es: Planta maravillosa con propiedades inflamables.
description_it: Una pianta dalle curiose proprietà incendiarie.
description_zh: A wondrous, flammable plant.

name: Ivy
description: A lightweight and extremely strong plant.
description_de: Eine leichte und extrem robuste Pflanze.
description_fr: Plante légère mais extrêmement résistante.
description_es: Una planta ultraligera y extremadamente fuerte.
description_it: Una pianta leggera, ma molto resistente.
description_zh: A lightweight and extremely strong plant.

name: Sleep Herb
description: A plant containing sleeping agents.
description_de: Eine Pflanze, die Schlafmittel enthält.
description_fr: Plante aux propriétés somnifères.
description_es: Planta con propiedades somníferas.
description_it: Pianta con proprietà soporifere.
description_zh: A plant containing sleeping agents.

name: Sap Plant
description: A plant with leaves coated in sticky sap. Difficult to remove once attached.
description_de: Eine Pflanze mit klebrigen Blättern. Lässt sich nach Kontakt schwer entfernen.
description_fr: Plante couverte de sève gluante. Difficile de s'en débarrasser.
description_es: Planta que deja una capa de savia pegajosa nada fácil de eliminar.
description_it: Una pianta appiccicosa. Difficile da togliere una volta che si è attaccata.
description_zh: A plant with leaves coated in sticky sap. Difficult to remove once attached.

name: Felvine
description: Melynxes' favorite food -- they just have to steal it.
description_de: Leibspeise der Melynx. Sie können ihr einfach nicht widerstehen.
description_fr: Les Melynx en raffolent. Ils ne peuvent s'empêcher d'en voler.
description_es: Maravilla a los Melynx. No pueden resistirse a su encanto.
description_it: Cibo preferito dai Melynx. Devono rubarlo: è più forte di loro.
description_zh: Melynxes' favorite food -- they just have to steal it.

name: Gloamgrass Root
description: Possesses antidotal agents, but it will not work by itself.
description_de: Enthält Gegengift, kann aber allein nichts bewirken.
description_fr: Possède des propriétés antidotiques mais n'a pas d'effet tel quel.
description_es: Contiene los componentes de un antídoto, pero no tiene efecto por sí misma.
description_it: Contiene sostanze antidotali, ma da sola non ha alcun effetto.
description_zh: Possesses antidotal agents, but it will not work by itself.

name: Hot Pepper
description: Blazingly spicy. Sure, it'll warm you up, but it's too hot to handle on its own.
description_de: Brennend scharf. Wärmt dich zweifellos auf, aber eigentlich schon zu sehr.
description_fr: Diablement épicé. Vous réchauffera, mais est trop fort pour être pris seul.
description_es: Al morderlo arde como el infierno. Da calor, pero a costa de ver las estrellas.
description_it: È piccantissimo. Ti scalderà, ma è troppo forte per mangiarlo da solo.
description_zh: Blazingly spicy. Sure, it'll warm you up, but it's too hot to handle on its own.

name: Snow Herb
description: A radiant plant admired for the lovely white patterns on its leaves. It's as cold as ice.
description_de: Leuchtende Pflanze mit prächtigem Blattmuster. Eiskalt.
description_fr: Très belle plante aux jolis motifs blancs. Froide comme la glace.
description_es: Planta radiante admirada por las bellas tramas blancas de sus hojas. Fría como el hielo.
description_it: Pianta apprezzata per le venature bianche delle foglie e fredda come il ghiaccio.
description_zh: A radiant plant admired for the lovely white patterns on its leaves. It's as cold as ice.

name: Spicy Mushroom
description: A mushroom with bite that recovers a small amount of Stamina.
description_de: Ein besonderer Pilz, der mit Schmackes einen Teil der Ausdauer wiederherstellt.
description_fr: Champignon épicé spécial qui restaure une petite quantité de stamina.
description_es: Seta picante especial que recupera una pequeña cantidad de resistencia.
description_it: Speciale fungo speziato; fa recuperare una piccola quantità di resistenza.
description_zh: A mushroom with bite that recovers a small amount of Stamina.

name: Frozen Berry
description: A completely frozen berry. Can provide relief from heat and recover Stamina.
description_de: Komplett gefrorene Beere. Wirkt hitzeabweisend und füllt den Ausdauerbalken auf.
description_fr: Baie entièrement gelée. Elle peut soulager de la chaleur et restaurer la stamina.
description_es: Baya totalmente congelada. Alivia el calor y recupera resistencia.
description_it: Bacca totalmente gelata. Può alleviare dal caldo e far recuperare resistenza.
description_zh: A completely frozen berry. Can provide relief from heat and recover Stamina.
