name: King Cactus
description: The ultimate cactus plant, just touching its spines can put you in a world of hurt.
description_de: Ein Kaktus, wie er stachliger nicht sein könnte. Schon der leichteste Kontakt schmerzt.
description_fr: Le cactus suprême. Il suffit d'effleurer ses épines pour souffrir énormément.
description_es: El cactus definitivo. El mero contacto con sus espinas causa terribles dolores.
description_it: Un cactus maestoso. Basta sfiorarne le spine per patire dolori lancinanti.
description_zh: The ultimate cactus plant, just touching its spines can put you in a world of hurt.

name: Dosbiscus
description: A large, beautifully colored flowering plant foreign to this land.
description_de: Eine große Pflanze mit wunderschönen Blüten; nicht aus diesem Land.
description_fr: Grande fleur venue d'ailleurs, aux couleurs éclatantes.
description_es: Planta de flores grandes, bellas y de colores. Extraña en estas tierras.
description_it: Una grande pianta fiorita dai bellissimi colori, estranea a queste terre.
description_zh: A large, beautifully colored flowering plant foreign to this land.

name: Heftcorn
description: Gigantic corn that's difficult to cultivate in this region. It's packed with kernels.
description_de: Riesiger Maiskolben, der in dieser Region schwer anbaubar ist. Voller Körner.
description_fr: Maïs géant difficile à cultiver dans cette région. Regorge de grains.
description_es: Maíz gigante difícil de cultivar en esta región. Tiene forma de mazorca.
description_it: Mais gigantesco pieno di chicchi; difficilmente coltivabile nella regione.
description_zh: Gigantic corn that's difficult to cultivate in this region. It's packed with kernels.

name: Stargazer Flower
description: A plant that looks to the heavens when it blooms. Its petals are used to make dye.
description_de: Sie schaut zum Himmel, während sie blüht. Ihre Blütenblätter liefern einen Farbstoff.
description_fr: Regarde le ciel à la floraison. Ses pétales entrent dans la composition de colorants.
description_es: Planta que apunta a los cielos cuando florece. Sus pétalos se usan para extraer un tinte.
description_it: Pianta che sboccia rivolta al cielo. Dai suoi petali si ricavano tinture.
description_zh: A plant that looks to the heavens when it blooms. Its petals are used to make dye.

name: Prismatic Dandelion
description: A pretty dandelion with petals of various colors. It's used for making dyes.
description_de: Hübscher Löwenzahn mit farbigen Blütenblättern für die Farbstoffgewinnung.
description_fr: Joli pissenlit. Ses pétales sont utilisés pour la fabrication de colorants.
description_es: Hermoso diente de león con pétalos de distintos colores. Se usa para hacer tintes.
description_it: Meraviglioso tarassaco con petali di vari colori dai quali si ricavano tinture.
description_zh: A pretty dandelion with petals of various colors. It's used for making dyes.

name: Immaculate Ore
description: This piece of ore is small but somehow perfect. Used for forging and upgrading armor.
description_de: Kleines, aber perfekt geschliffe- nes Erzstück. Taugt zur Verbes- serung von Rüstung und Waffen.
description_fr: Un minerai de petite taille mais néanmoins parfait. Sert à forger et à améliorer les armures.
description_es: Un trozo pequeño pero perfecto de mineral. Se usa para forjar y mejorar armaduras.
description_it: Pezzetto di minerale perfetto, usato per forgiare e potenziare le armature.
description_zh: This piece of ore is small but somehow perfect. Used for forging and upgrading armor.

name: Dragonvine
description: Legend says that wherever an ancient dragon stepped, this vine grew. Used to make armor.
description_de: Wächst laut Legenden in Fußstapfen von Drachen. Dient als Material für Ausrüstung.
description_fr: On dit que cette plante pousse où un dragon ancien a foulé le sol. Sert à confectionner des armures.
description_es: Dicen que solo crece donde haya pisado un dragón anciano. Se usa para crear armaduras.
description_it: Leggenda vuole che questa vite cresca dove i draghi antichi passavano. Usata per armature.
description_zh: Legend says that wherever an ancient dragon stepped, this vine grew. Used to make armor.

name: Tough Dragonvine
description: This high quality vine is said to grow where ancient dragons slept. Used to make armor.
description_de: Wächst laut Legenden an Schlafplätzen von Drachen. Dient als Material für Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Ce lierre supérieur pousserait où un dragon ancien s'est assoupi. Sert à confectionner des armures.
description_es: Dicen que solo crece donde haya dormido un dragón anciano. Se usa para crear armaduras.
description_it: Leggenda vuole che questa vite cresca dove i draghi antichi dormivano. Usata per armature.
description_zh: This high quality vine is said to grow where ancient dragons slept. Used to make armor.

name: Blue Mushroom
description: Rare mushroom with a power-enhancing effect.
description_de: Seltener Pilz, der die Kräfte steigert.
description_fr: Champignon rare qui catalyse la puissance des potions.
description_es: Extraña seta que aumenta la potencia.
description_it: Raro fungo che ha l'effetto di aumentare la potenza.
description_zh: Rare mushroom with a power-enhancing effect.

name: Nitroshroom
description: A hard-to-find mushroom with the power to generate blazing heat.
description_de: Ein schwer zu findender Pilz, der enorme Hitze erzeugen kann.
description_fr: Champignon rare aux propriétés hautement thermiques.
description_es: Seta poco frecuente con la capacidad de generar un calor abrasador.
description_it: Un fungo raro in grado di generare un forte calore.
description_zh: A hard-to-find mushroom with the power to generate blazing heat.

name: Parashroom
description: A mushroom that induces paralysis.
description_de: Ein Pilz, der Lähmung herbeiführt.
description_fr: Champignon aux effets paralysants.
description_es: Seta con un efecto paralizante.
description_it: Fungo che provoca paralisi.
description_zh: A mushroom that induces paralysis.

name: Toadstool
description: Logic says not to eat this poisonous fungus, but don't write it off completely.
description_de: Die Vernunft verbietet, den giftigen Pilz zu essen, aber schreib ihn nicht völlig ab.
description_fr: La logique dit de ne pas le manger. Mais ne le jetez pas pour autant.
description_es: La lógica dice que no deberías comerte esta seta venenosa, pero nunca se sabe.
description_it: La logica direbbe di non mangiare mai un fungo velenoso, eppure...
description_zh: Logic says not to eat this poisonous fungus, but don't write it off completely.

name: Mopeshroom
description: A mushroom that contains a Stamina-stealing constituent.
description_de: Dieser Pilz enthält eine Komponente, die die Ausdauer schwächt.
description_fr: Champignon contenant un élément qui fait disparaître la stamina.
description_es: Seta con un componente que reduce la resistencia.
description_it: Fungo ricolmo di tossine che riducono la resistenza.
description_zh: A mushroom that contains a Stamina-stealing constituent.

name: Exciteshroom
description: This one has a very strange aroma... But is it edible? Only one way to find out.
description_de: Ein Pilz mit einem seltsamen Geruch. Essbar? Es gibt nur eine Art, es herauszufinden.
description_fr: Champignon à l'odeur étrange... Que provoquerait sa consommation ?
description_es: Seta con un aroma muy extraño. ¿Qué pasará si te la comes...?
description_it: Fungo con un odore molto strano. C'è solo un modo per sapere se è commestibile...
description_zh: This one has a very strange aroma... But is it edible? Only one way to find out.

name: Dragon Toadstool
description: A dangerous fungus said to draw the life out of people. Beware.
description_de: Ein gefährlicher Pilz, der Lebenskraft entziehen soll. Vorsicht!
description_fr: Champignon dangereux qui draine l'énergie vitale. Prudence !
description_es: Peligroso hongo del que se rumorea que drena la energía vital. Ten mucho cuidado.
description_it: Un fungo pericoloso; si dice che sottragga vita alle persone. Attento.
description_zh: A dangerous fungus said to draw the life out of people. Beware.

name: Chaos Mushroom
description: A mushroom that invites disarray. Its spores cause monsters to hallucinate.
description_de: Erzeugt angeblich Chaos. Die Sporen bringen Monster zum Halluzinieren.
description_fr: Supposé causer le chaos. Ses spores peuvent faire halluciner les monstres.
description_es: Se dice que causa el caos. Sus esporas hacen alucinar a los monstruos.
description_it: Si dice che provochi il caos. Le sue spore danno allucinazioni ai mostri.
description_zh: A mushroom that invites disarray. Its spores cause monsters to hallucinate.

name: Bindshroom
description: A giant paralyzing mushroom. Just one touch can immobilize you, so handle with care!
description_de: Ein riesiger, lähmender Pilz. Vorsicht, wirkt schon bei leichtester Berührung!
description_fr: Champignon paralysant géant. Un seul contact et vous voilà immobilisé.
description_es: Seta paralizante gigante. ¡Cuidado, con solo tocarla te inmoviliza!
description_it: Fungo paralizzante gigante. Fai attenzione: basta toccarlo per immobilizzarti!
description_zh: A giant paralyzing mushroom. Just one touch can immobilize you, so handle with care!

name: Reststool
description: A large, poisonous mushroom. It looks like a comfy chair, but it's not worth the risk.
description_de: Großer Giftpilz, der wie ein Stuhl aussieht, zum Sitzen aber zu gefährlich ist.
description_fr: Gros champignon vénéneux qui donne envie de s'asseoir. Mais mieux vaut s'abstenir.
description_es: Seta grande y venenosa. Tiene forma de cómodo sillón, pero no merece la pena arriesgarse.
description_it: Grosso fungo velenoso. Sembra una comoda sedia, ma non conviene rischiare.
description_zh: A large, poisonous mushroom. It looks like a comfy chair, but it's not worth the risk.

name: Paintberry
description: A berry with a shocking hue and an overwhelming scent. Look out: it WILL stain!
description_de: Eine Beere mit grässlicher Farbe und überwältigendem Duft. Vorsicht vor Flecken!
description_fr: Baie de couleur vive au parfum enivrant. Attention, ça tache !
description_es: Baya de color impactante y aroma sobrecogedor. Cuidado: mancha.
description_it: Una bacca dal colore vistoso e dall'odore penetrante. Avvertenza: non è lavabile!
description_zh: A berry with a shocking hue and an overwhelming scent. Look out: it WILL stain!

name: Might Seed
description: Temporarily raises your Attack when ingested by improving energy flow.
description_de: Steigert vorübergehend die Angriffskraft durch besseren Energiefluss.
description_fr: Améliore le flux d'énergie pour augmenter temporairement l'attaque.
description_es: Mejora el flujo energético y aumenta temporalmente el ataque.
description_it: Se lo ingerisci, migliora il flusso energetico e aumenta temporaneamente l'attacco.
description_zh: Temporarily raises your Attack when ingested by improving energy flow.

name: Adamant Seed
description: Temporarily raises your Defense when ingested by hardening tissue.
description_de: Steigert vorübergehend die Verteidigung durch Gewebeverhärtung.
description_fr: Durcit les tissus musculeux pour augmenter temporairement la défense.
description_es: Endurece los tejidos y aumenta temporalmente la defensa.
description_it: Se lo ingerisci, indurisce i tessuti e migliora temporaneamente la difesa.
description_zh: Temporarily raises your Defense when ingested by hardening tissue.

name: Nulberry
description: A mysterious berry that cures various Blights and also protects from unknown viruses.
description_de: Geheimnisvolle Beere, die verschiedene Schäden heilt und vor Viren schützt.
description_fr: Baie mystérieuse qui guérit divers fléaux et protège de virus inconnus.
description_es: Baya misteriosa que cura varias plagas y protege de virus desconocidos.
description_it: Misteriosa bacca che cura i danni elementali e protegge da virus sconosciuti.
description_zh: A mysterious berry that cures various Blights and also protects from unknown viruses.

name: Dragonfell Berry
description: A mysterious berry, rumored since ancient times to be loathed by dragons.
description_de: Eine geheimnisvolle Beere, die Drachen angeblich seit Urzeiten verabscheuen.
description_fr: Baie mystérieuse. Les dragons la détestent depuis la nuit des temps.
description_es: Baya misteriosa que, según cuenta la leyenda, detestan los dragones.
description_it: Misteriosa bacca che si dice sia da sempre temuta dai draghi.
description_zh: A mysterious berry, rumored since ancient times to be loathed by dragons.

name: Scatternut
description: A nut that violently ejects its contents when struck.
description_de: Eine Nuss, die bei Aufprall heftig ihren Inhalt nach außen schleudert.
description_fr: Noix qui éjecte violemment son contenu lorsqu'elle subit un choc.
description_es: Fruto seco que expulsa el contenido violentamente al romperse.
description_it: Una noce che scaglia violentemente il contenuto se subisce un impatto.
description_zh: A nut that violently ejects its contents when struck.

name: Needleberry
description: A berry covered with needle- like thorns. Used as a material for ammo.
description_de: Mit spitzen Dornen übersäte Beere. Wird als Material für Munition verwendet.
description_fr: Baie couverte d'épines semblables à des aiguilles. Utilisée pour des munitions.
description_es: Baya cubierta de espinas parecidas a agujas. Se usa para munición.
description_it: Bacca ricoperta di aculei pungenti come aghi. È usata per produrre munizioni.
description_zh: A berry covered with needle- like thorns. Used as a material for ammo.

name: Latchberry
description: A berry with spiral grooves. It spins when it falls to firmly embed itself in soil.
description_de: Hat spiralförmige Rillen. Dreht sich im Fall, um sich fest im Boden zu verankern.
description_fr: Baie présentant des rainures en spirale. S'enfonce en tournant quand elle tombe.
description_es: Baya con ranuras en espiral. Gira al caer para incrustarse en el suelo.
description_it: Bacca con scanalature a spirale. Quando cade si avvita, piantandosi a terra.
description_zh: A berry with spiral grooves. It spins when it falls to firmly embed itself in soil.

name: Bomberry
description: A berry that explodes when struck.
description_de: Eine Beere, die bei Aufprall explodiert.
description_fr: Baie qui explose lorsqu'elle subit un choc.
description_es: Baya que explota al sufrir un impacto.
description_it: Una bacca che esplode se subisce un impatto.
description_zh: A berry that explodes when struck.

name: Bumblepumpkin
description: A trendy orange pumpkin. If left undisturbed, it can grow to gigantic proportions.
description_de: Ein beliebter Kürbis. Wenn man ihn in Ruhe lässt, kann er riesengroß werden.
description_fr: Un potiron orange. Il peut atteindre des proportions gigantesques.
description_es: Moderna calabaza naranja. Si se la deja crecer, puede hacerse gigantesca.
description_it: Simpatica zucca arancione. Lasciata crescere può diventare enorme.
description_zh: A trendy orange pumpkin. If left undisturbed, it can grow to gigantic proportions.

name: Giant Acorn
description: An extremely large and firm acorn. The tree that it grows from is said to be gigantic.
description_de: Extragroße, stabile Eichel. Der entsprechende Baum ist angeblich gigantisch.
description_fr: Très grosse et très ferme. Provient d'un arbre qui serait gigantesque.
description_es: Bellota de gran tamaño y dureza. Se dice que crece en un árbol gigantesco.
description_it: Ghianda molto grande e dura. Dicono cresca su alberi colossali.
description_zh: An extremely large and firm acorn. The tree that it grows from is said to be gigantic.

name: Spiky Acorn
description: An acorn with a very sharp tip. It's especially hard before it turns ripe.
description_de: Eine Eichel mit sehr scharfer Spitze. Vor ihrer Reifung ist sie besonders hart.
description_fr: Châtaigne au bout très pointu. Particulièrement dure lorsqu'elle n'est pas mûre.
description_es: Bellota de punta muy afilada. Es especialmente dura antes de madurar.
description_it: Ghianda dalla punta lunga e aguzza. Prima di maturare è ancora più dura al tatto.
description_zh: An acorn with a very sharp tip. It's especially hard before it turns ripe.

name: Yukumo Wood
description: A hearty tree that grows near Yukumo Village. It's pliable and easy to craft.
description_de: Ein uriger Baum, aus der Gegend um Yukumo stammend. Biegsam und leicht zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Arbre solide qui pousse près du village Yukumo. Très souple, on en fait ce que l'on veut.
description_es: Frondoso árbol que crece cerca de Yukumo. Es flexible y fácil de trabajar.
description_it: Albero robusto che cresce vicino a Yukumo. È flessibile e facile da lavorare.
description_zh: A hearty tree that grows near Yukumo Village. It's pliable and easy to craft.

name: Yukumo Hardwood
description: A tree of high quality that grows near Yukumo Village. It's widely used as lumber.
description_de: Ein edler Baum, aus der Gegend um Yukumo stammend. Wird als Nutzholz verwendet.
description_fr: Arbre de qualité qui pousse près du village Yukumo. Très utilisé dans la construction.
description_es: Árbol de gran calidad que crece cerca de Yukumo. Su madera se utiliza mucho.
description_it: Albero pregiato che cresce vicino a Yukumo. Se ne ricava principalmente legname.
description_zh: A tree of high quality that grows near Yukumo Village. It's widely used as lumber.

name: Yukumo Stoutwood
description: A sturdy tree that grows near Yukumo Village. It's so rare, you can't buy the wood anywhere.
description_de: Stabiles Holz aus der Gegend um Yukumo. So selten, dass man es auf keinem Markt kaufen kann.
description_fr: Arbre robuste qui pousse près du village Yukumo. Si rare que son bois n'est vendu nulle part ailleurs.
description_es: Proviene de un árbol muy robusto que solo crece cerca de Yukumo. No la venden en ninguna parte.
description_it: Legno resistente che cresce vicino a Yukumo. È molto raro e non si può comprare ovunque.
description_zh: A sturdy tree that grows near Yukumo Village. It's so rare, you can't buy the wood anywhere.

name: Stone
description: A small rock. Can be thrown.
description_de: Ein kleiner Brocken, der geworfen werden kann.
description_fr: Un petit caillou. Il peut être lancé.
description_es: Una piedra pequeña. Puede servir para lanzarla.
description_it: Una piccola pietra. Si può lanciare.
description_zh: A small rock. Can be thrown.

name: Iron Ore
description: Ore that can be smelted into metal and used for many different purposes.
description_de: Eisenerz kann zu Metall geschmolzen und vielseitig verwendet werden.
description_fr: Ce minerai peut être fondu en métal et utilisé pour de nombreux usages.
description_es: Un fragmento de hierro que puedes fundir y usar para distintos fines.
description_it: Minerale utilizzato per la produzione di metalli di uso comune.
description_zh: Ore that can be smelted into metal and used for many different purposes.

name: Earth Crystal
description: Crystallized microbes which are prized as an abrasive when forging weapons.
description_de: Kristallisierte Mikroben, die beim Waffenschmieden als Schleifmittel dienen.
description_fr: Les restes cristallisés d'organismes microbiotiques. Abrasif pour arme.
description_es: Microbios cristalizados que se utilizan como abrasivo en la forja de armas.
description_it: Microbi cristallizzati, usati come abrasivo nella forgiatura delle armi.
description_zh: Crystallized microbes which are prized as an abrasive when forging weapons.

name: Machalite Ore
description: An ore that yields better metals than Iron Ore. Used to make Machalite.
description_de: Hochwertiger als Eisenerz, wird zur Machalit-Herstellung verwendet.
description_fr: Minerai supérieur au fer. Surnommé la "pierre de moineau".
description_es: Un mineral que produce metales superiores al hierro. Usado para hacer machalita.
description_it: Minerale che produce metalli migliori rispetto al ferro.
description_zh: An ore that yields better metals than Iron Ore. Used to make Machalite.

name: Disc Stone
description: A disc-shaped stone. Not recommended to throw at your friends.
description_de: Ein scheibenförmiger Stein.
description_fr: Pierre en forme de disque. Ne la lancez pas sur vos compagnons !
description_es: Una piedra en forma de disco. No recomendada para lanzarla a tus amigos.
description_it: Una pietra a forma di disco.
description_zh: A disc-shaped stone. Not recommended to throw at your friends.

name: Ice Crystal
description: Ice that will not melt at room temperature. Can be used to create denser ore.
description_de: Schmilzt bei Raumtemperatur nicht. Dient zum Herstellen dichterer Erze.
description_fr: Ne fond pas à température ambiante. Peut augmenter la densité des minerais.
description_es: No se derrite a temperatura ambiente. Aumenta la densidad de los minerales.
description_it: Ghiaccio che non si scioglie a temperatura ambiente. Rende più densi i minerali.
description_zh: Ice that will not melt at room temperature. Can be used to create denser ore.

name: Bealite Ore
description: An ore that contains high amounts of gold. Can be used to create stronger metals.
description_de: Ein Gestein mit hohem Gold- anteil. Wird zur Gewinnung stärkerer Metalle verwendet.
description_fr: Minerai très aurifère, utilisable pour l'élaboration de métaux très résistants.
description_es: Mineral con alto contenido en oro. Se puede usar para crear metales más fuertes.
description_it: Minerale ricco di oro. Viene utilizzato per forgiare metalli più resistenti.
description_zh: An ore that contains high amounts of gold. Can be used to create stronger metals.

name: Lightcrystal
description: An extremely hard substance with a faint glow. Sometimes used for crafting tools.
description_de: Sehr harte, leicht leuchtende Substanz, die sich auch zur Werkzeugherstellung eignet.
description_fr: Cristal très dur doté d'un léger éclat. Utilisé pour fabriquer des outils.
description_es: Cristal de brillo tenue. Muy duro, se usa para herramientas en armería.
description_it: Un materiale durissimo e dal leggero bagliore. A volte lo si usa per le lavorazioni.
description_zh: An extremely hard substance with a faint glow. Sometimes used for crafting tools.

name: Dragonite Ore
description: An ore that yields metal superior to that of Machalite. Rare and valuable.
description_de: Erz, das noch hochwertigeres Metall als Machalit liefert. Selten und kostbar.
description_fr: Minerai rare et précieux, supérieur à la machalite.
description_es: Una roca de metal de mejores propiedades que la machalita. Valiosa y poco frecuente.
description_it: Minerale che produce metalli migliori rispetto alla machalite. Raro e prezioso.
description_zh: An ore that yields metal superior to that of Machalite. Rare and valuable.

name: Firestone
description: Combusts even at room temperature. Its high heat can be used to fuse materials.
description_de: Geht bei Raumtemperatur in Flammen auf. Die große Hitze kann Materialien verbinden.
description_fr: Brûle à température ambiante. Sa chaleur élevée peut fusionner les matériaux.
description_es: Arde incluso a temperatura ambiente. Su calor sirve para fundir materiales.
description_it: Brucia anche a temperatura ambiente. Molto calda, serve per fondere i materiali.
description_zh: Combusts even at room temperature. Its high heat can be used to fuse materials.

name: Allfire Stone
description: An ore that blazes with an all-consuming flame. Requires considerable skill to mine.
description_de: Ein Erz, das mit einer alles verzehrenden Flamme lodert. Sehr schwer abzubauen.
description_fr: Minerai qui brûle en continu. Une grande habileté est requise pour l'extraire.
description_es: Mineral que arde con una llama consumidora. Hay que ser hábil para extraerlo.
description_it: Minerale che brucia con una fiamma divorante. Difficilissimo da estrarre.
description_zh: An ore that blazes with an all-consuming flame. Requires considerable skill to mine.

name: Lava Nugget
description: Melted rock stripped from the body of an Uragaan or Agnaktor. Various ores are mixed within.
description_de: Geschmolzener Stein aus Ura- gaan- oder Agnaktor-Körpern. Enthält verschiedene Erze.
description_fr: Roche fondue extraite d'un Uragaan ou Agnaktor. Contient plusieurs minerais.
description_es: Roca fundida extraída de un Uragaan o un Agnaktor. Lleva varios minerales.
description_it: Roccia fusa strappata da un Uragaan o un Agnaktor. Composta da minerali misti.
description_zh: Melted rock stripped from the body of an Uragaan or Agnaktor. Various ores are mixed within.

name: Carbalite Ore
description: An ore still being researched. It yields even better metal than Dragonite.
description_de: Ein Erz, das noch erforscht wird. Es liefert noch besse- res Metall als Drachenit.
description_fr: Minerai supérieur à la dragonite, qui fait l'objet de nombreuses recherches.
description_es: Mineral experimental de propiedades aún superiores a las de la dragonita.
description_it: Minerale in corso di studio. Produce metalli migliori rispetto alla dragonite.
description_zh: An ore still being researched. It yields even better metal than Dragonite.

name: Eltalite Ore
description: A promising new ore that produces higher quality metal than Carbalite Ore.
description_de: Ein vielversprechendes neues Erz, das besseres Metall als Karbalit liefert.
description_fr: Nouveau minerai qui produit du métal de meilleure qualité que la carbalite.
description_es: Nuevo mineral prometedor que produce metal de mejor calidad que la carbalita.
description_it: Nuovo minerale promettente che produce metalli migliori della Carbalite.
description_zh: A promising new ore that produces higher quality metal than Carbalite Ore.

name: Meldspar Ore
description: An ore composed of a durable, flexible metal that works well as a combining agent.
description_de: Ein Erz aus haltbarem, biegsamem Metall, das sich gut zum Kombinieren eignet.
description_fr: Minerai de métal durable et flexible, parfait comme agent de combinaison.
description_es: Mineral compuesto de metal flexible y duradero. Buen agente de fusión.
description_it: Minerale metallico resistente e flessibile, efficacissimo nelle combinazioni.
description_zh: An ore composed of a durable, flexible metal that works well as a combining agent.

name: Novacrystal
description: A brightly glowing crystal. Extremely hard, it's also used to make armory tools.
description_de: Ein hell strahlender Kristall. Extrem hart. Für Werkzeuge in der Waffenkammer.
description_fr: Cristal très brillant et extrêmement dur, utilisé dans l'armurerie.
description_es: Cristal resplandeciente. Muy duro, se usa para herramientas en armería.
description_it: Cristallo brillante. Estremamente duro, è usato per attrezzi in armeria.
description_zh: A brightly glowing crystal. Extremely hard, it's also used to make armory tools.

name: Purecrystal
description: A crystal that's 100% pure. Hard enough to be used in workshop tools.
description_de: 100 Prozent reiner Kristall. Wird wegen seiner Härte für Werkzeuge genutzt.
description_fr: Un cristal totalement pur. Assez solide pour être utilisé en atelier.
description_es: Cristal puro. Es tan duro que se puede usar para herramientas de taller.
description_it: Cristallo purissimo e duro. Ottimo per creare attrezzi da laboratorio.
description_zh: A crystal that's 100% pure. Hard enough to be used in workshop tools.

name: Fucium Ore
description: Ore composed of a mysterious metal; capable of fusing nearly any two materials together.
description_de: Ein Erz aus mysteriösem Metall, das fast alle Materialien verbinden kann.
description_fr: Métal mystérieux qui peut amalgamer presque tous les matériaux.
description_es: Mineral compuesto de metal misterioso, capaz de unir casi todos los materiales.
description_it: Minerale metallico misterioso che può legare coppie di materiali di ogni tipo.
description_zh: Ore composed of a mysterious metal; capable of fusing nearly any two materials together.

name: Firecell Stone
description: A magma-like deposit that only trained hands can properly work with.
description_de: Magmaartige Ablagerung, die nur von Experten richtig verarbeitet werden kann.
description_fr: Pierre semblable à du magma. Seuls les experts savent la manier.
description_es: Sedimento de aspecto similar al magma. Solo los más expertos saben cómo trabajar con él.
description_it: Minerale simile a magma. Richiede grande esperienza per essere lavorato.
description_zh: A magma-like deposit that only trained hands can properly work with.

name: Rainbow Ore
description: A beautiful multi-colored ore. Colors and properties depend on many variables.
description_de: Wunderschönes Erz. Farbe und Eigenschaften können variieren.
description_fr: Superbe minerai. Ses couleurs et propriétés dépendent de nombreuses variables.
description_es: Bello mineral cuyo color y propiedades dependen de muchas variables.
description_it: Splendido minerale. Colori e proprietà dipendono da molte variabili.
description_zh: A beautiful multi-colored ore. Colors and properties depend on many variables.

name: Pristine Ore
description: An exquisite ore sure to elicit a gasp from veteran smiths. Used for forging and upgrading armor.
description_de: Extrem dichtes Erz, das selbst erfahrene Schmiede verblüfft. Zur Verbesserung von Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Son éclat éblouira même le plus chevronné des forgerons. Sert à créer et améliorer des armures.
description_es: Mineral muy valioso alabado por los mejores artesanos. Se usa para forjar y mejorar armaduras.
description_it: Minerale ad alta densità, amato dai fabbri più esperti. Serve per creare e potenziare armature.
description_zh: An exquisite ore sure to elicit a gasp from veteran smiths. Used for forging and upgrading armor.

name: Ultimas Crystal
description: A crystal used to reinforce metal. It improves both durability and shock absorbency.
description_de: Ein Kristall, der Haltbarkeit und Flexibilität von Metall erhöht.
description_fr: Cristal pouvant renforcer la durabilité et la résistance aux chocs des métaux.
description_es: Se usa para reforzar el metal, que se vuelve más duradero y amortigua mejor los golpes.
description_it: Usato per rinforzare il metallo. Migliora la resistenza e l'effetto di assorbimento dei colpi.
description_zh: A crystal used to reinforce metal. It improves both durability and shock absorbency.

name: Aquaglow Jewel
description: An indispensable item used in Decorations.
description_de: Ein unverzichtbares Objekt für Dekorationen.
description_fr: Composant indispensable pour les décorations.
description_es: Una joya indispensable en lo referente a decoración.
description_it: Un oggetto indispensabile usato nelle decorazioni.
description_zh: An indispensable item used in Decorations.

name: Sunspire Jewel
description: An indispensable item used in Decorations.
description_de: Ein unverzichtbares Objekt für Dekorationen.
description_fr: Composant indispensable pour les décorations.
description_es: Una joya indispensable en lo referente a decoración.
description_it: Un oggetto indispensabile usato nelle decorazioni.
description_zh: An indispensable item used in Decorations.

name: Bloodrun Jewel
description: An indispensable item used in Decorations. A shame that these are so high-end.
description_de: Ein unverzichtbares Objekt für Dekorationen. Leider übertrieben teurer Luxus.
description_fr: Composant indispensable pour les décorations. Hors de prix.
description_es: Una joya indispensable en lo referente a decoración. Una pena que sea tan cara.
description_it: Oggetto fondamentale usato nelle decorazioni. Purtroppo è molto costoso!
description_zh: An indispensable item used in Decorations. A shame that these are so high-end.

name: Lazurite Jewel
description: An indispensable item used in Decorations. This one doesn't come along often.
description_de: Ein unverzichtbares Objekt für Dekorationen. Man findet es nur selten.
description_fr: Composant indispensable pour les décorations. Très rare.
description_es: Una joya indispensable en lo referente a decoración. Muy escasa.
description_it: Un oggetto indispensabile usato nelle decorazioni. Non si vede spesso.
description_zh: An indispensable item used in Decorations. This one doesn't come along often.

name: Adamant Orb
description: An indispensable item used in Decorations. A rare orb that houses immense power.
description_de: Unverzichtbares Dekorations- objekt. Seltene Kugel mit gewaltiger Kraft.
description_fr: Objet indispensable utilisé pour les décorations. Orbe à l'immense pouvoir.
description_es: Una joya indispensable en lo referente a decoración. Alberga un gran poder.
description_it: Oggetto fondamentale usato nelle decorazioni. Globo raro e dall'immenso potere.
description_zh: An indispensable item used in Decorations. A rare orb that houses immense power.

name: Sovereign Orb
description: An indispensable item used in Decorations. Rare and brimming with fierce power.
description_de: Unverzichtbares Deko-Objekt. Selten und strotzend vor wilder Kraft.
description_fr: Objet indispensable utilisé pour les décorations. Rare et débordant de puissance.
description_es: Objeto indispensable usado como adorno. Raro y dotado de un poder feroz.
description_it: Oggetto molto utilizzato nelle decorazioni. Raro e percorso da un potere selvaggio.
description_zh: An indispensable item used in Decorations. Rare and brimming with fierce power.

name: Armor Stone
description: Reacts uniquely to heat. Combine with other materials to create equipment coating.
description_de: Einmalige Hitzereaktion. In Materialkombination geeignet für Ausrüstungsbeschichtung.
description_fr: Réaction unique à la chaleur. Produit un enduit avec d'autres matériaux.
description_es: Su reacción única al calor permite crear revestimientos para el equipo.
description_it: Reagisce in modo unico al calore. Se combinata, può rivestire l'equipaggiamento.
description_zh: Reacts uniquely to heat. Combine with other materials to create equipment coating.

name: Armor Sphere
description: Reacts uniquely to heat. Fuse this to equipment to increase its strength.
description_de: Einzigartige Hitzereaktion. Erhöht die Widerstandskraft der Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Réaction unique à la chaleur. À fusionner avec un équipement.
description_es: Su reacción única al calor permite aumentar la fuerza del equipo.
description_it: Reagisce in modo unico al calore. Se fusa, rende più robusto l'equipaggiamento.
description_zh: Reacts uniquely to heat. Fuse this to equipment to increase its strength.

name: Armor Sphere+
description: Fuse this high-quality Armor Sphere to existing equipment to increase its strength.
description_de: Für hochwertige Rüstungen. Erhöht die Widerstandskraft bestehender Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Sphère d'armure haute qualité. À fusionner avec un équipement.
description_es: Funde esta esfera de gran calidad con una pieza de equipo para aumentar su fuerza.
description_it: Fondi questa pregiata sfera al tuo equipaggiamento per aumentarne la resistenza.
description_zh: Fuse this high-quality Armor Sphere to existing equipment to increase its strength.

name: Adv Armor Sphere
description: A dense, rigid Armor Sphere. Rare, but enables higher- level equipment upgrades.
description_de: Dichte, seltene Rüstkugel. Ermöglicht Ausrüstungsver- besserungen höherer Stufen.
description_fr: Rigide et compacte. Rare, mais offre des améliorations d'équipement supérieures.
description_es: Esfera densa y rígida. Muy escasa, pero permite mejorar más el equipo.
description_it: Sfera densa e rigida. È molto rara, ma garantisce potenziamenti eccezionali.
description_zh: A dense, rigid Armor Sphere. Rare, but enables higher- level equipment upgrades.

name: Hard Armor Sphere
description: A thick, dense Armor Sphere. Use this precious rarity to push equipment to the limit.
description_de: Dicke, dichte Rüstkugel. Wertvolle Rarität für exzellente Rüstungen.
description_fr: Sphère d'armure très rare, utilisée pour forger des armures résistantes.
description_es: Esfera de armadura gruesa y densa. Esta rareza potencia tu equipo considerablemente.
description_it: Sfera densa, pesante e molto rara. Garantisce potenziamenti di alto livello.
description_zh: A thick, dense Armor Sphere. Use this precious rarity to push equipment to the limit.

name: Heavy Armor Sphere
description: A thick, dense Armor Sphere. Use this precious rarity to push armor to the limit.
description_de: Dicke, dichte Rüstkugel. Wertvolle Rarität für beste Rüstungen.
description_fr: Sphère d'armure dense et épaisse. Très rare, crée des armures étonnantes.
description_es: Esfera de armadura gruesa y densa. Esta rareza potencia las armaduras al máximo.
description_it: Sfere dure, dense e preziose che consentono di migliorare le armature al massimo.
description_zh: A thick, dense Armor Sphere. Use this precious rarity to push armor to the limit.

name: King Armor Sphere
description: A brightly glowing Armor Sphere. Use this scarce commodity to take your armor to new heights.
description_de: Eine hell leuchtende Rüstkugel, die extrem selten ist. Verstärkt Rüstungen.
description_fr: Sphère d'armure rayonnante et très rare. Peut porter une armure vers de nouveaux sommets.
description_es: Esfera de armadura de alta calidad, un recurso escaso que potencia mucho las armaduras.
description_it: Sfera-armatura brillante e rara. Viene usata per potenziare le armature come mai prima.
description_zh: A brightly glowing Armor Sphere. Use this scarce commodity to take your armor to new heights.

name: True Armor Sphere
description: An Armor Sphere of near-perfect purity. Its abilities require advanced techniques to extract.
description_de: Rüstkugel von fast perfekter Reinheit. Nur die Besten schaffen es, sie zu nutzen.
description_fr: Sphère d'armure quasiment pure. Son potentiel est libéré par des techniques avancées.
description_es: Esfera de armadura de gran pureza. Requiere técnicas avanzadas de extracción.
description_it: Sfera-armatura di elevata purezza. Servono grandi doti per liberarne il potenziale.
description_zh: An Armor Sphere of near-perfect purity. Its abilities require advanced techniques to extract.

name: Mystery Charm
description: A modest good luck charm. What does it do? Finish the Quest and you'll find out.
description_de: Schlichtes Glücksamulett. Was es bewirkt? Nach der Quest weißt du es!
description_fr: Petit porte-bonheur. Finissez la quête pour découvrir ses effets.
description_es: Modesto amuleto de la suerte. ¿Qué hace? Termina la aventura y lo averiguarás.
description_it: Un modesto portafortuna. A cosa serve? Concludi la missione e lo saprai!
description_zh: A modest good luck charm. What does it do? Finish the Quest and you'll find out.

name: Shining Charm
description: A curious good luck charm. What does it do? Finish the Quest and you'll find out.
description_de: Sonderbares Glücksamulett. Was es bewirkt? Nach der Quest weißt du es!
description_fr: Porte-bonheur étrange. Finissez la quête pour découvrir ses effets.
description_es: Curioso amuleto de la suerte. ¿Qué hace? Termina la aventura y lo averiguarás.
description_it: Un curioso portafortuna. A cosa serve? Concludi la missione e lo saprai!
description_zh: A curious good luck charm. What does it do? Finish the Quest and you'll find out.

name: Timeworn Charm
description: A powerful good luck charm. What does it do? Finish the Quest and you'll find out.
description_de: Kraftvolles Glücksamulett. Was es bewirkt? Nach der Quest weißt du es!
description_fr: Porte-bonheur puissant. Finissez la quête pour découvrir ses effets.
description_es: Poderoso amuleto de la suerte. ¿Qué hace? Termina la aventura y lo averiguarás.
description_it: Un potente portafortuna. A cosa serve? Concludi la missione e lo saprai!
description_zh: A powerful good luck charm. What does it do? Finish the Quest and you'll find out.

name: Enduring Charm
description: A mysterious good-luck charm. What does it do? Finish the Quest and you'll find out.
description_de: Mysteriöses Glücksamulett. Was es bewirkt? Nach der Quest weißt du es!
description_fr: Gri-gri mystérieux. Finissez la quête pour découvrir ses effets.
description_es: Misterioso amuleto de la suerte. ¿Qué hace? Termina la aventura y lo sabrás.
description_it: Un misterioso portafortuna. A cosa serve? Concludi la missione e lo saprai!
description_zh: A mysterious good-luck charm. What does it do? Finish the Quest and you'll find out.

name: Rustshard
description: Looks like a lump of dirt, but it's actually rusted metal. Try polishing it...
description_de: Kein Dreckklumpen, sondern verrostetes Metall. Müsste mal poliert werden!
description_fr: Du métal rouillé qui ressemble à un morceau de terre. Il faut le polir.
description_es: Parece un trozo de tierra, pero es metal oxidado. Prueba a sacarle brillo...
description_it: Sembra un pezzo di terra, ma è metallo arrugginito. Prova a lucidarlo...
description_zh: Looks like a lump of dirt, but it's actually rusted metal. Try polishing it...

name: Ancient Shard
description: A fossil? No, it appears to be metal... With a little polish, it could be more.
description_de: Eine Versteinerung? Nein, es scheint Metall zu sein. Müsste mal poliert werden!
description_fr: Un fossile ? Non, c'est du métal... Mais il faut le polir.
description_es: Parece algún tipo de metal fosilizado. Quizá sea un tesoro si le sacas brillo.
description_it: Un fossile? No, sembra un metallo... Bisognerà pulirlo per saperne di più.
description_zh: A fossil? No, it appears to be metal... With a little polish, it could be more.

name: Rare Fish
description: A lightly braised fish. Recovers the red portion of the Health Gauge when eaten.
description_de: Ein leicht gegrillter Fisch; füllt den roten Bereich des Gesundheitsbalkens auf.
description_fr: Poisson légèrement braisé. Remplit la partie rouge de la jauge de vie.
description_es: Pescado poco hecho. Recupera la parte roja del indicador de salud.
description_it: Se mangiato, ripristina la parte rossa della tua barra vita.
description_zh: A lightly braised fish. Recovers the red portion of the Health Gauge when eaten.

name: Burnt Fish
description: A fish burnt to a crisp. Sometimes recovers Health, but can also cause harm...
description_de: Ein verbrannter Fisch; er kann Gesundheit auffüllen oder dir schaden...
description_fr: Poisson carbonisé. Redonne parfois de la vie, mais peut aussi causer des dommages...
description_es: Pescado tostado crujiente. A veces recupera la salud, pero también puede hacer daño.
description_it: Pesce carbonizzato. A volte ripristina la tua barra vita, ma può far male...
description_zh: A fish burnt to a crisp. Sometimes recovers Health, but can also cause harm...

name: Gourmet Fish
description: Recovers the red portion of the Health Gauge and increases natural recovery.
description_de: Füllt den roten Bereich des Gesundheitsbalkens auf und beschleunigt deine Genesung.
description_fr: Remplit la partie rouge de la jauge de vie et accroît la récupération.
description_es: Recupera la parte roja del indicador de salud y aumenta la recuperación natural.
description_it: Ripristina la parte rossa della tua barra vita e aumenta il recupero naturale.
description_zh: Recovers the red portion of the Health Gauge and increases natural recovery.

name: Whetfish
description: A fish with a dorsal fin hard enough to be used to sharpen weapons.
description_de: Ein Fisch, dessen Rücken- flosse hart genug ist, um damit Waffen zu schärfen.
description_fr: Un poisson doté d'un aileron dorsal assez dur pour aiguiser les armes.
description_es: Pez cuya aleta dorsal es lo bastante dura como para afilar armas.
description_it: Pesce con pinna dorsale abbastanza dura da potervi affilare le armi.
description_zh: A fish with a dorsal fin hard enough to be used to sharpen weapons.

name: Sushifish
description: A fatty fish that can restore a small amount of Health. Helps cure Bleeding.
description_de: Fetthaltiger Fisch, mit dem Gesundheit wiederhergestellt wird. Hilft bei Blutungen.
description_fr: Poisson gras qui permet de récupérer un peu de vie. Utile en cas d'hémorragie.
description_es: Pez graso que restablece un poco de salud al comerlo. Ayuda a curar el sangrado.
description_it: Pesce grasso che ripristina una piccola porzione di barra vita e cura l'emorragia.
description_zh: A fatty fish that can restore a small amount of Health. Helps cure Bleeding.

name: Sleepyfish
description: A fish that contains sleeping agents.
description_de: Ein Fisch, der Schlafmittel enthält.
description_fr: Poisson aux propriétés somnifères. Zzzz...
description_es: Un pez con propiedades somníferas.
description_it: Un pesce con proprietà soporifere.
description_zh: A fish that contains sleeping agents.

name: Pin Tuna
description: A fish with jaws covered in tiny, needle-like spikes.
description_de: Ein Fisch, dessen Kiefer mit feinen, nadelartigen Stacheln besetzt ist.
description_fr: Poisson à la mâchoire couverte de minuscules pointes acérées.
description_es: Un pez con la mandíbula cubierta de púas.
description_it: Un pesce con la mascella ricoperta da minuscole punte aghiformi.
description_zh: A fish with jaws covered in tiny, needle-like spikes.

name: Speartuna
description: A giant fish that's both rare and valuable. It looks like it could be used for something...
description_de: Ein riesiger Fisch, selten und wertvoll. Dient offenbar einem eigenen Zweck...
description_fr: Poisson géant aussi rare que précieux. Doit pouvoir être utile.
description_es: Pez gigante muy valioso y raro. Seguro que se puede usar para algo...
description_it: Pesce gigante, raro e di notevole valore; potrebbe tornare utile...
description_zh: A giant fish that's both rare and valuable. It looks like it could be used for something...

name: Popfish
description: A fish that literally pops when it dies.
description_de: Ein Fisch, der buchstäblich platzt, wenn er stirbt.
description_fr: Poisson qui éclate comme une baudruche lorsqu'il meurt.
description_es: Pez que estalla al morir.
description_it: Un pesce che si apre in due quando viene ucciso.
description_zh: A fish that literally pops when it dies.

name: Scatterfish
description: A fish that splits into little pieces when it dies.
description_de: Ein Fisch, der in kleine Stücke splittert, wenn man ihn tötet.
description_fr: Poisson qui explose en mille morceaux lorsqu'il meurt.
description_es: Pez que al morir se deshace en trocitos.
description_it: Un pesce che va in pezzi quando viene ucciso.
description_zh: A fish that splits into little pieces when it dies.

name: Burst Arowana
description: A fish that bursts open when it dies.
description_de: Ein Fisch, der aufplatzt, wenn man ihn tötet.
description_fr: Poisson qui s'ouvre en deux lorsqu'il meurt.
description_es: Pez que al morir revienta y se abre en dos.
description_it: Un pesce che si spacca quando viene ucciso.
description_zh: A fish that bursts open when it dies.

name: Bomb Arowana
description: A fish that explodes when it dies.
description_de: Ein Fisch, der explodiert, wenn man ihn tötet.
description_fr: Poisson qui vole en éclats lorsqu'il meurt.
description_es: Pez que explota al morir.
description_it: Un pesce che esplode quando viene ucciso.
description_zh: A fish that explodes when it dies.

name: Glutton Tuna
description: A fish that eats anything -- allowing you to sometimes get items from its stomach.
description_de: Ein Fisch, der alles frisst. Dadurch lassen sich Dinge aus seinem Magen bergen.
description_fr: Dévore tout, ce qui vous permet parfois de récupérer des choses à l'intérieur.
description_es: Devora cualquier cosa. Es posible coger de dentro suyo lo que haya devorado.
description_it: Divora cose di ogni tipo e, a volte, è possibile recuperarle dal suo stomaco.
description_zh: A fish that eats anything -- allowing you to sometimes get items from its stomach.

name: Gastronome Tuna
description: An enormous Glutton Tuna. Will eat anything, no matter the size.
description_de: Riesiger Schlemmthunfisch. Verschlingt alles, unab- hängig von der Größe.
description_fr: Un énorme thon glouton. Dévore tout, quelle qu'en soit la taille.
description_es: Un enorme y glotón atún. Puede comerse cualquier cosa, sin importar su tamaño.
description_it: Un enorme tonno-ghiottone. Mangia qualsiasi cosa, non contano le dimensioni.
description_zh: An enormous Glutton Tuna. Will eat anything, no matter the size.

name: Ancient Fish
description: A precious fish; almost every part can be used as material.
description_de: Ein kostbarer Fisch, der fast vollständig aus wertvollen Materialien besteht.
description_fr: Un poisson rare qui peut être utilisé comme matériau.
description_es: Un pez muy valioso del que se aprovechan como materiales casi todas las partes.
description_it: Un prezioso pesce che può essere usato quasi tutto come materiale.
description_zh: A precious fish; almost every part can be used as material.

name: Small Goldenfish
description: A small, rare, gold fish. Commands a high price.
description_de: Ein kleiner, seltener Goldenfisch. Erzielt einen hohen Preis.
description_fr: Petit poisson rare et précieux.
description_es: Pequeño pez de un curioso color dorado. Puede venderse a muy buen precio.
description_it: Un pesce dorato molto piccolo e raro. Viene pagato bene.
description_zh: A small, rare, gold fish. Commands a high price.

name: Wanchovy
description: A fish that can induce exhaustion.
description_de: Ein Fisch, der Ermüdung verursachen kann.
description_fr: Poisson qui peut infliger une grande fatigue.
description_es: Pez que puede inducir fatiga.
description_it: Pesce che può provocare affaticamento.
description_zh: A fish that can induce exhaustion.

name: Blue Cutthroat
description: A fish that emits blue light. Its sharp body will cut you to pieces if you're not careful.
description_de: Ein Fisch, der blaues Licht abgibt. Sein Körper kann dich in Stücke schneiden!
description_fr: Émet une lumière bleue. Attention, son corps acéré peut vous mettre en pièces.
description_es: Pez que emite luz azul. Su cuerpo afilado te cortará si no tienes cuidado.
description_it: Pesce che emette una luce blu. Il suo corpo affilato può ferire se non si fa attenzione.
description_zh: A fish that emits blue light. Its sharp body will cut you to pieces if you're not careful.

name: Humspun Conch
description: A giant, spiked conch shell. If you listen closely, you can hear the melody of the tides within.
description_de: Eine riesige, stachelige Muschel. Wenn du sie ans Ohr hältst, hörst du das Meer.
description_fr: Conque géante à pointes. Approchez votre oreille pour entendre la mer.
description_es: Caracola gigante con púas. Si escuchas bien, oirás el rumor de la marea.
description_it: Grossa conchiglia con spine. Ascoltando bene, si sente la melodia delle maree.
description_zh: A giant, spiked conch shell. If you listen closely, you can hear the melody of the tides within.

name: Armored Bream
description: A fish with massive scales, which have a wyvern-like quality to them.
description_de: Ein Fisch mit riesigen Schuppen, die denen von Wyvern ähneln.
description_fr: Poisson aux écailles géantes, aussi résistantes que celles d'une wyverne.
description_es: Un pez de enormes escamas. Las escamas recuerdan a las de la piel de un wyvern.
description_it: Pesce dalle scaglie grosse, che richiamano quelle di un wyvern.
description_zh: A fish with massive scales, which have a wyvern-like quality to them.

name: Sharqskin
description: The skin of a carnivorous fish. Sought after for its unique feel and texture.
description_de: Die Haut eines Raubfischs. Sie ist aufgrund ihrer beson- deren Beschaffenheit begehrt.
description_fr: Peau de poisson carnivore. Prisée pour son toucher et sa texture uniques.
description_es: Piel de un pez carnívoro. Apreciada por tener un tacto y una textura únicos.
description_it: Pelle di pesce carnivoro molto ambita per l'unicità della sua consistenza.
description_zh: The skin of a carnivorous fish. Sought after for its unique feel and texture.

name: Springnight Carp
description: A species of carp whose arrival signals the start of the breeding season.
description_de: Karpfenspezies, deren Erscheinen den Beginn der Brutsaison ankündigt.
description_fr: Espèce de carpe dont l'arrivée signale la saison de la reproduction.
description_es: Especie de carpa cuya llegada indica el inicio de la temporada de cría.
description_it: Specie di carpa; il suo arrivo denota l'inizio della stagione riproduttiva.
description_zh: A species of carp whose arrival signals the start of the breeding season.

name: Tailed Frog
description: A rare frog that retained its tail. This only happens under special conditions.
description_de: Seltener Frosch mit Schwanz. Gedeiht nur unter bestimmten Bedingungen.
description_fr: Grenouille rare qui a toujours sa queue. Vit dans certains climats.
description_es: Extraña rana que ha perdido la cola, un fenómeno que solo se da en condiciones especiales.
description_it: Un raro anfibio che, a causa di circostanze speciali, ha mantenuto la sua coda.
description_zh: A rare frog that retained its tail. This only happens under special conditions.

name: Guardfish
description: An armored fish with a golden sheen. Sell it at a high price, or use it in crafting.
description_de: Goldener Fisch mit harten Schup- pen. Kann teuer verkauft oder zum Schmieden genutzt werden.
description_fr: Poisson cuirassé aux reflets dorés. Peut être revendu à bon prix ou utilisé à la Forge.
description_es: Pez de escamas duras y de brillo dorado. Véndelo a buen precio o úsalo para forjar equipamiento.
description_it: Pesce con un'armatura luccicante. Puoi venderlo a un prezzo alto o usarlo per forgiare.
description_zh: An armored fish with a golden sheen. Sell it at a high price, or use it in crafting.

name: Insect Husk
description: The remains of a dead insect.
description_de: Die Überreste eines toten Insekts.
description_fr: Les restes d'un insecte mort.
description_es: Los restos de un insecto muerto.
description_it: I resti di un insetto morto.
description_zh: The remains of a dead insect.

name: Godbug
description: An insect said to live for a thousand years.
description_de: Ein Insekt, das angeblich 1000 Jahre alt wird.
description_fr: Insecte supposé vivre pendant mille ans.
description_es: Insecto que supuestamente vive mil años.
description_it: Un insetto che, si dice, viva per mille anni.
description_zh: An insect said to live for a thousand years.

name: Bitterbug
description: A sharp-tasting bug with innate healing abilities. Eat one for a 50% chance of curing Poison.
description_de: Scharfer Käfer mit heilenden Kräften, der mit einer Chance von 50% Gift neutralisiert.
description_fr: Son goût est amer mais offre 50 % de chance de guérir d'un empoisonnement.
description_es: Bicho con propiedades curativas. Come uno y quizá te cure el envenenamiento.
description_it: Insetto dal sapore intenso e con doti curative. Mangiarlo cura il veleno nel 50% dei casi.
description_zh: A sharp-tasting bug with innate healing abilities. Eat one for a 50% chance of curing Poison.

name: Flashbug
description: An insect that emits a powerful flash when it dies.
description_de: Ein Insekt, das beim Sterben einen starken Blitz erzeugt.
description_fr: Insecte qui émet un flash puissant en mourant.
description_es: Insecto que emite un potente destello al morir.
description_it: Un insetto che morendo emette un potente lampo.
description_zh: An insect that emits a powerful flash when it dies.

name: Thunderbug
description: An insect that emits electricity when struck. Has many applications.
description_de: Ein Insekt, das bei Schlägen Strom abgibt. Viele Anwendungsmöglichkeiten.
description_fr: Insecte qui émet de l'électricité lorsqu'il est frappé. Très utile.
description_es: Insecto que desprende electricidad al golpearlo. Puede usarse de muchas formas.
description_it: Un insetto che, se colpito, emette elettricità. Molte possibilità d'uso.
description_zh: An insect that emits electricity when struck. Has many applications.

name: Stinkhopper
description: A grasshopper with a foul odor. Make fishing lures with it; its scent drives explosive fish wild.
description_de: Stinkender Grashüpfer. Guter Angelköder. Der Geruch macht explosive Fische verrückt.
description_fr: Sa mauvaise odeur excite les poissons explosifs.
description_es: Saltamontes de fétido olor. Usado como cebo, vuelve locos a los peces explosivos.
description_it: Cavalletta puzzolente. Usala come esca. I pesci esplosivi sono attratti dal suo odore.
description_zh: A grasshopper with a foul odor. Make fishing lures with it; its scent drives explosive fish wild.

name: Snakebee Larva
description: An unusual larva to make fishing lures with; its scent drives the best fish wild.
description_de: Ungewöhnliche Larve für Fischköder. Der Geruch macht die besten Fische wild.
description_fr: Peu commune. Sert à faire des appâts. Son odeur rend fous les meilleurs poissons.
description_es: Insólita larva usada como cebo; su aroma vuelve locos a los mejores peces.
description_it: Strana larva usata come esca. Manda fuori di testa anche i pesci più scaltri.
description_zh: An unusual larva to make fishing lures with; its scent drives the best fish wild.

name: Stygian Worm
description: Spins a jet-black silk which, when woven into cloth, can withstand wyvern claws.
description_de: Spinnt pechschwarze, extrem feste Seide. Stoffe daraus können Wyvernklauen trotzen.
description_fr: Une fois tissée, sa soie noir de jais peut même résister aux griffes d'une wyverne.
description_es: Dicen que la ropa confeccionada con su seda negra puede resistir incluso las garras de un wyvern.
description_it: Produce seta nera così resistente che le vesti con essa tessute non cedono agli artigli dei wyvern.
description_zh: Spins a jet-black silk which, when woven into cloth, can withstand wyvern claws.

name: Carpenterbug
description: Uses viscous fluids and sharp jaws to construct ant hills that are a sight to behold.
description_de: Nutzt zähe Flüssigkeiten und scharfe Kiefer zum Bau von sehenswerten Ameisenhaufen.
description_fr: Construit des fourmilières grâce à sa mâchoire acérée et ses fluides visqueux.
description_es: Usa fluidos viscosos y la mandíbula para construir hormigueros increíbles.
description_it: Usa fluidi viscosi e fauci affilate per costruire formicai di rara bellezza.
description_zh: Uses viscous fluids and sharp jaws to construct ant hills that are a sight to behold.

name: Shiny Beetle
description: An insect with dazzling wings. Its hard shell is often used as an abrasive.
description_de: Ein Insekt mit grellen Flügeln. Sein harter Panzer dient oft als Schleifmittel.
description_fr: Insecte aux ailes magnifiques. Sa carapace sert d'abrasif.
description_es: Insecto de alas brillantes. Su duro caparazón se suele usar como abrasivo.
description_it: Insetto con ali splendenti. La sua dura corazza ha proprietà abrasive.
description_zh: An insect with dazzling wings. Its hard shell is often used as an abrasive.

name: Hercudrome
description: Said to be the world's strongest bug. Used in forging and other things.
description_de: Der stärkste Käfer der Welt? Wird beim Schmieden und anderen Dingen verwendet.
description_fr: Réputé l'insecte le plus fort au monde. Utilisé entre autres pour le forgeage.
description_es: Dicen que es el bicho más fuerte. Se usa en la forja, entre otras cosas.
description_it: Pare sia l'insetto più forte del mondo. È usato nella forgiatura e non solo.
description_zh: Said to be the world's strongest bug. Used in forging and other things.

name: Fulgurbug
description: Thunderbugs which have been stimulated by Zinogre. They emit a pale blue light.
description_de: Ein Donnerkäfer, stimuliert von einem Zinogre. Er leuchtet blau - fahlblau.
description_fr: Foudrinsecte stimulé par un Zinogre. Il émet une lumière bleu pâle.
description_es: Bichos eléctricos estimulados por un Zinogre. Emiten una tenue luz azul.
description_it: Tipo di insetto-tuono stimolato dagli Zinogre. Emette una luce azzurra.
description_zh: Thunderbugs which have been stimulated by Zinogre. They emit a pale blue light.

name: King Scarab
description: The royal class of the scarabs, with a hard shell and lustrous wings.
description_de: Der König der Skarabäen, mit hartem Panzer und glänzenden Flügeln.
description_fr: Le plus grand des scarabées. Possède une carapace dure et des ailes brillantes.
description_es: Clase real de escarabajos, con duro caparazón y alas lustrosas.
description_it: Re degli scarabei, con una corazza dura e ali lucide.
description_zh: The royal class of the scarabs, with a hard shell and lustrous wings.

name: Rare Scarab
description: A rare and valuable insect that greatly assists in the bonding of metals.
description_de: Ein seltenes, wertvolles Insekt, das die Verbindung von Metallen unterstützt.
description_fr: Un insecte recherché, très utile pour coller les métaux.
description_es: Insecto raro y preciado, muy útil para unir metales.
description_it: Insetto raro e pregiato. Utilissimo per legare insieme i metalli.
description_zh: A rare and valuable insect that greatly assists in the bonding of metals.

name: Blossom Cricket
description: A beautiful bell cricket resembling a flower. Its sound opens even the hardest of hearts.
description_de: Wunderschöne, blumenähnliche Grille. Ihr Gesang öffnet die verschlossensten Herzen.
description_fr: Magnifique grillon ressemblant à une fleur. Son chant émeut tous les cœurs.
description_es: Hermosa campanilla con forma de flor. Su sonido abre hasta el corazón más arduo.
description_it: Un bel grillo dall'aspetto di un fiore. Il suo canto apre anche il cuore più duro.
description_zh: A beautiful bell cricket resembling a flower. Its sound opens even the hardest of hearts.

name: Great Hornfly
description: An insect with a giant horn, massive shell, and wings of butterfly-like beauty.
description_de: Ein Insekt mit Riesenhorn, festem Panzer und Flügeln schön wie Schmetterlinge.
description_fr: Insecte avec une corne géante, une carapace massive et des ailes de papillon.
description_es: Su cuerno gigante y enorme caparazón dan a este insecto la belleza de una mariposa.
description_it: Insetto con un corno gigante, grande carapace e ali da farfalla.
description_zh: An insect with a giant horn, massive shell, and wings of butterfly-like beauty.

name: Butterfly Beetle
description: A strange insect with the large jaws of a beetle and the delicate wings of a butterfly.
description_de: Ein merkwürdiges Insekt mit großen Kieferzangen und zarten Schmetterlingsflügeln.
description_fr: Insecte étrange aux larges mâchoires de scarabée et aux ailes de papillon.
description_es: Raro insecto con una enorme boca de escarabajo y delicadas alas de mariposa.
description_it: Strano insetto dalla mandibola di coleottero e delicate ali di farfalla.
description_zh: A strange insect with the large jaws of a beetle and the delicate wings of a butterfly.

name: Great Ladybug
description: A giant insect with a very hard shell. Protects crops by eating harmful pests.
description_de: Rieseninsekt mit hartem Panzer. Schützt die Ernte, indem es Schädlinge vertilgt.
description_fr: Insecte géant à la carapace très résistante. Dévore les nuisibles sur les récoltes.
description_es: Insecto gigante de duro caparazón. Protege de varias plagas a las cosechas.
description_it: Gigantesca e dalla corazza dura. Mangia i parassiti che infestano i raccolti.
description_zh: A giant insect with a very hard shell. Protects crops by eating harmful pests.

name: Emperor Hopper
description: A grasshopper with an exceptionally strong shell. Prized as a crafting material.
description_de: Ein Grashüpfer mit sehr starkem Panzer. Geschätzt als Handwerksmaterial.
description_fr: Une sauterelle à la carapace très résistante. C'est un matériau très apprécié.
description_es: Saltamontes con escudo muy resistente. Preciado como material para artesanía.
description_it: Cavalletta dalla corazza estremamente dura; materiale utile per le lavorazioni.
description_zh: A grasshopper with an exceptionally strong shell. Prized as a crafting material.

name: Flutterfly
description: A butterfly with shimmering wings. So rarely seen in the wild, many believe it to be a myth.
description_de: Ein Falter mit schimmernden Flügeln. So selten, dass er fast ein Mythos ist.
description_fr: Un papillon aux ailes étincelantes. Si rare qu'il est peut-être un mythe.
description_es: Mariposa de alas brillantes. Se ve tan pocas veces que muchos creen que es un mito.
description_it: Farfalla con ali luccicanti. È così rara che molti la credono una leggenda.
description_zh: A butterfly with shimmering wings. So rarely seen in the wild, many believe it to be a myth.

name: Toxic Kumori
description: An insect that possesses a powerful poison used by certain tribes for hunting.
description_de: Das starke Gift dieses Insekts setzen manche Stämme als Jagdwaffe ein.
description_fr: Insecte qui possède un puissant poison dont certaines tribus se servent pour la chasse.
description_es: Un insecto dotado de un potente veneno que algunas tribus usan para cazar.
description_it: Insetto che secerne un potente veleno utilizzato nella caccia da alcune tribù.
description_zh: An insect that possesses a powerful poison used by certain tribes for hunting.

name: Large Toxic Kumori
description: The largest of the Kumori, it possesses a deadly poison banned by many countries.
description_de: Ein Kumori mit tödlichem Gift, das in vielen Ländern gesetzlich verboten ist.
description_fr: Le plus gros des Kumori. Doté d'une poison mortel interdit dans de nombreux pays.
description_es: El Kumori más grande, posee un veneno mortal que está prohibido en muchos países.
description_it: Un kumori gigante che secerne un veleno mortale, il cui uso è bandito in molti paesi.
description_zh: The largest of the Kumori, it possesses a deadly poison banned by many countries.

name: Lethal Kumori
description: An irregular Kumori that carries a fast-acting, lethal poison. You'd need a miracle to survive...
description_de: Ein Kumori mit tödlichem Gift. Wenn jemand gebissen wird, kann nur ein Wunder ihn retten.
description_fr: Un Kumori inusuel porteur d'un poison foudroyant. Il faudrait un miracle pour y survivre...
description_es: El veneno de este Kumori es el más rápido y letal que se conoce. Sobrevivir sería un milagro.
description_it: Un kumori tossico con un veleno particolarmente letale. Solo un miracolo potrebbe salvarti...
description_zh: An irregular Kumori that carries a fast-acting, lethal poison. You'd need a miracle to survive...

name: Dracophage Bug
description: It likes Dragonfell Berries, causing it to store Dragon Element energy in its body.
description_de: Mag Drachentod-Beeren und kann Energie des Elements Drache im Körper speichern.
description_fr: Accumule l'élément dragon en raison de son goût pour les baies-dragon.
description_es: Adora las bayas antidragón, por lo que su cuerpo acumula energía de elemento dragón.
description_it: Si nutre di bacche-drago, accumulando nell'organismo energia elementale del drago.
description_zh: It likes Dragonfell Berries, causing it to store Dragon Element energy in its body.

name: Monster Bone S
description: A very useful material; indispensable for both hunting and daily life.
description_de: Unverzichtbar und nützlich für den Gebrauch auf der Jagd und im Alltag.
description_fr: Matériau utile aussi bien pour la chasse que pour la vie au quotidien.
description_es: Material muy útil, necesario tanto para la caza como para la vida cotidiana.
description_it: Materiale molto utile, sia per la caccia che per la vita di tutti i giorni.
description_zh: A very useful material; indispensable for both hunting and daily life.

name: Monster Bone M
description: A nicely-sized bone. Strong yet flexible, it's as reliable as steel and wood.
description_de: Knochen von guter Größe. Robust, aber biegsam. Ver- lässlich wie Stahl und Holz.
description_fr: Os de belle taille, à la fois dur comme l'acier et souple comme le bois.
description_es: De buen tamaño. Fuerte y flexible, tan fiable como el acero o la madera.
description_it: Un osso di buona taglia. Robusto e flessibile, si usa come il legno o l'acciaio.
description_zh: A nicely-sized bone. Strong yet flexible, it's as reliable as steel and wood.

name: Monster Bone L
description: Wyvern bone needed to craft larger items. The right item will fuse this to a shell.
description_de: Wyvern-Knochen für größere Objekte. Das richtige Objekt macht einen Panzer daraus.
description_fr: Utilisé pour forger les jointures dans les armures.
description_es: Para crear objetos grandes. Quizás con algún otro objeto puedas unirlo a un caparazón.
description_it: Utile se crei cose grandi. Si fonde alle corazze se hai l'oggetto giusto.
description_zh: Wyvern bone needed to craft larger items. The right item will fuse this to a shell.

name: Mystery Bone
description: A weathered bone. Not sturdy enough to use for crafting.
description_de: Ein verwitterter Knochen. Nicht stabil genug für Kombinationen.
description_fr: Trop usé pour être utilisé comme matériau.
description_es: Hueso muy desgastado. No es lo bastante resistente como para combinarlo.
description_it: Un osso consumato. È troppo friabile per usarlo nelle combinazioni.
description_zh: A weathered bone. Not sturdy enough to use for crafting.

name: Unknown Skull
description: Animal skull. So worn and weathered, its origin is unidentifiable.
description_de: Tierschädel. So abgenutzt und verwittert, dass er nicht identifizierbar ist.
description_fr: Crâne d'animal trop usé pour être identifié.
description_es: Cráneo animal. Demasiado erosionado para identificar de qué especie es.
description_it: Teschio di animale. Tanto eroso e sciupato da non essere identificabile.
description_zh: Animal skull. So worn and weathered, its origin is unidentifiable.

name: Huge Unknown Skull
description: A large weather-worn skull of unknown origin. It looks strong enough to be used in crafting.
description_de: Verwitterter Tierschädel, der nicht mehr identifizierbar ist. Taugt jedoch als Material.
description_fr: Grand crâne d'origine inconnue usé par le temps. Semble assez solide pour être travaillé.
description_es: Cráneo de origen desconocido; desgastado, pero aún lo bastante resistente como para combinarlo.
description_it: Teschio enorme eroso dalle intemperie. È così robusto che si presta a molti usi artigianali.
description_zh: A large weather-worn skull of unknown origin. It looks strong enough to be used in crafting.

name: Monster Bone+
description: A high-quality monster bone. Hard to obtain, but vital for crafting powerful equipment.
description_de: Hochwertiger Knochen. Schwer erhältlich. Zum Herstellen mächtiger Ausrüstung nötig.
description_fr: Os de grande qualité. Dur à obtenir, mais vital pour un équipement puissant.
description_es: De gran calidad. Difícil de encontrar, pero clave para crear equipo potente.
description_it: Osso di qualità. È difficile da ottenere, ma permette di forgiare potenti oggetti.
description_zh: A high-quality monster bone. Hard to obtain, but vital for crafting powerful equipment.

name: Monster Keenbone
description: A rare bone with a razor- sharp tip that retains its strength even when crafted.
description_de: Seltener Knochen mit sehr scharfer Spitze. Bleibt auch bei Verarbeitung stark.
description_fr: Os rare à la pointe tranchante. Il conserve toujours sa robustesse.
description_es: Hueso raro con punta afilada que conserva su fortaleza incluso tras trabajarlo.
description_it: Raro osso dalla punta affilata che mantiene la sua forza anche se lavorato.
description_zh: A rare bone with a razor- sharp tip that retains its strength even when crafted.

name: Monster Hardbone
description: A precious bone rarely yielded by large wyverns. Difficult to forge but prized for its strength.
description_de: Kostbarer, seltener Knochen von großen Wyvern. Schwer zu verarbeiten, aber stark.
description_fr: Os précieux rarement trouvé sur les wyvernes. Difficile à forger.
description_es: Hueso valioso y poco común de wyverns grandes. Difícil de trabajar, pero muy fuerte.
description_it: Osso raro e prezioso lasciato dai grandi wyvern. Duro da forgiare ma resistentissimo.
description_zh: A precious bone rarely yielded by large wyverns. Difficult to forge but prized for its strength.

name: Monster Toughbone
description: Arguably the strongest type of bone; it radiates an incredible strength and presence.
description_de: Selbst für einen Monsterknochen außergewöhnlich stark.
description_fr: Sans doute le type d'os le plus solide qui soit. Possède une force et une présence remarquables.
description_es: Candidato al premio al hueso más resistente de todos. Tiene muchísima presencia y poderío.
description_it: Forse il tipo di osso più duro in assoluto. È impressionante anche da vedere.
description_zh: Arguably the strongest type of bone; it radiates an incredible strength and presence.

name: Monster Slogbone
description: An incredibly strong bone harvested from a fearsome wyvern. Its heft is impressive.
description_de: Unglaublich starker, furcht- erregender Wyvernknochen. Beeindruckende Wucht.
description_fr: Os incroyablement puissant et au poids impressionnant. Récolté sur une wyverne.
description_es: Hueso increíblemente fuerte extraído de un temible wyvern. Su peso impresiona.
description_it: Osso molto resistente estratto da un temibile wyvern. Davvero imponente.
description_zh: An incredibly strong bone harvested from a fearsome wyvern. Its heft is impressive.

name: Elder Dragon Bone
description: A bone from an elder dragon. It exudes the great majesty of the beast.
description_de: Man spürt die Würde des Drachenältesten in diesem Riesenknochen.
description_fr: Os massif qui évoque la dignité d'un dragon ancien.
description_es: Un gigantesco hueso que conserva la majestad del dragón anciano al que perteneció.
description_it: Questo massiccio osso fa sentire la dignità del vecchio drago.
description_zh: A bone from an elder dragon. It exudes the great majesty of the beast.

name: Lrg ElderDragon Bone
description: Top-grade bone from a large wyvern. Its rough and majestic shape tells a vivid tale.
description_de: Bester Knochen eines großen Drachen. Der ist was für die Ewigkeit!
description_fr: Os de grande qualité d'un grand dragon. Semble éternel.
description_es: Hueso de primera clase de un gran dragón. Se dice que durará para siempre.
description_it: Un osso di drago che dall'aspetto sembra indistruttibile.
description_zh: Top-grade bone from a large wyvern. Its rough and majestic shape tells a vivid tale.

name: Avian Finebone
description: A bone from a Jaggi or other bird wyvern. Small in size, but high in quality.
description_de: Knochen von Jaggi oder anderen Vogelwyvern. Klein, aber hochwertig.
description_fr: Os de Jaggi ou d'un autre wyverne rapace. Petit, mais de grande qualité.
description_es: Hueso de un Jaggi, o algún otro tipo de wyvern pájaro. Pequeño, pero de gran calidad.
description_it: Osso di Jaggi o di altro wyvern rapace. Piccola taglia, altissima qualità.
description_zh: A bone from a Jaggi or other bird wyvern. Small in size, but high in quality.

name: Avian Stoutbone
description: The robust bone of a bird wyvern. Durable and easy to craft with.
description_de: Robuster Vogelwyvern- Knochen. Haltbar und leicht zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Bel os de wyverne rapace. Solide et facile à travailler.
description_es: Hueso robusto de un wyvern pájaro. Duradero y fácil de trabajar.
description_it: Solido osso di uccello wyvern. Resistente e facile da lavorare.
description_zh: The robust bone of a bird wyvern. Durable and easy to craft with.

name: Large Herbivore Bone
description: The thick, sturdy bone of a herbivore. Up there with the best of them.
description_de: Robuster Knochen eines Pflanzen- fressers. So robust wie die stärksten Monsterknochen.
description_fr: Os solide et épais d'un herbivore, figure parmi ce qu'il se fait de mieux.
description_es: Uno de los huesos más grandes y fuertes que se pueden extraer de monstruo alguno.
description_it: Grande e robusto osso di erbivoro. Immagina le dimensioni della bestia!
description_zh: The thick, sturdy bone of a herbivore. Up there with the best of them.

name: Brute Bone
description: The stout bone of a brutish monster. An easy-to-work material.
description_de: Der starke Knochen eines wilden Monsters. Lässt sich leicht verarbeiten.
description_fr: Os résistant mais facile à travailler.
description_es: Hueso ancho de un monstruo robusto. Un material muy maleable.
description_it: Forte osso di un mostro brutale. Un materiale facile da lavorare.
description_zh: The stout bone of a brutish monster. An easy-to-work material.

name: Jumbo Bone
description: A large, thick bone. Often cut apart in workshops for use in crafting.
description_de: Ein großer, dicker Knochen. Wird zur Verarbeitung in Werkstätten oft zerteilt.
description_fr: Os de grande taille. Souvent découpé en atelier pour être ensuite travaillé.
description_es: Hueso grande y grueso. Se suele cortar en talleres para su uso en artesanía.
description_it: Osso grosso e spesso. Fatto a pezzi nei laboratori per la lavorazione.
description_zh: A large, thick bone. Often cut apart in workshops for use in crafting.

name: Stoutbone
description: The large, sturdy bone of a beast. Prized by blacksmiths as a prime forging material.
description_de: Großer, stabiler Knochen einer Bestie. Von Schmieden gepriesenes Material.
description_fr: Gros os solide provenant d'une bête. Matériel de base très prisé des forgerons.
description_es: Hueso grande y robusto de bestia. Valorado como material de forja.
description_it: Osso grosso e robusto. Richiesto dai fabbri come materia scelta per forgiare.
description_zh: The large, sturdy bone of a beast. Prized by blacksmiths as a prime forging material.

name: Massive Bone
description: An impossibly hard bone from a large beast. Exceeds all known standards for crafting material.
description_de: Unfassbar harter Knochen einer großen Bestie. Stärker als bekannte Materialien.
description_fr: Un os incroyablement dur d'une grande bête. Dépasse toutes les normes connues.
description_es: Hueso muy duro de una gran bestia. Supera el estándar de materiales de artesanía.
description_it: Osso durissimo di un mostro enorme; di qualità superiore a tutti i materiali conosciuti.
description_zh: An impossibly hard bone from a large beast. Exceeds all known standards for crafting material.

name: Dragonbone Relic
description: A curiously unfossilized bone from a dragon that once roamed these lands.
description_de: Nicht versteinerter Knochen von Drachen, die einst diese Länder bevölkerten.
description_fr: Os d'un dragon qui errait jadis dans ces contrées. Étonnamment non fossilisé.
description_es: Curioso hueso no fosilizado de un dragón que antaño deambuló por estas tierras.
description_it: Osso di un drago che abitava queste terre. Stranamente non è mutato in fossile.
description_zh: A curiously unfossilized bone from a dragon that once roamed these lands.

name: Dragonbone Artifact
description: Rare bone from an elder dragon that once ruled the land. A mysterious power lies within.
description_de: Seltener Knochen eines Dra- chenältesten. Eine mystische Kraft schlummert in ihm.
description_fr: Os rare au pouvoir mystérieux d'un dragon ancien ayant régné sur ces terres.
description_es: Hueso raro de dragón anciano que una vez gobernó. Dentro yace un misterioso poder.
description_it: Raro osso di un drago anziano in cui scorre un potere misterioso.
