description_zh: Rare bone from an elder dragon that once ruled the land. A mysterious power lies within.

name: Irregular Bone
description: A bone with an unusual shape and color. It can be made into valuable equipment.
description_de: Ein Knochen mit ungewöhnlicher Form und Farbe zur Herstellung wertvoller Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Os de forme et de couleur inhabituelles. Sert à fabriquer de précieux équipements.
description_es: Hueso con color y forma inusuales. Se puede usar para crear equipo valioso.
description_it: Osso inusuale per forma e colore. Se ne ricavano equipaggiamenti pregiati.
description_zh: A bone with an unusual shape and color. It can be made into valuable equipment.

name: Irregular Stoutbone
description: An extra hard bone with an unusual shape and color. Used to create equipment.
description_de: Besonders harter Knochen von spezieller Form und Farbe zur Herstellung von Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Os très dur de forme et de couleur inhabituelles. Sert à fabriquer des équipements.
description_es: Hueso de especial dureza con color y forma inusuales. Se usa para crear equipo valioso.
description_it: Osso estremamente robusto di forma e colore inusuali. Se ne ricavano equipaggiamenti.
description_zh: An extra hard bone with an unusual shape and color. Used to create equipment.

name: Irregular Slogbone
description: A bone with an unusual shape and color. Its unusual sturdiness is used to forge strong armor.
description_de: Knochen von ungewöhnlicher Farbe und Form. Kann zu starker Ausrüstung verarbeitet werden.
description_fr: Os de forme et de couleur inhabituelles. Sert à fabriquer des armures solides.
description_es: Hueso muy duro con color y forma inusuales. Se usa para crear equipamiento resistente.
description_it: Osso con un colore e una forma strani. È così duro che viene usato per forgiare armature.
description_zh: A bone with an unusual shape and color. Its unusual sturdiness is used to forge strong armor.

name: Wyvern Fang
description: Used in Bowgun bullet points. Gunpowder shatters these, generating shrapnel.
description_de: Bogengewehrmunition, die mit Schießpulver Streugeschosse erzeugt.
description_fr: Pour créer des munitions de fusarbalète. La poudre génère des éclats.
description_es: Se usa para hacer munición de ballesta. La pólvora la rompe, generando metralla.
description_it: Si usa per fare munizioni da balestra. Con la polvere da sparo, crea schegge letali.
description_zh: Used in Bowgun bullet points. Gunpowder shatters these, generating shrapnel.

name: Wyvern Claw
description: Used in Bowgun bullet points. Gunpowder triggers a blast with a wide radius.
description_de: Bogengewehrmunition, die mit Schießpulver Explosionen mit großem Radius erzeugt.
description_fr: Pour créer des munitions de fusarbalète. La poudre déclenche une explosion.
description_es: La pólvora provoca una gran explosión. Se usa para hacer munición de ballesta.
description_it: Si usa per fare munizioni da balestra. Con la polvere da sparo crea ampie esplosioni.
description_zh: Used in Bowgun bullet points. Gunpowder triggers a blast with a wide radius.

name: Sharp Claw
description: A shining black claw. Unlike wyvern claws, this is shaped to grip objects.
description_de: Glänzende, schwarze Klaue. Im Gegensatz zu Wyvern- Klauen kann sie greifen.
description_fr: Griffe d'un noir brillant. Peut saisir des objets, à la différence de celles des wyvernes.
description_es: Garra negra brillante. Permite asir objetos, al contrario que las garras de un wyvern.
description_it: Artiglio nero. Afferra gli oggetti, a differenza degli artigli di wyvern.
description_zh: A shining black claw. Unlike wyvern claws, this is shaped to grip objects.

name: Piercing Claw
description: Dangerous to touch with bare hands, it's used as a knife in some workshops.
description_de: Berühren mit bloßen Händen ist gefährlich. Wird als Werkstattmesser benutzt.
description_fr: Utilisée comme couteau dans certains ateliers. Attention aux mains nues.
description_es: Es peligroso tocarla con las manos desnudas. Se usa como cuchillo.
description_it: Usato a volte come coltello da lavoro. Maneggiare con cura.
description_zh: Dangerous to touch with bare hands, it's used as a knife in some workshops.

name: Sharp Fang
description: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes -- the right fang for the right job.
description_de: Es gibt viele verschiedene Reißzähne - der richtige Zahn für den richtigen Job.
description_fr: Les crocs varient en forme et en taille. À chaque croc son usage.
description_es: De muchas formas y tamaños. Hay colmillos adecuados para todo tipo de trabajos.
description_it: Si trovano zanne di ogni forma o dimensione: questa è perfetta!
description_zh: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes -- the right fang for the right job.

name: Crushing Fang
description: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes -- the right fang for the right job.
description_de: Es gibt viele verschiedene Reißzähne - der richtige Zahn für den richtigen Job.
description_fr: Les crocs varient en forme et en taille. À chaque croc son usage.
description_es: De muchas formas y tamaños. Este puede rasgar un caparazón pequeño como si fuera de papel.
description_it: Si trovano zanne di ogni forma o dimensione. Questa penetra nei carapaci di piccoli mostri.
description_zh: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes -- the right fang for the right job.

name: Bird Wyvern Gem
description: A valuable gem that can be harvested from Jaggi and other bird wyverns.
description_de: Wertvoller Stein. Kann von Jaggi und anderen Vogel- wyvern gewonnen werden.
description_fr: Gemme de valeur pouvant être extraite de Jaggi et d'autres wyvernes rapaces.
description_es: Gema valiosa que se extrae de los Jaggi y de otros wyverns pájaro.
description_it: Gemma preziosa che può essere estratta dai Jaggi o da altri wyvern rapaci.
description_zh: A valuable gem that can be harvested from Jaggi and other bird wyverns.

name: Fey Wyvern Gem
description: An exceptionally pure gem taken from a bird wyvern. Its fragility makes it difficult to carve.
description_de: Ein unglaublich reiner Stein eines Vogelwyvern. Brüchig und schwer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Gemme de wyverne rapace très pure. Difficile à manipuler car très fragile.
description_es: Gema de gran pureza extraída de un wyvern pájaro. Difícil de cortar por su fragilidad.
description_it: Gemma purissima presa da un uccello wyvern. Fragilissima e difficile da ricavare.
description_zh: An exceptionally pure gem taken from a bird wyvern. Its fragility makes it difficult to carve.

name: Wyvern Gem
description: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.
description_de: Während eines Wyvern-Lebens sammeln sich Fremdstoffe an und formen diesen Stein.
description_fr: Les impuretés forment cette pierre étrange au cours de la vie d'une wyverne.
description_es: Las impurezas acumuladas a lo largo de la vida de los wyverns forman esta piedra.
description_it: Un calcolo che si forma nel corpo dei wyvern condensando le impurità.
description_zh: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

name: Lrg Wyvern Gem
description: A Wyvern Gem grown especially large after years of collecting mass. Emits a peculiar glow.
description_de: Ein Wyvern-Stein, der mit den Jahren immer größer wurde. Glüht merkwürdig.
description_fr: Une pierre de wyverne qui a grandi au fil du temps. Émet une lueur étrange.
description_es: Piedra de wyvern enorme tras años de crecimiento. Emite un brillo singular.
description_it: Pietra wyvern che ha accumulato massa per anni. Emette una luce particolare.
description_zh: A Wyvern Gem grown especially large after years of collecting mass. Emits a peculiar glow.

name: Elder Dragon Blood
description: Contains an unknown ingredient, the object of much scholarly research.
description_de: Enthält eine unbekannte Zutat. Wird oft von Gelehrten untersucht.
description_fr: Contient un ingrédient inconnu, objet de nombreuses études.
description_es: Contiene un ingrediente desconocido. Objeto de estudios académicos.
description_it: Contiene un ingrediente sconosciuto. Oggetto di molti studi.
description_zh: Contains an unknown ingredient, the object of much scholarly research.

name: Pure Dragon Blood
description: Elder dragon blood that contains a more potent mix of its mysterious ingredient.
description_de: Blut eines Drachenältesten, das noch mehr geheimnis- volle Stoffe enthält.
description_fr: Sang de dragon ancien encore plus riche en "ingrédient mystérieux".
description_es: Sangre de dragón anciano que contiene una mezcla más potente de su misteriosa esencia.
description_it: Sangue di drago anziano, ancora più ricco del suo misterioso ingrediente.
description_zh: Elder dragon blood that contains a more potent mix of its mysterious ingredient.

name: Viscous Dragon Blood
description: Rare even among elder dragons, this mysterious blood has unknown potential.
description_de: Sogar bei Drachenältesten ein seltener Fund. Birgt mysteriöse Kräfte.
description_fr: Rare même chez les dragons anciens, ce sang mystérieux possède un potentiel inconnu.
description_es: Rara incluso entre los dragones ancianos, esta sangre misteriosa posee un potencial desconocido.
description_it: Raro anche tra i draghi antichi, questo sangue misterioso ha poteri sconosciuti.
description_zh: Rare even among elder dragons, this mysterious blood has unknown potential.

name: Steel Egg
description: An egg of glittering steel. Very valuable and rare, but of no use to a hunter...?
description_de: Ein Ei aus funkelndem Stahl. Sehr kostbar und selten, aber für Jäger nutzlos...?
description_fr: Œuf brillant très cher. Inutile pour le chasseur...?
description_es: Brillante huevo de acero. Escaso y muy caro, pero... ¿sin utilidad para cazadores?
description_it: Un lucente uovo d'acciaio. Costoso e raro. Inutile per un cacciatore...?
description_zh: An egg of glittering steel. Very valuable and rare, but of no use to a hunter...?

name: Silver Egg
description: An egg of glittering silver. Very valuable and rare, but of no use to a hunter...?
description_de: Ein Ei aus funkelndem Silber. Sehr kostbar und selten, aber für Jäger nutzlos...?
description_fr: Œuf argenté d'une grande valeur. Inutile pour le chasseur...?
description_es: Brillante huevo de plata. Escaso y muy caro, pero... ¿sin utilidad para cazadores?
description_it: Un lucente uovo d'argento. Molto costoso e raro. Inutile per un cacciatore...?
description_zh: An egg of glittering silver. Very valuable and rare, but of no use to a hunter...?

name: Golden Egg
description: An egg of glittering gold. Insanely valuable and rare, but of no use to a hunter...?
description_de: Ein Ei aus funkelndem Gold. Extrem kostbar und selten, aber für Jäger nutzlos...?
description_fr: Œuf doré d'une valeur inestimable. Inutile pour le chasseur...?
description_es: Brillante huevo de oro. Escaso y muy caro, pero... ¿sin utilidad para cazadores?
description_it: Un lucente uovo d'oro. Molto costoso e raro. Inutile per un cacciatore...?
description_zh: An egg of glittering gold. Insanely valuable and rare, but of no use to a hunter...?

name: Platinum Egg
description: An egg of glittering platinum. Absurdly valuable and rare, but of no use to a hunter.
description_de: Ein Ei aus funkelndem Platin. Unglaublich kostbar und selten, aber für Jäger nutzlos.
description_fr: Œuf de platine étincelant, d'une valeur incommensurable. Inutile pour le chasseur.
description_es: Brillante huevo de platino. Escaso y muy caro, pero... ¿sin utilidad para cazadores?
description_it: Uovo di platino luccicante, dal valore e dalla rarità incredibili. Inutile per un cacciatore...?
description_zh: An egg of glittering platinum. Absurdly valuable and rare, but of no use to a hunter.

name: Slickaxe
description: A small pickaxe that looks useless for mining. It seems to have a strange power...
description_de: Kleine Spitzhacke, ungeeignet für den Abbau. Scheint aber seltsame Kraft zu haben!
description_fr: Petite pioche qui semble inutile pour forer. Semble avoir un étrange pouvoir...
description_es: Pequeño pico inútil para la mina. Parece que tiene un extraño poder...
description_it: Piccolo piccone all'apparenza inutile; nasconde in realtà uno strano potere.
description_zh: A small pickaxe that looks useless for mining. It seems to have a strange power...

name: Screamer Sac
description: A monster organ that emits an earsplitting sonic blast when ruptured.
description_de: Ein Monsterorgan, das beim Aufbrechen ein ohrenbetäu- bendes Geräusch ausstößt.
description_fr: Organe de monstre émettant un choc sonique lorsqu'il se déchire.
description_es: Órgano interno de un monstruo. Al romperlo emite un sonido agudo.
description_it: Organo interno di un mostro. Se viene rotto emette un suono straziante.
description_zh: A monster organ that emits an earsplitting sonic blast when ruptured.

name: Poison Sac
description: A monster organ that contains a lethal toxin. Handle with extreme care.
description_de: Ein Monsterorgan mit einem tödlichen Gift. Sei vorsichtig damit.
description_fr: Organe de monstre empli de venin mortel. À manipuler très soigneusement.
description_es: Órgano de monstruo que contiene veneno. Extrema la precaución.
description_it: Un organo di mostro con tossine mortali. Maneggialo con cautela!
description_zh: A monster organ that contains a lethal toxin. Handle with extreme care.

name: Toxin Sac
description: A monster organ filled with an extremely potent toxin. Just touching it is dangerous.
description_de: Ein Monsterorgan mit sehr starkem Gift. Schon eine Berührung ist gefährlich.
description_fr: Organe de monstre empli de toxine très nocive. Le toucher est dangereux.
description_es: Órgano de monstruo repleto de letales toxinas. Corres un riesgo solo con tocarlo.
description_it: Organo di mostro pieno di una potente tossina. È pericoloso anche solo toccarlo.
description_zh: A monster organ filled with an extremely potent toxin. Just touching it is dangerous.

name: Deadly Poison Sac
description: A monster's internal organ filled with a most lethal toxin. Use extreme care!
description_de: Inneres Monsterorgan, gefüllt mit sehr tödlichem Gift. Große Gefahr!
description_fr: Organe interne de monstre empli de toxine mortelle. Manier avec précaution.
description_es: Órgano interno de monstruo lleno de una toxina letal. Debe usarse con mucho cuidado.
description_it: Organo interno d'un mostro pieno di tossine letali. Maneggiare con cura.
description_zh: A monster's internal organ filled with a most lethal toxin. Use extreme care!

name: Paralysis Sac
description: A monster organ that contains paralyzing neurotoxins.
description_de: Ein Monsterorgan, das ein lähmendes Nervengift enthält.
description_fr: Organe de monstre empli de neurotoxines paralysantes.
description_es: Órgano interno de un monstruo relleno de una neurotoxina paralizante.
description_it: L'organo interno di un mostro; contiene una neurotossina paralizzante.
description_zh: A monster organ that contains paralyzing neurotoxins.

name: Omniplegia Sac
description: A monster organ filled with potent neurotoxins. A single touch can cause Paralysis.
description_de: Ein Monsterorgan mit starkem Nervengift. Schon eine Berührung kann lähmen.
description_fr: Organe de monstre empli de neurotoxines. Paralysie probable après contact.
description_es: Órgano de monstruo lleno de potentes neurotoxinas. Si lo tocas, te puede paralizar.
description_it: Organo di mostro pieno di potenti neurotossine. Paralizza al tocco.
description_zh: A monster organ filled with potent neurotoxins. A single touch can cause Paralysis.

name: Ultraplegia Sac
description: A monster organ filled with highly concentrated neurotoxins. Handle with extreme care.
description_de: Ein Monsterorgan mit hoch konzentriertem Nervengift. Mit Vorsicht zu handhaben!
description_fr: Organe de monstre empli de toxines concentrées. À manipuler avec soin.
description_es: Órgano de monstruo lleno de neurotoxinas concentradas. Debe manejarse con precaución.
description_it: Organo di mostro pieno di potenti neurotossine. Maneggiare con cura!
description_zh: A monster organ filled with highly concentrated neurotoxins. Handle with extreme care.

name: Sleep Sac
description: A monster organ that contains a knockout powder capable of inducing Sleep.
description_de: Ein Monsterorgan mit einem betäubenden Pulver, das einschläfern kann.
description_fr: Organe de monstre contenant de la poudre soporifique.
description_es: Órgano interno de un monstruo relleno de un polvo que provoca somnolencia.
description_it: L'organo interno di un mostro; contiene una polvere che fa dormire se inalata.
description_zh: A monster organ that contains a knockout powder capable of inducing Sleep.

name: Coma Sac
description: A monster organ that contains dangerous powder. One whiff can induce a coma.
description_de: Ein Monsterorgan mit einem gefährlichen Pulver. Einat- men kann zum Koma führen.
description_fr: Organe de monstre. Contient une poudre dangereuse qui met dans le coma.
description_es: Órgano interno de un monstruo lleno de un polvo que induce el coma.
description_it: Organo interno di un mostro; contiene una polvere che manda in coma se inalata.
description_zh: A monster organ that contains dangerous powder. One whiff can induce a coma.

name: Torpor Sac
description: A monster organ that can subdue rampaging monsters in the blink of an eye.

description_zh: A Dracophage scale from a Hyper Monster, it's darker and stronger than normal.

description_de: Die Dracophag-Schuppe eines Ferus-Monsters. Komplett schwarz und extrem robust.
description_fr: Écaille d'hyper monstre. Extrêmement robuste et d'un noir profond.
description_es: Escama dragoenergética de Híper monstruo. Es negra y extremadamente robusta.

description_zh: A Dracophage scale from a Hyper Monster, it's black all over and extremely robust.

description_de: Ein Gift von einem Ferus- Monster. Komplett schwarz und hoch konzentriert.
description_fr: Poison nocif d'hyper monstre. Extrêmement concentré et d'un noir profond.
description_es: Veneno potente extraído de un Híper monstruo. Es negro y extremadamente denso.
description_it: Potente veleno estratto da un ipermostro, più scuro ed efficace del normale.
description_zh: Potent poison taken from a Hyper monster, it's black and highly concentrated.

description_it: Veleno paralizzante estratto da un ipermostro, più scuro ed efficace del normale.

name: Hyper Sleep Sac
description: A sleep sac from a Hyper monster, it's darker and stronger than normal.
description_de: Der Schlafbeutel eines Ferus-Monsters. Dunkler und stärker als andere.
description_fr: Somnifère d'hyper monstre. Puissant, mais dégage une aura lugubre.

description_it: Sacca soporifera di ipermostro, più scura ed efficace del normale.

name: Hyper Coma Sac

description_de: Der Schlafbeutel eines Ferus-Monsters. Komplett schwarz und extrem robust.
description_fr: Somnifère d'hyper monstre. Extrêmement efficace et d'un noir profond.
description_es: Vesícula de coma de un Híper monstruo. Es totalmente negra y extremadamente robusta.
description_it: Sacca soporifera di ipermostro, più scura ed efficace del normale.
description_zh: A sleep sac from a Hyper monster, it's black all over and extremely durable.

description: Sleep poison from a Hyper monster, it's darker and stronger than normal.
description_de: Schlafgift eines Ferus- Monsters. Dunkler und stärker als andere.

description_it: Sonnifero ricavato da un ipermostro, più scuro ed efficace del normale.

name: Hyper Potent Narcotoxin

description_de: Schlafgift eines Ferus- Monsters. Komplett schwarz und hoch konzentriert.
description_fr: Somnifère toxique d'hyper monstre. Extrêmement concentré et d'un noir profond.

description_it: Sonnifero ricavato da un ipermostro, più scuro ed efficace del normale.
description_zh: Sleep poison from a Hyper monster, it's black and highly concentrated.

name: Hyper Catalyst
description: Explosive liquid from a Hyper Monster, it's darker and stronger than normal.
description_de: Die explosive Flüssigkeit eines Ferus-Monsters. Dunkler und stärker als andere.
description_fr: Liquide explosif d'hyper monstre. Puissant, mais dégage une aura lugubre.
description_es: Líquido explosivo de Híper monstruo. Es más oscuro y potente de lo normal.
description_it: Liquido esplosivo ricavato da un ipermostro, più scuro ed efficace del normale.
description_zh: Explosive liquid from a Hyper Monster, it's darker and stronger than normal.

name: Hyper Catalyst+
description: Explosive liquid from a Hyper Monster, it's black and highly concentrated.
description_de: Die explosive Flüssigkeit eines Ferus-Monsters. Komplett schwarz und hoch konzentriert.
description_fr: Liquide explosif d'hyper monstre. Extrêmement concentré et d'un noir profond.
description_es: Líquido explosivo de Híper monstruo. Es negro y extremadamente denso.
description_it: Liquido esplosivo ricavato da un ipermostro, più scuro ed efficace del normale.
description_zh: Explosive liquid from a Hyper Monster, it's black and highly concentrated.

name: Felyne Fur Ruby
description: A priceless ruby formed by the rare hardening of a Felyne hairball.
description_de: Unbezahlbarer Rubin aus einem verhärteten Felyne-Haarball.
description_fr: Rubis de valeur formé par la compression de poils de Felyne.
description_es: Rubí muy valioso formado al endurecerse una bola de pelo de Felyne.
description_it: Rubino formato dalla massa di peli che si è indurita nella pancia di un Felyne.
description_zh: A priceless ruby formed by the rare hardening of a Felyne hairball.

name: Larinoth Hide
description: The hide of the gigantic Larinoth. Its color is like fresh grass in springtime.
description_de: Die Haut des riesigen Larinoth ist grün wie Frühlingsgras.
description_fr: Peau de l'énorme Larinoth. Sa couleur rappelle l'herbe fraîche du printemps.
description_es: Piel de Larinoth gigante. Tiene el color de la hierba fresca en primavera.
description_it: La pelle di un gigantesco Larinoth. Ha il colore dell'erba a primavera.
description_zh: The hide of the gigantic Larinoth. Its color is like fresh grass in springtime.

name: Larinoth Finehide
description: The hide of the gigantic Larinoth. Lauded for its beautiful hues and all-around toughness.
description_de: Die Haut des riesigen Larinoth ist schön gefärbt und dazu extrem haltbar.
description_fr: Peau de l'énorme Larinoth. Appréciée aussi bien pour ses teintes que pour sa solidité.
description_es: Piel especial de Larinoth gigante. Es muy apreciada como material por su fuerza y su belleza.
description_it: La pelle di un gigantesco Larinoth, molto apprezzata per la sua bellezza e robustezza.
description_zh: The hide of the gigantic Larinoth. Lauded for its beautiful hues and all-around toughness.

name: Gargwa Feather
description: A big, beautiful feather plucked from a Gargwa. Often used as a fashion accessory.
description_de: Eine große, schöne Gargwa- Feder. Wird oft als Mode- Accessoire benutzt.
description_fr: Grande plume magnifique de Gargwa, utilisée comme accessoire de mode.
description_es: Gran pluma preciosa extraída de un Gargwa. Suele usarse como accesorio.
description_it: Grande e bella piuma di Gargwa. Usata spesso come accessorio di vestiario.
description_zh: A big, beautiful feather plucked from a Gargwa. Often used as a fashion accessory.

name: Gargwa Finefeather
description: A high quality feather plucked from a Gargwa. Stylish, and can be used to reinforce armor.
description_de: Eine besonders schöne Gargwa- Feder. Wird bei der Herstellung von Rüstungen verwendet.
description_fr: Plume de grande qualité de Gargwa. Élégante et utile pour renforcer une armure.
description_es: Pluma especial de un Gargwa. Se emplea en la fabricación de ropa y para reforzar armaduras.
description_it: Piuma di altissima qualità tolta a un Gargwa. Può essere usata per rinforzare le armature.
description_zh: A high quality feather plucked from a Gargwa. Stylish, and can be used to reinforce armor.

name: Moofah Horn
description: The horn of a Moofah. Since its shape varies by gender, it has a variety of uses.
description_de: Form und Gebrauch des Horns können je nach Geschlecht des Muufah variieren.
description_fr: La corne du Moofah. De forme variable en fonction du sexe, elle remplit plusieurs usages.
description_es: Cuerno de Moofah. Como su forma varía según el género, tiene diversos usos.
description_it: Corno di Moofah. La forma varia in base al sesso e, di conseguenza, anche l'impiego.
description_zh: The horn of a Moofah. Since its shape varies by gender, it has a variety of uses.

name: Moofah Fleeceball
description: A fleeceball that's white and fluffy like a cloud. It makes supple yet strong thread.
description_de: Aus dem weißen, flauschigen Pelzknäuel wird ein starkes, geschmeidiges Garn hergestellt.
description_fr: Boule blanche aussi cotonneuse qu'un nuage. Son tressage est souple mais très résistant.
description_es: Bola de lana blanca y mullida como una nube. Produce un hilo suave y resistente.
description_it: Gomitolo di lana bianca e soffice. Se ne ricava un filo elastico ma resistente.
description_zh: A fleeceball that's white and fluffy like a cloud. It makes supple yet strong thread.

name: Moofah Heavyhorn
description: The hefty horn of a Moofah. Resilient and easy to craft, it's a material with many uses.
description_de: Belastbar und leicht zu verarbeiten. Ein vielseitiges Material.
description_fr: Corne lourde de Moofah. Solide et simple à travailler, c'est un matériau polyvalent.
description_es: Cuerno pesado de Moofah. Es fuerte y maleable, por lo que se le dan muchos usos.
description_it: Robusto corno di Moofah, resistente e facile da usare per molti usi diversi.
description_zh: The hefty horn of a Moofah. Resilient and easy to craft, it's a material with many uses.

name: Kelbi Horn
description: An infusion of powdered Kelbi Horn that works wonders on stomachaches.
description_de: Aufguss aus pulverisiertem Kelbi-Horn. Wirkt Wunder bei Magenproblemen.
description_fr: Infusion de poudre de corne de Kelbi. Un remède miracle contre les maux de ventre.
description_es: Infusión de cuerno de Kelbi en polvo que va genial para el dolor de estómago.
description_it: Infuso con corno di Kelbi in polvere. È un toccasana per il mal di stomaco.
description_zh: An infusion of powdered Kelbi Horn that works wonders on stomachaches.

name: Warm Pelt
description: A pelt from a small animal. Used for many things, but mostly just regular clothes.
description_de: Pelz eines kleinen Tieres. Wird meist für normale Kleidung benutzt.
description_fr: La peau d'un petit animal. A de multiples usages, surtout pour les vêtements.
description_es: Piel de un animal pequeño. Tiene diversos usos, aunque el principal es hacer ropa.
description_it: Pelle di un piccolo animale. Si usa per molte cose, ma soprattutto per gli abiti.
description_zh: A pelt from a small animal. Used for many things, but mostly just regular clothes.

name: High-quality Pelt
description: Feels wonderful to the touch. Difficult to carve but valued by the Guild.
description_de: Fühlt sich edel an. Schwer herauszuschneiden, aber bei der Gilde begehrt.
description_fr: Agréable au toucher. Difficile à dépecer, mais recherché par la Guilde.
description_es: De excelente tacto y difícil de trabajar. Muy apreciada por el gremio.
description_it: Piacevolissima al tatto. Difficile da tagliare, ma apprezzata dalla Gilda.
description_zh: Feels wonderful to the touch. Difficult to carve but valued by the Guild.

name: Prized Pelt
description: A quality pelt from a small animal. Often used in clothing for its comfort.
description_de: Qualitätspelz eines kleinen Tieres. Meist für Kleidung benutzt, da sehr bequem.
description_fr: La peau d'un petit animal. A de multiples usages, surtout pour les vêtements.
description_es: Piel de un animal pequeño. Tiene diversos usos, aunque el principal es hacer ropa.
description_it: Pelle di un piccolo animale. Si usa per molte cose, ma soprattutto per gli abiti.
description_zh: A quality pelt from a small animal. Often used in clothing for its comfort.

name: Anteka Antler
description: An antler often used as raw material for armor. Popular with interior decorators.
description_de: Geweih, oft als Rohmaterial für Rüstungen verwendet. Beliebt bei Raumausstattern.
description_fr: Bois utilisés comme matière première pour les armures ou pour décorer les intérieurs.
description_es: Cuerno que se usa de materia prima para armaduras. Gusta a los interioristas.
description_it: Corna usate spesso come materia prima per armature. Apprezzate come decorazioni.
description_zh: An antler often used as raw material for armor. Popular with interior decorators.

name: Anteka Proud Antler
description: A hefty antler that's valued by seasoned hunters and collectors alike.
description_de: Prächtiges Geweih, das unter Jägern und Sammlern sehr gefragt ist.
description_fr: Bois robustes prisés des chasseurs émérites comme des collectionneurs.
description_es: Cuerno muy popular entre los cazadores y los coleccionistas de artículos poco comunes.
description_it: Corna pesanti, molto apprezzate sia da cacciatori esperti che da collezionisti.
description_zh: A hefty antler that's valued by seasoned hunters and collectors alike.

name: Rhenoplos Shell
description: A shell that is very strong despite coming from such a small monster.
description_de: Sehr stark, obwohl er von so einem kleinen Monster stammt.
description_fr: Très solide, bien qu'elle provienne d'un si petit monstre.
description_es: Caparazón muy resistente a pesar de pertenecer a un monstruo tan pequeño.
description_it: Corazza molto resistente, nonostante appartenga a una creatura tanto piccola.
description_zh: A shell that is very strong despite coming from such a small monster.

name: Rhenoplos Carapace
description: A carapace grown thick and hard over many years. Incredibly strong for a small-monster part.
description_de: Mit den Jahren dick und hart geworden. Sehr stark für so ein kleines Teil.
description_fr: Incroyablement solide de par son âge. Provient pourtant d'un petit monstre.
description_es: Coraza gruesa y endurecida por los años. Muy fuerte, para ser de una criatura tan pequeña.
description_it: Carapace di un mostro minuscolo, che il tempo ha reso spesso e coriaceo.
description_zh: A carapace grown thick and hard over many years. Incredibly strong for a small-monster part.

name: Rhenoplos Scalp
description: A sturdy part of the skull that yields, shall we say, dashing results?
description_de: Robuster Teil des Schädels, der wahrhaft einschlägige Ergebnisse liefert.
description_fr: Partie solide du crâne qui produit, dirait-on, de superbes résultats.
description_es: Parte resistente del cráneo. Digamos que sus resultados son vistosos.
description_it: Una parte molto resistente del teschio. È l'ideale per le cariche a testa bassa.
description_zh: A sturdy part of the skull that yields, shall we say, dashing results?

name: Slagtoth Hide+
description: Firm, lustrous hide often cut into large slabs. Prized for its water-resistant properties.
description_de: Feste, glänzende Haut, oft grob zerteilt. Gute wasser- abweisende Eigenschaften.
description_fr: Magnifique cuir lustré. Très recherché pour sa résistance à l'eau.
description_es: Piel lustrosa y firme que se corta en grandes trozos. Resistente al agua.
description_it: Pelle compatta e lucida, spesso tagliata a strisce. Nota per l'impermeabilità.
description_zh: Firm, lustrous hide often cut into large slabs. Prized for its water-resistant properties.

name: Supple Piel
description: A flexible, elastic hide from a leviathan. A useful material that requires effort to obtain.
description_de: Elastische Leviathan-Haut. Ein nützliches Material, das man nicht leicht bekommt.
description_fr: Cuir souple et élastique de léviathan. Utile mais difficile à obtenir.
description_es: Piel flexible de leviathan. Útil material difícil de conseguir.
description_it: Pelle flessibile ed elastica di leviathan; utile ma difficile da reperire.
description_zh: A flexible, elastic hide from a leviathan. A useful material that requires effort to obtain.

name: Monster Fluid
description: A liquid bugs suck from monsters. Mixes with insect gastric fluids to form adhesive.
description_de: Saugen Käfer aus Monstern. Ihr Verdauungssaft macht das Fluid dann zu Klebstoff.
description_fr: Liquide qui est mélangé aux fluides gastriques pour créer un adhésif.
description_es: Líquido que los bichos chupan de los monstruos. Mezclado con fluidos digestivos es adhesivo.
description_it: Liquido succhiato dagli insetti. Diventa adesivo mescolandosi ai loro fluidi digerenti.
description_zh: A liquid bugs suck from monsters. Mixes with insect gastric fluids to form adhesive.

name: Monster Broth
description: A broth made from only the thickest of a monster's juices. Quite rich.
description_de: Brühe aus den dicksten Monstersäften. Sehr gehaltvoll.
description_fr: Riche brouet à base de fluides épais extraits de monstres.
description_es: Un caldo hecho únicamente con los jugos más densos de un monstruo. Muy espeso.
description_it: Un brodo fatto solo con i più densi succhi di un mostro. Molto nutriente.
description_zh: A broth made from only the thickest of a monster's juices. Quite rich.

name: Monster Essence
description: A broth made from only the thickest, choicest parts of a monster's juices. Gross?
description_de: Brühe aus den dicksten und besten Teilen von Monster- säften. Lecker, oder?
description_fr: Un brouet fabriqué à partir des meilleurs fluides épais de monstres. Appétissant ?
description_es: Caldo cocinado con partes selectas de los jugos de un monstruo. ¿Asqueroso?
description_it: Un brodo fatto solo con i più densi succhi di un mostro. Disgustoso?
description_zh: A broth made from only the thickest, choicest parts of a monster's juices. Gross?

name: Bnahabra Shell
description: Just as useful as sturdy wyvern shell in the hands of a clever craftsman.
description_de: So nützlich und robust wie Wyvern-Panzer in den Händen eines schlauen Handwerkers.
description_fr: Un artisan ingénieux peut en tirer autant que d'une carapace de wyverne.
description_es: En manos de un buen artesano, puede ser tan útil como el duro caparazón de un wyvern mayor.
description_it: Corazza di wyvern tanto robusta quanto apprezzata dagli artigiani più abili.
description_zh: Just as useful as sturdy wyvern shell in the hands of a clever craftsman.

name: Bnahabra Carapace
description: The hardest part of the shell. Reveals curious properties when forged.
description_de: Härtester Teil des Panzers. Zeigt nach dem Schmieden seltsame Eigenschaften.
description_fr: Partie la plus dure de la carapace. Révèle d'étranges propriétés une fois forgée.
description_es: Parte más dura del caparazón. Al forjarla se ven sus curiosas propiedades.
description_it: La parte più resistente della corazza. Rivela strane proprietà con la forgiatura.
description_zh: The hardest part of the shell. Reveals curious properties when forged.

name: Bnahabra Wing
description: Difficult to forge with -- the results vary depending on which surface you use.
description_de: Schwierig zu schmieden - die Ergebnisse hängen von der verwendeten Oberfläche ab.
description_fr: Des ailes dures à forger. Les résultats dépendent de la surface utilisée.
description_es: Difícil de forjar. El resultado varía según la superficie sobre la que se use.
description_it: Difficile da forgiare. I risultati dipendono dalla superficie utilizzata.
description_zh: Difficult to forge with -- the results vary depending on which surface you use.

name: Bnahabra Razorwing
description: A wing that slices like a well-honed knife. Difficult to use in forging.
description_de: Ein Flügel, der wie ein scharfes Messer schneidet. Schwer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Aile aussi tranchante qu'un couteau bien aiguisé. Dure à utiliser pour forger.
description_es: Ala que corta cual cuchillo. Difícil usarla en forja.
description_it: Ala nera e affilata come un coltello. Difficile da usare nella forgiatura.
description_zh: A wing that slices like a well-honed knife. Difficult to use in forging.

name: Altaroth Jaw
description: These durable mouthparts are surprisingly difficult to carve loose.
description_de: Diese robusten Mundwerkzeuge sind erstaunlich schwer zu entfernen.
description_fr: Ces mâchoires solides sont incroyablement dures à découper.
description_es: Parte de la boca resistente y muy difícil de extraer.
description_it: Strutture boccali resistenti e difficili da rimuovere.
description_zh: These durable mouthparts are surprisingly difficult to carve loose.

name: Altaroth Stomach
description: A transparent sac cut from an Altaroth's abdomen, used to store who knows what.
description_de: Durchsichtiger Beutel aus einem Altaroth-Bauch. Kann wer-weiß-was aufbewahren.
description_fr: Poche transparente d'Altaroth, au contenu inconnu.
description_es: Saco transparente del abdomen de un Altaroth. Utilizada para almacenar quién sabe qué.
description_it: Sacca trasparente con cui gli Altaroth portano di tutto dentro all'addome.
description_zh: A transparent sac cut from an Altaroth's abdomen, used to store who knows what.

name: Quality Stomach
description: A high-quality sac cut from an Altaroth's abdomen. Its refined material is thin but durable.
description_de: Sehr hochwertiger Beutel aus dem Altaroth-Bauch. Dünn, aber trotzdem haltbar.
description_fr: Estomac d'Altaroth de haute qualité. Sa peau est fine mais très robuste.
description_es: Un órgano llamativo del abdomen de un Altaroth. De material fino pero duradero.
description_it: Stomaco di qualità dall'addome di un Altaroth. È di un materiale sottile ma resistente.
description_zh: A high-quality sac cut from an Altaroth's abdomen. Its refined material is thin but durable.

name: Premium Stomach
description: A rare find, as Altaroth stomachs go. It can never be torn, or so they say.
description_de: Extrem selten zu erbeutender Altaroth-Magen. Soll angeblich absolut unverwüstlich sein.
description_fr: Estomac d'Altaroth exceptionnel ayant la réputation d'être indéchirable.
description_es: Un estómago de Altaroth como hay pocos. Dicen que es imposible de rasgar.
description_it: Un rarissimo stomaco di Altaroth. Si dice che non possa essere fatto a pezzi.
description_zh: A rare find, as Altaroth stomachs go. It can never be torn, or so they say.

name: Vespoid Shell
description: With special materials, it can be worked into very strong armor.
description_de: Wird mit speziellen Materialien zu einer starken Rüstung gemacht.
description_fr: Associée à des matériaux spéciaux, peut devenir une armure très puissante.
description_es: Con los materiales adecuados, se puede hacer con ella una armadura muy resistente.
description_it: Con materiali speciali, può diventare una corazza molto forte.
description_zh: With special materials, it can be worked into very strong armor.

name: Vespoid Carapace
description: The hardest part of a Vespoid shell. Exhibits special properties when processed.
description_de: Härtester Panzerteil. Zeigt bei Verarbeitung besondere Merkmale.
description_fr: Zone dure d'une carapace Vespoid. A des propriétés spéciales lorsque traitée.
description_es: Parte dura del caparazón de un Vespoid. Tiene propiedades muy particulares.
description_it: Parte più dura di corazza di Vespoid. Se lavorata, ha speciali proprietà.
description_zh: The hardest part of a Vespoid shell. Exhibits special properties when processed.

name: Vespoid Wing
description: Difficult to forge with -- the results vary depending on which surface you use.
description_de: Schwierig zu schmieden - die Ergebnisse hängen von der verwendeten Oberfläche ab.
description_fr: Des ailes dures à forger. Les résultats dépendent de la surface utilisée.
description_es: Difícil de forjar. El resultado varía según la superficie sobre la que se use.
description_it: Difficile da forgiare. I risultati dipendono dalla superficie utilizzata.
description_zh: Difficult to forge with -- the results vary depending on which surface you use.

name: Vespoid Innerwing
description: Blade-shaped innerwing of a Vespoid. The secret behind the beast's killing prowess.
description_de: Der klingenförmige innere Flügel eines Vespoid, dadurch von mörderischer Natur.
description_fr: Cette partie de l'aile en forme de lame est son secret pour tuer ses proies.
description_es: Ala interna con forma de cuchilla de un Vespoid: el secreto de su habilidad como asesino.
description_it: Ala interna di un Vespoid; è a forma di lama. Il suo segreto come assassino.
description_zh: Blade-shaped innerwing of a Vespoid. The secret behind the beast's killing prowess.

name: Vespoid Razorwing
description: Much sharper than a Vespoid Innerwing. A simple graze is more than enough to cut.
description_de: Schärfer als der Innenflügel. Bereits simple Berührungen fügen Wunden zu.
description_fr: Plus affûtée que l'aile interne. Coupe au toucher.
description_es: Más afilada que el ala interior. Un simple toque es suficiente para provocar un gran corte.
description_it: È più affilata dell'ala interna. Taglia la carne solo sfiorandola.
description_zh: Much sharper than a Vespoid Innerwing. A simple graze is more than enough to cut.

name: Hornetaur Shell
description: With special materials, it can be worked into very strong armor.
description_de: Wird mit speziellen Materialien zu einer starken Rüstung gemacht.
description_fr: Associée à des matériaux spéciaux, elle peut devenir une armure très puissante.
description_es: Con los materiales adecuados, se puede hacer con ella una armadura muy resistente.
description_it: Con materiali speciali, può diventare una corazza molto forte.
description_zh: With special materials, it can be worked into very strong armor.

name: Hornetaur Carapace
description: The hard part of a Hornetaur shell. Exhibits special properties when worked.
description_de: Harter Teil des Panzers. Zeigt bei Bearbeitung besondere Eigenschaften.
description_fr: Partie dure d'une cuirasse d'Hornetaur. Propriétés spéciales après travail.
description_es: Parte dura del caparazón de un Hornetaur. Tiene propiedades especiales si se trabaja bien.
description_it: Parte dura di corazza di Hornetaur. Ha speciali proprietà se è lavorato.
description_zh: The hard part of a Hornetaur shell. Exhibits special properties when worked.

name: Hornetaur Wing
description: A hard-to-work material. Appears pearl-like when struck by light.
description_de: Schwieriges Material. Erscheint im Licht perlmuttartig.
description_fr: Matériau difficile à travailler. Iridescent à la lumière.
description_es: Un material difícil de trabajar. Brilla como el nácar a la luz del día.
description_it: Un materiale difficile da lavorare. Alla luce ha un aspetto perlaceo.
description_zh: A hard-to-work material. Appears pearl-like when struck by light.

name: Hornetaur Innerwing
description: A blade-shaped innerwing of a Hornetaur. The secret to its killing prowess.
description_de: Klingenförmiger innerer Flügel eines Hornetaur. Macht ihn so mörderisch.
description_fr: Aile interne d'Hornetaur en forme de lame. Secret de sa capacité à tuer.
description_es: Ala interna de un Hornetaur, con forma de cuchilla. Elemento clave de su destreza asesina.
description_it: Ala interna di Hornetaur; è a forma di lama. Il suo segreto come assassino.
description_zh: A blade-shaped innerwing of a Hornetaur. The secret to its killing prowess.

name: Hornetaur Razorwing
description: Much sharper than a Hornetaur Innerwing. A simple graze is more than enough to cut.
description_de: Schärfer als der Innenflügel. Bereits simple Berührungen fügen Wunden zu.
description_fr: Plus affûtée que l'aile interne. Coupe au toucher.
description_es: Más afilada que el ala interior. Un simple toque es suficiente para provocar un gran corte.
description_it: È più affilata dell'ala interna. Taglia la carne solo sfiorandola.
description_zh: Much sharper than a Hornetaur Innerwing. A simple graze is more than enough to cut.

name: Hornetaur Head
description: With special materials, it can be worked into strong weapons or armor.
description_de: Wird mit speziellen Materialien zu starker Rüstung oder Waffe.
description_fr: Associée à des matériaux spéciaux, peut donner des armes ou armures de choix.
description_es: Con los materiales adecuados, se pueden hacer con ella armas y armaduras de gran calidad.
description_it: Con materiali speciali può essere trasformata in armi o in corazze.
description_zh: With special materials, it can be worked into strong weapons or armor.

name: Konchu Shell
description: A shield-like insect shell as hard as any mineral. It emits an indescribable glow.
description_de: Schildähnlicher Insekten- panzer, hart wie Mineralien. Leuchtet unbeschreiblich.
description_fr: Carapace d'insecte aussi dure qu'un minéral. Émet une lueur indescriptible.
description_es: Caparazón de insecto similar a un escudo, de gran dureza. Su brillo es indescriptible.
description_it: Corazza d'insetto simile a uno scudo. È dura come il metallo ed emette un bagliore.
description_zh: A shield-like insect shell as hard as any mineral. It emits an indescribable glow.

name: Konchu Carapace
description: A shield-like insect shell so hard that only a supreme craftsman can forge it.
description_de: Schildähnlicher Insekten- panzer. Nur Technik-Asse können ihn schmieden.
description_fr: Carapace d'insecte si dure que seul un technicien d'exception peut la forger.
description_es: Coraza de insecto similar a un escudo. Tan dura que solo los mejores pueden forjarla.
description_it: Corazza d'insetto simile a uno scudo. Solo i tecnici più abili possono forgiarla.
description_zh: A shield-like insect shell so hard that only a supreme craftsman can forge it.

name: Konchu Cortex
description: A shield-like insect shell so hard that only a supreme craftsman can forge it.
description_de: Panzerung eines für Abwehr bekannten Monsters. Ideale Form und Belastbarkeit.
description_fr: Carapace d'insecte si dure que seul un technicien d'exception peut la forger.
description_es: Coraza de insecto similar a un escudo. Tan dura que solo los mejores pueden forjarla.
description_it: Corazza di un mostro rinomato per le sue difese. Ideale per forma e capacità di resistenza.
description_zh: A shield-like insect shell so hard that only a supreme craftsman can forge it.

name: Shocking Extract
description: A concentrate of Thunderbug essence that releases an electrical discharge when struck.
description_de: Wird diese Flüssigkeit erschüttert, entlädt sich die in ihr gespeicherte Elektrizität.
description_fr: Concentré de foudrinsecte qui libère une décharge électrique sous l'effet d'un choc.
description_es: Concentrado de bicho eléctrico que produce descargas cuando recibe un impacto.
description_it: Succo di insetto-tuono che rilascia una scarica elettrica quando viene colpito.
description_zh: A concentrate of Thunderbug essence that releases an electrical discharge when struck.

name: Shocking Jelly
description: A gelatinous substance made from Great Thunderbugs. Easy to use and generates high voltage.
description_de: Das Gelee speichert noch mehr Elektrizität als der Saft. Beim Umgang ist Vorsicht geboten.
description_fr: Substance gélatineuse sécrétée par les Grands foudrinsectes. Puissante et simple d'utilisation.
description_es: Gelatina de Gran Insectrueno. Es fácil de manejar y produce descargas de alto voltaje.
description_it: Sostanza gelatinosa di un insetto-tuono grande. Facile da usare, genera un alto voltaggio.
description_zh: A gelatinous substance made from Great Thunderbugs. Easy to use and generates high voltage.

name: Remobra Hide
description: A glossy and subdued black hide taken from a Remobra.
description_de: Glänzende Haut in gedämpftem Schwarz von einem Remobra.
description_fr: Cuir brillant de couleur noire passée provenant d'un Remobra.
description_es: Piel negra y brillante perteneciente a un Remobra.
description_it: Brillante pelle nera appartenuta a un Remobra. È ormai consumata dal tempo.
description_zh: A glossy and subdued black hide taken from a Remobra.

name: Remobra Hide+
description: A lustrous and elegant black hide taken from a Remobra.
description_de: Schimmernde Haut in elegantem Schwarz von einem Remobra.
description_fr: Cuir noir lustré et élégant provenant d'un Remobra.
description_es: Piel negra, lustrosa y elegante, de un Remobra.
description_it: Lucida ed elegante pelle nera appartenuta a un Remobra.
description_zh: A lustrous and elegant black hide taken from a Remobra.

name: Remobra Finehide
description: The highest quality in Remobra skins. It shines with a luster reminiscent of a black pearl.
description_de: Remobra-Haut höchster Qualität. Schimmert wie eine Schwarze Perle.
description_fr: Peau de Remobra de qualité supérieure. Scintille d'un éclat de perle noire.
description_es: Piel de Remobra de alta calidad. Tiene un lustre de perla negra.
description_it: Pelle di Remobra di ottima qualità. Ha una lucentezza nero-perlacea.
description_zh: The highest quality in Remobra skins. It shines with a luster reminiscent of a black pearl.

name: Striped Skin
description: Unassuming black-and-red hues from a Remobra that some hunters swear by.
description_de: Unaufdringliche Schwarz- und Rottöne von einem Remobra. Manche Jäger schwören drauf.
description_fr: Des chasseurs ne jurent que par cette peau de Remobra aux teintes discrètes.
description_es: De sencillos tonos rojos y negros. Algunos cazadores juran que es de Remobra.
description_it: Striature di Remobra in banali tonalità rosso-nere. Amate da alcuni cacciatori.
description_zh: Unassuming black-and-red hues from a Remobra that some hunters swear by.

name: Striped Finehide
description: Classy Remobra stripes on a resilient hide--a winner in any hunter's book.
description_de: Ein robustes Leder mit schicken Remobra-Streifen - kein Wunder, dass es überaus wertvoll ist.
description_fr: En alliant rayures de Remobra et solidité du cuir, cette peau gagne sur tous les tableaux.
description_es: Piel especial de Remobra muy robusta. Se vende a buen precio por su gran calidad.
description_it: Strisce di pelle di Remobra, indispensabili per qualunque cacciatore.
description_zh: Classy Remobra stripes on a resilient hide--a winner in any hunter's book.

name: Remobra Head
description: The snake-like head of a Remobra. It still looks ready to pounce!
description_de: Schlangenähnlicher Kopf eines Remobra. Sieht immer noch kampfbereit aus!
description_fr: Tête d'apparence reptilienne qui semble toujours prête à bondir sur les proies !
description_es: Cabeza con forma de serpiente de un Remobra. ¡Parece lista para atacar por sorpresa!
description_it: La testa serpentina di un Remobra. Sembra ancora pronta ad azzannare!
description_zh: The snake-like head of a Remobra. It still looks ready to pounce!

name: Mighty Remobra Head
description: The snake-like head of a Remobra. Being in its presence may induce mild panic.
description_de: Schlangenähnlicher Kopf eines Remobra. Weckt immer noch Fluchtinstinkte.
description_fr: Tête d'apparence reptilienne dont la seule présence suffit à causer des sueurs froides.
description_es: Cabeza con forma de serpiente de un Remobra. Verla de cerca puede asustar un poco.
description_it: La testa serpentina di un Remobra. La sola vista causa panico.
description_zh: The snake-like head of a Remobra. Being in its presence may induce mild panic.

name: Bird Wyvern Fang
description: A sharp, durable fang from a bird wyvern. Used to make Bowgun ammo.
description_de: Scharfer Reißzahn eines Vogelwyvern. Bestandteil von Bogengewehr-Munition.
description_fr: Croc de wyverne rapace. Utilisé pour fabriquer des munitions de fusarbalète.
description_es: Colmillo afilado de un wyvern pájaro. Se usa como munición de ballesta.
description_it: Zanna affilata e robusta di wyvern rapace. Usata per proiettili da balestra.
description_zh: A sharp, durable fang from a bird wyvern. Used to make Bowgun ammo.

name: Maccao Scale
description: A scale carved from a Maccao. Although soft, it offers good protection from the elements.
description_de: Die Maccao-Schuppe ist weich, bietet jedoch guten Schutz vor den Elementen.
description_fr: Écaille de Maccao. Malgré sa douceur, elle protège bien face aux éléments.
description_es: Escama extraída de un Maccao. Aunque es blanda, protege bien de los elementos.
description_it: Scaglia di Maccao. Sebbene morbida, garantisce una buona protezione dagli elementi.
description_zh: A scale carved from a Maccao. Although soft, it offers good protection from the elements.

name: Maccao Scale+
description: A superior scale from a Maccao. Its rigidity and durability make for excellent armor.
description_de: Diese bessere Schuppe ist hart und strapazierfähig; gut für Rüstungen geeignet.
description_fr: Écaille supérieure de Maccao. Rigide et résistante. Idéale pour forger une bonne armure.
description_es: Escama superior de Maccao. Crea una armadura excelente por su rigidez y resistencia.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata di Maccao. Abbastanza dura e rigida da garantire una buona difesa.
description_zh: A superior scale from a Maccao. Its rigidity and durability make for excellent armor.

name: Maccao Shard
description: An especially tough scale carved from a Maccao that offers resistance to vicious attacks.
description_de: Diese besonders starke Schuppe bietet Schutz vor den stärksten Angriffen.
description_fr: Écaille extrêmement résistante prélevée sur un Maccao pouvant offrir davantage de protection.
description_es: Escama gruesa de Maccao. Es capaz de resistir potentes ataques.
description_it: Frammento particolarmente duro, estratto da un Maccao. Resiste a quasi qualunque attacco.
description_zh: An especially tough scale carved from a Maccao that offers resistance to vicious attacks.

name: Maccao Hide
description: A Maccao hide stripped of its scales. Its elasticity allows for free and easy movement.
description_de: Diese Haut wurde von den Schuppen befreit und erlaubt eine gute Bewegungsfreiheit.
description_fr: Peau de Maccao dépourvue de ses écailles. Son élasticité offre une belle liberté de mouvement.
description_es: Piel de Maccao desprovista de escamas. Su elasticidad ofrece libertad de movimientos.
description_it: Pelle di Maccao privata delle scaglie. La sua elasticità non ostacola i movimenti.
description_zh: A Maccao hide stripped of its scales. Its elasticity allows for free and easy movement.

name: Great Maccao Scale
description: A scale that gets stronger when struck. Scales from the hands and feet are especially tough.
description_de: Schuppe, die unter Belastung stärker wird. An Händen und Füßen extra stark.
description_fr: Écaille plus résistante aux impacts, surtout au niveau des mains et des pieds.
description_es: Escama que gana dureza al golpearla. Las más cercanas a pies y manos son aún más duras.
description_it: Scaglie che si rafforzano con gli urti. Quelle poste sulle zampe sono più robuste.
description_zh: A scale that gets stronger when struck. Scales from the hands and feet are especially tough.

name: Great Maccao Scale+
description: A superior Great Maccao scale. The rarer, yellow scales are often used as decorations.
description_de: Bessere Groß-Maccao-Schuppe. Die seltenen, gelben Schuppen sind von besonderer Schönheit.
description_fr: Écaille supérieure de Grand Maccao. L'écaille jaune, rare, sert souvent de décoration.
description_es: Escama superior de Gran Maccao amarilla y poco usual, utilizada con fines decorativos.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata di Gran Maccao. Quelle gialle e rare sono usate come decorazioni.
description_zh: A superior Great Maccao scale. The rarer, yellow scales are often used as decorations.

name: Great Maccao Shard
description: An especially thick Great Maccao scale that's become hardened over the years.
description_de: Besonders starke Groß-Maccao- Schuppe, die über lange Jahre extrem hart geworden ist.
description_fr: Écaille de Grand Maccao très épaisse et endurcie par le poids des années.
description_es: Escama gruesa de Gran Maccao que se ha reforzado con el paso del tiempo.
description_it: Frammento di Gran Maccao, spesso e diventato molto duro con il tempo.
description_zh: An especially thick Great Maccao scale that's become hardened over the years.

name: Great Maccao Hide
description: The braver the specimen, the duller and stronger this red hide becomes. Highly prized.
description_de: Je nach Exemplar fällt diese rote Haut noch belastbarer aus. Sehr kostbar.
description_fr: Plus le spécimen est courageux, plus sa peau rouge ternit et se raffermit. Très prisée.
description_es: Cuanto más bravo es el animal, más apagada y fuerte es esta piel roja. Muy valiosa.
description_it: La pelle degli esemplari molto combattivi è più rossa e dura, nonché pregiata.
description_zh: The braver the specimen, the duller and stronger this red hide becomes. Highly prized.

name: Great Maccao Hide+
description: Top-grade red Great Maccao hide. It is valued for its scars, and is used to reward valor.
description_de: Eine Haut in Spitzenqualität, deren Narben kostbar sind. Eine Belohnung für Mutige.
description_fr: Peau rouge de Grand Maccao. Très prisée pour ses cicatrices, elle récompense la bravoure.
description_es: Piel roja de Gran Maccao de calidad. Muy apreciada, se usa para recompensar el valor.
description_it: Pelle rossastra resa molto preziosa dalle cicatrici. È usata come premio al valore.
description_zh: Top-grade red Great Maccao hide. It is valued for its scars, and is used to reward valor.

name: Great Maccao Piel
description: The high quality hide of a Great Maccao, made resilient from old wounds.
description_de: Eine Haut, deren Narben sie noch fester gemacht haben. Sehr stark als Material.
description_fr: Cuir de qualité d'un Grand Maccao, endurci par d'anciennes blessures.
description_es: Piel de Gran Maccao muy preciada. Viejas heridas la han fortalecido con los años.
description_it: Pelle di Gran Maccao di ottima qualità, resa resistente da vecchie ferite.
description_zh: The high quality hide of a Great Maccao, made resilient from old wounds.

name: Champion's Crest
description: Maccao males have decorative feathers, whose beauty is directly related to strength.
description_de: Maccao-Männchen haben einen Federschmuck, an dem man sieht, wie stark sie sind.
description_fr: Le Maccao mâle arbore des plumes décoratives, dont la beauté est proportionnelle à sa force.
description_es: El Maccao macho tiene plumas ornamentales, cuya belleza se vincula a su fuerza.
description_it: I maschi di Maccao sfoggiano piume la cui bellezza è proporzionale alla forza.
description_zh: Maccao males have decorative feathers, whose beauty is directly related to strength.

name: Glorious Crest
description: This eye-catching plumage indicates alpha status in the Great Maccao hierarchy.
description_de: Dieser prächtige Kamm zeigt bei Groß-Maccaos an, welches das Alphatier ist.
description_fr: Plumage tape-à-l'œil caractéristique d'un Grand Maccao alpha.
description_es: Plumas ornamentales de gran belleza características de un Gran Maccao alfa.
description_it: Questo splendido piumaggio appartiene ai maschi alfa tra i Gran Maccao.
description_zh: This eye-catching plumage indicates alpha status in the Great Maccao hierarchy.

name: Maccao Tailspike
description: Extremely hard, it provides balance, gripping the ground like claws.
description_de: Extrem hart. Wird eingesetzt wie eine Klaue und dient der Verbesserung der Balance.
description_fr: Extrêmement solide, elle favorise l'équilibre en serrant le sol comme des griffes.
description_es: Excepcionalmente dura, otorga equilibrio, ya que se fija al suelo como una garra.
description_it: È estremamente rigida e aiuta l'equilibrio affondando nel terreno come un artiglio.
description_zh: Extremely hard, it provides balance, gripping the ground like claws.

name: Maccao Tailspear
description: A particularly hefty tailspike, even by Maccao standards. Indispensable for crafting.
description_de: Außergewöhnlich hart, deshalb können nur Meister ihn verarbeiten.
description_fr: Piqueue particulièrement lourde, même pour un Maccao. C'est un matériau incontournable.
description_es: Una púa de Maccao más dura de lo normal. Indispensable para forjar.
description_it: Aculeo da coda, pesante anche per gli standard dei Maccao. Utilissimo per creare armi.
description_zh: A particularly hefty tailspike, even by Maccao standards. Indispensable for crafting.

name: Jaggi Scale
description: A scale carved from a Jaggi. Popular among hunters for its beauty and crafting versatility.
description_de: Jaggi-Schuppe. Unter Jägern wegen ihrer Schönheit und Vielseitigkeit sehr beliebt.
description_fr: Écaille appréciée des chasseurs pour sa beauté et son utilité.
description_es: Escama cortada de un Jaggi. Gusta a los cazadores por su belleza y versatilidad.
description_it: Scaglia di Jaggi. Apprezzata dai cacciatori per bellezza e versatilità nelle lavorazioni.
description_zh: A scale carved from a Jaggi. Popular among hunters for its beauty and crafting versatility.

name: Jaggi Scale+
description: A vividly-colored superior Jaggi scale that can be used to produce hardier equipment.
description_de: Bunte, hochwertige Jaggi- Schuppe, mit der man bessere Ausrüstung herstellen kann.
description_fr: Écaille colorée de qualité supérieure. Produit des équipements résistants.
description_es: Escama colorida de un Jaggi usada para dar más durabilidad al equipamiento.
description_it: Ottima scaglia sgargiante di Jaggi, utile per produrre equipaggiamenti più resistenti.
description_zh: A vividly-colored superior Jaggi scale that can be used to produce hardier equipment.

name: Jaggi Shard
description: An excellent Jaggi scale favored by hunters as it can be easily worked into the toughest gear.
description_de: Außergewöhnlich hochwertige Jaggi-Schuppe. Stark und einfach zu verarbeiten, daher beliebt.
description_fr: Écaille de Jaggi prisée par les chasseurs pour sa malléabilité et sa résistance.
description_es: Escama gruesa de un Jaggi. Gusta a los cazadores por su dureza y versatilidad.
description_it: Eccellente frammento di Jaggi. I cacciatori lo amano perché molto usato per costruire armi.
description_zh: An excellent Jaggi scale favored by hunters as it can be easily worked into the toughest gear.

name: Jaggi Hide
description: Soft hide from beneath a Jaggi's scales. Cheap and easy to work with, it has numerous uses.
description_de: Weiche Jaggi-Haut, unter den Schuppen zu finden. Günstig, praktisch, vielseitig.
description_fr: Du cuir souple bon marché et facile à travailler. Pour des usages multiples.
description_es: Piel blanda de escamas de un Jaggi. Barata y fácil de trabajar. Tiene muchos usos.
description_it: Morbida pelle sotto le scaglie dei Jaggi. Versatile, economica e semplice da lavorare.
description_zh: Soft hide from beneath a Jaggi's scales. Cheap and easy to work with, it has numerous uses.

name: Jaggi Piel
description: Very thick, even for Jaggi hide. A distinctively smooth material that's easy to work with.
description_de: Sogar für Jaggi-Verhältnisse extrem dicke Haut. Geschmeidig und leicht zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Cuir étonnamment épais pour un Jaggi. Sa douceur en fait un matériau agréable à travailler.
description_es: Piel de Jaggi muy dura. Se caracteriza por su suavidad y versatilidad.
description_it: Particolarmente robusto, anche per gli standard dei Jaggi. È facile da lavorare perché liscio.
description_zh: Very thick, even for Jaggi hide. A distinctively smooth material that's easy to work with.

name: Velociprey Scale
description: A scale obtained by carving up a Velociprey. Blue and black in color.
description_de: Erhält man durch Zerlegen eines Velociprey. Farbe: blau-schwarz.
description_fr: Écaille bleue et noire d'un Velociprey.
description_es: Escama obtenida al despiezar a un Velociprey. De color azul y negro.
description_it: Scaglia ottenuta affettando un Velociprey. Colorata di azzurro e nero.
description_zh: A scale obtained by carving up a Velociprey. Blue and black in color.

name: Velociprey Scale+
description: A scale stripped from a Velociprey. It can be made into light, durable armor.
description_de: Eine Schuppe des Velociprey, aus der man leichte, haltbare Rüstungen macht.
description_fr: Écaille de Velociprey. Peut servir à forger des armures légères et durables.
description_es: Escama obtenida de un Velociprey. Buena para fabricar armaduras ligeras y duraderas.
description_it: Scaglia di un Velociprey. Può diventare una leggera e durevole armatura.
description_zh: A scale stripped from a Velociprey. It can be made into light, durable armor.

name: Velociprey Shard
description: A thick scale carved from a Velociprey. It's light and easy to carry, yet hardy.
description_de: Dicke Schuppe eines Velociprey. Robust, aber leicht.
description_fr: Écaille épaisse de Velociprey. Elle est aussi légère que solide.
description_es: Escama gruesa de Velociprey. Muy resistente y fácil de transportar.
description_it: Frammento spesso di un Velociprey. È leggero e facile da trasportare.
description_zh: A thick scale carved from a Velociprey. It's light and easy to carry, yet hardy.

name: Velociprey Hide
description: A hide stripped of its scales. Used to join the plates in a suit of armor.
description_de: Entschuppte Haut. Verbindet die Platten einer Rüstung.
description_fr: Peau débarrassée de ses écailles. Sert à joindre les plaques d'une armure.
description_es: Piel a la que se han arrancado las escamas. Útil como base de las placas de una armadura.
description_it: Pelle senza scaglie. Usata per tenere insieme le piastre di un'armatura.
description_zh: A hide stripped of its scales. Used to join the plates in a suit of armor.

name: Velociprey Hide+
description: The high-quality, descaled hide of a Velociprey, it has many applications.
description_de: Die entschuppte Haut eines Velociprey mit vielen Nutzungsmöglichkeiten.
description_fr: Du cuir de qualité sans écailles, ayant de multiples applications.
description_es: Piel descamada de un Velociprey, de alta calidad. Tiene muchos usos.
description_it: Pelle di alta qualità di Velociprey, senza scaglie. Ha molte applicazioni.
description_zh: The high-quality, descaled hide of a Velociprey, it has many applications.

name: Velocidrome Hide
description: The hide of a Velociprey leader. It bears the scars of a leadership role.
description_de: Die Haut eines Velociprey- Anführers. Trägt die Narben eines Anführers.
description_fr: Peau d'un chef Velociprey. Ses cicatrices prouvent son rang.
description_es: Piel del líder de un grupo de Velociprey. Con las cicatrices que corresponden a un líder.
description_it: La pelle di un capo di Velociprey. Lo si nota dalle cicatrici.
description_zh: The hide of a Velociprey leader. It bears the scars of a leadership role.

name: Velocidrome Hide+
description: Top-grade Velocidrome hide. It's extremely tough, despite being covered in scars.
description_de: Velocidrome-Haut der besten Qualität. Extrem widerstands- fähig, trotz der vielen Narben.
description_fr: Peau haut de gamme de Velocidrome. Très résistante bien que couverte de cicatrices.
description_es: Piel de Velocidrome de calidad. Extremadamente dura, a pesar de estar cubierta de cicatrices.
description_it: Pregiata pelle di Velocidrome. È molto resistente, sebbene sia ricoperta di cicatrici.
description_zh: Top-grade Velocidrome hide. It's extremely tough, despite being covered in scars.

name: Velocidrome Piel
description: Dense Velocidrome hide. It can take a lot of punishment, as evidenced by all the scars.
description_de: Dicke Velocidrome-Haut, die viel aushält, wie die zahlreichen Narben belegen.
description_fr: Cuir épais de Velocidrome. Peut résister à de nombreux assauts, comme le prouvent ses cicatrices.
description_es: Piel dura de Velocidrome. Puede resistir muchos golpes, como demuestran todas las cicatrices.
description_it: Pelle dura di Velocidrome. Ha una grande resistenza agli attacchi, come si vede dalle cicatrici.
description_zh: Dense Velocidrome hide. It can take a lot of punishment, as evidenced by all the scars.

name: Velocidrome Claw
description: The claw of a Velocidrome. Its tip is as deadly as a sharpened knife.
description_de: Die Klauen des Velocidrome sind scharf und tödlich wie ein Messer.
description_fr: Griffe de Velocidrome à la pointe aussi mortelle qu'un couteau aiguisé.
description_es: Garra de un Velocidrome. Su punta es tan letal como un cuchillo afilado.
description_it: L'artiglio di un Velocidrome. La sua punta è letale come un pugnale affilato.
description_zh: The claw of a Velocidrome. Its tip is as deadly as a sharpened knife.

name: Velocidrome Claw+
description: The sharp claw of a Velocidrome. It can easily slice through prey.
description_de: Die Scharfe Klaue eines Velocidrome. Kann Beute leicht aufschlitzen.
description_fr: Griffe acérée d'un Velocidrome. Tranche aisément sa proie.
description_es: Garra afiladísima de un Velocidrome. Puede desgarrar fácilmente a cualquier presa.
description_it: L'affilato artiglio di un Velocidrome. Squarcia con facilità la preda.
description_zh: The sharp claw of a Velocidrome. It can easily slice through prey.

name: Velocidrome Talon
description: The sharpest of Velocidrome claws, allowing it to mercilessly rip its prey to shreds.
description_de: Ungewöhnlich scharfe Klaue, die jede Beute in kleine Streifen reißen kann.
description_fr: Griffe la plus acérée d'un Velocidrome, capable de tailler sa proie en pièces.
description_es: Garra dura y afilada de un Velocidrome. Corta piel y huesos con asombrosa facilidad.
description_it: L'artiglio più tagliente del Velocidrome. Taglia senza pietà qualunque preda.
description_zh: The sharpest of Velocidrome claws, allowing it to mercilessly rip its prey to shreds.

name: Velocidrome Head
description: A large head with a crest. You'd look pretty fierce if you put it on.
description_de: Ein großer Kopf mit Kamm. Verleiht dem Träger ein ziemlich wildes Aussehen.
description_fr: Large tête ornée d'une crête. Donne une apparence féroce à qui s'en coiffe.
description_es: Cabeza grande con cresta. Da un aspecto feroz a quien la viste.
description_it: Grossa testa con una cresta. Se la indossassi sembreresti più feroce.
description_zh: A large head with a crest. You'd look pretty fierce if you put it on.

name: Genprey Fang
description: The poisonous fang of a Genprey. The paralyzing toxin works even on wyverns.
description_de: Der Giftzahn eines Genprey. Das lähmende Nervengift wirkt sogar bei Wyvern.
description_fr: Croc venimeux dont la neurotoxine paralysante affecte les wyvernes.
description_es: Colmillo venenoso de un Genprey, cuya toxina paraliza incluso a wyverns.
description_it: Zanna velenosa di Genprey. La tossina paralizzante agisce sui wyvern.
description_zh: The poisonous fang of a Genprey. The paralyzing toxin works even on wyverns.

name: Genprey Scale
description: Scale from a Genprey. Acts as camouflage in desert areas.
description_de: Die Schuppe eines Genprey. Dient als Tarnung in verlassenen Gebieten.
description_fr: Écaille de Genprey qui aide à se camoufler dans le désert.
description_es: Escama de un Genprey. Sirve de camuflaje en zonas desérticas.
description_it: Scaglia di un Genprey. Serve da mimetizzazione nella zona desertica.
description_zh: Scale from a Genprey. Acts as camouflage in desert areas.

name: Genprey Scale+
description: Scale taken from a Genprey. Strong enough to repel a wyvern's fangs.
description_de: Die Schuppe eines Genprey. Stark genug, um Wyvern- Zähne abzuwehren.
description_fr: Écaille assez résistante pour repousser les crocs des wyvernes.
description_es: Escama de un Genprey. Capaz incluso de repeler los colmillos de un wyvern.
description_it: Scaglia di un Genprey. Tanto forte da resistere alle zanne di un wyvern.
description_zh: Scale taken from a Genprey. Strong enough to repel a wyvern's fangs.

name: Genprey Shard
description: Superior scale taken from a Genprey, that not even the sharpest of fangs can pierce.
description_de: Die Schuppe eines Genprey. Stark genug, um die schärfsten Zähne abzuwehren.
description_fr: Écaille de Genprey de qualité supérieure, que le plus affûté des crocs ne saurait percer.
description_es: Escama gruesa de un Genprey. Es tan dura que ni los colmillos más afilados pueden atravesarla.
description_it: Frammento superiore di un Genprey, resistente anche alle zanne più affilate.
description_zh: Superior scale taken from a Genprey, that not even the sharpest of fangs can pierce.

name: Genprey Hide
description: A hide with all the scales removed. Can be tanned and turned into leather.
description_de: Komplett schuppenfreie Haut. Kann im Fort gegerbt werden.
description_fr: Peau colorée dont les écailles ont été retirées. Peut être tannée en cuir.
description_es: Una piel descamada. Se puede curtir para convertirla en cuero.
description_it: Una pelle senza scaglie. Colorata e adatta alla concia.
description_zh: A hide with all the scales removed. Can be tanned and turned into leather.

name: Genprey Hide+
description: The high-quality, descaled hide of a Genprey. It can neutralize neurotoxins.
description_de: Hochwertige, entschuppte Haut eines Genprey. Kann Nervengift neutralisieren.
description_fr: Du cuir Genprey sans écailles de qualité. Il peut neutraliser les toxines.
description_es: Piel de Genprey de alta calidad y sin escamas. Neutraliza las neurotoxinas.
description_it: Pelle di alta qualità di Genprey, senza scaglie. Neutralizza neurotossine.
description_zh: The high-quality, descaled hide of a Genprey. It can neutralize neurotoxins.

name: Gendrome Hide
description: Sturdy green hide from a Gendrome. Perfect for making strong armor.
description_de: Die robuste grüne Haut eines Gendrome. Perfekt für starke Rüstungen.
description_fr: Peau robuste verte d'un Gendrome. Parfaite pour les armures puissantes.
description_es: La piel verde y robusta de un Gendrome. Ideal para hacer fuertes armaduras.
description_it: Robusta pelle verde di un Gendrome. Perfetta per fabbricare armature.
description_zh: Sturdy green hide from a Gendrome. Perfect for making strong armor.

name: Gendrome Hide+
description: A high-quality green hide from a Gendrome. The hides of leaders are especially tough.
description_de: Hochwertige, grüne ledrige Haut eines Gendrome. Die Haut der Anführer ist besonders stark.
description_fr: Peau verte d'un Gendrome offrant résistance et qualité. La peau des chefs est encore plus dure.
description_es: Piel verde de Gendrome de calidad. La piel de los líderes es especialmente dura.
description_it: Pregiata pelle verde di Gendrome. I capibranco hanno pelli più robuste.
description_zh: A high-quality green hide from a Gendrome. The hides of leaders are especially tough.

name: Gendrome Piel
description: Superior Gendrome hide, toughened by long years of leading the herd.
description_de: Erstklassige Gendrome-Haut eines langjährigen Herdenan- führers. Überaus hart.
description_fr: Cuir de Gendrome de qualité supérieure, tanné par le poids des années.
description_es: Piel dura de Gendrome. Largos años liderando la manada la han fortalecido.
description_it: Manto superiore di Gendrome, reso resistente dai molti anni di conduzione del branco.
description_zh: Superior Gendrome hide, toughened by long years of leading the herd.

name: Gendrome Fang
description: The large and developed fang of a Gendrome. Be careful of its powerful neurotoxin.
description_de: Der große, voll entwickelte Reißzahn des Gendrome enthält ein starkes Nervengift.
description_fr: Énorme croc de Gendrome. Restez bien à l'écart de sa puissante neurotoxine.
description_es: Colmillo largo y desarrollado de un Gendrome. Cuidado con su potente neurotoxina.
description_it: Grossa zanna di Gendrome ben sviluppata. Fai attenzione alla sua neurotossina.
description_zh: The large and developed fang of a Gendrome. Be careful of its powerful neurotoxin.

name: Gendrome Fang+
description: The large and sharpened fang of a Gendrome. Its tip excretes a deadly neurotoxin.
description_de: Der große, geschärfte Zahn eines Gendrome. Enthält ein tödliches Nervengift.
description_fr: Gros croc acéré de Gendrome. Son extrémité sécrète une neurotoxine mortelle.
description_es: Colmillo largo y afilado de un Gendrome. Su punta excreta una neurotoxina letal.
description_it: Zanna di Gendrome enorme e affilata. La punta secerne una neurotossina mortale.
description_zh: The large and sharpened fang of a Gendrome. Its tip excretes a deadly neurotoxin.

name: Gendrome Hardfang
description: A mighty Gendrome fang, able to rend the flesh of prey and inject a vicious neurotoxin.
description_de: Mächtiger Gendrome-Zahn, der die Haut seiner Opfer zerreißt und ein Nervengift injiziert.
description_fr: Puissant croc de Gendrome, taillé pour pénétrer la chair afin d'injecter des neurotoxines.
description_es: Colmillo largo y robusto de un Gendrome. Desgarra la piel de su presa para inyectar la toxina.
description_it: Artiglio del potente Gendrome, capace di tagliare la carne e infettare con una neurotossina.
description_zh: A mighty Gendrome fang, able to rend the flesh of prey and inject a vicious neurotoxin.

name: Gendrome Head
description: The head of a Gendrome. Noted for its two crests.
description_de: Der Kopf eines Gendrome zeichnet sich durch zwei Kämme aus.
description_fr: On reconnaît la tête d'un Gendrome à ses deux crêtes.
description_es: El cráneo de un Gendrome es característico por sus dos crestas.
description_it: Il teschio del Gendrome è riconoscibile dalle sue due creste.
description_zh: The head of a Gendrome. Noted for its two crests.

name: Ioprey Fang
description: A fang filled with deadly poison. Handle with care!
description_de: Ein tödlicher Giftzahn. Im Umgang damit ist oberste Vorsicht geboten.
description_fr: Croc empli d'un poison mortel. Attention en le manipulant.
description_es: Colmillo lleno de veneno mortal. Se debe manipular con cuidado.
description_it: Zanna satura di veleno mortale. È necessario maneggiarla con cura.
description_zh: A fang filled with deadly poison. Handle with care!

name: Ioprey Scale
description: Scale from an Ioprey. The poison irritates the skin so has been removed.
description_de: Die Schuppe eines Ioprey. Das Gift in der Schuppe ist entfernt worden.
description_fr: Le dangereux poison qui se trouve normalement dans l'écaille a été retiré.
description_es: Se ha extraído el peligroso veneno que suele haber en las escamas.
description_it: Il pericoloso veleno delle scaglie è stato rimosso.
description_zh: Scale from an Ioprey. The poison irritates the skin so has been removed.

name: Ioprey Scale+
description: Superior scale from an Ioprey. Can be used in crafting once the poison has been removed.
description_de: Hochwertigere Schuppe eines Ioprey. Kann man benutzen, sobald das Gift entfernt ist.
description_fr: Écaille prélevée sur un Ioprey. Utilisable une fois le poison retiré.
description_es: Escama obtenida de un Ioprey. Se puede usar tras haberle quitado el veneno.
description_it: Scaglia di un Ioprey. Si può usare dopo aver tolto il veleno.
description_zh: Superior scale from an Ioprey. Can be used in crafting once the poison has been removed.

name: Ioprey Shard
description: A massive poisonous scale from an Ioprey. Those who can work it safely are few and far between.
description_de: Gewaltige Schuppe, die nur wenige verarbeiten können, ohne sich dabei zu vergiften.
description_fr: Grosse écaille de Ioprey empoisonnée. Rares sont ceux capables de la travailler.
