description_es: Escama gruesa de un Ioprey. Solo los expertos pueden manipular este material tan peligroso.
description_it: Frammento enorme e velenoso di uno Ioprey. Pochi possono lavorarlo senza pericolo.
description_zh: A massive poisonous scale from an Ioprey. Those who can work it safely are few and far between.

name: Ioprey Hide
description: Descaled hide, often made into belts. Red belts are used in decorations.
description_de: Entschuppte Haut für Gürtel. Rote Gürtel werden in Dekoration eingesetzt.
description_fr: De la peau sans écailles, idéale pour la fabrication des ceintures.
description_es: Piel descamada para hacer cinturones. Los adornos de cuero rojo son muy populares.
description_it: La pelle, privata delle scaglie, è usata per fare cinte e decorazioni rosse.
description_zh: Descaled hide, often made into belts. Red belts are used in decorations.

name: Ioprey Hide+
description: High-quality, descaled Ioprey hide. The red skin resists poison.
description_de: Hochwertige, entschuppte Haut eines Ioprey. Sie widersteht Gift.
description_fr: Du cuir Ioprey de qualité sans écailles. La peau rouge résiste au poison.
description_es: Piel de Ioprey de calidad y sin escamas. Este cuero rojo es muy resistente al veneno.
description_it: Pelle Ioprey; rossa, alta qualità, senza scaglie. Resiste al veleno.
description_zh: High-quality, descaled Ioprey hide. The red skin resists poison.

name: Iodrome Hide
description: A sturdy red hide from an Iodrome. Perfect for making strong armor.
description_de: Die feste rote Haut eines Iodrome. Perfekt für robuste Rüstungen.
description_fr: Du cuir rouge résistant d'Iodrome. Parfait pour faire une bonne armure.
description_es: Piel roja y robusta de un Iodrome. Ideal para fabricar armaduras fuertes.
description_it: Robusta pelle rossa di un Iodrome. Ottima per fare un'armatura resistente.
description_zh: A sturdy red hide from an Iodrome. Perfect for making strong armor.

name: Iodrome Hide+
description: Sturdy hide from the toughest Iodromes. It is very rare and hardly ever seen at market.
description_de: Die dicke Haut eines starken Iodrome. Selten und fast nie auf dem Markt erhältlich.
description_fr: Peau robuste des Iodrome les plus coriaces. Très rare, on en trouve très peu sur le marché.
description_es: Piel robusta de los Iodromes más duros. Rara vez disponible en el mercado, ya que es muy escasa.
description_it: Pelle robusta ricavata dagli Iodrome più forti. È rara e poco reperibile sul mercato.
description_zh: Sturdy hide from the toughest Iodromes. It is very rare and hardly ever seen at market.

name: Iodrome Piel
description: High-grade Iodrome hide. Unbelievably strong, perfect for leading a large herd.
description_de: Außergewöhnlich dicke Iodrome-Haut. Perfekt, um eine Herde anzuführen.
description_fr: Cuir de Iodrome de qualité. A la robustesse caractéristique d'un chef de troupeau.
description_es: Piel dura de Iodrome que se ha curtido ocupándose de su manada.
description_it: Manto Iodrome di alta qualità. Incredibilmente resistente e perfetto per un grande branco.
description_zh: High-grade Iodrome hide. Unbelievably strong, perfect for leading a large herd.

name: Iodrome Violet Scale
description: A violet scale carved from an Iodrome. It is more difficult to obtain than regular scales.
description_de: Die violette Schuppe stammt vom Iodrome und ist nur sehr selten zu finden.
description_fr: Écaille pourpre d'Iodrome. Assez difficile à obtenir.
description_es: Escama violeta extraída de un Iodrome. Es más difícil de conseguir que las normales.
description_it: Scaglia viola di Iodrome, di minore reperibilità rispetto alle scaglie normali.
description_zh: A violet scale carved from an Iodrome. It is more difficult to obtain than regular scales.

name: Iodrome Violet Scale+
description: A quality violet Iodrome scale. Its deep color borders on black--a sign of its quality.
description_de: Hochwertige, violette Schuppe. Je dunkler, desto hochwertiger ist sie.
description_fr: Écaille pourpre supérieure d'Iodrome. Ses élégants contours sont signe de qualité.
description_es: Escama violeta de Iodrome de calidad. Su color casi negro es indicativo de su calidad.
description_it: Scaglia viola di Iodrome. Ha un colore intenso che vira al nero, segno di qualità.
description_zh: A quality violet Iodrome scale. Its deep color borders on black--a sign of its quality.

name: Iodrome Violet Shard
description: An Iodrome scale of the highest caliber, proven by its deep hue, virtually black.
description_de: Violette Iodrome-Schuppe von extremer Güte, wie ihre fast schwarze Farbe bezeugt.
description_fr: Écaille de Iodrome de grand calibre, comme en atteste son coloris noir.
description_es: Escama violeta de Iodrome de gran calidad, como indica su color negro.
description_it: Frammento di Iodrome della migliore qualità, con un colore che si avvicina di più al nero.
description_zh: An Iodrome scale of the highest caliber, proven by its deep hue, virtually black.

name: Iodrome Head
description: An Iodrome head with a large, eye-catching crest.
description_de: Der große Kamm auf dem Iodrome-Kopf fällt jedem auf.
description_fr: La grande crête sur la tête d'un Iodrome suffit à attirer l'attention.
description_es: La gran cresta del cráneo de un Iodrome basta para atraer la atención de todos.
description_it: La grossa cresta su un teschio di Iodrome non passa mai inosservata.
description_zh: An Iodrome head with a large, eye-catching crest.

name: Giaprey Scale
description: A scale carved from a Giaprey. The color allows you to stalk prey in the snow undetected.
description_de: Mit diesen Schuppen kann man sich im Schnee unbemerkt anpirschen.
description_fr: La couleur de ces écailles permet de rester discret dans la neige.
description_es: El color de esta escama permite acechar a monstruos en la nieve sin ser visto.
description_it: Il colore delle scaglie permette di mimetizzarsi perfettamente nella neve.
description_zh: A scale carved from a Giaprey. The color allows you to stalk prey in the snow undetected.

name: Giaprey Scale+
description: A high-quality scale carved from a Giaprey. Used to craft even better equipment.
description_de: Die Schuppe eines Giaprey. Sie wird zu hervorragenden Gegenständen verarbeitet.
description_fr: Écaille arrachée à un Giaprey. Produit de l'équipement de qualité.
description_es: Escama obtenida de un Giaprey. Se usa para fabricar equipo de altísima calidad.
description_it: Scaglia presa da un Giaprey. Se ne ricava un ottimo equipaggiamento.
description_zh: A high-quality scale carved from a Giaprey. Used to craft even better equipment.

name: Giaprey Shard
description: A superior scale carved from a Giaprey, used to forge high performance armor.
description_de: Hochwertige Schuppe eines Giaprey. Sie wird zu Luxus- Ausrüstung verarbeitet.
description_fr: Écaille supérieure de Giaprey, utilisée pour forger des armures hautement performantes.
description_es: Escama gruesa de un Giaprey. Se usa para fabricar equipo de la mejor calidad.
description_it: Frammento superiore preso da un Giaprey, usato per forgiare armature robustissime.
description_zh: A superior scale carved from a Giaprey, used to forge high performance armor.

name: Giaprey Hide
description: Hide stripped of all its scales. Used to make clothing for villagers.
description_de: Ledrige Haut ohne Schuppen. Daraus werden Kleider für die Dorfbewohner gefertigt.
description_fr: Peau débarrassée de ses écailles. Utilisée pour vêtir les habitants.
description_es: Piel extraída de las escamas de un Giaprey. La gente común la usa para fabricar ropa.
description_it: Pelle senza le scaglie. Usata per l'abbigliamento degli abitanti.
description_zh: Hide stripped of all its scales. Used to make clothing for villagers.

name: Giaprey Hide+
description: High quality hide carved from a Giaprey. Can be used to craft sturdy equipment.
description_de: Hochwertige Giaprey-Haut. Ein guter Weg zu robusten Ausrüstungsgegenständen.
description_fr: Peau Giaprey de qualité. Permet de créer de l'équipement robuste.
description_es: Piel de Giaprey de alta calidad. Permite crear equipamiento de gran durabilidad.
description_it: Pelle di Giaprey, di alta qualità. Per fabbricare un robusto equipaggiamento.
description_zh: High quality hide carved from a Giaprey. Can be used to craft sturdy equipment.

name: Giadrome Hide+
description: Extra-high quality hide carved from a Giadrome. Often used to forge powerful armor.
description_de: Hochwertige Giadrome-Haut. Ein guter Weg zu mächtigen Ausrüstungsgegenständen.
description_fr: Peau de Giadrome de très haute qualité, souvent utilisée pour forger de puissantes armures.
description_es: Piel de Giadrome de gran calidad. Se usa para fabricar equipamiento resistente.
description_it: Pelle di qualità superiore tagliata da un Giadrome. Spesso usata per forgiare armature.
description_zh: Extra-high quality hide carved from a Giadrome. Often used to forge powerful armor.

name: Giadrome Piel
description: The best Giadrome hide one can find, used by any hunter wishing to survive the frozen wastes.
description_de: Die hochwertigste Giadrome- Haut. Begehrt bei Jägern, die in extremer Kälte überleben wollen.
description_fr: Cuir de Giadrome d'exception prisé par quiconque compte survivre au grand froid.
description_es: Piel de Giadrome de la mayor calidad. Muy apreciada por los cazadores en zonas frías.
description_it: Il miglior manto Giadrome che si possa trovare, usato dai cacciatori che sfidano il gelo.
description_zh: The best Giadrome hide one can find, used by any hunter wishing to survive the frozen wastes.

name: Giadrome Claw+
description: Sharp claw recovered from a Giadrome. Used for weaponry, but also for decoration.
description_de: Die scharfe Klaue eines Giadrome. Wird zu Waffen und Schmuck verarbeitet.
description_fr: Griffe de Giadrome aussi bien utilisée pour la confection d'armes que pour la décoration.
description_es: Garra afilada de un Giadrome. Se suele usar para forjar equipo, pero también como decoración.
description_it: Artiglio affilato di Giadrome, usato spesso come arma ma anche come decorazione.
description_zh: Sharp claw recovered from a Giadrome. Used for weaponry, but also for decoration.

name: Giadrome Talon
description: A thickened Giadrome claw. Keen-edged and able to cut like a blade.
description_de: Schwere Klaue eines Giadrome. Scharf wie eine Klinge.
description_fr: Griffe épaisse de Giadrome. Son tranchant n'a rien à envier à celui d'une lame.
description_es: Garra gruesa de un Giadrome. Es tan afilada como el filo de una espada.
description_it: Artiglio di Giadrome, spesso ma così appuntito da riuscire a tagliare come una lama affilata.
description_zh: A thickened Giadrome claw. Keen-edged and able to cut like a blade.

name: Giadrome Head
description: Giadromes seem quite proud of their beautifully colored crests. Wouldn't you be?
description_de: Kopf mit prächtigem Kamm. In den Bergen der letzte Schrei.
description_fr: Les Giadrome sont fiers de leur crête colorée... Qui ne le serait pas à leur place ?
description_es: Los Giadromes se sienten muy orgullosos de sus coloridas crestas. ¿Quién no lo estaría?
description_it: I Giadrome sembrano alquanto fieri della loro cresta. E chi non lo sarebbe?!
description_zh: Giadromes seem quite proud of their beautifully colored crests. Wouldn't you be?

name: Arzuros Pelt
description: A pelt carved from an Arzuros. The white portion is soft, while the blue is short and taut.
description_de: Ein Arzuros-Pelz. Der weiße Teil ist weich, der blaue kurz und hart.
description_fr: La partie blanche de cette peau est douce tandis que la partie bleue est rêche.
description_es: Piel de un Arzuros. La parte blanca es suave; la azul, rasposa y dura.
description_it: Pelle di Arzuros con una sezione bianca morbida e una blu dal pelo più corto e ispido.
description_zh: A pelt carved from an Arzuros. The white portion is soft, while the blue is short and taut.

name: Arzuros Pelt+
description: A splendid Arzuros pelt. Sturdy enough to survive in harsh mountainous terrain.
description_de: Herrlicher Arzuros-Pelz. Hilft, in rauen Gebirgen zu überleben.
description_fr: Splendide peau d'Arzuros. Elle convient aux terrains montagneux hostiles.
description_es: Maravillosa piel de Arzuros. Resistente para sobrevivir en duro terreno montañoso.
description_it: Splendida pelle di Arzuros, capace di resistere in climi di montagna.
description_zh: A splendid Arzuros pelt. Sturdy enough to survive in harsh mountainous terrain.

name: Arzuros Fur
description: Exceptional Arzuros fur. Perfect for hunters to wrap up in, owing to it being both soft and tough.
description_de: Außergewöhnlicher Arzuros- Pelz. Der weiße Teil wärmt, der blaue schützt.
description_fr: Fourrure d'Arzuros d'exception. Sa douceur et sa solidité en font un manteau parfait.
description_es: Pelaje de Arzuros muy suave y resistente que los cazadores usan como abrigo.
description_it: Pelle di Arzuros di alta qualità. Soffice e resistente, è un buon mantello per cacciatori.
description_zh: Exceptional Arzuros fur. Perfect for hunters to wrap up in, owing to it being both soft and tough.

name: Arzuros Shell
description: A shell piece from an Arzuros's head or back. Bends willingly and is easy to forge.
description_de: Panzerstück vom Rücken oder Kopf eines Arzuros. Biegsam und leicht zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Bout de carapace facile à forger provenant de la tête ou du dos.
description_es: Parte del caparazón de la cabeza o espalda de un Arzuros. Flexible y fácil de trabajar.
description_it: Pezzo flessibile di corazza della testa o della schiena di un Arzuros. Facile da forgiare.
description_zh: A shell piece from an Arzuros's head or back. Bends willingly and is easy to forge.

name: Arzuros Carapace
description: A quality Arzuros carapace. The thick shell can withstand bites from ordinary fangs.
description_de: Hochwertiger Arzuros- Rückenpanzer. Hält normalen Reißzähnen stand.
description_fr: Belle cuirasse d'Arzuros. Son épaisseur lui permet de résister aux crocs communs.
description_es: Excelente coraza de Arzuros. Su dureza resiste bocados de colmillo común.
description_it: Pregiato carapace di Arzuros, in grado di resistere alle normali zanne.
description_zh: A quality Arzuros carapace. The thick shell can withstand bites from ordinary fangs.

name: Arzuros Cortex
description: A superior Arzuros cortex. This highly-developed shell is a huge thorn in all hunters' sides.
description_de: Hochwertiger Arzuros-Kortex. Der hoch entwickelte Panzer ist Jägern ein Dorn im Auge.
description_fr: De qualité supérieure. Ce gros cortex est comme une épine au pied des chasseurs.
description_es: Sublime placa de un Arzuros. Un caparazón de calidad, muy apreciado por los cazadores.
description_it: Ottima corteccia di Arzuros; questa corazza dà filo da torcere a tutti i cacciatori.
description_zh: A superior Arzuros cortex. This highly-developed shell is a huge thorn in all hunters' sides.

name: Arzuros Brace
description: A brace from an Arzuros's forelegs. Its sharp points give forged equipment a wild flavor.
description_de: Arzuros-Vorderbein-Schiene. Ihre Spitzen wirken an Ausrüstung wild.
description_fr: Attelle de patte avant d'Arzuros. Ses pointes sont un atout pour l'équipement.
description_es: Brazal de la pata delantera de Arzuros. Puntos afilados dan un aspecto salvaje.
description_it: Mitena dalla zampa di un Arzuros, con punte acuminate ideali per armature.
description_zh: A brace from an Arzuros's forelegs. Its sharp points give forged equipment a wild flavor.

name: Arzuros Brace+
description: A strong Arzuros brace. Its thorn-like protrusions make paw swipes deadly.
description_de: Starke Arzuros-Schiene. Durch dornengleiche Aufsätze eine tödliche Waffe.
description_fr: Solide attelle d'Arzuros. Ses pointes rendent ses coups de pattes mortels.
description_es: Fuerte brazal de Arzuros. Sus espinas convierten sus zarpazos en mortíferos.
description_it: Resistente mitena di un Arzuros, con punte che ne rendono letali gli attacchi.
description_zh: A strong Arzuros brace. Its thorn-like protrusions make paw swipes deadly.

name: Arzuros Allbrace
description: A supreme brace found only on certain Arzuros. Its tough, thornlike protrusions silence foes.
description_de: Seltene Arzuros-Schiene. Die dornengleichen Aufsätze lassen Feinde verstummen.
description_fr: De taille suprême chez certains Arzuros. Réduit ses ennemis au silence.
description_es: Brazal supremo de algunos Arzuros. Sus duras espinas acallan a los enemigos.
description_it: Eccellente mitena posseduta da alcuni Arzuros e dotata di punte acuminate.
description_zh: A supreme brace found only on certain Arzuros. Its tough, thornlike protrusions silence foes.

name: Redhelm Pelt
description: A pelt hard enough to pierce flesh. Its looks embody the Redhelm Arzuros's brutality.
description_de: Der harte Pelz des brutalen Rothelm-Arzuros kann Stichwunden verursachen.
description_fr: Peau capable de pénétrer la chair et dont l'aspect brutal rappelle l'Arzuros Crâne-ardent.
description_es: Piel tan dura que perfora la carne. Su aspecto expresa la brutalidad del Arzuros Ámbar.
description_it: Così dura da perforare le carni. Emana l'efferatezza del Sanguis Arzuros.
description_zh: A pelt hard enough to pierce flesh. Its looks embody the Redhelm Arzuros's brutality.

name: Redhelm Pelt+
description: A quality pelt that's hard and durable. Epitomizes the Redhelm's viciousness.
description_de: Hochwertiger, harter Pelz. Ein Kennzeichen für die Bösartigkeit des Rothelms.
description_fr: Toison de bonne qualité, dure et résistante. Son aspect rappelle la méchanceté du Crâne-ardent.
description_es: Piel de calidad, resistente y dura. Personifica la ferocidad del Arzuros Ámbar.
description_it: Pelle pregiata, coriacea e resistente. È il simbolo della crudeltà del Sanguis.
description_zh: A quality pelt that's hard and durable. Epitomizes the Redhelm's viciousness.

name: Redhelm Fur
description: The bristles in the Redhelm's fur show how shockingly ferocious it can be.
description_de: Übermäßig harter Pelz. Die Haarbüschel zeugen von der Wildheit des Rothelms.
description_fr: Ses poils sauvagement hérissés témoignent de la férocité de son propriétaire.
description_es: Cada pelo del Arzuros Ámbar es una muestra de su ferocidad: son duros como púas.
description_it: I peli duri del Sanguis fanno presagire la ferocia scioccante di questo mostro.
description_zh: The bristles in the Redhelm's fur show how shockingly ferocious it can be.

name: Redhelm Shell
description: A shell from a Redhelm Arzuros. Even its hard and sturdy shell looks fierce.
description_de: Selbst die harte Panzerung des Rothelm-Arzuros wirkt gefährlich.
description_fr: Cuirasse d'Arzuros Crâne-ardent. Cette carapace robuste transpire la férocité.
description_es: Caparazón de Arzuros Ámbar. Incluso su caparazón robusto y duro tiene un aspecto feroz.
description_it: Corazza di Sanguis Arzuros. Persino la sua robusta corazza ha un aspetto feroce.
description_zh: A shell from a Redhelm Arzuros. Even its hard and sturdy shell looks fierce.

name: Redhelm Carapace
description: A superior Redhelm Arzuros scale. Even its thick and sturdy shell looks ferocious.
description_de: Eine bessere Schuppe des Rothelm-Arzuros. Selbst die Panzerung wirkt bösartig.
description_fr: Écaille d'Arzuros Crâne-ardent de qualité supérieure. Même son épaisseur transpire la férocité.
description_es: Escama superior de Arzuros Ámbar. Su caparazón robusto y duro tiene un aspecto feroz.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata di Sanguis Arzuros. Anche la sua dura corazza emana ferocia.
description_zh: A superior Redhelm Arzuros scale. Even its thick and sturdy shell looks ferocious.

name: Redhelm Cortex
description: A superior Redhelm cortex. Extremely tough, evincing a ferocity that can dazzle the eye.
description_de: Außergewöhnlich harte Rothelm- Panzerung. Beängstigend wild und äußerst widerstandsfähig.
description_fr: Cortex de Crâne-ardent supérieur, aussi dur au toucher que féroce d'apparence.
description_es: Placa superior de Arzuros Ámbar. Su extrema resistencia inspira ferocidad.
description_it: Corteccia superiore di Sanguis. Molto resistente, suggerisce una ferocia che lascia a bocca aperta.
description_zh: A superior Redhelm cortex. Extremely tough, evincing a ferocity that can dazzle the eye.

name: Redhelm Ragehair
description: The hair from the head of a Redhelm Arzuros. Its looks befit the beast's wild nature.
description_de: Haar vom Kopf des Rothelm- Arzuros. Passend zur wilden Natur dieser Bestie.
description_fr: Poils de tête d'un Arzuros Crâne-ardent. Correspond bien à la nature sauvage de la bête.
description_es: Melena de Arzuros Ámbar. Su aspecto corresponde a la naturaleza salvaje de la bestia.
description_it: La pelliccia della testa di un Sanguis. L'aspetto è degno di una belva selvaggia.
description_zh: The hair from the head of a Redhelm Arzuros. Its looks befit the beast's wild nature.

name: Redhelm Furyhair
description: High quality hair from the head of a Redhelm Arzuros that embodies its ferocity.
description_de: Hochwertiges Haar vom Kopf des Rothelm-Arzuros und Symbol seiner Bösartigkeit.
description_fr: Poils de tête de qualité d'un Arzuros Crâne-ardent rappelant sa férocité.
description_es: Melena de calidad de Arzuros Ámbar que encarna su ferocidad.
description_it: Pelliccia pregiata ricavata dalla testa di un Sanguis e che ne incarna la ferocia.
description_zh: High quality hair from the head of a Redhelm Arzuros that embodies its ferocity.

name: Redhelm Zenith Furyhair
description: Redhelm head hair of the highest quality. Extremely thick, showing off the creature's pure rage.
description_de: Haar der höchsten Qualität, das die unbändige Wildheit des Rothelm-Arzuros bezeugt.
description_fr: Crête de Crâne-ardent de haute qualité, d'un rouge profond rappelant la rage de son porteur.
description_es: Melena de Arzuros Ámbar de gran calidad y de un rojo intenso como la ira.
description_it: Ottimo pelo della testa di Sanguis, spesso e resistente come la rabbia della bestia.
description_zh: Redhelm head hair of the highest quality. Extremely thick, showing off the creature's pure rage.

name: Lagombi Pelt
description: A white pelt carved from a Lagombi. One touch and you'll be hooked on its soft, fluffy fur.
description_de: Weißer Lagombi-Pelz. Eine Berührung des weichen, fluffigen Fells verzaubert.
description_fr: Peau blanche de Lagombi. Touchez-la et vous serez conquis par sa douceur.
description_es: Piel blanca de un Lagombi. Tócala una vez y te engancharás a su textura suave y sedosa.
description_it: Soffice pelle bianca di Lagombi. Il morbido pelo conquista fin dal primo tocco.
description_zh: A white pelt carved from a Lagombi. One touch and you'll be hooked on its soft, fluffy fur.

name: Lagombi Pelt+
description: A quality white Lagombi pelt. Its glossy, frosty shine makes it a sought-after luxury item.
description_de: Hochwertiger, weißer Lagombi-Pelz. Ein begehrter, frostig glänzender Luxus.
description_fr: L'aspect givré et lustré de cette belle peau en fait un objet de luxe recherché.
description_es: Excelente piel blanca de Lagombi. Su brillo glacial la convierte en un lujo.
description_it: Pregiata pelle bianca di Lagombi; il riflesso brillante e glaciale la rende ambita.
description_zh: A quality white Lagombi pelt. Its glossy, frosty shine makes it a sought-after luxury item.

name: Lagombi Fur
description: The very finest Lagombi fur, durable and yet surprisingly soft. A top-shelf item.
description_de: Bestes Lagombi-Fell, robust und doch weich. Ein Objekt allerhöchster Qualität.
description_fr: La plus belle des fourrures de Lagombi. Douce mais résistante. Objet prisé.
description_es: El mejor pelo de Lagombi, duradero y supersuave. Un objeto codiciado.
description_it: Il miglior pelo di Lagombi, resistente ma straordinariamente morbido.
description_zh: The very finest Lagombi fur, durable and yet surprisingly soft. A top-shelf item.

name: Lagombi Ear
description: The long ear of a Lagombi. A lifetime in frigid environments has made it hard as a shell.
description_de: Langes Lagombi-Ohr. Die eisige Umgebung hat es hart wie einen Panzer gemacht.
description_fr: Issue d'un environnement glacial, cette oreille est aussi dure qu'une carapace.
description_es: Larga oreja de un Lagombi. Toda una vida en el frío la ha endurecido como el hueso.
description_it: Lungo orecchio di Lagombi, indurito come una corazza dalla vita in climi gelidi.
description_zh: The long ear of a Lagombi. A lifetime in frigid environments has made it hard as a shell.

name: Lagombi Ear+
description: An impressive Lagombi ear. Highly developed, it can become sharp as steel if polished.
description_de: Beeindruckendes Lagombi-Ohr. Hoch entwickelt, Polieren macht es scharf wie Stahl.
description_fr: Oreille impressionnante. Devient aussi tranchante que l'acier une fois polie.
description_es: Una oreja de Lagombi inusual. Muy desarrollada, puede ser muy afilada si se pule.
description_it: Imponente orecchio di Lagombi; se ripulito può diventare affilato come acciaio.
description_zh: An impressive Lagombi ear. Highly developed, it can become sharp as steel if polished.

name: Lagombi Plastron
description: A shell piece from a Lagombi's belly. Its ridges are what allow the Lagombi to slide on ice.
description_de: Panzerstück eines Lagombi- Bauchs. Die Kanten lassen sie auf Eis gleiten.
description_fr: Un bout de carapace du ventre d'un Lagombi. Glisse sur la glace grâce aux vertèbres.
description_es: Parte del caparazón de la tripa de un Lagombi. Sus surcos le permiten deslizarse en el hielo.
description_it: Corazza ventrale di Lagombi: le increspature consentono di scivolare sul ghiaccio.
description_zh: A shell piece from a Lagombi's belly. Its ridges are what allow the Lagombi to slide on ice.

name: Lagombi Plastron+
description: A strong, sticky, and thick Lagombi Plastron. Used to make superior equipment.
description_de: Harter Lagombi-Plastron. Stark, klebrig und dick, für Qualitätsausrüstung.
description_fr: Solide, gluant et épais. Il est utilisé pour fabriquer des équipements supérieurs.
description_es: Fuerte caparazón de Lagombi. Duro y pegajoso, se usa para crear equipamiento superior.
description_it: Piastrone di Lagombi spesso e viscoso, usato per forgiare ottimo equipaggiamento.
description_zh: A strong, sticky, and thick Lagombi Plastron. Used to make superior equipment.

name: Lagombi Cuirass
description: Tougher and thicker even than Lagombi Plastrons, and glints from many ice-polishings.
description_de: Lagombi-Plastron der höchsten Güte. Vom Rutschen über Eis zu prächtigem Glanz poliert.
description_fr: Plus épais et résistant qu'un plastron Lagombi. Poli par la glace, il reflète la lumière.
description_es: Más fuerte y gruesa que el peto de Lagombi y pulida con hielo. Refleja la luz.
description_it: Più pesante e spesso di un piastrone di Lagombi normale, levigato con il ghiaccio.
description_zh: Tougher and thicker even than Lagombi Plastrons, and glints from many ice-polishings.

name: Lagombi Iceclaw
description: A Lagombi claw that's cold to the touch. Permanently covered in ice from a frigid climate.
description_de: Lagombi-Klaue, die sich kalt anfühlt. Das raue Klima hat sie mit Eis umhüllt.
description_fr: Froide au toucher, elle est en permanence recouverte de glace à cause du climat.
description_es: Garra de Lagombi. Fría al tacto y envuelta en hielo debido al clima glacial.
description_it: Artiglio di Lagombi freddo al tocco e avvolto dal ghiaccio perenne delle regioni gelide.
description_zh: A Lagombi claw that's cold to the touch. Permanently covered in ice from a frigid climate.

name: Lagombi Frozenclaw
description: A Lagombi claw surrounded by cold air. Wounds it causes freeze over in an instant.
description_de: Lagombi-Klaue, umgeben von kalter Luft. Damit zugefügte Wunden gefrieren sofort.
description_fr: Entourée d'air froid. Les blessures qu'elle inflige gèlent immédiatement.
description_es: Garra de Lagombi envuelta en aire gélido. Las heridas infligidas se congelan.
description_it: Artiglio di Lagombi avvolto da aria fredda. Infligge ferite autocongelanti.
description_zh: A Lagombi claw surrounded by cold air. Wounds it causes freeze over in an instant.

name: Lagombi Frigidclaw
description: Fearsomely sharp and tough, even among Lagombi claws, able to tear up and freeze prey.
description_de: Besonders scharfe Lagombi- Klaue, die Beute in Sekunden gefrieren lässt.
description_fr: Étonnamment solide et acérée, même pour un Lagombi, elle gèle la chair tout en la tranchant.
description_es: Garra de Lagombi muy afilada y dura que puede desgarrar y congelar a sus presas.
description_it: Artiglio duro anche per i normali Lagombi, capace di tagliare e congelare le prede.
description_zh: Fearsomely sharp and tough, even among Lagombi claws, able to tear up and freeze prey.

name: Snowbaron Pelt
description: A pelt that was carved from a Snowbaron Lagombi. It looks fluffy and is soft to the touch.
description_de: Der Pelz eines Schneesturm- Lagombi, so wunderbar flauschig und weich.
description_fr: Peau de Lagombi Maître-neige. Aspect cotonneux et toucher d'une grande douceur.
description_es: Piel extraída de un Lagombi Alud. De aspecto mullido y suave al tacto.
description_it: Pelle di Nix Lagombi. Ha un aspetto vaporoso ed è morbida al tatto.
description_zh: A pelt that was carved from a Snowbaron Lagombi. It looks fluffy and is soft to the touch.

name: Snowbaron Pelt+
description: A hardened pelt taken from a Snowbaron Lagombi. Although stiff, it has a pleasing feel to it.
description_de: Gehärteter Pelz eines Schneesturm-Lagombi. Fühlt sich angenehm an.
description_fr: Peau de Lagombi Maître-neige, mais plus dure. Un peu raide, mais son toucher reste plaisant.
description_es: Piel endurecida extraída de un Lagombi Alud. Es rígida, pero tiene un tacto agradable.
description_it: Pelle temprata di Nix Lagombi. Sebbene rigida, risulta gradevole al tatto.
description_zh: A hardened pelt taken from a Snowbaron Lagombi. Although stiff, it has a pleasing feel to it.

name: Snowbaron Fur
description: Particularly durable fur. The hairs feel wiry but the prickly sensation is actually quite comfortable.
description_de: Besonders haltbarer Pelz eines Schneesturm-Lagombi. Fühlt sich pieksig, aber angenehm an.
description_fr: Fourrure particulièrement résistante, sa texture rêche n'est pas si désagréable que ça.
description_es: Pelaje muy duradero. Es un poco áspero al tacto, pero bastante cómodo.
description_it: Pelo molto resistente e ispido, ma dà una piacevole sensazione quando lo si indossa.
description_zh: Particularly durable fur. The hairs feel wiry but the prickly sensation is actually quite comfortable.

name: Snowbaron Plastron
description: A shell piece from a Snowbaron Lagombi's belly. It is known for its deep ridges.
description_de: Panzerstück vom Bauch eines Lagombi mit den typischen Hautleisten.
description_fr: Bout de carapace du ventre d'un Lagombi Maître-neige. Connue pour ses vertèbres.
description_es: Trozo del caparazón de la panza de un Lagombi Alud. Se reconoce por sus surcos.
description_it: Corazza ventrale di Nix Lagombi. Si distingue per le profonde increspature.
description_zh: A shell piece from a Snowbaron Lagombi's belly. It is known for its deep ridges.

name: Snowbaron Plastron+
description: A high-quality Snowbaron Lagombi plastron. Its deep ridges give it a nice shape.
description_de: Hochwertiger Lagombi- Plastron, dessen Hautleisten ihm die schöne Form geben.
description_fr: Plastron de qualité d'un Lagombi Maître-neige. Ses vertèbres soulignent sa jolie forme.
description_es: Peto de Lagombi Alud de calidad. Sus profundos surcos le dan una forma bonita.
description_it: Corazza pregiata di Nix. Le profonde increspature le donano un aspetto gradevole.
description_zh: A high-quality Snowbaron Lagombi plastron. Its deep ridges give it a nice shape.

name: Snowbaron Cuirass
description: Even better than the Snowbaron Lagombi plastron, its pleasing shape approaches fine art.
description_de: Plastron allerhöchster Qualität. Die Form ist ein Kunstwerk der Natur.
description_fr: Surpasse les plastrons Maître-neige, sa forme est une véritable œuvre d'art.
description_es: De mejor calidad que el peto de Alud. Su forma es una verdadera obra de arte.
description_it: Migliore di un normale piastrone di Nix Lagombi, con un'estetica che ha il sapore dell'arte.
description_zh: Even better than the Snowbaron Lagombi plastron, its pleasing shape approaches fine art.

name: Volvidon Shell
description: The heat-resistant shell of a Volvidon. Unaffected even by boiling lava.
description_de: Hitzebeständiger Volvidon- Panzer. Auch kochende Lava kann ihm nichts anhaben.
description_fr: Carapace résistante à la chaleur. Même la lave en fusion ne l'affecte pas.
description_es: Caparazón de Volvidon resistente al calor. No le afecta ni la lava hirviendo.
description_it: Corazza di Volvidon resistente al calore e perfino alla lava.
description_zh: The heat-resistant shell of a Volvidon. Unaffected even by boiling lava.

name: Volvidon Carapace
description: A thick Volvidon carapace. Extra elasticity means extreme pressure is required to forge it.
description_de: Dicker Volvidon-Rücken- panzer. Sehr elastisch, daher schwer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Il faut exercer une forte pression pour forger cette cuirasse souple mais épaisse.
description_es: Gruesa coraza de Volvidon. Por su elasticidad, requiere mucha presión al forjarla.
description_it: Spesso carapace di Volvidon. Difficile da forgiare per la sua estrema elasticità.
description_zh: A thick Volvidon carapace. Extra elasticity means extreme pressure is required to forge it.

name: Volvidon Cortex
description: A heavy Volvidon cortex. Difficult to forge with, but can produce very powerful gear.
description_de: Schwerer Volvidon-Kortex. Schwer zu verarbeiten, aber die Ausrüstung wird stark.
description_fr: Lourd cortex. Difficile à forger mais peut produire des objets très puissants.
description_es: Dura placa de Volvidon. Aunque difícil de forjar, produce un equipo poderoso.
description_it: Pesante corteccia di Volvidon, difficile da forgiare ma può creare oggetti possenti.
description_zh: A heavy Volvidon cortex. Difficult to forge with, but can produce very powerful gear.

name: Volvidon Claw
description: A claw from a Volvidon's forelegs. Dramatically increases the power of a wide swing.
description_de: Klaue von einem Volvidon- Vorderbein. Erhöht die Kraft eines weiten Hiebs deutlich.
description_fr: Griffe de patte avant. Augmente spectaculairement la puissance d'un coup.
description_es: Garra de la pata delantera de un Volvidon. Aumenta el poder de sus zarpazos.
description_it: Artiglio della zampa di Volvidon; aumenta notevolmente la forza d'attacco.
description_zh: A claw from a Volvidon's forelegs. Dramatically increases the power of a wide swing.

name: Volvidon Claw+
description: A hard, sharp Volvidon claw. Constant exposure to heat has tempered it like steel.
description_de: Harte, scharfe Volvidon- Klaue. Dauernde Hitze hat sie wie Stahl gehärtet.
description_fr: Griffe dure et acérée. Durcie par l'exposition prolongée à la chaleur.
description_es: Garra dura y afilada de Volvidon. El calor la ha ha templado como el acero.
description_it: Artiglio duro e affilato di Volvidon, temprato dal contatto con il calore.
description_zh: A hard, sharp Volvidon claw. Constant exposure to heat has tempered it like steel.

name: Volvidon Talon
description: A punishing Volvidon claw. Its solidity and sharpness is almost overwhelming.
description_de: Harte Volvidon-Klaue. Ihre Robustheit und Schärfe sind beinahe überwältigend.
description_fr: Griffe pouvant infliger une punition. Incroyablement solide et affûtée.
description_es: Fuerte garra de Volvidon. Tan sólida y afilada que abruma.
description_it: Artiglio di Volvidon così affilato da essere sbalorditivo.
description_zh: A punishing Volvidon claw. Its solidity and sharpness is almost overwhelming.

name: Volvi Rickrack
description: The jagged shell of a Volvidon's back. Its high elasticity makes it ideal for crafting flexible gear.
description_de: Gezackter Panzer vom Volvi- don-Rücken. Elastisch, daher gut für flexible Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Carapace rugueuse de dos de Volvidon. Idéale pour faire un équipement souple.
description_es: Caparazón irregular del lomo de un Volvidon. Es perfecta para equipos flexibles.
description_it: Corazza dentellata della schiena di Volvidon, elastica e ideale per oggetti flessibili.
description_zh: The jagged shell of a Volvidon's back. Its high elasticity makes it ideal for crafting flexible gear.

name: Large Volvi Rickrack
description: A larger variety of Volvidon shell. It combines flexibility and durability in one package.
description_de: Besonders großer Volvidon- Rückenpanzer. Elastisch und haltbar zugleich.
description_fr: Une variété de grande taille de la carapace du Volvidon. Aussi flexible que solide.
description_es: Caparazón grande de Volvidon. Es flexible a la vez que resistente.
description_it: Varietà grande della corazza di Volvidon. Combina flessibilità e durata in un colpo solo.
description_zh: A larger variety of Volvidon shell. It combines flexibility and durability in one package.

name: Kut-Ku Scale
description: Pink scale from a Kut-Ku. Fire resistant. Can be found in the field.
description_de: Rosa Schuppe eines Kut-Ku. Feuerbeständig. Kann im Feld gefunden werden.
description_fr: Écaille rose résistante au feu. On en trouve dans la nature.
description_es: Escama rosa de un Kut-Ku. Resiste el fuego. A veces se puede encontrar en el campo.
description_it: Scaglia rosa di un Kut-Ku. Resistente al fuoco. Si può trovare sul campo.
description_zh: Pink scale from a Kut-Ku. Fire resistant. Can be found in the field.

name: Kut-Ku Scale+
description: Superior scale from a Kut-Ku. Its size and weight make it look classier than normal.
description_de: Bessere Kut-Ku-Schuppe. Größe und Gewicht nach ein echtes Plus!
description_fr: Écaille supérieure de taille et de poids appréciables.
description_es: Escama de un Kut-Ku especialmente buena. Tiene un tamaño y un peso superiores.
description_it: Ottima scaglia di Kut-Ku. Di classe superiore, grazie alle dimensioni e al peso.
description_zh: Superior scale from a Kut-Ku. Its size and weight make it look classier than normal.

name: Kut-Ku Shard
description: A superb Kut-Ku scale. It's rare to see scales mature to this degree.
description_de: Eine erstklassige Kut-Ku- Schuppe. Nur wenige Exemplare sind wie diese.
description_fr: L'apogée des écailles de Kut-Ku. Très peu atteignent cette maturité.
description_es: La mejor de todas las escamas del Kut-Ku. Muy pocas llegan a madurar como esta.
description_it: È molto difficile trovare delle scaglie di Kut-Ku così ben sviluppate.
description_zh: A superb Kut-Ku scale. It's rare to see scales mature to this degree.

name: Kut-Ku Shell
description: The Fire-resistant shell of a Kut-Ku.
description_de: Der feuerbeständige Panzer eines Kut-Ku.
description_fr: La carapace d'un Kut-Ku. Résiste bien aux flammes.
description_es: El caparazón ignífugo de un Kut-Ku.
description_it: Una corazza di Kut-Ku. Resistente al fuoco.
description_zh: The Fire-resistant shell of a Kut-Ku.

name: Kut-Ku Carapace
description: Harder than Kut-Ku Shell, this material is also known as Gravite.
description_de: Härter als normale Kut-Ku- Panzer. Dieses Material kennt man auch als Gravit.
description_fr: Plus dure que la carapace Kut-Ku. Aussi connue sous le nom de Gravite.
description_es: Aún más dura que el caparazón de Kut-Ku. A este material también se le llama Gravita.
description_it: Questo materiale, più duro della corazza di Kut-Ku, è chiamato anche Gravite.
description_zh: Harder than Kut-Ku Shell, this material is also known as Gravite.

name: Kut-Ku Cortex
description: A stout outer shell, much harder than a carapace. Also called Mediastinum.
description_de: Robust - viel härter als ein Rückenpanzer. Wird als Mediastinum bezeichnet.
description_fr: Carapace plus dure que la cuirasse de Kut-Ku. Aussi appelée Mediastinum.
description_es: Placa exterior más dura que el caparazón normal de Kut-Ku. También llamado "Mediastinum".
description_it: Corazza esterna, più dura di un carapace di Kut-Ku. È detta anche Mediastino.
description_zh: A stout outer shell, much harder than a carapace. Also called Mediastinum.

name: Kut-Ku Ear
description: The Fire-resistant ear of a Kut-Ku. Used to prevent Bowguns backfiring.
description_de: Feuerbeständiges Ohr eines Kut-Ku. Damit vermeidet man Bogengewehr-Rückstöße.
description_fr: Oreille de Kut-Ku résistante au feu. Utilisée pour les fusarbalètes.
description_es: La oreja ignífuga de un Kut-Ku. Se usa con la Ballesta para evitar posibles accidentes.
description_it: Orecchio di Kut-Ku, resiste al fuoco; evita il ritorno di fiamma della balestra.
description_zh: The Fire-resistant ear of a Kut-Ku. Used to prevent Bowguns backfiring.

name: Kut-Ku Auricle
description: A Kut-Ku's Fire-resistant ear. The flexible material is a good base for armor.
description_de: Feuerbeständiges Ohr eines Kut-Ku. Biegsam und eine gute Basis für Rüstungen.
description_fr: Oreille de Kut-Ku résistante au feu. Fait une bonne base d'armure.
description_es: Oreja ignífuga de un Kut-Ku. Un material flexible con el que hacer buenas armaduras.
description_it: Orecchio di Kut-Ku; resiste al fuoco. Flessibile. Buona base per armature.
description_zh: A Kut-Ku's Fire-resistant ear. The flexible material is a good base for armor.

name: Kut-Ku Luckear
description: A full grown Kut-Ku ear. Considered a good luck charm due to its texture and form.
description_de: Spezialisiertes Ohr. Viel Fleisch und gute Textur verheißen Glück.
description_fr: Une énorme oreille. Elle est considérée comme un porte-bonheur.
description_es: Oreja muy especial. Carnosa y de apreciada textura, dar con una es un buen augurio.
description_it: Un orecchio carnoso che, a detta di molti, porta fortuna.
description_zh: A full grown Kut-Ku ear. Considered a good luck charm due to its texture and form.

name: Giant Beak
description: The huge, sturdy beak of a Yian Kut-Ku.
description_de: Der riesige, kräftige Schnabel eines Yian Kut-Ku.
description_fr: Le bec énorme et solide d'un Yian Kut-Ku.
description_es: Pico enorme y robusto de un Yian Kut-Ku.
description_it: Il grosso e forte becco di uno Yian Kut-Ku.
description_zh: The huge, sturdy beak of a Yian Kut-Ku.

name: Splendid Beak
description: Finding a large, beautiful beak in this condition is quite rare! Splendid!
description_de: Einen derart prächtigen Schnabel in diesem Zustand findet man nur selten!
description_fr: Il est rare de trouver un bec si grand et magnifique. Splendide.
description_es: Es muy raro encontrar un pico grande y bonito en tan buen estado. ¡Espléndido!
description_it: È raro trovare un becco grande, bello e in buone condizioni come questo.
description_zh: Finding a large, beautiful beak in this condition is quite rare! Splendid!

name: Kut-Ku Webbing
description: Webbing from a Kut-Ku wing. Better than animal skin as a fusing material.
description_de: Flügelgewebe eines Kut-Ku. Als Verbindungsmaterial besser als Tierhäute.
description_fr: La palmure des ailes d'un Kut-Ku. Mieux que la peau animale comme matériau.
description_es: Membrana del ala de un Kut-Ku. Consigue combinar materiales mejor que con cuero.
description_it: Strisce di un'ala di Kut- Ku. Migliore della pelle animale per la fusione.
description_zh: Webbing from a Kut-Ku wing. Better than animal skin as a fusing material.

name: Kut-Ku Weave
description: Bulky webbing from a Kut-Ku wing, valued for its greater than normal powers of endurance.
description_de: Dickes Flügelgewebe eines Kut-Ku. Wird wegen seiner Stra- pazierfähigkeit hoch gehandelt.
description_fr: Toile épaisse d'une aile de Kut-Ku, prisée pour sa durabilité hors du commun.
description_es: Membrana gruesa de ala de Kut-Ku, muy apreciada por su resistencia fuera de serie.
description_it: Membrana alare di Kut-Ku, famosa per la sua resistenza fuori dal normale.
description_zh: Bulky webbing from a Kut-Ku wing, valued for its greater than normal powers of endurance.

name: Hyper Kut-Ku Scale
description: Darker than normal Kut-Ku scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Kut-Ku- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Kut-Ku normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Kut-Ku normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Kut-Ku, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Kut-Ku scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Kut-Ku Shard
description: Darker than normal Kut-Ku scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Kut-Ku-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Kut-Ku normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Kut-Ku normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Kut-Ku, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Kut-Ku scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Rubbery Hide
description: Highly elastic Gypceros hide. A good insulator, resistant to electricity.
description_de: Hochelastische Gypceros- Haut. Guter Dämmstoff, strombeständig.
description_fr: Cuir Gypceros hautement élastique. Isolant et résistant à l'électricité.
description_es: Piel de Gypceros muy elástica. Un buen aislante resistente a la electricidad.
description_it: Pelle molto elastica di Gypceros. Un buon isolante dall'elettricità.
description_zh: Highly elastic Gypceros hide. A good insulator, resistant to electricity.

name: Rubbery Hide+
description: High-quality, highly elastic Gypceros hide. Gives off a strange scent.
description_de: Hochwertige, elastische Gypceros-Haut. Verströmt einen seltsamen Geruch.
description_fr: Peau de grande qualité et très élastique. Diffuse une étrange odeur.
description_es: Piel de Gypceros de alta calidad y muy elástica. Desprende un extraño aroma.
description_it: Pelle di Gypceros; alte qualità ed elasticità. Ha uno strano odore.
description_zh: High-quality, highly elastic Gypceros hide. Gives off a strange scent.

name: Rubbery Finehide
description: A special, highly elastic Gypceros hide. It absorbs any attack.
description_de: Besondere, sehr elastische Gypceros-Haut. Absorbiert alle Angriffe.
description_fr: Belle peau de Gypceros spéciale et très élastique. Absorbe les attaques.
description_es: Piel de Gypceros de alta calidad y muy elástica. Absorbe todos los ataques.
description_it: Pelle di Gypceros: ottima qualità, molto elastica. Assorbe gli attacchi.
description_zh: A special, highly elastic Gypceros hide. It absorbs any attack.

name: Gypceros Webbing
description: Webbing from a Gypceros wing. A good insulator, it is also resistant to poison.
description_de: Vom Flügel eines Gypceros. Isolierend und resistent gegenüber Giften.
description_fr: La palmure des ailes d'un Gypceros. Isolant et résistant au poison.
description_es: Membrana de ala de Gypceros. Un buen aislante, también es resistente al veneno.
description_it: Membrana alare di Gypceros. Ha elevate proprietà isolanti e resiste al veleno.
description_zh: Webbing from a Gypceros wing. A good insulator, it is also resistant to poison.

name: Gypceros Weave
description: Bulky webbing from a Gypceros wing. Its improved insulation and toxin resistance make it valuable.
description_de: Vom Flügel eines Gypceros. Ihre überragende Isolation und Giftresistenz machen sie wertvoll.
description_fr: Toile épaisse d'une aile de Gypceros. Isole bien en plus de protéger du poison.
description_es: Membrana gruesa de ala de Gypceros. Buen aislante y resistente al veneno.
description_it: Grossa membrana alare di Gypceros. Ha elevate proprietà isolanti e resiste al veleno.
description_zh: Bulky webbing from a Gypceros wing. Its improved insulation and toxin resistance make it valuable.

name: Gypceros Wing
description: A wing from a Gypceros. It is highly elastic and is a good insulator against electricity.
description_de: Flügel eines Gypceros. Elastisch und isolierend gegenüber Elektrizität.
description_fr: Très élastique. Isolante et résistante à l'électricité.
description_es: Ala de Gypceros. Es muy elástica y un buen aislante resistente a la electricidad.
description_it: Ala di Gypceros. È molto elastica ed è un ottimo isolante dall'elettricità.
description_zh: A wing from a Gypceros. It is highly elastic and is a good insulator against electricity.

name: Gypceros Head
description: The uniquely shaped head of a Gypceros. A must have for Gypceros lovers!
description_de: Unverwechselbarer Kopf eines Gypceros. Ein Muss für Gypceros-Liebhaber!
description_fr: La tête à la forme si unique d'un Gypceros. Un must pour les amateurs.
description_es: Cabeza de un Gypceros de forma única. ¡Imprescindible para todo amante de los Gypceros!
description_it: La testa di un Gypceros, dalla forma unica. Vitale per chi ama i Gypceros!
description_zh: The uniquely shaped head of a Gypceros. A must have for Gypceros lovers!

name: Gypceros Hardhead
description: The hard, rubber-like head of a Gypceros. The rock-like noggin's popular among Gypceros fans.
description_de: Hartgummiartiger Kopf eines Gypceros. Ein Muss für Gypceros-Liebhaber!
description_fr: Tête caoutchouteuse et dure de Gypceros. Un must pour les amateurs.
description_es: Cráneo de Gypceros, de dureza extraordinaria. ¡Imprescindible para todo fan del Gypceros!
description_it: Testa di Gypceros. Gommosa ma resistente. Imperdibile per chi ama il genere.
description_zh: The hard, rubber-like head of a Gypceros. The rock-like noggin's popular among Gypceros fans.

name: Hyper Gypceros Hide
description: Darker than normal Gypceros hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Gypceros- Haut. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la peau de Gypceros normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que la piel de Gypceros normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelle iper di Gypceros, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Gypceros hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Gypceros Piel
description: Darker than normal Gypceros hide, this hardy Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als normale Gypceros-Haut. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une peau de Gypceros normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que la piel de Gypceros normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Manto iper di Gypceros, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Gypceros hide, this hardy Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Azurefeather
description: The blue scalefeather of a Malfestio, the secret behind its silent flight.
description_de: Die blaue Schuppenfeder eines Malfestio. Sie ist das Geheimnis ihres lautlosen Fluges.
description_fr: Plume écaillée bleue d'un Malfestio. Elle lui permet de voler sans faire de bruit.
description_es: Pluma de escama azul de Malfestio. Es el secreto de su silencioso vuelo.
description_it: Piuma a scaglie blu di Malfestio. Sono il segreto del suo volo silenzioso.
description_zh: The blue scalefeather of a Malfestio, the secret behind its silent flight.

name: Azurefeather+
description: A high-quality Malfestio scalefeather. Used in clothing as well as armor.
description_de: Hochwertige Malfestio-Feder. Eignet sich für Kleidung und Rüstungen.
description_fr: Plume de Malfestio de qualité. Utilisée dans la fabrication de vêtements et d'armures.
description_es: Pluma de escama de Malfestio de calidad. Se usa en ropa y como armadura.
description_it: Piuma a scaglie di Malfestio di alta qualità. Usata per indumenti e corazze.
description_zh: A high-quality Malfestio scalefeather. Used in clothing as well as armor.

name: Azure Plume
description: A scalefeather only found on a small number of Malfestios. Shines with ethereal colors.
description_de: Nur die wenigsten Malfestio besitzen so eine Feder. Schimmert mysteriös.
description_fr: Plume d'écaille rarement trouvée sur les Malfestio. Son éclat a des tons éthérés.
description_es: Pluma de escama que solo tienen algunos Malfestio. Brilla con colores etéreos.
description_it: Piume trovate solo in pochi esemplari di Malfestio. Brillano di un colore quasi etereo.
description_zh: A scalefeather only found on a small number of Malfestios. Shines with ethereal colors.

name: Malfestio Webbing
description: Webbing from a Malfestio wing. Its scales gather sound and emit a strange echo pattern.
description_de: Vom Flügel eines Malfestio. Die Schuppen speichern den Schall und erzeugen ein Echo.
description_fr: La palmure des ailes d'un Malfestio. Emprisonne les sons pour émettre un écho bizarre.
description_es: Membrana de ala de Malfestio. Sus escamas absorben sonidos y emiten un extraño eco.
description_it: Membrana alare di Malfestio. Le scaglie assorbono i suoni ed emettono una strana eco.
description_zh: Webbing from a Malfestio wing. Its scales gather sound and emit a strange echo pattern.

name: Malfestio Wing
description: The deep blue wing of a Malfestio. Widely known for its beautiful curves.
description_de: Tiefblauer Flügel eines Malfestio. Bekannt für die elegante Form.
description_fr: Aile de Malfestio d'un bleu profond. Appréciée pour ses courbes élégantes.
description_es: Ala azul oscura de Malfestio. Afamada por sus bellas curvas.
description_it: L'ala blu notte di un Malfestio. È apprezzata per le sue linee meravigliose.
description_zh: The deep blue wing of a Malfestio. Widely known for its beautiful curves.

name: Malfestio Grandwing
description: Malfestio wing with a refined curve, whose vivid blue color dazzles anyone who sees it.
description_de: Sein eleganter Schwung und die tiefblaue Farbe bestechen jeden Betrachter.
description_fr: Aile de Malfestio aux courbes d'un bleu raffiné, éternelle source d'émerveillement.
description_es: Ala de Malfestio de color azul vívido y elegante curvatura.
description_it: Ala di Malfestio con un'elegante curva, con un colore blu che lascia ipnotizzati.
description_zh: Malfestio wing with a refined curve, whose vivid blue color dazzles anyone who sees it.

name: Malfestio Wingtalon
description: A hard talon found at the end of a Malfestio wing. It's as sharp as a sword.
description_de: Harte Klaue am Ende eines Malfestio-Flügels. Scharf wie ein Schwert.
description_fr: Très dure, située en bout d'aile de Malfestio. Aussi tranchante qu'une épée.
description_es: Espolón duro que los Malfestio tienen en la punta del ala. Está tan afilado como una espada.
description_it: Sperone posto all'estremità dell'ala del Malfestio. È affilato come una lama.
description_zh: A hard talon found at the end of a Malfestio wing. It's as sharp as a sword.

name: Malfestio Wingtalon+
description: A high-quality talon from a Malfestio wing. Hard and sharp, it's difficult to work with.
description_de: Hochwertige Malfestio-Kralle. Hart und scharf. Schwer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Serre de qualité d'une aile de Malfestio. Tranchante, dure, son utilisation est délicate.
description_es: Espolón de calidad del ala de un Malfestio. Duro y afilado, resulta difícil trabajarlo.
description_it: Sperone pregiato dell'ala di Malfestio. Duro e affilato, non è di facile lavorazione.
description_zh: A high-quality talon from a Malfestio wing. Hard and sharp, it's difficult to work with.

name: Malfestio Hrd Wingtalon
description: A high-quality talon from a Malfestio wing. Very hard and can be made exquisitely sharp.
description_de: Hochwertige Malfestio-Kralle. Außergewöhnlich hart und bestechend scharf.
description_fr: Serre de qualité d'une aile de Malfestio. Très dure et au tranchant redoutable.
description_es: Espolón de calidad del ala de un Malfestio. Muy duro y puede llegar a ser muy afilado.
description_it: Sperone di alta qualità di Malfestio, molto duro e può essere reso molto affilato.
description_zh: A high-quality talon from a Malfestio wing. Very hard and can be made exquisitely sharp.

name: Malfestio Ear
description: The ear of a Malfestio. Smooth to the touch, it's quite muscular due to its constant movement.
description_de: Das Ohr ist weich und erstaunlich muskulös, da es ständig in Bewegung ist.
description_fr: Douce au toucher. Toujours en mouvement, ce qui explique sa forte musculature.
description_es: Oreja de Malfestio. Suave al tacto y bastante musculada por estar siempre en movimiento.
description_it: Orecchio di Malfestio. Liscio al tatto e assai muscoloso a causa del continuo movimento.
description_zh: The ear of a Malfestio. Smooth to the touch, it's quite muscular due to its constant movement.

name: Malfestio Luckear
description: A big fleshy piece of Malfestio ear which has a multitude of uses.
description_de: Großes, fleischiges Ohr, wie es nur die wenigsten Malfestios besitzen. Vielfältig einsetzbar.
description_fr: Ce morceau d'oreille de Malfestio possède de nombreuses utilités.
description_es: Un buen cacho de oreja de Malfestio que tiene multitud de usos.
description_it: Pezzo carnoso dell'orecchio di un Malfestio, utile in moltissime situazioni.
description_zh: A big fleshy piece of Malfestio ear which has a multitude of uses.

name: Malfestio Tailfeather
description: The flamboyant tail feather of a Malfestio. Its color gradually changes from blue to gold.
description_de: Bunte Schwanzfeder eines Malfestio. Die Farbe geht von Blau nach Gold über.
description_fr: Sa couleur flamboyante passe progressivement du bleu à une nuance d'or.
description_es: Llamativa pluma de la cola de un Malfestio. Su color cambia poco a poco del azul al dorado.
description_it: Una vistosa piuma caudale di Malfestio. I colori sfumano gradualmente dal blu all'oro.
description_zh: The flamboyant tail feather of a Malfestio. Its color gradually changes from blue to gold.

name: Malfestio Tailblade
description: A high-quality tail feather taken from a Malfestio. As beautiful as it is dangerous.
description_de: Edle Schwanzfeder eines Malfestio. Wunderschön, aber man schneidet sich leicht daran.
description_fr: Plume de haute qualité d'une queue de Malfestio, sa beauté n'a d'égal que sa dangerosité.
description_es: Pluma de la cola de un Malfestio de gran calidad. Es tan bonita como peligrosa.
description_it: Parte di piuma della coda di un Malfestio, la cui bellezza e pericolosità sono senza pari.
description_zh: A high-quality tail feather taken from a Malfestio. As beautiful as it is dangerous.

name: Malfestio Goldfeather
description: The magnificent golden feather of a Malfestio. Collectors prize it for its sense of flair.
description_de: Die prächtige goldene Feder eines Malfestio erzielt bei Sammlern hohe Preise.
description_fr: Superbe plume d'or de Malfestio. Prisée par les collectionneurs en raison de son élégance.
description_es: Magnífica pluma dorada de Malfestio. Los coleccionistas la valoran por su elegancia.
description_it: Piuma dorata di Malfestio. È ambita dai collezionisti per la sua eleganza.
description_zh: The magnificent golden feather of a Malfestio. Collectors prize it for its sense of flair.

name: Malfestio Goldfeather+
description: A particularly high quality golden feather which enchants anyone who gazes upon it.
description_de: Diese goldene Feder erster Güte verzaubert jeden, der sie ansieht.
description_fr: Plume d'or de très grande qualité dont l'éclat en ravira plus d'un.
description_es: Una pluma dorada de muchísima calidad que encandila a todo el que la mira.
description_it: Piuma dorata di alta qualità, che incanta chiunque la guardi.
description_zh: A particularly high quality golden feather which enchants anyone who gazes upon it.

name: Hyper Azurefeather
description: Darker than normal Malfestio scalefeathers, it emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Malfestio- Federn. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la plume d'écaille de Malfestio normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las plumas escama normales de Malfestio, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Più scura delle comuni piume a scaglie di Malfestio, emana un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Malfestio scalefeathers, it emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Azurefeather+
description: Darker than normal Malfestio scalefeathers, this tough Hyper feather emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als normale Malfestio-Federn. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et plus solide qu'une plume d'écaille ordinaire. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las plumas escama de Malfestio, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Piuma iper di Malfestio, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Malfestio scalefeathers, this tough Hyper feather emits an ominous glow.

name: Nightcloak Plume
description: A fine feather taken from a Nightcloak Malfestio. The color changes with viewing angle.
description_de: Prächtige Feder eines Mond- schein-Malfestio. Die Farbe ändert sich je nach Betrachtungswinkel.
description_fr: Belle plume de Malfestio Lune-noire. Change de couleur selon l'angle où on l'observe.
description_es: Una pluma de Malfestio Nébula. El color cambia según el ángulo en el que la mires.
description_it: Fine piuma di Occultus. Il colore cambia osservandola da altre angolazioni.
description_zh: A fine feather taken from a Nightcloak Malfestio. The color changes with viewing angle.

name: Nightcloak Grandwing
description: The plumage taken from a Nightcloak Malfestio is extra fine and deep in color.
description_de: Gewaltiger Flügel eines Mond- schein-Malfestio. Besonders schön gefärbt und robust.
description_fr: Cette aile de Malfestio Lune-noire possède un plumage raffiné aux teintes profondes.
description_es: Las plumas de Malfestio Nébula tienen mucha calidad y un color muy intenso.
description_it: Questo piumaggio di Occultus è elegante e dal colore più carico.
description_zh: The plumage taken from a Nightcloak Malfestio is extra fine and deep in color.

name: Nightcloak Clearscale
description: Camouflages a Nightcloak in the wild, but weapons fashioned with them stand out in a crowd.
description_de: Machte einst einen Mondschein- Malfestio unsichtbar. Kann Ausrüstung edle Farbe verleihen.
description_fr: Bien qu'elle permette au Malfestio de se camoufler, elle rend les armes très voyantes.
description_es: Aunque sirven para camuflar al Malfestio, en las armas quedan muy llamativas.
description_it: Serve all'Occultus per mimetizzarsi. Si usa anche per costruire armi appariscenti.
description_zh: Camouflages a Nightcloak in the wild, but weapons fashioned with them stand out in a crowd.

name: Garuga Scale
description: A scale carved from Yian Garuga. It shines an ominous purple.
description_de: Die Schuppe eines Yian Garuga. Sie leuchtet in einem ominösen Lila.
description_fr: Écaille prélevée sur un Yian Garuga. Elle brille d'un sinistre éclat violet.
description_es: Escama tallada de un Yian Garuga. De un brillo morado de mal agüero.
description_it: Scaglia presa dallo Yian Garuga. Di un inquietante colore viola.
description_zh: A scale carved from Yian Garuga. It shines an ominous purple.

name: Garuga Scale+
description: Superior Garuga scale. Looks like a Kut-Ku scale, but it's much tougher.
description_de: Überragende Garuga-Schuppe. Ähnelt einer Kut-Ku-Schuppe, ist aber viel stärker.
description_fr: Belle écaille de Garuga. Ressemble à l'écaille de Kut-Ku mais en plus dure.
description_es: Estupenda escama de un Garuga. Parece de Kut-Ku, pero es mucho más resistente.
description_it: Ottima scaglia di Garuga. Sembra una scaglia di Kut-Ku, ma più robusta.
description_zh: Superior Garuga scale. Looks like a Kut-Ku scale, but it's much tougher.

name: Garuga Shard
description: A top-grade Garuga scale. It sparkles like purple quartz and is just as hard.
description_de: Beste Garuga-Schuppe. Glänzt wie Rosenquarz und ist ebenso hart.
description_fr: Écaille de Garuga haute qualité. Brille comme du quartz violet, aussi dur.
description_es: Escama de Garuga de máxima calidad. Brilla como cuarzo púrpura y es igual de duro.
description_it: Scaglia suprema di Garuga. Viola come il quarzo e della stessa durezza.
description_zh: A top-grade Garuga scale. It sparkles like purple quartz and is just as hard.

name: Garuga Shell
description: A rare item, also in great demand as a research material.
description_de: Seltenes und viel bewundertes Material, das auch in der Forschung nachgefragt wird.
description_fr: Matériau rare et admiré, sujet de nombreuses recherches.
description_es: Un extraño material, admirado por sus propiedades y objeto de muchas investigaciones.
description_it: Un materiale raro, richiesto da tutti come materiale di ricerca.
description_zh: A rare item, also in great demand as a research material.

name: Garuga Carapace
description: Garuga Shell that's become strong over the years. Great skill is needed to work it.
description_de: Ein Garuga-Panzer, der immer härter wurde. Erfordert Geschick beim Bearbeiten.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Garuga qui durcit avec le temps. Pour les maîtres forgerons.
description_es: La coraza de un Garuga es más fuerte cuanto más viejo es. Solo para habilidosos.
description_it: Guscio di Garuga che si è indurito nel tempo. Serve perizia per lavorarlo.
description_zh: Garuga Shell that's become strong over the years. Great skill is needed to work it.

name: Garuga Cortex
description: A heavy, dark purple outer shell with an unusually intimidating air about it.
description_de: Schwerer, tieflilaner Außenpanzer. Sehr furchteinflößend.
description_fr: Carapace externe foncée, lourde et inhabituellement intimidante.
description_es: Pesado caparazón exterior púrpura oscuro. Posee un halo extrañamente intimidatorio.
description_it: Guscio esterno. Pesante, violaceo e dall'aspetto stranamente minaccioso.
description_zh: A heavy, dark purple outer shell with an unusually intimidating air about it.

name: Garuga Ear
description: Its shape and form show a different evolutionary path than Yian Kut-Ku.
description_de: Seine Form zeugt von einem anderen Evolutionspfad als der eines Yian Kut-Ku.
description_fr: Sa forme montre une évolution différente de celle du Yian Kut-Ku.
description_es: Su forma indica una evolución distinta a la del Yian Kut-Ku.
description_it: La sua forma indica un percorso evolutivo diverso da quello di Yian Kut-Ku.
description_zh: Its shape and form show a different evolutionary path than Yian Kut-Ku.

name: Garuga Auricle
description: Well-developed Garuga Ear. It's said to heighten one's senses when crafted into armor.
description_de: Ein gut entwickeltes Garuga- Ohr. Als Teil einer Rüstung soll es die Sinne schärfen.
description_fr: Elle développe les sens du chasseur lorsqu'elle est forgée en armure.
description_es: Una oreja de Garuga larga y bien desarrollada. Usada como armadura agudiza los sentidos.
description_it: Un orecchio di Garuga ben sviluppato. Indossato come armatura, acuisce i sensi.
description_zh: Well-developed Garuga Ear. It's said to heighten one's senses when crafted into armor.

name: Sharpened Beak
description: The sharpened beak of a Yian Garuga. Looks fiercer than that of a Kut-Ku.
description_de: Der geschliffene Schnabel eines Yian Garuga ist viel tödlicher als der des Kut-Ku.
description_fr: Bec d'un Yian Garuga. Il a l'air plus féroce que celui d'un Kut-Ku.
description_es: El pico afilado de un Yian Garuga. Mucho más letal que el de un Kut-Ku.
description_it: Il becco appuntito dello Yian Garuga. È più letale di quello di Kut-Ku.
description_zh: The sharpened beak of a Yian Garuga. Looks fiercer than that of a Kut-Ku.

name: Rejuvenated Beak
description: A Yian Garuga beak. Its color, luster, and the jawline's angle have been restored.
description_de: Ein Garuga-Schnabel. Farbe, Glanz und Kieferlinie wurden wiederhergestellt.
description_fr: Bec d'un Garuga. Sa couleur, son éclat et sa forme ont été restaurés.
description_es: Pico de un Garuga. Tiene el color, lustre y ángulo mandibular restaurados.
description_it: Becco di Garuga. È stato sottoposto a un'opera di restauro completa.
description_zh: A Yian Garuga beak. Its color, luster, and the jawline's angle have been restored.

name: Garuga Wing
description: A first class material that requires high crafting skills to work with.
description_de: Erstklassiges Material, das erstklassige Technologien erfordert.
description_fr: Matériau top niveau qui requiert une fabrication de haute technologie.
description_es: Material de primera clase. Para trabajarlo se requiere alta tecnología.
description_it: Materiale di prima classe; richiede alta tecnologia per la lavorazione.
description_zh: A first class material that requires high crafting skills to work with.

name: Garuga Fellwing
description: A large, well-developed Garuga wing. It's highly sought after by crafters the world round.
description_de: Großer und gut entwickelter Garuga-Flügel. Unter Handwerkern begehrt.
description_fr: Grande aile de Garuga bien développée. Prisée par les artisans.
description_es: Ala Garuga grande y bien desarrollada. Valorada entre los artesanos.
description_it: Un'ala di Garuga grande e ben sviluppata. Molto ricercata dagli artigiani.
description_zh: A large, well-developed Garuga wing. It's highly sought after by crafters the world round.

name: Garuga Tail
description: The tail of a Yian Garuga. Responds to shocks by spouting a powerful venom.
description_de: Dieser Schwanz eines Yian Garuga reagiert auf Erschütterung mit Gift.
description_fr: Queue qui riposte aux chocs avec un puissant venin.
description_es: Una cola de Yian Garuga. Responde a los golpes inoculando un potente veneno.
description_it: Ha la qualità speciale di rispondere ai colpi con un potente veleno.
description_zh: The tail of a Yian Garuga. Responds to shocks by spouting a powerful venom.

name: Garuga Lash
description: A tough, hard tail that stores within a deadly poison that kills its target in seconds.
description_de: Ledriger Schwanz voll tödlichen Gifts, das seine Opfer tötet.
description_fr: Queue en cuir avec poison fatal destiné à tuer sa cible.
description_es: Cola de cuero preparada con veneno mortal para matar a su objetivo.
description_it: Coda ruvida, con la punta avvelenata per uccidere gli avversari.
description_zh: A tough, hard tail that stores within a deadly poison that kills its target in seconds.

name: Garuga Mane
description: Mane from a Yian Garuga. Unusually intimidating.
description_de: Mähne eines Yian Garuga. Ungewöhnlich einschüchternd.
description_fr: Un sentiment de contrainte qui emplit l'air. Plus qu'une simple décoration.
description_es: Una crin de Garuga. Poco utilizada como adorno por su aspecto intimidante.
description_it: Un senso di oppressione riempie l'aria. Non è una semplice decorazione.
description_zh: Mane from a Yian Garuga. Unusually intimidating.

name: Garuga Silverpelt
description: A shimmering silver pelt that mesmerizes all with its beauty when it flutters.
description_de: Schimmernder Silberpelz, dessen Bewegungen verzaubern.
description_fr: Peau argentée qui hypnotise par sa beauté quand elle flotte.
description_es: Piel de plata centelleante. Verla agitarse al viento es de una belleza hipnótica.
description_it: Scintillante pelle di argento. Se agitata, la sua bellezza è ipnotica.
description_zh: A shimmering silver pelt that mesmerizes all with its beauty when it flutters.

name: Hyper Garuga Scale
description: Darker than normal Garuga scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Garuga- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Garuga normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Garuga normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: È più scura delle normali scaglie di Garuga e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Garuga scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Garuga Shard
description: Darker than normal Garuga scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als normale Garuga-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Garuga normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Garuga normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Garuga, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Garuga scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Deadeye Scale
description: A scale taken from a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.
description_de: Eine Schuppe eines Narbigen Yian Garuga. Trägt die Narben vieler harter Schlachten.
description_fr: Écaille d'un Yian Garuga Œil-mort. Marquée par de nombreux combats.
description_es: Escama de Yian Garuga Cíclope. Luce las cicatrices de muchas luchas encarnizadas.
description_it: Scaglia di Caecus Yian Garuga. Porta i segni di cruente battaglie.
description_zh: A scale taken from a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Scale+
description: A hardened scale of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.
description_de: Die gehärtete Schuppe eines Narbigen Yian Garuga. Trägt die Narben vieler Schlachten.
description_fr: Écaille dure d'un Yian Garuga Œil-mort. Marquée par de nombreux combats.
description_es: Escama endurecida de Y. Garuga Cíclope. Luce las cicatrices de un sinfín de batallas.
description_it: Scaglia temprata di Caecus Yian Garuga. Porta i segni di innumerevoli battaglie.
description_zh: A hardened scale of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Shard
description: The thick top shell of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.
description_de: Die extraharte Schuppe eines Narbigen Yian Garuga. Trägt die Narben vieler Schlachten.
description_fr: Carapace épaisse d'un Yian Garuga Œil-mort. Marquée par de nombreux combats.
description_es: Escama superior de Yian Garuga Cíclope. Luce las cicatrices de un sinfín de batallas.
description_it: Guscio doppio di Caecus Yian Garuga. Temprato da innumerevoli battaglie.
description_zh: The thick top shell of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Shell
description: The shell of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.
description_de: Der Panzer eines Narbigen Yian Garuga. Er trägt die Narben vieler Schlachten.
description_fr: Carapace d'un Yian Garuga Œil-mort. Marquée par de nombreux combats.
description_es: Caparazón de Yian Garuga Cíclope. Desgastado y repleto de marcas de lucha.
description_it: Corazza di Caecus Yian Garuga. Segnata dall'usura e dalle cicatrici di battaglia.
description_zh: The shell of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Carapace
description: A hardened shell of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.
description_de: Der gehärteter Panzer eines Narbigen Yian Garuga. Trägt die Narben vieler Schlachten.
description_fr: Cuirasse dure d'un Yian Garuga Œil-mort. Marquée par de nombreux combats.
description_es: Caparazón endurecido de Yian Garuga Cíclope. Puesto a prueba en incontables batallas.
description_it: Corazza rigida di Caecus Yian Garuga. Temprata da innumerevoli battaglie.
description_zh: A hardened shell of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Cortex
description: A very hard Deadeye Yian Garuga shell. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.
description_de: Der extraharte Panzer eines Narbigen Yian Garuga. Trägt die Narben vieler Schlachten.
description_fr: Carapace très dure d'un Yian Garuga Œil-mort. Marquée par de nombreux combats.
description_es: Placa muy resistente de Yian Garuga Cíclope. Puesta a prueba en incontables batallas.
description_it: Corazza rigida di Caecus Yian Garuga. Temprata da innumerevoli battaglie.
description_zh: A very hard Deadeye Yian Garuga shell. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Mosswine Hide
description: A musty hide covered in moss.
description_de: Eine Mosswine-Haut, mit Moos überzogen.
description_fr: Peau couverte de mousse étrange.
description_es: Piel de Mosswine. Está cubierta de musgo.
description_it: Pelle di Mosswine. È coperta di muschio.
description_zh: A musty hide covered in moss.

name: Mosswine Thick Hide
description: A thick, musty hide covered in moss.
description_de: Eine extradicke Mosswine- Haut, mit Moos überzogen.
description_fr: Peau épaisse couverte de mousse étrange.
description_es: Piel de Mosswine gruesa y cubierta de musgo.
description_it: Pelle spessa e dura, coperta di muschio.
description_zh: A thick, musty hide covered in moss.

name: Bullfango Pelt
description: A pelt from a Bullfango, covered in bristly fur.
description_de: Der Pelz eines Bullfango, bedeckt von borstigen Haaren.
description_fr: Peau composée de poils drus.
description_es: Piel de un Bullfango cubierta por un hirsuto pelaje.
description_it: Pelle di Bullfango, piuttosto ispida.
description_zh: A pelt from a Bullfango, covered in bristly fur.

name: Bullfango Pelt+
description: A high-quality pelt from a Bullfango. It's as tough as it is bristly.
description_de: Der hochwertige Pelz eines Bullfango. Gleichermaßen zäh und stachlig.
description_fr: Peau de qualité composée de poils drus. Très résistante.
description_es: Piel de Bullfango de calidad. Es tan dura como hirsuta.
description_it: Pelle pregiata di Bullfango, tanto resistente quanto ispida.
description_zh: A high-quality pelt from a Bullfango. It's as tough as it is bristly.

name: Bullfango Thickfur
description: A top-quality pelt from a Bullfango. The fur is particularly dense and bristly.
description_de: Der hochwertige Pelz eines Bullfango. Außergewöhnlich zäh und stachlig.
description_fr: Peau de qualité supérieure composée de poils drus. Très résistante.
description_es: Pelaje de Bullfango de gran calidad. El pelo es especialmente denso y rasposo.
description_it: Pelle pregiatissima di Bullfango, dal pelo particolarmente spesso e irsuto.
description_zh: A top-quality pelt from a Bullfango. The fur is particularly dense and bristly.

name: Bullfango Head
description: A Bullfango head, complete with two splendid tusks.
description_de: Ein Bullfango-Kopf, komplett mit zwei prächtigen Hauern.
description_fr: Tête ornée de deux magnifiques défenses.
description_es: Cabeza de Bullfango con dos colmillos increíbles.
description_it: Testa di Bullfango, completa di due splendide zanne.
description_zh: A Bullfango head, complete with two splendid tusks.

name: Bulldrome Hide
description: The hide of a Bulldrome. Its bristliness has a certain beauty to it.
