description_de: Die ledrige Haut eines Bull- drome. Seiner Rauheit wohnt eine gewisse Schönheit inne.
description_fr: Apparence broussailleuse, mais étrangement assez jolie.
description_es: Piel de Bulldrome cuyo reluciente aspecto le da una belleza especial.
description_it: Pelle dura di Bulldrome, tanto resistente quanto ispida.
description_zh: The hide of a Bulldrome. Its bristliness has a certain beauty to it.

name: Bulldrome Hide+
description: The tough, unblemished hide of a Bulldrome.
description_de: Die zähe, makellose Lederhaut eines Bulldrome.
description_fr: Cuir velu et résistant qui a conservé son éclat.
description_es: Piel curtida de un Bulldrome. Es simplemente perfecta.
description_it: La dura pelle di un Bulldrome. È perfetta.
description_zh: The tough, unblemished hide of a Bulldrome.

name: Bulldrome Thickhide
description: The thick skin from a Bulldrome. It's too tough to get scratched through regular use.
description_de: Extrem dicke Lederhaut eines Bulldrome. So widerstandsfähig wie ein Felsen.
description_fr: Peau si résistante et épaisse qu'elle ne peut s'user par un usage ordinaire.
description_es: Piel gruesa de Bulldrome. Es tan resistente que ni se desgasta con el uso.
description_it: Pelle spessa di Bulldrome. È troppo dura per essere scalfita dall'uso normale.
description_zh: The thick skin from a Bulldrome. It's too tough to get scratched through regular use.

name: Bulldrome Tusk
description: A majestic Bulldrome Tusk. The damaged surface tells the tale of many battles.
description_de: Mächtiger Bulldrome-Hauer. Die zerkratzte Oberfläche zeugt von vielen Kämpfen.
description_fr: Sa surface endommagée raconte moult batailles.
description_es: Majestuoso colmillo de Bulldrome. Su superficie recuerda muchas batallas.
description_it: Maestosa zanna di Bulldrome. La superficie danneggiata parla di molte battaglie.
description_zh: A majestic Bulldrome Tusk. The damaged surface tells the tale of many battles.

name: Bulldrome Tusk+
description: The large tusk of a majestic Bulldrome. It has been hardened through battle.
description_de: Der große Hauer eines majestätischen Bulldrome. Von Schlachten gehärtet.
description_fr: Grosse défense d'un digne Bulldrome. Endurcie par bien des combats.
description_es: Gran colmillo de un Bulldrome majestuoso. Se ha endurecido en combate.
description_it: Grossa zanna di un maestoso Bulldrome, resa ancora più coriacea dalle battaglie.
description_zh: The large tusk of a majestic Bulldrome. It has been hardened through battle.

name: Bulldrome Hardtusk
description: The large, hard tusk of a majestic Bulldrome. Hardened through countless battles.
description_de: Der enorme Hauer eines majestätischen Bulldrome. Von Schlachten gehärtet.
description_fr: Grosse défense solide d'un digne Bulldrome. Endurcie par bien des combats.
description_es: Colmillo grande y duro de un Bulldrome majestuoso. Se ha endurecido en combate.
description_it: Grossa zanna dura del maestoso Bulldrome, resa ancora più coriacea dalle battaglie.
description_zh: The large, hard tusk of a majestic Bulldrome. Hardened through countless battles.

name: Conga Pelt+
description: The hard pelt of a Conga. The thick fur can be used to make long-lasting equipment.
description_de: Der harte Pelz eines Conga. Das dichte Fell garantiert Haltbarkeit.
description_fr: La peau dure du Conga. Sa fourrure épaisse produit un équipement résistant.
description_es: Una dura piel de Conga. Con ella se fabrica equipamiento duradero.
description_it: La dura pelle di un Conga. La fitta pelliccia le dà una lunga durata.
description_zh: The hard pelt of a Conga. The thick fur can be used to make long-lasting equipment.

name: Conga Fur
description: The hard fur of a Conga has to be sanitized before use, but its toughness is top notch.
description_de: Der Gestank ist schwer herauszubekommen, aber die Qualität ist unschlagbar.
description_fr: Cette fourrure épaisse doit être désinfectée avant usage, mais sa robustesse vaut bien l'effort.
description_es: El pelo de Conga debe sanearse antes de usar, pero su resistencia no tiene parangón.
description_it: Pelle indurita di un Conga. Va pulita prima di usarla, ma ha una resistenza incomparabile.
description_zh: The hard fur of a Conga has to be sanitized before use, but its toughness is top notch.

name: Beastly Fang
description: A large fang from a Fanged Beast that can chomp the hardest of boulders in half.
description_de: Großer Reißzahn einer Bestie, der selbst härteste Felsen zermalmen kann.
description_fr: Le grand croc d'une bête à croc pouvant mordre le plus dur des rochers.
description_es: Gran colmillo de Pelagus que puede atravesar la más dura piedra.
description_it: Grande dente di una belva zannuta. Può sbriciolare anche le pietre più dure.
description_zh: A large fang from a Fanged Beast that can chomp the hardest of boulders in half.

name: Congalala Pelt+
description: The stout fur of a Congalala. Important crafting material.
description_de: Der feste Pelz eines Congalala ist ein wichtiger Rohstoff für Handwerker.
description_fr: Les poils durs de sa peau sont importants pour la création d'équipement.
description_es: Piel de gran utilidad en la fabricación de equipo gracias a la fortaleza de su pelo.
description_it: I suoi robusti peli sono molto utili per fabbricare equipaggiamento.
description_zh: The stout fur of a Congalala. Important crafting material.

name: Congalala Fur
description: The stout hairs of this pelt, coupled with its glossy coat make it highly valuable.
description_de: Die noch härteren Haare des Pelzes und sein Glanz machen ihn perfekt.
description_fr: Peau idéale grâce à ses poils encore plus durs et son aspect brillant.
description_es: Los pelos aún más fuertes de esta piel y su lustre la hacen perfecta.
description_it: Le setole dure e lucenti rendono questa pelle un materiale perfetto.
description_zh: The stout hairs of this pelt, coupled with its glossy coat make it highly valuable.

name: Congalala Fang
description: The fang of a Congalala. Solid enough to crunch objects into dust.
description_de: Der Reißzahn des Congalala ist solide genug, um Objekte zu zermahlen.
description_fr: Un croc de Congalala assez solide pour pulvériser des objets.
description_es: El colmillo de un Congalala. Capaz de hacer polvo cualquier objeto a mordiscos.
description_it: La zanna di un Congalala, abbastanza solida da sbriciolare gli oggetti.
description_zh: The fang of a Congalala. Solid enough to crunch objects into dust.

name: Congalala Claw+
description: A long, hard, sharp claw with a wild nature that makes crafting difficult.
description_de: Eine lange, harte, scharfe Klaue mit wilder Natur. Schwer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Une griffe dure dont la nature étrange rend l'ouvrage difficile.
description_es: Garra larga, dura y afilada, de una naturaleza salvaje que hace difícil utilizarla.
description_it: Lungo, affilato artiglio; la sua natura ne rende difficile la lavorazione.
description_zh: A long, hard, sharp claw with a wild nature that makes crafting difficult.

name: Vibrant Pelt
description: Vibrant hair that grows on the head of a Congalala. The colors are lovely.
description_de: Leuchtendes Haar, das auf dem Kopf des Congalala wächst. Liebliche Farben.
description_fr: Poils aux couleurs magnifiques venant de la tête d'un Congalala.
description_es: Pelo vibrante que crece en la cabeza de los Congalala. Sus colores son preciosos.
description_it: Peli vibranti che crescono sulla testa del Congalala. I colori sono magnifici.
description_zh: Vibrant hair that grows on the head of a Congalala. The colors are lovely.

name: Vibrant Fur
description: The best vibrant hair from the head of a Congalala is beautiful and tough.
description_de: Leuchtendes Haar, das auf dem Kopf des Congalala wächst. Äußerst robust.
description_fr: Poils solides aux couleurs magnifiques venant de la tête d'un Congalala.
description_es: El mejor pelo vibrante de la cabeza de un Congalala es tan resistente como hermoso.
description_it: Peli vibranti che crescono sulla testa del Congalala, eleganti e resistenti.
description_zh: The best vibrant hair from the head of a Congalala is beautiful and tough.

name: Congalala Hardclaw
description: Talons evolved specifically for combat. The natural weapon of Congalala.
description_de: Speziell für den Kampf entwickelt. Sehr scharf, eine natürliche Waffe.
description_fr: Conçue spécialement pour le combat. Si acérée que c'est une arme naturelle.
description_es: Desarrollada especialmente para luchar. Una afilada arma de la naturaleza.
description_it: Usato dall'animale nei combattimenti. È così affilato da essere letale.
description_zh: Talons evolved specifically for combat. The natural weapon of Congalala.

name: Hyper Congalala Pelt+
description: Darker than normal Congalala fur, this Hyper fur emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als ein norma- ler Congalala-Pelz. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la fourrure de Congalala normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que la piel de Congalala normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelle di Congalala più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Congalala fur, this Hyper fur emits an ominous glow.

name: Blango Pelt
description: A snow white Blango Pelt. It protects the body against the mountain cold.
description_de: Schneeweißer Blango-Pelz. Er schützt den Körper vor der Kälte in den Bergen.
description_fr: Fourrure d'un blanc immaculé. Protège du froid montagnard.
description_es: Piel de Blango muy blanca. Protege el cuerpo del frío de la montaña.
description_it: Pelle candida di Blango. Protegge il corpo dal freddo delle montagne.
description_zh: A snow white Blango Pelt. It protects the body against the mountain cold.

name: Blango Pelt+
description: Keeps you toasty in frigid temps; harder to work with than normal Blango Pelts.
description_de: Schwerer zu bearbeiten als normaler Blango-Pelz, aber sehr wertvolles Material.
description_fr: Belle mais difficile à travailler. Matériau de valeur.
description_es: Más difícil de trabajar que la piel de Blango normal. Te calienta en climas fríos.
description_it: Più difficile da lavorare della normale pelle di Blango; molto pregiata.
description_zh: Keeps you toasty in frigid temps; harder to work with than normal Blango Pelts.

name: Blango Fur
description: This tough Blango fur is as beautiful as it is fascinating to craft items with.
description_de: Wunderschöner Blango-Pelz. Ein faszinierendes Material.
description_fr: Fourrure épaisse de Blango aussi agréable à l'œil que passionnante à travailler.
description_es: El pelo de Blango es fuerte, hermoso y muy útil para crear equipamiento.
description_it: Pelle dura di Blango, bella da vedersi e molto utile per costruire oggetti.
description_zh: This tough Blango fur is as beautiful as it is fascinating to craft items with.

name: Blangonga Pelt
description: White fur with astounding thermal properties and as strong as an iron chain.
description_de: Weißer Pelz mit wärmenden Eigenschaften und der Stärke einer Eisenkette.
description_fr: Fourrure aux propriétés thermiques incroyables et très résistante.
description_es: Piel blanca con increíbles propiedades térmicas y tan fuerte como el hierro.
description_it: Pelle bianca, ottime proprietà termiche, forte come una cotta di ferro.
description_zh: White fur with astounding thermal properties and as strong as an iron chain.

name: Blangonga Pelt+
description: The hardened pelt of a Blangonga. The needle-like hairs are prized material.
description_de: Verstärkter Pelz eines Blangonga. Die nadeligen Haare sind sehr begehrt.
description_fr: Les poils en forme de piques de cette peau dure sont un matériau recherché.
description_es: Piel endurecida de un Blangonga. Sus cerdas, puntiagudas como agujas, son muy preciadas.
description_it: Pelle indurita di un Blangonga. Peli simili ad aghi: materiale pregiato.
description_zh: The hardened pelt of a Blangonga. The needle-like hairs are prized material.

name: Blangonga Fur
description: The tough fur of a Blangonga is harder than the depths of winter.
description_de: Dieses Fell wurde von eisigen Wintern geformt. Eine natürliche Rüstung.
description_fr: Cette fourrure épaisse de Blangonga est plus dure que le plus froid des hivers.
description_es: El pelo de Blangonga es tan duro como el invierno.
description_it: Pelo ispido di Blangonga, duro come gli inverni più rigidi.
description_zh: The tough fur of a Blangonga is harder than the depths of winter.

name: Blangonga Fang
description: The fang of the killer Blangonga. As sharp and deadly as a dagger.
description_de: Ein Reißzahn des Blangonga. So scharf und todbringend wie ein Dolch.
description_fr: Aussi pointue et mortelle qu'une dague.
description_es: Colmillo de un temible Blangonga. Tan afilado como una daga, e igual de mortífero.
description_it: La zanna del Blangonga assassino. Affilata e letale come un pugnale.
description_zh: The fang of the killer Blangonga. As sharp and deadly as a dagger.

name: Blangonga Fang+
description: A Blangonga dogtooth. As large as a human thigh, it has potential as a weapon.
description_de: Blangonga-Beißerchen. Groß wie ein Oberschenkel und als Waffe geeignet.
description_fr: Dent aussi large qu'une cuisse humaine. Peut être utilisée comme arme.
description_es: Premolar de Blangonga. Largo como el muslo de un hombre, y con gran potencial como arma.
description_it: Un premolare di Blangonga, grande come una coscia umana. Potenziale arma.
description_zh: A Blangonga dogtooth. As large as a human thigh, it has potential as a weapon.

name: Blangonga Hardfang
description: A Blangonga tooth that looks sharp enough to use as a skewer for cooking with.
description_de: Riesiger Blangonga-Zahn. So spitz, dass er sogar mittelgroße Monster glatt aufspießen kann.
description_fr: Croc de Blangonga si aiguisé qu'il pourrait faire office de pique à brochette.
description_es: Colmillo de Blangonga tan afilado que podría usarse de pincho para cocinar.
description_it: Dente di Blangonga così affilato che si potrebbe usare come spiedo per la brace!
description_zh: A Blangonga tooth that looks sharp enough to use as a skewer for cooking with.

name: Blangonga Whisker
description: A fine hair that sprouted from the face of a Blangonga troop leader.
description_de: Große Barthaare zeichnen den Anführer eines Blangonga-Rudels aus.
description_fr: Les grandes moustaches indiquent le mâle alpha d'un groupe de Blango.
description_es: Una cerda de los bigotes que señalan al macho dominante de un grupo de Blangonga.
description_it: I grossi baffi indicano il capo di un branco di Blangonga.
description_zh: A fine hair that sprouted from the face of a Blangonga troop leader.

name: Leather Beast Pelt
description: The fine tough skin of a Blangonga troop leader displays its authority and might.
description_de: Der dicke Pelz eines Reißzahn- Bestien-Anführers zeigt seine Macht in der Gruppe.
description_fr: Cette peau épaisse de chef de troupeau Blangonga est empreinte de force et d'autorité.
description_es: La piel curtida de un Blangonga alfa debe mostrar autoridad y fuerza.
description_it: Pelle dura di un capo branco Blangonga. Trasuda autorità e forza.
description_zh: The fine tough skin of a Blangonga troop leader displays its authority and might.

name: Blangonga Tail
description: The smooth feeling of a Blangonga Tail is undeniably appealing.
description_de: Die Berührung durch einen Blangonga-Schwanz erzeugt besondere Gefühle...
description_fr: Sa douce caresse est très apaisante.
description_es: Es innegable que el suave tacto de la cola de un Blangonga es muy agradable.
description_it: La liscia coda di un Blangonga dà una sensazione piacevole.
description_zh: The smooth feeling of a Blangonga Tail is undeniably appealing.

name: Blangonga Lash
description: The tail of this Blangonga is silkier to the touch than fresh powder snow.
description_de: Der Schwanz dieses Blangonga fühlt sich zarter an als frisch gefallener Schnee.
description_fr: Sa texture est plus douce encore que celle de la poudreuse fraîchement tombée.
description_es: Cola de Blangonga de tacto sedoso como la nieve en polvo.
description_it: Coda di Blangonga così soffice al tatto da sembrare neve fresca.
description_zh: The tail of this Blangonga is silkier to the touch than fresh powder snow.

name: Hyper Blangonga Pelt
description: Darker than normal Blangonga pelt, this Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als ein normaler Blangonga-Pelz. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus foncée que la peau de Blangonga normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que la piel de Blangonga normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelle iper di Blangonga, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Blangonga pelt, this Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Blangonga Pelt+
description: Darker than normal Blangonga pelt, this Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als ein norma- ler Blangonga-Pelz. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus foncée que la peau de Blangonga normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que la piel de Blangonga normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelo di Blangonga più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Blangonga pelt, this Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.

name: Kecha Pelt+
description: A quality Kecha Wacha pelt that manages to be durable, yet still soft to the touch.
description_de: Wertvoller Kecha-Wacha-Pelz. Sehr robust und dabei doch mollig weich.
description_fr: Peau de Kecha Wacha de qualité à la fois résistante et douce au toucher.
description_es: Piel de Kecha Wacha de alta calidad. Muy duradera, además de suave al tacto.
description_it: Raffinata pelle di Kecha Wacha. È resistente e al contempo soffice al tatto.
description_zh: A quality Kecha Wacha pelt that manages to be durable, yet still soft to the touch.

name: Kecha Fur
description: A fine Kecha Wacha pelt with a warm color and soft, sturdy coat. Very popular.
description_de: Feiner Kecha-Wacha-Pelz von warmer Farbe. Weich und robust. Sehr beliebt.
description_fr: Belle peau de Kecha Wacha, douce et aux couleurs chaudes. Très populaire.
description_es: Piel de Kecha Wacha de alta calidad. Muy duradera, además de suave al tacto.
description_it: Pregiata pelliccia di Kecha Wacha apprezzata per la sua morbidezza e le tinte calde.
description_zh: A fine Kecha Wacha pelt with a warm color and soft, sturdy coat. Very popular.

name: Kecha Grandbone
description: A quality, hardened arm bone that makes excellent armor in a gifted forger's hands.
description_de: Gehärteter Armknochen guter Qualität. Erfahrene Schmiede machen daraus gute Rüstungen.
description_fr: Os de bras de qualité, très dur. Un forgeron habile peut en faire une super armure.
description_es: Hueso de brazo endurecido de calidad. Gran armadura, si la forja un experto.
description_it: Pregiato osso del braccio. Gli artigiani di talento ne ricavano armature eccelse.
description_zh: A quality, hardened arm bone that makes excellent armor in a gifted forger's hands.

name: Kecha Leadbone
description: A dense arm bone whose slender sturdiness makes it fine weapon material.
description_de: Dichter Armknochen. Seine Festigkeit macht ihn zu feinem Waffenmaterial.
description_fr: Os de patte robuste dont la finesse en fait un matériau idéal pour les armes.
description_es: Hueso de brazo cuya flexible robustez lo hace ideal para convertirlo en arma.
description_it: Osso massiccio del braccio adatto per la sua compattezza alla fabbricazione di armi.
description_zh: A dense arm bone whose slender sturdiness makes it fine weapon material.

name: Kecha Talon
description: A thick, sharp talon that evolved for climbing up ivy.
description_de: Dicke, scharfe Kralle. Entwickelt, um an Efeu hochzuklettern.
description_fr: Serre acérée et épaisse qui a évolué pour permettre de grimper aisément au lierre.
description_es: Garra gruesa y afilada, desarrollada para escalar la hiedra.
description_it: Artiglio spesso e affilato. Ideale per scalare le pareti di rampicanti.
description_zh: A thick, sharp talon that evolved for climbing up ivy.

name: Kecha Ripper
description: A unique hooked talon for crossing vines. Poses a threat in battle as well.
description_de: Hakenförmige Kralle zum Rankenklettern. Ist auch eine Bedrohung im Kampf.
description_fr: Serre crochue idéale pour traverser les fourrés. Tout aussi efficace au combat.
description_es: Talón con forma de garfio para agarrarse a lianas. Peligroso en combate.
description_it: Artiglio uncinato usato dal mostro per aggrapparsi ai rampicanti e combattere.
description_zh: A unique hooked talon for crossing vines. Poses a threat in battle as well.

name: Kecha Ear+
description: The unmistakable, ocellated ear of a Kecha Wacha. Larger spots fetch a higher price.
description_de: Unverkennbares Ohr eines Kecha Wacha. Größere Flecken bringen mehr Geld.
description_fr: Oreille ocellée distinctive. Le prix est proportionnel à la grandeur des taches.
description_es: Inconfundible oreja ocelada de Kecha Wacha. Cuantas más manchas, mayor precio.
description_it: L'inconfondibile orecchio di un Kecha Wacha. Ha macchie enormi, quindi costa di più!
description_zh: The unmistakable, ocellated ear of a Kecha Wacha. Larger spots fetch a higher price.

name: Kecha Auricle
description: The unmistakable, ocellated ear of a Kecha Wacha. Larger spots fetch a higher price.
description_de: Einmaliges Kecha-Wacha- Ohr. Filtert Lärm, um sehr gut hören zu können.
description_fr: Oreille ocellée distinctive. Le prix est proportionnel à la grandeur des taches.
description_es: Inconfundible oreja ocelada de Kecha Wacha. Cuantas más manchas, mayor precio.
description_it: Un inconfondibile orecchio di Kecha Wacha. Filtra i rumori migliorando l'udito.
description_zh: The unmistakable, ocellated ear of a Kecha Wacha. Larger spots fetch a higher price.

name: Kecha Tail
description: A tail with soft strands of hair. It feels wonderful to the touch.
description_de: Ein Schweif aus weichen Haarsträhnen. Fühlt sich einfach wundervoll an.
description_fr: Dotée de poils doux. Incroyablement agréable au toucher.
description_es: Cola con suaves mechones de pelo. Posee un tacto increíble.
description_it: Coda con soffici ciuffi di pelo. Toccarli dà una sensazione meravigliosa.
description_zh: A tail with soft strands of hair. It feels wonderful to the touch.

name: Kecha Lash
description: A quality Kecha Wacha tail. Strong and supple, it may as well count as a third arm.
description_de: Guter Kecha-Wacha-Schwanz. Stark und biegsam, könnte auch als dritter Arm zählen.
description_fr: Queue de Kecha Wacha souple et puissante. Peut faire office de troisième bras.
description_es: Cola de Kecha Wacha de calidad. Fuerte y flexible, casi parece un tercer brazo.
description_it: Pregiata coda di Kecha Wacha. Robusta e flessibile, equivale quasi a un terzo braccio.
description_zh: A quality Kecha Wacha tail. Strong and supple, it may as well count as a third arm.

name: Hyper Kecha Pelt
description: Darker than normal Kecha pelt, this Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als ein normaler Kecha-Pelz. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus foncée que la peau de Kecha normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que la piel de Kecha normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelle iper di Kecha Wacha, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Kecha pelt, this Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Kecha Pelt+
description: Darker than normal Kecha pelt, this tough Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als ein normaler Kecha-Pelz. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus foncée et solide qu'une peau de Kecha normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que la piel de Kecha normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelle iper di Kecha Wacha, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Kecha pelt, this tough Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.

name: Small Lobstershell
description: The shell from a King Lobster. A rare find.
description_de: Der Panzer eines Königshummers. Ein seltener Fund.
description_fr: Issue d'un roi homard. Difficile à trouver.
description_es: El caparazón de un buen ejemplar de langosta. Un hallazgo poco habitual.
description_it: Il guscio di un'aragosta reale. Molto raro.
description_zh: The shell from a King Lobster. A rare find.

name: Large Lobstershell
description: A large shell from a King Lobster that was used as bait. Very rare.
description_de: Der Körperpanzer eines als Köder verwendeten Königshummers. Sehr selten.
description_fr: Carapace d'un homard géant utilisé comme appât. Très rare.
description_es: Caparazón del cuerpo de una langosta gigante, usado como anzuelo. Muy raro.
description_it: Guscio enorme del corpo di un'aragosta usata come esca. Rarissima.
description_zh: A large shell from a King Lobster that was used as bait. Very rare.

name: Giant Lobstershell
description: A large shell from a King Lobster that was used as bait. Very rare.
description_de: Der enorme Körperpanzer eines als Köder verwendeten Königshummers. Sehr selten.
description_fr: Carapace d'un homard géant utilisé comme appât. Très rare.
description_es: Caparazón de una langosta gigante. Solía usarse como anzuelo, pero hoy escasea.
description_it: Guscio enorme del corpo di un'aragosta usata come esca. Rarissima.
description_zh: A large shell from a King Lobster that was used as bait. Very rare.

name: Cephalos Scale
description: A sand wyvern scale. Its color is a brilliant blue. Retains moisture.
description_de: Die schillernd blaue Schuppe eines Sandwyvern. Sie speichert Feuchtigkeit.
description_fr: Écaille bleue de wyverne des sables. Utile pour conserver l'humidité.
description_es: Escama de un wyvern de arena de gran calidad. De color azul brillante, absorbe la humedad.
description_it: Scaglia di un wyvern di sabbia, blu vivo. Utile per trattenere l'umidità.
description_zh: A sand wyvern scale. Its color is a brilliant blue. Retains moisture.

name: Cephalos Scale+
description: High-quality sand wyvern scale. It absorbs moisture, leaving it glowing blue.
description_de: Eine hochwertige Sandwyvern- Schuppe, die Wasser absorbiert und dadurch blau leuchtet.
description_fr: Écaille d'une wyverne des sables. Son bleu intense est remarquable.
description_es: Escama de un wyvern de arena de gran calidad. De color azul brillante, absorbe la humedad.
description_it: Scaglia di un wyvern di sabbia; alta qualità. Di uno splendido blu.
description_zh: High-quality sand wyvern scale. It absorbs moisture, leaving it glowing blue.

name: Cephalos Shard
description: A thick scale packed with moisture, giving it a weird texture hunters go for.
description_de: Dicke Schuppe mit viel Feuchtigkeit. Jäger lieben die seltsame Textur.
description_fr: Écaille épaisse gorgée d'eau et dont l'étrange texture est appréciée des chasseurs.
description_es: Escama recubierta de humedad, lo que le da una textura extraña.
description_it: Grossa scaglia che deve la sua apprezzata colorazione al liquido di cui è impregnata.
description_zh: A thick scale packed with moisture, giving it a weird texture hunters go for.

name: Cephalos Fin
description: A sand wyvern fin. It isn't poisonous, but it's very sharp.
description_de: Die Flosse eines Sandwyvern. Nicht giftig, aber äußerst scharf.
description_fr: Nageoire de wyverne des sables. Pas de venin mais très aiguisée.
description_es: Aleta de un wyvern de arena. No es venenosa, pero sí muy afilada.
description_it: Pinna di un wyvern di sabbia. Non è velenosa, ma è molto affilata.
description_zh: A sand wyvern fin. It isn't poisonous, but it's very sharp.

name: Cephalos Fin+
description: A quality fin that is sharper than other comparable samples.
description_de: Eine hochwertige Flosse, die schärfer als andere vergleichbare Exemplare ist.
description_fr: Nageoire de qualité. Plus acérée que les autres spécimens comparables.
description_es: Aleta de calidad, más afilada que otras muestras similares.
description_it: Pinna di qualità, molto più affilata rispetto agli altri esemplari.
description_zh: A quality fin that is sharper than other comparable samples.

name: Cephalos Grandfin
description: A high-quality Cephalos fin. Much sharper than your run-of-the-mill fin.
description_de: Hochwertige Flosse eines Cephalos. Schärfer als die normale Version.
description_fr: Nageoire de Cephalos de qualité. Plus aiguisée que la version normale.
description_es: Aleta de calidad de un Cephalos. Más afilada que una aleta normal.
description_it: Pinna di Cephalos, di alta qualità. Più affilata di quella normale.
description_zh: A high-quality Cephalos fin. Much sharper than your run-of-the-mill fin.

name: Cephalos Fang
description: The fang of a Cephalos, which are known for their rows of jagged and razor-sharp teeth.
description_de: Der Reißzahn eines Cephalos. Besetzt mit messerscharfen Zähnen in mehreren Reihen.
description_fr: Croc de Cephalos, connu pour ses multiples rangées de dents rugueuses et très tranchantes.
description_es: Colmillo de Cephalos, afamados por sus hileras de dientes irregulares y muy afilados.
description_it: Zanna di Cephalos, mostro temuto per la sua lunga fila di denti aguzzi e seghettati.
description_zh: The fang of a Cephalos, which are known for their rows of jagged and razor-sharp teeth.

name: Cephalos Fang+
description: A sharp row of teeth made for sinking deep into prey.
description_de: Eine Reihe scharfer Zähne. Wie dafür gemacht, sich tief in Beute zu graben.
description_fr: Rangée de dents pointues conçue pour s'enfoncer au cœur des proies.
description_es: Hilera de dientes afilados que se hunden en la presa.
description_it: Una fila di denti aguzzi fatti per affondare nelle carni della preda.
description_zh: A sharp row of teeth made for sinking deep into prey.

name: Cephalos Hardfang
description: An evolved fang. Strong and sharp enough to chew right through a Carapaceon.
description_de: Entwickelter Reißzahn. Stark und scharf genug, um einen Carapaceon zu knacken.
description_fr: Croc amélioré. Assez puissant et pointu pour briser un Carapaceon.
description_es: Colmillo desarrollado. Fuerte y afilado, puede penetrar un carapaceon.
description_it: Zanna evoluta, forte e affilata abbastanza da poter frantumare un carapace.
description_zh: An evolved fang. Strong and sharp enough to chew right through a Carapaceon.

name: Plesioth Scale+
description: A high-grade Plesioth scale with a lapis lazuli glow. It shines even when dry.
description_de: Hochwertige, hellblaue Ple- sioth-Schuppe. Sie glänzt, auch wenn sie trocken ist.
description_fr: Écaille de haute qualité aux reflets lapis lazuli. Brille même lorsqu'elle est sèche.
description_es: Escama sublime de Plesioth con brillo azul eléctrico. Brilla incluso seca.
description_it: Pregiata scaglia di Plesioth dal riflesso blu. Brilla anche da asciutta.
description_zh: A high-grade Plesioth scale with a lapis lazuli glow. It shines even when dry.

name: Plesioth Shard
description: A thick Plesioth scale with a lapis lazuli glow. It fends off claw and fang attacks.
description_de: Dicke, hellblaue Plesioth- Schuppe. Resistent gegen Klauen und Reißzähne.
description_fr: Écaille épaisse aux reflets lapis lazuli. Repousse les crocs et les griffes.
description_es: Escama gruesa de Plesioth con brillo azul eléctrico. Repele zarpazos y mordiscos.
description_it: Pregiata scaglia di Plesioth dal riflesso blu. Devia attacchi di artigli e zanne.
description_zh: A thick Plesioth scale with a lapis lazuli glow. It fends off claw and fang attacks.

name: Plesioth Fin+
description: A radiant Plesioth fin. Below the surface lie sharp barbs with a deadly neurotoxin.
description_de: Leuchtende Plesioth-Flosse. Im Inneren befinden sich Widerhaken mit Nervengift.
description_fr: Nageoire rayonnante de Plesioth. Sa surface dissimile des pointes contenant une toxine mortelle.
description_es: Aleta radiante de Plesioth. Tiene afiladas espinas dotadas de una neurotoxina letal.
description_it: Pinna di Plesioth. Nasconde aculei ricoperti da una neurotossina letale.
description_zh: A radiant Plesioth fin. Below the surface lie sharp barbs with a deadly neurotoxin.

name: Plesioth Grandfin
description: The finest and most lovely of all Plesioth fins. Produces top-class armor when forged.
description_de: Unvergleichliche Plesioth- Flosse. Aus ihr kann man die besten Rüstungen fertigen.
description_fr: La plus belle des nageoires de Plesioth. Forgée, produit une armure de haute qualité.
description_es: La mejor y más bonita aleta de Plesioth. Al forjarla, produce armaduras sublimes.
description_it: Splendido esempio di pinna di Plesioth; produce le migliori armature.
description_zh: The finest and most lovely of all Plesioth fins. Produces top-class armor when forged.

name: Plesioth Fang+
description: A finely honed Plesioth Fang. Sharp enough to shatter the shells of small Carapaceons.
description_de: Fein geschliffener Plesioth- Reißzahn. Er durchdringt Panzer kleiner Carapaceon.
description_fr: Croc bien aiguisé. Assez affûté pour pouvoir broyer les petits carapaceons.
description_es: Afilado colmillo de Plesioth. Destroza los caparazones de pequeños monstruos.
description_it: Affilata zanna di Plesioth; può penetrare la corazza dei Carapaceon piccoli.
description_zh: A finely honed Plesioth Fang. Sharp enough to shatter the shells of small Carapaceons.

name: Plesioth Hardfang
description: A powerful, highly-developed Plesioth Fang. It can crush large Carapaceons with ease.
description_de: Starker, hoch entwickelter Plesioth-Reißzahn. Zermalmt spielend große Carapaceons.
description_fr: Croc puissant de Plesioth. Peut facilement broyer de grands carapaceons.
description_es: Poderoso colmillo de Plesioth. Machaca grandes monstruos con concha.
description_it: Potente zanna di Plesioth; può penetrare la corazza dei Carapaceon grandi.
description_zh: A powerful, highly-developed Plesioth Fang. It can crush large Carapaceons with ease.

name: Plesioth Webbing
description: Difficult to forge with, but its water-retention properties make it popular as armor lining.
description_de: Schwer zu bearbeiten, aber wasserabweisend, daher beliebt als Rüstungsfutter.
description_fr: Difficile à forger mais ses propriétés sont idéales pour renforcer une armure.
description_es: Difícil de forjar, pero por su resistencia al agua se usa para revestir armaduras.
description_it: Difficile da forgiare, ma trattiene l'acqua; ideale per foderare armature.
description_zh: Difficult to forge with, but its water-retention properties make it popular as armor lining.

name: Hrd Ples Webbing
description: Stronger than normal webbing, and just as water-retentive. Ideal for lining armor.
description_de: Stärker als normales Gewebe. Wasserabweisend, ideal als Futter für Rüstungen.
description_fr: Plus fort qu'une palmure, retient tout aussi bien l'eau. Pour renforcer une armure.
description_es: Más fuerte que la cincha común y retiene el agua. Perfecta para revestir.
description_it: Più forte del normale, ma trattiene l'acqua; ideale per foderare armature.
description_zh: Stronger than normal webbing, and just as water-retentive. Ideal for lining armor.

name: Plesioth Head
description: A surprisingly hard head prized as armor material. Might make for a great party gag, too.
description_de: Überraschend harter Schädel. Gut geeignet für Rüstungen. Oder auch als Party-Gag.
description_fr: Crâne solide apprécié comme matériau d'armure. Bon masque de carnaval.
description_es: Cabeza durísima usada como material de armadura. Sirve como broma para fiestas.
description_it: Testa resistentissima; ottimo materiale per armature e anche per gli scherzi alle feste.
description_zh: A surprisingly hard head prized as armor material. Might make for a great party gag, too.

name: Uber Plesio Head
description: A frighteningly hard head found on a select few Plesioth. Among the very best in armor materials.
description_de: Furchtbar harter Plesioth- Schädel. Mit das Beste, was man für Rüstungen findet.
description_fr: Crâne très solide trouvé sur les meilleurs Plesioth. Excellent matériau d'armure.
description_es: Cabeza dura y aterradora de algunos Plesioth. De lo mejor para armaduras.
description_it: Testa estremamente resistente posseduta da alcuni Plesioth; ottimo materiale per armature.
description_zh: A frighteningly hard head found on a select few Plesioth. Among the very best in armor materials.

name: Hyper Plesioth Scale
description: Darker than normal Plesioth scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Plesioth- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Plesioth normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Plesioth normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Plesioth, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Plesioth scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Plesioth Shard
description: Darker than normal Plesioth scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als normale Plesioth-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Plesioth normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Plesioth normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Plesioth, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Plesioth scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Lavasioth Scale+
description: A superior Lavasioth scale. The encrusted lava leaves behind a brilliant gold sheen.
description_de: Bessere Lavasioth-Schuppe. Die Lavakruste hinterlässt ein goldenes Schimmern.
description_fr: Excellente écaille de Lavasioth. La lave incrustée la fait briller d'une belle couleur or.
description_es: Escama superior de Lavasioth. La lava incrustada deja tras de sí un brillo dorado.
description_it: Pregevole scaglia di Lavasioth. I residui di lava emettono riflessi brillanti.
description_zh: A superior Lavasioth scale. The encrusted lava leaves behind a brilliant gold sheen.

name: Lavasioth Shard
description: A thick Lavasioth scale. Under the encrusted lava lies a golden treasure.
description_de: Dicke Lavasioth-Schuppe. Unter der Lavakruste liegt ein goldener Schatz.
description_fr: Une écaille épaisse de Lavasioth. Sous la lave gît un trésor doré.
description_es: Gruesa escama de Lavasioth. La lava incrustada en ella oculta un tesoro en su interior.
description_it: Dura scaglia di Lavasioth. Sotto la crosta di lava giace un tesoro dorato.
description_zh: A thick Lavasioth scale. Under the encrusted lava lies a golden treasure.

name: Lavasioth Carapace
description: Lavasioth carapace encrusted with rare hardened minerals, making for excellent armor.
description_de: Der Lavasioth-Rückenpanzer ist von hartem Gestein bedeckt. Gut für Rüstungen geeignet.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Lavasioth sertie de minéraux rares et durs qui en font une excellente armure.
description_es: Coraza de Lavasioth con raros minerales endurecidos, forma una armadura excelente.
description_it: Carapace incrostato di minerali rari che ne incrementano la resistenza.
description_zh: Lavasioth carapace encrusted with rare hardened minerals, making for excellent armor.

name: Lavasioth Cortex
description: Heavy Lavasioth carapace covered in hardened minerals, making for excellent armor.
description_de: Der schwere Lavasioth-Panzer ist von hartem Gestein bedeckt. Gut für Rüstungen geeignet.
description_fr: Carapace lourde de Lavasioth sertie de minéraux durs qui en font une excellente armure.
description_es: Pesado caparazón de Lavasioth. Sus minerales petrificados conforman una excelente coraza.
description_it: Carapace pesante e incrostato di minerali rari che ne incrementano la resistenza.
description_zh: Heavy Lavasioth carapace covered in hardened minerals, making for excellent armor.

name: Lavasioth Fang+
description: A sharp fang from a Lavasioth. Its size is unusual for a Piscine Wyvern.
description_de: Scharfer Reißzahn des Lavasioth. Die Größe ist für Fischwyvern ungewöhnlich.
description_fr: Croc affûté de Lavasioth. Sa taille est peu courante pour une wyverne des mers.
description_es: Colmillo afilado de Lavasioth. Tiene un tamaño poco habitual para un wyvern nadador.
description_it: Zanna di Lavasioth acuminata. Ha dimensioni inusuali per un wyvern acquatico.
description_zh: A sharp fang from a Lavasioth. Its size is unusual for a Piscine Wyvern.

name: Lavasioth Hardfang
description: A hard, sharp Lavasioth fang. Its size is unusual for a Piscine Wyvern.
description_de: Langer, scharfer Reißzahn des Lavasioth. Die Größe ist für Fischwyvern ungewöhnlich.
description_fr: Croc dur et affûté de Lavasioth. Sa taille est peu courante pour une wyverne marine.
description_es: Colmillo duro y afilado de Lavasioth. Su tamaño es inhabitual entre los wyvern nadadores.
description_it: Zanna di Lavasioth acuminata e dura. Ha dimensioni inusuali per un wyvern acquatico.
description_zh: A hard, sharp Lavasioth fang. Its size is unusual for a Piscine Wyvern.

name: Lavasioth Fin+
description: A high-quality fin that has been sharpened into a virtual weapon due to the lava's heat.
description_de: Hochwertige Flosse, die durch Lavahitze zu einer Waffe geschliffen wurde.
description_fr: De très grande qualité, elle a été aiguisée par la chaleur de la lave qu'elle contient.
description_es: Aleta de calidad que el calor de la lava ha afilado hasta convertirla en un arma virtual.
description_it: Pinna di alta qualità resa affilata come un'arma dal calore della lava.
description_zh: A high-quality fin that has been sharpened into a virtual weapon due to the lava's heat.

name: Lavasioth Grandfin
description: A top-grade Lavasioth fin. The magma has endowed it with an extremely sharp edge.
description_de: Beste Lavasioth-Flosse. In Magma geschmiedet, mit extrem scharfer Schneide.
description_fr: Une belle nageoire de Lavasioth. Le magma l'a dotée d'un tranchant exceptionnel.
description_es: Aleta de Lavasioth de máximo nivel. Forjada en magma, es afiladísima.
description_it: Pinna suprema Lavasioth. Indurita dal magma, ha un bordo affilatissimo.
description_zh: A top-grade Lavasioth fin. The magma has endowed it with an extremely sharp edge.

name: Hyper Lavasioth Scale
description: Darker than normal Lavasioth scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Lavasioth- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Lavasioth normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Lavasioth normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Lavasioth, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Lavasioth scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Lavasioth Shard
description: Darker than normal Lavasioth scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als normale Lavasioth-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Lavasioth normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Lavasioth normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Lavasioth, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Lavasioth scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hydro Hide
description: Hide that is highly resistant to Water. Don't expect it to sell for much.
description_de: Absolut wasserdicht, aber erwarte keinen hohen Preis dafür.
description_fr: Très résistant à l'eau, mais n'a pas une grande valeur.
description_es: Muy resistente al agua, pero no esperes venderla por mucho dinero.
description_it: Molto resistente all'acqua, ma il prezzo di vendita non è molto interessante.
description_zh: Hide that is highly resistant to Water. Don't expect it to sell for much.

name: Hydro Hide+
description: The durable hide of an aquatic monster. Highly Water-resistant, and in especially good shape.
description_de: Die robuste Haut eines Wassermonsters. Wasserdicht und sehr gut erhalten.
description_fr: Cuir solide d'un monstre aquatique. Très résistant à l'eau et en excellent état.
description_es: Piel duradera de un monstruo acuático. Resistente al agua y de forma perfecta.
description_it: Pelle resistente di un mostro acquatico. Resiste all'acqua ed è in buone condizioni.
description_zh: The durable hide of an aquatic monster. Highly Water-resistant, and in especially good shape.

name: Hydro Piel
description: This thick, durable hide of an aquatic monster is highly water-resistant.
description_de: Extrem robuste Haut eines Wassermonsters. Wasserdicht und sehr gut erhalten.
description_fr: Cuir solide et épais d'un monstre aquatique. Très résistant à l'eau.
description_es: Piel gruesa y duradera de un monstruo acuático, muy resistente al agua.
description_it: Pelle spessa di un mostro acquatico, molto resistente all'acqua.
description_zh: This thick, durable hide of an aquatic monster is highly water-resistant.

name: Immature Sponge
description: A sponge from the sea that is not fully developed. Demand for it is high in general.
description_de: Ein Schwamm aus dem Meer. Die Nachfrage nach solchen Schwämmen ist groß.
description_fr: Pas tout à fait développée. Ce qui ne l'empêche pas d'être toujours aussi recherchée.
description_es: Esponja marina que no está totalmente desarrollada. Muy solicitada en general.
description_it: Spugna marina non ancora pienamente sviluppata. È molto richiesta sul mercato.
description_zh: A sponge from the sea that is not fully developed. Demand for it is high in general.

name: Spongy Hide
description: Hide that is highly resistant to Water. Don't expect it to sell for much.
description_de: Absolut wasserdicht, aber erwarte keinen hohen Preis dafür.
description_fr: Très résistant à l'eau, mais n'a pas une grande valeur.
description_es: Muy resistente al agua, pero no esperes venderla por mucho dinero.
description_it: Molto resistente all'acqua, ma il prezzo di vendita non è molto interessante.
description_zh: Hide that is highly resistant to Water. Don't expect it to sell for much.

name: Spongy Hide+
description: High-grade elastic hide that boasts a remarkable ability to retain water.
description_de: Eine hochwertige elastische Haut, die erstaunlich gut Wasser aufnimmt.
description_fr: Cuir élastique de haute qualité. Retient étonnamment bien l'eau.
description_es: Piel muy elástica con la capacidad de almacenar agua.
description_it: Pregiata pelle elastica con ottime capacità di trattenere l'acqua.
description_zh: High-grade elastic hide that boasts a remarkable ability to retain water.

name: Spongy Piel
description: Nearly flawless elastic hide that retains water better than any comparable item.
description_de: Fast makellose, elastische Haut, nimmt Wasser besser als jedes andere Objekt auf.
description_fr: Cuir quasi parfait. Retient mieux l'eau que tout autre objet similaire.
description_es: Piel elástica casi perfecta que retiene el agua mejor que ninguna.
description_it: Pelle elastica e impeccabile che trattiene l'acqua meglio di ogni altra.
description_zh: Nearly flawless elastic hide that retains water better than any comparable item.

name: R.Ludroth Scale
description: A small scale that enables graceful movement. Several are needed to forge equipment.
description_de: Kleine Schuppe, die anmutige Bewegung ermöglicht. Eine reicht nicht für Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Sa taille permet de bouger avec grâce. Plusieurs sont requises pour forger un équipement.
description_es: Pequeña escama que permite movimientos gráciles. Usa varias para crear equipo.
description_it: Scaglia piccola per movimenti agili. Ne servono molte per forgiare equipaggiamenti.
description_zh: A small scale that enables graceful movement. Several are needed to forge equipment.

name: R.Ludroth Scale+
description: A large, strong scale from a Royal Ludroth. It reflects light in every direction.
description_de: Eine große, starke Königs-Lud- roth-Schuppe. Sie reflektiert Licht in alle Richtungen.
description_fr: Grande écaille de Ludroth royal. Reflète la lumière dans toutes les directions.
description_es: Escama grande y fuerte de un Ludroth Real. Refleja la luz en todas las direcciones.
description_it: Scaglia grande e resistente di Ludroth reale. Riflette in tutte le direzioni.
description_zh: A large, strong scale from a Royal Ludroth. It reflects light in every direction.

name: R.Ludroth Shard
description: The ultimate Royal Ludroth scale. A rainbow of colors shimmer on its surface.
description_de: Die ultimative Königs- Ludroth-Schuppe in allen Farben des Regenbogens.
description_fr: L'écaille de Ludroth royal par excellence. Sa surface est comme un arc-en-ciel.
description_es: Escama suprema de Ludroth Real. Todo un arco iris brilla en su superficie.
description_it: Scaglia perfetta di Ludroth reale. La sua superficie brilla di mille colori.
description_zh: The ultimate Royal Ludroth scale. A rainbow of colors shimmer on its surface.

name: R.Ludroth Claw
description: A claw from a Royal Ludroth. Adapted better to movement than to attacking.
description_de: Eine Königs-Ludroth-Klaue, die eher auf Bewegung als auf Angriffe abgestimmt ist.
description_fr: Ces griffes sont plus adaptées au déplacement qu'à l'attaque.
description_es: Garra del Ludroth Real. Está más adaptada a los movimientos que al ataque.
description_it: Artigli che si sono adattati per agevolare i movimenti più che gli attacchi.
description_zh: A claw from a Royal Ludroth. Adapted better to movement than to attacking.

name: R.Ludroth Claw+
description: A sharp, pointed Royal Ludroth claw. It plunges deep into the earth with each step taken.
description_de: Eine scharfe, spitze Königs- Ludroth-Klaue. Dringt beim Gehen tief in die Erde ein.
description_fr: Très acérée, elle s'enfonce en profondeur dans la terre à chaque pas.
description_es: Garra afilada de un Ludroth Real. Se hunde en la tierra a cada paso.
description_it: Artiglio affilato e appuntito di Ludroth reale. Affonda nel terreno a ogni passo.
description_zh: A sharp, pointed Royal Ludroth claw. It plunges deep into the earth with each step taken.

name: R.Ludroth Talon
description: A menacingly powerful Royal Ludroth claw that enables it to charge through any terrain.
description_de: Bedrohliche, mächtige Königs-Ludroth-Klaue, die durch jedes Gelände pflügt.
description_fr: Griffe effrayante de Ludroth royal permettant d'attaquer sur tous les terrains.
description_es: Poderosa garra de Ludroth Real que le permite embestir en cualquier terreno.
description_it: Artiglio potente e minaccioso di Ludroth reale, permette di caricare su ogni terreno.
description_zh: A menacingly powerful Royal Ludroth claw that enables it to charge through any terrain.

name: R.Ludroth Crest
description: These crests become rigid when the beast is angry; quantity indicates status.
description_de: Diese Kämme erstarren, wenn die Bestie wütend ist. Die Anzahl zeigt den Status.
description_fr: Devient rigide quand la bête est en colère. Symbole d'autorité.
description_es: Se pone rígida cuando la bestia se enfada. La cantidad indica el estado.
description_it: Si irrigidiscono quando l'animale è arrabbiato. La quantità indica lo status.
description_zh: These crests become rigid when the beast is angry; quantity indicates status.

name: R.Ludroth Crest+
description: A proud, strong crest befitting a pack leader. Its sharp horns shine magnificently.
description_de: Der stolze, starke Kamm eines Anführers. Seine scharfen Hörner glänzen.
description_fr: Crête forte et fière à l'image d'un chef de meute. Ses cornes acérées brillent.
description_es: Cresta altiva digna de un líder de manada. Sus cuernos relucen majestuosamente.
description_it: Cresta resistente e superba da capobranco, con corna affilate e splendenti.
description_zh: A proud, strong crest befitting a pack leader. Its sharp horns shine magnificently.

name: Chic Crest
description: A proud, strong crest befitting a pack leader. Its sharp horns shine magnificently.
description_de: Der stolze, starke Kamm eines Anführers. Schärfer als scharf, drohend schön.
description_fr: Crête forte et fière à l'image d'un chef de meute. Ses cornes acérées brillent.
description_es: Cresta altiva digna de un líder de manada. Sus cuernos relucen majestuosamente.
description_it: Cresta resistente e superba da capobranco. Estremamente affilata, bella e terribile.
description_zh: A proud, strong crest befitting a pack leader. Its sharp horns shine magnificently.

name: R.Ludroth Tail
description: The finned tail of a Royal Ludroth, used by fishermen for their boats.
description_de: Der Flossenschwanz eines Königs-Ludroth. Von Fischern für ihre Boote verwendet.
description_fr: Queue munie de nageoires. Les marins s'en servent sur leurs bateaux.
description_es: Aleta caudal de Ludroth Real. Los pescadores la utilizan en sus barcos.
description_it: La coda pinnata di un Ludroth reale, utilizzata nelle barche dei pescatori.
description_zh: The finned tail of a Royal Ludroth, used by fishermen for their boats.

name: R.Ludroth Lash
description: A superior tail from a Royal Ludroth. Its strength shows it was honed in harsh conditions.
description_de: Exzellenter Königs-Ludroth- Schwanz. Stark genug für unwirtliche Umgebungen.
description_fr: La magnifique queue d'un Ludroth royal. Sa force n'a d'égal que sa rareté.
description_es: Cola superior de Ludroth Real. Su fuerza muestra que se forjó con dificultad.
description_it: Ottima coda di Ludroth reale; la sua forza dimostra che è stata temprata dalle avversità.
description_zh: A superior tail from a Royal Ludroth. Its strength shows it was honed in harsh conditions.

name: Hyper R.Ludroth Scale
description: Darker than normal R.Ludroth scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als nomale KgsLudroth- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Ludroth royal normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Ludroth Real normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Ludroth reale, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal R.Ludroth scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper R.Ludroth Shard
description: Darker than normal R.Ludroth scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als nomale KgsLudroth-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Ludroth royal normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Ludroth Real, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Ludroth reale, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal R.Ludroth scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Nibelsnarf Shell
description: A shell piece from a Nibelsnarf. Its great strength and hornlike bulges produce unique gear.
description_de: Nibelsnarf-Panzerstück. Die hornähnlichen Beulen ergeben eine einmalige Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Puissante et dotée de sortes de cornes saillantes. Pour faire un équipement unique.
description_es: Parte del caparazón de un Nibelsnarf. Su fuerza y espinas producen equipamiento único.
description_it: Pezzo di corazza di Nibelsnarf, forte e dotato di sporgenze simili a corna.
description_zh: A shell piece from a Nibelsnarf. Its great strength and hornlike bulges produce unique gear.

name: Nibel Carapace
description: A rigid Nibelsnarf carapace. Hard to forge, but the resulting equipment is worth the effort.
description_de: Ein richtig fester Nibelsnarf- Rückenpanzer. Die schwierige Bearbeitung lohnt sich.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Nibelsnarf rigide. Difficile à forger mais cela en vaut la peine.
description_es: Dura coraza de un Nibelsnarf. Aunque es difícil de forjar, el resultado merece la pena.
description_it: Rigido carapace di Nibelsnarf; difficile da forgiare ma dà ottimi risultati.
description_zh: A rigid Nibelsnarf carapace. Hard to forge, but the resulting equipment is worth the effort.

name: Nibelsnarf Cortex
description: A heavy Nibelsnarf cortex. Difficult to forge, but capable of producing impressive gear.
description_de: Nibelsnarf-Kortex. Schwer zu verarbeiten, ergibt aber beeindruckende Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Lourd cortex de Nibelsnarf. Difficile à forger, mais peut faire un super équipement.
description_es: Dura placa de Nibelsnarf. Aunque difícil de forjar, crea equipos inigualables.
description_it: Corteccia di Nibelsnarf; difficile da forgiare, ma produce oggetti straordinari.
description_zh: A heavy Nibelsnarf cortex. Difficult to forge, but capable of producing impressive gear.

name: Nibelsnarf Hide
description: Hide from a Nibelsnarf. Many are surprised by its bright colors, in contrast to the outer shell.
description_de: Nibelsnarf-Haut. Die hellen Farben wirken im Kontrast zum Panzer überraschend.
description_fr: Comparées à la carapace, les couleurs vives peuvent surprendre.
description_es: Piel de Nibelsnarf. Sorprende el contraste entre sus colores y los del caparazón.
description_it: Pelle di Nibelsnarf. I colori vivaci, che contrastano con la corazza, sorprendono molti.
description_zh: Hide from a Nibelsnarf. Many are surprised by its bright colors, in contrast to the outer shell.

name: Nibelsnarf Hide+
description: Quality Nibelsnarf hide often used as lining for armor. Strong enough to withstand the desert.
description_de: Hochwertige Nibelsnarf-Haut, ein häufiges Rüstungsfutter. Hält auch der Wüste stand.
description_fr: Beau cuir, souvent utilisé pour renforcer une armure. Résiste au désert aride.
description_es: Sublime piel de Nibelsnarf usada en forro de armadura. Resistente al desierto.
description_it: Pelle di Nibelsnarf di qualità, usata per imbottire armature. Resiste anche nel deserto.
description_zh: Quality Nibelsnarf hide often used as lining for armor. Strong enough to withstand the desert.

name: Nibelsnarf Piel
description: Honed by exposure to sand, this top-quality Nibelsnarf hide boasts great strength and elasticity.
description_de: Hochwertige Nibelsnarf-Haut, von Sand geschliffen, sehr stark und sehr elastisch.
description_fr: Exposé au sable, ce cuir de très bonne qualité est puissant et souple.
description_es: Pulida por la arena, esta excelente piel de Nibelsnarf es muy fuerte y elástica.
description_it: Pregiata pelle di Nibelsnarf di alta qualità. Temprata dalla sabbia è forte ed elastica.
description_zh: Honed by exposure to sand, this top-quality Nibelsnarf hide boasts great strength and elasticity.

name: Nibelsnarf Claw
description: Nibelsnarf claws have evolved to be able to quickly and easily burrow through desert sand.
description_de: Nibelsnarf-Klauen sind ideal, um sich schnell durch Wüstensand zu graben.
description_fr: Les griffes de Nibelsnarf sont capables de creuser rapidement le sable.
description_es: Garras de Nibelsnarf evolucionadas para cavar fácilmente en la arena.
description_it: Artiglio di Nibelsnarf evoluto per scavare rapidamente e facilmente nella sabbia del deserto.
description_zh: Nibelsnarf claws have evolved to be able to quickly and easily burrow through desert sand.

name: Nibelsnarf Claw+
description: A bold, firm Nibelsnarf claw. Ideal as material for crafting superior equipment parts.
description_de: Eine feste Nibelsnarf-Klaue. Sie ist ideal für hochwertige Ausrüstungsteile geeignet.
description_fr: Puissante et ferme. Matériau idéal pour fabriquer des parties d'équipements sup.
description_es: Garra firme de Nibelsnarf. Material perfecto para crear partes de equipo superior.
description_it: Artiglio robusto di Nibelsnarf, ideale per realizzare ottimo equipaggiamento.
description_zh: A bold, firm Nibelsnarf claw. Ideal as material for crafting superior equipment parts.

name: Nibelsnarf Talon
description: The sharp talon of a Nibelsnarf, perfectly adapted to burrow through sand. A quality item.
description_de: Scharfe Nibelsnarf-Kralle, perfekt zum Graben im Sand. Hochwertiges Objekt.
description_fr: Serre acérée. Parfaitement adaptée pour creuser dans le sable. Objet de qualité.
description_es: Zarpa afilada Nibelsnarf, adaptada para cavar en la arena. Objeto de calidad.
description_it: Sperone affilato di Nibelsnarf, evoluto per scavare nella sabbia. Oggetto di qualità.
description_zh: The sharp talon of a Nibelsnarf, perfectly adapted to burrow through sand. A quality item.

name: Nibelsnarf Scalp
description: A part of the skull that holds various organs. The useful bits must be cut out carefully.
description_de: Ein Schädelteil, der einige Organe enthält; Nützliches vorsichtig herausschneiden!
description_fr: Partie du crâne contenant différents organes à découper avec précaution.
description_es: Parte del cráneo que posee varios órganos. Las piezas se deben cortar con cuidado.
description_it: Parte del teschio che contiene vari organi; va ritagliata con attenzione.
description_zh: A part of the skull that holds various organs. The useful bits must be cut out carefully.

name: Nibelsnarf Crown
description: The heavy scalp of a Nibelsnarf is difficult to work with but it's an extremely versatile material
description_de: Schwerer Kopfpanzer eines Nibelsnarf. Schwer zu verar- beiten, aber voller Potenzial.
description_fr: Scalp lourd de Nibelsnarf. Difficile à travailler mais possède néanmoins de nombreux usages.
description_es: El cráneo duro de un Nibelsnarf. Es difícil de trabajar, pero muy versátil.
description_it: Scalpo di Nibelsnarf, difficile da lavorare, ma molto versatile.
description_zh: The heavy scalp of a Nibelsnarf is difficult to work with but it's an extremely versatile material

name: Vivid Fluid
description: A fluid which helps retain water in a Nibelsnarf and allows the beast to thrive in the desert.
description_de: Fluid, das Wasser in einem Nibelsnarf speichert und in der Wüste überleben lässt.
description_fr: Le fluide retenant l'eau dans un Nibelsnarf. Il permet de survivre dans le désert.
description_es: Fluido que usa el Nibelsnarf para retener agua y poder sobrevivir en el desierto.
description_it: Fluido che aiuta i Nibelsnarf a trattenere l'acqua e a sopravvivere nel deserto.
description_zh: A fluid which helps retain water in a Nibelsnarf and allows the beast to thrive in the desert.

name: Brilliant Fluid
description: A fluid with strong water- retention ability. Improves equipment performance.
description_de: Stark Wasser speicherndes Fluid. Es verbessert die Leistung der Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Fluide ayant une grande capacité à retenir l'eau. Améliore l'équipement.
description_es: Fluido con la capacidad de retener agua. Mejora el rendimiento del equipo.
description_it: Fluido capace di trattenere l'acqua, Migliora l'equipaggiamento.
description_zh: A fluid with strong water- retention ability. Improves equipment performance.

name: Dazzling Fluid
description: A sparkling fluid with impressive water-retention ability. Improves equipment performance and style.
description_de: Prickelndes Fluid, das viel Wasser halten kann. Verbes- sert Ausrüstung und Stil.
description_fr: Scintillant, il retient bien l'eau. Améliore le style et la performance de l'équipement.
description_es: Fluido brillante que retiene agua. Mejora el rendimiento y estilo del equipo.
description_it: Fluido brillante che trattiene l'acqua. Migliora prestazioni e stile dell'equipaggiamento.
description_zh: A sparkling fluid with impressive water-retention ability. Improves equipment performance and style.

name: Hyper Nibelsnarf Shell
description: Darker than normal Nibelsnarf shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als nomale Nibelsnarf- Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la carapace de Nibelsnarf normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que un caparazón de Nibelsnarf normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Nibelsnarf, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Nibelsnarf shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Nibelsnarf Cortex
description: Darker than normal Nibelsnarf shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als nomale Nibelsnarf-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace de Nibelsnarf normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Nibelsnarf normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Nibelsnarf, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Nibelsnarf shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Lagiacrus Hide
description: Not especially durable, but soft and workable. Use it to forge valuable leatherware.
description_de: Nicht sehr haltbar, aber weich und gut zu bearbeiten. Für wertvolle Lederwaren.
description_fr: Pas très solide, mais souple et malléable. Pour faire des objets en cuir de valeur.
description_es: No es muy duradera, pero es blanda y manejable. Haz valiosos objetos de cuero.
description_it: Non è molto resistente, ma è morbida e lavorabile. Usata per creare pelletteria raffinata.
description_zh: Not especially durable, but soft and workable. Use it to forge valuable leatherware.

name: Lagiacrus Hide+
description: A fine hide taken from a Lagiacrus. It's quite strong and immensely flexible.
description_de: Die schöne Haut eines Lagiacrus. Sie ist ziemlich haltbar und sehr elastisch.
description_fr: Beau cuir de Lagiacrus. Plutôt solide et très malléable.
description_es: Piel buena de Lagiacrus. Es bastante resistente y muy flexible.
description_it: Bella pelle di Lagiacrus. È resistente e incredibilmente flessibile.
description_zh: A fine hide taken from a Lagiacrus. It's quite strong and immensely flexible.

name: Lagiacrus Piel
description: The strong, flexible hide of a Lagiacrus. Used in expensive leatherwear, among other items.
description_de: Starke, flexible Lagiacrus- Haut. Für teure Lederwaren und andere Objekte.
description_fr: Le cuir flexible et solide d'un Lagiacrus. Utilisé pour les vêtements.
description_es: La fuerte y flexible piel de un Lagiacrus. Se usa para prendas de piel y más.
description_it: Coda flessibile di Lagiacrus, usata per creare lussuosi articoli in pelle.
description_zh: The strong, flexible hide of a Lagiacrus. Used in expensive leatherwear, among other items.

name: Lagiacrus Scale
description: A supple scale that turns myriad shades of blue in the light. In high demand.
description_de: Eine biegsame Schuppe, die im Licht in Blautönen schimmert. Sehr begehrt.
description_fr: Écaille souple aux éclats bleus à la lumière. Très demandée.
description_es: Una escama flexible que a la luz refleja miles de tonos azules. Tiene mucha demanda.
description_it: Scaglia morbida che assume infinite sfumature blu sotto alla luce. Richiestissima.
description_zh: A supple scale that turns myriad shades of blue in the light. In high demand.

name: Lagiacrus Scale+
description: A fine example of a supple Lagiacrus Scale. Its beauty is truly breathtaking.
description_de: Ein schönes Exemplar einer Lagiacrus-Schuppe. Sie ist einfach atemberaubend.
description_fr: Parfait exemple d'écaille souple. Sa beauté est à couper le souffle.
description_es: Estupenda escama flexible de Lagiacrus. Su belleza deja sin aliento.
description_it: Bell'esempio di una grossa scaglia di Lagiacrus. Bella da mozzare il fiato.
description_zh: A fine example of a supple Lagiacrus Scale. Its beauty is truly breathtaking.

name: Lagiacrus Shard
description: The ultimate specimen of Lagiacrus Scale. Special skills are required to craft with it.
description_de: Die ultimative Lagiacrus- Schuppe. Zur Verarbeitung braucht man viel Geschick.
description_fr: L'écaille de Lagiacrus par excellence. Talents spéciaux nécessaires pour l'utiliser.
description_es: Ejemplar final de escama de Lagiacrus. Necesitas ciertas habilidades para usarla.
description_it: Esemplare perfetto di scaglia di Lagiacrus. Solo i migliori la sanno lavorare.
description_zh: The ultimate specimen of Lagiacrus Scale. Special skills are required to craft with it.

name: Shell Shocker
description: This shell is actually used to release electricity, not generate it. Safe to handle.
description_de: Dieser Panzer soll Elektrizität abgeben, nicht erzeugen. Einfach zu handhaben.
description_fr: Libère de l'électricité, n'en génère pas. Manipulable sans danger.
description_es: Un caparazón que se usa para soltar electricidad, no para generarla. Es segura.
description_it: Si può toccare senza rischi: rilascia l'elettricità del Lagiacrus, ma non la genera.
description_zh: This shell is actually used to release electricity, not generate it. Safe to handle.

name: Shell Shocker+
description: A superior shell found only on certain Lagiacrus. Its structure permits greater electric output.
description_de: Ein Panzer, den nur wenige Lagiacrus aufweisen. Er kann mehr Elektrizität abgeben.
description_fr: Carapace de Lagiacrus de qualité, produisant beaucoup d'électricité.
description_es: Solo algunos Lagiacrus cuentan con un caparazón como este. Su estructura da mayor voltaje.
description_it: Ottima corazza di alcuni Lagiacrus. La sua struttura può produrre più elettricità.
description_zh: A superior shell found only on certain Lagiacrus. Its structure permits greater electric output.

name: Deathly Shocker
description: A thick shell found on a select few Lagiacrus. It releases huge bolts of electricity.
description_de: Dicker Panzer einiger weniger Lagiacri. Er gibt sehr große Mengen Elektrizität ab.
description_fr: Carapace dure propre à de rares Lagiacrus. Libère une énorme décharge électrique.
description_es: Concha gruesa de algunos Lagiacrus especiales. Lanza descargas eléctricas.
description_it: Spessa corazza di alcuni Lagiacrus. Emette potenti scariche elettriche.
description_zh: A thick shell found on a select few Lagiacrus. It releases huge bolts of electricity.

name: Lagiacrus Horn
description: The power of Lagiacrus horns has been sung of for ages. In high demand.
description_de: Die Kraft des Lagiacrus- Horns ist legendär und dadurch ist es sehr begehrt!
description_fr: On chante leur puissance depuis des siècles. Sont très demandées.
description_es: El poder de estos cuernos se ha alabado durante siglos. Tiene mucha demanda.
description_it: La potenza di queste corna viene esaltata da sempre. Molto richieste.
description_zh: The power of Lagiacrus horns has been sung of for ages. In high demand.

name: Lagiacrus Horn+
description: A fine horn taken from a strong Lagiacrus. A horn like this is sure to catch people's attention.
description_de: Schönes Horn eines starken Lagiacrus. Ein solches Horn zieht die Blicke auf sich.
description_fr: Belle corne d'un puissant Lagiacrus. Elle ne passera pas inaperçue.
description_es: Buen cuerno de un fuerte Lagiacrus. Seguro que no pasará desapercibido.
description_it: Bel corno di un forte Lagiacrus. Attira sempre l'attenzione di tutti.
description_zh: A fine horn taken from a strong Lagiacrus. A horn like this is sure to catch people's attention.

name: Lagia Hardhorn
description: A fine horn from an especially strong Lagiacrus. So unique, it's almost legendary.
description_de: Horn eines besonders starken Lagiacrus. So einzigartig, dass es schon legendär ist.
description_fr: Belle corne de Lagiacrus. Si unique qu'elle en est presque légendaire.
description_es: Excelente cuerno de fuerte Lagiacrus. Único, es casi una leyenda.
description_it: Corno di Lagiacrus estremamente forte; così unico da essere leggendario.
description_zh: A fine horn from an especially strong Lagiacrus. So unique, it's almost legendary.

name: Lagiacrus Tail
description: Not only do these serve for weaponcraft, they also wind up on Moga dinner plates.
description_de: Er dient nicht nur zur Waffenherstellung, man sieht ihn auch auf Moga-Tellern.
description_fr: Entre dans la fabrication d'armes et relève aussi les plats Moga.
description_es: No solo sirve para crear armas, también llenan los platos de Moga.
description_it: Viene utilizzata per creare armi e manicaretti di Moga.
description_zh: Not only do these serve for weaponcraft, they also wind up on Moga dinner plates.

name: Lagiacrus Flail
description: Not only do these serve for weaponcraft, they also wind up on Moga dinner plates.
description_de: Abgetrennter Lagiacrus- Schwanz. Stark und flexibel, ideal für Ausrüstungen.
description_fr: Entre dans la fabrication d'armes et relève aussi les plats Moga.
description_es: No solo sirve para crear armas, también llenan los platos de Moga.
description_it: Coda mozzata di Lagiacrus. Resistente e flessibile, ideale per la forgiatura.
description_zh: Not only do these serve for weaponcraft, they also wind up on Moga dinner plates.

name: Lagiacrus Claw
description: A sharp claw that grows on the fin. Not pretty enough to command good money.
description_de: Scharfe Klaue, die an der Flosse wächst. Nicht hübsch genug, um Geld zu bringen.
description_fr: Griffe aiguisée poussant sur la nageoire. Ne rapportera pas beaucoup d'argent.
description_es: Garra afilada que sale en la aleta. No tan bonita como para sacar un buen precio por ella.
description_it: Artigli affilati che sbucano dalle pinne. Hanno un'aria scialba e prezzi bassi.
description_zh: A sharp claw that grows on the fin. Not pretty enough to command good money.

name: Lagiacrus Claw+
description: A very sharp claw found on certain Lagiacrus. Its mundane appearance belies its strength.
description_de: Sehr scharfe Klaue einiger Lagiacrus. Sie ist viel stärker, als sie aussieht.
description_fr: Griffe acérée de certains Lagiacrus. Semble ordinaire mais est puissante.
description_es: Zarpa muy afilada de algunos Lagiacrus. Su apariencia mundana esconde su fuerza.
description_it: Artiglio affilatissimo di alcuni Lagiacrus. L'aspetto ne cela il potenziale.
description_zh: A very sharp claw found on certain Lagiacrus. Its mundane appearance belies its strength.

name: Lagiacrus Talon
description: A thick talon found on only a select few Lagiacrus. Adds both power and dignity to weapons.
description_de: Dicke Kralle einiger weniger Lagiacri. Verleiht Waffen Kraft und Würde.
description_fr: Serre épaisse de certains rares Lagiacrus. Ajoute force et tenue aux armes.
description_es: Zarpa gruesa de algunos Lagiacrus especiales. Otorga poder y honor a las armas.
description_it: Grosso sperone che si trova su pochi Lagiacrus. Dà sia forza che dignità alle armi.
description_zh: A thick talon found on only a select few Lagiacrus. Adds both power and dignity to weapons.

name: Lagiacrus Plate
description: The largest and most prized of Lagiacrus scales. Boosts the efficacy of equipment.
description_de: Die größte und wertvollste Lagiacrus-Schuppe. Steigert die Wirkung der Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Grande écaille très prisée. Améliore l'efficacité de l'équipement.
description_es: La escama más grande y preciada de un Lagiacrus. Mejora la eficacia de tu equipo.
description_it: La scaglia di Lagiacrus più grande e pregiata. Rende più efficace l'equipaggiamento.
description_zh: The largest and most prized of Lagiacrus scales. Boosts the efficacy of equipment.

name: Lagiacrus Sapphire
description: A gem only rarely plucked from a Lagiacrus. Craft with it to boost Resistances.
description_de: Ein Edelstein, den man nur sehr selten erlangt. Produkte daraus steigern die Abwehr.
description_fr: Gemme très rare extraite sur un Lagiacrus. Augmente les résistances.
description_es: Gema poco común encontrada en ocasiones en los Lagiacrus. Puede mejorar las resistencias.
description_it: Gemma che ogni tanto si ricava dai Lagiacrus. Aumenta le resistenze.
description_zh: A gem only rarely plucked from a Lagiacrus. Craft with it to boost Resistances.

name: Lagiacrus Mantle
description: A valuable azure scale found on select Lagiacrus. Said to greatly boost equipment performance.
description_de: Seltene azurne Lagiacrus- Schuppe. Soll Ausrüstungen deutlich verbessern.
description_fr: Écaille azur de certains Lagiacrus. Améliore la performance de l'équipement.
description_es: Valiosa escama celeste de algunos Lagiacrus. Aumenta el rendimiento del equipo.
description_it: Preziosa scaglia azzurra di alcuni Lagiacrus. Migliora molto l'equipaggiamento.
description_zh: A valuable azure scale found on select Lagiacrus. Said to greatly boost equipment performance.

name: Hyper Lagiacrus Hide
description: Darker than normal Lagiacrus hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als andere Lagiacrus- Haut. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus foncée que la peau de Lagiacrus normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que la piel de Lagiacrus normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelle iper di Lagiacrus, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Lagiacrus hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Lagiacrus Piel
description: Darker than normal Lagiacrus hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als normale Lagiacrus-Haut. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus foncé qu'une peau de Lagiacrus normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que la piel de Lagiacrus normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Manto più scuro dei normali Lagiacrus. Emette un suono sinistro.
description_zh: Darker than normal Lagiacrus hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Uroktor Scale
description: A volcanic monster's scale. Highly resistant to Fire, but doesn't sell for much.
description_de: Schuppe vom Feuer speienden Monster. Absolut feuerfest, bringt aber nicht viel ein.
description_fr: Écaille de monstre volcanique très résistante au feu. A peu de valeur.
description_es: Escama de monstruo volcánico. Muy resistente al fuego, pero no sacarás mucho dinero por ella.
description_it: Scaglia di mostro vulcanico. È molto resistente al fuoco, ma si vende a poco prezzo.
description_zh: A volcanic monster's scale. Highly resistant to Fire, but doesn't sell for much.

name: Uroktor Scale+
description: A high-quality Uroktor scale. Heat-resistant, bright crimson, and popular with the ladies.
description_de: Hochwertige Uroktor-Schuppe. Hitzebeständig, leuchtend rot und bei Damen beliebt.
description_fr: Écaille pourpre de haute qualité. Résistante à la chaleur. Prisée des dames.
