description_es: Sublime escama de Uroktor. Resistente al calor y de brillo carmesí. Embelesa a las mujeres.
description_it: Scaglia rossa di Uroktor. Resistente al calore, di un rosso vivace e in voga tra le donne.
description_zh: A high-quality Uroktor scale. Heat-resistant, bright crimson, and popular with the ladies.

name: Uroktor Shard
description: A superior-quality Uroktor scale. Heat-resistant, bright crimson, and popular with the ladies.
description_de: Dicke Schuppe, die ihren Besitzer vor Vulkanhitze schützte. Noch robuster als andere Schuppen.
description_fr: Écaille pourpre de qualité supérieure. Résistante à la chaleur et prisée des dames.
description_es: Escama superior de Uroktor. Resistente al calor y de brillo carmesí. Apreciada en joyería.
description_it: Ottima scaglia rossa di Uroktor. Resistente al calore, di un rosso vivace e in voga tra le donne.
description_zh: A superior-quality Uroktor scale. Heat-resistant, bright crimson, and popular with the ladies.

name: Agnaktor Scale
description: A scale so bright that it looks like it's on fire. Not worth very much, though.
description_de: Die helle Schuppe wirkt, als stünde sie in Flammen. Leider ist ihr Wert gering.
description_fr: Écaille si éclatante qu'on la croirait en feu. A peu de valeur.
description_es: Tan brillante que parece estar envuelta en llamas, pero no tiene gran valor.
description_it: Scaglia talmente radiosa da sembrare infuocata. Purtroppo non è di grande valore.
description_zh: A scale so bright that it looks like it's on fire. Not worth very much, though.

name: Agnaktor Carapace
description: Sturdier and more heat-resistant than the Shell. It produces a vivid red color when crafted.
description_de: Härter und hitzebeständiger als der Panzer. Wird bei der Verarbeitung leuchtend rot.
description_fr: Très résistante à la chaleur. Devient rouge vif lorsqu'on la forge.
description_es: Más dura y resistente al calor que el caparazón. Emite un intenso color rojo al forjarla.
description_it: Più robusto e resistente al calore della corazza; se lavorato diventa rosso.
description_zh: Sturdier and more heat-resistant than the Shell. It produces a vivid red color when crafted.

name: Agnaktor Cortex
description: The rigid cortex of an Agnaktor. Highly heat-resistant, creates bright red items when forged.
description_de: Harter Agnaktor-Kortex. Hit- zebeständig. Zum Schmieden von hellroten Objekten.
description_fr: Cortex rigide d'Agnaktor. Très résistant à la chaleur, donne des objets rouges.
description_es: Corteza rígida de Agnaktor. Resistente al calor, produce objetos ígneos al forjarla.
description_it: Rigida corteccia di Agnaktor; resiste al fuoco e produce oggetti dal vivace colore rosso.
description_zh: The rigid cortex of an Agnaktor. Highly heat-resistant, creates bright red items when forged.

name: Agnaktor Hide+
description: Precious, high-quality Agnaktor hide tempered by frequent exposure to magma.
description_de: Hochwertige Agnaktor-Haut. Wertvoll und durch Magma- Kontakt gut gehärtet.
description_fr: Cuir de haute qualité, transformé par de fréquentes expositions au magma.
description_es: Piel de primera de Agnaktor reforzada por la continua exposición al magma.
description_it: Preziosa pelle di Agnaktor temprata dal frequente contatto con la lava.
description_zh: Precious, high-quality Agnaktor hide tempered by frequent exposure to magma.

name: Agnaktor Piel
description: Top-quality Agnaktor hide with fantastic heat resistance. Thick but sufficiently supple.
description_de: Beste Agnaktor-Haut, äußerst hitzebeständig. Dick, aber ausreichend geschmeidig.
description_fr: Cuir de très bonne qualité qui résiste super bien à la chaleur. Épais mais souple.
description_es: Piel de primera de Agnaktor que resiste al calor. Gruesa pero flexible.
description_it: Pregiata pelle di Agnaktor, spessa ma duttile. Ha una fantastica resistenza al calore.
description_zh: Top-quality Agnaktor hide with fantastic heat resistance. Thick but sufficiently supple.

name: Agnaktor Claw+
description: A claw sharpened by magma so hot it can melt rock. Almost as strong as a volcano itself.
description_de: Klaue, geschärft von Magma. Schmilzt Fels und ist fast so stark wie ein Vulkan.
description_fr: Acérée par le magma. Aussi puissante qu'un volcan.
description_es: Garra afilada por magma ardiente. Casi tan fuerte como un volcán.
description_it: Artiglio affilato dalla lava, capace di sciogliere la roccia; forte quasi quanto un vulcano.
description_zh: A claw sharpened by magma so hot it can melt rock. Almost as strong as a volcano itself.

name: Agnaktor Talon
description: A powerful talon found only on certain Agnaktor. Even magma cowers before it.
description_de: Nur wenige Agnaktore haben diese mächtige Kralle. Sogar Magma schreckt davor zurück.
description_fr: Serre puissante de certains Agnaktors. Même le magma la craint.
description_es: Zarpa poderosa de algunos Agnaktor. Incluso el magma tiembla ante ella.
description_it: Potente sperone posseduto da alcuni Agnaktor; fa tremare la lava stessa.
description_zh: A powerful talon found only on certain Agnaktor. Even magma cowers before it.

name: Agnaktor Fin+
description: An Agnaktor fin with an elegant dappled pattern. Apparently a popular item with collectors.
description_de: Agnaktor-Flosse mit einem eleganten Fleckenmuster. Bei Sammlern beliebt.
description_fr: Son élégant motif tacheté en fait un objet prisé des collectionneurs.
description_es: Aleta de Agnaktor de elegante diseño veteado. Popular entre los coleccionistas.
description_it: Pinna di Agnaktor dall'elegante motivo maculato, ambita dai collezionisti.
description_zh: An Agnaktor fin with an elegant dappled pattern. Apparently a popular item with collectors.

name: Agnaktor Grandfin
description: A premium fin lovely enough to have been painted by an artist. Behold the mystery of nature!
description_de: Hochwertige Flosse, schön wie gemalt. Erblicke die Geheimnisse der Natur!
description_fr: De qualité supérieure, semble peinte par un artiste. Un mystère de la nature.
description_es: Aleta sublime tan exquisita que parece pintada por un artista. Admira su misterio.
description_it: Eccellente pinna che sembra dipinta da un artista. Un vero e proprio mistero della natura!
description_zh: A premium fin lovely enough to have been painted by an artist. Behold the mystery of nature!

name: Agnaktor Beak
description: An Agnaktor's distinguishing beak, which allows it to tunnel beneath the earth.
description_de: Ein auffälliger Agnaktor- Schnabel, mit dem er Tunnel bohren kann.
description_fr: Permet à l'Agnaktor de creuser des tunnels sous terre.
description_es: Pico característico del Agnaktor, que le permite hacer túneles en la tierra.
description_it: Sono le doti di questo becco a consentire le incursioni sotterranee degli Agnaktor.
description_zh: An Agnaktor's distinguishing beak, which allows it to tunnel beneath the earth.

name: Agnaktor Tail
description: A tail carved from an Agnaktor. The going price is low due to lack of demand.
description_de: Schwanz von einem Agnaktor. Wegen der geringen Nachfrage ist der Preis dafür nicht hoch.
description_fr: Un matériau qui a peu de valeur par manque de demande.
description_es: Cola obtenida de un Agnaktor. Su precio es bajo, ya que hay poca demanda.
description_it: Una coda ricavata da un Agnaktor. Non è molto richiesta, perciò vale poco.
description_zh: A tail carved from an Agnaktor. The going price is low due to lack of demand.

name: Scalding Pleura+
description: A chestplate made from ore fusing together over a number of years. Won't melt, despite the heat.
description_de: Brustplatte aus über Jahre verbundenem Erz. Schmilzt trotz der Hitze nicht.
description_fr: Cuirasse faite de minerai fusionné au cours des ans. Ne fondra pas à la chaleur.
description_es: Placa delantera hecha de minerales fundidos juntos. No se derrite ni con calor.
description_it: Piastra pettorale con minerali fusi insieme negli anni; non si scioglie al calore.
description_zh: A chestplate made from ore fusing together over a number of years. Won't melt, despite the heat.

name: Scorching Pleura
description: A burning chestplate tempered for ages. The various ores fused within are the key to its strength.
description_de: Brennende Brustplatte. Die enthaltenen Erze sind der Schlüssel zu ihrer Stärke.
description_fr: Cuirasse ancienne brûlante. Les minerais qui la composent la rendent puissante.
description_es: Placa delantera ardiente. Su composición de minerales es la clave de su fuerza.
description_it: Piastra pettorale temprata dal fuoco negli anni e resa resistente da diversi minerali.
description_zh: A burning chestplate tempered for ages. The various ores fused within are the key to its strength.

name: Hyper Agnaktor Shell
description: Darker than normal Agnaktor shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als andere Agnaktor- Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la carapace d'Agnaktor normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que un caparazón de Agnaktor normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Agnaktor, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Agnaktor shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Agnaktor Cortex
description: Darker than normal Agnaktor shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als andere Agnaktor-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace d'Agnaktor normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Agnaktor normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Agnaktor, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Agnaktor shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Tetsucabra Scale
description: A scale with red and black patches that blends in well with cavern environments.
description_de: Schuppe mit rot-schwarzen Flecken, die gut mit Höhlen- wänden verschmelzen.
description_fr: Ses taches rouges et noires permettent de se fondre dans les cavernes.
description_es: Sus tonos rojos y negros te ayudan a camuflarte en las cavernas.
description_it: Scaglia con chiazze rosse e nere. Si adatta assai bene agli ambienti delle grotte.
description_zh: A scale with red and black patches that blends in well with cavern environments.

name: Tetsucabra Scale+
description: A fine red-and-black scale. The top pick for artisans who want the time-hardened best.
description_de: Feine rot-schwarze Schuppe. Erste Wahl von Handwerkern, die höchste Härte wünschen.
description_fr: Écaille rouge et noire de qualité prisée des artisans pour sa dureté optimale.
description_es: Escama roja y negra de alta calidad. Favorita de muchos artesanos por su dureza.
description_it: Pregiata scaglia rossa e nera. Perfetta per i fabbri in cerca di materiali duri.
description_zh: A fine red-and-black scale. The top pick for artisans who want the time-hardened best.

name: Tetsucabra Shard
description: A thick, red-and-black scale so hard that people justi- fiably mistake it for rock.
description_de: Dicke rot-schwarze Schuppe. So hart, man könnte sie für einen Stein halten.
description_fr: Écaille rouge et noire si dure qu'on la prend souvent pour un vulgaire caillou.
description_es: Escama roja y negra tan dura que mucha gente llega a confundirla con una piedra.
description_it: Una scaglia nera e rossa così spessa e dura da poter sembrare una roccia.
description_zh: A thick, red-and-black scale so hard that people justi- fiably mistake it for rock.

name: Tetsucabra Shell
description: A flexible yet hard rubber- like shell. In high demand as an armor forging material.
description_de: Flexibel, hart und gummi- ähnlich. Heiß begehrt von Rüstungsschmieden.
description_fr: Caoutchouteuse, mais assez solide. Très prisée comme matériau d'armure.
description_es: Duro pero flexible; parece de goma. Un material de forja muy demandado.
description_it: Corazza gommosa, flessibile e robusta. È richiestissima dai fabbricanti di armature.
description_zh: A flexible yet hard rubber- like shell. In high demand as an armor forging material.

name: Tetsucabra Carapace
description: A flexible, highly durable shell that makes comfortable and easy-to-move-in armor.
description_de: Flexibel und sehr haltbar. Ergibt eine bequem zu tragende Rüstung.
description_fr: Souple et très résistante. Fournit armures confortables et très maniables.
description_es: Coraza flexible y duradera. Es muy cómoda y facilita el movimiento.
description_it: Corazza flessibile e resistente, usata per creare le armature più comode.
description_zh: A flexible, highly durable shell that makes comfortable and easy-to-move-in armor.

name: Tetsucabra Cortex
description: Tough, rubbery plating that is difficult to break. A popular equipment material.
description_de: Harte, gummiartige, schwer zerbrechbare Platten. Belieb- tes Ausrüstungsmaterial.
description_fr: Plaque élastique difficile à briser. Matériau idéal pour la fabrication d'équipement.
description_es: Coraza flexible y duradera. Es muy cómoda y facilita el movimiento.
description_it: Una corazza elastica e resistente utilizzata per fabbricare equipaggiamenti.
description_zh: Tough, rubbery plating that is difficult to break. A popular equipment material.

name: Tetsucabra Claw
description: A powerful claw that can pulverize rock. Short, but worth the effort to obtain.
description_de: Starke Klaue, die Felsen pulverisieren kann. Kurz, aber der Beschaffung wert.
description_fr: Courte griffe puissante qui pulvérise la roche.
description_es: Potente garra pulverizadora de rocas. Es corta, pero tenerla merece la pena.
description_it: Potente artiglio in grado di sgretolare la pietra. È corto, ma a chi importa?
description_zh: A powerful claw that can pulverize rock. Short, but worth the effort to obtain.

name: Tetsucabra Claw+
description: A powerful claw that can pulverize rock. Creates scratch-proof equipment.
description_de: Starke Klaue, die Felsen pulverisieren kann. Ergibt kratzfeste Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Griffe puissante qui pulvérise la roche. À l'épreuve des éraflures.
description_es: Potente garra pulverizadora de rocas. Crea equipo a prueba de arañazos.
description_it: Potente artiglio in grado di sgretolare la pietra. Crea oggetti indistruttibili.
description_zh: A powerful claw that can pulverize rock. Creates scratch-proof equipment.

name: Tetsucabra Hardclaw
description: A powerful claw that can smash through boulders. Challenging to forge with.
description_de: Kräftige Klaue, die durch Felsen schlagen kann. Schwierig zu schmieden.
description_fr: Griffe puissante capable de briser des rocs. Difficile à travailler.
description_es: Una garra muy fuerte capaz de destrozar rocas. Todo un reto para la forja.
description_it: Poderoso artiglio capace di sbriciolare i macigni, quindi di difficile lavorazione.
description_zh: A powerful claw that can smash through boulders. Challenging to forge with.

name: Tetsucabra Tusks
description: A giant, shovel-like jaw, complete with tusks used for attacking and movement.
description_de: Riesiger, schaufelähnlicher Kiefer mit Hauern zum Angreifen und Bewegen.
description_fr: Mâchoire géante semblable à une pelle dotée de défenses pour attaquer et se mouvoir.
description_es: Mandíbula gigante con forma de pala. Con colmillos para atacar y desplazarse.
description_it: Gigantesca mascella a forma di pala, con denti usati per muoversi e attaccare.
description_zh: A giant, shovel-like jaw, complete with tusks used for attacking and movement.

name: Tetsucabra Tusks+
description: A jaw with oversized tusks. Recent finds reveal damaged tusks grow back even harder.
description_de: Kiefer mit übergroßen Hauern. Beschädigte Hauer wachsen noch härter nach.
description_fr: Mâchoire dotée de défenses démesurées qui durcissent en repoussant si on les abîme.
description_es: Mandíbula con impresionantes colmillos. Se dice que al caer salen aún más fuertes.
description_it: Mandibola con zanne enormi. Pare che i denti spezzati ricrescano ancor più grandi.
description_zh: A jaw with oversized tusks. Recent finds reveal damaged tusks grow back even harder.

name: Tetsucabra Gnawrl
description: A fang that grows like a mighty tree. Lost fangs are replaced by stronger ones.
description_de: Reißzahn, der so groß wie ein Riesenbaum wird. Fällt er aus, wächst ein stärkerer nach.
description_fr: Croc à forte croissance. Tout croc perdu laisse place à un croc plus puissant.
description_es: Colmillo que crece como un gran árbol. Cuando pierden uno, sale otro más fuerte.
description_it: Zanna imponente come un albero secolare. Le zanne cadute ricrescono ancora più forti.
description_zh: A fang that grows like a mighty tree. Lost fangs are replaced by stronger ones.

name: Dignified Skull
description: A distinctly warped skull that is far more durable than normal bone.
description_de: Deutlich verformter Schädel, der haltbarer als normaler Knochen ist.
description_fr: Crâne à la déformation caractéristique. Bien plus solide qu'un crâne normal.
description_es: Cráneo de forma peculiar, de resistencia mucho mayor que la del hueso normal.
description_it: Un teschio bizzarramente deformato. È molto più durevole delle ossa comuni.
description_zh: A distinctly warped skull that is far more durable than normal bone.

name: Vicious Visage
description: A skull with opposing fangs and a sturdy lower jaw whose evolution warrants study.
description_de: Schädel, mit gegenüberliegen- den Reißzähnen und robustem Unterkiefer.
description_fr: Crâne équipé de crocs et d'une mâchoire dont l'évolution pose question.
description_es: Cráneo con colmillos y una robusta mandíbula cuya evolución merece estudiarse.
description_it: Teschio con zanne contrapposte e una grossa mandibola la cui evoluzione è tema di studio.
description_zh: A skull with opposing fangs and a sturdy lower jaw whose evolution warrants study.

name: Paddock Oil
description: A mysterious oil found only in nature. Used at the Smithy as a lubricant and additive.
description_de: Mysteriöses Naturöl. Wird in Schmieden als Schmiermittel und Zusatzstoff verwendet.
description_fr: Huile naturelle mystérieuse. Utilisée comme lubrifiant ou additif dans les forges.
description_es: Misterioso aceite presente en la naturaleza. Se usa en forja como lubricante o aditivo.
description_it: Misterioso olio naturale. È usato nella Forgia come additivo e lubrificante.
description_zh: A mysterious oil found only in nature. Used at the Smithy as a lubricant and additive.

name: Paddock Oil+
description: A mysterious oil found only in nature. Purer oil yields higher forge temperatures.
description_de: Mysteriöses Naturöl. Je reiner das Öl, desto höher die Schmiedetemperatur.
description_fr: Huile naturelle mystérieuse utilisée dans les forges. Chauffe plus, car plus pure.
description_es: Misterioso aceite presente en la naturaleza. Aumenta la temperatura de forja.
description_it: Misterioso olio naturale. Le derrate più pure alzano la temperatura nella Forgia.
description_zh: A mysterious oil found only in nature. Purer oil yields higher forge temperatures.

name: Paddock Cream
description: A mysterious oil found only in nature. Used at the Smithy as a lubricant and additive.
description_de: Mysteriöses Natur-Öl. Verbessert die Haltbarkeit geschmiedeter Objekte stark.
description_fr: Huile naturelle mystérieuse. Utilisée comme lubrifiant ou additif dans les forges.
description_es: Misterioso aceite presente en la naturaleza. Se usa en forja como lubricante o aditivo.
description_it: Olio misterioso presente solo in natura. Rende più resistenti gli oggetti forgiati.
description_zh: A mysterious oil found only in nature. Used at the Smithy as a lubricant and additive.

name: Hyper Tetsu. Scale
description: Darker than normal Tetsucabra scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als andere Tetsucabra- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Tetsucabra normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Tetsucabra normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Tetsucabra, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Tetsucabra scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Tetsu. Shard
description: Darker than normal Tetsucabra scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als andere Tetsucabra-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Tetsucabra normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Tetsucabra normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Tetsucabra, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Tetsucabra scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Drilltusk Scale
description: A Drilltusk Tetsucabra scale. It's hard and features a unique red and blue pattern.
description_de: Eine Bohrhauer-Tetsucabra- Schuppe. Hart und mit dem typischen rot-blauen Muster.
description_fr: Écaille de Tetsucabra Brise-roc. Dure, elle présente un motif unique rouge et bleu.
description_es: Escama de Tetsucabra Toro. Muy dura, tiene una trama rojiazul única.
description_it: Scaglia di Vis Tetsucabra. È robusta e presenta una strana colorazione rossa e blu.
description_zh: A Drilltusk Tetsucabra scale. It's hard and features a unique red and blue pattern.

name: Drilltusk Scale+
description: A hard scale of a Drilltusk Tetsucabra. It's sharp and features a unique pattern.
description_de: Gehärtete Schuppe eines Bohrhauer-Tetsucabra. Scharf und mit dem typischen Muster.
description_fr: Écaille de Tetsucabra Brise-roc. Coupante, plus dure, elle présente un motif unique.
description_es: Escama dura de Tetsucabra Toro. Está afilada y tiene una trama única.
description_it: Scaglia rigida di Vis Tetsucabra. È affilata e presenta colori unici.
description_zh: A hard scale of a Drilltusk Tetsucabra. It's sharp and features a unique pattern.

name: Drilltusk Shard
description: A thick scale of a Drilltusk Tetsucabra. Unbelievably hard with a unique pattern.
description_de: Unglaublich harte Schuppe eines Bohrhauer-Tetsucabra. Scharf und mit dem typischen Muster.
description_fr: Écaille épaisse de Tetsucabra Brise-roc. Incroyablement dure, elle présente un motif unique.
description_es: Escama gruesa de Tetsucabra Toro. Es increíblemente dura y muestra un patrón inconfundible.
description_it: Scaglia spessa di Vis Tetsucabra, incredibilmente dura e con un disegno unico.
description_zh: A thick scale of a Drilltusk Tetsucabra. Unbelievably hard with a unique pattern.

name: Drilltusk Shell
description: A Drilltusk Tetsucabra shell. It's quite hard and has a unique red and blue pattern.
description_de: Ein Bohrhauer-Tetsucabra- Panzer. Hart und mit dem typischen rot-blauen Muster.
description_fr: Carapace très dure de Tetsucabra Brise-roc. Présente un motif unique rouge et bleu.
description_es: Caparazón de Tetsucabra Toro. Es bastante duro y tiene una trama rojiazul única.
description_it: Corazza di Vis Tetsucabra. È molto dura e con un originale motivo rosso e blu.
description_zh: A Drilltusk Tetsucabra shell. It's quite hard and has a unique red and blue pattern.

name: Drilltusk Carapace
description: A Drilltusk Tetsucabra carapace. Its thickness makes it quite hard.
description_de: Ein Bohrhauer-Tetsucabra- Rückenpanzer. Die Dicke verleiht ihm seine Härte.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Tetsucabra Brise-roc. Très dure en raison de son épaisseur.
description_es: Coraza de Tetsucabra Toro. Su espesor le da gran dureza.
description_it: Carapace di Vis Tetsucabra. L'elevato spessore lo rende molto rigido.
description_zh: A Drilltusk Tetsucabra carapace. Its thickness makes it quite hard.

name: Drilltusk Cortex
description: An unbelievably tough Drilltusk Tetsucabra carapace with a unique pattern.
description_de: Ein Bohrhauer-Tetsucabra- Rückenpanzer. Die Dicke verleiht ihm seine unglaubliche Härte.
description_fr: Carapace de Tetsucabra Brise-roc incroyablement dure et aux motifs uniques.
description_es: Caparazón de Tetsucabra Toro. Es increíblemente resistente y muestra un patrón inconfundible.
description_it: Corteccia di Vis Tetsucabra incredibilmente dura e con un disegno unico.
description_zh: An unbelievably tough Drilltusk Tetsucabra carapace with a unique pattern.

name: Drilltusk Tusk
description: The tusk of a Drilltusk Tetsucabra. Used to dig up large boulders.
description_de: Hauer eines Bohrhauer- Tetsucabra. Wird verwendet, um große Felsen auszugraben.
description_fr: Défense de Tetsucabra Brise-roc. Utilisée pour déplacer de gros rochers.
description_es: Colmillo de Tetsucabra Toro. Se usa para excavar rocas de gran tamaño.
description_it: Zanna di Vis Tetsucabra. Viene utilizzata per smuovere grossi macigni.
description_zh: The tusk of a Drilltusk Tetsucabra. Used to dig up large boulders.

name: Drilltusk Tusk+
description: A massive Drilltusk Tetsucabra tusk. An extension of its jaw and its brutality.
description_de: Massiver Bohrhauer-Tetsucabra- Hauer. Die Erweiterung seiner Kiefer und seiner Brutalität.
description_fr: Énorme défense de Tetsucabra Brise-roc. Prolongement de sa mâchoire et de sa brutalité.
description_es: Enorme colmillo de Tetsucabra Toro. Una extensión de su mandíbula y su brutalidad.
description_it: Un'enorme zanna di Vis Tetsucabra. È un'estensione delle sue fauci brutali.
description_zh: A massive Drilltusk Tetsucabra tusk. An extension of its jaw and its brutality.

name: Drilltusk Gnawrl
description: A giant fang that is hard and sharp enough to grind a mountain to powder.
description_de: Gigantischer Zahn, der hart genug ist, um einen Berg zu Staub zu zermahlen.
description_fr: Défense gigantesque si dure et aiguisée qu'elle pourrait limer une montagne.
description_es: Colmillo gigantesco tan duro y afilado que podría reducir a polvo toda una montaña.
description_it: Una zanna così dura e affilata da riuscire a ridurre una montagna in briciole.
description_zh: A giant fang that is hard and sharp enough to grind a mountain to powder.

name: Sharqskin Scale
description: Zamite skin that feels smooth or coarse depending on which way you rub it.
description_de: Zamitenhaut, die sich je nach Streichrichtung weich oder rau anfühlt.
description_fr: Peau de Zamite lisse ou rugueuse selon le sens dans lequel on la touche.
description_es: Piel de Zamite. Suave o áspera, dependiendo de en qué dirección se frote.
description_it: Pelle di Zamite che sembra liscia o ruvida in base al verso in cui la strofini.
description_zh: Zamite skin that feels smooth or coarse depending on which way you rub it.

name: Meaty Hide+
description: The hide from the underbelly of a Zamite. The most elastic samples are costly.
description_de: Haut von der Unterseite eines Zamiten. Die Elastischsten sind teuer.
description_fr: Provient du bas-ventre d'un Zamite. Plus il est élastique, plus il est cher.
description_es: Piel abdominal del Zamite. Las piezas más elásticas son muy costosas.
description_it: Pelle ricavata dal ventre di uno Zamite. I campioni più elastici costano parecchio.
description_zh: The hide from the underbelly of a Zamite. The most elastic samples are costly.

name: Zamtrios Hide+
description: A fine, stretchy hide. It tears only after new, harder skin has formed underneath.
description_de: Feine, dehnbare Haut. Reißt nur, wenn sich neuere, härtere Haut darunter bildet.
description_fr: De qualité et élastique. Se déchire seulement quand une peau s'est formée dessous.
description_es: Piel elástica de calidad. Se rasga solo tras haberse formado piel más dura debajo.
description_it: Pregiata pelle elastica. Si stacca solo se sotto si è formata pelle più robusta.
description_zh: A fine, stretchy hide. It tears only after new, harder skin has formed underneath.

name: Zamtrios Piel
description: A thick, elastic hide with high Ice resistance. Like wearing winter, yet warm.
description_de: Dicke, elastische Haut mit hoher Widerstandskraft gegen Eis. Hält warm.
description_fr: Cuir élastique résistant à la glace. Visiblement gelé, mais chaud au toucher.
description_es: Una piel elástica resistente al hielo. Como vestir el invierno, pero cálida.
description_it: Pelle spessa ed elastica che resiste al ghiaccio. Porta con sé l'inverno, ma dona calore.
description_zh: A thick, elastic hide with high Ice resistance. Like wearing winter, yet warm.

name: Zamtrios Scale+
description: A fine scale that functions like sandpaper. Used to hone the edges of weapons.
description_de: Feine Schuppe, die wirkt wie Sandpapier. Zum Feinschliff von Waffenklingen.
description_fr: Écaille de qualité, similaire à du papier de verre. Sert à affûter les bords des armes.
description_es: Escama de calidad, parecida a la lija. Se puede utilizar para afilar las armas.
description_it: Fine scaglia che funziona come la carta vetrata. Usata per affilare le lame.
description_zh: A fine scale that functions like sandpaper. Used to hone the edges of weapons.

name: Zamtrios Shard
description: One of many thick, razor- sharp scales that shred any foolish enough to touch.
description_de: Eine von vielen scharfen Schuppen, die dich bei Berührung zerstückeln.
description_fr: Écaille extrêmement aiguisée mettant en lambeaux quiconque ose la toucher.
description_es: Una escama afilada que corta a aquellos incautos que se atreven a tocarla.
description_it: Una delle numerose scaglie affilate che fanno a brandelli chi è così stolto da sfiorarle.
description_zh: One of many thick, razor- sharp scales that shred any foolish enough to touch.

name: Zamtrios Fin+
description: A quality dorsal fin that's in high demand. Big fins go for a premium at market.
description_de: Kostbare, begehrte Rücken- flosse. Große Flossen sind auf dem Markt sehr teuer.
description_fr: Nageoire dorsale de qualité, très prisée. Les grandes se vendent à prix d'or.
description_es: Aleta dorsal de calidad, muy demandada. Cuanto mayor tamaño, mejor se pagan.
description_it: Pinna dorsale di grande qualità. È richiestissima per via delle dimensioni.
description_zh: A quality dorsal fin that's in high demand. Big fins go for a premium at market.

name: Zamtrios Grandfin
description: A huge dorsal fin that cuts gracefully through the ice. Loved by artisans and hunters.
description_de: Große Rückenflosse. Schneidet elegant durchs Eis. Beliebt bei Handwerkern und Jägern.
description_fr: Énorme nageoire perçant la glace avec aisance. Prisée des artisans et des chasseurs.
description_es: Una aleta dorsal enorme que rompe el hielo. Favorita de artesanos y cazadores.
description_it: Poderosa pinna dorsale che fende il ghiaccio. Apprezzata da cuochi e artigiani.
description_zh: A huge dorsal fin that cuts gracefully through the ice. Loved by artisans and hunters.

name: Zamtrios Sawtooth
description: A blunt tooth that slowly and painfully tears through the Zamtrios's prey.
description_de: Eher stumpfer Zahn, der die Opfer des Zamtrios langsam und schmerzvoll durchdringt.
description_fr: Dent émoussée qui transperce lentement et douloureusement la proie du Zamtrios.
description_es: Un diente romo. El Zamtrios lo usa para desgarrar lentamente a su presa.
description_it: Dente smussato che penetra lentamente nella preda dello Zamtrios. Che dolore!
description_zh: A blunt tooth that slowly and painfully tears through the Zamtrios's prey.

name: Zamtrios Sawtooth+
description: Triangular, saw-like teeth for biting and crushing. Will grow back if pulled out.
description_de: Dreieckige, sägezahnartige Zähne zum Beißen und Zermalmen. Wachsen nach.
description_fr: Dent triangulaire faite pour déchirer et mastiquer. Repousse si arrachée.
description_es: Dientes como sierras para morder y aplastar. Vuelven a crecer si se caen.
description_it: Dente triangolare e seghettato che lacera e distrugge. Se estratto può ricrescere.
description_zh: Triangular, saw-like teeth for biting and crushing. Will grow back if pulled out.

name: Zamtrios Tailblade
description: A razor-sharp tail that does as well as any axe if one brings it down hard.
description_de: Rasiermesserscharf und so gut wie eine Axt, wenn man sie nur kräftig schwingt.
description_fr: Tranchant comme un rasoir. Abattu avec force, il est aussi efficace qu'une hache.
description_es: Cola afilada cual hoja. Si la usas con fuerza, corta como un hacha.
description_it: Una coda affilatissima. Se brandita con forza, funziona come la migliore delle asce.
description_zh: A razor-sharp tail that does as well as any axe if one brings it down hard.

name: Zamtrios Tailbrand
description: A large tail whose meaty swings can knock prey out with a single lash.
description_de: Großer Schwanz. Mit einem einzigen Hieb kann er Beute erschlagen.
description_fr: Grande queue charnue capable d'assommer une proie d'un seul coup.
description_es: Una cola enorme cuyo meneo puede dejar fuera de combate a la presa.
description_it: Grossa coda che abbatte le prede con un'unica spazzata.
description_zh: A large tail whose meaty swings can knock prey out with a single lash.

name: Hyper Zamtrios Hide
description: Darker than normal Zamtrios hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Zamtrios- Haut. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus foncée que la peau de Zamtrios normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que la piel de Zamtrios normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelle iper di Zamtrios, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Zamtrios hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Zamtrios Piel
description: Darker than normal Zamtrios hide, this tough Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als normale Zamtrios-Haut. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus foncé et solide qu'une peau de Zamtrios normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que la piel de Zamtrios normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Manto iper di Zamtrios, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Zamtrios hide, this tough Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Najarala Shell
description: A shell that grows both large and small -- whatever won't impede movement.
description_de: Gibt es in groß und klein. Beide Größen behindern die Bewegung nicht.
description_fr: Prend une grande ou une petite forme de manière à ne pas gêner le mouvement.
description_es: Caparazón de tamaño grande o pequeño, pero que nunca dificulta el movimiento.
description_it: Corazza che assume varie dimensioni, ma che non intralcia mai i movimenti.
description_zh: A shell that grows both large and small -- whatever won't impede movement.

name: Najarala Ampsounder
description: A special plate that ampli- fies sound, getting messages across loud and clear.
description_de: Spezialplatte. Verstärkt Töne für bessere Nachrichtenübertragung.
description_fr: Plaque spéciale amplifiant les sons pour une diffusion claire des messages.
description_es: Un caparazón que amplifica sonidos. Difícil de trabajar debido a su fragilidad.
description_it: Una corazza speciale che amplifica i suoni, facilitando le comunicazioni.
description_zh: A special plate that ampli- fies sound, getting messages across loud and clear.

name: Najarala Carapace
description: A long shell that covers the Najarala and may have evolved from a scale.
description_de: Der lange Panzer bedeckt den Najarala und könnte sich aus Schuppen entwickelt haben.
description_fr: Longue carapace couvrant le Najarala. Peut-être issue de l'évolution d'une écaille.
description_es: La alargada coraza que cubre al Najarala. Es posible que haya evolucionado de una escama.
description_it: Lunga corazza che ricopre il Najarala. Che sia l'evoluzione di una scaglia?
description_zh: A long shell that covers the Najarala and may have evolved from a scale.

name: Najarala Cortex
description: The hardest part of the carapace. Multiple, layered plates provide durability.
description_de: Härtester Teil des Rücken- panzers. Geschichtete Platten sorgen für Haltbarkeit.
description_fr: Partie la plus dure de la cuirasse. Leur superposition offre une grande résistance.
description_es: Parte más dura del caparazón. Capas superpuestas dan mayor durabilidad.
description_it: La parte più dura del carapace. Gli strati sovrapposti le assicurano robustezza.
description_zh: The hardest part of the carapace. Multiple, layered plates provide durability.

name: Najarala Hide
description: Comparatively flexible hide found under the shell and on the underbelly.
description_de: Die vergleichsweise flexible Haut unter dem Panzer und an der Bauchunterseite.
description_fr: Cuir relativement souple présent sous la carapace et sur le bas-ventre.
description_es: Piel muy flexible que se halla bajo el caparazón y sobre el vientre del monstruo.
description_it: Pelle relativamente flessibile ricavata dal ventre e dal sottoguscio.
description_zh: Comparatively flexible hide found under the shell and on the underbelly.

name: Najarala Hide+
description: A fine, silky-smooth hide that sells well at market as a top-class material.
description_de: Feine, seidenweiche Haut. Als Spitzenmaterial auf dem Markt gut verkäuflich.
description_fr: Cuir de qualité doux comme de la soie. Se vend bien comme produit haut de gamme.
description_es: Piel de calidad, muy suave. Muy apreciada en el mercado como material de primera.
description_it: Pelle pregiata e liscia come la seta. È molto richiesta dai clienti più facoltosi.
description_zh: A fine, silky-smooth hide that sells well at market as a top-class material.

name: Najarala Piel
description: The finest of Najarala hides. Often used in all kinds of leatherwork.
description_de: Die feinste der Najarala- Häute. Oft für vielerlei Lederwerk benutzt.
description_fr: L'un des plus beaux cuirs de Najarala. Très utilisé dans l'artisanat.
description_es: Piel de Najarala de la mejor calidad. Muy utilizada en peletería.
description_it: La più pregiata tra le pelli di Najarala. Utilizzata per oggetti in cuoio di ogni tipo.
description_zh: The finest of Najarala hides. Often used in all kinds of leatherwork.

name: Najarala Marrow
description: Marrow known to cause paralysis if handled improperly.
description_de: Wird es falsch angewendet, kann dieses Knochenmark Lähmung hervorrufen.
description_fr: Moelle susceptible de causer une paralysie si elle n'est pas maniée correctement.
description_es: Fragmento de médula ósea. Puede llegar a causar parálisis si no se usa correctamente.
description_it: Famigerato midollo che provoca la paralisi se maneggiato senza cautela.
description_zh: Marrow known to cause paralysis if handled improperly.

name: Najarala Medulla
description: A mass of tissue used as a coagulant in all manner of crafts.
description_de: Eine Gewebemasse, die in vielen Fertigungsprozessen als Verdichter genutzt wird.
description_fr: Masse de tissu utilisée comme coagulant pour toutes sortes d'usages.
description_es: Masa de tejido usada como coagulante en todo tipo de artesanías.
description_it: Massa di tessuti usati come coagulante nei processi artigianali più disparati.
description_zh: A mass of tissue used as a coagulant in all manner of crafts.

name: Najarala Sounder
description: A Najarala shell with unique acoustic properties that amplify sound.
description_de: Najarala-Panzer. Einmalige akustische Eigenschaften, die Geräusche verstärken.
description_fr: Carapace dotée de propriétés acoustiques uniques qui amplifient le son.
description_es: Caparazón de Najarala con propiedades acústicas que amplifican el sonido.
description_it: Un guscio di Najarala dotato di proprietà acustiche che amplificano i suoni.
description_zh: A Najarala shell with unique acoustic properties that amplify sound.

name: Najarala Sounder+
description: A shell with unique acoustic properties. Fragile and a real challenge to work with.
description_de: Panzer mit einmaligen akustischen Eigenschaften. Fragil, schwer bearbeitbar.
description_fr: Carapace dotée de propriétés acoustiques uniques. Fragile et très dure à travailler.
description_es: Un caparazón que amplifica sonidos. Difícil de trabajar debido a su fragilidad.
description_it: Guscio dotato di proprietà acustiche uniche. È fragile e difficile da lavorare.
description_zh: A shell with unique acoustic properties. Fragile and a real challenge to work with.

name: Najarala Fang
description: A fang containing an organ that induces neurogenic paralysis.
description_de: Dieser Reißzahn enthält ein Organ, das Nervenlähmungen verursacht.
description_fr: Contient un organe induisant une paralysie neurogène.
description_es: Colmillo con un órgano que provoca parálisis neurogénicas.
description_it: Zanna che contiene un apparato in grado di indurre la paralisi neurogena.
description_zh: A fang containing an organ that induces neurogenic paralysis.

name: Chilling Beak
description: The Najarala's bird-like beak, which it uses to instantaneously seize prey.
description_de: Mit diesem vogelähnlichen Schnabel schnappt der Najarala erbarmungslos zu.
description_fr: Bec du Najarala, dont il se sert pour saisir sa proie instantanément.
description_es: Pico de ave del Najarala. Lo usa para atrapar a su presa instantáneamente.
description_it: Becco simile a quello di un uccello. Il Najarala lo usa per ghermire le sue prede.
description_zh: The Najarala's bird-like beak, which it uses to instantaneously seize prey.

name: Heart-stopping Beak
description: The Najarala's unique beak. Fangs inside it neutralize prey in ghastly fashion.
description_de: Einzigartiger Schnabel des Najarala. Reißzähne eliminieren die Beute.
description_fr: Bec unique de Najarala. Ses crocs paralysent les proies d'une manière terrifiante.
description_es: El pico único del Najarala. Los colmillos de su interior atenazan a la presa.
description_it: Il becco del Najarala. Le zanne racchiuse all'interno non hanno pietà di alcuna preda.
description_zh: The Najarala's unique beak. Fangs inside it neutralize prey in ghastly fashion.

name: Hyper Najarala Shell
description: Darker than normal Najarala shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Najarala- Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la carapace de Najarala normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que un caparazón de Najarala normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Najarala, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Najarala shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Najarala Cortex
description: Darker than normal Najarala shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als normale Najarala-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace de Najarala normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Najarala normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Najarala, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Najarala shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Black Pearl
description: A pearl with a black glow. Fetches a high price.
description_de: Eine Perle mit schwarzem Glanz. Sie erzielt extrem hohe Preise.
description_fr: Perle à l'éclat noir. Elle vaut très cher.
description_es: Una perla de extraño fulgor oscuro. Puede venderse por precios muy elevados.
description_it: La flotta da caccia a volte trova queste perle pregiate dalla lucentezza nera.
description_zh: A pearl with a black glow. Fetches a high price.

name: Fine Black Pearl
description: Largest and most beautiful of all black pearls. Very valuable and hard to find.
description_de: Größte und schönste aller Schwarzen Perlen. Wert- voll und schwer zu finden.
description_fr: La plus grande et belle de toutes les perles noires. Précieuse et rare.
description_es: La perla negra más grande y hermosa. Muy valiosa y rara de encontrar.
description_it: La più grande e bella delle perle nere. Molto preziosa e rara.
description_zh: Largest and most beautiful of all black pearls. Very valuable and hard to find.

name: Wyvern Scalp
description: A Carapaceon shell made from a wyvern's skull.
description_de: Ein Carapaceon-Panzer aus dem Schädel eines Wyvern.
description_fr: Carapace de Carapaceon faite à partir d'un crâne de wyverne.
description_es: Caparazón de un carapaceon hecho con un cráneo de wyvern.
description_it: Corazza di carapaceon, fatta con il teschio di un wyvern.
description_zh: A Carapaceon shell made from a wyvern's skull.

name: Heavy Wyvern Scalp
description: A Carapaceon shell made from a wyvern's skull that is harder than normal.
description_de: Ein Carapaceon-Panzer aus dem außergewöhnlich harten Schädel eines Wyvern.
description_fr: Carapace de carapaceon faite à partir d'un crâne de wyverne plus dur que la moyenne.
description_es: Coraza de un carapaceon hecha con un cráneo de wyvern más duro de lo normal.
description_it: Corazza di carapaceon, fatta con il teschio di un wyvern e più pesante del normale.
description_zh: A Carapaceon shell made from a wyvern's skull that is harder than normal.

name: Decayed Crimson Horn
description: A red horn from a shelled monster. Despite the decay, it remains extremely durable.
description_de: Rotes Horn eines Monsters, das trotz der Verwesung noch äußerst widerstandsfähig ist.
description_fr: Corne rouge d'un monstre à carapace. Extrêmement résistante malgré son usure.
description_es: Cuerno carmesí de una bestia con caparazón. Está podrido, pero es muy resistente.
description_it: Corno cremisi di un mostro corazzato. Ancora molto duro, anche se decomposto.
description_zh: A red horn from a shelled monster. Despite the decay, it remains extremely durable.

name: Timeworn Crimson Horn
description: A faded horn which has been weathered over time but still has some value.
description_de: Rotes Horn eines Monsters, das trotz seines Alters noch Würde verströmt.
description_fr: Corne d'un rouge délavé usée par le temps mais toujours d'une certaine valeur.
description_es: Cuerno descolorido y gastado por el paso del tiempo, pero que aún conserva algo de valor.
description_it: Un corno rovinato dal tempo, ma ancora molto prezioso.
description_zh: A faded horn which has been weathered over time but still has some value.

name: Sm. Hermitaur Shell
description: A piece of bone from a giant Carapaceon. Its small form means it has limited use.
description_de: Knochenstück eines Riesen- Carapaceon. Klein und nur beschränkt nutzbar.
description_fr: Morceau d'os d'un carapaceon géant. Son usage est limité du fait de sa taille.
description_es: Trozo de hueso de un carapaceon gigante. Pequeño y con usos limitados.
description_it: Pezzo d'osso di carapaceon gigante. È piccolo e il suo utilizzo è limitato.
description_zh: A piece of bone from a giant Carapaceon. Its small form means it has limited use.

name: Tiny Hermitaur Shell
description: A tiny piece of bone from a giant Carapaceon. It may be small but its value depends on its use.
description_de: Knochensplitter eines Riesen- Carapaceon. Äußerst robust und vielfältig einsetzbar.
description_fr: Minuscule morceau d'os d'un Carapaceon géant d'une valeur proportionnelle à son utilité.
description_es: Trozo diminuto de hueso de un carapaceon gigante. Aunque pequeño, puede resultar útil.
description_it: Minuscolo pezzo d'osso di carapaceon gigante, dal grande valore nonostante le dimensioni.
description_zh: A tiny piece of bone from a giant Carapaceon. It may be small but its value depends on its use.

name: Hermitaur Shell
description: A large piece of exoskeleton that's surprisingly light and easy to use in crafting.
description_de: Dieser Teil eines Exoskeletts ist überraschend leicht... und einfach zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Étrangement légère et facile à travailler.
description_es: Caparazón externo de un Daimyo, más ligero de lo que parece y fácil de trabajar.
description_it: Corazza Daimyo facile da lavorare e più leggera di quanto non appaia.
description_zh: A large piece of exoskeleton that's surprisingly light and easy to use in crafting.

name: Hermitaur Carapace
description: The hard carapace of a Daimyo Hermitaur. Harder than shell to work.
description_de: Rückenpanzer eines Daimyo Hermitaur. Schwerer zu bearbeiten als ein Panzer.
description_fr: Cuirasse d'un Hermitaur Daimyo. Plus difficile à forger que la carapace.
description_es: La rígida coraza de un Daimyo Hermitaur gigante. Más dura que su caparazón.
description_it: Duro carapace di Daimyo Hermitaur. Più duro da lavorare che la corazza.
description_zh: The hard carapace of a Daimyo Hermitaur. Harder than shell to work.

name: Hermitaur Cortex
description: A Daimyo Hermitaur's tough bone shell. Its thickness makes for strong armor.
description_de: Starker Knochenpanzer des riesigen Daimyo Hermitaur. Gut für feste Rüstungen.
description_fr: Os d'Hermitaur Daimyo. Son épaisseur en fait une armure robuste.
description_es: Fuerte caparazón de hueso de Daimyo Hermitaur. Buen grosor para armaduras.
description_it: Guscio osseo di Daimyo Hermitaur. Lo spessore lo rende ideale per armature.
description_zh: A Daimyo Hermitaur's tough bone shell. Its thickness makes for strong armor.

name: Hermitaur Claw
description: A giant claw from a Daimyo Hermitaur. The sharp claw can slice through rock.
description_de: Die Riesenklaue eines Daimyo Hermitaur. Scharf, kann auch Stein durchschneiden.
description_fr: Griffe aiguisée qui peut trancher la pierre.
description_es: Garra gigante de Daimyo Hermitaur. Afilada, puede cortar la roca.
description_it: Artiglio gigante di Daimyo Hermitaur. Così affilato che taglia la roccia.
description_zh: A giant claw from a Daimyo Hermitaur. The sharp claw can slice through rock.

name: Hermitaur Claw+
description: Sharp claw from a Daimyo Hermitaur. As hard as metal.
description_de: Die scharfe Klaue eines Daimyo Hermitaur. Angeblich so hart wie Metall.
description_fr: Griffe pointue aussi dure que le métal.
description_es: Garra afilada de un Daimyo Hermitaur gigante. Es más fuerte que el metal.
description_it: Artiglio affilato di Daimyo Hermitaur. Dicono che sia duro come metallo.
description_zh: Sharp claw from a Daimyo Hermitaur. As hard as metal.

name: Hermitaur Hardclaw
description: A Daimyo Hermitaur's hard claw. Tough enough to fortify castles.
description_de: Harte Klaue eines Daimyo Hermitaur. So stark wie eine Festung.
description_fr: Griffe dure d'Hermitaur Daimyo. Résiste comme un fort contre les assauts.
description_es: Dura garra de Daimyo Hermitaur. Aguanta como un fuerte a los ataques.
description_it: Duro artiglio di Daimyo Hermitaur. Ottimo per difendersi dagli assalti.
description_zh: A Daimyo Hermitaur's hard claw. Tough enough to fortify castles.

name: Hyper Hermitaur Scale
description: Darker than normal Hermitaur scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Hermitaur- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille d'Hermitaur normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Hermitaur normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Hermitaur, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Hermitaur scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Hermitaur Cortex
description: Darker than normal Hermitaur scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als normale Hermitaur-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille d'Hermitaur normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Hermitaur normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Hermitaur, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Hermitaur scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Stonefist Shell
description: The shell from a Stonefist Hermitaur. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.
description_de: Panzer eines Steinfaust- Hermitaur. Wurde im Laufe der Jahre dunkel und hart.
description_fr: Carapace d'Hermitaur Poing-fer. Endurcie et assombrie par le passage du temps.
description_es: Caparazón de Hermitaur Pétreo. Con los años se ha vuelto más duro y oscuro.
description_it: Corazza di Marmor Hermitaur, divenuta più coriacea e scura nel corso degli anni.
description_zh: The shell from a Stonefist Hermitaur. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Carapace
description: A hardened Stonefist Hermitaur shell. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.
description_de: Gehärteter Panzer eines Steinfaust-Hermitaur. Hart und dunkel.
description_fr: Cuirasse d'Hermitaur Poing-fer. Endurcie et assombrie par le passage du temps.
description_es: Caparazón de Hermitaur Pétreo endurecido. Con los años se ha vuelto más duro y oscuro.
description_it: Robusta corazza di Marmor, divenuta più coriacea e scura nel corso degli anni.
description_zh: A hardened Stonefist Hermitaur shell. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Cortex
description: A very hard Stonefist Hermitaur shell. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.
description_de: Extrem harter Panzer eines Steinfaust-Hermitaur. Über die Jahre fast schwarz geworden
description_fr: Carapace durcie d'Hermitaur Poing-fer. Endurcie et assombrie par le passage du temps.
description_es: Caparazón de Hermitaur Pétreo muy robusto. Con los años se ha vuelto más duro y oscuro.
description_it: Robustissima corteccia di Marmor, divenuta più coriacea e scura nel corso degli anni.
description_zh: A very hard Stonefist Hermitaur shell. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Claw
description: A claw taken from a Stonefist Hermitaur. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.
description_de: Klaue eines Steinfaust- Hermitaur. Wurde im Laufe der Jahre dunkel und hart.
description_fr: Griffe d'Hermitaur Poing-fer. Endurcie et assombrie par le passage du temps.
description_es: Garra extraída de un Hermitaur Pétreo. Con los años se ha vuelto más dura y oscura.
description_it: Artiglio di Marmor Hermitaur, divenuto più robusto e scuro nel corso degli anni.
description_zh: A claw taken from a Stonefist Hermitaur. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Claw+
description: A sharp claw from a Stonefist Hermitaur. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.
description_de: Scharfe Klaue des Steinfaust- Hermitaur. Wurde im Laufe der Jahre dunkel und hart.
description_fr: Griffe d'Hermitaur Poing-fer. Acérée, endurcie et assombrie par le passage du temps.
description_es: Garra afilada de un Hermitaur Pétreo. Con los años se ha vuelto más dura y oscura.
description_it: Artiglio affilato di Marmor, divenuto più coriaceo e scuro nel corso degli anni.
description_zh: A sharp claw from a Stonefist Hermitaur. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Talon
description: A very sharp Stonefist Hermitaur claw. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.
description_de: Extrem scharfe Klaue des Steinfaust-Hermitaur. Wurde im Laufe der Jahre dunkel und hart.
description_fr: Griffe très acérée d'Hermitaur Poing-fer. Endurcie et assombrie par le passage du temps.
description_es: Garra muy afilada de un Hermitaur Pétreo. Con los años se ha vuelto más dura y oscura.
description_it: Sperone affilatissimo di Marmor Hermitaur, divenuto più coriaceo e scuro nel corso degli anni.
description_zh: A very sharp Stonefist Hermitaur claw. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Small Ceanataur Shell
description: A piece of a giant Ceanataur Shell. Lighter than it looks and easy to craft.
description_de: Ein Ceanataur-Panzer-Stück. Leichter als es aussieht... und einfacher zu bearbeiten.
description_fr: Morceau de carapace. Légère et facile à travailler.
description_es: Trozo de un caparazón de Ceanataur gigante. Ligero y fácil de trabajar.
description_it: Piccolo pezzo di corazza di un Ceanataur. Non è pesante quanto sembra.
description_zh: A piece of a giant Ceanataur Shell. Lighter than it looks and easy to craft.

name: Ceanataur Shell
description: A giant Shogun Ceanataur Shell. Has a distinctive color and shape.
description_de: Riesiger Shogun-Ceanataur- Panzer. Auffällige Form und Farbe.
description_fr: Carapace géante à la couleur et la forme uniques.
description_es: Caparazón de Shogun Ceanataur gigante. De forma y color característicos.
description_it: La corazza ossea di uno Shogun Ceanataur. Tipica per forma e colore.
description_zh: A giant Shogun Ceanataur Shell. Has a distinctive color and shape.

name: Ceanataur Carapace
description: Harder than a Ceanataur Shell, this carapace is harder to work with.
description_de: Härter als ein Ceanataur- Panzer... und schwerer zu bearbeiten.
description_fr: Très résistante et difficile à travailler.
description_es: Más dura que un caparazón de Ceanataur, aunque también más difícil de trabajar.
description_it: Più duro della corazza di uno Shogun Ceanataur, è molto difficile da lavorare.
description_zh: Harder than a Ceanataur Shell, this carapace is harder to work with.

name: Ceanataur Cortex
description: Thicker than normal Ceanataur bone, this high quality material demands a master craftsman.
description_de: Deutlich dicker als gewöhnliche Ceanataur-Panzer. Nur Meister können ihn verarbeiten.
description_fr: Os très épais qui demande une grande habileté pour pouvoir être travaillé.
description_es: Más dura que un hueso de Ceanataur. Solo los mejores artesanos pueden trabajarla.
description_it: Osso di Ceanataur più spesso del normale, lavorato solo dai forgiatori più esperti.
description_zh: Thicker than normal Ceanataur bone, this high quality material demands a master craftsman.

name: Ceanataur Leg
description: A Shogun Ceanataur leg. Incredibly strong to support the beast's massive body.
description_de: Bein des Shogun Ceanataur. Sehr stark, weil es einen Riesenkörper tragen muss.
description_fr: Assez puissante pour déplacer un corps massif.
description_es: Pata de Shogun Ceanataur. Lo bastante fuerte como para soportar un cuerpo gigantesco.
description_it: Zampa di Shogun Ceanataur. Necessariamente forte per muovere il suo enorme corpo.
description_zh: A Shogun Ceanataur leg. Incredibly strong to support the beast's massive body.

name: Ceanataur Leg+
description: A giant Shogun Ceanataur leg. Extremely strong to support the beast's massive body.
description_de: Riesiges Shogun-Ceanataur- Bein. Extrem stark, da diese Bestien enormes Gewicht haben.
description_fr: Extrêmement puissante, elle est capable de déplacer un corps massif.
description_es: Pata de Shogun Ceanataur gigante. Tan fuerte como para soportar su cuerpo colosal.
description_it: Grossa zampa di Shogun Ceanataur, molto possente per supportarne l'enorme corpo.
description_zh: A giant Shogun Ceanataur leg. Extremely strong to support the beast's massive body.

name: Heavy Ceanataur Leg
description: An extremely thick Shogun Ceanataur leg. The shape is perfect for making weapons.
description_de: Extrem dickes Shogun-Ceanataur- Bein. Extrem stark, da diese Bestien enormes Gewicht haben.
description_fr: Jambe très épaisse de Ceanataur Shogun. Sa forme est idéale pour confectionner des armes.
description_es: La gruesa pata de un gran Shogun Ceanataur. La forma es perfecta para forjar armas.
description_it: Gamba di Shogun Ceanataur molto spessa, dalla forma perfetta per farne delle armi.
description_zh: An extremely thick Shogun Ceanataur leg. The shape is perfect for making weapons.

name: Ceanataur Claw
description: A giant Shogun Ceanataur claw. Those who fall in its path pay a dear price.
description_de: Riesige Shogun-Ceanataur- Klaue. Wer ihr in den Weg gerät, muss dafür büßen.
description_fr: Griffe de Ceanataur Shogun. Barrez-lui la route et payez-en le prix.
description_es: Una enorme garra de Shogun Ceanataur. Quienes se crucen en su camino pagarán por ello.
description_it: Enorme artiglio di Shogun Ceanataur. Chi passa sulla sua strada paga lo scotto.
description_zh: A giant Shogun Ceanataur claw. Those who fall in its path pay a dear price.

name: Ceanataur Claw+
description: The sharp claw of a giant Shogun Ceanataur. It's a true menace to hunters.
description_de: Die scharfe Klaue eines Shogun Ceanataur. Eine echte Bedrohung für Jäger.
description_fr: Griffe énorme et pointue. Une menace pour tout chasseur.
description_es: Garra afilada de un gran Shogun Ceanataur. Una amenaza real para cualquier cazador.
description_it: L'affilato artiglio di uno Shogun Ceanataur. Vera minaccia per i cacciatori.
description_zh: The sharp claw of a giant Shogun Ceanataur. It's a true menace to hunters.

name: Ceanataur Hardclaw
description: A top quality claw from a giant Shogun Ceanataur. Reserved for use in the finest equipment.
description_de: Hochwertige Klaue eines Shogun Ceanataur. Dient als Material für erlesene Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Griffe de qualité supérieure de Ceanataur Shogun réservée à la confection de matériel de pointe.
description_es: Garra de calidad de un gran Shogun Ceanataur. Se reserva para crear el mejor equipo.
description_it: Artiglio di altissima qualità di un Ceanataur gigante, da usare solo nei migliori equipaggiamenti.
description_zh: A top quality claw from a giant Shogun Ceanataur. Reserved for use in the finest equipment.

name: Hyper Ceanataur Shell
description: Darker than normal Ceanataur shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Ceanataur- Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la carapace de Ceanataur normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que un caparazón de Ceanataur normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Ceanataur, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Ceanataur shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Ceanataur Crtx
description: Darker than normal Ceanataur shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als ein norma- ler Ceanataur-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace de Ceanataur normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Ceanataur normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Ceanataur, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Ceanataur shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Heavy Rustrazor Scalp
description: A thick and durable skull bone from inside a Rustrazor Ceanataur.
description_de: Ein kräftiger Schädelpanzer eines Rostklauen-Ceanataur.
description_fr: Os crânien solide et épais extrait d'un Ceanataur Brise-os.
description_es: Un hueso grueso y resistente del interior del cráneo de un Ceanataur Férreo.
description_it: Osso di teschio preso da un Acutus Ceanataur, molto resistente e spesso.
description_zh: A thick and durable skull bone from inside a Rustrazor Ceanataur.

name: Rustrazor Cortex
description: A thick and durable Rustrazor Ceanataur carapace used only by the finest craftsmen.
description_de: Dicker, harter Panzer eines Rost- klauen-Ceanataur. Nur die besten Handwerker kommen damit klar.
description_fr: Carapace solide et épaisse de Ceanataur Brise-os. Seuls les meilleurs peuvent la travailler.
description_es: Caparazón de Ceanataur Férreo. Tan duro que solo los mejores artesanos lo pueden trabajar.
description_it: Carapace spesso e resistente di Acutus Ceanataur, usato dai migliori artigiani.
description_zh: A thick and durable Rustrazor Ceanataur carapace used only by the finest craftsmen.

name: Rustrazor Hardclaw
description: A hard Rustrazor Ceanataur claw that possesses unrivaled beauty and toughness.
description_de: Riesige Rostklaue, die nicht nur schön anzusehen ist, sondern auch erstklassige Ausrüstung ergibt.
description_fr: Griffe de Ceanataur Brise-os à la beauté et à la solidité incomparables.
description_es: Garra dura de Ceanataur Férreo que posee una belleza y una dureza sin igual.
description_it: Duro artiglio di Acutus Ceanataur, dalla bellezza e coriaceità incomparabili.
description_zh: A hard Rustrazor Ceanataur claw that possesses unrivaled beauty and toughness.

name: Nerscylla Carapace
description: A white shell popular with women and treated as a top- class material.
description_de: Weißer Panzer, sehr beliebt bei Frauen. Wird gehandelt als Spitzenmaterial.
description_fr: Carapace blanche prisée des femmes. Traitée comme un produit haut de gamme.
description_es: Coraza blanca muy popular entre las mujeres. Un material de primera clase.
description_it: Guscio bianco molto in voga tra le donne. È ritenuto un materiale di prima qualità.
description_zh: A white shell popular with women and treated as a top- class material.

name: Nerscylla Cortex
description: Thick, opalescent plating with nary a scratch. Trades at an extremely high price.
description_de: Dicke, opaleszierende Panzerung ohne Makel. Sie ist sehr teuer.
description_fr: Plaque vermillon épaisse intacte. Peut être revendue pour un très bon prix.
description_es: Coraza opalescente sin apenas arañazos. Se vende por un precio muy elevado.
description_it: Corazza vermiglia robusta e priva di graffi. Può essere venduta per somme ingenti.
description_zh: Thick, opalescent plating with nary a scratch. Trades at an extremely high price.

name: Nerscylla Shear
description: A venomous fang that expands and contracts at will. Beware its lethal poison!
description_de: Giftiger Kiefer. Öffnet und schließt sich nach Belieben. Vorsicht vor seinem Gift!
description_fr: Croc venimeux qui se dilate et se contracte à volonté. À manier avec précaution !
description_es: Colmillo letal que se dilata y contrae a voluntad. ¡Debe usarse con cuidado!
description_it: Zanna venefica che emerge e si ritrae a piacimento. Attenzione al veleno letale!
description_zh: A venomous fang that expands and contracts at will. Beware its lethal poison!

name: Nerscylla Scishorn
description: Stretching, poison-laden fangs found in a Nerscylla's mouth. Perfect for weapons.
description_de: Lange, giftige Reißzähne vom Nerscylla-Maul. Perfekt für Waffen.
description_fr: Crocs toxiques venant de la gueule d'une Nerscylla. Idéaux pour les armes.
description_es: Colmillos cargados de veneno. Son las armas perfectas.
description_it: Lunghe zanne velenose poste nelle fauci del Nerscylla, perfette per forgiare armi.
description_zh: Stretching, poison-laden fangs found in a Nerscylla's mouth. Perfect for weapons.

name: Nerscylla Sharpclaw
description: One of the Nerscylla's sharp claws. Prey attacked by this never survives.
description_de: Scharfe Nerscylla-Klaue. Wer damit hinterrücks attackiert wird, überlebt niemals.
description_fr: Les proies attaquées par surprise par cette griffe acérée ne survivent jamais.
description_es: Garra afilada de Nerscylla. Ataca desde las sombras y jamás deja supervivientes.
description_it: Affilatissimo artiglio di Nerscylla. Le prede colte di sorpresa non hanno scampo.
description_zh: One of the Nerscylla's sharp claws. Prey attacked by this never survives.

name: Nerscylla Hardclaw
description: An impressive specimen used once its web-weaving owner has danced prey in circles.
description_de: Der Netze webende Besitzer verwendet sie sobald er Beu- te in Kreisen umtanzt hat.
description_fr: Spécimen étonnant utilisé par son propriétaire après avoir acculé sa proie.
description_es: Una garra interesante que su propietario usa tras rodear a su presa.
description_it: Esemplare notevole, utilizzato dal suo proprietario aracnide per finire le prede.
description_zh: An impressive specimen used once its web-weaving owner has danced prey in circles.

name: Nerscylla Spike+
description: A dorsal spike that is prized for its lethal poison sac more than its sharpness.
description_de: Rückendorn mit Giftbeutel, dessen Gift tödlicher ist, als der scharfe Dorn selbst.
description_fr: Pointe dorsale prisée pour sa poche à venin mortel plus que pour son tranchant.
description_es: Púa dorsal más reputada por su saco de veneno letal que por su extremo afilado.
description_it: Aculeo dorsale apprezzato per la sacca di veleno più che per la punta acuminata.
description_zh: A dorsal spike that is prized for its lethal poison sac more than its sharpness.

name: Nerscylla Surspike
description: Spikes from the back whose concentrated poison requires very careful handling.
description_de: Rückenstachel. Sein kon- zentriertes Gift muss vor- sichtig gehandhabt werden.
description_fr: Pointes dorsales dont le poison concentré nécessite une grande prudence.
description_es: Espinas del lomo cuyo veneno concentrado dificulta la manipulación.
description_it: Aculei dorsali da maneggiare con cura a causa del veleno concentrato al loro interno.
description_zh: Spikes from the back whose concentrated poison requires very careful handling.

name: Hyper Nerscylla Cortex
description: Darker than normal Nerscylla shell, this tough Hyper Shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als andere Nerscylla-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace de Nerscylla normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que el caparazón de Nerscylla normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Nerscylla, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Nerscylla shell, this tough Hyper Shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Seltas Carapace
description: A hard piece of exoskeleton whose smooth surface reduces air resistance while flying.
description_de: Harter Teil des Exoskeletts. Die Oberfläche reduziert den Luftwiderstand beim Fliegen.
description_fr: Partie d'exosquelette dure dont la surface augmente l'aérodynamisme lors du vol.
description_es: Trozo duro de exoesqueleto que no ofrece resistencia al aire por su superficie lisa.
description_it: Esoscheletro rigido. La superficie liscia riduce l'attrito in volo.
description_zh: A hard piece of exoskeleton whose smooth surface reduces air resistance while flying.

name: Seltas Cortex
description: A thick but shockingly light piece of exoskeleton made of shock-resistant layers.
description_de: Dickes, erstaunlich leichtes Stück Außenskelett aus stoßresistenten Schichten.
description_fr: Pièce d'exosquelette aussi épaisse que légère, et résistante aux chocs.
description_es: Un pedazo de exoesqueleto sorprendentemente ligero y que resiste la electricidad.
description_it: Un esoscheletro massiccio ma incredibilmente leggero composto da strati antiurto.
description_zh: A thick but shockingly light piece of exoskeleton made of shock-resistant layers.

name: Seltas Innerwing
description: A vital organ for the flying Seltas. In high demand as a household material.
description_de: Wichtiges Organ fliegender Seltas. Sehr begehrt als Haushaltsmaterial.
description_fr: Organe vital pour le Seltas volant. Très prisé comme produit domestique.
description_es: Órgano vital del Seltas volador. Muy demandado como material doméstico.
description_it: Organo vitale per i Seltas volanti. Richiestissima come prodotto per la casa.
description_zh: A vital organ for the flying Seltas. In high demand as a household material.

name: Seltas Razorwing
description: Fluid-filled wings that beat at high speeds to grant the Seltas flight.
description_de: Mit Flüssigkeit gefüllt. Sie schlagen sehr schnell, um den Seltas fliegen zu lassen.
description_fr: Ailes gorgées de fluides battant à grande vitesse pour supporter le Seltas.
description_es: Órgano vital del Seltas volador. Muy demandado como material doméstico.
description_it: Ali percorse da vasi linfatici che tengono in volo il Seltas con movimenti rapidi.
description_zh: Fluid-filled wings that beat at high speeds to grant the Seltas flight.

name: Seltas Horn+
description: A sharp horn popular with artisans because, frankly, it's pretty deadly as is.
description_de: Scharf und sehr beliebt bei Handwerkern, da es bereits unverarbeitet tödlich ist.
description_fr: Corne acérée très prisée car même non traitée, elle fait pas mal de ravages.
description_es: Cuerno afilado muy popular entre los artesanos solo por su pasmosa belleza.
description_it: Un corno appuntito. È amato dagli artigiani perché... è già letale così com'è!
description_zh: A sharp horn popular with artisans because, frankly, it's pretty deadly as is.

name: Seltas Hardhorn
description: A vicious horn that the Seltas sharpens on boulders as if whetting a blade.
description_de: Ein bösartiges Horn. Seltas schärfen es wie eine Klinge an Felsen.
description_fr: Corne victorieuse que le Seltas aiguise contre les rochers telle une lame.
description_es: Un cuerno feroz afilado contra las rocas como si se tratase de una espada.
description_it: Un corno appuntito. È amato dagli artigiani perché... è già letale così com'è!
description_zh: A vicious horn that the Seltas sharpens on boulders as if whetting a blade.

name: S.Queen Carapace
description: A hard piece of exoskeleton that once made a Seltas Queen a veritable fortress.
description_de: Harter Teil des Exoskeletts. Machte einst eine Seltas- Königin zur wahren Festung.
description_fr: Partie d'exosquelette dure qui faisait de la Reine Seltas une vraie forteresse.
description_es: Trozo duro de exoesqueleto, antaño de una vigorosa Seltas Reina.
description_it: L'esoscheletro rigido di una Seltas regina. Più che un mostro, una fortezza!
description_zh: A hard piece of exoskeleton that once made a Seltas Queen a veritable fortress.

name: S.Queen Cortex
description: An especially thick, iridescent carapace used in impressive Decorations.
description_de: Schimmernder, besonders dicker Panzer für ein- drucksvolle Dekorationen.
description_fr: Cuirasse irisée très épaisse utilisée pour fabriquer de formidables décorations.
description_es: Un caparazón duro e irisado que se utiliza en adornos impactantes.
description_it: Solido carapace dalle tinte iridescenti da cui si ricavano fantastiche decorazioni.
description_zh: An especially thick, iridescent carapace used in impressive Decorations.

name: S.Queen Hardpectus
description: A hard shell from the chest. Its non-slip surface exists so males can mount easily.
description_de: Harter Panzer von der Brust. Rutschfeste Oberfläche hilft Männchen beim Besteigen.
description_fr: Carapace dure. Sa surface antidérapante permet aux mâles de monter facilement.
description_es: Fragmento del enorme tórax. De superficie antideslizante para fácil acceso a los machos.
description_it: Dura corazza del torace. La superficie ruvida favorisce l'approccio dei maschi.
description_zh: A hard shell from the chest. Its non-slip surface exists so males can mount easily.

name: S.Queen Pectus+
description: Especially thick chest plating. Nearby gas holes have given it an odd aroma.
description_de: Besonders dicke Brustplatten. Nahe Gasmulden haben ihnen ein seltsames Aroma gegeben.
description_fr: Plaque de poitrail épaisse. Les gaz ambiants lui ont donné un étrange parfum.
description_es: Placa pectoral muy dura. Los agujeros para el gas tienen un olor raro.
description_it: Corazza pettorale di notevole spessore. Il suo strano odore è dovuto a esalazioni gassose.
description_zh: Especially thick chest plating. Nearby gas holes have given it an odd aroma.

name: S.Queen Sharpclaw
description: A claw with a non-slip coating. Used mostly for movement and tunneling.
description_de: Eine Klaue mit rutschfester Beschichtung. Meist zum Bewegen und Graben genutzt.
description_fr: Griffe antidérapante. Utilisée surtout pour se déplacer et creuser.
description_es: Garra con revestimiento antideslizante que permite desplazarse y hacer túneles.
description_it: Artiglio con rivestimento ruvido. Usato principalmente per scavare e muoversi.
description_zh: A claw with a non-slip coating. Used mostly for movement and tunneling.

name: S.Queen Hardclaw
description: A beefy Seltas Queen claw. Dull, but its high durability suits it for equipment.
description_de: Kräftige Seltas-Königin- Klaue. Stumpf, aber haltbar. Gut für Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Griffe compacte et émoussée, mais d'une résistance idéale pour l'artisanat.
description_es: Garra de una Seltas Reina. Roma, pero muy duradera, por lo que es ideal para equipo.
description_it: Artiglio smussato di Seltas regina da cui si ricavano equipaggiamenti resistenti.
description_zh: A beefy Seltas Queen claw. Dull, but its high durability suits it for equipment.

name: S.Queen Jaw
description: A shell that serves as the Seltas Queen's jaw. Used to expel potent breath.
description_de: Ein Panzer, der der Seltas- Königin als Kiefer dient. Stößt mächtigen Atem aus.
description_fr: Carapace servant de mâchoire à la Reine Seltas. Permet de cracher un feu puissant.
description_es: Era la mandíbula de una Seltas Reina. Se usa para expeler un potente aliento.
description_it: Mascella corazzata della Seltas regina. Può espellere potenti getti d'aria.
description_zh: A shell that serves as the Seltas Queen's jaw. Used to expel potent breath.

name: S.Queen Maw
description: A large jaw that opens laterally to chew through meals with ease.
description_de: Großer Kiefer. Öffnet sich seitlich, um das Mahl leicht zu fressen.
description_fr: Grande mâchoire à ouverture latérale pour tout dévorer facilement.
description_es: Una gran mandíbula cuyos laterales se abren al masticar.
description_it: Enorme mandibola che si apre anche sui lati per facilitare il consumo delle prede.
description_zh: A large jaw that opens laterally to chew through meals with ease.

name: S.Queen Crescent
description: Moon-shaped shears that double as a tail. Used for defense when foes approach.
description_de: Schwanz in Form einer mond- förmigen Schere als Waffe gegen anrückende Feinde.
description_fr: Lame en forme de lune attachée à la queue. Protège des attaques.
description_es: Cizallas en forma de luna que sirven también como cola para defenderse del enemigo.
description_it: Cesoia a mezzaluna che si sdoppia sulla coda. Serve a difendersi dai nemici.
description_zh: Moon-shaped shears that double as a tail. Used for defense when foes approach.

name: S.Queen Moonlash
description: Large shears from the tip of the tail. Inspires servitude from Seltas, fear in humans.
description_de: Große Schere von der Schwanzspitze. Sorgt für Unterwürfigkeit und Angst.
description_fr: Grandes cisailles d'une pointe de queue. Inspire la peur chez les humains.
description_es: Las hojas de la punta inspiran servidumbre a los machos y miedo a los humanos.
description_it: Cesoie che sormontano la coda. Incutono rispetto nei Seltas e timore negli umani.
