description_zh: Large shears from the tip of the tail. Inspires servitude from Seltas, fear in humans.

name: S.Queen Extract
description: A fluid that circulates through the body. Acidifies when it touches the air.
description_de: Diese Flüssigkeit zirkuliert im Körper. Bei Berührung mit Luft wird sie zu Säure.
description_fr: Fluide circulant à travers le corps. Devient acide au contact de l'air.
description_es: Fluido que recorre el cuerpo de la reina. Vuelve ácido el aire con el que entra en contacto.
description_it: Fluido che circola nel corpo del mostro. Diviene acido al contatto con l'aria.
description_zh: A fluid that circulates through the body. Acidifies when it touches the air.

name: D.S.QueenConcentrate
description: An abnormally secreted substance acclaimed for its use in Neopteron forging.
description_de: Anormales Sekret. Berühmt für seinen Einsatz beim Neopteron-Schmieden.
description_fr: Substance anormalement sécrétée et prisée pour le travail à base de Neopteron.
description_es: Una sustancia anormal útil en la forja de partes de neopterones.
description_it: Sostanza secreta in abbondanza che viene impiegata nella lavorazione del Neopteron.
description_zh: An abnormally secreted substance acclaimed for its use in Neopteron forging.

name: Hyper S.Queen Shell
description: Darker than normal S.Queen shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als die normalen Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la carapace de Reine Seltas normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que un caparazón de Seltas Reina normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Seltas regina, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal S.Queen shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper S.Queen Cortex
description: Darker than normal Seltas Queen shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als die normalen Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une cara- pace de Reine Seltas normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Seltas Reina, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Seltas regina, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Seltas Queen shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Barroth Carapace
description: A Barroth's carapace coated in multiple layers of mud, making it quite rigid.
description_de: Ein Barroth-Rückenpanzer, gehärtet durch zahlreiche Schlammschichten.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Barroth recouverte de boue la rendant assez rigide.
description_es: Caparazón de Barroth con múltiples capas de barro que le dan rigidez.
description_it: Carapace di un Barroth, irrigidito da diversi strati di fango.
description_zh: A Barroth's carapace coated in multiple layers of mud, making it quite rigid.

name: Barroth Cortex
description: A Barroth's cortex. Years' worth of mud have hardened it beyond all measure.
description_de: Ein Barroth-Kortex. Viele schlammige Jahre haben ihn unglaublich gehärtet.
description_fr: Cortex de Barroth recouvert de boue depuis si longtemps qu'il est très dur.
description_es: Placa de Barroth. El barro la ha endurecido de forma increíble.
description_it: Corteccia di un Barroth, indurita all'estremo da anni di fango.
description_zh: A Barroth's cortex. Years' worth of mud have hardened it beyond all measure.

name: Barroth Ridge+
description: A thick, sturdy part of a Barroth backplate. Mud and sunlight have helped to harden it further.
description_de: Dicker, stabiler Teil einer Barroth-Rückenplatte. Durch Sonne und Schlamm gehärtet.
description_fr: Bout épais provenant de la plaque arrière. Durci par la boue et le soleil.
description_es: Parte gruesa y robusta del lomo de un Barroth. Curtida por el barro y el sol.
description_it: Parte spessa e resistente della piastra dorsale di un Barroth, indurita da fango e sole.
description_zh: A thick, sturdy part of a Barroth backplate. Mud and sunlight have helped to harden it further.

name: Barroth Chine
description: The thickest part of a Barroth's backplate. Mud, sun, and age have made it rock-hard.
description_de: Dickster Teil einer Barroth- Rückenplatte. Durch Sonne, Schlamm und Alter steinhart.
description_fr: Partie la plus épaisse de la plaque arrière. Durcie par la boue et le temps.
description_es: Parte más fina del lomo del Barroth. Dura por el barro, el sol y el paso del tiempo.
description_it: Parte più spessa della piastra dorsale di un Barroth, indurita da età, fango e sole.
description_zh: The thickest part of a Barroth's backplate. Mud, sun, and age have made it rock-hard.

name: Barroth Claw+
description: A polished claw sharpened by sand and dirt. It can dig through even the toughest earth.
description_de: Polierte Klaue, von Sand und Schmutz geschärft. Gräbt sich in den härtesten Boden.
description_fr: Griffe polie aiguisée par le sable. Peut pénétrer dans les sols les plus durs.
description_es: Garra afilada por la arena y mugre. Se clava incluso en la tierra más dura.
description_it: Artiglio lucido, affilato da sabbia e terra. Affonda nei terreni più duri.
description_zh: A polished claw sharpened by sand and dirt. It can dig through even the toughest earth.

name: Barroth Talon
description: A strong claw found on only the most formidable of Barroth. It can easily dig through solid rock.
description_de: Starke Klaue des stärksten Barroth. Durchdringt ohne Probleme jeden Felsen.
description_fr: Griffe solide distinctive des plus beaux Barroth. Pénètre facilement les sols.
description_es: Fuerte garra del Barroth más imponente. Perfora roca sólida sin dificultad.
description_it: Artiglio possente dei Barroth più temibili. Scava facilmente anche la dura roccia.
description_zh: A strong claw found on only the most formidable of Barroth. It can easily dig through solid rock.

name: Barroth Scalp
description: This durable part of a Barroth's skull is also the hardest to remove.
description_de: Dieser haltbare Teil des Barroth-Schädels ist auch am schwierigsten zu entfernen.
description_fr: Cette partie solide du crâne est aussi la plus dure à enlever.
description_es: El cuero cabelludo es la parte más resistente del cráneo y difícil de quitar.
description_it: Questa parte del cranio è la più resistente ma anche la più difficile da rimuovere.
description_zh: This durable part of a Barroth's skull is also the hardest to remove.

name: Barroth Crown
description: The heavy scalp of a formidable Barroth. As hard to remove as it is durable.
description_de: Schwerer Skalp eines furcht- baren Barroth. Schwer zu entfernen und sehr robust.
description_fr: Scalp lourd d'un fantastique Barroth. Aussi solide qu'il est dur à enlever.
description_es: Cuero de un temible Barroth. Tan difícil de quitar como duradero.
description_it: Calotta di un temibile Barroth. Difficile da rimuovere ma resistente.
description_zh: The heavy scalp of a formidable Barroth. As hard to remove as it is durable.

name: Barroth Tail
description: Barroth tails aren't very valuable, but the meat is hailed as a delicacy.
description_de: Nicht besonders wertvoll, aber das Fleisch gilt als Delikatesse.
description_fr: Sans grande valeur, mais dont la viande est un mets raffiné.
description_es: Estas colas no son muy valiosas, pero la carne es exquisita.
description_it: Non ha un grande valore, ma la carne è considerata una vera ghiottoneria.
description_zh: Barroth tails aren't very valuable, but the meat is hailed as a delicacy.

name: Barroth Lash
description: A rigid tail carved from a select few Barroth. Inexpensive, but surprisingly versatile.
description_de: Harter Schwanz ausgewählter Barrothe. Preiswert, aber erstaunlich vielseitig.
description_fr: Queue rigide taillée dans les Barroth. Peu coûteuse, mais polyvalente.
description_es: Cola rígida de excelentes especímenes de Barroth. Barata, pero muy versátil.
description_it: Coda rigida posseduta da alcuni Barroth; economica ma sorprendentemente versatile.
description_zh: A rigid tail carved from a select few Barroth. Inexpensive, but surprisingly versatile.

name: Fertile Mud
description: Mud that Barroth roll around in. Nutrient-rich and great for farming.
description_de: Schlamm, in dem Barrothe herumrollen. Nährstoffreich, gut für die Landwirtschaft.
description_fr: Les Barroth se roulent dedans. Riche en nutriments et top pour l'agriculture.
description_es: Barro en el que se revuelcan los Barroth. Rico en nutrientes y para cultivar.
description_it: Fango in cui si rotolano i Barroth. Ricco di nutrienti e ottimo per coltivare.
description_zh: Mud that Barroth roll around in. Nutrient-rich and great for farming.

name: Hyper Barroth Cortex
description: Darker than normal Barroth shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als nomale Barroth-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace de Barroth normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Barroth normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Barroth, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Barroth shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Uragaan Scale
description: A hardened scale composed of ore that gives off a faint glow when exposed to light.
description_de: Gehärtete Schuppe aus Erz. Leuchtet schwach, wenn sie Licht ausgesetzt wird.
description_fr: Écaille durcie constituée d'un minerai qui lui donne un peu d'éclat en pleine lumière.
description_es: Escama endurecida dotada de mineral que emite un brillo tenue al exponerla a la luz.
description_it: Scaglia indurita composta da un minerale che emette un tenue bagliore sotto la luce.
description_zh: A hardened scale composed of ore that gives off a faint glow when exposed to light.

name: Uragaan Scale+
description: A strong scale formed by layers and layers of ore. Its hardness makes forging tricky.
description_de: Eine Starke Schuppe aus vielen Erzschichten. Sie ist sehr hart und schwer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Écaille solide constituée de plusieurs couches de minerai la rendant dure à forger.
description_es: Fuerte escama formada por capas de mineral. Su dureza la hace difícil de forjar.
description_it: Scaglia resistente formata da strati di minerali e difficile da forgiare.
description_zh: A strong scale formed by layers and layers of ore. Its hardness makes forging tricky.

name: Uragaan Shard
description: An impenetrable scale found on certain Uragaan. Formed when layers of hard ore bonded.
description_de: Undurchdringliche Uragaan- Schuppe. Aus Erzschichten, die sich verbunden haben.
description_fr: Écaille impénétrable. Résultat de l'accumulation de couches de minerai.
description_es: Escama irrompible de ciertos Uragaan. Creada por la unión de capas de duro mineral.
description_it: Scaglia impenetrabile di strati di minerali posseduta da alcuni Uragaan.
description_zh: An impenetrable scale found on certain Uragaan. Formed when layers of hard ore bonded.

name: Uragaan Shell
description: This strong, sturdy piece of exoskeleton makes armor that looks dull but works great.
description_de: Dieses robuste Außenskelett ergibt Rüstungen, die blöd aussehen, aber gut sind.
description_fr: Exosquelette résistant qui ressemble à une armure émoussée.
description_es: Trozo de exoesqueleto fuerte para hacer armaduras poco bonitas, pero muy buenas.
description_it: Questo robusto esoscheletro diventa un'armatura poco vistosa, ma molto efficace.
description_zh: This strong, sturdy piece of exoskeleton makes armor that looks dull but works great.

name: Uragaan Carapace
description: A hard Uragaan carapace. Its rigidity makes it quite a challenge to remove.
description_de: Harter Uragaan-Rückenpanzer. Seine Starrheit macht ihn schwer zu entfernen.
description_fr: Cuirasse dure d'Uragaan. Tellement rigide qu'il est difficile de l'enlever.
description_es: Coraza dura de Uragaan. Su rigidez la hace difícil de arrancar.
description_it: Robusto carapace di Uragaan, rigido e difficile da rimuovere.
description_zh: A hard Uragaan carapace. Its rigidity makes it quite a challenge to remove.

name: Uragaan Cortex
description: An especially hard Uragaan cortex. Crafting with it can be a trying task, to say the least.
description_de: Besonders harter Uragaan- Kortex. Die Verarbeitung ist alles, nur nicht leicht.
description_fr: Cortex particulièrement dur. Difficile de fabriquer quoi que ce soit avec.
description_es: Placa muy dura de Uragaan. Es un material muy difícil de trabajar, como poco.
description_it: Corteccia di Uragaan particolarmente dura. Lavorarla può essere davvero difficile.
description_zh: An especially hard Uragaan cortex. Crafting with it can be a trying task, to say the least.

name: Uragaan Jaw
description: A crooked Uragaan jaw. Coated with melted minerals that have hardened over time.
description_de: Gebogener Uragaan-Kiefer. Von einst geschmolzenen und jetzt gehärteten Mineralien bedeckt.
description_fr: Mâchoire courbée d'Uragaan. Endurcie par l'application d'un enduit de minerais fondus.
description_es: Mandíbula torcida de Uragaan. Recubierta con mineral fundido que se ha dejado endurecer.
description_it: Mandibola curva di Uragaan. È stata temprata con una colata di minerali fusi.
description_zh: A crooked Uragaan jaw. Coated with melted minerals that have hardened over time.

name: Uragaan Jaw+
description: An exceptionally heavy Uragaan jaw. Its destructive power comes from a makeup of dense ore.
description_de: Extrem schwerer Uragaan- Kiefer. Erz macht ihn zu einer zerstörerischen Waffe.
description_fr: Mâchoire très lourde et puissante constituée d'un minerai dense.
description_es: Mandíbula superdura de Uragaan. Su fuerza yace en su composición de mineral.
description_it: Mascella di Uragaan dalla composizione minerale; è incredibilmente pesante.
description_zh: An exceptionally heavy Uragaan jaw. Its destructive power comes from a makeup of dense ore.

name: Uragaan Scute
description: Even more heat resistant than the Shell, this is said to protect sensitive organs.
description_de: Noch hitzebeständiger als der restliche Panzer. Schützt empfindliche Organe.
description_fr: Résiste plus à la chaleur que la carapace. Censé protéger les organes sensibles.
description_es: Aún más resistente al calor que el caparazón. Protege los órganos más delicados.
description_it: Resiste al calore più della corazza Uragaan. Pare che protegga gli organi vitali.
description_zh: Even more heat resistant than the Shell, this is said to protect sensitive organs.

name: Uragaan Scute+
description: A highly heat-resistant Uragaan scute. Its thermal insulation promises new armor possibilities.
description_de: Dieser hitzebeständige Uragaan-Schild verspricht neue Rüstungsmöglichkeiten.
description_fr: Très résistant à la chaleur. Une isolation thermique qui peut servir pour une armure.
description_es: Placa resistente al calor de Uragaan. El aislante térmico es ideal para armaduras.
description_it: Placca di Uragaan resistente al calore; può essere utilizzata per nuovi tipi di armature.
description_zh: A highly heat-resistant Uragaan scute. Its thermal insulation promises new armor possibilities.

name: Uragaan Marrow
description: Hard-to-obtain bone marrow used for special crafts as well as medicinal purposes.
description_de: Schwer zu bekommendes Knochenmark für spezielle Arbeiten und Arzneien.
description_fr: Dure à obtenir. Sert à créer des choses particulières et à des fins médicales.
description_es: Médula espinal difícil de obtener. Se usa en artesanía especial y medicina.
description_it: Midollo osseo difficile da trovare, usato in medicina e per lavorazioni speciali.
description_zh: Hard-to-obtain bone marrow used for special crafts as well as medicinal purposes.

name: Uragaan Ruby
description: A precious Uragaan gem. Prized for its strengthening ability during the forging process.
description_de: Kostbarer Uragaan-Edelstein. Geschätzt aufgrund der Stärkung beim Schmiedeprozess.
description_fr: Gemme précieuse d'Uragaan. Propriétés raffermissantes appréciées pendant le forgeage.
description_es: Piedra preciosa de Uragaan. Apreciada por su capacidad de endurecimiento en el forjado.
description_it: Preziosa gemma di Uragaan. Rinforza i materiali se usata nel processo di forgiatura.
description_zh: A precious Uragaan gem. Prized for its strengthening ability during the forging process.

name: Uragaan Pallium
description: A legendary Uragaan shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendärer Uragaan-Panzer. Wer ihn verarbeitet, soll der Herrscher der Welt sein.
description_fr: Une carapace légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Caparazón legendario de Uragaan. Los que lo usan rigen la tierra y el cielo.
description_it: Leggendaria corazza di Uragaan. Si dice che chi la lavora possa conquistare cielo e terra.
description_zh: A legendary Uragaan shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Uragaan Scale
description: Darker than normal Uragaan scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Uragaan- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille d'Uragaan normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Uragaan normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Uragaan, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Uragaan scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Uragaan Shard
description: Darker than normal Uragaan scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Uragaan-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille d'Uragaan normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Uragaan normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Uragaan, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Uragaan scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Crystalbeard Scale
description: A Crystalbeard Uragaan scale. Contains unique ores that make it shine bright.
description_de: Eine Kristallbart-Uragaan- Schuppe mit besonderen Erzen, die sie hell leuchten lassen.
description_fr: Écaille d'Uragaan Roi-cristal. Renferme des minerais uniques qui la font briller.
description_es: Escama de Uragaan Vítreo. Contiene minerales únicos que la hacen relucir.
description_it: Scaglia di Adamas Uragaan. Contiene minerali rari che la rendono splendente.
description_zh: A Crystalbeard Uragaan scale. Contains unique ores that make it shine bright.

name: Crystalbeard Scale+
description: A high-quality Crystalbeard Uragaan scale. Contains unique ores that make it shine bright.
description_de: Hochwertige Kristallbart- Schuppe. Mit besonderen Erzen, die sie hell leuchten lassen.
description_fr: Écaille d'Uragaan Roi-cristal. Avec des minerais uniques qui la font briller. Grande qualité.
description_es: Escama de Uragaan Vítreo de calidad. Contiene minerales únicos que la hacen relucir.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata di Adamas Uragaan. Contiene minerali che la rendono splendente.
description_zh: A high-quality Crystalbeard Uragaan scale. Contains unique ores that make it shine bright.

name: Crystalbeard Shard
description: An exquisite Crystalbeard Uragaan scale. Has exceptional shock-absorbing ability.
description_de: Erlesene Kristallbart-Schuppe, die Stöße außergewöhnlich gut abfedert.
description_fr: Magnifique écaille d'Uragaan Roi-cristal dotée d'une résistance aux chocs incomparable.
description_es: Escama de Uragaan Vítreo de gran calidad y con mucha resistencia a golpes.
description_it: Frammento meraviglioso di Adamas, con ottime abilità antiurto.
description_zh: An exquisite Crystalbeard Uragaan scale. Has exceptional shock-absorbing ability.

name: Crystalbeard Jaw
description: The jaw from a Crystalbeard Uragaan. Contains unique ores that make it shine bright.
description_de: Kiefer des Kristallbart-Uragaan. Enthält besondere Erze, die ihn hell leuchten lassen.
description_fr: Mâchoire d'Uragaan Roi-cristal. Renferme des minerais uniques qui la font briller.
description_es: Mandíbula de Uragaan Vítreo. Contiene minerales únicos que la hacen relucir.
description_it: Mandibola di Adamas Uragaan. Contiene minerali rari che la rendono splendente.
description_zh: The jaw from a Crystalbeard Uragaan. Contains unique ores that make it shine bright.

name: Crystalbeard Maw
description: A high-quality Crystalbeard Uragaan jaw. Contains unique ores that make it shine bright.
description_de: Hochwertiger Kristallbart- Uragaan-Rachen. Mit besonderen, leuchtenden Erzen.
description_fr: Mâchoire d'Uragaan Roi-cristal. Avec des minerais uniques qui la font briller. Grande qualité.
description_es: Mandíbula de Uragaan Vítreo de calidad. Contiene minerales únicos que la hacen relucir.
description_it: Fauci pregiate di Adamas Uragaan. Contengono minerali che le rendono splendenti.
description_zh: A high-quality Crystalbeard Uragaan jaw. Contains unique ores that make it shine bright.

name: Crystalbeard Mandible
description: An exceptional Crystalbeard Uragaan jaw. Contains so much ore that it is dazzlingly bright.
description_de: Kristallbart-Uragaan-Kiefer allererster Güte. Mit blendend leuchtenden Erzen.
description_fr: Mâchoire d'Uragaan Roi-cristal d'exception. Contient tellement de minerai qu'elle resplendit.
description_es: Mandíbula de Uragaan Vítreo excepcional. Contiene tantos minerales que reluce.
description_it: Fantastica mascella di Adamas Uragaan. Contiene tanto minerale da brillare.
description_zh: An exceptional Crystalbeard Uragaan jaw. Contains so much ore that it is dazzlingly bright.

name: Treasure Nugget
description: A stone shard taken from a Crystalbeard Uragaan. Prized for the rare minerals within it.
description_de: Ein Steinsplitter von einem Kristallbart-Uragaan. Kostbar aufgrund der Mineralien darin.
description_fr: Éclat d'Uragaan Roi-cristal. Recherché pour les minerais rares qu'il renferme.
description_es: Esquirla de roca extraída de un Uragaan Vítreo. Apreciada por los raros minerales que posee.
description_it: Frammento di pietra estratto da un Adamas Uragaan. Contiene minerali pregiati.
description_zh: A stone shard taken from a Crystalbeard Uragaan. Prized for the rare minerals within it.

name: Large Treasure Nugget
description: A large stone shard taken from a Crystalbeard Uragaan. Prized for the rare minerals within it.
description_de: Ein großer Steinsplitter von einem Kristallbart-Uragaan. Kostbar aufgrund der Mineralien darin.
description_fr: Grand éclat d'Uragaan Roi-cristal. Recherché pour les minerais rares qu'il renferme.
description_es: Gran roca extraída de un Uragaan Vítreo. Apreciada por los raros minerales que contiene.
description_it: Grosso frammento di pietra estratto da un Adamas Uragaan. Contiene minerali pregiati.
description_zh: A large stone shard taken from a Crystalbeard Uragaan. Prized for the rare minerals within it.

name: Brach Shell
description: A dark green Brachydios shell. Glossy like obsidian, it adds a refined beauty to crafted gear.
description_de: Ein dunkelgrüner Panzer, der wie Obsidian glänzt. Verleiht allem Schönheit.
description_fr: Brille comme une obsidienne. Les outils fabriqués avec sont raffinés.
description_es: Caparazón verde de Brachydios. Brilla como la obsidiana y da belleza a las armaduras.
description_it: La verde e lucida corazza di un Brachydios. Rende ogni oggetto più meraviglioso.
description_zh: A dark green Brachydios shell. Glossy like obsidian, it adds a refined beauty to crafted gear.

name: Brach Carapace
description: A hard Brachydios carapace. Glossy like obsidian, it adds a refined beauty to crafted gear.
description_de: Harter Brachydios-Rücken- panzer mit Obsidianglanz. Verleiht allem Schönheit.
description_fr: Brillante comme une obsidienne, elle ajoute de l'élégance à vos armures.
description_es: La coraza de un Brachydios. Brilla como la obsidiana y da belleza a las armaduras.
description_it: Solido carapace di Brachydios che splende come ossidiana e può essere lavorato.
description_zh: A hard Brachydios carapace. Glossy like obsidian, it adds a refined beauty to crafted gear.

name: Brach Cortex
description: Thick cortex of a Brachydios. Its stoic beauty adds strength and dignity to equipment.
description_de: Dicker Brachydios-Kortex. Seine Schönheit verleiht Ausrüstung Stärke und Würde.
description_fr: Cortex épais. Sa beauté inébranlable ajoute force et dignité à l'équipement.
description_es: Gruesa placa de Brachydios. Con su belleza da tanto fuerza como distinción.
description_it: Spessa corteccia di Brachydios; produce equipaggiamento robusto e di pregio.
description_zh: Thick cortex of a Brachydios. Its stoic beauty adds strength and dignity to equipment.

name: Brach Ebonshell
description: An obsidian Brachydios brace. Makes especially strong armor, perhaps due to the slime mold.
description_de: Obsidian-Brachydios-Schiene. Wegen des Schleims für sehr starke Rüstungen geeignet.
description_fr: Attelle en obsidienne idéale pour créer des armures puissantes.
description_es: Brazal de obsidiana de Brachydios. Crea armaduras fuertes, quizá por su moho.
description_it: Mitena nera di Brachydios; produce armature resistenti, forse grazie alla sua melma.
description_zh: An obsidian Brachydios brace. Makes especially strong armor, perhaps due to the slime mold.

name: Brach Ebonshell+
description: An obsidian shell from the foreleg. It has evolved to withstand slime blasts.
description_de: Ein Obsidianpanzer vom Vorderbein. Gewappnet gegen Schleimattacken.
description_fr: Carapace en obsidienne issue de la patte avant. A évolué pour résister aux explosions.
description_es: Caparazón de obsidiana de la pata delantera. Resiste explosiones de nitro.
description_it: Corazza di ossidiana della zampa anteriore, nata per opporsi ai getti di melma.
description_zh: An obsidian shell from the foreleg. It has evolved to withstand slime blasts.

name: Fine Brach Ebonshell
description: A premium Brachydios brace. The slime coating may contain weird bacteria, so be careful.
description_de: Premium-Brachydios-Schiene. Der Schleim könnte Bakterien enthalten, also Vorsicht.
description_fr: La poisse qui la recouvre contient peut-être des bactéries. Attention !
description_es: Brazal especial Brachydios. El revestimiento de barro presenta bacterias: cuidado.
description_it: Ottima mitena di Brachydios ricoperta di melma. Fai attenzione ai batteri!
description_zh: A premium Brachydios brace. The slime coating may contain weird bacteria, so be careful.

name: Brach Scalp
description: The large, protruding scalp of a Brachydios, covered in an explosive green substance.
description_de: Großer, vorstehender Skalp eines Brachydios. Bedeckt mit explosiver grüner Substanz.
description_fr: Gros crâne couvert d'une substance verte explosive.
description_es: Abultado cuero de Brachydios cubierto por una sustancia verdosa explosiva.
description_it: Grossa calotta sporgente di Brachydios, ricoperta di una sostanza esplosiva verde.
description_zh: The large, protruding scalp of a Brachydios, covered in an explosive green substance.

name: Brach Scalp+
description: A hard and sharp scalp piece from a fierce Brachydios. Even more explosive than usual.
description_de: Ein hartes und scharfes Brachydios-Skalpstück. Noch explosiver als üblich.
description_fr: Crâne d'un monstre féroce. Hautement explosif.
description_es: Cuero duro y afilado de un feroz Brachydios. Más explosivo de lo normal.
description_it: Pezzo affilato di calotta di feroce Brachydios; ancor più esplosivo del normale.
description_zh: A hard and sharp scalp piece from a fierce Brachydios. Even more explosive than usual.

name: Brach Crown
description: A large head projection that continually produces potent slime from within.
description_de: Große Kopfvorwölbung, die ständig potenten Schleim aus dem Inneren fördert.
description_fr: Grande projection frontale produisant en permanence une substance puissante.
description_es: Proyección de la cabeza que no deja de producir babas en su interior.
description_it: Ampia protezione per il cranio che secerne continuamente melma dall'interno.
description_zh: A large head projection that continually produces potent slime from within.

name: Brach Warhead
description: A skull that rage has turned into something far worse. The pinnacle of materials.
description_de: Zorn machte den Schädel zu etwas viel Schlimmerem. Das beste Material von allen.
description_fr: Crâne que la rage a défiguré. Le matériau par excellence.
description_es: Cráneo que la ira ha convertido en algo peor. El súmmum de los materiales.
description_it: Teschio sfigurato dalla collera che lo pervade. È il materiale più pregiato in assoluto.
description_zh: A skull that rage has turned into something far worse. The pinnacle of materials.

name: Mystery Slime
description: The explosive green substance found on Brachydios monsters. Handle with extreme care.
description_de: Explosive grüne Substanz eines Brachydios; sehr vorsichtig behandeln!
description_fr: Matière explosive extraite d'un Brachydios. À manipuler très soigneusement.
description_es: Sustancia explosiva y verde encontrada en un Brachydios. Úsala con cuidado.
description_it: Sostanza verde ed esplosiva dei Brachydios; maneggiare con la massima cautela.
description_zh: The explosive green substance found on Brachydios monsters. Handle with extreme care.

name: Glowing Slime
description: A highly volatile fluid used by especially savage Brachydios. Handle very carefully!
description_de: Unbeständige Flüssigkeit. Von wilden Brachydios genutzt. Mit Vorsicht handhaben!
description_fr: Matière hautement volatile extraite d'un Brachydios furieux. À manipuler très soigneusement !
description_es: Fluido muy volátil que usan los Brachydios más fieros. Empléalo con cuidado.
description_it: Fluido altamente infiammabile utilizzato da Brachydios selvaggi. Da maneggiare con cura!
description_zh: A highly volatile fluid used by especially savage Brachydios. Handle very carefully!

name: Flashpoint Slime
description: Red Brachydios slime at its most volatile: right before an all-or-nothing attack.
description_de: Instabiler, roter Brachy- dios-Schleim für einen Alles-oder-nichts-Angriff.
description_fr: Poisse de Brachydios rouge à son état le plus volatil. Pour une attaque suicide !
description_es: Baba roja de Brachydios en su punto más volátil: antes del último ataque.
description_it: Melma esplosiva di Brachydios rosso utilizzata dal mostro quando in pericolo di vita.
description_zh: Red Brachydios slime at its most volatile: right before an all-or-nothing attack.

name: Brach Hammer
description: An arm that has crushed the courage out of many a hunter. Slime makes forging tricky.
description_de: Eine Faust, die vielen Jägern den Mut nahm. Der Schleim macht Schmieden knifflig.
description_fr: Bras qui a mis à plat bien des chasseurs. La poisse rend le forgeage difficile.
description_es: Brazo bajo el cual sucumbieron muchos valerosos cazadores. La baba complica su forja.
description_it: Ha instillato il terrore in molti cacciatori. La melma rende ardua la forgiatura.
description_zh: An arm that has crushed the courage out of many a hunter. Slime makes forging tricky.

name: Brach Pounder
description: A Brachydios arm that buried countless foolhardy hunters. It's covered in green slime.
description_de: Eine Faust, die viele törichte Jäger begrub. Ist mit grünem Schleim überzogen.
description_fr: Bras de Brachydios ayant déjoué les chasseurs les plus téméraires. Poisseux.
description_es: Brazo de Brachydios que enterró a muchos cazadores insensatos. Con baba verde.
description_it: Braccio di Brachydios che ha ucciso schiere di temerari. È coperto di melma verde.
description_zh: A Brachydios arm that buried countless foolhardy hunters. It's covered in green slime.

name: Brach Pounder+
description: The arm of an especially angry Brachydios. Strong and heavy, as if made of iron.
description_de: Arm eines besonders wütenden Brachydios. Stark und schwer, fast wie aus Eisen.
description_fr: Le bras d'un Brachydios particulièrement furieux. Solide comme le fer.
description_es: Brazo de un Brachydios muy enfadado. Duro y pesado, pues está hecho de hierro.
description_it: Braccio di Brachydios infuriato; forte e pesante, come se fosse fatto di ferro.
description_zh: The arm of an especially angry Brachydios. Strong and heavy, as if made of iron.

name: Brach Obliterator
description: A violent mass that triggers blasts well beyond anything a Barrel Bomb L can do.
description_de: Explosive Masse, die mehr Verwüstung anrichtet als jede Fassbombe L.
description_fr: Masse violente provoquant des explosions bien pires qu'une grande bombe baril.
description_es: Una masa violenta que explota con una potencia indescriptible.
description_it: Ordigno capace di generare esplosioni più violente di qualunque bomba-botte grande.
description_zh: A violent mass that triggers blasts well beyond anything a Barrel Bomb L can do.

name: Brach Tail
description: While most focus on Brachydios's arms, its tail is also strong. Beware the explosive slime!
description_de: Auch der Schwanz des Brachydios ist stark. Vorsicht vor dem explosiven Schleim!
description_fr: Cette queue explosive est très puissante. Attention !
description_es: Los Brach son de brazos fuertes pero la cola no se queda atrás. ¡Cuidado con la baba explosiva!
description_it: La coda è un elemento forte dei Brachydios. Attenzione alla melma esplosiva!
description_zh: While most focus on Brachydios's arms, its tail is also strong. Beware the explosive slime!

name: Brach Lash
description: A strong tail that hits like a cudgel and smashes through boulders like so much dust.
description_de: Starker Schwanz. Schlägt wie eine Keule zu und verwandelt Felsen zu Staub.
description_fr: Puissante queue frappant tel un gourdin et brisant les rochers sans effort.
description_es: Una cola fuerte que golpea como un garrote y convierte las rocas en polvo.
description_it: Coda robusta che colpisce con la forza di una mazza, riducendo in polvere i macigni.
description_zh: A strong tail that hits like a cudgel and smashes through boulders like so much dust.

name: Brach Marrow
description: Stickier than normal marrow. A top-class welding material, if you're in the market.
description_de: Klebriger als normales Mark. Bestes Schweißmaterial, wenn man im Markt aktiv ist.
description_fr: Plus collante que la moelle normale. Matériau de soudage de première qualité.
description_es: Más pegajoso que el normal. En el mercado se considera un material para soldar de primera.
description_it: Più appiccicoso del comune midollo. È un materiale da saldatura di prima qualità.
description_zh: Stickier than normal marrow. A top-class welding material, if you're in the market.

name: Brach Gem
description: A rare gem from a Brachydios. Perhaps the secret of its dreadful slime is hidden inside?
description_de: Der seltene Edelstein eines Brachydios. Liegt darin das Geheimnis des Schleims?
description_fr: Gemme rare de Brachydios. Renferme peut-être le secret de son horrible poisse.
description_es: Rara gema extraída de un Brachydios. ¿Esconderá el secreto de su temible baba?
description_it: Gemma rara di Brachydios: che racchiuda il segreto della melma esplosiva?
description_zh: A rare gem from a Brachydios. Perhaps the secret of its dreadful slime is hidden inside?

name: Brach Pallium
description: A legendary Brachydios shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendärer Brachydios- Panzer. Die ihn bearbeiten, sollen die Welt beherrschen.
description_fr: Une carapace légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Coraza legendaria de Brachydios. Los que la usan rigen la tierra y el cielo.
description_it: Leggendaria corazza di Brachydios; solo i fabbri più esperti possono lavorarla.
description_zh: A legendary Brachydios shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Immortal Reactor
description: A hard-to-obtain Brachydios organ. Used to render slime more volatile when in peril.
description_de: Schwer erhältliches Organ des Brachydios, das Schleim bei Gefahr explosiver macht.
description_fr: Organe de Brachydios dur à obtenir. Rend la poisse plus volatile en cas de danger.
description_es: Un órgano de Brachydios difícil de conseguir. Hace la baba más volátil.
description_it: Organo raro di Brachydios che rende esplosiva la melma quando il mostro è in pericolo.
description_zh: A hard-to-obtain Brachydios organ. Used to render slime more volatile when in peril.

name: Hyper Brach Shell
description: Darker than normal Brachydios shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als andere Brachydios- Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la carapace de Brachydios normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que un caparazón de Brach normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Brachydios, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Brachydios shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Brach Cortex
description: Darker than normal Brachydios shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als nomale Brachydios-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace de Brachydios normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Brach normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Brachydios, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Brachydios shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Duram Carapace
description: A stiff Duramboros carapace. It can withstand attacks like an impenetrable aegis.
description_de: Ein starrer Duramboros- Rückenpanzer. Er widersteht Angriffen wie ein Bollwerk.
description_fr: Cuirasse rigide de Duramboros. Tient bon contre les attaques imparables.
description_es: Dura coraza de Duramboros. Resiste ataques, pues es impenetrable.
description_it: Rigido carapace di Duramboros; è un muro impenetrabile contro gli attacchi.
description_zh: A stiff Duramboros carapace. It can withstand attacks like an impenetrable aegis.

name: Duramboros Cortex
description: A Duramboros cortex. This heavy, strong armor saps an opponent's will to fight.
description_de: Ein Duramboros-Kortex. Diese starke Panzerung entzieht Gegnern den Kampfeswillen.
description_fr: Cortex de Duramboros. Cette armure très solide décourage les ennemis.
description_es: Placa de Duramboros. Esta fuerte armadura mina la voluntad del rival.
description_it: Pesante corteccia di Duramboros che prosciuga la volontà di combattere.
description_zh: A Duramboros cortex. This heavy, strong armor saps an opponent's will to fight.

name: Hard Mossplate
description: A shell covered in moss. Not only is it hard, the moss absorbs the shock of physical blows.
description_de: Moosbedeckter Panzer. Nicht nur hart, sondern auch stoß- fest, aufgrund des Mooses.
description_fr: Carapace couverte de mousse. En plus d'être dure, elle amortit les coups reçus.
description_es: Caparazón cubierto de musgo. No solo es duro, sino que absorbe los golpes físicos.
description_it: Corazza ricoperta da muschio, che la irrobustisce e assorbe l'impatto dei colpi.
description_zh: A shell covered in moss. Not only is it hard, the moss absorbs the shock of physical blows.

name: Heavy Mossplate
description: A Duramboros cortex covered in moss. Its weight and mossy shock absorber make it impenetrable.
description_de: Moosbedeckter Duramboros- Kortex. Undurchdringlich durch Moos und sein Gewicht.
description_fr: Cortex recouvert d'une mousse épaisse qui absorbe les chocs, le rendant impénétrable.
description_es: Corteza de Duramboros con musgo. Al absorber golpes se vuelve impenetrable.
description_it: Pesante corteccia di Duramboros ricoperta di muschio. Assorbe i colpi, è impenetrabile.
description_zh: A Duramboros cortex covered in moss. Its weight and mossy shock absorber make it impenetrable.

name: Duramboros Hump
description: The hump of a Duramboros's back. The fatty skin produces sturdy, pliable equipment when crafted.
description_de: Ein Duramboros-Höcker. Die fettige Haut liefert stabile und geschmeidige Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Bosse se situant sur le dos. La peau adipeuse produit des équipements flexibles.
description_es: Joroba de un Duramboros. Su piel grasienta crea equipo resistente y flexible.
description_it: Gobba della schiena di Duramboros. Offre pelle grassa per equipaggiamento flessibile.
description_zh: The hump of a Duramboros's back. The fatty skin produces sturdy, pliable equipment when crafted.

name: Marbled Hump
description: A quality hump found on select Duramboros. Currently being researched as a possible delicacy.
description_de: Hervorragender Duramboros- Höcker. Sehr gefragt als mögliche Delikatesse.
description_fr: Bosse de bonne qualité, chez certains Duramboros. Prisée comme mets délicat.
description_es: Joroba de calidad de algunos Duramboros. Se investiga como posible manjar.
description_it: Pregiata gobba posseduta da alcuni Duramboros; si studia come ricavarne prelibatezze.
description_zh: A quality hump found on select Duramboros. Currently being researched as a possible delicacy.

name: Duram Tailcase+
description: A superior Duramboros tailcase. Slices and crushes using sharp shell and heavy bone.
description_de: Erstklassiger Duramboros- Schwanzschutz. Verletzt mit Panzer- und Knochenkraft.
description_fr: Étui de queue de Duramboros. Tranche et écrase grâce à sa lourde carapace acérée.
description_es: Caja de cola de Duramboros. Corta y parte con su caparazón afilado y duro hueso.
description_it: Ottima corazza caudale di Duramboros, può tagliare e distruggere corazze e ossa.
description_zh: A superior Duramboros tailcase. Slices and crushes using sharp shell and heavy bone.

name: Duram Hardtail
description: A rigid shell from a Duramboros's tail. Powerful and heavy enough to smash through mountains.
description_de: Harte Duramboros-Schweif- schuppe. So stark, dass sie Berge vernichten kann.
description_fr: Carapace rigide. Puissante, pour frayer un chemin à travers les montagnes.
description_es: Rígida concha de la cola de Duramboros. Su poder puede atravesar montañas.
description_it: Corazza rigida della coda di Duramboros; pesante e potente, distrugge intere montagne.
description_zh: A rigid shell from a Duramboros's tail. Powerful and heavy enough to smash through mountains.

name: Duramboros Horn+
description: A rigid Duramboros horn. Nothing in the world can stop it during a vicious charge.
description_de: Ein hartes Duramboros-Horn. Nichts auf dieser Welt kann einem Angriff widerstehen.
description_fr: Corne rigide de Duramboros. Rien ne peut l'arrêter quand le monstre se met à charger.
description_es: Rígido cuerno de Duramboros. Nada es capaz de detenerlo en una feroz embestida.
description_it: Rigido corno di Duramboros; nulla al mondo può fermare le sue cariche selvagge.
description_zh: A rigid Duramboros horn. Nothing in the world can stop it during a vicious charge.

name: Duramboros Hardhorn
description: An incredibly hard Duramboros horn that somehow manages to amplify the monster's ferocity.
description_de: Sehr hartes Duramboros-Horn, das die Wildheit des Monsters noch steigert.
description_fr: Corne incroyablement dure, amplifiant encore plus la force féroce du monstre.
description_es: Cuerno superduro de Duramboros que aumenta la ferocidad del monstruo.
description_it: Corno di Duramboros incredibilmente duro; riesce ad aumentare la ferocia del mostro.
description_zh: An incredibly hard Duramboros horn that somehow manages to amplify the monster's ferocity.

name: Duram Sacrum
description: A striking Duramboros sacrum. Such tough, symmetrical bones are considered rare materials.
description_de: Beeindruckendes Duramboros- Kreuzbein. Die symmetrischen Knochen sind sehr selten.
description_fr: Incroyable sacrum. Ces os symétriques sont considérés comme des matériaux rares.
description_es: Sublime sacro de Duramboros. Esos huesos simétricos y duros son bastante raros.
description_it: Osso sacro di Duramboros dall'incredibile simmetria; è un materiale raro.
description_zh: A striking Duramboros sacrum. Such tough, symmetrical bones are considered rare materials.

name: Durambolite
description: Legendary gem rarely produced inside a Duramboros's body. Elegant, though gloomy.
description_de: Legendärer Edelstein aus einem Duramboros-Körper. Elegant, aber düster.
description_fr: Gemme légendaire très rare chez les Duramboros. À la fois élégante et lugubre.
description_es: Gema legendaria producida en un Duramboros. Elegante a la par que lúgubre.
description_it: Gemma tetra e leggendaria, raramente formata nel corpo del Duramboros.
description_zh: Legendary gem rarely produced inside a Duramboros's body. Elegant, though gloomy.

name: Hyper Duram Shell
description: Darker than normal Duramboros shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als andere Duramboros- Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la carapace de Boros normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que un caparazón de Duramboros normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Duramboros, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Duramboros shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Duram Cortex
description: Darker than normal Duramboros shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als nomale Duram-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une cara- pace de Duramboros normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Duramboros normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Duramboros, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Duramboros shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Flabby Hide
description: Finally useable as a material thanks to recent advances. Has mysterious properties.
description_de: Kann erst seit kurzer Zeit verarbeitet werden. Hat mysteriöse Eigenschaften.
description_fr: Matériaux mystérieux devenu utilisable grâce aux dernières technologies.
description_es: Material aprovechable gracias a nuevas técnicas de trabajo. De propiedades misteriosas.
description_it: Materiale lavorabile solo dopo recenti migliorie. Ha proprietà misteriose.
description_zh: Finally useable as a material thanks to recent advances. Has mysterious properties.

name: Pearl Hide
description: The hide of a Khezu. Its strange properties are still not fully understood.
description_de: Die gegerbte Haut eines Khezu. Die seltsamen Eigenschaften sind noch nicht entschlüsselt.
description_fr: La peau d'un Khezu. Ses étranges propriétés constituent un mystère.
description_es: Piel curtida de un Khezu. Sus extrañas propiedades son un misterio.
description_it: La pelle conciata di un Khezu. Le sue strane proprietà sono un mistero.
description_zh: The hide of a Khezu. Its strange properties are still not fully understood.

name: Pearl Glosshide
description: Top-quality Khezu hide. Hunters must take caution not to be enraptured by its luster.
description_de: Hochwertige Khezu-Leder- haut. Der Glanz verzaubert alle, die sie sehen.
description_fr: Peau de qualité supérieure de Khezu. Son éclat brillant hypnotise.
description_es: Piel de Khezu de máxima calidad. Su lustre brillante resulta hipnótico.
description_it: Pelle di Khezu di buona qualità. La sua lucentezza risulta ipnotica.
description_zh: Top-quality Khezu hide. Hunters must take caution not to be enraptured by its luster.

name: Pale Bone
description: The rib bone from a Khezu. Still has chunks of meat attached.
description_de: Der Rippenknochen eines Khezu, an dem sich noch ein wenig Fleisch befindet.
description_fr: Côte de Khezu avec un peu de viande.
description_es: Costilla de un Khezu con carne todavía pegada.
description_it: Costola di Khezu con carne ancora attaccata.
description_zh: The rib bone from a Khezu. Still has chunks of meat attached.

name: Pale Steak
description: Fatty meat from a Khezu. Looks tasty, but cannot be eaten.
description_de: Fettes Steak des Bleichen Khezu. Sieht gut aus, ist aber nicht essbar.
description_fr: Viande grasse d'un Khezu. Appétissant mais non comestible.
description_es: Carne roja grasa de un Khezu. Parece sabrosa, pero no es comestible.
description_it: Carne grassa di un Khezu. Sembra buona, ma non si mangia.
description_zh: Fatty meat from a Khezu. Looks tasty, but cannot be eaten.

name: Khezu Special Cut
description: An extremely high-quality cut of red Khezu flesh. ...Yuck.
description_de: Das Filetstück des roten Khezu-Fleischs. Schmeckt aber nicht besonders gut...
description_fr: Morceau de choix parmi la viande rouge de Khezu. Pas très appétissant...
description_es: Corte de calidad de la roja carne de un Khezu. No se puede decir que sea muy sabrosa...
description_it: Un eccellente taglio di carne Khezu. Il gusto però lascia a desiderare.
description_zh: An extremely high-quality cut of red Khezu flesh. ...Yuck.

name: Hyper Khezu Hide
description: Darker than normal Khezu hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als andere Khezu- Haut. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus foncée que la peau de Khezu normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que la piel de Khezu normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelle iper di Khezu, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Khezu hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Khezu Glosshide
description: Darker than normal Khezu hide, this tough Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als normale Khezu-Haut. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une peau de Khezu normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que la piel de Khezu normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelle iper di Khezu, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Khezu hide, this tough Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Nargacuga Scale
description: A scale from a Nargacuga. The surface is covered with the beast's black fur.
description_de: Die Nargacuga-Schuppe ist bedeckt vom schwarzen Fell der Bestie.
description_fr: Écaille de Nargacuga dont la surface est recouverte de la fourrure noire de la bête.
description_es: Escama de Nargacuga. Su superficie está cubierta del pelo negro de la bestia.
description_it: Scaglia di Nargacuga. La superficie è ricoperta dalla pelliccia nera del mostro.
description_zh: A scale from a Nargacuga. The surface is covered with the beast's black fur.

name: Nargacuga Scale+
description: A black Nargacuga scale. Despite its hardness, it's surprisingly light and smooth.
description_de: Schwarze Nargacuga-Schuppe. Trotz ihrer Härte ist sie leicht und geschmeidig.
description_fr: Écaille noire de Nargacuga. Dure, mais étonnamment légère et douce.
description_es: Negra escama de Nargacuga. Pese a su dureza, es muy ligera y suave.
description_it: Scaglia nera di Nargacuga, dura ma sorprendentemente leggera e liscia.
description_zh: A black Nargacuga scale. Despite its hardness, it's surprisingly light and smooth.

name: Nargacuga Shard
description: A tough, black Nargacuga scale. Thicker than standard scales, but still lightweight.
description_de: Harte, schwarze Nargacuga- Schuppe. Dicker als normale Schuppen, trotzdem leicht.
description_fr: Écaille robuste. Plus épaisse que les écailles ordinaires, mais légère.
description_es: Negra y dura escama de Nargacuga. Más gruesa que la escama común, aunque ligera.
description_it: Resistente scaglia nera di Nargacuga, più spessa del normale ma leggera.
description_zh: A tough, black Nargacuga scale. Thicker than standard scales, but still lightweight.

name: Nargacuga Blackfur
description: Black fur that grows on scales. Covers the animal in jet-black darkness.
description_de: Schwarzes Fell, wächst auf Schuppen. Verbirgt Tiere in tiefster Finsternis.
description_fr: Fourrure noire qui pousse sur les écailles. Couvre l'animal de ténèbres.
description_es: Pelo negro que crece en escamas. Cubre al animal en la oscuridad total.
description_it: Pelliccia nera che ricopre le scaglie, avvolgendo la bestia nelle tenebre.
description_zh: Black fur that grows on scales. Covers the animal in jet-black darkness.

name: Nargacuga Pelt+
description: Pitch-black fur from a Nargacuga. It absorbs all light and emits pure darkness.
description_de: Finsteres Nargacuga-Fell. Absorbiert Licht vollständig und strahlt Düsternis aus.
description_fr: Fourrure noir de Nargacuga. Absorbe la lumière et émet de pures ténèbres.
description_es: Pelaje azabache de un Nargacuga. Absorbe la luz y emite oscuridad pura.
description_it: Pelo nero di Nargacuga; assorbe la luce emanando oscurità pura.
description_zh: Pitch-black fur from a Nargacuga. It absorbs all light and emits pure darkness.

name: Nargacuga Blackfur+
description: A Nargacuga's highly evolved black fur. Glossy and resilient, it fends off claws and fangs.
description_de: Schwarzes Nargacuga-Fell. Glänzend und robust, schützt gegen Klauen und Reißzähne.
description_fr: Fourrure complexe noire. Elle brille et elle protège des griffes et des crocs.
description_es: Piel negra de Nargacuga evolucionada. Es brillante y resiste garras y colmillos.
description_it: Pelo nero di Nargacuga lucido e resistente, evoluto per deviare artigli e zanne.
description_zh: A Nargacuga's highly evolved black fur. Glossy and resilient, it fends off claws and fangs.

name: Nargacuga Tail
description: A Nargacuga's impressive tail. Might be mistaken for a weapon if seen out of context.
description_de: Beeindruckender Nargacuga- Schwanz. Kann man leicht mit einer Waffe verwechseln.
description_fr: Impressionnante queue de Nargucaga. Peut être confondue avec une arme.
description_es: Imponente cola de Nargacuga. Se puede confundir con un arma fuera de contexto.
description_it: Imponente coda di Nargacuga; vista di sfuggita, potrebbe essere scambiata per un'arma.
description_zh: A Nargacuga's impressive tail. Might be mistaken for a weapon if seen out of context.

name: Nargacuga Lash
description: A top-flight Nargacuga tail. An ideal crafting material due to its flexibility and strength.
description_de: Erstklassiger Nargacuga- Schwanz. Besonders gut zur Weiterverarbeitung geeignet.
description_fr: Superbe queue. Flexible et puissante, elle est idéale pour fabriquer des objets.
description_es: Excelente cola de Nargacuga. Material ideal para crear por ser flexible y fuerte.
description_it: Pregiata coda di Nargacuga, flessibile e resistente, è ideale per le lavorazioni.
description_zh: A top-flight Nargacuga tail. An ideal crafting material due to its flexibility and strength.

name: Narga Tailspike
description: A spiky scale from a Nargacuga tail. It stands up when the beast is enraged.
description_de: Stachlige Nargacuga-Schwanz- schuppe. Richtet sich auf, wenn das Monster wütend ist.
description_fr: Écaille pleine de pointes. Se soulève lorsque la bête est enragée.
description_es: Escama puntiaguda de una cola de Nargacuga. Se alza al enfurecerse la bestia.
description_it: Scaglia appuntita della coda che si drizza quando il Nargacuga è infuriato.
description_zh: A spiky scale from a Nargacuga tail. It stands up when the beast is enraged.

name: Narga Tailspear
description: A first-class spike from a Nargacuga tail. Heavy and sharp, it can be shockingly deadly.
description_de: Erstklassiger Stachel eines Nargacuga-Schwanzes. Schwer, scharf und absolut tödlich.
description_fr: Super pointe de queue de Nargacuga. Lourde et affûtée, elle peut être mortelle.
description_es: Púa de calidad de una cola de Nargacuga. Pesada y afilada, puede ser mortal.
description_it: Eccellente punta della coda di Nargacuga; pesante, acuminata e mortale.
description_zh: A first-class spike from a Nargacuga tail. Heavy and sharp, it can be shockingly deadly.

name: Nargacuga Cutwing
description: Blade-like Nargacuga wing. Evolved to cut down prey on the fly.
description_de: Klingenähnlicher Nargacuga- Flügel. Kann Beute extrem schnell in Teile schnetzeln.
description_fr: Aile en forme d'épée. Elle a évolué pour couper les proies en plein vol.
description_es: Una afilada ala de Narga. La evolución ha convertido sus alas en auténticas cuchillas.
description_it: Ala di Nargacuga a forma di lama. Serve a tagliare la preda in volo.
description_zh: Blade-like Nargacuga wing. Evolved to cut down prey on the fly.

name: Narga Razor
description: The large, sharp bladewing of a Nargacuga. It can slice through foes in a flash.
description_de: Großer, scharfer Nargacuga- Klingenflügel. Zerteilt Feinde blitzschnell.
description_fr: Grande aile tranchante de Nargacuga. Peut découper les ennemis en un éclair.
description_es: Enorme filo del ala de un Nargacuga. Corta a los enemigos en un instante.
description_it: Grossa scapola affilata di Nargacuga; può tagliare di netto i nemici.
description_zh: The large, sharp bladewing of a Nargacuga. It can slice through foes in a flash.

name: Nargacuga Cutwing+
description: A stronger Nargacuga cutwing. Extra-hard, it can cleave foes in twain with a single swing.
description_de: Dieser stärkere Nargacuga- Schnittflügel zerteilt alle Feinde mühelos in Stücke.
description_fr: Solide ailame. Dure, elle peut fendre l'ennemi en un seul coup.
description_es: Fuerte filo del ala de Nargacuga. Muy duro, puede partir a enemigos en dos.
description_it: Scapola di Nargacuga più resistente del normale, può tagliare in due in un colpo solo.
description_zh: A stronger Nargacuga cutwing. Extra-hard, it can cleave foes in twain with a single swing.

name: Nargacuga Fang
description: Although small, the jagged placement of these fangs increase their cutting ability.
description_de: Klein, aber aufgrund der Platzierung der Reißzähne sehr scharf.
description_fr: Crocs de petite taille mais tranchants grâce à leur disposition idéale.
description_es: Aunque son pequeños, su disposición irregular aumenta su capacidad de corte.
description_it: Zanne minute, ma rese più taglienti dal loro allineamento sfalsato.
description_zh: Although small, the jagged placement of these fangs increase their cutting ability.

name: Nargacuga Fang+
description: A Nargacuga's incredibly sharp fang. Evolved to tear rather than chew.
description_de: Sehr scharfer Nargacuga- Reißzahn. Eher zum Zerreißen geeignet als zum Kauen.
description_fr: Croc incroyablement affûté. Davantage destiné à déchirer qu'à mâcher.
description_es: Colmillo muy afilado de Nargacuga. Es para desgarrar más que para masticar.
description_it: Zanna estremamente affilata di Nargacuga, usata soprattutto per lacerare.
description_zh: A Nargacuga's incredibly sharp fang. Evolved to tear rather than chew.

name: Nargacuga Hardfang
description: A highly developed Nargacuga fang. Bold and sharp, it can easily slice prey to pieces.
description_de: Exzellenter Nargacuga-Reiß- zahn. Groß und scharf, reißt Beute leicht in Stücke.
description_fr: Croc évolué. Affûté, il peut facilement découper les proies en morceaux.
description_es: Colmillo muy desarrollado de Nargacuga. Liso y afilado, hace trizas a los enemigos.
description_it: Zanna affilata di Nargacuga, evoluta per fare a pezzi le prede.
description_zh: A highly developed Nargacuga fang. Bold and sharp, it can easily slice prey to pieces.

name: Nargacuga Marrow
description: Marrow as nimble as the Nargacuga itself; requires talent to properly harvest.
description_de: So beweglich wie der Narga- cuga selbst. Zum richtigen Ernten braucht es Talent.
description_fr: Aussi souple que le Nargacuga. Son extraction requiert de l'expertise.
description_es: Médula tan ágil como el mismo Nargacuga. Recogerla requiere de mucho talento.
description_it: Bulbo sfuggente come lo stesso Nargacuga. Serve grande talento per estrarlo.
description_zh: Marrow as nimble as the Nargacuga itself; requires talent to properly harvest.

name: Narga Medulla
description: A Nargacuga's medulla. Merely touching it causes extreme pain, making crafting quite difficult.
description_de: Nargacuga-Rückenmark. Schon Berühren tut sehr weh, daher schwierig zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Très douloureuse au toucher, ce qui la rend difficile à travailler.
description_es: Médula de Nargacuga. Solo con tocarla causa dolor, lo que dificulta la creación.
description_it: Midollo di Nargacuga. Il solo tocco causa intenso dolore, quindi è difficile da lavorare.
description_zh: A Nargacuga's medulla. Merely touching it causes extreme pain, making crafting quite difficult.

name: Nargacuga Mantle
description: A legendary Nargacuga scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendäre Nargacuga-Schuppe. Die sie bearbeiten, sollen über die Welt herrschen.
description_fr: Une écaille légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Escama legendaria de Nargacuga. Los que la portan rigen la tierra y el cielo.
description_it: Leggendaria scaglia di Nargacuga; chi è capace di lavorarla può regnare sul mondo.
description_zh: A legendary Nargacuga scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Narga Scale
description: Darker than normal Nargacuga scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als andere Nargacuga- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Nargacuga normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Nargacuga normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Nargacuga, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Nargacuga scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Narga Shard
description: Darker than normal Nargacuga scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Kut-Ku-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Nargacuga normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Nargacuga normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Nargacuga, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Nargacuga scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Silverwind Scale
description: A Silverwind Nargacuga scale. Its lightness allows free and swift movement.
description_de: Silberwind-Nargacuga-Schuppe. Das geringe Gewicht gewährt große Bewegungsfreiheit.
description_fr: Écaille de Nargacuga Vent-acier. Une légèreté synonyme de liberté et de rapidité de mouvement.
description_es: Escama de Nargacuga Argénteo. Su ligereza ofrece gran libertad de movimientos.
description_it: Scaglia di Ventus Nargacuga. Il peso ridotto permette di muoversi agili e veloci.
description_zh: A Silverwind Nargacuga scale. Its lightness allows free and swift movement.

name: Silverwind Scale+
description: Although extremely hard, this scale's lightness allows free and swift movement.
description_de: Trotz der extremen Härte bietet die Leichtigkeit der Schuppe Bewegungsfreiheit.
description_fr: Écaille très dure mais dont la légèreté garantit la liberté et la rapidité des mouvements.
description_es: Es extremadamente dura, pero su ligereza ofrece gran libertad de movimientos.
description_it: Sebbene sia una scaglia molto dura, permette movenze agili grazie alla sua leggerezza.
description_zh: Although extremely hard, this scale's lightness allows free and swift movement.

name: Silverwind Shard
description: A Silverwind Nargacuga scale. Its quality is denoted by its flexibility and strength.
description_de: Silberwind-Nargacuga-Schuppe. Ihre Stärke und Flexibilität bezeugen ihre hohe Güte.
description_fr: Écaille de Nargacuga Vent-acier. Sa flexibilité et sa résistance attestent de sa qualité.
description_es: Escama de Nargacuga Argénteo. Su valor lo determinan su dureza y flexibilidad.
description_it: Scaglia di Ventus, la cui qualità superiore offre flessibilità e forza.
description_zh: A Silverwind Nargacuga scale. Its quality is denoted by its flexibility and strength.

name: Silverwind Blackfur
description: Black fur from a Silverwind Nargacuga. Its lightness allows swift and free movement.
description_de: Schwarzes Fell des Silberwind- Nargacuga. Das geringe Gewicht sorgt für Bewegungsfreiheit.
description_fr: Fourrure noire de Nargacuga Vent-acier. Légère, elle assure des mouvements libres et vifs.
description_es: Pelaje negro de Nargacuga Argénteo. Su ligereza ofrece gran libertad de movimientos.
description_it: Pelliccia nera di Ventus. La sua leggerezza consente di muoversi agili e veloci.
description_zh: Black fur from a Silverwind Nargacuga. Its lightness allows swift and free movement.

name: Silverwind Blackfur+
description: Quality fur from a Silverwind Nargacuga. Its lightness allows swift and free movement.
description_de: Gutes Fell des Silberwind- Nargacuga. Das geringe Gewicht sorgt für Bewegungsfreiheit.
description_fr: Bonne fourrure de Nargacuga Vent-acier. Légère, elle assure des mouvements libres et vifs.
description_es: Pelaje de calidad de Nargacuga Argénteo. Su ligereza ofrece gran libertad de movimientos.
description_it: Pelliccia pregiata di Ventus. La sua leggerezza consente di muoversi agili e veloci.
description_zh: Quality fur from a Silverwind Nargacuga. Its lightness allows swift and free movement.

name: Silverwind Blackpelage
description: Refined fur from a Silverwind Nargacuga. Its lightness allows swift and free movement.
description_de: Erlesenes Fell des Silberwind- Nargacuga. Das geringe Gewicht sorgt für Bewegungsfreiheit.
description_fr: Fourrure raffinée de Nargacuga Vent-acier. Légère, elle assure des mouvements libres et vifs.
description_es: Pelaje refinado de Nargacuga Argénteo. Su ligereza ofrece gran libertad de movimientos.
description_it: Pelliccia pregiatissima di Ventus. La sua leggerezza consente di muoversi agili e veloci.
description_zh: Refined fur from a Silverwind Nargacuga. Its lightness allows swift and free movement.

name: Barioth Carapace
description: A Barioth carapace with an impressive shine. Strongly resembles an ice floe.
description_de: Barioth-Rückenpanzer von prächtigem Glanz. Sieht wie eine Eisscholle aus.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Barioth spectaculairement brillante. Ressemble à de la glace.
description_es: Caparazón de Barioth con un brillo increíble. Parece un témpano de hielo.
description_it: Carapace di Barioth dall'intenso splendore. Sembra una lastra di ghiaccio.
description_zh: A Barioth carapace with an impressive shine. Strongly resembles an ice floe.

name: Barioth Cortex
description: A cortex from a formidable Barioth. Surprisingly strong and impressively lightweight.
description_de: Kortex eines beeindruckenden Barioth. Überraschend stark und trotzdem leicht.
description_fr: Cortex d'un superbe Barioth. Étonnamment puissant et pourtant très léger.
description_es: Corteza de un Barioth imponente. Sorprenden su fuerza y ligereza.
description_it: Corteccia di un formidabile Barioth, incredibilmente resistente e leggera.
description_zh: A cortex from a formidable Barioth. Surprisingly strong and impressively lightweight.

name: Barioth Pelt+
description: A high-quality white pelt with a lovely texture. Nobles use it as a symbol of authority.
description_de: Hochwertiger weißer Pelz von herrlicher Struktur. Adliges Symbol der Autorität.
description_fr: Peau blanche et à la texture agréable. Utilisée par les nobles. Symbole d'autorité.
description_es: Genial piel blanca de sublime textura. Símbolo de autoridad para los nobles.
description_it: Pelle bianca a grana fine di alta qualità; i nobili la adottano come simbolo di autorità.
description_zh: A high-quality white pelt with a lovely texture. Nobles use it as a symbol of authority.

name: Barioth Thickfur
description: Top quality white fur from a Barioth. It feels like being wrapped in angel wings.
description_de: Bestes weißes Barioth-Fell. Fast wie eine Umarmung von Engelsflügeln.
description_fr: Fourrure blanche de grande qualité. On dirait les ailes d'un ange.
description_es: Excelente pelaje blanco de Barioth. Es como si las alas de un ángel te envolvieran.
description_it: Pregiato pelo bianco di Barioth; al tocco è come ali d'angelo.
description_zh: Top quality white fur from a Barioth. It feels like being wrapped in angel wings.

name: Barioth Claw+
description: A claw honed in the harsh Tundra environment. It can take down prey with a single swipe.
description_de: Klaue, geschärft in der rauen Tundra. Sie erledigt Beute mit einem Hieb.
description_fr: Griffe de la Toundra. Peut abattre sa proie d'un seul mouvement.
description_es: Garra pulida en la dura tundra. Derrota a su presa con solo acariciarla.
description_it: Artiglio affilato dalla gelida tundra; può abbattere la preda con un colpo.
description_zh: A claw honed in the harsh Tundra environment. It can take down prey with a single swipe.

name: Barioth Talon
description: A strong, hard talon found on select Barioth. It can slice through hard shells like butter.
description_de: Starke, harte Kralle einiger Bariothe. Durchdringt harte Panzer wie Butter.
description_fr: Serre puissante de certains Barioth. Pénètre les carapaces comme du beurre.
description_es: Zarpa fuerte de ciertos Barioth. Corta conchas duras como si fueran de mantequilla.
description_it: Resistente sperone posseduto da alcuni Barioth; fende le corazze come burro.
description_zh: A strong, hard talon found on select Barioth. It can slice through hard shells like butter.

name: Amber Fang+
description: Amber tusks sharpened by countless kills. They can smash through gigantic ice blocks.
description_de: Bernsteinhauer, von etlichen Kämpfen geschärft. Können dicke Eisblöcke durchstoßen.
description_fr: Défenses d'ambre aiguisées à force de tuer. Peuvent briser les blocs de glace.
description_es: Colmillos ámbar afilados por muertes incontables. Rompen bloques de hielo gigantes.
description_it: Zanne ambra affilate dall'uso e capaci di distruggere blocchi di ghiaccio.
description_zh: Amber tusks sharpened by countless kills. They can smash through gigantic ice blocks.

name: Amber Hardfang
description: A thick, heavy tusk found on select Barioth. Strong enough to shatter almost anything.
description_de: Dicke, schwere Hauer einiger Bariothe. Stark genug, um fast alles zu zerschmettern.
description_fr: Défenses épaisses et lourdes de certains Barioth. Elles peuvent presque tout briser.
description_es: Colmillos gruesos y duros de algunos Barioth. Su fuerza acaba con todo.
description_it: Grosse zanne possedute da alcuni Barioth, capaci di distruggere quasi tutto.
description_zh: A thick, heavy tusk found on select Barioth. Strong enough to shatter almost anything.

name: Barioth Spike
description: These come in many sizes and assist the Barioth in clinging to walls of ice.
description_de: Es gibt sie in vielen Größen. Sie helfen Bariothen beim Eisklettern.
description_fr: De plusieurs tailles. Aide le Barioth à s'agripper aux murs de glace.
description_es: Hay muchos tamaños. El Barioth se aferra con ellas a las paredes de hielo.
description_it: Punte di più taglie, usate dai Barioth per aggrapparsi alle pareti ghiacciate.
description_zh: These come in many sizes and assist the Barioth in clinging to walls of ice.

name: Barioth Tail
description: Barioth tails are covered in hard plate and surprisingly tough to sever.
description_de: Barioth-Schwänze sind gut gepanzert und schwer zu entfernen.
description_fr: Recouverte de plaque dure et difficile à couper.
description_es: Estas colas están cubiertas de placa dura y es difícil cortarlas.
description_it: È ricoperta da placche dure e si mozza con difficoltà.
description_zh: Barioth tails are covered in hard plate and surprisingly tough to sever.

name: Barioth Lash
description: A top-quality Barioth Tail. Covered in hard plate, it requires considerable skill to remove.
description_de: Hochwertiger Barioth- Schwanz. Wegen der Platten nur schwer zu entfernen.
description_fr: Queue de très bonne qualité recouverte d'une plaque dure. Difficile à retirer.
description_es: Excelente cola de Barioth. Cubierta por una placa dura, no es fácil de arrancar.
description_it: Pregiata coda di Barioth, ricoperta di piastre. Serve una certa abilità per rimuoverla.
description_zh: A top-quality Barioth Tail. Covered in hard plate, it requires considerable skill to remove.

name: Hyper Barioth Piel
description: Darker than normal Barioth hide, this tough Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als normale Barioth-Haut. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre qu'une peau de Barioth normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que la piel de Barioth normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Manto iper di Barioth, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Barioth hide, this tough Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Basarios Carapace
description: Harder than Basarios shell, this material is also known as Gravite.
description_de: Härter als der normale Basarios-Panzer. Kennt man auch als Gravit.
description_fr: Plus dure qu'une carapace Basarios. Ce matériau est aussi connu sous le nom de Gravite.
description_es: Más duro que el caparazón del Basarios. A este material también se le llama gravita.
description_it: Più duro della corazza di Basarios, questo materiale è chiamato anche Gravite.
description_zh: Harder than Basarios shell, this material is also known as Gravite.

name: Basarios Wing
description: The wing of a Basarios. Very hard to work as a material.
description_de: Der Flügel eines Basarios. Äußerst schwer zu bearbeiten.
description_fr: L'aile d'un Basarios. Très difficile à travailler en tant que matériau.
description_es: Ala de un Basarios. Muy difícil de trabajar.
description_it: L'ala di un Basarios. Materiale molto difficile da lavorare.
description_zh: The wing of a Basarios. Very hard to work as a material.

name: Basarios Tears
description: Faintly pink gems found near the tear ducts of a Basarios.
description_de: Blassrosa Juwelen an den Tränendrüsen des Basarios.
description_fr: Une gemme rosée trouvée près des glandes lacrymales d'un Basarios.
description_es: Gemas ligeramente rosas que se hallan cerca de los conductos lagrimales de los Basarios.
description_it: Gemme di un rosa tenue, estratte dal condotto lacrimale di un Basarios.
description_zh: Faintly pink gems found near the tear ducts of a Basarios.

name: Basarios Cortex
description: A heavy Basarios shell encrusted with quality ore. Perfectly mimics a stone wall.
description_de: Schwerer Panzer, bedeckt mit edlem Erz. Ähnelt einer Steinmauer.
description_fr: Une lourde carapace incrustée de minerais de qualité. On dirait un mur de pierre.
description_es: Pesado caparazón engarzado de mineral de calidad. Imita muy bien al sillar.
description_it: Corazza pesante con incrostazioni metalliche. Sembra un muro di pietra.
description_zh: A heavy Basarios shell encrusted with quality ore. Perfectly mimics a stone wall.

name: Basarios Fellwing
description: A top-grade Basarios wing. It's not great for flying, but highly sought after as material.
description_de: Hochwertiger Basarios- Flügel. Nicht flugtauglich, aber großartiges Material.
description_fr: Aile Basarios top qualité. Pas super pour voler mais génial comme matériau.
description_es: Ala de Basarios de máxima calidad. No es la mejor para volar, pero es un buen material.
description_it: Ala Basarios di qualità. Scadente per il volo, ma ottima come materia prima.
description_zh: A top-grade Basarios wing. It's not great for flying, but highly sought after as material.

name: Basarios Pallium
description: A legendary Basarios shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendärer Basarios-Flügel. Wer daraus Ausrüstung anfertigt, herrscht über Himmel und Erde.
description_fr: Une carapace légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Escama legendaria de Basarios. Los que la usan rigen la tierra y el cielo.
description_it: Scaglia leggendaria di Basarios. Chi la usa come arma, domina la terra e i cieli.
description_zh: A legendary Basarios shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Basarios Cortex
description: Darker than normal Basarios shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als nomale Basarios-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace de Basarios normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Basarios normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Basarios, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Basarios shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Gravios Carapace
description: Harder than Gravios Shell, this material is also known as Gravite.
description_de: Härter als Gravios-Panzer. Man nennt dieses Material Gravit.
description_fr: Plus dure qu'une carapace Gravios. Ce matériau est aussi connu sous le nom de Gravite.
description_es: Más duro que el caparazón del Gravios. A este material se le conoce también como gravita.
description_it: Questo materiale, più duro della corazza di Gravios, è noto come Gravite.
description_zh: Harder than Gravios Shell, this material is also known as Gravite.

name: Gravios Cortex
description: A stout outer shell, heavier than a carapace. Also known as Mediastinum.
description_de: Robuster Außenpanzer, härter als Gravios-Rücken- panzer. Auch "Mediastinum".
description_fr: Carapace plus dure que la carapace de Gravios. Aussi appelée Mediastinum.
description_es: Sólida placa de un Gravios, más densa que su coraza. Apodada "Mediastinum".
description_it: Questo materiale, più duro della corazza di Gravios, è detto anche Mediastino.
description_zh: A stout outer shell, heavier than a carapace. Also known as Mediastinum.

name: Gravios Scalp
description: A part carved from the head of a Gravios. Incredibly hard to work with.
description_de: Teil eines Gravios- Schädels. Unvorstellbar schwer zu bearbeiten.
