description_fr: Une portion taillée dans le crâne d'un Gravios. Très difficile à travailler.
description_es: Fragmento arrancado del cráneo de un Gravios. Su dureza lo hace difícil de trabajar.
description_it: Ricavata dal teschio di un Gravios. Incredibilmente dura da lavorare.
description_zh: A part carved from the head of a Gravios. Incredibly hard to work with.

name: Gravios Crown
description: Robust head plating whose splendid shapes are weapon- worthy already.
description_de: Robuster Kopfpanzer. Die prächtigen Formen sind bereits waffenwürdig.
description_fr: Plaque de tête robuste dont la forme en fait un matériau idéal pour les armes.
description_es: Coraza de cabeza cuya forma ya es digna de usarse como arma.
description_it: Robusta corazza del cranio dalla foggia perfetta per fabbricare armi.
description_zh: Robust head plating whose splendid shapes are weapon- worthy already.

name: Gravios Wing
description: A hefty-looking Gravios wing. Its value is on the up due to its uses in crafting.
description_de: Kräftig wirkender Gravios- Flügel. Wertvoll dank seiner Verwendung im Handwerk.
description_fr: Aile de Gravios massive. Sa valeur augmente en raison de ses usages artisanaux.
description_es: Ala de Gravios de aspecto pesado. Muy valiosa por sus usos en artesanía.
description_it: Gigantesca ala di Gravios. I suoi molteplici utilizzi ne fanno lievitare il costo.
description_zh: A hefty-looking Gravios wing. Its value is on the up due to its uses in crafting.

name: Gravios Fellwing
description: A thick, heavy wing. The distinct webbing once full grown fetches high prices.
description_de: Dicker, schwerer Flügel. Das schöne Gewebe erreicht voll ausgewachsen hohe Preise.
description_fr: Aile épaisse et lourde. À maturité, sa seule membrane se revend au prix fort.
description_es: Ala dura y pesada. Su entrelazado, al crecer, se vende por un dineral.
description_it: Ala spessa e pesante. La membrana degli esemplari adulti è molto preziosa.
description_zh: A thick, heavy wing. The distinct webbing once full grown fetches high prices.

name: Gravios Medulla
description: This brain stem is a precious but hard to craft Gravios part.
description_de: Der Hirnstamm ist ein wertvoller, aber schwer zu bearbeitender Teil.
description_fr: Le cerveau du Gravios est une partie précieuse mais difficile à travailler.
description_es: La médula de los Gravios es muy codiciada, si bien labrarla está al alcance de pocos.
description_it: Il midollo allungato è molto pregiato, ma difficile da lavorare.
description_zh: This brain stem is a precious but hard to craft Gravios part.

name: Gravios Pallium
description: A legendary Gravios shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendärer Panzer, dessen Träger über den Himmel und die Erde herrscht.
description_fr: Une carapace légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Caparazón fantasmal. Cuando se creó, unificó la tierra y atrapó el cielo.
description_it: Una corazza eterea. Si dice che sia in grado di unire la terra e il cielo.
description_zh: A legendary Gravios shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Gravios Cortex
description: Darker than normal Gravios shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als nomale Gravios-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace de Gravios normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Gravios normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corteccia iper di Gravios, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Gravios shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Rathian Scale
description: The scale of a Rathian, the mate of Rathalos.
description_de: Die Schuppe einer Rathian, der Gefährtin eines Rathalos.
description_fr: La femelle du Rathalos vit souvent près de son nid.
description_es: Escama de Rathian. Su pareja es el macho Rathalos.
description_it: Una scaglia di Rathian che vive presso il nido con il compagno: un Rathalos.
description_zh: The scale of a Rathian, the mate of Rathalos.

name: Rathian Scale+
description: A superior Rathian scale. Looks like a normal Rathian scale, but is extremely hard.
description_de: Die überlegene Schuppe einer Rathian. Wirkt normal, ist aber außergewöhnlich hart.
description_fr: Écaille d'apparence normale, mais extrêmement rigide.
description_es: Una escama de Rathian de apariencia normal, pero de dureza extraordinaria.
description_it: Una scaglia di Rathian. Sembra normale, ma la sua rigidità non lo è.
description_zh: A superior Rathian scale. Looks like a normal Rathian scale, but is extremely hard.

name: Rathian Shard
description: A particularly thick Rathian scale. Its large size proves its owner's advanced age.
description_de: Besonders dicke Rathian- Schuppe. Ihre Größe zeugt vom hohen Alter des Trägers.
description_fr: Écaille de Rathian très épaisse. Sa taille témoigne d'un individu âgé.
description_es: Escama especialmente gruesa de Rathian. Su tamaño indica una edad avanzada.
description_it: Spessa scaglia di Rathian. Le dimensioni indicano un esemplare di età avanzata.
description_zh: A particularly thick Rathian scale. Its large size proves its owner's advanced age.

name: Rathian Shell
description: A shell piece comprised of layered scales, making it much harder than just one.
description_de: Ein Panzer-Stück aus geschichteten Schuppen. Dadurch ist es viel härter.
description_fr: Carapace résistante composée de plusieurs couches d'écailles.
description_es: Un caparazón de Rathian, formado por numerosas escamas. Muy duro.
description_it: Questa corazza ha numerosi strati di scaglie per una maggiore resistenza.
description_zh: A shell piece comprised of layered scales, making it much harder than just one.

name: Rathian Carapace
description: A sturdy Rathian carapace. Even harder than a normal Rathian Shell.
description_de: Robuster Rückenpanzer einer Rathian. Sogar härter als ein normaler Rathian-Panzer.
description_fr: Plus dure qu'une carapace de Rathian normale.
description_es: La robusta coraza de una Rathian. Mucho más dura aún que su caparazón.
description_it: Più duro anche della normale corazza di Rathian.
description_zh: A sturdy Rathian carapace. Even harder than a normal Rathian Shell.

name: Rathian Cortex
description: A Rathian shell that is heavier than the carapace. Used to reinforce parts of equipment.
description_de: Rathian-Panzer, härter als ein Rückenpanzer. Für eine Verstärkung der Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Plus lourd qu'une cuirasse de Rathian normale. Renforce l'équipement.
description_es: Concha de Rathian más pesada que un caparazón. Usada para reforzar partes del equipo.
description_it: Corazza di Rathian più pesante di un carapace. Viene usato come rinforzo.
description_zh: A Rathian shell that is heavier than the carapace. Used to reinforce parts of equipment.

name: Rathian Webbing
description: This heat-resistant material is often used as armor lining.
description_de: Diesen hitzebeständigen Stoff benutzt man oft als Rüstungsinnenfutter.
description_fr: Ce matériau résistant à la chaleur est souvent utilisé dans les armures.
description_es: Muy resistente al calor y utilizada a menudo como tela en armaduras.
description_it: Materiale resistente al calore, spesso usato per l'interno delle corazze.
description_zh: This heat-resistant material is often used as armor lining.

name: Rathian Weave
description: Excellent heat retention but it's so difficult to work with that it has a legendary reputation.
description_de: Fast perfekte Wärmeisolation, aber für schwierige Verarbeitung berüchtigt.
description_fr: Conserve très bien la chaleur mais a la réputation d'être extrêmement difficile à travailler.
description_es: Conserva bien el calor, pero tiene la fama de ser muy difícil de trabajar.
description_it: Ha un'ottima ritenzione del calore, ma è notoriamente difficile da manipolare.
description_zh: Excellent heat retention but it's so difficult to work with that it has a legendary reputation.

name: Rathian Spike
description: Needle-like hair found on a Rathian's back and wings. They contain poison.
description_de: Nadelartige Haare vom Rücken und den Flügeln einer Rathian. Sie enthalten Gift.
description_fr: Poil acéré et empoisonné trouvé sur le dos et les ailes d'une Rathian.
description_es: Una cerda del lomo o las alas de la Rathian. Es afilada como una aguja, y contiene veneno.
description_it: Peli simili a chiodi tratti dal dorso e dalle ali di una Rathian. Contengono veleno.
description_zh: Needle-like hair found on a Rathian's back and wings. They contain poison.

name: Rathian Spike+
description: As sharp as the keenest blade. It is longer and sturdier than other spikes.
description_de: So scharf wie die kühnste Klinge. Länger und robuster als andere Stacheln.
description_fr: Poil long et solide, plus tranchant qu'une épée.
description_es: Más larga y fuerte que otras púas, y afilada como la mejor de las espadas.
description_it: Affilata come un rasoio, questa punta è più lunga e resistente del normale.
description_zh: As sharp as the keenest blade. It is longer and sturdier than other spikes.

name: Rathian Surspike
description: Only a few of these superior spikes grow on a Rathian. It is both sharp and highly toxic.
description_de: Eine Rathian hat nur wenige dieser wirksamen Stacheln. Sie sind scharf und giftig.
description_fr: Les Rathian ne possèdent pas beaucoup de ces pointes tranchantes et toxiques.
description_es: Crecen pocas púas superiores como esta en una Rathian. Afilada y muy tóxica.
description_it: Ogni Rathian ha alcuni ottimi aculei come questi. Sono affilati e molto tossici.
description_zh: Only a few of these superior spikes grow on a Rathian. It is both sharp and highly toxic.

name: Rathian Plate
description: A searing tail scale. Hard to come by and as fiery as the wyvern it came from.
description_de: Sengende Schwanzschuppe. Schwer zu kriegen und feurig wie der Wyvern selbst.
description_fr: Écaille de queue brûlante. Dure et aussi ardente que la wyverne qui la portait.
description_es: Parte de la cola. Difícil de encontrar y tan temible como el wyvern al que pertenece.
description_it: Scaglia incandescente della coda. È rara e ardente come il wyvern a cui appartiene.
description_zh: A searing tail scale. Hard to come by and as fiery as the wyvern it came from.

name: Rathian Ruby
description: A rare, precious gem from inside a wyvern. Almost too nice to use.
description_de: Edelstein aus einem Wyvern. So schön, dass man ihn kaum benutzen möchte.
description_fr: Pierre précieuse extraite d'une wyverne. D'une somptueuse beauté.
description_es: Gema rara y preciosa hallada en el interior de un wyvern. Demasiado bella para usarla.
description_it: Una rara e preziosa gemma dall'interno di un wyvern. Quasi troppo bella.
description_zh: A rare, precious gem from inside a wyvern. Almost too nice to use.

name: Rathian Mantle
description: A legendary Rathian scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendäre Rathian-Schuppe. Wer sie bearbeitet, soll der Herrscher der Welt sein.
description_fr: Une écaille légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Escama legendaria de Rathian. Los que la usen gobernarán la tierra y el cielo.
description_it: Scaglia di Rathian leggendaria. Si dice che chi la lavora possa conquistare cielo e terra.
description_zh: A legendary Rathian scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Rathian Scale
description: Darker than normal Rathian scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als andere Rathian- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Rathian normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Rathian normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Rathian, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Rathian scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Rathian Shard
description: Darker than normal Rathian scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Rathian-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Rathian normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Rathian normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Rathian, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Rathian scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Dreadqueen Scale
description: A Dreadqueen Rathian scale. Its deadly poison makes it too dangerous to even touch.
description_de: Giftstachel-Rathian-Schuppe. Zu giftig zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Écaille de Rathian Reine-poison. Attention, poison mortel. Il ne faut pas la toucher.
description_es: Escama de Rathian Maldita. Su letal veneno hace que resulte demasiado peligroso tocarla.
description_it: Scaglia di Imperatrix Rathian. Il veleno rende un azzardo anche solo sfiorarla.
description_zh: A Dreadqueen Rathian scale. Its deadly poison makes it too dangerous to even touch.

name: Dreadqueen Scale+
description: A hardened Dreadqueen Rathian scale. Its poison makes it too dangerous to even touch.
description_de: Gehärtete Giftstachel-Rathian- Schuppe. Zu giftig zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Écaille durcie de Rathian Reine-poison. Poison mortel. Il ne faut pas la toucher.
description_es: Escama endurecida de Rathian Maldita. Es tan venenosa que es muy peligroso tocarla.
description_it: Scaglia dura di Imperatrix Rathian. Il veleno rende un azzardo anche solo sfiorarla.
description_zh: A hardened Dreadqueen Rathian scale. Its poison makes it too dangerous to even touch.

name: Dreadqueen Shard
description: A hardened Dreadqueen Rathian scale so poisonous that it can only be handled by professionals.
description_de: Diese Giftstachel-Rathian- Schuppe ist so giftig, dass nur Profis sie anfassen sollten.
description_fr: Écaille durcie de Rathian Reine-poison. Si toxique qu'elle est réservée aux professionnels.
description_es: Escama dura de Rathian Maldita. Su letal veneno hace que solo expertos puedan manejarla.
description_it: Scaglia dura di Imperatrix Rathian così velenosa che pochi la possono usare.
description_zh: A hardened Dreadqueen Rathian scale so poisonous that it can only be handled by professionals.

name: Dreadqueen Shell
description: A Dreadqueen Rathian shell. Its deadly poison makes it too dangerous to even touch.
description_de: Giftstachel-Rathian-Panzer. Zu giftig zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Carapace de Rathian Reine-poison au poison mortel. Attention, mieux vaut ne pas la toucher.
description_es: Caparazón de Rathian Maldita. Su letal veneno hace que sea demasiado peligroso tocarla.
description_it: Corazza di Imperatrix Rathian. Il veleno rende un azzardo anche solo sfiorarla.
description_zh: A Dreadqueen Rathian shell. Its deadly poison makes it too dangerous to even touch.

name: Dreadqueen Carapace
description: A Dreadqueen Rathian carapace. Its deadly poison makes it too dangerous to even touch.
description_de: Rückenpanzer des Giftstachel-Rathian Zu giftig zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Rathian Reine-poison au poison mortel. Attention, mieux vaut ne pas la toucher.
description_es: Coraza de Rathian Maldita. Su letal veneno hace que resulte demasiado peligroso tocarla.
description_it: Carapace di Imperatrix Rathian. Il veleno rende un azzardo anche solo sfiorarlo.
description_zh: A Dreadqueen Rathian carapace. Its deadly poison makes it too dangerous to even touch.

name: Dreadqueen Cortex
description: A hardened Dreadqueen Rathian carapace so poisonous that it can only be handled by professionals.
description_de: Dieser Giftstachel-Rathian- Panzer ist so giftig, dass nur Profis ihn anfassen sollten.
description_fr: Carapace durcie de Rathian Reine-poison. Si toxique qu'elle est réservée aux professionnels.
description_es: Coraza muy dura de Rathian Maldita. Es tan venenosa que solo los expertos pueden trabajarla.
description_it: Corteccia dura di Imperatrix Rathian, così velenosa che pochi la possono usare.
description_zh: A hardened Dreadqueen Rathian carapace so poisonous that it can only be handled by professionals.

name: G.Rathian Scale+
description: Scale carved from the body of a Gold Rathian. Brilliant, even at night.
description_de: Schuppe aus dem Körper der Goldenen Rathian. Strahlt selbst nachts.
description_fr: Écaille qui brille même en pleine nuit.
description_es: Escama extraída del cuerpo de una Rathian Dorada. Brillante día y noche.
description_it: Scaglia ricavata dal corpo di una Rathian dorata. Brilla anche di notte.
description_zh: Scale carved from the body of a Gold Rathian. Brilliant, even at night.

name: G.Rathian Shard
description: A thick Gold Rathian scale unlike anything seen before. Sunlight gives it an almost sacred glow.
description_de: Dicke, außergewöhnliche Schuppe einer Goldenen Rathian von heiligem Glanz.
description_fr: Écaille épaisse de Rathian d'or. Prend des reflets presque sacrés au soleil.
description_es: Escama gruesa de Rathian Dorada singular. El sol le da un brillo casi sagrado.
description_it: Spessa e insolita scaglia di Rathian dorata. La luce del sole le dà un bagliore unico.
description_zh: A thick Gold Rathian scale unlike anything seen before. Sunlight gives it an almost sacred glow.

name: G.Rathian Carapace
description: A hard shell covered in shining gold scales. As gorgeous as a gold bar.
description_de: Ein harter Panzer mit golden leuchtenden Schuppen. So schön wie ein Goldbarren.
description_fr: Une cuirasse couverte d'écailles dorées aussi belle qu'un lingot d'or.
description_es: Durísima coraza cubierta de escamas doradas. Parece un lingote de oro.
description_it: Dura corazza coperta di lucenti scaglie dorate. Sontuosa come un lingotto.
description_zh: A hard shell covered in shining gold scales. As gorgeous as a gold bar.

name: G.Rathian Cortex
description: A cortex carved from a Gold Rathian. All who see it gasp at its intense glow.
description_de: Kortex einer Goldenen Rathian. Der Glanz lässt einem den Atem stocken.
description_fr: Cortex de Rathian dorée. Sa lueur intense surprend tous ceux qui la voient.
description_es: Corteza de Rathian Dorada. Los que la ven quedan boquiabiertos por su brillo.
description_it: Corteccia di Rathian dorata. Chi la vede ne ammira l'intenso bagliore.
description_zh: A cortex carved from a Gold Rathian. All who see it gasp at its intense glow.

name: G.Rathian Spike+
description: A sharp, poison-tipped hair strand from the Gold Rathian that resembles a sword.
description_de: Spitze, vergiftete Strähne der Goldenen Rathian, die einem Schwert ähnlich ist.
description_fr: Poil acéré et enduit du venin de la Rathian d'or. Ressemble à une épée.
description_es: Un solo cabello afilado y venenoso de la Rathian Dorada, similar a una espada.
description_it: Ciocca di peli della Rathian dorata. È intrisa di veleno e appuntita come una spada.
description_zh: A sharp, poison-tipped hair strand from the Gold Rathian that resembles a sword.

name: G.Rath Surspike
description: A poisonous spike found on Gold Rathians in rare circumstances. It can pierce through anything.
description_de: Sehr seltener Giftstachel einer Goldenen Rathian. Durchdringt einfach alles.
description_fr: Pointe empoisonnée de Rathian dorée. Peut tout transpercer. Rare.
description_es: Púa venenosa encontrada en Rathian Doradas raras veces. Lo perfora todo.
description_it: Aculeo avvelenato che si trova sulle Rathian dorate in rari casi. Penetra qualsiasi cosa.
description_zh: A poisonous spike found on Gold Rathians in rare circumstances. It can pierce through anything.

name: Hyper G.Rathian Scale
description: Darker than normal Gold Rathian scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Gold- Rathian-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Rathian d'or normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Rathian Dorada normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Rathian dorata, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Gold Rathian scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper G.Rathian Shard
description: Darker than normal Gold Rathian scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale GoldRathian-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Rathian d'or normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Rathian Dorada, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Rathian, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Gold Rathian scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Rathalos Scale
description: A Rathalos scale. Wyvern scales and shells such as this are fundamental forging materials.
description_de: Wyvernschuppen und -panzer wie diese sind elementare Schmiedeobjekte.
description_fr: Les écailles et carapaces de wyvernes sont des matériaux de base pour la forge.
description_es: Escama de Rathalos. Material básico de forja, junto con los caparazones de wyvern.
description_it: Corazze robuste e scaglie di wyvern come questa sono alla base della forgiatura.
description_zh: A Rathalos scale. Wyvern scales and shells such as this are fundamental forging materials.

name: Rathalos Scale+
description: An extraordinarily durable scale carved from the body of a Rathalos.
description_de: Die außergewöhnlich haltbare Schuppe eines Rathalos.
description_fr: Écaille de Rathalos extraordinairement solide.
description_es: Escama de un Rathalos. Extraordinariamente duradera.
description_it: Una scaglia dalla resistenza straordinaria ricavata da un Rathalos.
description_zh: An extraordinarily durable scale carved from the body of a Rathalos.

name: Rathalos Shard
description: A Rathalos part made of several overlapping scales. Its strength is a natural wonder.
description_de: Teil eines Rathalos aus geschichteten Schuppen. Die Stärke ist ein Naturwunder.
description_fr: Bout de Rathalos constitué d'écailles superposées. Naturellement puissant.
description_es: Parte de Rathalos formada por escamas superpuestas. Destaca su belleza natural.
description_it: Parte di Rathalos composta da scaglie sovrapposte. Resistenza stupefacente.
description_zh: A Rathalos part made of several overlapping scales. Its strength is a natural wonder.

name: Rathalos Shell
description: A shell piece comprised of layered scales, making it much harder than just one.
description_de: Ein Panzer-Stück aus geschichteten Schuppen. Dadurch ist es viel härter.
description_fr: Carapace résistante composée de plusieurs couches d'écailles.
description_es: Un caparazón de Rathalos, formado por numerosas escamas. Muy duro.
description_it: Questa corazza ha numerosi strati di scaglie per una maggiore resistenza.
description_zh: A shell piece comprised of layered scales, making it much harder than just one.

name: Rathalos Carapace
description: A rigid Rathalos carapace. Even harder than a normal Rathalos Shell.
description_de: Robuster Rückenpanzer eines Rathalos. Sogar härter als ein normaler Rathalos-Panzer.
description_fr: Plus dure qu'une carapace de Rathalos normale.
description_es: Coraza robusta de un Rathalos. Es incluso más dura que su caparazón.
description_it: Più duro anche della normale corazza di Rathalos.
description_zh: A rigid Rathalos carapace. Even harder than a normal Rathalos Shell.

name: Rathalos Cortex
description: A robust Rathalos shell that is harder and sturdier than the carapace.
description_de: Robuster Rathalos-Panzer, härter und stabiler als der Rückenpanzer.
description_fr: Carapace robuste de Rathalos. Plus dure et plus solide qu'une cuirasse.
description_es: Placa robusta de un Rathalos, más dura y resistente que su caparazón.
description_it: Robusta corazza di Rathalos, più dura e resistente di un carapace.
description_zh: A robust Rathalos shell that is harder and sturdier than the carapace.

name: Rathalos Webbing
description: This heat-resistant material is often used as armor lining.
description_de: Diesen hitzebeständigen Stoff benutzt man oft als Rüstungsinnenfutter.
description_fr: Ce matériaux résistant à la chaleur est souvent utilisé dans les armures.
description_es: Muy resistente al calor y utilizada a menudo como tela en armaduras.
description_it: Materiale resistente al calore, spesso usato per l'interno delle corazze.
description_zh: This heat-resistant material is often used as armor lining.

name: Rathalos Wing
description: A wing that has been removed. Skilled artisans can craft it into strong equipment.
description_de: Ein entfernter Flügel. Fähige Handwerker fertigen daraus mächtige Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Une aile déchirée. Les bons artisans peuvent en faire un bon usage.
description_es: Ala arrancada. Un buen artesano puede convertirla en equipamiento resistente.
description_it: Ala che può essere lavorata per creare equipaggiamento resistente.
description_zh: A wing that has been removed. Skilled artisans can craft it into strong equipment.

name: Rathalos Fellwing
description: A top-grade Rathalos wing, removed in full. Such majesty befits the King of the Skies.
description_de: Hochwertiger Rathalos- Flügel, komplett abgetrennt. Ausgesprochen majestätisch.
description_fr: Aile entière de haute qualité. Majestueuse, elle sied au roi des cieux.
description_es: Sublime ala de Rathalos extraída de una pieza. Digna del rey de los cielos.
description_it: Ala che può essere lavorata per creare equipaggiamento resistente.
description_zh: A top-grade Rathalos wing, removed in full. Such majesty befits the King of the Skies.

name: Rathalos Tail
description: The severed tail of a Rathalos. It has any number of uses.
description_de: Der abgetrennte Schwanz eines Rathalos. Erfüllt viele Verwendungszwecke.
description_fr: La queue coupée d'un Rathalos. A de multiples usages.
description_es: Cola de un Rathalos. Un objeto multiusos.
description_it: La coda mozzata di un Rathalos. Un oggetto dai molti usi.
description_zh: The severed tail of a Rathalos. It has any number of uses.

name: Rathalos Lash
description: Top-grade Rathalos tail. Strong ones like this are precious, and only used in select equipment.
description_de: Hochwertiger Rathalos- Schwanz. Wertvoll und nur für ausgewählte Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Queue de haute qualité. Précieuse, elle est utilisée pour de rares équipements.
description_es: Excelente cola de Rathalos. Su fortaleza es valiosísima. Solo en el mejor equipo.
description_it: Eccellente coda di Rathalos. È preziosa e si usa solo per i migliori equipaggiamenti.
description_zh: Top-grade Rathalos tail. Strong ones like this are precious, and only used in select equipment.

name: Rathalos Plate
description: A searing tail scale. Hard to come by and as fiery as the wyvern it came from.
description_de: Sengende Schwanzschuppe. Schwer zu kriegen und feurig wie der Wyvern selbst.
description_fr: Écaille de queue brûlante. Dure et aussi ardente que la wyverne qui la portait.
description_es: Parte de la cola. Difícil de encontrar y tan temible como el wyvern al que pertenece.
description_it: Scaglia incandescente della coda. È rara e ardente come il wyvern a cui appartiene.
description_zh: A searing tail scale. Hard to come by and as fiery as the wyvern it came from.

name: Rathalos Ruby
description: A rare, precious gem from inside a wyvern. Almost too nice to use.
description_de: Edelstein aus einem Wyvern. So schön, dass man ihn kaum benutzen möchte.
description_fr: Pierre précieuse extraite d'une wyverne. D'une somptueuse beauté.
description_es: Gema rara y preciosa hallada en el interior de un wyvern. Demasiado bella para usarla.
description_it: Gemma rara e preziosa di un wyvern. È fin troppo bella per essere utilizzata.
description_zh: A rare, precious gem from inside a wyvern. Almost too nice to use.

name: Rathalos Mantle
description: A legendary Rathalos scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendäre Rathalos-Schuppe. Wer sie verarbeitet, soll der Herrscher der Welt sein.
description_fr: Une écaille légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Escama legendaria de Rathalos. Quienes la utilicen a su favor reinarán sobre tierra y cielo.
description_it: Scaglia di Rathalos leggendaria. Si dice che chi la lavora possa conquistare cielo e terra.
description_zh: A legendary Rathalos scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Rathalos Scale
description: Darker than normal Rathalos scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Rathalos- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Rathalos normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Rathalos normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Rathalos, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Rathalos scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Rathalos Shard
description: Darker than normal Rathalos scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Rathalos-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une écaille de Rathalos normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Rathalos normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Rathalos, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Rathalos scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Dreadking Scale
description: A Dreadking Rathalos scale. It remains red-hot. Not recommended to touch.
description_de: Dunkelfeuer-Rathalos-Schuppe. Zu glühend heiß zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Écaille de Rathalos Roi-enfer. Toujours brûlante, mieux vaut ne pas la toucher.
description_es: Escama de Rathalos Maldito. Se mantiene al rojo vivo. Se recomienda no tocarla.
description_it: Scaglia di Rex Rathalos. È ancora incandescente, non conviene toccarla.
description_zh: A Dreadking Rathalos scale. It remains red-hot. Not recommended to touch.

name: Dreadking Scale+
description: A hardened Dreadking Rathalos scale. It remains red-hot. Not recommended to touch.
description_de: Gehärtete Dunkelfeuer-Rathalos- Schuppe. Zu glühend heiß zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Écaille dure de Rathalos Roi-enfer. Toujours brûlante, mieux vaut ne pas la toucher.
description_es: Escama endurecida de R. Maldito. Se mantiene al rojo vivo. Se recomienda no tocarla.
description_it: Scaglia dura di Rex Rathalos. È ancora incandescente, non conviene toccarla.
description_zh: A hardened Dreadking Rathalos scale. It remains red-hot. Not recommended to touch.

name: Dreadking Shard
description: A hardened Dreadking Rathalos scale so red-hot, it should only be handled by professionals.
description_de: Erlesene Dunkelfeuer-Rathalos- Schuppe. Zu glühend heiß zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Écaille durcie de Rathalos Roi-enfer. Si brûlante qu'elle est réservée aux professionnels.
description_es: Escama muy dura de Rath Maldito. Está tan caliente que solo los expertos pueden manejarla.
description_it: Scaglia dura di Rex Rathalos, così bollente che può essere usata solo da professionisti.
description_zh: A hardened Dreadking Rathalos scale so red-hot, it should only be handled by professionals.

name: Dreadking Shell
description: A Dreadking Rathalos shell. It remains red-hot. Not recommended to touch.
description_de: Dunkelfeuer-Rathalos-Panzer. Zu glühend heiß zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Carapace de Rathalos Roi-enfer. Toujours brûlante, mieux vaut ne pas la toucher.
description_es: Caparazón de Rathalos Maldito. Se mantiene al rojo vivo. Se recomienda no tocarlo.
description_it: Corazza di Rex Rathalos. È ancora incandescente, non conviene toccarla.
description_zh: A Dreadking Rathalos shell. It remains red-hot. Not recommended to touch.

name: Dreadking Carapace
description: A hardened Dreadking Rathalos shell. It remains red-hot. Not recommended to touch.
description_de: Gehärteter Dunkelfeuer- Rathalos-Panzer. Zu glühend heiß zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Rathalos Roi-enfer. Toujours brûlante, mieux vaut ne pas la toucher.
description_es: Caparazón endurecido de R. Maldito. Se mantiene al rojo vivo. Se recomienda no tocarlo.
description_it: Corazza dura di Rex Rathalos. È ancora incandescente, non conviene toccarla.
description_zh: A hardened Dreadking Rathalos shell. It remains red-hot. Not recommended to touch.

name: Dreadking Cortex
description: A hardened Dreadking Rathalos shell so red-hot, it should only be handled by professionals.
description_de: Erlesener Dunkelfeuer- Rathalos-Panzer. Zu glühend heiß zum Anfassen.
description_fr: Carapace durcie de Rathalos Roi-enfer. Si brûlante qu'elle est réservée aux professionnels.
description_es: Caparazón muy duro de Rath Maldito. Tan caliente que solo los expertos pueden manejarla.
description_it: Corteccia dura di Rex Rathalos, così fervente che può essere usata solo da professionisti.
description_zh: A hardened Dreadking Rathalos shell so red-hot, it should only be handled by professionals.

name: S.Rathalos Scale+
description: Quality scale carved from a Silver Rathalos. It has a moon-like shine.
description_de: Die hochwertige Schuppe des Silbernen Rathalos. Strahlt wie der Mond.
description_fr: Écaille de qualité prise sur un Rathalos d'argent. Elle brille comme la lune.
description_es: Escama de calidad de un Rathalos Plateado. Brilla como la luna.
description_it: Scaglia di qualità del Rathalos argentato. Brilla come la luna.
description_zh: Quality scale carved from a Silver Rathalos. It has a moon-like shine.

name: S.Rathalos Shard
description: A Silver Rathalos part made of several overlapping scales. Makes for a nice accessory.
description_de: Silberner-Rathalos-Teil aus geschichteten Schuppen. Nettes silbernes Accessoire.
description_fr: Bout de Rathalos d'argent constitué d'écailles superposées. Bel accessoire.
description_es: Parte de Rathalos plateado con escamas superpuestas. Para accesorios de plata.
description_it: Parte di Rathalos argentato composta da scaglie sovrapposte. Bella come accessorio.
description_zh: A Silver Rathalos part made of several overlapping scales. Makes for a nice accessory.

name: S.Rathalos Carapace
description: Carapace carved from a Silver Rathalos. The silver scales have an icy shine.
description_de: Die Silberschuppen an diesem Rückenpanzer des silbernen Rathalos glänzen eisig.
description_fr: Écailles de la dure carapace du Rathalos d'argent. Brillent comme la glace.
description_es: Las escamas de la coraza de un Rathalos Plateado brillan como el hielo.
description_it: Scaglie del carapace di un Rathalos argentato; brillano come il ghiaccio.
description_zh: Carapace carved from a Silver Rathalos. The silver scales have an icy shine.

name: S.Rath Cortex
description: A heavy Silver Rathalos cortex. This legendary item shines like moonlight, even in darkness.
description_de: Schwerer Kortex eines Silbernen Rathalos. Er leuchtet wie der Mond.
description_fr: Cortex lourd de Rathalos d'argent. Objet légendaire qui brille dans l'obscurité.
description_es: Placa dura de Rathalos plateado. Brilla como la luna e ilumina el camino.
description_it: Corteccia pesante di Rathalos argentato. Risplende anche nell'oscurità come la luna.
description_zh: A heavy Silver Rathalos cortex. This legendary item shines like moonlight, even in darkness.

name: S.Rathalos Tail
description: Severed tail of a Silver Rathalos. Sells at a high price due to its rarity.
description_de: Der Schwanz eines Silbernen Rathalos. Seine Seltenheit erklärt den hohen Wert.
description_fr: La queue coupée d'un Rathalos d'argent. Sa rareté fait sa valeur.
description_es: Cola cortada de un Rathalos Plateado. De gran valor debido a su escasez.
description_it: Coda tagliata a un Rathalos argentato. È rara e quindi molto preziosa.
description_zh: Severed tail of a Silver Rathalos. Sells at a high price due to its rarity.

name: S.Rath Lash
description: A top-grade Silver Rathalos tail. Beauty like this is worth far more than actual silver.
description_de: Hochwertiger Schwanz eines Silbernen Rathalos. Noch viel wertvoller als Silber.
description_fr: Queue de haute qualité de Rathalos d'argent. Vaut bien plus que de l'argent.
description_es: Excelente cola de Rathalos plateado. Su belleza es superior a la de la plata.
description_it: Eccellente coda di Rathalos argentato. Tanto bella da essere più preziosa del vero argento.
description_zh: A top-grade Silver Rathalos tail. Beauty like this is worth far more than actual silver.

name: Hyper S.Rath. Scale
description: Darker than normal Silver Rathalos scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Silber- Rathalos-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Rathalos d'argent normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Rathalos Plateado normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Rathalos argentato, scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Silver Rathalos scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper S.Rath. Shard
description: Darker than normal Rathalos scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale SiRathalos-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide que l'écaille de Rathalos d'argent normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Rathalos Plateado, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Rathalos, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Rathalos scales, this tough Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Rath Wingtalon
description: A talon that grows on a wyvern's wing. Break it off in battle and you may just be rewarded.
description_de: Kralle, die an einem Wyvern- Flügel wächst. Brich sie im Kampf für eine Belohnung ab.
description_fr: Une serre de wyverne située sur l'aile. Brisez-la durant le combat pour l'acquérir.
description_es: Zarpa que crece en las alas de los wyverns. Rómpela y puede que recibas una recompensa.
description_it: Sperone dell'ala di un wyvern. Ricompensa per chi lo spezza in battaglia.
description_zh: A talon that grows on a wyvern's wing. Break it off in battle and you may just be rewarded.

name: Rath Wingtalon+
description: A powerful talon from a wyvern's wing. Hard and sharp enough to rend boulders like paper.
description_de: Mächtige Kralle von einem Wyvern-Flügel. Sie schneidet Stein wie Papier.
description_fr: Serre puissante. Si acérée et dure qu'elle fend les rochers comme du beurre.
description_es: Zarpa poderosa del ala de un wyvern. Dura y afilada, desgarra rocas como papel.
description_it: Potente sperone dell'ala di un wyvern. Taglia le rocce come fossero carta.
description_zh: A powerful talon from a wyvern's wing. Hard and sharp enough to rend boulders like paper.

name: Rath Marrow
description: Recent advances allow this marrow to be extracted. It ignites on air contact.
description_de: Wird durch neue Techniken gewonnen. Entzündet sich durch Luftkontakt.
description_fr: Un matériau extrait grâce à une technique récente. Prend feu au contact de l'air.
description_es: Médula extraída con técnicas novedosas. Arde al contacto con el aire.
description_it: Midollo ricavabile grazie a tecniche recenti. Brucia a contatto con l'aria.
description_zh: Recent advances allow this marrow to be extracted. It ignites on air contact.

name: Rath Medulla
description: Only recently extractable thanks to advances in carving techniques. Difficult to process.
description_de: Kann dank neuster Technik als Material genutzt werden. Schwer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Un matériau difficile à travailler, nécessitant une technologie avancée.
description_es: Extraíble únicamente gracias a las últimas tecnologías, pero aún es muy difícil de trabajar.
description_it: Bulbo ricavabile grazie a tecniche recenti. È piuttosto difficile da lavorare.
description_zh: Only recently extractable thanks to advances in carving techniques. Difficult to process.

name: Rath Gleam
description: A liquid produced only by a rare species of fire wyverns. It glows faintly in the dark.
description_de: Flüssigkeit, die nur von seltenen Feuerwyvern erzeugt wird. Leuchtet schwach im Dunkeln.
description_fr: Liquide produit par une espèce rare de wyverne de feu. Faible lueur dans l'obscurité.
description_es: Líquido que solo produce una especie rara de wyvern de fuego. Brilla en la oscuridad.
description_it: Liquido prodotto solo da rare specie di wyvern del fuoco. Emana un bagliore al buio.
description_zh: A liquid produced only by a rare species of fire wyverns. It glows faintly in the dark.

name: Firegleam Dollop
description: A shining fluid produced only in rare wyverns. Even now, it continues to boil.
description_de: Glänzende Flüssigkeit, die nur in seltenen Wyvern er- zeugt wird. Sie kocht noch.
description_fr: Liquide luisant produit par quelques rares wyvernes de feu. Il bouillonne encore.
description_es: Un fluido brillante que producen algunos wyverns. No deja de hervir.
description_it: Un fluido scintillante prodotto da esemplari rari di wyvern. Non ha ancora perso ardore.
description_zh: A shining fluid produced only in rare wyverns. Even now, it continues to boil.

name: Zinogre Shell
description: A blue-green shell which stores electricity and works as a protective insulator.
description_de: Blaugrüner Panzer, der Elektrizität speichert und als Schutzisolator dient.
description_fr: Carapace bleu-vert stockant de l'électricité et faisant office d'isolant protecteur.
description_es: Caparazón verdeazulado que almacena electricidad y actúa como aislante.
description_it: Corazza blu-verdastra che accumula elettricità e funge da isolante protettivo.
description_zh: A blue-green shell which stores electricity and works as a protective insulator.

name: Zinogre Carapace
description: The teal carapace of a Zinogre. Its magnificence reveals the futility of facing the monarch.
description_de: Blaugrüner Rückenpanzer eines Zinogre. Er zeigt, dass ein Angriff sinnlos ist.
description_fr: Sa splendeur montre à quel point il est futile d'attaquer ce monarque.
description_es: Coraza turquesa de un Zinogre. Su magnificencia le da un aspecto invencible.
description_it: Carapace turchese di Zinogre, tanto magnifico da scoraggiare ogni attacco.
description_zh: The teal carapace of a Zinogre. Its magnificence reveals the futility of facing the monarch.

name: Zinogre Cortex
description: The teal cortex of a Zinogre. The monarch's armor crushes wills with its immense power.
description_de: Blaugrüner Zinogre-Kortex. Die Monarchen-Rüstung bricht den Willen mit Kraft.
description_fr: Le pouvoir immense de l'armure du monarque est dissuasif.
description_es: Corteza turquesa de Zinogre. La armadura real doblega a todos con su inmenso poder.
description_it: Corteccia turchese di Zinogre dal potere straordinariamente distruttivo.
description_zh: The teal cortex of a Zinogre. The monarch's armor crushes wills with its immense power.

name: Zinogre Shockfur
description: White fur that stores and magnifies electricity, which it retains even after carving.
description_de: Weißes Fell. Die enthaltene verstärkte Elektrizität wird auch nach Zerlegen erhalten.
description_fr: Fourrure blanche qui stocke et amplifie l'électricité, conservée après le dépeçage.
description_es: Piel blanca que almacena y magnifica la electricidad, incluso después de tallarla.
description_it: Pelo bianco che accumula e amplifica l'elettricità, conservandola per sempre.
description_zh: White fur that stores and magnifies electricity, which it retains even after carving.

name: Zinogre Electrofur
description: Zinogre fur said to store a high amount of electricity. Shines white from the charge.
description_de: Zinogre-Fell speichert große Mengen an Elektrizität. Leuchtet durch Ladung weiß.
description_fr: Une fourrure brillante qui renferme une grande quantité d'électricité.
description_es: El pelo de Zinogre es capaz de almacenar mucha electricidad, e irradia un brillo blanco.
description_it: Pelo di Zinogre che conserva l'elettricità, brillando di luce bianca.
description_zh: Zinogre fur said to store a high amount of electricity. Shines white from the charge.

name: Zinogre Electrofur+
description: Zinogre fur said to store an endless amount of electricity. Shines with intense light.
description_de: Zinogre-Fell, speichert große Mengen Elektrizität. Leuchtet sehr hell.
description_fr: Contenant une quantité infinie d'électricité. Brille intensément.
description_es: La piel de Zinogre almacena infinita electricidad. Brilla con luz intensa.
description_it: Pelo di Zinogre che conserva l'elettricità, brillando in modo intenso.
description_zh: Zinogre fur said to store an endless amount of electricity. Shines with intense light.

name: Zinogre Horn
description: The Zinogre's magnificent horn, which sends most of nature running for cover.
description_de: Wundervolles Zinogre-Horn, das fast jedes Lebewesen in Deckung gehen lässt.
description_fr: Corne majestueuse qui fait fuir la plupart des êtres vivants.
description_es: Majestuoso cuerno de Zinogre que provoca la huida de todo ser vivo.
description_it: Il magnifico corno dello Zinogre, temuto e rifuggito da creature di ogni sorta.
description_zh: The Zinogre's magnificent horn, which sends most of nature running for cover.

name: Zinogre Horn+
description: A pointed Zinogre horn. When carved, it can be used to grant equipment incomparable power.
description_de: Ein spitzes Zinogre-Horn. Bearbeitet verleiht es Aus- rüstung unermessliche Macht.
description_fr: Une corne pointue qui donne à l'équipement un pouvoir incomparable.
description_es: Cuerno puntiagudo de Zinogre. Se usa para otorgar al equipo un poder inmenso.
description_it: Corno appuntito di Zinogre; se intagliato, dona un immenso potere agli equipaggiamenti.
description_zh: A pointed Zinogre horn. When carved, it can be used to grant equipment incomparable power.

name: Zinogre Hardhorn
description: A mighty Zinogre horn. None can stand before its sky-shattering, awe-inspiring power.
description_de: Ein mächtiges Zinogre-Horn. Niemand widersteht seiner unvergleichlichen Macht.
description_fr: Imposante, transperce les cieux et inspire les dieux. Personne ne peut y résister.
description_es: Cuerno poderoso de Zinogre. Todos se doblegan ante su poder divino e inspirador.
description_it: Potente corno di Zinogre, dotato di un potere che incute terrore e fa tremare i cieli.
description_zh: A mighty Zinogre horn. None can stand before its sky-shattering, awe-inspiring power.

name: Zinogre Claw
description: A sharp and tremendously powerful claw capable of quickly dicing up prey.
description_de: Scharfe, extrem mächtige Klaue, die Beute schnell in feine Würfel schneiden kann.
description_fr: Acérée et incroyablement puissante. Coupe rapidement les proies en dés.
description_es: Garra afilada y muy poderosa capaz de hacer pedazos a una presa rápidamente.
description_it: Un artiglio affilato e terribilmente potente. Può squartare qualsiasi preda.
description_zh: A sharp and tremendously powerful claw capable of quickly dicing up prey.

name: Zinogre Claw+
description: A sharp, high voltage Zinogre claw. Its electrified attacks are truly brutal.
description_de: Eine scharfe Starkstrom- Zinogre-Klaue. Ihre Elektro- Angriffe sind gnadenlos.
description_fr: Une griffe à haute tension de Zinogre. Ses attaques électriques sont brutales.
description_es: Garra afilada y eléctrica de un Zinogre. Sus ataques electrificados son brutales.
description_it: Affilato artiglio elettrico di Zinogre, capace di sferrare attacchi brutali.
description_zh: A sharp, high voltage Zinogre claw. Its electrified attacks are truly brutal.

name: Zinogre Hardclaw
description: A rigid, high-voltage Zinogre talon. Its electrified attacks threaten all existence.
description_de: Harte Starkstrom-Zinogre- Kralle. Ihre Elektro-An- griffe bedrohen alles Leben.
description_fr: Serre rigide à haute tension de Zinogre. Ses attaques électriques sont fatales.
description_es: Zarpa rígida y eléctrica de Zinogre. Sus ataques eléctricos son mortíferos.
description_it: Rigido sperone elettrico di Zinogre, capace di attacchi elettrici letali.
description_zh: A rigid, high-voltage Zinogre talon. Its electrified attacks threaten all existence.

name: Zinogre Tail
description: The plate-covered tail of a Zinogre. It wields deadly force when swung.
description_de: Ein gut gepanzerter Zinogre-Schwanz. Wird er geschwungen, ist er tödlich.
description_fr: Une queue de Zinogre couverte de plaques, à la puissance mortelle.
description_es: Cola recubierta de placas de un Zinogre. Al sacudirla ejerce una fuerza descomunal.
description_it: Coda di Zinogre ricoperta di piastre e capace di attacchi letali.
description_zh: The plate-covered tail of a Zinogre. It wields deadly force when swung.

name: Zinogre Lash
description: A superior Zinogre tail that wields incomparable destructive power.
description_de: Hochwertiger Zinogre- Schwanz mit unvergleich- licher Zerstörungskraft.
description_fr: Queue de qualité supérieure possédant un pouvoir destructeur incomparable.
description_es: Cola superior de Zinogre que ejerce un poder destructivo incomparable.
description_it: Ottima coda di Zinogre che possiede un enorme potere distruttivo.
description_zh: A superior Zinogre tail that wields incomparable destructive power.

name: Zinogre Shocker
description: The ocher shell that once lined a Zinogre's body. Contains conductive lipids.
description_de: Ockerfarbener Panzer eines Zinogre. Enthält leitungsfähige Lipide.
description_fr: Recouvrait jadis le corps d'un Zinogre. Contient des lipides conducteurs.
description_es: Caparazón que perteneció a un Zinogre. Contiene lípidos conductores.
description_it: Corazza ocra che ricopriva il corpo di uno Zinogre. Contiene lipidi conduttori.
description_zh: The ocher shell that once lined a Zinogre's body. Contains conductive lipids.

name: Zinogre Shocker+
description: A Zinogre shell that stores and releases electricity. Grants a thunder god's power to gear.
description_de: Zinogre-Panzer, der Elektri- zität speichert und entlädt. Die Kraft des Donnergottes!
description_fr: Carapace possédant le pouvoir du dieu de la foudre.
description_es: El caparazón de los Zinogres almacena su electricidad, y da al equipo poderes eléctricos.
description_it: Corazza di Zinogre caricata elettricamente, che dona il potere del tuono.
description_zh: A Zinogre shell that stores and releases electricity. Grants a thunder god's power to gear.

name: Zinogre D-Shocker
description: A shell with electric power that shames even lightning. Its effect on forged equipment is vast.
description_de: Elektrischer Panzer, stärker als Blitze. Große Wirkung auf bearbeitete Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Si électrique que la foudre en serait jalouse. Très utile pour l'équipement.
description_es: Caparazón con poder eléctrico superior. Su efecto al forjarlo es increíble.
description_it: Corazza dal potere elettrico superiore al fulmine; ideale per la forgiatura.
description_zh: A shell with electric power that shames even lightning. Its effect on forged equipment is vast.

name: Zinogre Plate
description: A rare and intimidating trophy that seems to pulse with residual fury.
description_de: Seltene, einschüchternde Trophäe, die noch immer wütend zu pulsieren scheint.
description_fr: Trophée rare et intimidant qui semble animé d'une fureur résiduelle.
description_es: Trofeo raro e intimidante que aún parece latir con una furia residual.
description_it: Raro e inquietante trofeo che sembra pulsare in un residuo di furia.
description_zh: A rare and intimidating trophy that seems to pulse with residual fury.

name: Zinogre Jasper
description: A rare gem sometimes produced inside a Zinogre's body. The beast's power swells within.
description_de: Seltener Edelstein. Kann im Inneren eines Zinogres entstehen. Enthält die Macht dieser Bestie.
description_fr: Gemme rare à l'intérieur d'un Zinogre. Renferme le pouvoir de la bête.
description_es: Gema que a veces se forma en las entrañas de un Zinogre. Rezuma energía de la bestia.
description_it: Gemma rara che si forma in alcuni Zinogre. Racchiude la forza della belva.
description_zh: A rare gem sometimes produced inside a Zinogre's body. The beast's power swells within.

name: Zinogre Skymerald
description: An extremely rare gem found only in select Zinogres. Proof of the overwhelming warrior.
description_de: Sehr seltener Edelstein spe- zieller Zinogre-Exemplare. Zeichen brillanter Krieger.
description_fr: Gemme extrêmement rare chez certains Zinogre. Preuve d'un immense guerrier.
description_es: Gema muy rara encontrada dentro de algunos Zinogre. Prueba de guerrero poderoso.
description_it: Gemma rarissima e preziosa posseduta da alcuni Zinogre. Il trofeo dei grandi guerrieri.
description_zh: An extremely rare gem found only in select Zinogres. Proof of the overwhelming warrior.

name: Hyper Zinogre Shell
description: Darker than normal Zinogre shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Zinogre- Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la carapace de Zinogre normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que un caparazón de Zinogre normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Zinogre, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Zinogre shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Zinogre Cortex
description: Darker than normal Zinogre shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als nomale Zinogre-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre et solide qu'une carapace de Zinogre normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que un caparazón de Zinogre normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Zinogre, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Zinogre shell, this tough Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Thunderlord Shell
description: A Thunderlord Zinogre shell. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.
description_de: Ein Donnerschlag-Zinogre-Panzer. Selbst ohne Zinogre strahlt er hell und golden.
description_fr: Carapace d'un Zinogre Feu-du-ciel. Brille d'une belle nuance couleur d'or.
description_es: Caparazón de Zinogre Tormenta. Incluso separada del cuerpo, sigue emitiendo un fulgor dorado.
description_it: Corazza di Fulgur Zinogre. Anche se asportata, continua a brillare come oro.
description_zh: A Thunderlord Zinogre shell. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Carapace
description: A hardened Thunderlord Zinogre shell. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.
description_de: Gehärteter Donnerschlag-Zinogre- Panzer. Selbst ohne Zinogre strahlt er hell und golden.
description_fr: Carapace d'un Zinogre Feu-du-ciel. Brille d'une belle nuance couleur d'or.
description_es: Caparazón endurecido de Zinogre Tormenta. Brilla sin cesar con un fulgor dorado.
description_it: Corazza dura di Fulgur Zinogre. Anche se asportata, continua a brillare come oro.
description_zh: A hardened Thunderlord Zinogre shell. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Cortex
description: A tough Thunderlord Zinogre shell. It shines even more brilliantly than gold.
description_de: Erlesener Donnerschlag-Zinogre- Panzer. Strahlt goldener als Gold.
description_fr: Robuste carapace de Zinogre Feu-du-ciel. Brille d'un éclat encore plus aveuglant que l'or.
description_es: Caparazón muy duro de Zinogre Tormenta. Brilla con mucha más intensidad que el oro.
description_it: Corazza molto dura di Fulgur Zinogre. Brilla più dell'oro.
description_zh: A tough Thunderlord Zinogre shell. It shines even more brilliantly than gold.

name: Thunderlord Shockfur
description: A Thunderlord Zinogre pelt. Even on its own, it continues to give off electricity.
description_de: Ein Donnerschlag-Zinogre-Pelz. Selbst ohne Zinogre gibt er Elektrizität ab.
description_fr: Pelage d'un Zinogre Feu-du-ciel. Produit de l'électricité, même loin de la bête.
description_es: Piel de Zinogre Tormenta. Incluso por sí sola sigue generando electricidad.
description_it: Pelliccia di Fulgur Zinogre. Continua tuttora a emettere scosse elettriche.
description_zh: A Thunderlord Zinogre pelt. Even on its own, it continues to give off electricity.

name: Thunderlord Electrofur
description: A gold Thunderlord Zinogre pelt. Even on its own, it continues to give off electricity.
description_de: Ein goldener Donnerschlag- Zinogre-Pelz. Selbst ohne Zinogre gibt er Elektrizität ab.
description_fr: Pelage d'un Zinogre Feu-du-ciel. Produit de l'électricité, même loin de la bête. Couleur or.
description_es: Piel dorada de Zin. Tormenta. Incluso por sí sola sigue generando electricidad.
description_it: Pelliccia dorata di Fulgur Zinogre. Continua tuttora a emettere scosse elettriche.
description_zh: A gold Thunderlord Zinogre pelt. Even on its own, it continues to give off electricity.

name: Thunderlord Boltfur
description: A fine Thunderlord Zinogre pelt that keeps its charge, so care should be taken when holding it.
description_de: Ein erlesener Donnerschlag- Zinogre-Pelz. Steht unter Hochspannung.
description_fr: Pelage d'un Zinogre Feu-du-ciel conservant sa charge électrique. À manier avec précaution.
description_es: Piel de calidad de Zinogre Tormenta. Genera electricidad, así que debe usarse con cuidado.
description_it: Pelliccia pregiata di Fulgur Zinogre che mantiene la carica e va perciò usata con attenzione.
description_zh: A fine Thunderlord Zinogre pelt that keeps its charge, so care should be taken when holding it.

name: Thunderlord Horn
description: A Thunderlord Zinogre horn. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.
description_de: Ein Donnerschlag-Zinogre-Horn. Selbst ohne Zinogre strahlt es hell und golden.
description_fr: Corne d'un Zinogre Feu-du-ciel. Brille d'une belle nuance d'or, même loin de la bête.
description_es: Cuerno de Zinogre Tormenta. Incluso por sí solo irradia un brillo dorado.
description_it: Corno di Fulgur Zinogre. Anche se rimosso, continua a emettere riflessi dorati.
description_zh: A Thunderlord Zinogre horn. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Horn+
description: A fine Thunderlord Zinogre horn. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.
description_de: Feines Donnerschlag-Zinogre- Horn. Selbst ohne Zinogre strahlt es hell und golden.
description_fr: Très jolie corne de Zinogre. Brille d'une superbe nuance d'or, même loin de la bête.
description_es: Cuerno de calidad de Zinogre Tormenta. Incluso por sí solo irradia un brillo dorado.
description_it: Pregevole corno di Fulgur Zinogre. Continua tuttora a emettere riflessi dorati.
description_zh: A fine Thunderlord Zinogre horn. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Gleamhorn
description: A high grade Thunderlord Zinogre horn. It shines even more brilliantly than gold.
description_de: Erlesenes Donnerschlag- Zinogre-Horn. Es strahlt goldener als Gold.
description_fr: Corne de Zinogre Feu-du-ciel de qualité supérieure. Brille d'un éclat encore plus aveuglant que l'or.
description_es: Cuerno superior de Zinogre Tormenta. Brilla con mucha más intensidad que el oro.
description_it: Meraviglioso corno di Fulgur Zinogre. Brilla più dell'oro.
description_zh: A high grade Thunderlord Zinogre horn. It shines even more brilliantly than gold.

name: Astalos Scale
description: An Astalos scale that reflects sunlight, giving it a rainbow-like appearance.
description_de: Eine Astalos-Schuppe, die das Sonnenlicht in den Farben des Regenbogens reflektiert.
description_fr: Écaille d'Astalos qui réfléchit la lumière du soleil et la fait ressembler à un arc-en-ciel.
description_es: Escama de Astalos que refleja la luz solar de forma similar a un arco iris.
description_it: Scaglia di Astalos che riflette la luce solare, assumendo tinte arcobaleno.
description_zh: An Astalos scale that reflects sunlight, giving it a rainbow-like appearance.

name: Astalos Scale+
description: A quality scale carved from an Astalos. Looks tough, but is actually quite flexible.
description_de: Hochwertige Schuppe von einem Astalos. Flexibel, auch wenn sie starr wirkt.
description_fr: Écaille qualité venant d'un Astalos. De la souplesse, malgré son aspect robuste.
description_es: Escama de calidad extraída de un Astalos. Parece dura, pero en realidad es bastante flexible.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata di Astalos. Ha un aspetto rigido, ma è piuttosto flessibile.
description_zh: A quality scale carved from an Astalos. Looks tough, but is actually quite flexible.

name: Astalos Shard
description: A high quality scale carved from an Astalos. Looks tough, but is actually quite flexible.
description_de: Erlesene Schuppe von einem Astalos. Flexibel, auch wenn sie starr wirkt.
description_fr: Écaille de grande qualité venant d'un Astalos. Plutôt souple, malgré son aspect robuste.
description_es: Escama de gran calidad de un Astalos. Parece dura, pero en realidad es bastante flexible.
description_it: Scaglia molto pregiata di Astalos. Ha un aspetto rigido, ma è piuttosto flessibile.
description_zh: A high quality scale carved from an Astalos. Looks tough, but is actually quite flexible.

name: Astalos Shell
description: The spiny shell of an Astalos that covers it like armor. Try to keep a safe distance!
description_de: Dorniger Panzer eines Astalos. Dient ihm als Rüstung. Vorsicht, Abstand halten!
description_fr: Carapace piquante d'un Astalos qui s'en sert d'amure. Prière de garder ses distances !
description_es: Caparazón espinoso de Astalos, protege como una armadura. Mantén las distancias.
description_it: Corazza spinosa che avvolge l'Astalos come un'armatura. Non conviene avvicinarsi!
description_zh: The spiny shell of an Astalos that covers it like armor. Try to keep a safe distance!

name: Astalos Shell+
description: An Astalos's tough, spiny shell. Hard and sharp, it's a favored material for armor.
description_de: Starker, dorniger Panzer eines Astalos. Hart und scharf. Ein guter Grundstoff für Rüstungen.
description_fr: Épaisse carapace piquante d'un Astalos. On en fait d'excellentes armures.
description_es: Caparazón duro y espinoso de Astalos. Duro y afilado, se usa para fabricar armaduras.
description_it: Corazza di Astalos robusta e coperta di spine affilate che la rendono un'ottima difesa.
description_zh: An Astalos's tough, spiny shell. Hard and sharp, it's a favored material for armor.

name: Heavy Astalos Shell
description: The spiny shell of an Astalos that covers it like armor. Try to keep a safe distance!
description_de: Sein dorniger Panzer schützt den Astalos wie eine Rüstung. Da sollte man Abstand halten!
description_fr: Épaisse carapace piquante d'un Astalos faisant office d'armure. Prière de garder ses distances !
description_es: Caparazón robusto y espinoso de Astalos que lo protege cual armadura. ¡Mantén la distancia!
description_it: Corazza di Astalos ricoperta di spine che lo avvolge come un'armatura. Stanne alla larga!
description_zh: The spiny shell of an Astalos that covers it like armor. Try to keep a safe distance!

name: Astalos Membrane
description: An Astalos wing membrane. It glows when exposed to electricity. Thin but tough.
description_de: Schwingenmembran eines Astalos. Glüht beim Kontakt mit Elektrizität. Dünn, aber hart.
description_fr: Membrane d'aile d'Astalos. Luit sous l'effet de stimulations électriques. Fine et résistante.
description_es: Membrana de ala de Astalos. Al exponerla a la electricidad, brilla. Es fina pero resistente.
description_it: Membrana alare di Astalos. Sottile ma robusta, brilla a contatto con l'elettricità.
description_zh: An Astalos wing membrane. It glows when exposed to electricity. Thin but tough.

name: Astalos Membrane+
description: Quality Astalos wing membrane. Pulses green and continues to conduct electricity.
description_de: Gute Schwingenmembran eines Astalos. Pulsiert grün und leitet nach wie vor Elektrizität.
description_fr: Bonne membrane d'aile d'Astalos. Conduit l'électricité et émet des pulsations vertes.
description_es: Membrana de ala de Astalos de calidad. Emite destellos verdes y es conductora.
description_it: Pregiata membrana alare di Astalos. Brilla di verde e conduce elettricità.
description_zh: Quality Astalos wing membrane. Pulses green and continues to conduct electricity.

name: Astalos Wingmembrane
description: High quality wing membrane. Pulses green and continues to conduct electricity.
description_de: Makellose Schwingenmembran eines Astalos. Pulsiert grün und leitet nach wie vor Elektrizität.
description_fr: Membrane d'aile d'Astalos de qualité. Conduit l'électricité et émet des pulsations vertes.
description_es: Membrana de ala de Astalos de calidad. Emite destellos verdes y conduce la electricidad.
description_it: Lussuosa membrana alare di Astalos. Brilla di verde e conduce elettricità.
description_zh: High quality wing membrane. Pulses green and continues to conduct electricity.

name: Astalos Wingtalon
description: An Astalos wingtalon. Black, but turns a beautiful green when exposed to electricity.
description_de: Eine Astalos-Flügelkralle. Schwarz, aber färbt sich bei Kontakt mit Elektrizität grün.
description_fr: Serre d'Astalos noire qui passe à un joli vert sous l'effet d'une stimulation électrique.
description_es: Espolón de Astalos negro. Al exponerlo a la electricidad, se vuelve de color verde.
description_it: Sperone di Astalos. È nero, ma si illumina di verde a contatto con l'elettricità.
description_zh: An Astalos wingtalon. Black, but turns a beautiful green when exposed to electricity.

name: Astalos Wingtalon+
description: A sharp Astalos wingtalon, capable of cutting through its prey in one fell swoop.
description_de: Scharfe Astalos-Flügelkralle. Kann Beute mit einem Schwung zerteilen.
description_fr: Serre acérée d'Astalos capable de découper sa proie d'une seule attaque portée.
description_es: Espolón afilado de Astalos, capaz de desgarrar a su presa de un solo golpe.
description_it: Sperone acuminato con cui l'Astalos squarcia la preda al primo attacco.
description_zh: A sharp Astalos wingtalon, capable of cutting through its prey in one fell swoop.

name: Astalos Wingripper
description: A sharp Astalos wingtalon, capable of cutting through its prey with just a touch.
description_de: Extrascharfe Astalos-Flügelkralle. Kann Beute mit einer kleinen Berührung zerteilen.
description_fr: Serre acérée d'Astalos capable de découper sa proie au moindre contact.
description_es: Espolón afilado de Astalos, capaz de desgarrar a su presa de un toque.
description_it: Sperone acuminato di Astalos. La preda che ne subisce l'attacco esala subito il suo ultimo respiro.
description_zh: A sharp Astalos wingtalon, capable of cutting through its prey with just a touch.

name: Astalos Crest
description: Conductive material can be harvested from an Astalos's head when it's threatened.
description_de: Leitendes Material kann vom Kopf des Astalos gewonnen werden, wenn er bedroht wird.
description_fr: Matériau conducteur pouvant être extrait de la tête d'un Astalos se sentant menacé.
description_es: Material conductor extraído de la cabeza de un Astalos cuando se siente amenazado.
description_it: Se l'Astalos è minacciato, dal cranio si può estrarre materiale conduttivo.
description_zh: Conductive material can be harvested from an Astalos's head when it's threatened.

name: Astalos Crest+
description: A highly conductive material pulsing with electricity that is harvested from an Astalos.
description_de: Hochgradig leitfähiges, elektrisches Material, das man von einem Astalos gewinnt.
description_fr: Matériau très conducteur pouvant être extrait d'un Astalos. Émet des pulsations électriques.
description_es: Material muy conductor y cargado de electricidad que se obtiene del Astalos.
description_it: Materiale conduttivo di Astalos ancora carico di corrente elettrica.
description_zh: A highly conductive material pulsing with electricity that is harvested from an Astalos.

name: Heavy Astalos Crest+
description: A special highly-conductive material pulsing with electricity taken from an Astalos head.
description_de: Extrem leitfähiges, elektrisches Material vom Kopf eines Astalos.
description_fr: Matériau spécial très conducteur extrait d'une tête d'Astalos. Émet des pulsations électriques.
description_es: Material cargado de electricidad y extremadamente conductor que se obtiene del Astalos.
description_it: Materiale molto conduttivo ricavato dalla testa di Astalos e carico di corrente elettrica.
description_zh: A special highly-conductive material pulsing with electricity taken from an Astalos head.

name: Astalos Scissortail
description: The scissors-shaped tail of an Astalos. It's able to store large amounts of electricity.
description_de: Scherenförmiger Schwanz eines Astalos. Kann große Mengen Elektrizität speichern.
description_fr: Queue d'Astalos en forme de ciseaux. Capable de stocker de grandes quantités d'électricité.
description_es: Cola con forma de tijera de Astalos. Puede almacenar una gran cantidad de electricidad.
description_it: Coda a forbice di Astalos. Può accumulare grandi quantità di elettricità.
description_zh: The scissors-shaped tail of an Astalos. It's able to store large amounts of electricity.

name: Astalos Scissortailblade
description: The scissors-shaped tail of an Astalos. Watch out for its dangerously high voltage.
description_de: Scherenförmiger Schwanz eines Astalos. Kann extrem viel Elektrizität speichern.
description_fr: Queue d'Astalos en forme de ciseaux. Attention à l'importante charge électrique qu'elle contient.
description_es: Cola en forma de tijera de un Astalos. Cuidado con sus descargas de alto voltaje.
description_it: Coda a forbice di Astalos. Bisogna sempre temere la sua alta carica elettrica.
description_zh: The scissors-shaped tail of an Astalos. Watch out for its dangerously high voltage.

name: Electroscale
description: Highly conductive scale from an Astalos. Its unique shape is hard to work with.
description_de: Hochgradig leitfähige Schuppe eines Astalos. Aufgrund der Form schwer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Écaille très conductrice d'un Astalos. Sa forme unique la rend dure à travailler.
description_es: Escama muy conductora de Astalos. Su forma única es difícil de trabajar.
description_it: Scaglia di Astalos altamente conduttiva. La forma anomala la rende ardua da plasmare.
description_zh: Highly conductive scale from an Astalos. Its unique shape is hard to work with.

name: Electroscale+
description: An Astalos scale that gene- rates electricity, even after being separated from its body.
description_de: Diese Astalos-Schuppe erzeugt noch Elektrizität, nachdem sie vom Monster entfernt wurde.
description_fr: Écaille venant de l'organe générateur d'électricité d'un Astalos.
description_es: Escama de Astalos que genera electricidad incluso después de separarla del cuerpo.
description_it: Scaglia che genera elettricità anche quando viene separata dal corpo dell'Astalos.
description_zh: An Astalos scale that gene- rates electricity, even after being separated from its body.

name: Boltscale
description: An Astalos scale that bristles with electricity, even after being separated from its body.
description_de: Diese Astalos-Schuppe steht noch unter Hochspannung, nachdem sie vom Monster entfernt wurde.
description_fr: Écaille crépitant d'énergie, même après avoir été séparée de son corps d'origine.
description_es: Escama de Astalos que produce electricidad incluso después de separarla del cuerpo.
description_it: Scaglia che emana forti scariche elettriche anche quando viene separata dal corpo dell'Astalos.
description_zh: An Astalos scale that bristles with electricity, even after being separated from its body.

name: Astalos Plate
description: A scale carved from an Astalos. It glows a bright green and is very rare.
description_de: Eine Schuppe von einem Astalos. Sie leucht hellgrün und ist sehr selten.
description_fr: Grosse écaille d'un Astalos. Brille d'un vert vif. Très rare.
description_es: Escama extraída de un Astalos. Emite un brillo verde y es muy poco común.
description_it: Scaglia di Astalos. Emana un forte bagliore verde ed è molto rara.
description_zh: A scale carved from an Astalos. It glows a bright green and is very rare.

name: Astalos Electrogem
description: A brilliant green gem found inside an Astalos. It pulsates with an intense energy.
description_de: Ein hellgrüner Edelstein, gefunden in einem Astalos. Pulsiert mit starker Energie.
description_fr: Gemme verte brillante extraite d'un Astalos. Grosse énergie de palpitation.
description_es: Gema verde brillante ubicada en las entrañas del Astalos. Emite una energía intensa.
description_it: Gemma verde brillante di Astalos. È percorsa da un'energia intensa.
description_zh: A brilliant green gem found inside an Astalos. It pulsates with an intense energy.

name: Astalos Mantle
description: A legendary Astalos scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendäre Astalos-Schuppe. Wer daraus Ausrüstung anfertigt, herrscht über Himmel und Erde.
description_fr: Écaille légendaire d'un Astalos. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Escama legendaria de Astalos. Los que la usan rigen la tierra y el cielo.
description_it: Leggendaria scaglia di Astalos. Si dice che chi la lavora possa conquistare cielo e terra.
description_zh: A legendary Astalos scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Astalos Scale
description: Darker than normal Astalos scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Astalos- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille d'Astalos normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Astalos normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Astalos, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Astalos scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Astalos Shard
description: Darker than normal Astalos scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Astalos-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille d'Astalos normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Astalos normales, emite un resplandor lúgubre y ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Astalos, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Astalos scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Boltreaver Shard
description: A Boltreaver Astalos scale, whose rigidity and amazing ductility make it highly coveted.
description_de: Wertvolle Schuppe eines Blitz- schlag-Astalos. Ihre Härte und Leitfähigkeit sind unübertrefflich.
description_fr: Écaille d'Astalos Prince-orage. Rigide et hautement conductrice, elle est très convoitée.
description_es: Escama de Fulmen Astalos que ha sido muy refinada gracias a su rigidez y maleabilidad.
description_it: Scaglia preziosa di Fulmen Astalos molto ricercata per la sua robustezza e duttilità.
description_zh: A Boltreaver Astalos scale, whose rigidity and amazing ductility make it highly coveted.

name: Heavy Boltreaver Shell
description: This Boltreaver Astalos shell is so sharp it should only be handled by professionals.
description_de: Wertvoller Panzer eines Blitz- schlag-Astalos. So scharf, dass ihn nur Experten bearbeiten können.
description_fr: Carapace d'Astalos Prince-orage. Si aiguisée qu'elle est réservée aux professionnels.
description_es: El caparazón del Fulmen Astalos es tan afilado que solo deberían trabajarlo manos expertas.
description_it: Corazza pesante di Fulmen Astalos così affilata che solo i migliori sanno maneggiarla.
description_zh: This Boltreaver Astalos shell is so sharp it should only be handled by professionals.

name: Boltreaver Electric Barb
description: A Boltreaver Astalos barb that can withstand immense electrical currents.
description_de: Extrem spitzer Stachel eines Blitzschlag-Astalos. Kann selbst Hochspannung widerstehen.
description_fr: Touffe de poils d'Astalos Prince- orage. Résiste à des décharges électriques immenses.
description_es: Púa de Fulmen Astalos que puede soportar corrientes eléctricas de alta intensidad.
description_it: Un uncino di Fulmen Astalos che può sopportare intense scariche elettriche.
description_zh: A Boltreaver Astalos barb that can withstand immense electrical currents.

name: Gammoth Pelt
description: A pelt carved from a Gammoth. It's very durable as well as resistant to cold.
description_de: Der Gammoth-Pelz ist sehr haltbar und außerdem kälteabweisend.
description_fr: Peau de Gammoth, très durable et résistante au froid.
description_es: Piel extraída de un Gammoth. Es muy duradera y resistente a las bajas temperaturas.
description_it: Pelle di Gammoth. È molto robusta e può resistere al freddo.
description_zh: A pelt carved from a Gammoth. It's very durable as well as resistant to cold.

name: Gammoth Pelt+
description: A high-quality pelt from a Gammoth. It absorbs physical blows without losing durability.
description_de: Der hochwertige Pelz eines Gammoth. Absorbiert physische Schläge ohne Beschädigung.
description_fr: Très bonne peau de Gammoth. Amortit les coups sans incidence sur sa longévité.
description_es: Piel de Gammoth de calidad. Absorbe los golpes físicos sin perder sus propiedades.
description_it: Pelle pregiata di Gammoth. Assorbe gli impatti senza perdere robustezza.
description_zh: A high-quality pelt from a Gammoth. It absorbs physical blows without losing durability.

name: Gammoth Fur
description: This fine Gammoth fur boasts both weatherproof durability and luxuriant suppleness.
description_de: Erlesener Pelz eines Gammoth. Unfassbar widerstandsfähig und flexibel.
description_fr: Belle fourrure de Gammoth. Combine grande imperméabilité et remarquable flexibilité.
description_es: Pelo de Gammoth de calidad. Soporta las inclemencias del tiempo sin perder flexibilidad.
description_it: Pelle pregiata di Gammoth che unisce qualità impermeabili a un'eccezionale flessibilità.
