description_zh: This fine Gammoth fur boasts both weatherproof durability and luxuriant suppleness.

name: Gammoth Shell
description: A shell from a Gammoth leg. It is designed to adhere to snow, and is utilized in armor joints.
description_de: Der Panzer von einem Gammoth- Bein. Bietet Halt im Schnee und wird in Rüstungen verarbeitet.
description_fr: Carapace de patte de Gammoth. Conçue pour adhérer à la neige. Sert aux articulations d'armure.
description_es: Caparazón de pata de Gammoth. Se adhiere a la nieve. Se usa en articulaciones de armadura.
description_it: Protegge le zampe del mostro. Fa presa sulla neve e si usa nelle giunture delle corazze.
description_zh: A shell from a Gammoth leg. It is designed to adhere to snow, and is utilized in armor joints.

name: Gammoth Carapace
description: An especially hard shell taken from a Gammoth leg. It's used to protect vulnerable areas.
description_de: Die besonders harte Panzerung von einem Gammoth-Bein. Kann verwundbare Bereiche schützen.
description_fr: Carapace très dure venant d'une patte de Gammoth. Sert à protéger les zones vulnérables.
description_es: Caparazón muy duro de la pata de un Gammoth. Se usa para proteger zonas vulnerables.
description_it: Corazza dura ricavata dalle zampe di Gammoth e usata per proteggere aree vulnerabili.
description_zh: An especially hard shell taken from a Gammoth leg. It's used to protect vulnerable areas.

name: Gammoth Cortex
description: The shock absorption qualities of this tough Gammoth shell can take a craftsman's breath away.
description_de: Der Panzer von einem Gammoth- Bein. Verblüfft Handwerker mit seiner Härte.
description_fr: Robuste carapace de Gammoth. Les artisans sont subjugués par sa résistance aux chocs.
description_es: Placa robusta de Gammoth. Los artesanos se asombran ante su resistencia a los golpes.
description_it: La sua capacità di ammortizzare gli attacchi lascia a bocca aperta anche gli artigiani più esperti.
description_zh: The shock absorption qualities of this tough Gammoth shell can take a craftsman's breath away.

name: Gammoth Fang
description: A large fang taken from a Gammoth. Valued for being tough, yet still pliable.
description_de: Der große Reißzahn von einem Gammoth. Geschätzt aufgrund seiner Härte und Biegsamkeit.
description_fr: Grand croc de Gammoth. Apprécié pour sa solidité, il reste malléable.
description_es: Gran colmillo de Gammoth. Valorado por ser duro al tiempo que flexible.
description_it: Lunga zanna di Gammoth, molto ambita poiché resistente ma malleabile.
description_zh: A large fang taken from a Gammoth. Valued for being tough, yet still pliable.

name: Gammoth Fang+
description: An extremely hard and tough Gammoth fang. Difficult to work with, but versatile.
description_de: Extrem harter und belastbarer Gammoth-Reißzahn. Schwer zu verarbeiten, aber vielseitig.
description_fr: Croc de Gammoth aussi dur que solide. Difficile à travailler, mais très polyvalent.
description_es: Colmillo de Gammoth muy duro y resistente. Es difícil de trabajar, pero versátil.
description_it: Zanna molto dura e coriacea. È di difficile lavorazione, ma possiede diversi usi.
description_zh: An extremely hard and tough Gammoth fang. Difficult to work with, but versatile.

name: Gammoth Hardfang
description: This weighty Gammoth fang can destroy an eye-opening array of materials without a scratch.
description_de: Gewaltiger Reißzahn von einem Gammoth. So hart, dass er alles zermalmen kann.
description_fr: Croc de Gammoth massif pouvant pulvériser un nombre ahurissant de matériaux.
description_es: Colmillo duro de Gammoth capaz de pulverizar muchos materiales sin esfuerzo alguno.
description_it: Possente zanna di Gammoth che distrugge una vasta gamma di materiali senza subire danni.
description_zh: This weighty Gammoth fang can destroy an eye-opening array of materials without a scratch.

name: Trunkspine
description: A spine taken from the trunk of a Gammoth. Strong enough to pierce the ground.
description_de: Ein Dorn vom Körper eines Gammoth. Stark genug, um den Boden zu durchdringen.
description_fr: Épine venant de la trompe d'un Gammoth. Solide, on l'utilise pour creuser le sol.
description_es: Espina extraída de la trompa de un Gammoth. Capaz de perforar el suelo.
description_it: Aculeo di proboscide di Gammoth. È talmente rigido da perforare il terreno.
description_zh: A spine taken from the trunk of a Gammoth. Strong enough to pierce the ground.

name: Trunkspine+
description: A hard spine taken from the trunk of a Gammoth. So sharp it can be used to drill through solid rock.
description_de: Ein Dorn vom Körper eines Gammoth. So hart und spitz, dass er Löcher in Fels bohren kann.
description_fr: Épine durcie venant de la trompe d'un Gammoth. Si aiguisée qu'elle peut percer la roche.
description_es: Espina dura extraída de la trompa de un Gammoth. Capaz de perforar la roca más sólida.
description_it: Aculeo duro di proboscide di Gammoth. È così appuntito che riesce a perforare la roccia.
description_zh: A hard spine taken from the trunk of a Gammoth. So sharp it can be used to drill through solid rock.

name: Gammoth Redfur
description: Thick fur made of hard, red hair taken from the lengthy mane of a Gammoth.
description_de: Ein dichter Pelz aus harten, roten Haaren von der langen Mähne eines Gammoth.
description_fr: Fourrure épaisse de poils rouges et drus provenant de la longue toison d'un Gammoth.
description_es: Pelaje espeso de cerdas rojas de la larga crin de un Gammoth.
description_it: Pelo ispido e rossiccio reciso dalla lunga criniera di un Gammoth.
description_zh: Thick fur made of hard, red hair taken from the lengthy mane of a Gammoth.

name: Snowclod
description: A clump of snow hardened by the material secreted from a Gammoth's leg.
description_de: Ein Klumpen Schnee, der mit dem Material aus einem Gammoth-Bein gehärtet wurde.
description_fr: Amas de neige durci par la substance sécrétée par la patte d'un Gammoth.
description_es: Un bloque de nieve endurecida por el material que los Gammoth segregan en las patas.
description_it: Un blocco di neve indurito dalle secrezioni delle zampe di Gammoth.
description_zh: A clump of snow hardened by the material secreted from a Gammoth's leg.

name: Large Snowclod
description: A large clump of snow stuck to a Gammoth's leg. It is very hard and doesn't melt easily.
description_de: Ein großer Klumpen Schnee vom Bein eines Gammoth. Sehr hart und schmilzt nur schwer.
description_fr: Gros amas de neige collé à la patte d'un Gammoth. Très long à faire fondre.
description_es: Gran bloque de nieve adherido a una pata de Gammoth. Muy duro, no se derrite fácilmente.
description_it: Un grosso blocco di neve rimosso da una zampa di Gammoth. È molto compatto.
description_zh: A large clump of snow stuck to a Gammoth's leg. It is very hard and doesn't melt easily.

name: Giant Snowclod
description: A huge clump of the snow that protects a Gammoth's legs. It's surprisingly sturdy.
description_de: Ein riesiger Klumpen Schnee vom Bein eines Gammoth. Unfassbar hart und haltbar.
description_fr: Amas de neige imposant et étonnamment solide qui protège la patte du Gammoth.
description_es: Enorme bloque de nieve que protege las patas del Gammoth. Es increíblemente resistente.
description_it: Un enorme blocco di neve che protegge le zampe di Gammoth. È molto robusto.
description_zh: A huge clump of the snow that protects a Gammoth's legs. It's surprisingly sturdy.

name: Gammoth Scalp
description: A shell from a Gammoth's head. Difficult to work with, but worth the effort.
description_de: Schwer zu verarbeitender Teil vom Kopf eines Gammoth, aber der Aufwand lohnt sich.
description_fr: Carapace d'une tête de Gammoth. Dure à travailler, mais cela vaut la peine d'insister.
description_es: Caparazón craneal de un Gammoth. Difícil de trabajar, pero hace que merezca la pena.
description_it: Corazza cranica di Gammoth. Difficile da lavorare, ma lo sforzo sarà ripagato.
description_zh: A shell from a Gammoth's head. Difficult to work with, but worth the effort.

name: Gammoth Ice Orb
description: A gem from inside a Gammoth. Named for its ice-like clarity and being as shiny as a jewel.
description_de: Ein Juwel aus einem Gammoth. So benannt wegen ihres Glanzes und ihrer Transparenz.
description_fr: Gemme extraite d'un Gammoth. Claire comme la glace et brillante comme un joyau.
description_es: Gema interna del Gammoth. Debe su nombre a su claridad y brillo, propios de una joya.
description_it: Gemma estratta da un Gammoth. È limpida come il ghiaccio e luccicante come un gioiello.
description_zh: A gem from inside a Gammoth. Named for its ice-like clarity and being as shiny as a jewel.

name: Gammoth Pallium
description: A legendary Gammoth shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendärer Gammoth-Panzer. Wer daraus Ausrüstung anfertigt, herrscht über Himmel und Erde.
description_fr: Une carapace légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Caparazón legendario de Gammoth. Los que lo usan rigen la tierra y el cielo.
description_it: Leggendaria corazza di Gammoth. Chi la crea può conquistare cielo e terra.
description_zh: A legendary Gammoth shell. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Gammoth Fur
description: Darker than normal Gammoth fur, this Hyper fur emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normales Gammoth- Fell. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la fourrure de Gammoth normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que el pelo de Gammoth normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelliccia iper di Gammoth, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Gammoth fur, this Hyper fur emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Gammoth Fur X
description: Darker than normal Gammoth fur, this Hyper fur emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als ein nor- maler Gammoth-Pelz. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la fourrure de Gammoth normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que el pelo de Gammoth normal, emite un resplandor lúgubre y ominoso.
description_it: Pelliccia iper di Gammoth, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Gammoth fur, this Hyper fur emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Elderfrost Pelt
description: Hugely stout and supple to match, this Elderfrost Gammoth pelt is a great material to work with.
description_de: Pelz eines Eiszapfen-Gammoth. Unverwüstlich, aber flexibel. Das perfekte Material.
description_fr: Aussi souple que robuste, cette peau de Gammoth Givre-ancien est un régal à travailler.
description_es: Tan resistente como maleable, la piel de Gammoth Glacial es un material excelente.
description_it: Estremamente resistente e molto duttile. È un materiale eccezionale con cui lavorare.
description_zh: Hugely stout and supple to match, this Elderfrost Gammoth pelt is a great material to work with.

name: Elderfrost Cortex
description: This Elderfrost Gammoth shell won't let anything or anyone near you. Peerless strength.
description_de: Panzer eines Eiszapfen-Gammoth. Seine unübertreffliche Härte wehrt alle Angreifer ab.
description_fr: Cette carapace de Gammoth Givre-ancien éminemment robuste est à toute épreuve.
description_es: Caparazón de Gammoth Glacial que te protegerá a toda costa.
description_it: Corteccia di Glacialis Gammoth. Non permette a niente e a nessuno di avvicinarsi.
description_zh: This Elderfrost Gammoth shell won't let anything or anyone near you. Peerless strength.

name: Elderfrost Trunkspine
description: A spine taken from the trunk of an Elderfrost Gammoth. Artisans would kill to work with it.
description_de: Stachel vom Rüssel eines Eiszapfen-Gammoth. Handwerker würden alles dafür geben.
description_fr: Épine venant de la trompe d'un Givre-ancien. Nombre d'artisans rêvent de mettre la main dessus.
description_es: Espina extraída de la trompa de un Gammoth Glacial. Cualquier artesano mataría por trabajarla.
description_it: Aculeo di proboscide di Glacialis Gammoth. Gli artigiani farebbero carte false per poterlo lavorare.
description_zh: A spine taken from the trunk of an Elderfrost Gammoth. Artisans would kill to work with it.

name: Mizutsune Scale
description: A transparent Mizutsune scale. Its irregular shape refracts light into many bright colors.
description_de: Eine transparente Mizutsune- Schuppe. Die unregelmäßige Form bricht das Licht in viele Farben.
description_fr: Écaille transparente dont la forme irrégulière décompose la lumière en couleurs brillantes.
description_es: Escama transparente de Mizutsune. Su forma irregular descompone la luz en colores.
description_it: Scaglia trasparente di Mizutsune. La forma anomala genera riflessi colorati.
description_zh: A transparent Mizutsune scale. Its irregular shape refracts light into many bright colors.

name: Mizutsune Scale+
description: A quality Mizutsune scale. Older scales polished over time can be very valuable.
description_de: Hochwertige Mizutsune-Schuppe. Ältere Schuppen können an Wert gewinnen, wenn man sie poliert.
description_fr: Bonne écaille de Mizutsune. Précieuse comme une écaille polie par le passage du temps.
description_es: Escama de Mizutsune de calidad. Pulidas con el paso de los años, son muy valiosas.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata di Mizutsune. Le vecchie scaglie smussate sono molto ambite.
description_zh: A quality Mizutsune scale. Older scales polished over time can be very valuable.

name: Mizutsune Shard
description: A top-quality Mizutsune scale. Its glossy appearance belies a surprising toughness.
description_de: Erlesene Mizutsune-Schuppe. Glänzt wie neu, ist aber uralt und extrem hart.
description_fr: Écaille de Mizutsune de qualité supérieure. Son aspect brillant dissimule une surprenante solidité.
description_es: Escama de Mizutsune de altísima calidad. Es más dura de lo que parece.
description_it: Scaglia molto pregiata di Mizutsune. La sua lucentezza cela un'incomparabile robustezza.
description_zh: A top-quality Mizutsune scale. Its glossy appearance belies a surprising toughness.

name: Mizutsune Purplefur
description: The purple fur of a Mizutsune. Stiff, but is soft as silk when soaked with bubblefoam.
description_de: Das lila Fell eines Mizutsune. Steif, aber samtweich, wenn es in Schaum getränkt wird.
description_fr: Fourrure mauve de Mizutsune. Très drue, elle s'adoucit sous l'action de la mousse à bulles.
description_es: Pelo violeta de Mizutsune. Rígido, pero suave como la seda si se empapa de espuma.
description_it: Pelliccia viola di Mizutsune. È irta, ma si ammorbidisce se intrisa nella bollischiuma.
description_zh: The purple fur of a Mizutsune. Stiff, but is soft as silk when soaked with bubblefoam.

name: Mizutsune Purplefur+
description: High-quality purple fur. More foam-absorbent than its lighter counterpart.
description_de: Hochwertiges Violettfell. Kann mehr Schaum aufnehmen, als die leichtere Variante.
description_fr: Fourrure mauve de qualité. Absorbe plus de mousse que sa version allégée.
description_es: Pelo violeta de calidad. Absorbe más espuma que la versión básica.
description_it: Pelliccia viola di pregio. Assorbe più schiuma rispetto alla variante leggera.
description_zh: High-quality purple fur. More foam-absorbent than its lighter counterpart.

name: Mizutsune Purplefell
description: Luxuriant purple fur of great toughness. Works amazingly with bubblefoam.
description_de: Violettfell höchster Güte. Bewährte Festheit und extrem hohe Kompabilität mit Schaum.
description_fr: Toison mauve d'une grande durabilité superbement tolérante à la mousse à bulles.
description_es: Pelo violeta de Mizutsune de gran calidad y rigidez. Combina de maravilla con la espuma.
description_it: Magnifica pelliccia viola di gran pregio. Estremamente efficace se intrisa di bollischiuma.
description_zh: Luxuriant purple fur of great toughness. Works amazingly with bubblefoam.

name: Mizutsune Claw
description: A claw that flies freely through bubblefoam, allowing it to be used as a spike.
description_de: Eine Klaue, die ungehindert durch Schaum gleitet und als Dorn verwendet werden kann.
description_fr: Griffe que la mousse à bulles ne ralentit pas et qui peut donc servir de pointe.
description_es: Garra que atraviesa fácilmente la espuma de burbujas y que puede usarse como púa.
description_it: Artiglio che si muove libero nella bollischiuma. Può essere usato come lancia.
description_zh: A claw that flies freely through bubblefoam, allowing it to be used as a spike.

name: Mizutsune Claw+
description: Friction-reducing bubblefoam helps this deadly claw slice through prey like sushi.
description_de: Schaum, der Reibung verringert, lässt diese tödliche Klaue durch Beute gleiten wie durch Sushi.
description_fr: De la mousse à bulles permet à cette griffe acérée de découper ses proies comme des sushis.
description_es: Con espuma de burbujas, que reduce la fricción, corta la presa como si fuera sushi.
description_it: La bollischiuma lubrificante consente a questo artiglio di tagliare le prede come sushi.
description_zh: Friction-reducing bubblefoam helps this deadly claw slice through prey like sushi.

name: Mizutsune Hardclaw
description: A Mizutsune claw of unparalleled hardness, able to pierce any enemy.
description_de: Extrem hart und scharf. Ein Hieb zerschneidet jeden Gegner.
description_fr: Griffe de Mizutsune à la solidité sans égale, capable de percer n'importe quel ennemi.
description_es: Garra de Mizutsune de increíble dureza capaz de cortar a cualquier enemigo.
description_it: Artiglio di Mizutsune di incomparabile durezza. Riesce a trapassare qualsiasi nemico.
description_zh: A Mizutsune claw of unparalleled hardness, able to pierce any enemy.

name: Mizutsune Fin
description: A beautiful brocade-like fin. Males have large fins that turn red to match their mood.
description_de: Schöne, brokatgleiche Flosse. Männchen haben große Flossen, die nach Gemütslage rot werden.
description_fr: Belle nageoire semblable à celle d'un koï. Rouge chez le mâle pour mieux coller à leur humeur.
description_es: Aleta con aspecto de brocado. La del macho pasa al rojo a la par que su estado de ánimo.
description_it: Stupenda pinna decorata. Le pinne dei maschi si colorano di rosso in base all'umore.
description_zh: A beautiful brocade-like fin. Males have large fins that turn red to match their mood.

name: Mizutsune Fin+
description: A high-quality fin. Bubble- foam gives it an elegant pattern prettier than dye.
description_de: Hochwertige Flosse. Schaum erzeugt ein Muster, prächtiger noch als eines aus Farben.
description_fr: Nageoire de qualité. Se pare d'un élégant motif sous l'effet de la mousse à bulles.
description_es: Aleta de calidad. La espuma forma una trama más bonita que un tinte.
description_it: Pinna pregiata. Possiede raffinate sfumature di colore create dalla bollischiuma.
description_zh: A high-quality fin. Bubble- foam gives it an elegant pattern prettier than dye.

name: Mizutsune Silkfin
description: A fin so beautiful it wouldn't look out of place as a sacred raiment in a ritual dance.
description_de: Eine Mizutsune-Flosse, so elegant wie das Gewand einer Tempeltänzerin.
description_fr: Une nageoire si élégante qu'elle semble venir tout droit de la tenue d'une danseuse.
description_es: Una aleta tan hermosa que no desentonaría en el atuendo durante una danza ceremonial.
description_it: Splendida pinna di Mizutsune. Ricorda le vesti morbide e setose delle diafane dee danzanti.
description_zh: A fin so beautiful it wouldn't look out of place as a sacred raiment in a ritual dance.

name: Mizutsune Tail
description: The flowing tail of a Mizutsune. It's prized for its supple fur and beautiful scales.
description_de: Geschwungener Schwanz eines Mizutsune. Begehrt aufgrund des Fells und der schönen Schuppen.
description_fr: Queue de Mizutsune recherchée pour sa fourrure souple et ses jolies écailles.
description_es: Cola fluida de Mizutsune. Apreciada por su sutil pelaje y bellas escamas.
description_it: Coda fluente di Mizutsune. È ambita per il pelo morbido e le meravigliose scaglie.
description_zh: The flowing tail of a Mizutsune. It's prized for its supple fur and beautiful scales.

name: Purple Mizutsune Tail
description: This flowing Mizutsune tail whose lush fur and gorgeous scales make it a top dance accessory.
description_de: Eleganter Mizutsune-Schwanz mit perfektem Pelz und wunderschönen Schuppen.
description_fr: Sa fourrure ondulante et ses écailles resplendissantes en font un accessoire de danse très prisé.
description_es: Muy preciada como accesorio de baile debido a su frondoso y bello pelaje.
description_it: Superba coda di Mizutsune ricoperta di folto pelo e lucenti squame. Una vera meraviglia!
description_zh: This flowing Mizutsune tail whose lush fur and gorgeous scales make it a top dance accessory.

name: Bubblefoam
description: Fluid secreted by a Mizutsune. Just a few drops can turn a swamp into a bubble bath.
description_de: Vom Mizutsune ausgestoßene Flüssigkeit. Durch wenige Tropfen wird ein Sumpf zum Schaumbad.
description_fr: Fluide sécrété par le Mizutsune. Quelques gouttes transforment un marais en bain de bulles.
description_es: Líquido secretado por el Mizutsune. Unas gotas cubren de burbujas toda una ciénaga.
description_it: Secrezione di Mizutsune. Poche gocce possono trasformare una palude in una vasca termale.
description_zh: Fluid secreted by a Mizutsune. Just a few drops can turn a swamp into a bubble bath.

name: Bubblefoam+
description: The top layer of a Mizutsune's fluid. It removes impurities and is used in religious rituals.
description_de: Die beste der Mizutsune- Flüssigkeiten. Wirkt reinigend. Bestandteil religiöser Rituale.
description_fr: Couche supérieure d'un fluide de Mizutsune. Purifiante, on s'en sert dans les rituels religieux.
description_es: Capa superior de líquido de Mizutsune. Elimina impurezas y se usa en rituales religiosos.
description_it: La secrezione più pregiata del Mizutsune. Purifica ed è impiegata nei riti religiosi.
description_zh: The top layer of a Mizutsune's fluid. It removes impurities and is used in religious rituals.

name: Distilled Bubblefoam
description: The top layer of a Mizutsune's fluid, strained and distilled to the highest purity.
description_de: Die beste der Mizutsune- Flüssigkeiten, bis zur Makellosig- keit gereinigt und konzentriert.
description_fr: Couche supérieure d'un fluide de Mizutsune, distillé pour un maximum de pureté.
description_es: Capa superior de líquido de Mizutsune, colado y destilado hasta alcanzar la máxima pureza.
description_it: La secrezione più pregiata del Mizutsune, filtrata e distillata per estrarne l'essenza più pura.
description_zh: The top layer of a Mizutsune's fluid, strained and distilled to the highest purity.

name: Mizutsune Plate
description: A very old scale present since the creature's birth. It can even create a rainbow from light.
description_de: Besonders alte Schuppe, die seit Geburt der Kreatur vorhanden ist. Kann Regenbogen erzeugen.
description_fr: Née avec la créature donneuse. Fait des arcs-en-ciel sous l'effet de la lumière.
description_es: Escama muy antigua, data del nacimiento de la bestia. Con luz, puede crear un arco iris.
description_it: Scaglia antica che si forma già alla nascita. Può persino generare arcobaleni di luce.
description_zh: A very old scale present since the creature's birth. It can even create a rainbow from light.

name: Mizutsune Water Orb
description: A multicolored orb formed from a crystalized Mizutsune scale and bubblefoam.
description_de: Eine vielfarbige Kugel aus kristallisierten Schuppen und Mizutsune-Schaum.
description_fr: Orbe multicolore formée d'une écaille cristallisée de Mizutsune et de mousse à bulles.
description_es: Orbe multicolor compuesto por una escama cristalizada y espuma de Mizutsune.
description_it: Sfera multicolore creata da una scaglia cristallizzata di Mizutsune e bollischiuma.
description_zh: A multicolored orb formed from a crystalized Mizutsune scale and bubblefoam.

name: Mizutsune Pallium
description: A legendary Mizutsune scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendäre Mizutsune-Schuppe. Wer daraus Ausrüstung anfertigt, herrscht über Himmel und Erde.
description_fr: Une écaille légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Caparazón legendario de Mizutsune. Los que lo usan rigen la tierra y el cielo.
description_it: Leggendaria scaglia di Mizutsune. Si dice che chi la lavora possa conquistare cielo e terra.
description_zh: A legendary Mizutsune scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Mizutsune Scale
description: Darker than normal Mizutsune scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Mizutsune- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Mizutsune normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Mizutsune normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Mizutsune, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Mizutsune scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Mizutsune Scale X
description: Darker than normal Mizutsune scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Mizutsune-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre qu'une écaille de Mizutsune normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura y robusta que las escamas de Mizutsune normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Mizutsune, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Mizutsune scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Soulseer Shard
description: A Soulseer Mizutsune scale. Those who gaze on its polished surface will find their way once more.
description_de: Dicke Schuppe eines Karmaseher- Mizutsune. Wer ihre Schönheit betrachtet, verliert alle Illusionen.
description_fr: Écaille de Mizutsune Perce-âme. Aide ceux qui posent les yeux sur elle à retrouver leur voie.
description_es: Escama de Tengen Mizutsune. Su superficie pulida muestra el camino a quienes la miran.
description_it: Frammento di Arcanum Mizutsune. Ammirare la sua superficie lucida dona calma e fuga ogni dubbio.
description_zh: A Soulseer Mizutsune scale. Those who gaze on its polished surface will find their way once more.

name: Soulseer Purplehide
description: A beautiful Soulseer Mizutsune pelt. One stroke of its soft fur is enough to bring calm.
description_de: Schöner Pelz eines Karmaseher- Mizutsune. Das weich fließende Fell beruhigt schon beim Zusehen.
description_fr: Magnifique peau de Mizutsune Perce-âme. La caresser aide à retrouver son calme.
description_es: Piel suave de Tengen Mizutsune. Calma a cualquiera con tan solo una caricia.
description_it: Magnifica pelliccia di Arcanum Mizutsune. Il solo guardarla infonde pace e serenità.
description_zh: A beautiful Soulseer Mizutsune pelt. One stroke of its soft fur is enough to bring calm.

name: Soulseer Tail
description: Those who touch this Soulseer Mizutsune tail are captivated by its loveliness. A priceless article.
description_de: Stattlicher Schwanz eines Karma- seher-Mizutsune. Wer ihn berührt, kann nicht genug bekommen.
description_fr: Quiconque touche cette queue de Mizutsune Perce-âme devient captivé par son raffinement.
description_es: Quienes tocan esta piel de Mizutsune quedan cautivados por su suavidad. Muy preciada.
description_it: Meravigliosa coda di Arcanum Mizutsune. La sua finezza e il suo valore non passano inosservati.
description_zh: Those who touch this Soulseer Mizutsune tail are captivated by its loveliness. A priceless article.

name: Glavenus Scale
description: A Glavenus scale. Along with the shell, they cover its body's vulnerable parts.
description_de: Eine Glavenus-Schuppe. Zusammen mit dem Panzer bedecken sie die verwundbaren Körperbereiche.
description_fr: Écaille de Glavenus. Complète la carapace pour couvrir les parties vulnérables du corps.
description_es: Escama de Glavenus. Junto al caparazón, cubre las partes más vulnerables del cuerpo.
description_it: Scaglia di Glavenus. Con la corazza, ne protegge i punti più vulnerabili.
description_zh: A Glavenus scale. Along with the shell, they cover its body's vulnerable parts.

name: Glavenus Scale+
description: A quality scale taken from a Glavenus. It possesses excellent heat and damage resistance.
description_de: Hochwertige Schuppe von einem Glavenus. Bietet hervorragende Hitze- und Schadensresistenz.
description_fr: Écaille de qualité venant d'un Glavenus. Très résistante à la chaleur et aux dégâts.
description_es: Escama de calidad extraída de un Glavenus. Posee una gran resistencia al calor y al daño.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata di Glavenus. Garantisce un'elevata difesa contro danni e calore.
description_zh: A quality scale taken from a Glavenus. It possesses excellent heat and damage resistance.

name: Glavenus Shard
description: A Glavenus scale whose heat resistance and protection could probably withstand hellfire.
description_de: Erlesene Schuppe von einem Glavenus. Bietet überragende Hitze- und Schadensresistenz.
description_fr: Écaille de Glavenus si résistante à la chaleur qu'elle pourrait supporter une plongée en enfer.
description_es: Escama de Glavenus resistente al calor que podría soportar incluso el fuego del averno.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata di Glavenus. Spessa e ignifuga, non teme nemmeno le fiamme dell'inferno.
description_zh: A Glavenus scale whose heat resistance and protection could probably withstand hellfire.

name: Glavenus Shell
description: A shell covering the entire body of a Glavenus. It easily deflects all but the strongest blows.
description_de: Ein Panzer, der den gesamten Glavenuskörper bedeckt. Nur von schwersten Hieben zu verletzen.
description_fr: Carapace intégrale du corps de Glavenus. Dévie tous les coups, sauf les plus puissants.
description_es: Caparazón que protege todo su cuerpo. Rechaza cualquier golpe, salvo los muy fuertes.
description_it: Corazza che ricopre il corpo del Glavenus. Solo un colpo devastante può perforarla.
description_zh: A shell covering the entire body of a Glavenus. It easily deflects all but the strongest blows.

name: Glavenus Carapace
description: The hard shell of a Glavenus. It has been tempered many times due to its high body heat.
description_de: Die harte Panzerung eines Gla- venus. Vielfach gehärtet durch seine hohe Körpertemperatur.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Glavenus, plusieurs fois trempée en raison de sa forte chaleur corporelle.
description_es: Caparazón duro de Glavenus. Templado repetidamente por su elevado calor corporal.
description_it: Corazza rigida di Glavenus. È stata temprata dall'elevato calore del suo corpo.
description_zh: The hard shell of a Glavenus. It has been tempered many times due to its high body heat.

name: Glavenus Cortex
description: The tough shell of a Glavenus. When forged to its limit, it makes completely impenetrable armor.
description_de: Die harte Panzerung eines Gla- venus. Eine daraus geschmiedete Rüstung ist fast unzerstörbar.
description_fr: Carapace durcie de Glavenus. Devient impénétrable après avoir été suffisamment travaillée.
description_es: Caparazón duro de Glavenus. Si se forja hasta el límite, crea armaduras impenetrables.
description_it: Corazza molto dura di Glavenus. Se forgiata alla perfezione, diventa davvero impenetrabile.
description_zh: The tough shell of a Glavenus. When forged to its limit, it makes completely impenetrable armor.

name: Glavenus Fang
description: A fang from a Glavenus. Razor sharp, it makes a formidable weapon.
description_de: Der Reißzahn von einem Glavenus. Rasiermesserscharf und eine furchtbare Waffe.
description_fr: Croc d'un Glavenus. Son tranchant en fait une arme redoutable.
description_es: Colmillo de Glavenus. Afilado como una cuchilla, constituye un arma formidable.
description_it: Zanna di Glavenus. È molto affilata e rappresenta un'arma formidabile.
description_zh: A fang from a Glavenus. Razor sharp, it makes a formidable weapon.

name: Glavenus Fang+
description: Durable enough to withstand the jaws of a Glavenus's pressure, this fang can cut through anything.
description_de: Er hält dem Druck der mächtigen Glavenus-Kiefer stand und kann beinahe alles zerteilen.
description_fr: Résiste à la puissance de la mâchoire d'un Glavenus. Rien n'est trop dur pour lui.
description_es: Capaz de resistir la presión de las mandíbulas de Glavenus, puede cortar cualquier cosa.
description_it: Così dura da resistere alla pressione delle fauci di Glavenus. È molto affilata.
description_zh: Durable enough to withstand the jaws of a Glavenus's pressure, this fang can cut through anything.

name: Glavenus Hardfang
description: This Glavenus fang is so hard and sharp that it can crunch through anything unscathed.
description_de: Mächtiger Glavenus-Reißzahn, der so hart ist, dass er beinahe alles zermalmen kann.
description_fr: Croc de Glavenus si dur et acéré qu'il peut trancher n'importe quelle matière sans s'ébrécher.
description_es: Colmillo de Glavenus tan duro y afilado que puede desgarrar todo a su paso.
description_it: Zanna molto dura di Glavenus. Può tranciare qualsiasi materiale senza subire alcun danno.
description_zh: This Glavenus fang is so hard and sharp that it can crunch through anything unscathed.

name: Glavenus Pyroshell
description: A shell that resembles flickering flames. Its heat resistance is quite high.
description_de: Ähnelt züngelnden Flammen. Dieser Panzer hat eine hohe Hitzeresistenz.
description_fr: Carapace ressemblant à des flammes vacillantes. Haute résistante à la chaleur.
description_es: Caparazón con aspecto de llamas oscilantes y elevada resistencia al calor.
description_it: Corazza che sembra avvolta dalle fiamme. Ha un'elevata resistenza al calore.
description_zh: A shell that resembles flickering flames. Its heat resistance is quite high.

name: Glavenus Pyroshell+
description: A shell that looks like a raging inferno. The constant heat makes it hard to work with.
description_de: Wirkt wie ein wütendes Inferno. Die Temperatur macht seine Bearbeitung zur Herausforderung.
description_fr: Carapace ressemblant à un brasier infernal. Difficile à travailler car trop chaude.
description_es: Caparazón con aspecto de averno rugiente. El permanente calor hace difícil trabajarlo.
description_it: Corazza ardente come l'inferno. Il costante calore la rende poco malleabile.
description_zh: A shell that looks like a raging inferno. The constant heat makes it hard to work with.

name: Glavenus Hellshell
description: A shell that resembles flickering flames. One touch will reduce you to ash, so handle with care.
description_de: Wirkt wie ein wütendes Inferno. Eine Berührung verwandelt dich in ein Häuflein Asche.
description_fr: Carapace aux airs de flammes dansantes. À manipuler avec soin sous peine de finir en cendres.
description_es: Caparazón con aspecto de llamas tintineantes. Reduce a cenizas todo lo que toca.
description_it: Corazza che ricorda le fiamme dell'inferno. Chi la tocca viene ridotto subito in cenere.
description_zh: A shell that resembles flickering flames. One touch will reduce you to ash, so handle with care.

name: Glavenus Tail
description: The tailblade of a Glavenus. Constant heating and cooling have forged a sturdy blade.
description_de: Im Wechsel von Hitze und Kälte entstand diese stabile Schwanz- klinge eines Glavenus.
description_fr: La queue acérée d'un Glavenus. Rendue tranchante sous l'effet de la chaleur et du froid.
description_es: Cola de Glavenus. Hoja robusta forjada con aplicación constante de calor y frío.
description_it: Coda di Glavenus. È stata temprata come una spada dalle continue escursioni termiche.
description_zh: The tailblade of a Glavenus. Constant heating and cooling have forged a sturdy blade.

name: Glavenus Tailedge
description: The tailblade of a Glavenus. So sharp, anything in its path will be cleaved in two.
description_de: Schwanz eines Glavenus, der die Hälfte seiner Körperlänge ausmacht. Unglaublich scharf.
description_fr: Lame située sur la queue d'un Glavenus. Plus tranchante que bien des épées.
description_es: Fragmento de la cola de un Glavenus. Tan afilado que parte en dos todo cuanto toca.
description_it: Coda affilata di Glavenus. Così tagliente che può dividere qualsiasi cosa in due.
description_zh: The tailblade of a Glavenus. So sharp, anything in its path will be cleaved in two.

name: Glavenus Tailpiece
description: A detached piece of a Glavenus tail. Only a piece, but it'll still cut through most swords.
description_de: Teilstück des Schwanzes eines Glavenus. Selbst in dieser Form stärker als viele Schwerter.
description_fr: Bout de queue de Glavenus. Plus tranchant que bien des épées.
description_es: Trozo de cola de Glavenus. Es un simple fragmento, pero puede partir muchas espadas.
description_it: Parte della coda di Glavenus. È solo un frammento, ma può frantumare molte spade.
description_zh: A detached piece of a Glavenus tail. Only a piece, but it'll still cut through most swords.

name: Flaming Bursa
description: A furnace-like organ located in the throat. It enables the beast to breathe red-hot magma.
description_de: Ein Organ, das einem Ofen ähnelt. Mit ihm kann die Bestie rote, heiße Magma atmen.
description_fr: Sorte de fournaise organique dans la gorge de la bête qui lui permet de cracher du magma.
description_es: Órgano similar a un horno situado en la garganta. Permite a la bestia escupir magma.
description_it: Organo simile a una fornace posto nella gola della belva. Produce magma bollente.
description_zh: A furnace-like organ located in the throat. It enables the beast to breathe red-hot magma.

name: Solar Bursa
description: A highly developed flaming bursa. Cotton-thin, but can resist even white-hot magma.
description_de: Eine hochentwickelte, flammende Bursa. Dünn wie Stoff, aber überlebt selbst heißeste Magma.
description_fr: Fournaise organique très élaborée. Très fine, elle résiste au magma le plus chaud.
description_es: Bolsa flamígera muy desarrollada. Fina como la tela, resiste magma incandescente.
description_it: Borsa ardente ben sviluppata. Anche se sottile come seta, può resistere al magma.
description_zh: A highly developed flaming bursa. Cotton-thin, but can resist even white-hot magma.

name: Molten Bursa
description: A fully-developed bursa carved from a strong Glavenus. Can't even be lightly scorched, ever.
description_de: Eine voll entwickelte Bursa. Nimmt auch im heißesten Feuer keinen Schaden.
description_fr: Fournaise organique à maturité prélevée sur un Glavenus aguerri. Est entièrement ignifugée.
description_es: Bolsa flamígera de un Glavenus totalmente desarrollada. Nada puede quemarla.
description_it: Borsa ben sviluppata estratta da un Glavenus micidiale. È completamente ignifuga.
description_zh: A fully-developed bursa carved from a strong Glavenus. Can't even be lightly scorched, ever.

name: Glavenus Plate
description: A sharp scale that grows near the Glavenus's tail, it has the same role -- a short blade.
description_de: Scharfe Schuppe, im Glavenus- Schwanzbereich zu finden. Dient ebenfalls als kurze Klinge.
description_fr: Écaille aiguisée poussant près de la queue du Glavenus et qui sert aussi de petite lame.
description_es: Escama afilada situada cerca de la cola y que tiene la misma función, una hoja corta.
description_it: Scaglia caudale aguzza che viene utilizzata dal Glavenus come un piccolo artiglio.
description_zh: A sharp scale that grows near the Glavenus's tail, it has the same role -- a short blade.

name: Glavenus Fire Orb
description: A red orb that grows within a flaming bursa. One peek can set even your soul aflame.
description_de: Rote Kugel, die im Inneren einer Solarbursa wächst. Ein Blick kann die Seele in Brand setzen.
description_fr: Orbe rouge extraite d'une luette de flammes. On prendrait feu rien qu'en la regardant.
description_es: Orbe rojo que se desarrolla en la bolsa flamígera. Un vistazo basta para incendiar tu alma.
description_it: Sfera rossa che cresce nella borsa ardente. Può ridurre in cenere al primo sguardo.
description_zh: A red orb that grows within a flaming bursa. One peek can set even your soul aflame.

name: Glavenus Pallium
description: A legendary Glavenus scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Legendäre Glavenus-Schuppe. Wer daraus Ausrüstung anfertigt, herrscht über Himmel und Erde.
description_fr: Une écaille légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Caparazón legendario de Glavenus. Los que lo usan rigen la tierra y el cielo.
description_it: Leggendaria scaglia di Glavenus. Si dice che chi la lavora possa conquistare cielo e terra.
description_zh: A legendary Glavenus scale. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Glavenus Scale
description: Darker than normal Glavenus scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normales Glavenus- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Glavenus normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Glavenus normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Glavenus, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Glavenus scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Glavenus Scale X
description: Darker than normal Glavenus scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Glavenus-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Glavenus normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Glavenus normales, emite un resplandor lúgubre y ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Glavenus, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Glavenus scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Hellblade Scale
description: A Hellblade Glavenus scale. Explodes violently if not handled with care.
description_de: Zornklingen-Glavenus-Schuppe. Bei unvorsichtiger Behandlung droht eine heftige Explosion.
description_fr: Écaille de Glavenus Lame-chaos. Explose violemment si elle n'est pas manipulée avec soin.
description_es: Escama de Glavenus Inferno. Explota violentamente si no se maneja con cuidado.
description_it: Scaglia di Ignis Glavenus. Può esplodere se non è maneggiata con attenzione.
description_zh: A Hellblade Glavenus scale. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Scale+
description: A superior Hellblade Glavenus scale. Explodes violently if not handled with care.
description_de: Eine bessere Schuppe des Zornklingen-Glavenus. Vorsicht! Explosiv!
description_fr: Bonne écaille de Glavenus Lame-chaos. Explose violemment si non manipulée avec soin.
description_es: Escama superior de Glavenus Inferno. Explota violentamente si no se maneja con cuidado.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata di Ignis Glavenus. Può esplodere se non è maneggiata con cura.
description_zh: A superior Hellblade Glavenus scale. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Shard
description: A Hellblade Glavenus scale. A thoughtless slip with it will reduce the surrounding land to rubble.
description_de: Erlesene Schuppe des Zorn- klingen-Glavenus. Ein Fehler kann Großbrände auslösen.
description_fr: Écaille de Lame-chaos. Gare à ne pas la laisser tomber sous peine de souffler les environs.
description_es: Escama de Glavenus Inferno. Puede destruir toda una zona de un descuido.
description_it: Frammento di Ignis Glavenus. Usarlo distrattamente provoca danni immensi e irreparabili.
description_zh: A Hellblade Glavenus scale. A thoughtless slip with it will reduce the surrounding land to rubble.

name: Hellblade Shell
description: A shell taken from a Hellblade Glavenus. Explodes violently if not handled with care.
description_de: Der Panzer eines Zornklingen- Glavenus. Bei unvorsichtiger Behandlung droht eine Explosion.
description_fr: Carapace de Glavenus Lame-chaos. Explose violemment si elle n'est pas manipulée avec soin.
description_es: Caparazón de Glavenus Inferno. Explota violentamente si no se maneja con cuidado.
description_it: Corazza di Ignis Glavenus. Può esplodere se non è maneggiata con attenzione.
description_zh: A shell taken from a Hellblade Glavenus. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Carapace
description: A hard Hellblade Glavenus shell. Explodes violently if not handled with care.
description_de: Der harte Panzer eines Zornklingen-Glavenus. Vorsicht! Explosiv!
description_fr: Cuirasse de Glavenus Lame-chaos. Explose violemment si elle n'est pas manipulée avec soin.
description_es: Caparazón duro de Glavenus Inferno. Explota violentamente si no se maneja con cuidado.
description_it: Robusta corazza di Ignis Glavenus. Può esplodere se non è maneggiata con cura.
description_zh: A hard Hellblade Glavenus shell. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Cortex
description: A hard Hellblade Glavenus shell. Handled carelessly, it can reduce the world to eternal wasteland.
description_de: Der schwere Panzer eines Zornklingen-Glavenus. Ein Fehler kann ganze Landstriche vewüsten.
description_fr: Carapace durcie de Lame-chaos. Peut dévaster une région entière si manipulée imprudemment.
description_es: Escama dura de Glavenus Inferno. Puede devastar el mundo entero si no se maneja con cuidado.
description_it: Corazza molto dura di Ignis Glavenus. Usata a cuor leggero porta alla distruzione totale.
description_zh: A hard Hellblade Glavenus shell. Handled carelessly, it can reduce the world to eternal wasteland.

name: Hellblade Powder
description: Powder taken from a Hellblade Glavenus. Explodes violently if not handled with care.
description_de: Pulver vom Zornklingen-Glavenus. Bei unvorsichtiger Behandlung droht eine heftige Explosion.
description_fr: Poudre extraite de Glavenus Lame-chaos. Explose violemment si non manipulée avec soin.
description_es: Polvo extraído de un Glavenus Inferno. Explota violentamente si no se maneja con cuidado.
description_it: Polvere estratta da un Ignis Glavenus. Può esplodere se non è maneggiata con cura.
description_zh: Powder taken from a Hellblade Glavenus. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Tigrex Scale
description: Scale from the incredibly violent Tigrex. Incredibly massive and sturdy.
description_de: Die Schuppe des brutalen Tigrex. Unvorstellbar massiv und robust.
description_fr: Grosse écaille d'un Tigrex terriblement violent.
description_es: Escama del violentísimo Tigrex. Asombrosamente grande y resistente.
description_it: Scaglia del violento Tigrex. Terribilmente massiccia e robusta.
description_zh: Scale from the incredibly violent Tigrex. Incredibly massive and sturdy.

name: Tigrex Scale+
description: A flawless Tigrex scale. Can be fastened with others to become harder than steel.
description_de: Makellose Tigrex-Schuppe. Zusammengefügt sind sie härter als Stahl.
description_fr: Écaille de Tigrex parfaite, aussi dure que l'acier.
description_es: Una escama de Tigrex perfecta. Su tenacidad al juntar varias es similar a la del acero.
description_it: Ottima scaglia di Tigrex. Se sono intrecciate, sono più dure dell'acciaio.
description_zh: A flawless Tigrex scale. Can be fastened with others to become harder than steel.

name: Tigrex Shard
description: A thick Tigrex scale. Made to withstand both the searing heat and the shivering cold.
description_de: Dicke Tigrex-Schuppe. Widersteht sengender Hitze und klirrender Kälte.
description_fr: Écaille de Tigrex épaisse. Résiste à la chaleur et et au froid.
description_es: Gruesa escama de Tigrex. Puede resistir tanto el calor del desierto como el frío alpino.
description_it: Spessa scaglia di Tigrex. Protegge dal calore e dal freddo estremi.
description_zh: A thick Tigrex scale. Made to withstand both the searing heat and the shivering cold.

name: Tigrex Shell
description: A hard Tigrex shell capable of repelling any impact. Extreme tenacity.
description_de: Ein harter Tigrex-Panzer, der jeden Stoß abwehrt. Extrem zäh.
description_fr: Carapace à la résistance extrême, qui peut repousser n'importe quel impact.
description_es: Un duro caparazón de Tigrex. Extremadamente rígido y capaz de repeler cualquier impacto.
description_it: Dura corazza di Tigrex; respinge ogni attacco. Estremamente compatta.
description_zh: A hard Tigrex shell capable of repelling any impact. Extreme tenacity.

name: Tigrex Carapace
description: A material hardened by the sands of time. Sharp edges show the Tigrex's ferocity.
description_de: Vom Lauf der Zeit gehärtet. Die rauen Seiten zeugen von Wildheit.
description_fr: Durcie par les sables du temps. Ses bords indiquent la férocité du Tigrex.
description_es: Endurecida por las arenas del tiempo. En sus bordes afilados se ve la ferocidad del Tigrex.
description_it: Indurito dal tempo. I suoi bordi indicano la ferocia di un Tigrex.
description_zh: A material hardened by the sands of time. Sharp edges show the Tigrex's ferocity.

name: Tigrex Cortex
description: A heavy Tigrex shell. Even the terrible forces of nature cannot penetrate it.
description_de: Schwerer Tigrex-Panzer. Widersteht den rauen Gefahren der Natur.
description_fr: Lourde carapace de Tigrex. Résiste à ce que la nature a de plus dur à offrir.
description_es: Pesada escama de Tigrex. Resistiría lo más violento que se encuentre en la naturaleza.
description_it: Corazza pesante di Tigrex. In grado di resistere alla furia degli elementi.
description_zh: A heavy Tigrex shell. Even the terrible forces of nature cannot penetrate it.

name: Tigrex Tail
description: This flexible and strong tail can make great equipment.
description_de: Flexibler und starker Schwanz für hervorragende Ausrüstungsstücke.
description_fr: Cette queue flexible et puissante peut produire de beaux équipements.
description_es: Cola fuerte y flexible con la que se puede fabricar buen equipamiento.
description_it: Da questa flessibile e forte coda si può ricavare un ottimo equipaggiamento.
description_zh: This flexible and strong tail can make great equipment.

name: Tigrex Lash
description: A top-grade tail from a violent Tigrex. Requires a veteran artisan's skill and experience.
description_de: Hochwertiger Schwanz des brutalen Tigrex. Verarbei- tung erfordert Geschick.
description_fr: Queue du violent Tigrex. Difficile à œuvrer. Exige des mains d'expert.
description_es: Una cola de máxima calidad del violento Tigrex. No es nada fácil de trabajar.
description_it: Coda di Tigrex di buona qualità. Per lavorarla è necessaria molta perizia.
description_zh: A top-grade tail from a violent Tigrex. Requires a veteran artisan's skill and experience.

name: Tigrex Claw
description: A vicious foreclaw unique to the Tigrex. Other flying wyverns do not have it.
description_de: Wilde Vorderklaue, die unter den fliegenden Wyvern nur der Tigrex besitzt.
description_fr: Griffe antérieure redoutable que seul le Tigrex possède parmi les wyvernes volantes.
description_es: Feroz garra, única del Tigrex. Ningún otro wyvern volador posee una igual.
description_it: Un letale artiglio centrale. Tra i wyvern volanti, il Tigrex è l'unico ad averlo.
description_zh: A vicious foreclaw unique to the Tigrex. Other flying wyverns do not have it.

name: Tigrex Claw+
description: A claw that time has sharpened into a horrible death sentence for prey.
description_de: Diese Klaue entwickelte sich zu einem grausig scharfen Todesurteil für jede Beute.
description_fr: S'est acérée avec le temps, condamnant ses proies à une mort horrible.
description_es: Garra que el paso del tiempo ha convertido en una afilada sentencia de muerte.
description_it: Artiglio che il tempo ha affilato e mutato in una tragica sentenza di morte.
description_zh: A claw that time has sharpened into a horrible death sentence for prey.

name: Tigrex Hardclaw
description: A highly durable Tigrex claw. Tempered by the flesh and blood of its prey.
description_de: Superharte Tigrex-Klaue. Hat viel Fleisch zerrissen und mehr Blut vergossen.
description_fr: Griffe de Tigrex dure. A tranché beaucoup de chair et répandu beaucoup de sang.
description_es: Garra Tigrex superdura. Ha rasgado mucha carne y derramado mucha sangre.
description_it: Durissimo artiglio di Tigrex che sicuramente ha versato molto sangue.
description_zh: A highly durable Tigrex claw. Tempered by the flesh and blood of its prey.

name: Tigrex Fang
description: A terrifying fang used to crush prey. Makes all who see it quiver in fear.
description_de: Alle fürchten diesen Reiß- zahn, der vom Schmerz selbst geschärft wurde.
description_fr: Ce croc terrible inspire la peur à tous les chasseurs.
description_es: Escalofriante colmillo para aplastar presas. Te estremece solo con mirarlo.
description_it: Tutti temono questa terribile zanna affilata dal dolore stesso.
description_zh: A terrifying fang used to crush prey. Makes all who see it quiver in fear.

name: Tigrex Fang+
description: The sharp fang of a Tigrex. These fangs can cut any prey to shreds.
description_de: Scharfer Reißzahn eines Tigrex. Diese Reißzähne zerfetzen jede Beute.
description_fr: Ces crocs aiguisés peuvent réduire en charpie n'importe quelle proie.
description_es: Afiladísimo colmillo de un Tigrex, capaz de despedazar a cualquier presa.
description_it: L'affilata zanna di un Tigrex. Può ridurre a brandelli qualsiasi preda.
description_zh: The sharp fang of a Tigrex. These fangs can cut any prey to shreds.

name: Tigrex Hardfang
description: A thick, large Tigrex fang that tore prey into unrecognizable pieces.
description_de: Dicker, großer Tigrex- Reißzahn. Riss einst Beute in Stücke.
description_fr: Grand et épais croc de Tigrex utilisé pour réduire ses proies en miettes.
description_es: Colmillo de Tigrex, grande y grueso, para romper a su presa en pedazos.
description_it: Zanna di Tigrex, grande e spessa, usata per fare a pezzi le prede.
description_zh: A thick, large Tigrex fang that tore prey into unrecognizable pieces.

name: Tigrex Scalp
description: Part of the head of a violent Tigrex. Looks terrifying, as if it is still alive.
description_de: Schädel des brutalen Tigrex. Ebenso furchtbar wie die lebende Version.
description_fr: Ce crâne est aussi terrible que la version vivante du violent Tigrex.
description_es: Fragmento del cráneo del violento Tigrex. Tan terrible como la versión viva.
description_it: Il teschio del violento Tigrex. Terrificante come la versione viva.
description_zh: Part of the head of a violent Tigrex. Looks terrifying, as if it is still alive.

name: Tigrex Maw
description: The awe-inspiring jaws of a Tigrex, ready to crush both bone and spirit.
description_de: Furchterregend und bereit, Knochen und Geist zu zerschmettern.
description_fr: Mâchoire imposante prête à broyer les os et à anéantir tout courage.
description_es: Las intimidatorias mandíbulas de un Tigrex, listas para moler huesos y almas por igual.
description_it: Le impressionanti fauci di un Tigrex, pronte a frantumare ossa e spirito.
description_zh: The awe-inspiring jaws of a Tigrex, ready to crush both bone and spirit.

name: Tigrex Mantle
description: A phantasmal scale of a Tigrex. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Phantasmische Schuppe. Vereint angeblich die Erde und ergreift den Himmel.
description_fr: Une écaille légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Escama fantasmal. Cuando se creó, unificó la tierra y atrapó el cielo.
description_it: Una scaglia eterea. Si dice che sia in grado di unire la terra e il cielo.
description_zh: A phantasmal scale of a Tigrex. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Hyper Tigrex Scale
description: Darker than normal Tigrex scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Tigrex- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Tigrex normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Tigrex normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Tigrex, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Tigrex scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Tigrex Scale X
description: Darker than normal Tigrex scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Tigrex-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Tigrex normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Tigrex normales, emite un resplandor lúgubre y ominoso.
description_it: Frammento iper di Tigrex, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Tigrex scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Grimclaw Scale
description: A Grimclaw Tigrex scale. Dark and thickly layered. Features exceptional hardness.
description_de: Düsterklauen-Tigrex-Schuppe. Dunkel und mit vielen Schichten. Außerordentlich hart.
description_fr: Écaille de Tigrex Griffe-sombre. Très dense, foncée, et d'une exceptionnelle dureté.
description_es: Escama de Tigrex Guadaña. Oscura y muy espesa. Posee una dureza excepcional.
description_it: Scaglia di Furor Tigrex. È scura, stratificata e molto robusta.
description_zh: A Grimclaw Tigrex scale. Dark and thickly layered. Features exceptional hardness.

name: Grimclaw Scale+
description: A superior Grimclaw Tigrex scale. A scale of the highest quality.
description_de: Bessere Düsterklauen-Tigrex- Schuppe. Eine Schuppe von höchster Qualität.
description_fr: Écaille de Tigrex Griffe-sombre de la meilleure qualité.
description_es: Escama superior de Tigrex Guadaña de la mejor calidad.
description_it: Pregevole scaglia di Furor Tigrex. Un esemplare di prima qualità.
description_zh: A superior Grimclaw Tigrex scale. A scale of the highest quality.

name: Grimclaw Shard
description: A scale from a Grimclaw Tigrex. Even the dark inner layers are exceptionally hard.
description_de: Erlesene Düsterklauen-Tigrex- Schuppe. Dunkel gefärbt und extrem hart und dick.
description_fr: Écaille de Tigrex Griffe-sombre. Même son revêtement interne est incroyablement solide.
description_es: Escama de Tigrex Guadaña. Incluso las capas interiores oscuras son muy resistentes.
description_it: Spessa scaglia di Furor Tigrex. Anche i suoi strati più interni sono estremamente duri e coriacei.
description_zh: A scale from a Grimclaw Tigrex. Even the dark inner layers are exceptionally hard.

name: Grimclaw Shell
description: A Grimclaw Tigrex shell. You can see the thick blue blood vessels pulsating on its exterior.
description_de: Düsterklauen-Tigrex-Panzer. An der Außenseite sind pulsierende, blaue Blutgefäße sichtbar.
description_fr: Carapace de Tigrex Griffe-sombre avec de grosses veines bleues qui palpitent en surface.
description_es: Caparazón de Tigrex Guadaña. Desde el exterior se aprecian sus gruesas venas palpitantes.
description_it: Corazza di Furor Tigrex. È ricoperta da spessi vasi sanguigni blu pulsanti.
description_zh: A Grimclaw Tigrex shell. You can see the thick blue blood vessels pulsating on its exterior.

name: Grimclaw Carapace
description: You can see the blue blood vessels pulsating on the exterior of the shell.
description_de: An der Außenseite des Panzers sind pulsierende, blaue Blutgefäße sichtbar.
description_fr: Avec de belles veines bleues qui palpitent à la surface de la cuirasse.
description_es: Se pueden apreciar sus venas palpitantes desde el exterior.
description_it: L'esterno è ricoperto da spessi vasi sanguigni blu ancora pulsanti.
description_zh: You can see the blue blood vessels pulsating on the exterior of the shell.

name: Grimclaw Cortex
description: You can see the blue blood vessels pulsating violently on the shell's exterior.
description_de: An der Außenseite des Panzers sind heftig pulsierende, blaue Blutgefäße sichtbar.
description_fr: Avec de belles veines bleues qui palpitent violemment à la surface de la carapace.
description_es: Se pueden apreciar sus venas palpitando violentamente desde el exterior.
description_it: L'esterno è ricoperto da spessi vasi sanguigni blu che pulsano violentemente.
description_zh: You can see the blue blood vessels pulsating violently on the shell's exterior.

name: Grimclaw Talon
description: A talon from a Grimclaw Tigrex. It's as frightening and deadly as it looks.
description_de: Düsterklauen-Tigrex-Kralle. Ist so furchterregend und tödlich wie sie aussieht.
description_fr: Serre de Tigrex Griffe-sombre. Aussi effrayante et mortelle qu'elle en a l'air.
description_es: Espolón de Tigrex Guadaña. Es tan aterrador y letal como parece.
description_it: Sperone di Furor Tigrex. Ha un aspetto terrificante e letale.
description_zh: A talon from a Grimclaw Tigrex. It's as frightening and deadly as it looks.

name: Grimclaw Talon+
description: A quality talon from a Grimclaw Tigrex. It's as frightening and deadly as it looks.
description_de: Die hochwertige Kralle eines Düsterklauen-Tigrex. So furchterregend wie sie aussieht.
description_fr: Serre de Tigrex Griffe-sombre. Aussi effrayante et fatale qu'elle en a l'air. Belle qualité.
description_es: Espolón de Tigrex Guadaña de calidad. Es tan aterrador y letal como parece.
description_it: Sperone pregiato di Furor Tigrex. Ha un aspetto terrificante e letale.
description_zh: A quality talon from a Grimclaw Tigrex. It's as frightening and deadly as it looks.

name: Grimclaw Hardclaw
description: This high-quality Grimclaw Tigrex claw is the embodiment of ferocity.
description_de: Erlesene Kralle eines Düster- klauen-Tigrex. Noch furcht- erregender, als sie aussieht.
description_fr: Cette griffe de Tigrex Griffe-sombre de haute qualité est l'incarnation de la férocité.
description_es: Garra de Tigrex Guadaña de gran calidad y dureza. Es la personificación de la ferocidad.
description_it: Artiglio molto pregiato di Furor Tigrex. La rappresentazione della violenza allo stato puro.
description_zh: This high-quality Grimclaw Tigrex claw is the embodiment of ferocity.

name: Seregios Bladescale
description: A dangerous scale that opens at the tip to viscerally attack the beast's foes.
description_de: Gefährliche Schuppe, die sich an der Spitze öffnet und Feinde der Bestie instinktiv angreift.
description_fr: Écaille dangereuse à la pointe ouverte pour éventrer les bêtes ennemies.
description_es: Peligrosa escama, abierta en la punta para atacar ferozmente a los enemigos de la bestia.
description_it: Temibile scaglia che si biforca in punta per dilaniare le prede.
description_zh: A dangerous scale that opens at the tip to viscerally attack the beast's foes.

name: Seregios Slavescale
description: A sharp scale the Seregios can make stand on end. Gouges anything it touches.
description_de: Scharfe Schuppe, die der Seregios aufstellen kann. Tötet bei Berührung.
description_fr: Écaille de Seregios très dissuasive. Transperce tout ce qu'elle touche.
description_es: Escama afilada de Seregios cuya punta puede erguir. Desgarra todo lo que toca.
description_it: Scaglia affilata che il Seregios può drizzare per fare a pezzi tutto ciò che tocca.
description_zh: A sharp scale the Seregios can make stand on end. Gouges anything it touches.

name: Seregios Slavescale+
description: A sharp scale that stands on end as its master angers and rips prey to awful pieces.
description_de: Scharfe Schuppe. Sträubt sich, wenn der Meister die Beute zornig zerreißt.
description_fr: Écaille acérée aussi féroce que son propriétaire. Met ses proies en lambeaux.
description_es: Escama afilada que se yergue si su maestro se enfada para trocear a su presa.
description_it: Scaglia affilata che si rizza quando il mostro si avventa furioso sulla preda.
description_zh: A sharp scale that stands on end as its master angers and rips prey to awful pieces.

name: Airblade Shard
description: A fragment from a Seregios's Airblade. Despite its small size, it shouldn't be underestimated.
description_de: Fragment von einer Seregios- Luftklinge. Trotz der geringen Größe nicht zu unterschätzen.
description_fr: Fragment d'Aérolame de Seregios. À ne pas sous-estimer du fait de sa petite taille.
description_es: Fragmento de filo de Seregios. A pesar de su reducido tamaño, no debe subestimarse.
description_it: Frammento di cielolama di Seregios. Anche se minuto, non è da sottovalutare.
description_zh: A fragment from a Seregios's Airblade. Despite its small size, it shouldn't be underestimated.

name: Seregios Airblade
description: A blade shot from the body and carried on the wind toward unsuspecting hunters.
description_de: Sie wird vom Körper abgefeu- ert und vom Wind auf ahnungs- lose Gegner zugetragen.
description_fr: Lame expulsée du corps et portée par le vent vers les chasseurs insouciants.
description_es: Hoja disparada por el cuerpo del monstruo hacia cazadores desprevenidos.
description_it: Lama da lancio che solca il cielo verso gli ignari cacciatori.
description_zh: A blade shot from the body and carried on the wind toward unsuspecting hunters.

name: Seregios Airblade+
description: One of a seemingly limitless supply of wild blades shot at any who dare approach.
description_de: Eine von zahllosen wilden Klingen, die auf Feinde abgefeuert werden.
description_fr: L'une des innombrables lames féroces tirées sur quiconque ose approcher.
description_es: Una del millar de hojas que parece poder disparar a quien se le acerque.
description_it: Una delle apparentemente infinite lame che il mostro lancia a chi osa avvicinarsi.
description_zh: One of a seemingly limitless supply of wild blades shot at any who dare approach.

name: Seregios Talon
description: The hard and sharp talon of a Seregios. It is capable of tearing most armor to shreds.
description_de: Harte und scharfe Kralle eines Seregios. Kann die meisten Rüstungen in Stücke reißen.
description_fr: Griffe dure et acérée d'un Seregios. Capable de réduire bien des armures en lambeaux.
description_es: Espolón de Seregios duro y afilado. Puede hacer trizas casi cualquier armadura.
description_it: Artiglio duro e aguzzo di un Seregios. Può squarciare gran parte delle armature.
description_zh: The hard and sharp talon of a Seregios. It is capable of tearing most armor to shreds.

name: Seregios Carver
description: Hooked hind leg talons that tear through armor and flesh without mercy.
description_de: Hakenförmige Kralle vom Hinterbein. Geht gnadenlos durch Rüstung und Fleisch.
description_fr: Des serres arrière crochues qui déchirent la chair et les armures sans pitié.
description_es: Garras en forma de garfio que rajan las armaduras y la carne sin piedad.
description_it: Artigli uncinati della zampa posteriore utilizzati per fare a pezzi carni e armature.
description_zh: Hooked hind leg talons that tear through armor and flesh without mercy.

name: Seregios Carver+
description: Hooked talons that strike like lightning, sharp enough to rend the very air.
description_de: Hakenförmige Kralle. Schlägt blitzschnell zu. Zerteilt sogar die Luft.
description_fr: Des serres crochues rapides comme l'éclair et qui déchirent l'air sans effort.
description_es: Garras curvadas que atacan como el rayo y tan afiladas que cortan el aire.
description_it: Artigli uncinati che attaccano con la velocità del fulmine, fendendo l'aria stessa.
description_zh: Hooked talons that strike like lightning, sharp enough to rend the very air.

name: Seregios Impaler
description: A spear-like tail covered in blade-like scales. Capable of truly horrific things.
description_de: Speerartiger Schwanz mit klingenähnlichen Schuppen. Bewirkt Entsetzliches.
description_fr: Une queue en trident couverte d'écailles acérées, capable de choses inavouables.
description_es: Cola con forma de lanza cubierta de escamas afiladas. Aterradora.
description_it: Coda a tre punte ricoperta di scaglie affilate come coltelli. Infliggono ferite orribili.
description_zh: A spear-like tail covered in blade-like scales. Capable of truly horrific things.

name: Seregios Impaler+
description: A spear-like tail so hard and sharp, it passes through prey as if they were air.
description_de: Speerartiger, wilder Schwanz. So scharf, dass er Beute wie Luft durchdringt.
description_fr: Une queue en trident implacable si aiguisée qu'elle tranche ses proies sans effort.
description_es: Cola con forma de lanza, tan afilada que atraviesa a la presa como si nada.
description_it: Coda a tre punte dura e affilata che trapassa le prede come fossero nubi.
description_zh: A spear-like tail so hard and sharp, it passes through prey as if they were air.

name: Seregios Sunderer
description: The horn from a Seregios. Sturdy yet agile as a blade, it is perfect for crafting them.
description_de: Das Horn eines Seregios. Kann zu einer robusten und schnellen Klinge verarbeitet werden.
description_fr: Corne de Seregios, robuste mais maniable comme une lame, qu'elle sert à fabriquer.
description_es: Un cuerno de Seregios. Robusto y ágil, ideal para utilizar como hoja de un arma.
description_it: Corno di Seregios. Viene utilizzato per forgiare lame, in quanto solido ma leggero.
description_zh: The horn from a Seregios. Sturdy yet agile as a blade, it is perfect for crafting them.

name: Seregios Breacher
description: A sharp horn like a hefty axe that, not surprisingly, makes for fine equipment.
description_de: Ein Horn, scharf wie eine Axt. Eignet sich bestens für feine Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Une corne aiguisée telle une hache. Matériau idéal pour la fabrication d'équipement.
description_es: Cuerno tan afilado como un hacha que, por supuesto, es de una calidad excelente.
description_it: Corno la cui forma ad ascia si presta perfettamente alla forgiatura di equipaggiamenti.
description_zh: A sharp horn like a hefty axe that, not surprisingly, makes for fine equipment.

name: Seregios Breacher+
description: A sharp, robust horn with ripples as lovely as those in the most famed blades.
description_de: Scharfes, robustes Horn mit Rillen, so schön wie die berühmten Klingen.
description_fr: Une corne résistante dont les motifs rappellent ceux des plus belles lames.
description_es: Cuerno afilado, con ondas tan bonitas como las de las espadas más famosas.
description_it: Corno duro e affilato le cui venature sembrano decori di una spada pregiata.
description_zh: A sharp, robust horn with ripples as lovely as those in the most famed blades.

name: Seregios Wingtalon
description: A talon that grows on the wing of a Seregios. Enables superior flight and handling capabilities.
description_de: Eine Kralle vom Flügel eines Seregios. Bietet bessere Flug- eigenschaften und Handhabung.
description_fr: Serre qui pousse sur l'aile du Seregios. Améliore la qualité du vol et de la préhension.
description_es: Espolón del ala de un Seregios. Goza de una excelente capacidad de vuelo y manejo.
description_it: Sperone alare di Seregios. Ne migliora il controllo e la stabilità di volo.
description_zh: A talon that grows on the wing of a Seregios. Enables superior flight and handling capabilities.

name: Seregios Scraper
description: A wing talon. Most attacks come from the hind legs; the wings serve to shift weight.
description_de: Flügelkralle. Die meisten Angriffe kommen von den Hinterbeinen.
description_fr: Une serre d'aile. Les pattes arrière servent à l'attaque, les ailes à l'équilibre.
description_es: Garra de ala. Casi todos los ataques vienen de las patas, y las alas equilibran el peso.
description_it: Artiglio alare. Le ali spostano il baricentro mentre le zampe posteriori portano l'attacco.
description_zh: A wing talon. Most attacks come from the hind legs; the wings serve to shift weight.

name: Seregios Scraper+
description: A sharp wing talon. This fine specimen is as good a material as a hindleg claw.
description_de: Scharfe Flügelkralle. Genauso gutes Material wie eine Hinterbeinkralle.
description_fr: Serre d'aile aiguisée. Ce beau spécimen n'a rien à envier à une griffe arrière.
description_es: Garra de ala afilada. Esta es tan buena como una de las de las patas traseras.
description_it: Artiglio alare affilato. Le sue proprietà sono simili a quelle di un artiglio posteriore.
description_zh: A sharp wing talon. This fine specimen is as good a material as a hindleg claw.

name: Seregios Dissenter
description: A single scale that points defiantly in a different direction from its brethren.
description_de: Einzelne Schuppe, die trotzig in eine andere Richtung weist.
description_fr: Écaille unique pointant fièrement dans le sens contraire aux autres.
description_es: Una escama única que apunta en una dirección distinta a las demás.
description_it: Scaglia ribelle sviluppatasi in direzione opposta rispetto alle altre.
description_zh: A single scale that points defiantly in a different direction from its brethren.

name: Seregios Lens
description: A rare pearl formed inside the body. Said to reveal invisible truths.
description_de: Seltene Perle, die im Körper geformt wurde. Soll unsicht- bare Wahrheiten enthüllen.
description_fr: Perle formée à l'intérieur du corps. Fenêtre vers des vérités invisibles.
description_es: Una perla rara formada en el interior del cuerpo. Se dice que revela la verdad.
description_it: Perla rara formatasi all'interno dell'organismo. Si dice riveli verità nascoste.
description_zh: A rare pearl formed inside the body. Said to reveal invisible truths.

name: Hyper Seregios Scale
description: Darker than normal Seregios scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Seregios- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Seregios normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Seregios normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Seregios, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Seregios scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Seregios Scale X
description: Darker than normal Seregios scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Seregios-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Seregios normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Seregios normales, emite un resplandor lúgubre y ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Seregios, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Seregios scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Diablos Carapace
description: A sturdy Diablos carapace. Even harder than a normal Diablos Shell.
description_de: Robuster Diablos-Rücken- panzer. Sogar härter als ein normaler Diablos-Panzer.
description_fr: Plus dure qu'une carapace Diablos normale.
description_es: Caparazón robusto de un Diablos. Aún más duro que la Concha de Diablos.
description_it: Più duro della normale corazza di Diablos.
description_zh: A sturdy Diablos carapace. Even harder than a normal Diablos Shell.

name: Diablos Cortex
description: The rigid cortex of a Diablos, both harder and sturdier than its carapace.
description_de: Fester Diablos-Kortex, härter und robuster als der Rückenpanzer.
description_fr: Cortex rigide de Diablos. Plus dur et solide que sa cuirasse.
description_es: Placa rígida de Diablos, más dura y resistente que su caparazón.
description_it: Rigida corteccia di Diablos, più resistente del suo carapace.
description_zh: The rigid cortex of a Diablos, both harder and sturdier than its carapace.

name: Diablos Ridge+
description: The hardest part of a Diablos's backplate. Very difficult to carve off.
description_de: Der härteste Teil der Diablos-Rückenplatte. Sehr schwer zu gewinnen.
description_fr: Partie la plus dure d'une plaque arrière de Diablos. Très difficile à tailler.
description_es: Parte más dura de la columna de un Diablos. Muy difícil de cortar.
description_it: La parte più dura della piastra dorsale dei Diablos. Difficilissima da estrarre.
description_zh: The hardest part of a Diablos's backplate. Very difficult to carve off.

name: Diablos Chine
description: Tough Diablos backplate, strengthened by burning sands. An ideal material for armor.
description_de: Harte Diablos-Rückenplatte, gestärkt von brennendem Sand. Ideal für Rüstungen.
description_fr: Plaque arrière de Diablos durcie par le sable. Idéale pour les armures.
description_es: Robusta coraza dorsal de un Diablos, curtida por la arena ardiente. Se usa en armaduras.
description_it: Piastra dorsale di Diablos temprata dalle sabbie; ideale per armature.
description_zh: Tough Diablos backplate, strengthened by burning sands. An ideal material for armor.

name: Twisted Horn
description: A twisted Diablos horn. Used in this region for many (less twisted) purposes.
description_de: Ein krummes Diablos-Horn. Dient in der Region vielen (weniger krummen) Zwecken.
description_fr: Corne tordue d'un Diablos. A de nombreux usages (moins tordus) par ici.
description_es: Cuerno retorcido de Diablos. En esta zona tiene muchos usos (no tan retorcidos).
description_it: Un corno nodoso di Diablos. Ha molti usi.
description_zh: A twisted Diablos horn. Used in this region for many (less twisted) purposes.

name: Majestic Horn
description: A twisted Diablos horn in great shape. Use it to make more powerful weapons.
description_de: Ein krummes, hochwertiges Diablos-Horn. Wird für mächtige Waffen verwendet.
description_fr: Corne tordue d'un Diablos de grande taille. Pour créer des armes plus puissantes.
description_es: Cuerno de gran calidad de un Diablos. Se usa para crear armas robustas.
description_it: Corno nodoso di Diablos della massima qualità. Usato per armi potenti.
description_zh: A twisted Diablos horn in great shape. Use it to make more powerful weapons.

name: Diablos Hardhorn
description: An especially elegant Diablos horn with almost perfect shape. An extremely rare material.
description_de: Sehr elegantes Diablos-Horn in fast perfekter Form. Ein sehr seltenes Material.
description_fr: Corne de Diablos élégante à la forme presque parfaite. Matériau extrêmement rare.
description_es: Elegante cuerno de Diablos con una forma casi perfecta. Material muy raro.
description_it: Corno di Diablos dalla forma particolarmente elegante; materiale rarissimo.
description_zh: An especially elegant Diablos horn with almost perfect shape. An extremely rare material.

name: Diablos Fang
description: A large, sturdy fang used in everything from weapons to ornaments.
description_de: Großer, robuster Zahn, der für alles von Waffen bis zu Verzierungen verwendet wird.
description_fr: Un large croc solide polyvalent, des armes aux ornements.
description_es: Colmillo grande y robusto que tiene todo tipo de usos: desde armas hasta adornos.
description_it: Una zanna grande e robusta usata per realizzare dalle armi agli ornamenti.
