description_zh: A large, sturdy fang used in everything from weapons to ornaments.

name: Diablos Tailcase
description: An armored tailcase that puts iron hammers to shame. This material is a keeper.
description_de: Gepanzerter Schwanzschutz, härter als Eisenhämmer. Äußerst wertvoll!
description_fr: Étui de queue cuirassé à faire pâlir les marteaux. Une protection hors pair.
description_es: Caja de cola blindada que avergüenza a los martillos. Este material es un tesoro.
description_it: Una corazza caudale più dura di una mazza di ferro. Un oggetto di valore.
description_zh: An armored tailcase that puts iron hammers to shame. This material is a keeper.

name: Diablos Tailcase+
description: A tailcase heavy enough to bend a steel hammer. Unimaginably powerful.
description_de: Schwanzschutz, schwer genug, um einen Stahlhammer zu ver- biegen. Unfassbar mächtig.
description_fr: Un bout de queue assez lourd pour courber un marteau. Incroyablement puissant.
description_es: Cola tan pesada como para doblar un martillo de acero. Poder inimaginable.
description_it: Potente corazza caudale capace di piegare un martello d'acciaio.
description_zh: A tailcase heavy enough to bend a steel hammer. Unimaginably powerful.

name: Blos Medulla
description: A rare medulla. Difficult to remove, but of great interest to researchers.
description_de: Seltenes Rückenmark. Schwer zu entfernen, aber interessant für Forscher.
description_fr: Medulla rare. Difficile à retirer mais utile pour les chercheurs.
description_es: Raro tipo de médula. Difícil de extraer, pero de interés científico.
description_it: Tipo raro di bulbo, difficile da estrarre ma ambito dai ricercatori.
description_zh: A rare medulla. Difficult to remove, but of great interest to researchers.

name: Hyper Diablos Cortex
description: Darker than normal Diablos shell, this Hyper shell emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und härter als nomale Diablos-Panzer. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre qu'une carapace de Diablos normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que un caparazón de Diablos normal, emite un resplandor lúgubre y ominoso.
description_it: Corazza iper di Diablos, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Diablos shell, this Hyper shell emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Bloodbath Cortex
description: A Bloodbath Diablos hard outer shell. It wears the scars of previous battles with honor.
description_de: Harter Panzer eines Blutbad- Diablos. Die Narben unzähliger Kämpfe schmücken ihn.
description_fr: Carapace extérieure d'un Diablos Bain-de-sang. Porte fièrement les marques de ses combats passés.
description_es: Caparazón robusto de Diablos Sanguinario. Lleva las cicatrices de batallas pasadas con orgullo.
description_it: Corazza spessa di Cruor Diablos. Sfoggia con orgoglio le ferite riportate in antiche battaglie.
description_zh: A Bloodbath Diablos hard outer shell. It wears the scars of previous battles with honor.

name: Bloodbath Chine
description: A Bloodbath Diablos carapace. Tempered thoroughly by the blows of brave warriors.
description_de: Rückenpanzer eines Blutbad- Diablos. In Kämpfen gegen unzählige Helden gestählt.
description_fr: Cuirasse de Diablos Bain-de-sang fortifiée par ses nombreux coups reçus.
description_es: Caparazón de Diablos Sanguinario. Endurecido por los golpes de guerreros bravos.
description_it: Carapace di Cruor Diablos. Temprato dagli impietosi attacchi di valorosi guerrieri.
description_zh: A Bloodbath Diablos carapace. Tempered thoroughly by the blows of brave warriors.

name: Bloodbath Grimhorn
description: A Bloodbath Diablos horn. Vile enough to recall the tragedies the beast has caused.
description_de: Horn eines Blutbad-Diablos. Genügt, um jeden in Schaudern zu versetzen.
description_fr: Corne de Diablos Bain-de-sang qui n'est pas sans rappeler les tragédies causées par la bête.
description_es: Cuerno de Diablos Sanguinario. Su aspecto lúgubre impide olvidar los desastres que ha causado.
description_it: Corno di Cruor Diablos. Evoca immagini cruente delle atrocità commesse dal mostro.
description_zh: A Bloodbath Diablos horn. Vile enough to recall the tragedies the beast has caused.

name: Gore Magala Scale
description: A black scale artisans fear because of the ill fortune said to surround it.
description_de: Handwerker fürchten diese schwarze Schuppe. Sie soll von Unglück umgeben sein.
description_fr: Écaille noire redoutée des artisans car on dit d'elle qu'elle porte malheur.
description_es: Escama negra de reputación infame entre los artesanos, ya que causa mala fortuna.
description_it: Scaglia nera temuta dagli artigiani per la sinistra fama che la circonda.
description_zh: A black scale artisans fear because of the ill fortune said to surround it.

name: Gore Magala Scale+
description: A deep black scale that seems to devour surrounding light, not reflect it.
description_de: Tiefschwarz. Scheint das Licht zu schlucken, statt es zu reflektieren.
description_fr: Écaille noir foncé semblant engloutir la lumière et non pas la refléter.
description_es: Escama de color negro intenso que parece devorar la luz en lugar de reflejarla.
description_it: Scaglia nera come la notte. Più che riflettere la luce, sembra divorarla.
description_zh: A deep black scale that seems to devour surrounding light, not reflect it.

name: Gore Magala Shard
description: A quality scale whose jet black, lusterless surface bewitches unwary beholders.
description_de: Wertige Schuppe. Die mattschwarze Oberfläche verzaubert den Betrachter.
description_fr: Écaille de qualité dont la surface noire et mate ensorcelle les imprudents.
description_es: Una escama de calidad cuya superficie negra embruja a los observadores.
description_it: Scaglia pregiata che ammalia gli sprovveduti con la sua superficie nera e opaca.
description_zh: A quality scale whose jet black, lusterless surface bewitches unwary beholders.

name: Gore Magala Shell
description: The Gore Magala's outer shell, said to eat the flesh of half-hearted attackers.
description_de: Gore-Magala-Außenpanzer. Soll Fleisch halbherziger Angreifer verzehren.
description_fr: Carapace extérieure dont on dit qu'elle dévore la chair des ennemis sans ressort.
description_es: Caparazón exterior del Gore Magala. Se dice que devora la carne de atacantes indecisos.
description_it: Corazza esterna del Gore Magala. Si dice che divori le carni dei più timorosi.
description_zh: The Gore Magala's outer shell, said to eat the flesh of half-hearted attackers.

name: Gore Magala Carapace
description: The Gore Magala's handsome black suit of armor, said to negate all blows.
description_de: Die stolze schwarze Rüstung des Gore Magala soll alle Hiebe zunichtemachen.
description_fr: Armure noire élégante du Gore Magala. On dit qu'elle protège de tous les coups.
description_es: Espléndida armadura del Gore Magala. Dicen que resiste todos los golpes.
description_it: La splendida corazza nera del Gore Magala. C'è chi giura che sia impenetrabile.
description_zh: The Gore Magala's handsome black suit of armor, said to negate all blows.

name: Gore Magala Cortex
description: A heavy, dark carapace which offers solid equipment, but no guarantees of sanity.
description_de: Schwerer, dunkler Panzer. Solide Ausrüstung, kann aber wahnsinnig machen.
description_fr: Cuirasse sombre et lourde pour plus de résistance mais pouvant mener à la folie.
description_es: Un caparazón oscuro y pesado que ofrece un equipo sólido, pero puede enloquecerte.
description_it: Carapace da cui si ricavano equipaggiamenti pregiati ma dannosi per la salute mentale.
description_zh: A heavy, dark carapace which offers solid equipment, but no guarantees of sanity.

name: Gore Magala Wing
description: A writhing, jet black flight organ almost too hideous to be called a "wing."
description_de: Zuckendes, pechschwarzes Organ. Fast zu widerlich, um "Flügel" genannt zu werden.
description_fr: Organe de vol noir de jais, tortillant. Presque trop laid pour être appelé aile.
description_es: Serpenteante órgano volador color negro azabache. Desde luego, no parece un "ala".
description_it: Un arto corvino e tremante, persino troppo orribile per essere chiamato "ala".
description_zh: A writhing, jet black flight organ almost too hideous to be called a "wing."

name: Gore Magala Wing+
description: A horrifying wing that casts a hungry shadow over prey and drives them insane.
description_de: Entsetzlicher Flügel. Wirft hungrige Schatten auf Beute und macht sie wahnsinnig.
description_fr: Aile effroyable jetant une ombre vorace sur les proies, les menant à la folie.
description_es: Horrible ala que planea amenazante sobre la presa y le hace perder el juicio.
description_it: Un'ala terrificante. La sua ombra famelica avvolge la preda e le strappa il senno.
description_zh: A horrifying wing that casts a hungry shadow over prey and drives them insane.

name: Gore Magala Eclipse
description: Calamitous wings that go unseen in the night, sowing disease and reaping death.
description_de: Unheilvolle Flügel. Unsicht- bar in der Nacht. Sie säen Krankheit und Tod.
description_fr: Ailes terribles, invisibles de nuit, répandant la maladie et la mort.
description_es: Alas calamitosas, invisibles de noche, que esparcen enfermedad y muerte.
description_it: Ali che solcano la notte, seminando morte e malattia senza essere viste.
description_zh: Calamitous wings that go unseen in the night, sowing disease and reaping death.

name: Antinomic Wing
description: A strange harmony between darkness and rainbow light peeking between the bones.
description_de: Dunkelheit und Regenbogen- licht gehen eine seltsame Harmonie ein.
description_fr: Une harmonie étrange entre ténèbres et lumière irisée s'échappe d'entre les os.
description_es: Una extraña armonía entre la oscuridad y la luz irisada se asoma entre los huesos.
description_it: Dalle ossa filtra una strana miscela armonica di buio e splendore iridescente.
description_zh: A strange harmony between darkness and rainbow light peeking between the bones.

name: Gore Magala Ripclaw
description: A menacing claw that carves beautiful, indelible curves through soft, pink flesh.
description_de: Eine bedrohliche Klaue, die hübsche Linien in zartes rosa Fleisch schlitzt.
description_fr: Griffe menaçante gravant des lignes gracieuses à jamais dans la tendre chair rose.
description_es: Garra amenazadora que talla bonitas curvas indelebles en la carne fresca y rosada.
description_it: Terribile artiglio che scava splendidi solchi indelebili sul tenero rosa della carne.
description_zh: A menacing claw that carves beautiful, indelible curves through soft, pink flesh.

name: Gore Magala Ripclaw+
description: A claw from a third foreleg that inflicts Frenzy and generations of suffering.
description_de: Eine Klaue vom dritten Vorderbein, die für Raserei und endloses Leid sorgt.
description_fr: Griffe issue d'une 3e patte avant. Cause la folie et des générations de souffrance.
description_es: Garra de una tercera pata que causa cólera y un sufrimiento inenarrable.
description_it: Artiglio della terza zampa anteriore, che infligge frenesia e atroci dolori.
description_zh: A claw from a third foreleg that inflicts Frenzy and generations of suffering.

name: Gore Magala Shredder
description: A grotesque claw that sows madness. Some Smithies shun it, fearing infection.
description_de: Groteske Klaue, die Wahnsinn sät. Manche Schmiede fürchten eine Infektion durch sie.
description_fr: Griffe monstrueuse semant la folie. Certains forgerons l'évitent comme la peste.
description_es: Una garra grotesca que siembra la locura. Algunos herreros temen infectarse.
description_it: Artiglio che trasuda follia. Alcuni fabbri lo rifiutano, temendo possa contagiarli.
description_zh: A grotesque claw that sows madness. Some Smithies shun it, fearing infection.

name: Gore Magala Tail
description: A pliant tail covered in reverse scales that strikes like a whip, not a blade.
description_de: Ein biegsamer Schwanz mit umgedrehten Schuppen. Mehr Peitsche als Klinge.
description_fr: Queue souple recouverte d'écailles à l'envers. Cinglante et non tranchante.
description_es: Cola flexible cubierta de escamas invertidas que golpea como un látigo.
description_it: Coda flessibile e coperta di squame rovesciate. Colpisce come una frusta.
description_zh: A pliant tail covered in reverse scales that strikes like a whip, not a blade.

name: Gore Magala Lash
description: A black tail covered in sharp inverted scales that shred prey at a stroke.
description_de: Schwarzer Schwanz mit scharfen, umgekehrten Schuppen. Tödlich.
description_fr: Queue couverte d'écailles noires inversées déchirant les proies d'un seul coup.
description_es: Cola negra cubierta de escamas invertidas que despedazan a la presa.
description_it: Una coda nera ricoperta di scaglie invertite capaci di uccidere con un sol colpo.
description_zh: A black tail covered in sharp inverted scales that shred prey at a stroke.

name: Gore Magala Plate
description: Plating from the wing-limbs of the Gore Magala. Hunger and madness deepen the hue.
description_de: Platten von Gore-Magala- Flügeln. Hunger und Wahnsinn vertiefen ihre Farbe.
description_fr: Issue des membres alaires du Gore Magala. La faim et la folie l'assombrissent.
description_es: Escama inferior de los miembros alados del Gore Magala. Intensa como el hambre.
description_it: Rivestimento alare del Gore Magala. La fame e la follia ne intensificano il colore.
description_zh: Plating from the wing-limbs of the Gore Magala. Hunger and madness deepen the hue.

name: Contrary Scale
description: A scale with a mix of white and black that seem to be trying to devour each other.
description_de: Die Mischung aus Weiß und Schwarz scheint sich gegenseitig zu verschlingen.
description_fr: Écaille dont les teintes noires et blanches cherchent à s'annihiler mutuellement.
description_es: Escama con una mezcla de blanco y negro que parecen querer devorarse.
description_it: Scaglia con venature bianche e nere che sembrano inseguirsi per divorarsi a vicenda.
description_zh: A scale with a mix of white and black that seem to be trying to devour each other.

name: Gore Magala Nyctgem
description: A pure, dark jewel that imprisons and then destroys all nearby light.
description_de: Reines, dunkles Juwel, das Umgebungslicht einfängt und es vernichtet.
description_fr: Joyau pur et sombre qui emprisonne la lumière environnante et la détruit.
description_es: Joya oscura de gran pureza que captura y destruye toda la luz del entorno.
description_it: Purissimo gioiello nero che imprigiona e poi distrugge qualsiasi luce vicina.
description_zh: A pure, dark jewel that imprisons and then destroys all nearby light.

name: Gore Magala Mantle
description: A scale considered unfind- able. Equipment made with it yields superhuman power.
description_de: Sehr seltene Schuppe. In Ausrüstung integriert, gibt sie übermenschliche Kraft.
description_fr: Écaille réputée introuvable. L'équipement produit octroie une force surhumaine.
description_es: Una escama difícil de hallar. El equipo que produce es sobrehumano.
description_it: Scaglia considerata introvabile da cui si ricavano oggetti che donano poteri sovraumani.
description_zh: A scale considered unfind- able. Equipment made with it yields superhuman power.

name: Gore Magala Feeler
description: The Gore Magala's versatile sensory organ and lifeline. It serves many purposes.
description_de: Vielseitiges Sinnesorgan und Lebensader des Gore Magala. Erfüllt mehrere Aufgaben.
description_fr: Organe sensoriel polyvalent et vital du Gore Magala. A de nombreux usages.
description_es: Versátil órgano sensorial y vital del Gore Magala. Tiene múltiples utilidades.
description_it: Il versatile organo sensorio e vitale del Gore Magala. Svolge numerosi compiti.
description_zh: The Gore Magala's versatile sensory organ and lifeline. It serves many purposes.

name: Gore Magala Feeler+
description: A well-honed sensory organ that oozes violet melancholy from its infected tip.
description_de: Feines Sinnesorgan, dem violette Melancholie aus der infizierten Spitze strömt.
description_fr: Organe sensoriel bien acéré. Son bout infecté exsude une mélancolie violette.
description_es: Órgano sensorial que por su extremo infectado rezuma melancolía violácea.
description_it: Affinato organo sensorio che irradia violenta malinconia dalla sua punta infetta.
description_zh: A well-honed sensory organ that oozes violet melancholy from its infected tip.

name: Gore Magala Sensor
description: A large horn that pulses purple -- an ill omen that made this a forbidden spoil.
description_de: Großes Horn - pulsiert lila: Ein böses Omen, das es zu verbotener Beute machte.
description_fr: Grande corne émettant une lueur pourpre. Ce présage en fait un butin interdit.
description_es: Un gran cuerno palpitante de color morado... Un mal augurio.
description_it: Un grosso corno viola considerato simbolo di sventura e per questo bandito.
description_zh: A large horn that pulses purple -- an ill omen that made this a forbidden spoil.

name: Diametrical Horn
description: A sensory organ full of golden fibers that squeaks eerily as it hardens.
description_de: Sinnesorgan voller goldener Fasern, das beim Härten fürchterlich kreischt.
description_fr: Organe sensitif empli de fibres dorées qui grince drôlement en se solidifiant.
description_es: Un órgano sensorial lleno de fibras doradas que chirría al endurecerse.
description_it: Organo sensoriale percorso da fibre dorate che stridono se i tessuti si inturgidiscono.
description_zh: A sensory organ full of golden fibers that squeaks eerily as it hardens.

name: Defiled Scale
description: A Frenzy-infested scale with patches of sickly color that make for a dangerous weapon.
description_de: Rasereigetränkte Schuppe mit Klecksen kranker Farbe. Für gefährliche Waffen nutzbar.
description_fr: Infestée par la folie. Ses taches de couleur blafarde en font une arme redoutable.
description_es: Escama infestada con la cólera llena de parches sucios. Puede convertirse en un arma letal.
description_it: Scaglia infestata di frenesia con macchie di nauseabondi toni che la rendono letale.
description_zh: A Frenzy-infested scale with patches of sickly color that make for a dangerous weapon.

name: Chaos Scale
description: A shape-shifting scale whose jet-black cornified layer has turned a golden white.
description_de: Formwandelnde Schuppe. Die einst tiefschwarze Schicht erstrahlt in güldenem Weiß.
description_fr: Écaille à forme multiple dont la surface noire a pris une teinte d'un blanc doré.
description_es: Escama maleable cuya capa de queratina ha adquirido un tono blanco dorado.
description_it: Scaglia cangiante ricoperta da uno strato osseo che da nero è mutato in bianco dorato.
description_zh: A shape-shifting scale whose jet-black cornified layer has turned a golden white.

name: Hyper G.Magala Scale
description: Darker than normal Gore Magala scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Gore- Magala-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Gore Magala normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Gore Magala normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Gore Magala, più scura e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Gore Magala scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper G.Magala Scale X
description: Darker than normal Gore Magala scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale GoreMagala-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre qu'une écaille de Gore Magala normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Gore Magala normales, emite un resplandor lúgubre y ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Gore Magala, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Gore Magala scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: S.Magala Scale
description: A shining scale just shy of blinding white. Dignified, like an ancient dragon.
description_de: Glänzende Schuppe, fast blendend weiß. Würdevoll wie ein uralter Drache.
description_fr: Écaille brillante d'un blanc presque aveuglant. Noble, comme un vieux dragon.
description_es: Reluciente escama de color blanco. Majestuosa como un dragón ancestral.
description_it: Luminosa scaglia che brilla di un bianco accecante. Nobile come un antico drago.
description_zh: A shining scale just shy of blinding white. Dignified, like an ancient dragon.

name: S.Magala Scale+
description: A golden-white scale whose light stays with the eye through a thousand nights.
description_de: Weißgoldene Schuppe, deren Licht 1000 Nächte im Auge zurückbleibt.
description_fr: Écaille blanc doré dont la lumière éblouit pendant mille nuits.
description_es: Escama blanca dorada cuya luz permanece en la retina durante miles de noches.
description_it: Scaglia bianco-dorata la cui luce continua a riscaldare gli occhi per mille notti.
description_zh: A golden-white scale whose light stays with the eye through a thousand nights.

name: S.Magala Shard
description: An especially thick, white scale. Fully matured, it boasts wall-like resistance.
description_de: Besonders dicke, weiße Schuppe. Ausgewachsen ist sie hart wie eine Mauer.
description_fr: Écaille blanche épaisse. À maturité, sa résistance est exceptionnelle.
description_es: Una escama dura que, al madurar, se vuelve resistente como un muro.
description_it: Scaglia chiara e notevolmente robusta. Al culmine dello sviluppo è dura come roccia.
description_zh: An especially thick, white scale. Fully matured, it boasts wall-like resistance.

name: S.Magala Shell
description: A layered shell from which scratches seem to disappear before one's very eyes.
description_de: Schichtpanzer, dessen Kratzer vor deinen Augen zu verschwinden scheinen.
description_fr: Carapace composée de couches dont les rayures semblent disparaître devant les yeux.
description_es: Caparazón laminado del que cualquier arañazo desaparece instantáneamente.
description_it: Corazza a strati su cui gli squarci sembrano dissolversi davanti agli occhi.
description_zh: A layered shell from which scratches seem to disappear before one's very eyes.

name: S.Magala Carapace
description: Celestial armor the Shagaru Magala once wore: an impervious font of light.
description_de: Himmelsrüstung des Shagaru Magala. Eine unzerstörbare Quelle des Lichts.
description_fr: Armure céleste jadis portée par le Shagaru Magala. Puits de lumière impénétrable.
description_es: Armadura celestial del Shagaru Magala: una fuente de luz impenetrable.
description_it: Divina corazza dello Shagaru Magala: un'impenetrabile fonte di luce.
description_zh: Celestial armor the Shagaru Magala once wore: an impervious font of light.

name: S.Magala Cortex
description: Impregnable armor. It is said humankind possesses no means of breaching it.
description_de: Undurchdringliche Rüstung. Menschen sollen sie nicht durchbrechen können.
description_fr: Amure impénétrable. On raconte qu'aucun homme n'a le pouvoir de la briser.
description_es: Armadura inexpugnable. Se dice que la humanidad no puede atravesarla.
description_it: Corazza impenetrabile. Si dice che l'uomo non possieda i mezzi per poterla scalfire.
description_zh: Impregnable armor. It is said humankind possesses no means of breaching it.

name: S.Magala Prismwing
description: A newly grown wing whose seemingly airy membranes belie rock-like strength.
description_de: Neu gewachsener Flügel. Die scheinbar luftigen Membranen sind dennoch extrem stark.
description_fr: Aile de formation récente. Ses membranes légères en apparence sont très dures.
description_es: Un ala nueva con membranas asombrosamente ligeras pero fuertes como una roca.
description_it: Nuova ala le cui sottili membrane celano la forza e la resistenza di una roccia.
description_zh: A newly grown wing whose seemingly airy membranes belie rock-like strength.

name: S.Magala Prismwing+
description: A wing that casts iridescent light in the sun. Thinner wings sell at higher prices.
description_de: Leuchtet irisierend in der Sonne. Dünnere Flügel sind teurer.
description_fr: Projette une lumière irisée au soleil. Plus l'aile est fine, plus elle est chère.
description_es: Ala de color irisado bajo el sol. Las más finas se cotizan a mayores precios.
description_it: Ala che sprigiona nel sole una luce iridescente. Le ali sottili sono più pregiate.
description_zh: A wing that casts iridescent light in the sun. Thinner wings sell at higher prices.

name: S.Magala Lightwing
description: A divine wing that guides the living toward both prosperity and ruin.
description_de: Göttlicher Flügel, der die Lebenden zu Reichtum und Niedergang führt.
description_fr: Une aile divine qui guide les vivants vers la prospérité et la ruine.
description_es: Ala divina que guía a los vivos tanto hacia la prosperidad como hacia la ruina.
description_it: Ala divina che guida i vivi verso l'inevitabile epilogo inflitto dalla frenesia.
description_zh: A divine wing that guides the living toward both prosperity and ruin.

name: S.Magala Caress
description: A claw with a mystic shimmer that hardens with age. Used like a tree's growth rings.
description_de: Mystisch schimmernde Klaue, die mit dem Alter immer härter wird.
description_fr: Chatoie de façon mystique et durcit avec le temps. Pareille aux cernes d'arbre.
description_es: Tiene un brillo místico y se endurece con los años. Úsalo como los anillos del árbol.
description_it: Artiglio che brilla di lampi mistici. Come un albero, si indurisce con gli anni.
description_zh: A claw with a mystic shimmer that hardens with age. Used like a tree's growth rings.

name: S.Magala Caress+
description: A tender claw that hardens only in the face of danger, then kills softly.
description_de: Zarte Klaue, die sich nur bei Gefahr verhärtet und dann sanft tötet.
description_fr: Griffe tendre qui durcit en situation de danger et tue doucement sa proie.
description_es: Garra blanda que se endurece ante el peligro y luego mata dulcemente.
description_it: Morbido artiglio che si indurisce al pericolo e poi uccide dolcemente.
description_zh: A tender claw that hardens only in the face of danger, then kills softly.

name: S.Magala Purifier
description: A Shagaru Magala claw in its hardest form. Proof of the beast's death and rebirth.
description_de: Shagaru-Magala-Klaue in härtester Form. Beweis für dessen Tod und Wiedergeburt.
description_fr: Une griffe Shagaru Magala. La preuve de la mort et de la renaissance de la bête.
description_es: Garra de Shagaru Magala. Prueba de la muerte y el renacimiento del monstruo.
description_it: Artiglio di Shagaru Magala al culmine dello sviluppo, quindi reduce da mille battaglie.
description_zh: A Shagaru Magala claw in its hardest form. Proof of the beast's death and rebirth.

name: S.Magala Tail
description: A white tail whose sheer muscularity is concealed by a coat of bristly scales.
description_de: Weißes Schwanzstück mit kräftigen Muskeln, versteckt unter borstigen Schuppen.
description_fr: Queue blanche dont les écailles piquantes cachent des muscles très puissants.
description_es: Cola blanca que oculta puro músculo bajo un abrigo de erizadas escamas.
description_it: Coda bianca con una fine muscolatura nascosta da un manto di squame irsute.
description_zh: A white tail whose sheer muscularity is concealed by a coat of bristly scales.

name: S.Magala Lash
description: A strong tail with inverted scales. Its pure white color is proof of its fine quality.
description_de: Starker Schwanz mit umge- kehrten Schuppen. Die weiße Farbe bürgt für Qualität.
description_fr: Une queue aux écailles inversées. Le blanc pur témoigne de sa qualité.
description_es: Poderosa cola con escamas invertidas. Su color blanco puro prueba su gran calidad.
description_it: Coda bianca con scaglie invertite. Quelle nere in basso sono più leggere e affilate.
description_zh: A strong tail with inverted scales. Its pure white color is proof of its fine quality.

name: S.Magala Plate
description: A back scale claimed only by hunters who stand beneath the beast's wings and survive.
description_de: Rückenschuppe, die erbeutet, wer unter den Flügeln der Bestie stand und überlebte.
description_fr: Écaille dorsale réservée aux chasseurs qui se tiennent sous les ailes et survivent.
description_es: Escama negra que solo pueden reclamar quienes sobrevivan al ataque de la bestia alada.
description_it: Scaglia nera recuperata da un ardito cacciatore spintosi sotto le ali della bestia.
description_zh: A back scale claimed only by hunters who stand beneath the beast's wings and survive.

name: S.Magala Phosgem
description: A pure jewel of light that ignites the skies and eradicates all darkness.
description_de: Reines Juwel aus Licht. Entzündet den Himmel und vertreibt alle Dunkelheit.
description_fr: Joyau de lumière pur qui embrase les cieux et éradique les ténèbres.
description_es: Joya de gran pureza cuya luz prende los cielos y erradica la oscuridad.
description_it: Puro gioiello di luce che incendia i cieli e annienta l'oscurità.
description_zh: A pure jewel of light that ignites the skies and eradicates all darkness.

name: S.Magala Mantle
description: A white scale believed lost. It can be used to create gear with superhuman power.
description_de: Weiße, verloren geglaubte Schuppe. Für Ausrüstung mit übermenschlicher Kraft.
description_fr: Une écaille blanche que l'on croyait perdue. Elle octroie une force surhumaine.
description_es: Escama blanca que parecía perdida. Para crear equipo con poderes sobrehumanos.
description_it: Scaglia bianca ritenuta smarrita. Vi si ricavano oggetti di potenza inaudita.
description_zh: A white scale believed lost. It can be used to create gear with superhuman power.

name: S.Magala Horn
description: A hardened sensory organ. The Frenzy's madness is still locked inside.
description_de: Ein gehärtetes Sinnesorgan. Der Wahnsinn der Raserei ist im Inneren eingeschlossen.
description_fr: Organe sensoriel très dur. Renferme encore la folie du monstre.
description_es: Órgano sensorial endurecido. En su interior sigue encerrada la locura de la cólera.
description_it: Robusto organo sensoriale. Racchiude ancora la furia della frenesia.
description_zh: A hardened sensory organ. The Frenzy's madness is still locked inside.

name: S.Magala Horn+
description: A heroic arch whose hues have been changed; even now the Frenzy pollutes it.
description_de: Heroischer Bogen, dessen Farbe sich geändert hat. Die Raserei steckt noch darin.
description_fr: Arc héroïque aux couleurs modifiées. Encore infesté par la folie du monstre.
description_es: Arco heroico de tonalidad variable a lo largo del tiempo. Aún ahora rebosa cólera.
description_it: Arco eroico dalle mutate sfumature. Ancora oggi è corrotto dalla frenesia.
description_zh: A heroic arch whose hues have been changed; even now the Frenzy pollutes it.

name: S.Magala Hardhorn
description: A Shagaru Magala horn. These are said to withstand the test of time and never decay.
description_de: Shagaru-Magala-Horn, das angeblich dem Zahn der Zeit widersteht und nie verrottet.
description_fr: Une corne de Shagaru Magala. Elle résiste à l'épreuve du temps et ne s'effrite jamais.
description_es: Cuerno de Shagaru Magala. Inmune al paso del tiempo, nunca se descompondrá.
description_it: Organo vitale di colore nero, a differenza del resto del corpo. Infligge frenesia.
description_zh: A Shagaru Magala horn. These are said to withstand the test of time and never decay.

name: Pure Scale
description: A scale of forbidden white whose complete lack of impurities is truly rare.
description_de: Aus verbotenem Weiß ohne jede Unreinheit, was wirklich selten ist.
description_fr: Écaille à la couleur blanche défendue dont l'absence d'impuretés est rarissime.
description_es: Escama de un blanco cegador cuya ausencia de impurezas resulta asombrosa.
description_it: Scaglia di un bianco quasi proibito. La totale assenza di impurità la rende unica.
description_zh: A scale of forbidden white whose complete lack of impurities is truly rare.

name: Rajang Horn+
description: The majestic golden horn of a Rajang. Hunters yearn for the heroism it represents.
description_de: Goldhorn des Rajang. Jäger ersehnen den Heldenmut, von dem es zeugt.
description_fr: Corne dorée d'un Rajang. Représente l'héroïsme aux yeux des chasseurs.
description_es: Majestuoso cuerno dorado de un Rajang. Los cazadores anhelan el heroísmo que representa.
description_it: Maestoso corno dorato di Rajang. Bramato perché rappresenta l'eroismo.
description_zh: The majestic golden horn of a Rajang. Hunters yearn for the heroism it represents.

name: Rajang Hardhorn
description: A large, majestic golden horn. All who see it feel the over- whelming bravery of its owner.
description_de: Majestätisch großes Gold- horn. Wer es sieht, fühlt den Mut des Jägers.
description_fr: Grande corne dorée et majestueuse. Reflète le courage du chasseur.
description_es: Gran cuerno dorado majestuoso. Nadie que lo vea puede dudar del valor de su portador.
description_it: Maestoso corno dorato. Mostra a tutti il coraggio del cacciatore.
description_zh: A large, majestic golden horn. All who see it feel the over- whelming bravery of its owner.

name: Rajang Fang+
description: This sharpened fang can cut through anything dumb enough to touch it.
description_de: Geschärfter Reißzahn, der alles zerschneidet, was ihn berührt.
description_fr: Ce croc aiguisé peut couper tout ce qui a l'audace de le toucher.
description_es: Este colmillo afilado puede desgarrar a cualquiera que sea tan tonto como para acercarse.
description_it: Zanna affilata che può penetrare in chi è tanto sciocco da toccarla.
description_zh: This sharpened fang can cut through anything dumb enough to touch it.

name: Rajang Hardfang
description: A Rajang fang that cuts through anything. A prey's life vanishes in an instant once caught.
description_de: Reißzahn, der alles durch- trennt. Die Beute, die er fängt, ist erledigt.
description_fr: Croc qui tranche tout. Une fois attrapée, la vie de la proie s'évanouit.
description_es: Colmillo capaz de cortar cualquier cosa. Si es atrapada, la presa no tiene escapatoria.
description_it: Una zanna in grado di forare qualunque cosa. Non lascia scampo.
description_zh: A Rajang fang that cuts through anything. A prey's life vanishes in an instant once caught.

name: Rajang Blackfur
description: Black Rajang fur. When crafted, the resulting fabric is desired even by royalty.
description_de: Ein schwarzes Rajang-Fell. Verarbeitet ist es selbst bei Hoheiten begehrt.
description_fr: Fourrure noire recherchée par la royauté même.
description_es: Pelo de Rajang negro. La tela trabajada es codiciada incluso por la realeza.
description_it: Pelliccia nera di Rajang. Dopo la lavorazione, anche i reali la desiderano.
description_zh: Black Rajang fur. When crafted, the resulting fabric is desired even by royalty.

name: Rajang Wildpelt
description: A wild set of fur from a Rajang. When forged, the jet-black fur causes the wearer to rage.
description_de: Der schwere, ledrige Pelz verleiht Rüstungen ein Gefühl der Sicherheit.
description_fr: Transformé en armure, ce cuir dur donne une sensation de sécurité.
description_es: Pocas armaduras pueden dar la seguridad que da una hecha con este cuero impecable.
description_it: Questa pelle può essere lavorata per produrre ottime armature.
description_zh: A wild set of fur from a Rajang. When forged, the jet-black fur causes the wearer to rage.

name: Rajang Claw+
description: A sharp Rajang claw. Difficult to carve and more difficult to craft.
description_de: Scharfe Rajang-Klaue. Schwer zu bekommen, noch schwerer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Griffe pointue difficile à tailler et encore plus à utiliser.
description_es: Garra de Rajang afilada. Difícil de tallar y más aún de trabajar.
description_it: Aguzzo artiglio di Rajang. Difficile da prendere e difficile da lavorare.
description_zh: A sharp Rajang claw. Difficult to carve and more difficult to craft.

name: Rajang Hardclaw
description: A hard Rajang claw that's taken a multitude of lives in a manner best left unsaid.
description_de: Diese harte Rajang-Klaue hat viele Leben brutal beendet.
description_fr: Griffe de Rajang dure qui a pris bien des vies de manière très brutale.
description_es: Una dura garra de Rajang que probablemente haya segado incontables vidas sin piedad.
description_it: In molti sono caduti vittime di questo affilato artiglio di Rajang.
description_zh: A hard Rajang claw that's taken a multitude of lives in a manner best left unsaid.

name: Rajang Tail
description: The glistening tail of a Rajang. The golden fur is beautiful and elegant.
description_de: Der funkelnde Schwanz eines Rajang. Der goldene Pelz ist schön und elegant.
description_fr: Queue luisante dont la fourrure dorée est aussi belle qu'élégante.
description_es: Cola brillante de un Rajang. El pelo dorado es bonito y elegante.
description_it: Splendente coda di Rajang. La sua pelliccia dorata è bella ed elegante.
description_zh: The glistening tail of a Rajang. The golden fur is beautiful and elegant.

name: Gold Rajang Pelt
description: Fur taken from a Rajang's body. The golden hair is treasured by tailors.
description_de: Der Pelz eines Rajang. Das goldene Haar ist bei Schneidern begehrt.
description_fr: Fourrure dorée très convoitée par les artisans.
description_es: Piel de un Rajang de pelo dorado. Los sastres la consideran un auténtico tesoro.
description_it: Pelliccia del corpo di un Rajang. Pelo dorato, molto apprezzato dai sarti.
description_zh: Fur taken from a Rajang's body. The golden hair is treasured by tailors.

name: Gold Rajang Pelt+
description: A golden pelt that shimmers with the same furious power as a Rajang.
description_de: Golden schimmernder Pelz. Er leuchtet mit der Kraft des Rajang-Zorns.
description_fr: Peau dorée miroitante. Elle reflète la force de la colère d'un Rajang.
description_es: Centelleante piel dorada. Brilla con el furioso poder del Rajang.
description_it: Pelle la cui lucentezza dorata ricorda la furia rabbiosa di un Rajang.
description_zh: A golden pelt that shimmers with the same furious power as a Rajang.

name: Rajang Ragehair
description: Hair that hardens when a Rajang becomes furious. Armorsmiths line up for it.
description_de: Verfestigt sich, wenn ein Rajang wütend wird. Schmiede stehen Schlange dafür.
description_fr: Crinière qui durcit lorsque le Rajang se déchaîne. Prisée pour les armures.
description_es: Pelaje que se endurece si se enfurece el Rajang. Lo más para armaduras.
description_it: Crini che si induriscono quando il Rajang s'infuria. Tutti i fabbri li bramano.
description_zh: Hair that hardens when a Rajang becomes furious. Armorsmiths line up for it.

name: Rajang Apoplexy
description: A long mane which still bristles with rage. The hairs are fine, but robust.
description_de: Lange Mähne voller Rage. Die Haare sind fein, aber robust.
description_fr: Longue crinière imprégnée de rage. Ses poils sont fins, mais très résistants.
description_es: Larga melena que aún destella ira. El pelo es fino, pero robusto.
description_it: Lunga criniera ancora fremente d'ira. I crini sono sottili ma resistenti.
description_zh: A long mane which still bristles with rage. The hairs are fine, but robust.

name: Rajang Nerve
description: The source of a Rajang's power, which continues its mystic pulsing after death.
description_de: Die Quelle der Kraft des Rajang. Der mystische Puls schlägt noch nach dem Tod.
description_fr: Source mystique de la force d'un Rajang. Continue à battre après le trépas.
description_es: La fuente de poder del Rajang. Sigue palpitando aún después de muerto.
description_it: L'origine della forza di ogni Rajang. Sprigiona energia anche dopo la morte.
description_zh: The source of a Rajang's power, which continues its mystic pulsing after death.

name: Rajang Heart
description: A symbol of flesh-searing rage that releases massive power with every beat.
description_de: Symbol Fleisch versengenden Zorns, das mit jedem Hieb unglaubliche Kraft entfesselt.
description_fr: Symbole d'une rage brûlante qui dégage une puissance folle à chaque battement.
description_es: Símbolo de ira desgarradora que libera un poder enorme con cada latido.
description_it: Simbolo di ira funesta capace di sviluppare un'enorme forza a ogni battito.
description_zh: A symbol of flesh-searing rage that releases massive power with every beat.

name: Ghoulish Gold Horn
description: The golden horn of a furious Rajang. It seems almost too lovely to waste on equipment.
description_de: Goldenes Horn eines wütenden Rajang. Fast zu schön, um es als Ausrüstung zu nutzen.
description_fr: Corne dorée d'un Rajang déchaîné. Presque trop belle pour être utilisée.
description_es: Cuerno dorado de un furioso Rajang. Tan bonito que da pena gastarlo para fabricar equipo.
description_it: Corno dorato di un Rajang furioso. È così bello che dispiace persino usarlo.
description_zh: The golden horn of a furious Rajang. It seems almost too lovely to waste on equipment.

name: Ghoulish Gold Gorer
description: A golden horn that seethes with rage even now. Not to be touched with bare hands.
description_de: Goldenes Horn, immer noch voller Zorn. Nicht mit bloßen Händen berühren.
description_fr: Corne dorée débordant de rage. Mieux vaut ne pas la toucher les mains nues.
description_es: Un cuerno dorado que destila rabia. No debe tocarse con las manos desnudas.
description_it: Corno dorato tuttora pulsante di collera. Si sconsiglia di toccarlo a mani nude.
description_zh: A golden horn that seethes with rage even now. Not to be touched with bare hands.

name: Hyper Rajang Fur
description: Darker than normal Rajang fur, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normales Rajang- Fell. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que la fourrure de Rajang normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que el pelo de Rajang normal, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Pelo iper di Rajang, più scuro del normale e avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Rajang fur, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Rajang Fur X
description: Darker than normal Rajang fur, this Hyper fur emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und fester als ein normaler Rajang-Pelz. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre qu'une fourrure de Rajang normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscuro que el pelo de Rajang normal, emite un resplandor lúgubre y ominoso.
description_it: Pelo iper di Rajang, più scuro e robusto del normale, è avvolto da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Rajang fur, this Hyper fur emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Deviljho Scale
description: A greenish-black Deviljho scale. It's not often sold, as rumors claim it brings misfortune.
description_de: Grün-schwarze Dämonjho- Schuppe. Ein Ladenhüter, da sie Unglück bringen soll.
description_fr: Écaille vert sombre à l'aura sinistre. Elle est censée porter malheur.
description_es: Escama verde oscuro de un Deviljho. Es difícil de vender, ya que atrae la desgracia.
description_it: Scaglia verde-nera di Deviljho; è poco venduta perché corre voce che porti sfortuna.
description_zh: A greenish-black Deviljho scale. It's not often sold, as rumors claim it brings misfortune.

name: Deviljho Shard
description: A heavy, high-quality Deviljho scale. Rumored to be bad luck, but is excellent material.
description_de: Hochwertige Dämonjho- Schuppe. Soll Pech bringen, ist aber gutes Material.
description_fr: Écaille lourde de haute qualité. Matériau utile bien que censé porter malheur.
description_es: Escama pesada y sublime de Deviljho. Trae mala suerte, pero es excelente material.
description_it: Pesante scaglia di Deviljho; si dice che porti sfortuna, ma è un ottimo materiale.
description_zh: A heavy, high-quality Deviljho scale. Rumored to be bad luck, but is excellent material.

name: Deviljho Crook
description: An unsettling scale that became warped as it absorbed the hate of the Deviljho's various prey.
description_de: Beunruhigende Schuppe, die sich durch den Hass der Dämonjho-Beute gekrümmt hat.
description_fr: Écaille étrange. Déformée à force d'absorber la cruauté des proies du Deviljho.
description_es: Inquietante escama que se retuerce cuando absorbe el mal de presas de Deviljho.
description_it: Inquietante scaglia che si è contorta assorbendo la malvagità delle prede del Deviljho.
description_zh: An unsettling scale that became warped as it absorbed the hate of the Deviljho's various prey.

name: Deviljho Hide
description: Black hide that is oddly slimy and difficult to forge with.
description_de: Schwarze Haut, die seltsam schleimig und schwer zu verarbeiten ist.
description_fr: Du cuir noir bizarrement gluant et difficile à forger.
description_es: Piel negra excesivamente viscosa y difícil de forjar.
description_it: Pelle nera stranamente vischiosa e difficile da usare in forgiatura.
description_zh: Black hide that is oddly slimy and difficult to forge with.

name: Deviljho Blackpiel
description: Thick hide taken from a violent Deviljho. Especially slimy and difficult to forge with.
description_de: Dicke Haut eines wilden Dä- monjho-Exemplars. Schleimig und schwer zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Cuir épais prélevé sur un Deviljho violent. Gluant et difficile à forger.
description_es: Piel gruesa de un Deviljho violento. Muy viscosa y difícil de forjar.
description_it: Pelle spessa di Deviljho, vischiosa e difficile da usare in forgiatura.
description_zh: Thick hide taken from a violent Deviljho. Especially slimy and difficult to forge with.

name: Bloodied Ebonhide
description: A hide bloodied and battered from ceaseless hunts that give it no time to dry.
description_de: Blutig und zerschunden von zahllosen Jagden, sodass sie nicht trocknen konnte.
description_fr: Cuir rossé et encore ensanglanté à la suite de chasses innombrables.
description_es: Una piel ensangrentada y maltratada por la caza que no se pudo secar.
description_it: Pelle cosparsa di ferite mai rimarginate, traccia delle battaglie cui ha preso parte.
description_zh: A hide bloodied and battered from ceaseless hunts that give it no time to dry.

name: Deviljho Tallfang
description: A large fang from a maw of alarming size. Helps the vile beast sate its hunger.
description_de: Ein Reißzahn aus einem beängstigend großen Rachen. Macht grausame Bestien satt.
description_fr: De taille pratique et provenant d'une gueule probablement très active.
description_es: Colmillo de tamaño apropiado a unas fauces gigantes. Ayuda a la bestia vil a saciarse.
description_it: Zanna di dimensioni notevoli tratta da un'enorme mascella; aiuta la belva a sfamarsi.
description_zh: A large fang from a maw of alarming size. Helps the vile beast sate its hunger.

name: Deviljho Hardfang
description: A massive fang that tears, crushes, and grinds prey without mercy.
description_de: Massiver Reißzahn, der ohne Gnade alles zerreißt, zerbricht und zermalmt.
description_fr: Un croc géant qui déchire, écrase et broie sa proie sans pitié. Le mal à l'état pur.
description_es: Colmillo gigantesco hecho para aplastar, cortar y triturar a la presa sin compasión.
description_it: Enorme zanna in grado di addentare qualsiasi cosa. Trasuda pura malvagità.
description_zh: A massive fang that tears, crushes, and grinds prey without mercy.

name: Vile Fang
description: A massive, overgrown fang that can chomp through anything. Filled with pure evil.
description_de: Massiver, riesiger Reißzahn, der alles zermalmt. Gefüllt mit purer Bosheit.
description_fr: Croc surdimensionné pouvant tout déchirer. Le mal à l'état pur.
description_es: Colmillo de gran tamaño que puede mascar cualquier cosa. Lo carga el diablo.
description_it: Enorme zanna in grado di addentare qualsiasi cosa. Trasuda pura malvagità.
description_zh: A massive, overgrown fang that can chomp through anything. Filled with pure evil.

name: Deviljho Talon
description: A dangerously sharp, hooked talon. Inexperienced crafters risk serious injury.
description_de: Sehr scharfe, gebogene Kralle. Gefährlich für unerfahrene Handwerker!
description_fr: Serre crochue dangereusement aiguisée. Risque de blessure grave.
description_es: Zarpa muy afilada. No apta para artesanos sin experiencia.
description_it: Uno sperone ricurvo: chi lo lavora senza esperienza rischia di farsi molto male.
description_zh: A dangerously sharp, hooked talon. Inexperienced crafters risk serious injury.

name: Deviljho Ripper
description: An incredibly sharp, rigid talon. Even experienced handlers can be injured if not careful.
description_de: Unglaublich scharfe Kralle. Selbst erfahrenen Experten drohen Verletzungen.
description_fr: Serre rigide très aiguisée Risque de blessure, même pour les plus expérimentés.
description_es: Zarpa afilada y rígida. Hasta los expertos se pueden herir si no tienen cuidado.
description_it: Sperone affilato e rigido. Anche i più esperti possono ferirsi nel maneggiarlo.
description_zh: An incredibly sharp, rigid talon. Even experienced handlers can be injured if not careful.

name: Deviljho Scalp
description: Removing this part of a Deviljho's skull releases an unimaginably putrid odor.
description_de: Entfernt man ihn vom Dämonjho-Schädel, riecht es unglaublich faulig.
description_fr: Son extraction libère une odeur monstrueusement putride.
description_es: Al quitar el cuero cabelludo la calavera de Deviljho desprende un olor pútrido.
description_it: Rimuovendolo dal teschio dei Deviljho si esala un fetore indescrivibile.
description_zh: Removing this part of a Deviljho's skull releases an unimaginably putrid odor.

name: Deviljho Tail
description: A massive tail resembling a giant leech. Some folks are out to collect these exclusively.
description_de: Wuchtiger Schwanz, der an einen Egel erinnert. Manche sammeln nur genau diese.
description_fr: Queue énorme semblable à une sangsue géante. C'est un objet de collection.
description_es: Enorme cola que recuerda a una sanguijuela. Algunos salen solo para recogerlas.
description_it: Una coda enorme simile a una sanguisuga. Alcune persone le cercano per collezionarle.
description_zh: A massive tail resembling a giant leech. Some folks are out to collect these exclusively.

name: Deviljho Flail
description: A large slab of a Deviljho's leech-like tail. Even so-called experts are shocked by it.
description_de: Großes Stück eines Dämonjho- Schwanzes. Schockiert selbst sogenannte Experten.
description_fr: Gros morceau de queue. Même les experts le trouvent impressionnant.
description_es: Trozo de cola de sanguijuela de un Deviljho. Hasta los expertos quedan alucinados.
description_it: Grossa porzione di un'allarmante coda di Deviljho, simile a una sanguisuga.
description_zh: A large slab of a Deviljho's leech-like tail. Even so-called experts are shocked by it.

name: Deviljho Saliva
description: The symbol of a Deviljho's insatiable appetite. The strong acid corrodes all it touches.
description_de: Symbol für den unstillbaren Dämonjho-Appetit. Die Säure darin verätzt alles.
description_fr: Symbole de l'appétit vorace du Deviljho. L'acide ronge tout ce qu'il touche.
description_es: Símbolo del insaciable apetito del Deviljho. El fuerte ácido lo corroe todo.
description_it: Il simbolo della fame insaziabile del Deviljho; l'acido corrode al tocco.
description_zh: The symbol of a Deviljho's insatiable appetite. The strong acid corrodes all it touches.

name: Black Blood
description: Dark black blood characteristic of a Deviljho. It feels like it may jump up and attack at any time.
description_de: Dunkles, schwarzes Dämonjho- Blut. Wirkt, als könnte es aufspringen und angreifen.
description_fr: Du sang d'un noir profond, caractéristique du Deviljho. Très effrayant !
description_es: Sangre negra de un Deviljho. Parece que te vaya a atacar en cualquier momento.
description_it: Sangue nero del Deviljho; sembra quasi che possa prendere vita e attaccare.
description_zh: Dark black blood characteristic of a Deviljho. It feels like it may jump up and attack at any time.

name: Spattered Hide
description: A jet black hide with a slimy, tar-like sheen: dried blood spatter, some insist.
description_de: Pechschwarz mit schleimigem, teerähnlichem Glanz. Sind das vielleicht Blutspritzer?
description_fr: Cuir noir de jais dont l'éclat poisseux rappelle le goudron. Imbibé de sang.
description_es: Negra azabache con brillo alquitranado: dicen que son manchas de sangre resecas.
description_it: Pelle corvina con melmosi riflessi grigiastri: sono schizzi di sangue secco?
description_zh: A jet black hide with a slimy, tar-like sheen: dried blood spatter, some insist.

name: Deviljho Gem
description: A precious gem said to contain a Deviljho's might. Used in shady rituals.
description_de: Wertvoller Edelstein, der Dämonjho-Macht enthalten soll. Für dunkle Rituale.
description_fr: Une pierre de grande puissance utilisée dans les rituels occultes.
description_es: Gema preciosa que al parecer contiene la fuerza de Deviljho. Se usa en rituales oscuros.
description_it: Secondo alcuni conterrebbe la forza dei Deviljho. Viene usata per loschi rituali.
description_zh: A precious gem said to contain a Deviljho's might. Used in shady rituals.

name: Hyper Deviljho Scale
description: Darker than normal Deviljho scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler als normale Dämonjho- Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre que l'écaille de Deviljho normale. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Deviljho normales, emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Deviljho, più scura del normale e avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Deviljho scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hyper Deviljho Scale X
description: Darker than normal Deviljho scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.
description_de: Dunkler und dicker als normale Dämonjho-Schuppen. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Plus sombre qu'une écaille de Deviljho normale. Émet une lueur persistante et menaçante.
description_es: Más oscura que las escamas de Deviljho normales, emite un resplandor lúgubre y ominoso.
description_it: Scaglia iper di Deviljho, più scura e robusta del normale, è avvolta da un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: Darker than normal Deviljho scales, this Hyper scale emits a steady, ominous glow.

name: Kirin Thunderhorn
description: The horn of Kirin, as powerful as a lightning bolt. Exquisite material.
description_de: Horn eines Monstergottes, stark wie ein Blitz. Erlesenes Material.
description_fr: Magnifique corne du dieu-bête. Aussi puissante qu'un éclair.
description_es: Cuerno de Kirin, potente como un rayo. Un material exquisito.
description_it: Il corno di Kirin, potente come un fulmine. Splendido materiale.
description_zh: The horn of Kirin, as powerful as a lightning bolt. Exquisite material.

name: Kirin Hide
description: A rare and lovely hide, but difficult to carve loose and dangerous to handle.
description_de: Seltene, schöne Haut. Schwer abzuziehen und gefährlich zu handhaben.
description_fr: Cuir rare d'une grande beauté, mais dur à découper et dangereux à manier.
description_es: Piel rara y de gran belleza, pero difícil de extraer y de peligroso manejo.
description_it: Pelle rara e meravigliosa. È difficile da scuoiare e pericolosa da lavorare.
description_zh: A rare and lovely hide, but difficult to carve loose and dangerous to handle.

name: Kirin Hide+
description: A rare and lovely hide. This one is undamaged: proof of its former owner's strength.
description_de: Selten, schön und völlig intakt. Ein Beweis für die Kraft des vorigen Besitzers.
description_fr: Cuir rare et beau. Celui-ci est intact, témoignant de la force de l'ancien porteur.
description_es: Piel rara y de gran belleza. No tiene daño alguno, lo que prueba la fuerza de su dueño.
description_it: Pelle rara, meravigliosa e ancora indenne: quel mostro doveva essere potentissimo.
description_zh: A rare and lovely hide. This one is undamaged: proof of its former owner's strength.

name: Kirin Finehide
description: Beautiful Kirin hide that hunters can only fantasize of obtaining.
description_de: Ausgewähltes Kirin-Leder, von dem die meisten Jäger nur träumen können.
description_fr: Cuir de Kirin de choix. Tout chasseur rêve d'en acquérir la beauté.
description_es: Piel selecta de Kirin. No hay un solo cazador que no sueñe con su belleza.
description_it: Meravigliosa pelle di Kirin. Ogni cacciatore sogna di possederne una.
description_zh: Beautiful Kirin hide that hunters can only fantasize of obtaining.

name: Kirin Mane
description: A rare, dashing mane that retains its dignity even after being cut free.
description_de: Seltene, verwegene Mähne. Behält ihre Würde auch nach dem Abschneiden.
description_fr: Crinière rare et superbe qui conserve toute sa majesté même après avoir été coupée.
description_es: Espléndida melena poco usual que conserva su dignidad aun tras haberla cortado.
description_it: Pregiata criniera fluente che mantiene la propria maestosità anche se recisa.
description_zh: A rare, dashing mane that retains its dignity even after being cut free.

name: Platinum Mane
description: Kirin mane that sparkles like platinum. It shimmers when kissed by the wind. Priceless.
description_de: Die Kirin-Mähne funkelt wie Platin und schimmert im Wind. Unbezahlbar.
description_fr: Crinière Kirin brillante comme du platine. Tremble avec le vent. Inestimable.
description_es: Crin de Kirin que centellea como el platino al viento. No se le puede poner precio.
description_it: Criniera di Kirin che brilla come platino. Splende ancora di più quando è accarezzata dal vento.
description_zh: Kirin mane that sparkles like platinum. It shimmers when kissed by the wind. Priceless.

name: Kirin Thundertail
description: A rare tail, overflowing with elegance, charged with electricity.
description_de: Seltener Schwanz voller Eleganz und sprühend vor elektrischer Spannung.
description_fr: Queue rare et pleine d'élégance. Chargée d'électricité.
description_es: Cola rara llena de elegancia y cargada con electricidad.
description_it: Una rara coda ricca di eleganza ed elettricità.
description_zh: A rare tail, overflowing with elegance, charged with electricity.

name: Kirin Thunderlash
description: The highly rare tail of Kirin. The electricity stored within causes it to glimmer.
description_de: Ultraseltener Schwanz voller Elektrizität, die leicht schimmert.
description_fr: Queue ultra rare chargée d'électricité qui lui confère un léger éclat.
description_es: Cola de extrema rareza, cuya carga de electricidad le da un leve resplandor.
description_it: Una coda rarissima. La sua carica elettrica la fa brillare leggermente.
description_zh: The highly rare tail of Kirin. The electricity stored within causes it to glimmer.

name: Kirin Azure Horn
description: An azure horn, rare even among Kirin Horns. Gives off a divine light.
description_de: Das Azurhorn ist selbst für Kirin-Hörner selten. Gibt göttliches Licht ab.
description_fr: Corne rare, même pour un Kirin. Brille d'une lueur divine.
description_es: Este cuerno azul celeste es un objeto raro que desprende una luz divina.
description_it: Corno azzurro; raro anche tra le corna di Kirin. Emette una luce divina.
description_zh: An azure horn, rare even among Kirin Horns. Gives off a divine light.

name: Kirin Azure Peak
description: A dangerous horn containing the charge of the thousand bolts that struck it.
description_de: Gefährliches Horn. Enthält die Ladung tausender Blitze, die es getroffen haben.
description_fr: Corne dangereuse renfermant le pouvoir des milliers d'éclairs qui l'ont frappée.
description_es: Un cuerno peligroso que contiene la carga de mil rayos.
description_it: Un corno che trattiene ancora l'energia delle mille saette che lo colpirono.
description_zh: A dangerous horn containing the charge of the thousand bolts that struck it.

name: Daora Shell
description: The shining silver Kushala Daora shell is solid and highly useful.
description_de: Der leuchtend silberne Kushala-Daora-Panzer ist solide und sehr nützlich.
description_fr: Carapace argentée. Solide et très utile.
description_es: Brillante caparazón plateado de un Kushala Daora. Sólido y de gran utilidad.
description_it: Brillante corazza argentata del Kushala Daora; solida e utile.
description_zh: The shining silver Kushala Daora shell is solid and highly useful.

name: Daora Carapace
description: A shell hardened by time. Crafting it is incredibly difficult.
description_de: Von der Zeit gehärteter Panzer. Unglaublich schwer zu bearbeiten.
description_fr: Cuirasse durcie par le temps. Très difficile à travailler.
description_es: Un caparazón endurecido por el tiempo. Muy difícil de trabajar.
description_it: Corazza indurita dal tempo. Lavorarla è incredibilmente difficile.
description_zh: A shell hardened by time. Crafting it is incredibly difficult.

name: Daora Cortex
description: The repeated molting of skin has made this shell near impregnable.
description_de: Wiederholtes Schmelzen hat diesen Panzer nahezu undurchdringlich gemacht.
description_fr: Des mues répétées tout au long de sa vie ont endurci cette carapace.
description_es: Las repetidas mudas han dado mucha dureza a este caparazón.
description_it: Una corazza temprata dal tempo, fino a diventare durissima.
description_zh: The repeated molting of skin has made this shell near impregnable.

name: Daora Scale
description: A scale that glows a dull silver. Hard enough to serve as an abrasive for weapons.
description_de: Diese dumpf silbern leuchtende Schuppe ist hart genug als Schleifmittel für Waffen.
description_fr: Écaille argentée. Assez dure pour affûter les lames.
description_es: Escama que brilla con un fulgor plateado. Tan dura como para afilar armas.
description_it: Scaglia dai riflessi argentati. Può essere usata come abrasivo per armi.
description_zh: A scale that glows a dull silver. Hard enough to serve as an abrasive for weapons.

name: Daora Dragon Scale+
description: High-quality scale from Kushala Daora. It is said to surpass steel.
description_de: Hochwertige Schuppe eines Kushala Daora. Angeblich besser als Stahl.
description_fr: Écaille de Kushala Daora de grande qualité. Elle surpasse l'acier.
description_es: Escama de calidad de un Kushala Daora. Dicen que es superior al acero.
description_it: Scaglia di Kushala Daora; di alta qualità. Si dice che superi l'acciaio.
description_zh: High-quality scale from Kushala Daora. It is said to surpass steel.

name: Daora Shard
description: A thick scale from Kushala Daora. The winters have made it strong and cold to the touch.
description_de: Dicke Daora-Schuppe. Viele Winter haben sie stark und kühl gemacht.
description_fr: Écaille de Daora épaisse. Le grand froid l'a endurcie.
description_es: Gruesa escama Daora. El frío extremo la ha hecho fría y fortísima.
description_it: Splendida scaglia di Daora. Temprata dal gelo e con un tocco glaciale.
description_zh: A thick scale from Kushala Daora. The winters have made it strong and cold to the touch.

name: Daora Webbing
description: Hard to craft but highly compatible with metals. Valued for its light weight.
description_de: Schwer zu bearbeiten, aber gut in Verbindung mit Metall. Sehr leichtes Material.
description_fr: Matériau léger et compatible avec l'acier. Difficile à travailler.
description_es: Difícil de trabajar, pero útil para combinar con metal. Se aprecia su ligereza.
description_it: Difficile da lavorare, ma funziona bene col metallo. Amata per la leggerezza.
description_zh: Hard to craft but highly compatible with metals. Valued for its light weight.

name: Daora Fellwing
description: A curious wing that's strong as steel, but soft to the touch. Highly sought after material.
description_de: Stark wie Stahl und sanft wie der Wind: Ein unglaub- lich wertvolles Material.
description_fr: Dure comme le métal mais douce comme le vent, incroyablement précieuse.
description_es: Dura como el acero pero ligera como el viento. De enorme valor.
description_it: Dura come l'acciaio e leggera come la brezza. Ha un valore altissimo.
description_zh: A curious wing that's strong as steel, but soft to the touch. Highly sought after material.

name: Daora Horn
description: The gallant horn of Daora. Using it requires extra- ordinary experience.
description_de: Das edle Horn eines Kushala Daora. Es kann nur mit viel Erfahrung genutzt werden.
description_fr: Jolie corne de Kushala Daora. Nécessite une expérience extraordinaire.
description_es: El orgullo de un Daora. Su uso requiere una experiencia extraordinaria.
description_it: Il prode corno del Daora. Usarlo richiede una straordinaria esperienza.
description_zh: The gallant horn of Daora. Using it requires extra- ordinary experience.

name: Daora Hardhorn
description: A hard, ferocious horn that engulfs everything in a freezing wind on impact.
description_de: Ein hartes Horn, das bei Berührung alles in eiskalte Winde hüllt.
description_fr: Cette corne dure peut invoquer des rafales givrantes.
description_es: Este duro cuerno puede invocar vientos gélidos con un solo mandoble.
description_it: Un corno duro che può richiamare i gelidi venti del nord.
description_zh: A hard, ferocious horn that engulfs everything in a freezing wind on impact.

name: Daora Horn+
description: A fierce-looking horn that instantly robs the body of cold if handled improperly.
description_de: Wild aussehendes Horn. Falsch gehandhabt, entzieht es dem Körper Kälte.
description_fr: Une corne redoutable qui maniée incorrectement, fait chuter la température du corps.
description_es: Cuerno de aspecto feroz que de usarse descuidadamente roba el calor corporal.
description_it: Corno dall'aspetto feroce che può surriscaldare ogni corpo se usato incautamente.
description_zh: A fierce-looking horn that instantly robs the body of cold if handled improperly.

name: Daora Tail
description: Cut from Kushala Daora. Incredibly destructive power contained within.
description_de: Schwanz eines Kushala Daora. Enthält eine un- glaublich zerstörerische Kraft.
description_fr: Queue d'un Kushala Daora au grand pouvoir destructeur.
description_es: Cortada de un Kushala Daora. Contiene un poder realmente destructivo.
description_it: Preso dal Kushala Daora. Dentro ha un potere atrocemente distruttivo.
description_zh: Cut from Kushala Daora. Incredibly destructive power contained within.

name: Daora Lash
description: The durable tail of Kushala Daora. As strong as any storm, but flexible as well.
description_de: Robuster, ledriger Daora- Schwanz. Stark wie der Wind und dabei flexibel.
description_fr: Robuste queue de Daora en cuir. Solide comme les vents mais flexible.
description_es: Dura cola de cuero Daora. Fuerte como el viento y también flexible.
description_it: La coda coriacea di un Daora. Forte e impalpabile come il vento stesso.
description_zh: The durable tail of Kushala Daora. As strong as any storm, but flexible as well.

name: Daora Claw
description: Kushala Daora's claw. As hard as ore, it cannot be used by ordinary crafters.
description_de: Eine Daora-Klaue. Hart wie Erz, für normale Handwerker nicht zu gebrauchen.
description_fr: Griffe de Kushala Daora. Ne peut être utilisée par des artisans ordinaires.
description_es: Garra de Kushala Daora. Su dureza extrema la hace inútil para un artesano común.
description_it: Artiglio di Kushala Daora. Durissimo; non può essere usato da artigiani comuni.
description_zh: Kushala Daora's claw. As hard as ore, it cannot be used by ordinary crafters.

name: Daora Claw+
description: Even now the black gleam of this claw seems to emit a life force.
description_de: Diese scharfe Klaue leuchtet mit dem dunklen Schein von Daoras Leben.
description_fr: Sa lueur sombre émet une étrange force vitale.
description_es: Esta garra afilada ilumina el lustre negro de la vida de Daora.
description_it: Questo affilato artiglio ha lo splendore nero della vita di un Daora.
description_zh: Even now the black gleam of this claw seems to emit a life force.

name: Daora Hardclaw
description: A robust claw one might mistake for steel. Enhances equipment capabilities.
description_de: Robust. Wird oft für Stahl gehalten. Verstärkt die Fähigkeiten der Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Griffe résistante semblable à l'acier. Améliore les capacités d'équipement.
description_es: Garra robusta que parece de acero. Mejora el equipo.
description_it: Artiglio tanto robusto da sembrare d'acciaio. Migliora gli equipaggiamenti.
description_zh: A robust claw one might mistake for steel. Enhances equipment capabilities.

name: Daora Gem
description: A rare gem formed inside a Daora. Its glow is breathtaking.
description_de: Seltenes Juwel aus einem Kushala Daora. Sein Leuchten ist atemberaubend.
description_fr: Pierre extraite sur un Daora. Sa lueur est sublime.
description_es: Gema muy extraña de las entrañas de un Daora. Su brillo es impresionante.
description_it: Rara. Si è formata dentro un Daora. Uno splendore che toglie il respiro.
description_zh: A rare gem formed inside a Daora. Its glow is breathtaking.

name: Lrg Elder Dragon Gem
description: A giant, ultra-rare stone that forms inside an Elder Dragon once in a millennium.
description_de: Sehr selten bildet sich ein so gewaltiger Stein in einem Drachenältesten.
description_fr: Cette énorme pierre est extrêmement rare. Se forme dans un dragon ancien.
description_es: Piedra gigante que en raras ocasiones se forma en el interior de un dragón anciano.
description_it: È raro che una pietra di questo tipo si formi nel corpo di un drago anziano.
description_zh: A giant, ultra-rare stone that forms inside an Elder Dragon once in a millennium.

name: Chameleos Hide
description: This hide is so strange to the touch, you'll want to rub it all over your face.
description_de: Diese Haut fühlt sich seltsam an; man will sie sich übers Gesicht reiben.
description_fr: Cette peau est si étrange au toucher que vous y frotterez votre visage.
description_es: Un pelaje de textura tan extraña que te apetecerá frotártelo por toda la cara.
description_it: Questa pelle è così strana al tatto che ti verrà da strofinartela sul viso.
description_zh: This hide is so strange to the touch, you'll want to rub it all over your face.

name: Chameleos Hide+
description: Superior hide of Chameleos. Strange to the touch, but very durable.
description_de: Eine bessere Chameleos-Haut, die sich seltsam anfühlt, aber sehr haltbar ist.
description_fr: Peau de qualité supérieure. Étrange au toucher, mais très résistante.
description_es: Piel de calidad superior de un Chameleos. Algo extraña al tacto, pero muy duradera.
description_it: Pelle raffinata di Chameleos. Strana al tatto, ma molto duratura.
description_zh: Superior hide of Chameleos. Strange to the touch, but very durable.

name: Chameleos Finehide
description: Top-grade Chameleos hide. Its strange texture calms the soul of those who touch it.
description_de: Hochwertige Chameleos-Haut. Die seltsame Beschaffenheit beruhigt.
description_fr: Peau de Chameleos top qualité. Son étrange texture calme au toucher.
description_es: Piel de Chameleos de gran calidad. Su extraña textura calma a quien la toca.
description_it: Pelle suprema di Chameleos. Ha il potere di calmare chi la tocca.
description_zh: Top-grade Chameleos hide. Its strange texture calms the soul of those who touch it.

name: Chameleos Horn
description: Faintly glows with a white light. Great for interior decorating.
description_de: Leuchtet schwach weiß. Hervorragend für die Inneneinrichtung.
description_fr: Brille légèrement d'une lueur blanche. Adapté à la décoration intérieure.
description_es: Emite una tenue luz blanca. Perfecto para utilizar como decoración en interiores.
description_it: Brilla leggermente di luce bianca. Ottimo per decorazioni di interni.
description_zh: Faintly glows with a white light. Great for interior decorating.

name: Chameleos Spike
description: A sharp horn of a Chameleos. Strong and hard, but strangely easy to work with.
description_de: Scharfes Chameleos-Horn. Stark und hart, dabei leicht zu bearbeiten.
description_fr: Corne pointue et résistante. Facile à travailler.
description_es: Cuerno afilado de Chameleos. Inesperadamente fácil de trabajar a pesar de su dureza y tenacidad.
description_it: Aguzzo corno di Chameleos. Forte e duro, eppure facile da lavorare.
description_zh: A sharp horn of a Chameleos. Strong and hard, but strangely easy to work with.

name: Chameleos Hardhorn
description: A super-hard horn that refracts light. A highly sought commodity.
description_de: Ein superhartes Horn, das Licht bricht. Sehr gefragt und daher wertvoll.
description_fr: Corne dure, en cuir, qui réfracte la lumière. Aussi belle que précieuse.
description_es: Duro cuerno de cuero que refracta la luz. Muy hermoso y de gran valor.
description_it: Corno di cuoio indurito che rifrange la luce. Bello e prezioso.
description_zh: A super-hard horn that refracts light. A highly sought commodity.

name: Chameleos Claw
description: Thin, yet incredibly strong and very easy to work with during crafting.
description_de: Dünn, aber unglaublich stark und leicht zu bearbeiten.
description_fr: Mince mais très dure. Facile à travailler.
description_es: Increíblemente fuerte a pesar de su delgadez, y muy fácil de trabajar para un artesano.
description_it: Sottile, eppure fortissimo e anche molto facile da lavorare.
description_zh: Thin, yet incredibly strong and very easy to work with during crafting.

name: Chameleos Claw+
description: Sharpened claw of a Chameleos. Small and sharp, but still valued for being easy to work with.
description_de: Die geschärfte Klaue eines Chameleos. Klein, scharf und leicht zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Griffe acérée d'un Chameleos. Petite, aiguisée et appréciée car facile à travailler.
description_es: Garra afilada de Chameleos. Aunque pequeña, se la valora mucho por ser fácil de trabajar.
description_it: Artiglio acuminato di Chameleos. Piccolo e aguzzo, ma facile da lavorare.
description_zh: Sharpened claw of a Chameleos. Small and sharp, but still valued for being easy to work with.

name: Chameleos Hardclaw
description: A tough Chameleos claw. Its slender sharpness and strength make it an exceptional weapon.
description_de: Messerscharfe Klaue eines Chameleos. Material für erstklassige Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Le tranchant affûté et la solidité de cette griffe de Chameleos en font une arme d'exception.
description_es: Zarpa muy dura y resistente, El que sea tan afilada hace de ella un arma excepcional.
description_it: Artiglio sottile, ma acuminato e resistente, usato per forgiare armi di qualità eccezionale.
description_zh: A tough Chameleos claw. Its slender sharpness and strength make it an exceptional weapon.

name: Chameleos Webbing
description: Thin, light wing webbing. The inner part of the webbing is highly durable.
description_de: Dünnes, leichtes Flügel- gewebe. Der innere Teil ist sehr haltbar.
description_fr: Palmure d'aile légère. La partie interne de la palmure est résistante.
description_es: Membrana delgada y ligera. La parte interior es resistente al desgaste.
description_it: Sottile e leggera membrana di un'ala. La parte interna è molto duratura.
description_zh: Thin, light wing webbing. The inner part of the webbing is highly durable.

name: Chameleos Fellwing
description: A top-grade Chameleos wing. The strong, firm frame makes it invaluable as material.
description_de: Spitzenflügel. Der starke und robuste Rahmen macht ihn sehr wertvoll.
description_fr: Aile de qualité. Dure, en cuir avec une solide armature. Ultra précieuse.
description_es: Ala de máxima calidad. De fuerte cuero y firme armazón. Muy valiosa.
description_it: Un'ala di cuoio robusta e leggera, con una solida intelaiatura. Preziosa.
description_zh: A top-grade Chameleos wing. The strong, firm frame makes it invaluable as material.

name: Chameleos Tail
description: The distinctive tail of Chameleos. Feels very strange.
description_de: Ein unverkennbarer Schwanz des Chameleos. Löst ein seltsames Gefühl aus.
description_fr: Queue distinctive provoquant une sensation étrange.
description_es: Cola característica de los Chameleos. Causa una extraña sensación.
description_it: La caratteristica coda del Chameleos. Provoca una strana sensazione.
description_zh: The distinctive tail of Chameleos. Feels very strange.

name: Chameleos Lash
description: The tough, hard tail of Chameleos. The unique texture makes for excellent material.
description_de: Starker, zäher Schwanz. Die Beschaffenheit macht ihn zum tollen Material.
description_fr: Queue en cuir ferme. Sa texture unique en fait un excellent matériau.
description_es: Sólida cola de cuero. Su textura única la hace un excelente material.
description_it: Coda di cuoio dalla consistenza unica. Ottimo materiale da lavoro.
description_zh: The tough, hard tail of Chameleos. The unique texture makes for excellent material.

name: Chameleos Gem
description: A rare gem formed inside Chameleos. It has a multi-colored glow.
description_de: Ein seltenes Juwel aus einem Chameleos. Leuchtet in mehreren Farben.
description_fr: Pierre rare qui brille de nombreuses couleurs.
description_es: Extraña gema encontrada en las entrañas de un Chameleos. De brillo multicolor.
description_it: Rara. Si è formata dentro un Chameleos. Luminosa e multicolore.
description_zh: A rare gem formed inside Chameleos. It has a multi-colored glow.

name: Teostra Shell
description: The red hot shell of Teostra. It proves its domain over all fire.
description_de: Der glutrote Panzer eines Teostra. Herrscht über das Feuer.
description_fr: Carapace brûlante du Teostra. Démontre son règne sur le feu.
description_es: Caparazón ardiente de Teostra. Demuestra su dominio sobre el fuego.
description_it: Rossa e calda corazza del Teostra. Dimostra il suo dominio sul fuoco.
description_zh: The red hot shell of Teostra. It proves its domain over all fire.

name: Teostra Carapace
description: Harder than Teostra Shell. Looks like red-hot steel; particularly eye catching.
description_de: Härter als Teostra-Panzer. Zieht das Auge an, wie rotglühender Stahl.
description_fr: Plus dure que la carapace du Teostra. Fascine comme l'acier brûlant.
description_es: Más duro que el caparazón de Teostra. Tan atractivo como el acero ardiente.
description_it: Più duro della corazza di Teostra. Cattura l'occhio come l'acciaio rovente.
description_zh: Harder than Teostra Shell. Looks like red-hot steel; particularly eye catching.

name: Teostra Cortex
description: Merely looking upon this heavy shell is enough to shatter the hearts of hardened warriors.
description_de: Der bloße Anblick dieses Panzers bricht die Herzen abgebrühter Krieger.
description_fr: Regarder le rouge majestueux de cette carapace suffit à briser le cœur des plus vaillants.
description_es: El corazón del que ve el majestuoso rojo de este caparazón se parte en dos.
description_it: Il magnifico colore rosso di questa corazza pesante è degno di ammirazione.
description_zh: Merely looking upon this heavy shell is enough to shatter the hearts of hardened warriors.

name: Teostra Mane
