description: This majestic mane is a sure sign of Teostra's regality.
description_de: Majestätische Mähne eines Teostra. Symbol für die königliche Würde.
description_fr: La digne crinière du Teostra, signe de son caractère royal.
description_es: Majestuosa crin de Teostra. Muestra lo regio que es su portador.
description_it: La maestosa criniera del Teostra è un segno sicuro della sua regalità.
description_zh: This majestic mane is a sure sign of Teostra's regality.

name: Teostra Tail
description: Covered in red scales, the tree like tail of Teostra is incredibly hard to cut.
description_de: Der Schwanz ist mit roten Schuppen bedeckt und schwer zu schneiden.
description_fr: Queue difficile à couper, sertie d'écailles rouges et épaisses comme un arbre.
description_es: Cubierta de escamas rojas, la cola arbórea de un Teostra es muy difícil de cortar.
description_it: Coda di Teostra, coperta di scaglie rosse; davvero difficile da tagliare.
description_zh: Covered in red scales, the tree like tail of Teostra is incredibly hard to cut.

name: Teostra Lash
description: The stone-hard tail of Teostra. A lash from this tail unleashes unimaginable explosions.
description_de: Der steinharte Schwanz eines Teostra; verursacht unglaubliche Explosionen.
description_fr: Queue en cuir qui peut briser des murs de pierre. Un coup cause une tornade.
description_es: Cola de cuero capaz de romper muros de piedra. Con un solo latigazo puede crear un tornado.
description_it: Coda di cuoio che può distruggere intere mura. Agitata, crea un tornado.
description_zh: The stone-hard tail of Teostra. A lash from this tail unleashes unimaginable explosions.

name: Teostra Horn
description: A horn that displays the power of Teostra. Hunters wither before its might.
description_de: Das Horn zeigt die Kraft des Teostra. Jäger sacken davor in sich zusammen.
description_fr: Représente la puissance du Teostra. Les chasseurs tremblent à sa vue.
description_es: Cuerno que muestra el poder del Teostra. Su poder debilita a los cazadores.
description_it: Corno che mostra il potere del Teostra. I cacciatori temono la sua potenza.
description_zh: A horn that displays the power of Teostra. Hunters wither before its might.

name: Teostra Horn+
description: A sharp horn that burns with the fury of Teostra. It is tinged with fire.
description_de: Ein scharfes Horn mit dem Zorn von Teostra und umhüllt von Feuer.
description_fr: Une corne pointue brûlant de la fureur du Teostra. Teintée de feu.
description_es: Cuerno afilado que arde con la furia de un Teostra. Matizado con fuego.
description_it: Un corno affilato che arde della furia del Teostra. Colorato dal fuoco.
description_zh: A sharp horn that burns with the fury of Teostra. It is tinged with fire.

name: Teostra Hardhorn
description: A majestic horn that commands all who gaze upon it to bend the knee.
description_de: Erhabenes Horn, vor dem alle auf die Knie fallen.
description_fr: Corne majestueuse devant laquelle quiconque se prosterne.
description_es: Cuerno majestuoso. Su visión hace que muchos se arrodillen en su admiración.
description_it: Un corno maestoso. Chi lo vede cade in ginocchio.
description_zh: A majestic horn that commands all who gaze upon it to bend the knee.

name: Fire Dragon Scale
description: A scalding hot scale. It'll take your fingerprints right off.
description_de: Glühend heiße Feuerdrachenschuppe.
description_fr: Écaille de feu encore brûlante.
description_es: Escama al rojo vivo de un dragón de fuego ardiente.
description_it: Una scaglia ustionante di drago di fuoco.
description_zh: A scalding hot scale. It'll take your fingerprints right off.

name: Fire Dragon Scale+
description: A scale from a majestic fire dragon. It burns with hot fire from within.
description_de: Eine schöne Teostra- Schuppe, in der ein heißes Feuer lodert.
description_fr: Jolie écaille de dragon brûlant d'une flamme interne.
description_es: Escama de un valiente dragón de fuego que arde con fuego propio.
description_it: Scaglia di drago di fuoco, che brucia dall'interno con un fuoco rovente.
description_zh: A scale from a majestic fire dragon. It burns with hot fire from within.

name: Flame Shard
description: The highest quality scale from Teostra. Hunters can only dream of finding one.
description_de: Teostra-Schuppe von höchster Qualität. Jäger träumen davon, eine zu besitzen.
description_fr: Écaille de dragon de feu top qualité à la chaleur sans égale.
description_es: Escama de dragón de fuego de la mejor calidad de una auténtica bestia.
description_it: È molto difficile trovare delle scaglie di Teostra così ben sviluppate.
description_zh: The highest quality scale from Teostra. Hunters can only dream of finding one.

name: Fire Dragon Claw
description: A sharp, glowing Fire Dragon claw. Hard even for experts to craft.
description_de: Scharfe, glühende Drachen- Klaue. Selbst für Experten schwer zu bearbeiten.
description_fr: Griffe brûlante très difficile à travailler.
description_es: Garra de dragón de fuego brillante y afilada. Difícil de trabajar, hasta para un experto.
description_it: Aguzzo, splendido artiglio di drago di fuoco. Molto difficile da lavorare.
description_zh: A sharp, glowing Fire Dragon claw. Hard even for experts to craft.

name: Teostra Claw+
description: A death sentence to he who tries to elude the dragon's flames. Still feels hot.
description_de: Todesurteil für den, der des Drachens Flammen auswei- chen will. Immer noch heiß.
description_fr: Condamne à mort celui qui cherche à fuir les flammes du dragon. Encore chaude.
description_es: Sentencia de muerte para todo aquel que intente escapar del fuego del dragón. ¡Quema!
description_it: Uccide chiunque tenti di sfuggire al fuoco del drago. È ancora caldo al tatto.
description_zh: A death sentence to he who tries to elude the dragon's flames. Still feels hot.

name: Fire Dragon Hardclaw
description: A hard, fiery Teostra claw. It causes anything it scratches to burst into flames.
description_de: Ein Kratzer von dieser Klaue lässt das Opfer in Flammen aufgehen.
description_fr: Une griffure de cette griffe dure et ardente cause une combustion spontanée.
description_es: Los rasguños de esta dura y afilada garra a menudo entran en combustión espontánea.
description_it: Il solo tocco di questo artiglio fiammeggiante scatena incendi terribili.
description_zh: A hard, fiery Teostra claw. It causes anything it scratches to burst into flames.

name: Teostra Webbing
description: Wing webbing carved from a fire dragon. A marvelous material with many uses.
description_de: Das Flügelgewebe des Teostra. Ein Material mit vielen Möglichkeiten.
description_fr: Partie de l'aile d'un dragon de feu. Pour de nombreux usages.
description_es: Membrana del ala de un dragón de fuego. Un material con muchos usos.
description_it: Membrana di ala di drago di fuoco. Meraviglioso materiale dai molti usi.
description_zh: Wing webbing carved from a fire dragon. A marvelous material with many uses.

name: Teostra Powder
description: Powder from fire dragon wings. Said to magnify a material's abilities.
description_de: Pulver aus einem Teostra- Flügel. Verstärkt die Materialeigenschaften.
description_fr: De la poudre extraite des ailes d'un dragon. Améliore les matériaux.
description_es: Polvo de las alas de un dragón de fuego. Mejora las cualidades de los demás materiales.
description_it: Polvere di ali di drago di fuoco. Si dice che aumenti le qualità dei materiali.
description_zh: Powder from fire dragon wings. Said to magnify a material's abilities.

name: Teostra Gem
description: A rare gem formed inside a fire dragon. Flickers with ferocious flames.
description_de: Ein seltenes Juwel aus einem Teostra, das ein brüllendes Inferno enthält.
description_fr: Pierre rare extraite d'un dragon de feu. Contient un brasier infernal.
description_es: Extraña joya extraída de las entrañas de un dragón. Contiene al infierno mismo.
description_it: Raro gioiello, formato dentro un drago di fuoco. Contiene un inferno.
description_zh: A rare gem formed inside a fire dragon. Flickers with ferocious flames.

name: Wyvern Crystal
description: A mysterious crystal that glows with the energy of both light and dark spirits.
description_de: Ein geheimnisvoller Kristall, in dem die Energie dunkler und heller Geister glüht.
description_fr: Cristal mystérieux qui émet une lueur provenant des esprits de la lumière et des ténèbres.
description_es: Misterioso cristal en el que brilla la energía de espíritus de luz y de oscuridad.
description_it: Cristallo misterioso che emana l'energia degli spiriti della luce e delle tenebre.
description_zh: A mysterious crystal that glows with the energy of both light and dark spirits.

name: Great Wyvern Crystal
description: A mysterious crystal of light and dark spirits. The owner is said to gain godlike powers.
description_de: Perfekter Kristall, in dem helle und dunkle Geister wohnen. Wer ihn berührt, wird gottgleich.
description_fr: Ce cristal habité par les esprits de la lumière et des ténèbres octroierait de grands pouvoirs.
description_es: Misterioso cristal habitado por espíritus de la luz y las tinieblas. Concede gran poder.
description_it: Cristallo misterioso che unisce spiriti di luce ed ombra. Dona poteri divini a chi lo possiede.
description_zh: A mysterious crystal of light and dark spirits. The owner is said to gain godlike powers.

name: Akantor Scale+
description: Faintly glittering Akantor Scale. It will not melt, even if dipped in lava.
description_de: Leicht glänzende Akantor- Schuppe. Sie schmilzt nicht einmal in Lava.
description_fr: Écaille luisant faiblement. Ne fond pas, même dans la lave.
description_es: Escama de Akantor con un ligero brillo. Ni la lava podría fundirla.
description_it: Scaglia di Akantor; brilla leggermente. Non si fonde neanche nella lava.
description_zh: Faintly glittering Akantor Scale. It will not melt, even if dipped in lava.

name: Akantor Shard
description: A splendid scale with a faint glow. Requires cooling after all that time in lava.
description_de: Prächtige Schuppe mit mattem Glanz. Nach der Zeit in der Lava braucht sie Kühlung.
description_fr: Magnifique écaille à la lueur délicate. Doit encore être refroidie.
description_es: Una escama espléndida con un brillo tenue. Hay que enfriarla antes de usarla.
description_it: Scaglia scintillante che deve essere raffreddata dopo una esistenza immersa nella lava.
description_zh: A splendid scale with a faint glow. Requires cooling after all that time in lava.

name: Akantor Carapace
description: Shining Akantor Shell. Exceptionally hard, and thus difficult to craft.
description_de: Glänzender Akantor-Panzer. Unglaublich hart und schwer zu bearbeiten.
description_fr: Carapace exceptionnellement dure, donc difficile à travailler.
description_es: Coraza de un Akantor. Excepcionalmente dura y, por tanto, difícil de trabajar.
description_it: Splendente corazza di Akantor. Molto dura e difficile da lavorare.
description_zh: Shining Akantor Shell. Exceptionally hard, and thus difficult to craft.

name: Akantor Cortex
description: Bulky plating with a faint glow. Deters most attacks and repels the rest.
description_de: Dicke Panzerung mit mattem Glanz. Hält die meisten Angriffe ab.
description_fr: Plaque volumineuse à la lueur délicate. Prévient et repousse les attaques.
description_es: Coraza robusta con un brillo tenue. Para casi todos los ataques.
description_it: Corazza robusta che emana un lieve bagliore. Incute timore e protegge da ogni attacco.
description_zh: Bulky plating with a faint glow. Deters most attacks and repels the rest.

name: Akantor Tail
description: The large rock-like tail of an Akantor. Strong enough to gouge the earth.
description_de: Der felsgleiche Schwanz eines Akantor. Kann die Erde aufwühlen.
description_fr: Queue en forme de rocher. Sa force suffit à fendre la terre en deux.
description_es: Gran cola de un Akantor, similar a una roca. Capaz de abrir la tierra.
description_it: Grossa coda, simile alla roccia. Così forte da poter scavare la terra.
description_zh: The large rock-like tail of an Akantor. Strong enough to gouge the earth.

name: Akantor Flail
description: A barbed tail that razes the earth and knocks the fight right out of prey.
description_de: Scharfer Schwanz. Schlitzt die Erde auf und peitscht den Kampf aus der Beute.
description_fr: Queue à pointes qui rase le sol et met une proie à terre avant tout combat.
description_es: Cola con pinchos que le quita las ganas de luchar a la presa.
description_it: Coda appuntita che squarcia il terreno e fiacca l'ardore degli avversari.
description_zh: A barbed tail that razes the earth and knocks the fight right out of prey.

name: Akantor Hardclaw
description: Hard Akantor claw that can smash bedrock. Its victims are left unrecognizable.
description_de: Die Akantor-Klaue kann Felsen zerschmettern. Ihre Opfer sind verunstaltet.
description_fr: Peut briser la roche ou mettre ses victimes en charpie.
description_es: Garra de Akantor, capaz de partir la roca. Deja a sus víctimas irreconocibles.
description_it: Duro artiglio di Akantor; spezza la roccia. Rende le vittime irriconoscibili.
description_zh: Hard Akantor claw that can smash bedrock. Its victims are left unrecognizable.

name: Akantor Shredtalon
description: An earth-shredding claw that destroys anything caught in the Akantor's charge.
description_de: Erde aufreißende Kralle, die alles vernichtet, was dem Akantor im Weg ist.
description_fr: Griffe capable de tout détruire sur le passage d'un Akantor.
description_es: Una garra que rasga la tierra y destruye todo lo que se cruza en su camino.
description_it: Artiglio devastante con cui l'Akantor fa a pezzi qualunque avversario.
description_zh: An earth-shredding claw that destroys anything caught in the Akantor's charge.

name: Akantor Tallfang
description: Huge fang that can pierce the heavens. It has passed through many foes.
description_de: Ein Reißzahn, den nichts aufhalten kann. Hat schon viele Feinde zerfetzt.
description_fr: Croc énorme qui peut fendre les cieux. A écrasé de nombreux adversaires.
description_es: Enorme colmillo capaz de golpear el cielo. Ha atravesado muchos rivales.
description_it: Enorme zanna che può raggiungere i cieli. Ha trapassato molti nemici.
description_zh: Huge fang that can pierce the heavens. It has passed through many foes.

name: Akantor Greatfang
description: One of a pair of towering fangs. The hard base makes it ideal equipment material.
description_de: Gewaltiger Reißzahn. Seine Härte macht ihn zum idealen Ausrüstungsmaterial.
description_fr: Croc colossal. Sa base très solide en fait un matériau idéal.
description_es: Un colmillo imponente. La base dura es ideal como componente de equipo.
description_it: Una di due imponenti zanne. La base rigida è un'ottima materia prima per oggetti.
description_zh: One of a pair of towering fangs. The hard base makes it ideal equipment material.

name: Akantor Spike
description: A flawless spike from an Akantor. It can easily scar rock.
description_de: Makelloser Stachel aus der Akantor-Panzerung. Schneidet sogar Felsen ohne Probleme.
description_fr: Elle peut tailler la pierre.
description_es: Púa perfecta de la armadura de un Akantor. Puede marcar fácilmente la roca.
description_it: Perfetta punta di una corazza di Akantor; può sfregiare la roccia.
description_zh: A flawless spike from an Akantor. It can easily scar rock.

name: Akantor Thickspike
description: A thick, sturdy shell spike believed to have evolved as defense against larger foes.
description_de: Dicker Panzerstachel. Ob er sich zur Verteidigung gegen große Feinde entwickelt hat?
description_fr: Pointe de carapace qu'on pense être apparue pour se protéger des prédateurs.
description_es: Una espina muy dura que podría haber evolucionado como defensa.
description_it: Un grosso aculeo di carapace sviluppatosi come risposta evolutiva ai grossi predatori.
description_zh: A thick, sturdy shell spike believed to have evolved as defense against larger foes.

name: Akantor Gem
description: A gem that once belonged to the Ancient World-King. Its aura resists new ownership.
description_de: Gehörte einst dem uralten Weltenkönig. Seine Aura widersteht neuen Besitzern.
description_fr: Appartenait au roi de l'ancien monde. Son aura résiste à l'épreuve du temps.
description_es: Gema que perteneció al antiguo rey del mundo. No quiere un nuevo propietario.
description_it: Gemma appartenuta all'antico re del mondo. La sua aura permane ancora oggi.
description_zh: A gem that once belonged to the Ancient World-King. Its aura resists new ownership.

name: Conquest Sphere
description: A gem said to grant dominion over everything under the sun. Courses with ambition.
description_de: Edelstein, der die Herrschaft über alles unter der Sonne bringen soll. Voller Ehrgeiz.
description_fr: Gemme réputée donner le contrôle de toute chose et imprégnée d'ambition.
description_es: Una gema que podría dar poder sobre todo bajo el sol. Una ambición maldita.
description_it: Si narra che questa gemma assicuri il dominio sul mondo. Infonde un'ambizione smodata.
description_zh: A gem said to grant dominion over everything under the sun. Courses with ambition.

name: Ukanlos Carapace
description: The minerals encrusted in this cold-infused shell make it surprisingly strong.
description_de: Die Mineralien in diesem Panzer machen ihn so erstaunlich stark.
description_fr: Les minerais composant cette carapace glaciale lui donnent sa force.
description_es: Una coraza helada, engarzada de multitud de minerales que la hacen muy resistente.
description_it: I minerali che ricoprono questa gelida corazza, la rendono molto resistente.
description_zh: The minerals encrusted in this cold-infused shell make it surprisingly strong.

name: Ukanlos Cortex
description: The minerals encrusted in this cold-infused cortex make it surprisingly strong.
description_de: Die Mineralien in diesem Kortex machen ihn so erstaunlich stark.
description_fr: Les minerais incrustés dans cette carapace glaciale la renforcent de façon étonnante.
description_es: Los minerales incrustados en esta fría placa la hacen todavía más resistente de lo normal.
description_it: I minerali che ricoprono questa gelida corazza, la rendono molto resistente.
description_zh: The minerals encrusted in this cold-infused cortex make it surprisingly strong.

name: Ukanlos Underscale
description: A thick, sharp belly scale. Cuts through snow, allowing Ukanlos to move easier.
description_de: Dicke wasserfeste Schuppe, mit der sich der Ukanlos leicht durch Schnee bewegt.
description_fr: Épaisse écaille étanche qui couvre le ventre de l'Ukanlos.
description_es: Escama gruesa e impermeable que cubre la zona ventral del Ukanlos.
description_it: Scaglia impermeabile che copre il ventre dell'Ukanlos.
description_zh: A thick, sharp belly scale. Cuts through snow, allowing Ukanlos to move easier.

name: Ukanlos Underscale+
description: A thick, sharp belly scale. Used to get around by cutting through the ice.
description_de: Dicke, scharfe Bauchschuppe. Wird verwendet, um damit durch Eis zu schneiden.
description_fr: Épaisse écaille ventrale. Utilisée pour se frayer un chemin à travers la glace.
description_es: Escama afilada de la panza. La usan para cortar el hielo al desplazarse.
description_it: Scaglia del ventre spessa e affilata. Utilizzata per avanzare sul ghiaccio.
description_zh: A thick, sharp belly scale. Used to get around by cutting through the ice.

name: Ukanlos Tail
description: The icy tail of Ukanlos. A single lash makes the air scream and the earth cry.
description_de: Eisiger Schwanz des Ukanlos. Lässt die Erde erbeben und die Luft vibrieren.
description_fr: Queue glacée d'un Ukanlos. Un coup fait trembler la terre et résonner l'air.
description_es: Cola helada de Ukanlos. Un latigazo retumba la tierra y hace resonar el aire.
description_it: Gelida coda di Ukanlos. Una sua frustata scuote la terra e fa gemere l'aria.
description_zh: The icy tail of Ukanlos. A single lash makes the air scream and the earth cry.

name: Ukanlos Flail
description: A giant, icy Ukanlos tail. One swipe makes the air scream and glaciers crack.
description_de: Riesiger, eisiger Schwanz des Ukanlos; die Luft schreit und Gletscher reißen ein.
description_fr: Queue glacée d'un Ukanlos. Un coup fait trembler la terre et résonner l'air.
description_es: La gigantesca cola helada de un Ukanlos. Hace chillar al viento y llorar a la tierra.
description_it: Gelida coda di Ukanlos. Una sua frustata scuote la terra e fa gemere l'aria.
description_zh: A giant, icy Ukanlos tail. One swipe makes the air scream and glaciers crack.

name: Ukanlos Digger
description: An Ukanlos claw. Repeated voyages through the ice have twisted its shape.
description_de: Ukanlos-Klaue. Die verdrehte Form rührt vom Graben durch Eis her.
description_fr: Griffe d'Ukanlos. Forme torsadée à force de creuser dans la glace.
description_es: Garra de Ukanlos. Está torcida porque la usaba para escarbar el hielo.
description_it: Artiglio Ukanlos. La forma contorta è dovuta ai colpi contro il ghiaccio.
description_zh: An Ukanlos claw. Repeated voyages through the ice have twisted its shape.

name: Ukanlos Digger+
description: An impossibly massive claw with ridges used to pull the monster onto the ice.
description_de: Unfassbar massive Klaue mit Rillen, die das Monster auf das Eis ziehen.
description_fr: Griffe massive striée utilisée pour tirer les monstres sur la glace.
description_es: Una garra enorme con partes rugosas que tiran del monstruo hacia el hielo.
description_it: Enorme artiglio ricoperto di scanalature usate dal mostro per muoversi sul ghiaccio.
description_zh: An impossibly massive claw with ridges used to pull the monster onto the ice.

name: Ukanlos Shoveljaw
description: Ukanlos's shovel-like jaw. Developed to shovel snow, one scoop can cause an avalanche.
description_de: Schaufelartiger Kiefer des Ukanlos. Wird wie ein Schneepflug verwendet.
description_fr: Une mâchoire en forme de pelle utilisée pour labourer la neige.
description_es: Mandíbula de Ukanlos en forma de pala, utilizada por el monstruo para trillar la nieve.
description_it: La mandibola di Ukanlos sembra una pala e serve a scavare nel ghiaccio.
description_zh: Ukanlos's shovel-like jaw. Developed to shovel snow, one scoop can cause an avalanche.

name: Ukanlos Shoveljaw+
description: A prominent jaw that makes for a real spectacle when it smashes apart hunks of ice.
description_de: Markanter Kiefer. Es ist ein wahres Spektakel, wenn er Eis zermalmt.
description_fr: Mâchoire imposante, dont les capacités à briser la glace sont spectaculaires.
description_es: Una mandíbula prominente que resulta espectacular al partir pedazos de hielo.
description_it: Mandibola prominente capace di sbriciolare blocchi di ghiaccio con stupefacente facilità.
description_zh: A prominent jaw that makes for a real spectacle when it smashes apart hunks of ice.

name: Ukanlos Fin+
description: A huge dorsal fin with saw-like ridges at the tip that cut through anything.
description_de: Große Rückenflosse mit Erhöhungen ähnlich einer Säge; durchschneidet alles.
description_fr: Grande nageoire dorsale dentée et dont la pointe peut tout transpercer.
description_es: Gran aleta dorsal con borde aserrado que corta todo lo que toca.
description_it: Enorme pinna dorsale con bordi seghettati capaci di squarciare qualunque materiale.
description_zh: A huge dorsal fin with saw-like ridges at the tip that cut through anything.

name: Ukanlos Strongfin
description: A giant, saw-like fin that runs along the Ukanlos's back. Cuts through all.
description_de: Riesige Sägeflosse vom Ukanlos-Rücken. Durchschneidet alles.
description_fr: Une nageoire géante située le long du dos de l'Ukanlos. En forme de scie, elle coupe tout.
description_es: Aleta gigante en forma de sierra de la espada del Ukanlos. Lo corta todo.
description_it: Pinna seghettata che corre sul dorso dell'Ukanlos. È molto tagliente.
description_zh: A giant, saw-like fin that runs along the Ukanlos's back. Cuts through all.

name: Ukanlos Gem
description: A gem owned by a king who nearly ended the world. It seeks to destroy new owners.
description_de: Gehörte dem König, der fast die Welt zerstörte. Er will neue Besitzer vernichten.
description_fr: Appartenait à un roi qui a failli détruire le monde. A un pouvoir maléfique.
description_es: Pertenecía a un rey que casi acaba con el mundo. Ansía destruir a su nuevo dueño.
description_it: Gemma di un re che rischiò di scatenare l'apocalisse. Distrugge i suoi possessori.
description_zh: A gem owned by a king who nearly ended the world. It seeks to destroy new owners.

name: Ukanlos Stone
description: A legendary Ukanlos stone. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Phantasmischer Stein. Vereint angeblich die Erde und ergreift den Himmel.
description_fr: Une pierre légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Piedra fantasmal. Cuando se creó, unificó la tierra y atrapó el cielo.
description_it: Una pietra eterea. Si dice che sia in grado di unire la terra e il cielo.
description_zh: A legendary Ukanlos stone. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Alatreon Scute
description: A unique plating that can protect against attacks, and even deflect blows.
description_de: Eine einzigartige Panzerung, die vor Angriffen schützt. Kann Angriffe abwehren.
description_fr: Plaque singulière protégeant des attaques, qu'elle peut même dévier.
description_es: Placa única que protege de ataques. Incluso permite rechazar algunos.
description_it: Placca eccellente che difende dagli attacchi, persino respingendoli.
description_zh: A unique plating that can protect against attacks, and even deflect blows.

name: Alatreon Pallium
description: A miraculous plate impervious to all attacks. Legend says the bearer receives heaven's love.
description_de: Wunderbare Platte, die allen Angriffen trotzt. Ihr Träger soll Himmelsliebe erfahren.
description_fr: Insensible à toutes les attaques. On dit que celui qui l'a est béni des cieux.
description_es: Placa milagrosa contra todo ataque. El portador recibirá la gracia divina.
description_it: Miracolosa piastra invulnerabile agli attacchi; pare che chi la porta sia benedetto.
description_zh: A miraculous plate impervious to all attacks. Legend says the bearer receives heaven's love.

name: Alatreon Plate
description: This particular Alatreon scale grows in backwards. It is as sharp as a blade.
description_de: Diese besondere Alatreon- Schuppe wächst in die Haut. Scharf wie eine Klinge.
description_fr: Cette écaille spéciale pousse à l'envers. Aussi aiguisée qu'une épée.
description_es: Esta escama especial de Alatreon crece hacia atrás. Afilada como una espada.
description_it: Una scaglia particolare che cresce al contrario. È affilata come una lama.
description_zh: This particular Alatreon scale grows in backwards. It is as sharp as a blade.

name: Alatreon Mantle
description: The mantle of Alatreon is the stuff of legend, containing traces of every element within.
description_de: Die Alatreon-Hülle ist legendär und enthält Spuren aller denkbaren Elemente.
description_fr: Censée faire partie des légendes, elle contient des traces de tous les éléments.
description_es: El manto de un Alatreon es legendario. Contiene trazas de todos los elementos.
description_it: Il mantello dell'Alatreon è leggendario: contiene tracce di tutti gli elementi.
description_zh: The mantle of Alatreon is the stuff of legend, containing traces of every element within.

name: Alatreon Talon
description: A talon capable of making weapons of untold power. Ridiculously sharp.
description_de: Eine Kralle, mit der sagenhafte Waffen zu erschaffen sind. Unwahrscheinlich scharf.
description_fr: Griffe qui sert à fabriquer des armes d'une puissance phénoménale. Très acérée.
description_es: Espolón capaz de crear armas de extraordinario poder. Increíblemente afilado.
description_it: Sperone da cui si ricavano armi di straordinaria potenza e altrettanto affilate.
description_zh: A talon capable of making weapons of untold power. Ridiculously sharp.

name: Alatreon Riptalon
description: The mere sight of this deadly talon calls forth images of terrible weapons made from it.
description_de: Schon der Anblick dieser tödlichen Kralle lässt an schreckliche Waffen denken.
description_fr: La simple vue de cette serre fait penser aux armes terribles faites avec.
description_es: La visión de esta zarpa mortífera evoca terribles armas que se han forjado.
description_it: Sperone dall'aspetto spaventoso, almeno quanto le armi che è possibile ricavarne.
description_zh: The mere sight of this deadly talon calls forth images of terrible weapons made from it.

name: Alatreon Webbing
description: At times this looks like a dark abyss; at others, like the coming of first light.
description_de: Kann aussehen wie ein dunkler Abgrund, aber auch wie das erste zarte Licht.
description_fr: Semblable aux abysses sombres ou aux premières lueurs du jour.
description_es: A veces parece un oscuro abismo; otras veces, la llegada de la primera luz.
description_it: A volte emana una luce radiosa, altre un'oscurità inquietante.
description_zh: At times this looks like a dark abyss; at others, like the coming of first light.

name: Alatreo Direwing
description: This vile wing can cut through time and space to destroy the entire world...say the rumors.
description_de: Dieser schreckliche Flügel kann Raum, Zeit und die Welt vernichten... Heißt es.
description_fr: Cette aile ignoble perce à travers l'espace et le temps et détruit tout... paraît-il.
description_es: Se dice que esta ala puede atravesar tiempo y espacio para destruir el mundo...
description_it: Quest'ala può tagliare lo spazio-tempo e distruggere il mondo... almeno così dicono.
description_zh: This vile wing can cut through time and space to destroy the entire world...say the rumors.

name: Alatreon Tail
description: The tail from an Alatreon, previously thought to only have existed in legend.
description_de: Der Schwanz eines Alatreon. Früher dachte man, er existiere nur in Legenden.
description_fr: Queue d'Alatreon qui n'existait auparavant que dans les légendes.
description_es: Cola de Alatreon, hasta ahora se creía que solo existía en las leyendas.
description_it: Coda di Alatreon, creatura un tempo considerata una mera leggenda.
description_zh: The tail from an Alatreon, previously thought to only have existed in legend.

name: Alatreo Diretail
description: "Is this a dream?" "Am I alive?" Those who grasp this tail begin to harbor such doubts.
description_de: "Ist das ein Traum?" "Lebe ich?" Wer diesen Schweif berührt, fragt sich das.
description_fr: "Suis-je vraiment encore en vie ?" se demandent ceux qui s'emparent de cette queue.
description_es: "¿Es un sueño?" "¿Sigo vivo?" Los que toquen esta cola se lo preguntarán.
description_it: Chi si assicura questa coda inizia a chiedersi se è vivo, o se sta sognando.
description_zh: "Is this a dream?" "Am I alive?" Those who grasp this tail begin to harbor such doubts.

name: Broken Skypiercer
description: A piece of the horn from atop an Alatreon's head. Broken due to the difficulty harvesting it.
description_de: Ein Hornstück von einem Alatreonkopf. Wurde bei der Bergung beschädigt.
description_fr: Bout de corne d'Alatreon. Introuvable, sauf sous cette forme.
description_es: Trozo de cuerno de la cabeza de Alatreon. Está roto debido a la dificultad de su extracción.
description_it: Parte del corno cranico di un Alatreon. Si è spezzato in quanto difficile da estrarre.
description_zh: A piece of the horn from atop an Alatreon's head. Broken due to the difficulty harvesting it.

name: Skypiercer
description: Part of an Alatreon's convoluted horns.
description_de: Teil der gewundenen Alatreon-Hörner.
description_fr: Partie des cornes tortueuses d'un Alatreon.
description_es: Una parte de los enrevesados cuernos del Alatreon.
description_it: Parte delle corna contorte di un Alatreon.
description_zh: Part of an Alatreon's convoluted horns.

name: Skyswayer
description: Part of an Alatreon's convoluted horns. The finest specimen known to exist.
description_de: Teil der gewundenen Alatreon-Hörner. Die schönsten, die es gibt.
description_fr: Partie des cornes tortueuses d'un Alatreon. Le plus beau spécimen connu.
description_es: Parte de los cuernos enrevesados del Alatreon. El mejor espécimen conocido.
description_it: Parte delle corna contorte di un Alatreon; le migliori al mondo.
description_zh: Part of an Alatreon's convoluted horns. The finest specimen known to exist.

name: Azure Dragongem
description: The legend to beat all legends. It is said to bring about the end of those who obtain it.
description_de: Die Legende, die alle Legenden besiegt. Wer sie findet, dessen Ende ist nah, so sagt man.
description_fr: Une légende parmi les légendes. Elle précipiterait la fin de celui qui s'en procure.
description_es: La leyenda entre leyendas. Se dice que supone el fin de aquel que se haga con ella.
description_it: La leggenda che supera ogni leggenda. Si mormora condanni chiunque la possegga.
description_zh: The legend to beat all legends. It is said to bring about the end of those who obtain it.

name: Azure Dragonsphire
description: Legend says the discovery of this brilliant gem heralds the end of the world.
description_de: Der Legende nach soll die Entdeckung dieses Juwels das Ende der Welt einläuten.
description_fr: La légende raconte que la découverte de cette gemme annonce la fin du monde.
description_es: La leyenda cuenta que el descubrimiento de esta gema anuncia el fin del mundo.
description_it: Si dice che trovare questa sfavillante gemma annunci la fine del mondo.
description_zh: Legend says the discovery of this brilliant gem heralds the end of the world.

name: Amatsu Carapace
description: Black armor beaten by fierce winds into powerful defense for a celestial god.
description_de: Schwarze Rüstung, die grimmi- ger Wind zum mächtigen Panzer eines Himmelsgottes hämmerte.
description_fr: Armure noire battue par les vents pour mieux protéger un dieu céleste.
description_es: Coraza negra golpeada por los vientos hasta conseguir una resistencia divina.
description_it: Corazza nera temprata dal vento, che l'ha resa una difesa degna di un dio.
description_zh: Black armor beaten by fierce winds into powerful defense for a celestial god.

name: Amatsu Cortex
description: This black armor, forged by the storm for a malevolent god, is almost unmatched in strength.
description_de: Schwarze Rüstung, die wilder Sturmwind zum erhabenen Panzer eines Himmelsgottes hämmerte.
description_fr: Cette armure noire forgée par une tempête pour protéger un dieu maléfique est inégalable.
description_es: Armadura negra forjada en plena tempestad por un dios malévolo. Su resistencia es inigualable.
description_it: Armatura scura e robusta forgiata da un dio malvagio. Una delle più resistenti.
description_zh: This black armor, forged by the storm for a malevolent god, is almost unmatched in strength.

name: Amatsu Webbing
description: Ethereal robes that make one appear to float, like something out of a fable.
description_de: Ätherische Gewänder, die den Eindruck vermitteln, dass du schwebst wie im Märchen.
description_fr: Robe éthérée donnant l'illusion de léviter, comme dans un conte de fées.
description_es: Toga etérea que da la sensación de flotar, como algo salido de un cuento.
description_it: Chi indossa questi abiti eterei sembra fluttuare come una creatura delle fiabe.
description_zh: Ethereal robes that make one appear to float, like something out of a fable.

name: Amatsu Membrane
description: Legendary material that, when worn, can even allow the wearer to float for a short time.
description_de: Ätherische Gewänder, die den Träger schweben lassen wie im Märchen.
description_fr: Matériau légendaire qui, revêtu, permet même à son porteur de léviter un court instant.
description_es: Material legendario que permite flotar durante un corto espacio de tiempo a quien lo lleve puesto.
description_it: Membrana creata con materiale leggendario. Chi la indossa può volare per brevi periodi.
description_zh: Legendary material that, when worn, can even allow the wearer to float for a short time.

name: Amatsu Horn
description: A horn carved from an Amatsu. The unblemished horns are proof of its strength.
description_de: Das Horn eines Amatsu. Die perfekten Hörner sind ein Zeichen seiner Stärke.
description_fr: Corne d'Amatsu. Son état intact donne une idée de sa résistance.
description_es: Cuerno extraído de un Amatsu. Los cuernos inmaculados son una prueba de su fuerza.
description_it: Corno di Amatsu. Le corna immacolate sono la prova della sua forza.
description_zh: A horn carved from an Amatsu. The unblemished horns are proof of its strength.

name: Amatsu Hardhorn
description: A horn carved from an Amatsu. It was grown in the midst of ferocious storms.
description_de: Das Horn eines Amatsu. Inmitten der Sturmwinde hat es sich prächtig entwickelt.
description_fr: Corne d'Amatsu. Elle a poussé sous de violentes tempêtes.
description_es: Cuerno extraído de un Amatsu. Creció en el seno de violentas tormentas.
description_it: Corno duro di Amatsu. Creato da una forza divina, ha avuto origine durante una tempesta.
description_zh: A horn carved from an Amatsu. It was grown in the midst of ferocious storms.

name: Amatsu Claw+
description: The incredibly sharp claw of an Amatsu. Just seeing the claw will instill fear of its owner.
description_de: Die äußerst scharfe Klaue eines Amatsu. Schon ihr Anblick ruft Furcht vor dem Besitzer hervor.
description_fr: Griffe archi-acérée d'un Amatsu. Elle fait peur même à celui qui la possède.
description_es: Garra increíblemente afilada de un Amatsu. Su mera visión provoca miedo a su poseedor.
description_it: Artiglio affilatissimo di Amatsu. Basta brandirlo per incutere terrore.
description_zh: The incredibly sharp claw of an Amatsu. Just seeing the claw will instill fear of its owner.

name: Amatsu Hardclaw
description: The incredibly sharp claw of an Amatsu. Just seeing the claw inspires intense fear.
description_de: Die extrem scharfe Klaue eines Amatsu. Schon ihr Anblick ruft Furcht vor dem Besitzer hervor.
description_fr: Griffe extrêmement acérée d'un Amatsu. Sa simple vue peut déclencher une panique.
description_es: Zarpa increíblemente afilada de un Amatsu. Su mera presencia puede desencadenar el pánico.
description_it: Artiglio affilatissimo di Amatsu. Basta vederlo per essere sopraffatti dal terrore.
description_zh: The incredibly sharp claw of an Amatsu. Just seeing the claw inspires intense fear.

name: Amatsu Tail
description: The tail of the Storm Dragon. It is very tough, which helps maneuverability in the storm.
description_de: Der Schwanz eines Sturm- drachen. Äußerst stark, was bei Manövern im Sturm nützlich ist.
description_fr: Queue du Dragon de Tempête. Sa robustesse assure sa maniabilité pendant la tempête.
description_es: Cola del Dragón tormentoso. Es muy dura, lo que mejora la maniobrabilidad en tormentas.
description_it: Coda di drago della tempesta. La sua rigidità lo aiuta a volare tra le tormente.
description_zh: The tail of the Storm Dragon. It is very tough, which helps maneuverability in the storm.

name: Amatsu Stormtail
description: The gorgeous tail of the Storm Dragon. Its dancing movements are said to call the storm.
description_de: Der Schwanz eines Sturmdrachen. Seine tanzenden Bewegungen rufen angeblich den Sturm herbei.
description_fr: Queue élégante du Dragon de Tempête. On dit que ses ondulations appellent la tempête.
description_es: Cola del Dragón tormentoso. Dicen que sus gráciles movimientos invocan la lluvia.
description_it: Coda meravigliosa di drago della tempesta. I suoi movimenti scatenano tempeste feroci.
description_zh: The gorgeous tail of the Storm Dragon. Its dancing movements are said to call the storm.

name: Amatsu Pleura
description: A chestplate that is said to steal the future of those who bathe in its passionate light.
description_de: Ein Brustpanzer, in dessen Licht zu baden dem Unvorsichtigen die Zukunft raubt.
description_fr: Plastron qui aurait le pouvoir de voler le futur de quiconque se prélasse dans sa lumière.
description_es: Una placa pectoral. Se dice que arrebata el futuro de quien sea irradiado por su luz apasionada.
description_it: Piastra pettorale che si dice rubi il futuro a chi si inebria della sua calda luce.
description_zh: A chestplate that is said to steal the future of those who bathe in its passionate light.

name: Amatsu Heavypleura
description: A heavy chestplate whose light emits despair. The passion it inspires is particularly strong.
description_de: Ein schwerer Brustpanzer, in dessen Licht zu baden den Unvorsichtigen verzweifeln lässt.
description_fr: Plastron lourd à la lueur empreinte de désespoir. Inspire de grandes passions.
description_es: Placa pectoral cuya luz transmite desesperación. Inspira grandes pasiones.
description_it: Piastra pettorale pesante la cui luce infonde sgomento e ispira passioni violente.
description_zh: A heavy chestplate whose light emits despair. The passion it inspires is particularly strong.

name: Storm Vesicle
description: Unique organ that stores large amounts of water. Even a sliver can power up your gear.
description_de: Organ, das große Wassermengen speichert. Schon ein Splitter verbessert deine Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Organe singulier renfermant de grandes quantités d'eau.
description_es: Órgano único que almacena gran cantidad de agua. Con un pedazo se llena tu equipo.
description_it: Sacca per l'accumulo d'acqua. Ne basta un frammento per potenziare l'equipaggiamento.
description_zh: Unique organ that stores large amounts of water. Even a sliver can power up your gear.

name: Storm Vesicle Clump
description: A particularly well-developed organ that stores enough water to wash away the world.
description_de: Besonders gut ausgeprägtes Sturm-Vesikel. Kann Sturmfluten hervorbringen.
description_fr: Organe à maturité pouvant contenir assez d'eau pour causer une inondation.
description_es: Órgano muy desarrollado que contiene suficiente agua como para inundar el mundo.
description_it: Sacca per l'accumulo d'acqua molto sviluppata. Ne contiene abbastanza da lavar via il mondo.
description_zh: A particularly well-developed organ that stores enough water to wash away the world.

name: Heavenly Dragongem
description: The root of the celestial gods' power. It grants their far-reaching vision.
description_de: Machtquelle der Himmels- götter. Verleiht ihre weitreichende Sicht.
description_fr: Source de la force des dieux célestes leur octroyant le pouvoir de clairvoyance.
description_es: La raíz del poder de los dioses celestiales. Otorga visión divina.
description_it: La fonte di potere degli dei celestiali, cui garantisce l'onniscienza.
description_zh: The root of the celestial gods' power. It grants their far-reaching vision.

name: Heavenly Dragonsphire
description: The root of the celestial gods' power. It grants their far-reaching vision.
description_de: Machtquelle der Himmels- götter. Verleiht dem Besitzer Allwissenheit.
description_fr: Source de la force des dieux célestes leur octroyant le pouvoir de prescience.
description_es: La raíz del poder de los dioses celestiales. Otorga visión divina.
description_it: La fonte di potere degli dei. Garantisce saggezza suprema e onniscienza terrena e divina.
description_zh: The root of the celestial gods' power. It grants their far-reaching vision.

name: Dragon Healing Crystal
description: A hard crystal made from dragon scales. Valued as medicine. (Account Item)
description_de: Aus kristallisierten Drachen- schuppen hergestelltes Heilmittel. (Kontoobjekt)
description_fr: Cristal solide formé à partir d'écailles de dragon et aux vertus curatives. (Objet bonus)
description_es: Cristal duro elaborado con escamas de dragón. Tiene uso medicinal. (Objeto cuenta)
description_it: Minerale taumaturgico nato dalla cristallizzazione di una scaglia di drago. (Oggetto punti)
description_zh: A hard crystal made from dragon scales. Valued as medicine. (Account Item)

name: Lao-Shan Shard
description: The thick scale of Lao-Shan. Its hardness is on par with any wyvern cortex.
description_de: Dicke Schuppe eines Riesendrachen. Gekrümmt wie bei einem Wyvern.
description_fr: L'écaille épaisse d'un dragon géant. Sa robustesse égale le cortex des wyvernes.
description_es: Gruesa escama de Lao-Shan. Su curvatura es como la de la placa de un wyvern normal.
description_it: Scaglia pesante del drago gigante. Distorta come quella dei wyvern.
description_zh: The thick scale of Lao-Shan. Its hardness is on par with any wyvern cortex.

name: Lao-Shan Cortex
description: An unbelievably heavy shell from Lao-Shan. The ages have made this shell immortal.
description_de: Schwerer Panzer eines Riesendrachen. Entstanden in der Ewigkeit.
description_fr: Lourde carapace d'un dragon géant. Le temps n'a pas d'effet sur elle.
description_es: Pesado caparazón de Lao-Shan. La eternidad hizo de él algo eterno.
description_it: Corazza pesante del drago gigante. Indistruttibile.
description_zh: An unbelievably heavy shell from Lao-Shan. The ages have made this shell immortal.

name: Lao-Shan Hardhorn
description: Horn from a Lao-Shan Lung snout. Perfectly formed even without forging -- a true luxury item.
description_de: Horn von der Schnauze eines Lao-Shan Lung. Auch ohne jede Bearbeitung ein Schmuckstück.
description_fr: Corne de museau de Lao-Shan Lung. Parfaitement proportionnée à l'état naturel. Un vrai trésor.
description_es: Cuerno del hocico de un Lao-Shan Lung. Posee una forma perfecta sin necesidad de forjarlo.
description_it: Pregiato corno duro del muso di Lao-Shan Lung. La sua naturale bellezza non ha paragoni.
description_zh: Horn from a Lao-Shan Lung snout. Perfectly formed even without forging -- a true luxury item.

name: Lao-Shan Megaclaw
description: A Lao-Shan Lung claw. So gigantic that even skilled artisans find themselves unable to work it.
description_de: Gewaltige Klaue eines Lao-Shan Lung. Überfordert selbst erfahrene Handwerker.
description_fr: Griffe de Lao-Shan Lung si volumineuse que les meilleurs artisans ont du mal à la travailler.
description_es: Garra de Lao-Shan Lung tan grande que ni los artesanos más capaces saben cómo utilizarla.
description_it: Artiglio gigante di Lao-Shan Lung. Così grande da mettere in difficoltà i più abili degli artigiani.
description_zh: A Lao-Shan Lung claw. So gigantic that even skilled artisans find themselves unable to work it.

name: Lao-Shan Mantle
description: A legendary scale of Lao-Shan. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.
description_de: Phantasmische Schuppe. Vereint angeblich die Erde und ergreift den Himmel.
description_fr: Une écaille légendaire. Celui qui la forge peut régner sur la terre et conquérir les cieux.
description_es: Escama fantasmal. Cuando se creó, unificó la tierra y atrapó el cielo.
description_it: Una scaglia eterea. Si dice che sia in grado di unire la terra e il cielo.
description_zh: A legendary scale of Lao-Shan. Those who craft it rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: Fatalis Shard
description: A thick, jet-black scale that covers the body of Fatalis. Grows thick with age.
description_de: Dicke, tiefschwarze Körperschuppe. Ihre Dicke zeigt das Alter an.
description_fr: Écaille noire et épaisse qui couvre le corps. Son épaisseur indique son âge.
description_es: Gruesa escama negra que cubre el cuerpo. Su grosor es prueba de su edad.
description_it: Una spessa scaglia nera che ricopre il corpo. Lo spessore indica anzianità.
description_zh: A thick, jet-black scale that covers the body of Fatalis. Grows thick with age.

name: Fatalis Cortex
description: Harder than a Fatalis shell, it's also known as Mediastinum.
description_de: Härter als ein Fatalis- Panzer. Wird auch Mediastinum genannt.
description_fr: Plus dur que la carapace de Fatalis. Aussi appelé Mediastinum.
description_es: Más dura que el caparazón de Fatalis, apodada "Mediastinum".
description_it: Questo materiale, più duro della corazza di Fatalis, è detto anche Mediastino.
description_zh: Harder than a Fatalis shell, it's also known as Mediastinum.

name: Fatalis Hardhorn
description: A horn of immense strength. The black glow of the horn gives off a strange attraction.
description_de: Ein immens starkes Horn - schwarz glänzend, seltsam faszinierend.
description_fr: Corne noire et rutilante dotée d'une immense force. Elle a un étrange pouvoir.
description_es: Cuerno negro y brillante de inmensa fuerza con un extraño poder.
description_it: Uno scintillante corno nero che cela un potere immenso e misterioso.
description_zh: A horn of immense strength. The black glow of the horn gives off a strange attraction.

name: Fatalis Evil Eye
description: An unusual aura surrounds the eye of Fatalis. Perhaps it's possessed...
description_de: Fatalis-Auge mit einer ganz ungewöhnlichen Aura. Es ist möglicherweise besessen.
description_fr: Œil de Fatalis doté d'une aura inhabituelle. Peut-être possédé...
description_es: Ojo de Fatalis con un halo inusual. Puede que esté poseído...
description_it: Occhio di Fatalis con un'aura insolita. Potrebbe essere posseduto.
description_zh: An unusual aura surrounds the eye of Fatalis. Perhaps it's possessed...

name: Fatalis Fellwing
description: A wing hard as any metal, yet still very malleable. Only the most skilled can work with it.
description_de: Hart wie Metall und doch formbar. Nur mit Geschick zu bearbeiten.
description_fr: Aile dure comme le métal mais malléable. Expertise requise pour la maîtriser.
description_es: Ala dura como el hierro pero maleable. Se necesita habilidad para trabajarla.
description_it: Un'ala dura come il ferro, ma malleabile. Serve molta perizia per lavorarla.
description_zh: A wing hard as any metal, yet still very malleable. Only the most skilled can work with it.

name: Crimson Fatalis Scale
description: The scale of a Fatalis overcome with rage. Crimson fire hides a deep darkness.
description_de: Fatalis-Schuppe, erfüllt von Rage. Blutrotes Feuer verbirgt tiefe Dunkelheit.
description_fr: Écaille d'un Fatalis empli de rage. Les flammes cachent un noir profond.
description_es: La escama de un Fatalis que bulle de ira. Fuego carmesí que oculta un lado oscuro.
description_it: Scaglia di un Fatalis furente. Le fiamme cremisi nascondono un cuore di tenebra.
description_zh: The scale of a Fatalis overcome with rage. Crimson fire hides a deep darkness.

name: Crimson Fatalis Shell
description: The shell of a Fatalis overcome with rage. It shines an unforgiving crimson.
description_de: Fatalis-Panzer, erfüllt von Rage. Leuchtet in gnadenlosem Blutrot.
description_fr: Carapace d'un Fatalis empli de rage. Son éclat vermillon inspire la cruauté.
description_es: La concha de un Fatalis que bulle de ira. Brilla con un color carmesí.
description_it: La corazza di un Fatalis furente. Brilla di un rosso inquietante.
description_zh: The shell of a Fatalis overcome with rage. It shines an unforgiving crimson.

name: Crimson Fatalis Horn
description: The horn of a Fatalis overcome with rage. It looks ready to tear down the sky.
description_de: Fatalis-Horn, erfüllt von Rage. Scheint bereit dafür, den Himmel einzureißen.
description_fr: Corne d'un Fatalis empli de rage. Elle semble prête à déchirer le ciel.
description_es: El cuerno de un Fatalis que bulle de ira. Parece listo para arrasar el cielo.
description_it: Il corno di un Fatalis furente. Sembra pronto a far crollare la volta celeste.
description_zh: The horn of a Fatalis overcome with rage. It looks ready to tear down the sky.

name: Crimson Fatalis Wing
description: The wing of a Fatalis overcome with rage. The air fears its crimson pulse.
description_de: Fatalis-Flügel, erfüllt von Rage. Die Luft fürchtet seinen blutroten Schlag.
description_fr: Aile d'un Fatalis empli de rage. Le vent même craint ses battements vermillon.
description_es: El ala de un Fatalis que bulle de ira. El aire teme su embate carmesí.
description_it: L'ala di un Fatalis furente. Persino l'aria teme i suoi battiti dalle scie cremisi.
description_zh: The wing of a Fatalis overcome with rage. The air fears its crimson pulse.

name: Fatalis Devileye+
description: The eye of a Fatalis overcome with rage. Its wicked gaze devours one's courage.
description_de: Fatalis-Auge, erfüllt von Rage. Sein böser Blick nimmt einem den Mut.
description_fr: Œil d'un Fatalis empli de rage. Son regard malsain épuise le courage de chacun.
description_es: El ojo de un Fatalis que bulle de ira. Su mirada maligna se come el valor.
description_it: L'occhio di un Fatalis furente. Il suo sguardo malevolo fiacca il coraggio di chiunque.
description_zh: The eye of a Fatalis overcome with rage. Its wicked gaze devours one's courage.

name: Old Fatalis Shard
description: A sparkling white scale of an ancient Fatalis. Its beauty can capture your heart.
description_de: Glitzernde, weiße Schuppe. Ihre Schönheit kann Herzen stehlen.
description_fr: Écaille d'un blanc éclatant. Sa beauté peut vous voler le cœur.
description_es: Escama blanca centelleante. Su belleza roba los corazones.
description_it: Scaglia di un bianco brillante. La sua bellezza ti ruba il cuore.
description_zh: A sparkling white scale of an ancient Fatalis. Its beauty can capture your heart.

name: Old Fatalis Cortex
description: A sparkling white shell of an ancient Fatalis. Heavier and stronger than most parts.
description_de: Glitzernder weißer Panzer. Schwerer und stärker als die meisten Fatalis-Teile.
description_fr: Carapace d'un blanc éclatant plus lourde et solide que les autres parties du Fatalis.
description_es: Caparazón blanco centellante. Más fuerte y pesado que otras partes de Fatalis.
description_it: Corazza di un bianco brillante. Più resistente di altre parti di Fatalis.
description_zh: A sparkling white shell of an ancient Fatalis. Heavier and stronger than most parts.

name: Old Fatalis Hardhorn
description: A sparkling white horn of an ancient Fatalis. Said to be lightning personified.
description_de: Glitzernd weißes Horn. Voller Elektrizität, ein schockierender Ansturm.
description_fr: Corne d'un blanc éclatant. Chargée d'électricité, une seule attaque suffit.
description_es: Cuerno blanco centellante. Cargado de electricidad que ataca creando shocks.
description_it: Corno di un bianco brillante. La sua carica elettrica è devastante.
description_zh: A sparkling white horn of an ancient Fatalis. Said to be lightning personified.

name: Old Fatalis Fellwing
description: A sparkling white wing of an ancient Fatalis. To gaze upon it is to know true oppression.
description_de: Glitzernd weißer Flügel. Zeigt seine verheerende Macht dem Betrachter.
description_fr: Aile d'un blanc éclatant. Exsude un pouvoir écrasant sur ceux qui la regardent.
description_es: Una blanca y reluciente ala. Exuda un poder enorme que aplasta al que lo mira.
description_it: Ala di un bianco brillante. Trasuda una potenza spaventosa.
description_zh: A sparkling white wing of an ancient Fatalis. To gaze upon it is to know true oppression.

name: Old Fatalis Souleye
description: A crimson eye, fierce and unforgiving, that gazes back with red, electric finality.
description_de: Blutrotes, wildes, gnadenlo- ses Auge. Blickt mit roter, elektrischer Endgültigkeit.
description_fr: Œil vermillon, vicieux, impitoyable et funeste, brillant de reflets de sang.
description_es: Ojo carmesí, fiero y despiadado que te observa con un único fin.
description_it: Un occhio rosso, feroce e spietato, il cui sguardo è carico di propositi malvagi.
description_zh: A crimson eye, fierce and unforgiving, that gazes back with red, electric finality.

name: Nakarkos Husk
description: The outer shell covering the Nakarkos. Used for crafting, but not much else is known.
description_de: Äußerer Panzer eines Nakarkos. Für die Herstellung von Gegen- ständen. Weitgehend unerforscht.
description_fr: Carapace extérieure recouvrant le Nakarkos. On en sait assez peu à son sujet.
description_es: Costra exterior que recubre al Nakarkos. No se sabe su función, pero es útil para crear objetos.
description_it: L'involucro del Nakarkos. Usato per creare oggetti, ma nient'altro è noto.
description_zh: The outer shell covering the Nakarkos. Used for crafting, but not much else is known.

name: Nakarkos Husk+
description: Bones that have become hardened somehow due to the fluid of a Nakarkos.
description_de: Knochen, die durch die Säfte eines Nakarkos gehärtet wurden.
description_fr: Os durcis sous l'effet du fluide d'un Nakarkos.
description_es: Un exoesqueleto endurecido de algún modo por los fluidos del Nakarkos.
description_it: Ossa in qualche modo temprate dai fluidi del Nakarkos.
description_zh: Bones that have become hardened somehow due to the fluid of a Nakarkos.

name: Heavy Nakarkos Husk
description: These bones have become impossibly hard after years of soaking in Nakarkos fluid.
description_de: Die Knochen waren so lange den Säften des Nakarkos ausgesetzt, dass sie nun härter als Stahl sind.
description_fr: Os durcis à l'extrême sous l'effet du fluide d'un Nakarkos.
description_es: Un exoesqueleto endurecido hasta un extremo inusitado por los fluidos del Nakarkos.
description_it: Guscio che è stato immerso per millenni in fluidi di Nakarkos e si è perciò indurito a dismisura.
description_zh: These bones have become impossibly hard after years of soaking in Nakarkos fluid.

name: Nakarkos Shell
description: The outer shell covering the Nakarkos. Its properties make for great armor.
description_de: Äußerer Panzer eines Nakarkos. Aufgrund seiner Eigenschaften gut für Rüstungen geeignet.
description_fr: Carapace extérieure recouvrant le Nakarkos. Ses propriétés font de très bonnes armures.
description_es: Caparazón externo que recubre al Nakarkos. Sus propiedades crean una armadura excelente.
description_it: La corazza esterna che ricopre il Nakarkos. Se ne ricavano ottime armature.
description_zh: The outer shell covering the Nakarkos. Its properties make for great armor.

name: Nakarkos Shell+
description: A spiny outer shell, it has undergone many changes over time, making it quite unique.
description_de: Stachelige äußere Panzerhülle. Im Laufe der Zeit mehrfach modifiziert und einzigartig.
description_fr: Carapace externe piquante dont la singularité s'explique par de multiples évolutions.
description_es: Caparazón externo espinoso; los cambios experimentados con el tiempo lo hacen único.
description_it: Corazza ricoperta di aculei, resa unica dalle numerose alterazioni subite nel tempo.
description_zh: A spiny outer shell, it has undergone many changes over time, making it quite unique.

name: Nakarkos Hardshell
description: The outer shell covering the Nakarkos. Its hardness makes truly top-class armor.
description_de: Äußerer Panzer eines Nakarkos. Ergibt aufgrund seiner Härte erstklassige Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Carapace extérieure recouvrant le Nakarkos. Sert à la confection d'armures d'exception.
description_es: Caparazón externo que protege al Nakarkos. Sirve para crear armaduras de gran calidad.
description_it: La corazza esterna che ricopre il Nakarkos. Se ne ricavano armature indistruttibili.
description_zh: The outer shell covering the Nakarkos. Its hardness makes truly top-class armor.

name: Nakarkos Skull
description: A horrifying skull that strikes fear into the hearts of all who see it.
description_de: Ein schrecklicher Schädel, dessen Anblick bei allen Furcht hervorruft.
description_fr: Crâne terrifiant qui glace le sang de tous ceux qui s'y exposent.
description_es: Espeluznante cráneo que infunde miedo en el corazón de todo el que lo ve.
description_it: Terrificante teschio che fa sprofondare nel terrore chiunque lo veda.
description_zh: A horrifying skull that strikes fear into the hearts of all who see it.

name: Nakarkos Hardskull
description: A hair-raisingly frightening skull. Said to induce fainting in those who gaze upon its horror.
description_de: Ein so grässlicher Anblick, dass nicht nur zarte Naturen in Ohnmacht fallen.
description_fr: Crâne effroyable dont la seule vue peut déclencher une perte de connaissance.
description_es: Cráneo que infunde verdadero terror a quien lo contempla. Incluso hay quien se desmaya.
description_it: Teschio che fa venire la pelle d'oca. Si dice che molti svengano al suo cospetto.
description_zh: A hair-raisingly frightening skull. Said to induce fainting in those who gaze upon its horror.

name: Nakarkos Vertebra
description: The sound of this bone terrifies all who hear it. Surprisingly easy to work with.
description_de: Der Klang dieses Knochen erschreckt jeden, der ihn hört. Erstaunlich gut zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Son bruit terrifie tous ceux qui l'entendent. Chose étonnante, elle se travaille facilement.
description_es: El sonido de este hueso aterra a todo el que lo oye. Extrañamente fácil de trabajar.
description_it: Il suono emesso da questo osso semina il terrore. È molto malleabile.
description_zh: The sound of this bone terrifies all who hear it. Surprisingly easy to work with.

name: Nakarkos Hardvertebra
description: The echoing sound of this bone brings madness to all who hear it. Valuable and easy to work with.
description_de: Der hohle Klang dieses Knochens erschreckt jeden, der ihn hört. Wertvoll und gut zu verarbeiten.
description_fr: Son tintement peut entraîner la folie. Demeure néanmoins un matériau utile et précieux.
description_es: Produce un eco que aboca a la locura a quien lo escucha. Es un material muy valioso.
description_it: L'eco prodotta da questo osso fa impazzire chiunque la oda. Di valore e facile da lavorare.
description_zh: The echoing sound of this bone brings madness to all who hear it. Valuable and easy to work with.

name: Nakarkos Hide
description: The beautiful blue hide of a Nakarkos. It is hard to tear despite its elasticity.
description_de: Die schöne, blaue Haut eines Nakarkos. Elastisch und reißfest.
description_fr: La belle peau bleue d'un Nakarkos. Difficile à déchirer malgré son élasticité.
description_es: Bella piel azul de Nakarkos. A pesar de su elasticidad, es difícil de rasgar.
description_it: Stupenda pelle blu di Nakarkos. È molto resistente, a dispetto dell'elasticità.
description_zh: The beautiful blue hide of a Nakarkos. It is hard to tear despite its elasticity.

name: Nakarkos Azurehide
description: The beautiful blue hide of a Nakarkos. Both incredibly strong and highly-prized.
description_de: Die blaue Haut eines Nakarkos. Extrem schön und reißfest.
description_fr: La belle peau bleue d'un Nakarkos. Aussi solide que convoitée.
description_es: Bella piel azul celeste de Nakarkos. Muy resistente, alcanza un alto precio en el mercado.
description_it: Stupenda pelle cerulea di Nakarkos. È molto resistente e apprezzata da tutti.
description_zh: The beautiful blue hide of a Nakarkos. Both incredibly strong and highly-prized.

name: Nakarkos Arm Brace
description: A keratinized brace from the oral arm of a Nakarkos. Hard and oozing a strong adhesive.
description_de: Eine Hornschiene vom Arm eines Nakarkos. Hart und mit starkem Klebemittel getränkt.
description_fr: Attelle kératinisée du bras d'un Nakarkos. En suinte une substance très collante.
description_es: Brazal queratinizado de brazo bucal de Nakarkos. Es duro y rezuma un potente adhesivo.
description_it: Protezione cheratinizzata del braccio orale di un Nakarkos. Rilascia un potente collante.
description_zh: A keratinized brace from the oral arm of a Nakarkos. Hard and oozing a strong adhesive.

name: Scary Nakarkos ArmBrce
description: A keratinized brace from the oral arm of a Nakarkos. Stickier and harder than ever.
description_de: Furcherregende Hornschiene vom Arm eines Nakarkos. Extrem hart und klebrig.
description_fr: Attelle kératinisée du bras d'un Nakarkos. Plus dure et collante que la normale.
description_es: Brazal queratinizado de brazo bucal de Nakarkos. Es muy pegajoso y resistente.
description_it: Protezione cheratinizzata del braccio orale di un Nakarkos. Più dura e appiccicosa che mai.
description_zh: A keratinized brace from the oral arm of a Nakarkos. Stickier and harder than ever.

name: Nakarkos Fang
description: One of countless fangs in the mouth of a Nakarkos. It can crunch through bone with ease.
description_de: Einer der vielen Reißzähne im Maul des Nakarkos. Kann Knochen mit Leichtigkeit zermalmen.
description_fr: L'un des innombrables crocs de la bouche d'un Nakarkos. Écrase des os avec aisance.
description_es: Uno de los incontables colmillos del Nakarkos. Machaca huesos con facilidad.
description_it: Una delle numerose zanne di Nakarkos. Può sbriciolare le ossa senza sforzo.
description_zh: One of countless fangs in the mouth of a Nakarkos. It can crunch through bone with ease.

name: Nakarkos Cuttlebone
description: A small white bone that is found inside the body of a Nakarkos.
description_de: Ein kleiner, weißer Knochen aus dem Inneren eines Nakarkos.
description_fr: Petit os blanc extrait du corps d'un Nakarkos.
description_es: Pequeño hueso blanco que se halla en el interior de los Nakarkos.
description_it: Piccolo osso bianco che si trova all'interno del Nakarkos.
description_zh: A small white bone that is found inside the body of a Nakarkos.

name: Lrg Nakarkos Cuttlebone
description: A huge white bone found inside the body of a Nakarkos. Though called a bone, it's more of a shell.
description_de: Ein großer, weißer Knochen aus dem Inneren eines Nakarkos. Eher Muschel als Knochen.
description_fr: Gros os blanc extrait du corps d'un Nakarkos. À vrai dire, il tient plus de la carapace.
description_es: Gran hueso blanco que se halla en el interior de los Nakarkos. En realidad es un caparazón.
description_it: Enorme osso bianco che si trova all'interno del Nakarkos. Pare che sia, in realtà, una conchiglia.
description_zh: A huge white bone found inside the body of a Nakarkos. Though called a bone, it's more of a shell.

name: Nakarkos Soul Orb
description: A jewel formed in a Nakarkos from the remains of the endless prey it has devoured.
description_de: Ein Juwel, das sich im Inneren eines Nakarkos aus den Resten seiner Beute bildete.
description_fr: Joyau formé naturellement dans un Nakarkos à partir des restes d'une lointaine proie.
description_es: Joya formada por el Nakarkos con los restos de las incontables presas devoradas.
description_it: Gemma che si forma nel Nakarkos dai resti delle sue numerose prede.
description_zh: A jewel formed in a Nakarkos from the remains of the endless prey it has devoured.

name: Nakarkos SecretSoulOrb
description: An extremely rare jewel formed inside a Narkakos from the remains of its prey.
description_de: Ein extrem seltenes Juwel, das sich im Nakarkos aus den Resten seiner Beute bildete.
description_fr: Joyau rare formé naturellement dans un Nakarkos à partir des restes d'une de ses proies.
description_es: Joya poco común formada por el Nakarkos con los restos de una de sus presas.
description_it: Una gemma estremamente rara che si forma dentro il Nakarkos dai residui delle sue prede.
description_zh: An extremely rare jewel formed inside a Narkakos from the remains of its prey.

name: Radiant Mucus
description: A viscous liquid produced by the Nakarkos. It gives off an ominous glow.
description_de: Zähflüssige Substanz, die vom Nakarkos erzeugt wird. Verströmt ein geheimnisvolles Leuchten.
description_fr: Liquide visqueux produit par les Nakarkos. Émet une lueur menaçante.
description_es: Líquido viscoso que segrega el Nakarkos. Emite un resplandor ominoso.
description_it: Liquido viscoso secreto dal Nakarkos. Emette un sinistro bagliore.
description_zh: A viscous liquid produced by the Nakarkos. It gives off an ominous glow.

name: Radiant Mucus+
description: Nakarkos mucus is said to help prevent the deterioration of bone materials.
description_de: Nakarkos-Schleim steht in dem Ruf, den Verfall von Knochen- material zu verhindern.
description_fr: Le mucus de Nakarkos peut enrayer la détérioration des matières osseuses.
description_es: Se dice que la mucosidad de Nakarkos evita el deterioro de los materiales óseos.
description_it: Muco di Nakarkos che sembra possa prevenire l'usura dei materiali ossei.
description_zh: Nakarkos mucus is said to help prevent the deterioration of bone materials.

name: Viscous Radiant Mucus
description: Good quality Narkakos mucus. Keeps bone in good condition and can harden it too.
description_de: Erstklassiger Nakarkos-Schleim, der Knochenmaterial stärken kann.
description_fr: Mucus de Nakarkos de bonne qualité. Préserve et renforce les os.
description_es: Mucosidad de Narkakos de gran calidad. Preserva los huesos e incluso los refuerza.
description_it: Muco viscoso di Nakarkos di grande qualità. Lubrifica le ossa e le mantiene sane e resistenti.
description_zh: Good quality Narkakos mucus. Keeps bone in good condition and can harden it too.

name: Valstrax Scale+
description: A high-quality Valstrax scale that can withstand movement at the speed of sound.
description_de: Wertvolle Valstrax-Schuppe, die selbst Schallgeschwindigkeit übersteht.
description_fr: Écaille de qualité capable de soutenir des déplacements à la vitesse du son.
description_es: Escama de gran calidad capaz de soportar desplazamientos a la velocidad del sonido.
description_it: Una scaglia di Valstrax di grande qualità che risponde agli attacchi alla velocità della luce.
description_zh: A high-quality Valstrax scale that can withstand movement at the speed of sound.

name: Valstrax Shard
description: A faintly glittering silver Valstrax scale. Precious dragon scales like these were once used in rituals.
description_de: Silberne Valstrax-Schuppe, die früher für Rituale eingesetzt wurde.
description_fr: Écaille de Valstrax aux reflets argentés utilisée dans les rituels d'antan.
description_es: Escama plateada de Valstrax, ligeramente brillante. Se utilizaba en antiguos rituales.
description_it: Scaglia di Valstrax d'argento brillante. Molto preziosa, in tempi antichi si usava nelle cerimonie.
description_zh: A faintly glittering silver Valstrax scale. Precious dragon scales like these were once used in rituals.

name: Valstrax Carapace
description: A sturdy Valstrax outer shell. Not even impacts at the speed of sound can mar it.
description_de: Harter Valstrax-Panzer. So stark, dass er jeden Überschall-Knall ohne Blessuren übersteht.
description_fr: Une carapace externe qui rend le Valstrax invulnérable, même aux attaques supersoniques.
description_es: Exoesqueleto que protege al Valstrax hasta de ataques supersónicos.
description_it: Corazza solida di Valstrax. Resistente anche ai colpi che infrangono il muro del suono.
description_zh: A sturdy Valstrax outer shell. Not even impacts at the speed of sound can mar it.

name: Valstrax Cortex
description: A particularly hard shell inside Valstrax's outer shell. Light and strong, it's of the finest quality.
description_de: Besonders schöner Valstrax- Panzer. Von exquisiter Stärke und Leichtigkeit.
description_fr: Partie très dure de la carapace externe du Valstrax, qui allie résistance et légèreté.
description_es: Hay que retirar la coraza exterior del Valstrax para acceder a ella. Es ligera a la par que resistente.
description_it: La più resistente tra le corazze di Valstrax. Forza e leggerezza ai massimi livelli.
description_zh: A particularly hard shell inside Valstrax's outer shell. Light and strong, it's of the finest quality.

name: Valstrax Claw+
description: This piece of Valstrax claw is remarkably hard and sharp. It's torn up countless peacetimes.
description_de: Besonders hartes Teil einer Valstrax-Klaue. Beendete das Leben vieler Unschuldiger.
description_fr: Cette griffe particulièrement dure et coupante a déjà commis bien des ravages...
description_es: Extremadamente dura y afilada, con ella se puede perpetrar una carnicería.
description_it: La parte più dura e affilata dell'unghia di Valstrax. Portatrice di innumerevoli disastri.
description_zh: This piece of Valstrax claw is remarkably hard and sharp. It's torn up countless peacetimes.

name: Valstrax Hardclaw
description: A fierce-looking Valstrax claw. Just the sight of this disaster- bringing claw chills the blood.
description_de: Furchterregende Valstrax-Klaue. Beim bloßen Anblick läuft es einem kalt den Rücken hinunter.
description_fr: La simple vue de cette griffe exceptionnellement résistante et destructrice donne des frissons.
description_es: Hiela la sangre con solo verla. Su poder destructivo es inconmensurable.
description_it: Artiglio di Valstrax che trasuda ferocia. Vengono i brividi anche solo a guardarlo.
description_zh: A fierce-looking Valstrax claw. Just the sight of this disaster- bringing claw chills the blood.

name: Valstrax Tail
description: A large Valstrax tail that shines like a comet. Effortlessly sweeps aside all tranquility.
description_de: Gewaltiger Valstrax-Schwanz. Bringt Tod und Zerstörung, aber funkelt unschuldig wie ein Komet.
description_fr: Longue, souple et dévastatrice, elle fend l'air telle une comète étincelante.
description_es: Larga y muy resistente, arrasa con todo a su paso como un cometa destructor.
description_it: Grossa coda di Valstrax. Splende come una cometa, ma porta sventure e distruzione.
description_zh: A large Valstrax tail that shines like a comet. Effortlessly sweeps aside all tranquility.

name: Valstrax Helixtail
description: A beautifully sharp section of Valstrax tail. Glows eerily like the tail of a comet.
description_de: Messerscharfes Teil eines Valstrax-Schwanzes. Funkelt wie ein Kometenschweif.
description_fr: Une partie de la queue joliment tranchante. Elle brille telle la queue d'une comète.
description_es: Parte afilada de gran belleza de la cola de un Valstrax. Brilla con la intensidad de un cometa.
description_it: La parte più affilata e letale della coda di Valstrax. Splende come la coda di una cometa.
description_zh: A beautifully sharp section of Valstrax tail. Glows eerily like the tail of a comet.

name: Valstrax Lancewing
description: A Valstrax wing, capable of infinite subtle variety. Requires special handling to work with.
description_de: Valstrax-Flügel. Wandelbar und vielseitig. Zum Bearbeiten ist eine spezielle Technik nötig.
description_fr: Aile aux fonctions multiples. La travailler nécessite des compétences spéciales.
description_es: Existe en mil sutiles variaciones distintas, y cada una puede tener sus usos si el artesano es hábil.
description_it: Mutevole ala di Valstrax. Per potersene servire, occorre una tecnica di lavorazione speciale.
description_zh: A Valstrax wing, capable of infinite subtle variety. Requires special handling to work with.

name: Valstrax Lancewing+
description: A rare piece of Valstrax wing, the pointed tip changes shape and is used to attack prey.
description_de: Seltenes Teil eines Valstrax. Zum Angriff auf Beute setzt er die äußerste Spitze ein.
description_fr: Partie rare de l'aile, sa forme changeante se distingue par une partie perforante.
description_es: Una parte muy singular del ala del Valstrax. La punta cambia de forma y sirve para atacar.
description_it: Parte rara dell'ala di Valstrax. La punta si trasforma durante un attacco.
description_zh: A rare piece of Valstrax wing, the pointed tip changes shape and is used to attack prey.

name: Valstrax Spineshell
description: A Valstrax shell used to protect its back. Its sharp, glittering points look like sharpened blades.
description_de: Rückenpanzerung des Valstrax. Sieht messerscharf geschliffen aus, wie eine Klinge.
description_fr: L'extrémité aiguisée de cette protection dorsale évoque une lame affûtée.
description_es: Protege la espalda del Valstrax. Las escamas puntiagudas y brillantes parecen espadas.
description_it: La crosta che protegge la schiena del Valstrax. Tagliente e affilata come la punta di una spada.
description_zh: A Valstrax shell used to protect its back. Its sharp, glittering points look like sharpened blades.

name: Valstrax Spineshell+
description: A very rare piece of spine- protecting Valstrax shell that gleams like a giant mirror.
description_de: Besonders große Panzerung, die das Rückgrat des Valstrax schützt. Glänzt wie ein riesiger Spiegel.
description_fr: Prélevée sur la carapace dorsale, elle est coupante tel un rasoir et brillante tel un miroir.
description_es: Sección central de la espalda del Valstrax. Su superficie está tan pulida como un espejo.
description_it: La parte più grande e rara della crosta che protegge la schiena del Valstrax.
description_zh: A very rare piece of spine- protecting Valstrax shell that gleams like a giant mirror.

name: Red Dragon Mindstone
description: The source of evil heavenly omens. The owner gains the power of the red comet.
description_de: Quelle himmlischer Zeichen. Wer ihn besitzt, kann angeblich mit roter Kometenkraft fliegen.
description_fr: La source de bien mauvais présages. Qui l'acquiert obtient la puissance de la comète rouge.
description_es: Fuente de funestos presagios. Quien la lleve consigo obtendrá el poder del cometa rojo.
description_it: L'origine dell'oscuro presagio che percorre i cieli. Chi la ottiene può volare come una cometa.
description_zh: The source of evil heavenly omens. The owner gains the power of the red comet.

name: Ruby Dragon Mindstone
description: The source of evil heavenly omens. The owner gains the power to bring disaster.
description_de: Quelle himmlischer Zeichen. Wer ihn besitzt, kann angeblich die Sterne auf die Erde einladen.
description_fr: La source de bien mauvais présages. Qui l'acquiert peut provoquer de grands désastres.
description_es: Fuente de funestos presagios. Quien la posea obtendrá el poder de causar cataclismos.
description_it: L'origine dell'oscuro presagio che percorre i cieli. Chi la ottiene può diventare messaggero di rovina.
description_zh: The source of evil heavenly omens. The owner gains the power to bring disaster.

name: Burned Husk
description: An object that dropped from a comet, of great interest to the Wycademy researchers.
description_de: Objekt, das von einem Kometen herabgefallen ist. Sehr interessant für die Wykademie.
description_fr: Tombé d'une comète fendant le ciel, cet objet est d'un grand intérêt pour la recherche.
description_es: Fragmento desprendido de un meteorito. Resulta de gran interés para la Wycademia.
description_it: Materiale caduto da una cometa. Per la Wyccademia è un oggetto di studio molto interessante.
description_zh: An object that dropped from a comet, of great interest to the Wycademy researchers.

name: Shimmering Dragonfluid
description: The red light this Valstrax fluid emits is always slightly warm.
description_de: Vom Valstrax gewonnene Flüssigkeit. Glänzt rubinrot und gibt Wärme ab.
description_fr: Un liquide sécrété par le Valstrax. Il émet une lumière rouge et une légère chaleur.
description_es: Líquido secretado por un Valstrax. Emite una luz roja y cálida.
description_it: Liquido di Valstrax. Sempre caldo e vermiglio, splende di una luce calma e soffusa.
description_zh: The red light this Valstrax fluid emits is always slightly warm.

name: Golden Silk
description: Golden thread left behind by an Ahtal-Ka. Its tensile strength and great beauty give it value.
description_de: Golden glänzender Faden einer Ahtal-Ka. Ebenso schön wie fest.
description_fr: Un fil d'or abandonné par une Ahtal-Ka. Robuste, élastique et aussi splendide que précieux.
description_es: Secretada por una Ahtal-Ka. Su resistencia y elasticidad hacen de ella un producto muy preciado.
description_it: Filo dorato splendente di Ahtal-Ka. Unisce in modo perfetto bellezza e potenza.
