description_zh: Golden thread left behind by an Ahtal-Ka. Its tensile strength and great beauty give it value.

name: Ahtal-Ka Gold Cocoon
description: A shimmering golden Ahtal-Ka shell. Its ancient surface is filled with mysterious beauty.
description_de: Golden schimmernde Panzerung einer Ahtal-Ka. Ihr Alter verleiht ihr eine mysteriöse Schönheit.
description_fr: Carapace dorée d'une Ahtal-Ka. Malgré son grand âge, elle chatoie d'une mystérieuse beauté.
description_es: Fragmento dorado del capullo de una Ahtal-Ka. Su superficie posee una belleza primitiva y misteriosa.
description_it: Carapace dorato di Ahtal-Ka. La parte esterna emana un bagliore misterioso.
description_zh: A shimmering golden Ahtal-Ka shell. Its ancient surface is filled with mysterious beauty.

name: Ahtal-Ka Purple Cocoon
description: A purple piece of Ahtal-Ka shell. Worth much more than the ordinary shells.
description_de: Violettes Teil einer Ahtal-Ka- Panzerung. Erzielt deutlich höhere Preise als die normalen.
description_fr: Carapace pourpre d'Ahtal-Ka. Sa valeur est bien supérieure aux carapaces ordinaires.
description_es: Fragmento morado del capullo de una Ahtal-Ka. Su superficie posee una belleza primitiva y misteriosa.
description_it: La parte di colore indaco del carapace di Ahtal-Ka. Molto raro e di valore inestimabile.
description_zh: A purple piece of Ahtal-Ka shell. Worth much more than the ordinary shells.

name: Ahtal-Ka Foreblade
description: A piece of sharp Ahtal-Ka foreleg. Note its fantastic cutting ability and attractive glitter.
description_de: Scharfe Kralle einer Ahtal-Ka. Fällt durch ihr Funkeln und ihre unübertroffene Schärfe auf.
description_fr: Patte avant d'une Ahtal-Ka, d'un tranchant remarquable et d'une beauté étincelante.
description_es: Afilado fragmento de la pata delantera de una Ahtal-Ka. Brilla con gran intensidad.
description_it: La parte tagliente che è possibile strappare dall'Ahtal-Ka. Affilata e splendente.
description_zh: A piece of sharp Ahtal-Ka foreleg. Note its fantastic cutting ability and attractive glitter.

name: Iridescent Carapace
description: A piece of Ahtal-Ka shell. Its color changes depending on the angle of the light.
description_de: Teil vom Rücken einer Ahtal-Ka. Schillert in allen Farben.
description_fr: Morceau de carapace d'Ahtal-Ka, dont la couleur change selon l'angle sous lequel on l'observe.
description_es: Parte del caparazón de una Ahtal-Ka. Cambia de color según incida en él la luz.
description_it: Parte della corazza di Ahtal-Ka. In base alla luce, è possibile ammirarne gli affascinanti colori.
description_zh: A piece of Ahtal-Ka shell. Its color changes depending on the angle of the light.

name: Ahtal-Ka Pheromone
description: A fragrant liquid secreted by an Ahtal-Ka. Its scent is so strong it can be detected for miles.
description_de: Von einer Ahtal-Ka abgesonderte Flüssigkeit. Ihr Geruch verbreitet sich meilenweit.
description_fr: Fluide sécrété par une Ahtal-Ka. L'odeur est si puissante qu'on peut la sentir à des kilomètres.
description_es: Un líquido de fragancia tan intensa que puede detectarse a kilómetros de distancia.
description_it: Liquido contenuto nel corpo dell'Ahtal-Ka. La forte fragranza copre grandi distanze.
description_zh: A fragrant liquid secreted by an Ahtal-Ka. Its scent is so strong it can be detected for miles.

name: Ahtal-Ka Fine Silk
description: A bright thread spun by an Ahtal-Ka. Contains beautiful crystalline patterns.
description_de: Von einer Ahtal-Ka erbeuteter prächtiger Stachel. Das Muster gibt ihm juwelenhafte Eleganz.
description_fr: Fil brillant tissé par une Ahtal-Ka. Ses motifs cristallins lui confèrent une fascinante beauté.
description_es: Hilo brillante con figuras cristalinas que le confieren una belleza insuperable.
description_it: Scheggia brillante di Ahtal-Ka. Il motivo all'interno è splendido come un diamante.
description_zh: A bright thread spun by an Ahtal-Ka. Contains beautiful crystalline patterns.

name: Ahtal-Ka Alluring Gem
description: A jewel that will bewitch a beholder forever. Created after an eternity deep in the ruins.
description_de: Mysteriöses Juwel, das jeden Betrachter verzaubert. Im Inneren des Ruinenschlosses entstanden.
description_fr: Bijou ensorcelant à jamais quiconque s'en empare, fabriqué au cœur de ruines éternelles.
description_es: Esta joya confunde los sentidos de quien la contempla. Cristalizó en el corazón de vetustas ruinas.
description_it: Gemma misteriosa che ammalia all'infinito chi la guarda. Formatasi nelle profondità di antiche rovine.
description_zh: A jewel that will bewitch a beholder forever. Created after an eternity deep in the ruins.

name: Royal Pyroxene
description: The pyroxene throne created such fear among the people that they could only kneel before it.
description_de: Juwel, in dem die ersten Götter wohnen. Sein Glänzen gebietet, sich vor ihm zu Boden zu werfen.
description_fr: Ce trône sacré inspire un effroi tel qu'on ne peut que s'agenouiller devant lui.
description_es: Este trono sagrado inspiraba tanto terror que nadie podía resistirse a postrarse ante él.
description_it: Gemma delle divinità primordiali. I comuni mortali si prostrano dinanzi al suo splendore.
description_zh: The pyroxene throne created such fear among the people that they could only kneel before it.

name: Map
description: A complete field map that shows terrain. (Supply Item)
description_de: Komplette Feldkarte, die das Terrain zeigt. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Une carte complète de la zone. (Fourniture)
description_es: Mapa completo del terreno. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Mappa che riproduce la conformazione del territorio. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A complete field map that shows terrain. (Supply Item)

name: First-aid Med
description: Restores a small amount of Health. (Supply Item)
description_de: Stellt einen kleinen Teil der Gesundheit wieder her. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Restaurent une petite quantité de vie. (Fourniture)
description_es: Restablece ligeramente la salud. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Ripristina una modesta quantità di vita. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Restores a small amount of Health. (Supply Item)

name: First-aid Med+
description: Restores a moderate amount of Health. (Supply Item)
description_de: Stellt einen mäßigen Teil der Gesundheit wieder her. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Restaurent une quantité modérée de vie. (Fourniture)
description_es: Restablece moderadamente la salud. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Ripristina una notevole quantità di vita. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Restores a moderate amount of Health. (Supply Item)

name: Ration
description: Restores a small amount of Stamina. (Supply Item)
description_de: Stellt einen kleinen Teil der Ausdauer wieder her. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Restaure une petite quantité de stamina. (Fourniture)
description_es: Restablece ligeramente la resistencia. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Aumenta moderatamente la barra resistenza. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Restores a small amount of Stamina. (Supply Item)

name: Portable Spit
description: A portable spit issued to new hunters. Get cookin'! (Supply Item)
description_de: Tragbar, wird an neue Jäger ausgegeben. Nun koch schon! (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Broche portable remise aux nouveaux chasseurs. Aux fourneaux ! (Fourniture)
description_es: Asador portátil para nuevos cazadores. ¡A cocinar! (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Spiedo portatile per i nuovi cacciatori. Ai fornelli! (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A portable spit issued to new hunters. Get cookin'! (Supply Item)

name: Mini Whetstone
description: A portable Whetstone for restoring Sharpness to weapons. (Supply Item)
description_de: Tragbarer Wetzstein zum Schärfen von Waffen. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Aiguisoir portable pour redonner du tranchant aux armes. (Fourniture)
description_es: Piedra de afilar que repone el afilado de las armas. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Cote portatile che ridona acutezza alle armi. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A portable Whetstone for restoring Sharpness to weapons. (Supply Item)

name: EZ Shock Trap
description: Immobilizes a target for easy capture. (Supply Item)
description_de: Setzt Ziele zum leichten Fangen außer Gefecht. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Immobilise une cible pour la capturer plus facilement. (Fourniture)
description_es: Inmoviliza el objetivo para capturarlo fácilmente. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Immobilizza un bersaglio per agevolarne la cattura. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Immobilizes a target for easy capture. (Supply Item)

name: EZ Flash Bomb
description: A grenade-like bomb that flashes brightly on impact. (Supply Item)
description_de: Granatenähnliche Bombe. Strahlt hell beim Aufprall. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Bombe à lancer qui émet un flash à l'impact. (Fourniture)
description_es: Bomba de mano que desprende un gran brillo al impactar. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Granata che sprigiona un vivo bagliore all'impatto. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A grenade-like bomb that flashes brightly on impact. (Supply Item)

name: EZ Sonic Bomb
description: A grenade-like bomb that emits a loud, high-frequency sound. (Supply Item)
description_de: Eine Art Granate. Erzeugt laute Hochfrequenztöne. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Bombe à lancer qui émet une déflagration haute fréquence. (Fourniture)
description_es: Bomba de mano que emite un sonido de alta frecuencia. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Granata che emette un suono acuto e fragoroso. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A grenade-like bomb that emits a loud, high-frequency sound. (Supply Item)

name: EZ Max Potion
description: Fully restores Health and maximizes your Health Gauge. (Supply Item)
description_de: Stellt volle Gesundheit her. Maximiert Gesundheitsanzeige. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Restaure toute la vie et maximise la jauge de vie. (Fourniture)
description_es: Aumenta el indicador de salud al máximo y la recupera toda. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Cura completamente e porta al massimo la barra vita. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Fully restores Health and maximizes your Health Gauge. (Supply Item)

name: EZ Lifepowder
description: Heals those within range with a single touch. (Supply Item)
description_de: Heilt alle in Reichweite durch bloße Berührung. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Guérit tous ceux à proximité par simple contact. (Fourniture)
description_es: Cura a aquellos a su alcance con un solo toque. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Cura al primo tocco chi si trova nel suo raggio d'azione. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Heals those within range with a single touch. (Supply Item)

name: EZ Dust of Life
description: Disperses on use and heals serious injuries instantly. (Supply Item)
description_de: Zieht bei Verwendung ein und heilt schlimme Wunden sofort. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Se répand et guérit aussitôt les blessures graves. (Fourniture)
description_es: Se dispersa al usarlo y cura heridas graves. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Si disperde durante l'uso e cura all'istante le ferite gravi. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Disperses on use and heals serious injuries instantly. (Supply Item)

name: EZ Pitfall Trap
description: Activates a pitfall to catch monsters with. (Supply Item)
description_de: Aktiviert eine Fallgrube zum Fangen von Monstern. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Active une fosse pour attraper les monstres. (Fourniture)
description_es: Activa una trampa para atrapar monstruos. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Attiva una trappola coperta che imprigiona i mostri. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Activates a pitfall to catch monsters with. (Supply Item)

name: EZ Barrel Bomb L
description: A powered-up Barrel Bomb L. Just as potent as a Barrel Bomb L+. (Supply Item)
description_de: Verstärkte Große Fassbombe (stark wie Große Fassbombe+). (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Version améliorée de la grande bombe baril. Très puissante. (Fourniture)
description_es: Bomba barril grande mejorada (como la bomba barril grande+). (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Potente come una bomba-botte gr+. Per grandi mostri. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A powered-up Barrel Bomb L. Just as potent as a Barrel Bomb L+. (Supply Item)

name: EZ Hunter's Drink
description: Temporarily makes it easier to refill the Hunter Arts Gauge. (Supply Item)
description_de: Erleichtert zeitweilig das Füllen des Technikbalkens. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Facilite temporairement le remplissage de la jauge d'arts. (Fourniture)
description_es: Ayuda temporalmente a llenar el indicador de técnica de caza. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Accelera la ricarica della barra delle arti di caccia. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Temporarily makes it easier to refill the Hunter Arts Gauge. (Supply Item)

name: Ballista Ammo
description: Ammunition for the large Ballista. (Supply Item)
description_de: Munition für die große Balliste. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Munition pour la grande baliste. (Fourniture)
description_es: Munición para balista grande. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Proiettile per la balista grande. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Ammunition for the large Ballista. (Supply Item)

name: One-shot Binder
description: Ballista ammo that restrains targets. Disposable ammo, no cooldown. (Supply Item)
description_de: Ballistenmunition. Fesselt Ziele. Einwegmunition, keine Abklingzeit. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Immobilise les cibles. Non réutilisable. (Fourniture)
description_es: Se usa para sujetar al objetivo. Desechable; un solo uso. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Proiettile bloccante per balista. Monouso, senza recupero. (Ogg. scorte)
description_zh: Ballista ammo that restrains targets. Disposable ammo, no cooldown. (Supply Item)

name: Anti-dragon Bomb
description: A small time bomb that can be stuck directly on targets you mount. (Supply Item)
description_de: Kleine Zeitbombe. Kann an bestiegenen Zielen befestigt werden. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Petite bombe à retardement à coller directement sur les cibles. (Fourniture)
description_es: Pequeña bomba de relojería que se engancha al objetivo. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Bomba a tempo da attaccare sui bersagli cavalcati. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: A small time bomb that can be stuck directly on targets you mount. (Supply Item)

name: Dense Marcoal
description: Special fuel used with the Demolisher. Requires a cooldown between uses. (Supply Item)
description_de: Einmaliger Brennstoff für den Demolierer. Abkühlen nötig. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Carburant spécial pour démolisseur. Délai d'attente après chaque tir. (Fourniture)
description_es: Combustible para el aniquilador. Deberás esperar un poco entre un uso y otro. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Carburante speciale utilizzato dal demolitore. Necessita di un tempo di recupero. (Ogg. scorte)
description_zh: Special fuel used with the Demolisher. Requires a cooldown between uses. (Supply Item)

name: Paw Pass Ticket
description: Deliver to end the Quest. Maybe the Felynes will take you home... (Supply Item)
description_de: Abliefern, um die Quest zu beenden. Vielleicht bringen dich die Felynen nach Hause... (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: À livrer pour finir la quête. Les Felynes vous ramèneront-ils au village ? (Fourniture)
description_es: Entrégalo para acabar la misión. Tal vez los Felyne te lleven a casa. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Consegnalo a fine missione e i Felyne potrebbero portarti a casa... (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Deliver to end the Quest. Maybe the Felynes will take you home... (Supply Item)

name: EZ Farcaster
description: Instantly transports you back to base camp. (Supply Item)
description_de: Bringt dich sofort zurück ins Basislager. (Vorratsobjekt)
description_fr: Vous ramène instantanément au camp de base. (Fourniture)
description_es: Te transporta al instante al campamento base. (Objeto de apoyo)
description_it: Ti riporta istantaneamente al campo base. (Oggetto scorte)
description_zh: Instantly transports you back to base camp. (Supply Item)

name: Rusted Fragment
description: An oddly shaped metal fragment covered in rust. It looks like it could be used for something...
description_de: Ein einzigartig geformtes, rostiges Metallfragment. Könnte nützlich sein.
description_fr: Fragment de métal à la forme unique couvert de rouille. Il peut servir.
description_es: Fragmento metálico de forma única oxidado. Parece que se puede usar para algo...
description_it: Frammento metallico arrugginito dalla strana forma; potrebbe tornare utile per qualcosa...
description_zh: An oddly shaped metal fragment covered in rust. It looks like it could be used for something...

name: Ancient Fragment
description: A metal fragment taken from deep in the earth. Still strong, and maybe useful...
description_de: Metallfragment aus den Tiefen der Erde. Noch stark, könnte mal nützlich sein.
description_fr: Fragment de métal issu des profondeurs de la terre. Puissant et utile.
description_es: Trozo de metal de las entrañas de la tierra. De gran dureza. Puede resultar útil...
description_it: Metallo duro estratto dalle profondità della terra. Forse è ancora utile...
description_zh: A metal fragment taken from deep in the earth. Still strong, and maybe useful...

name: Mythical Fragment
description: An unidentifiably old piece of metal that gives off a mystical light. Might be usable somehow.
description_de: Metallfragment aus vergessenen Zeiten, das mysteriös leuchtet. Könnte nützlich sein.
description_fr: Ancien morceau de métal à l'origine mystérieuse et à l'éclat mystique. À quoi peut-il servir ?
description_es: Trozo de metal de origen desconocido y rodeado de un halo divino. Algún uso tendrá.
description_it: Scheggia di metallo di un'epoca sconosciuta. Rilascia un bagliore sacro...
description_zh: An unidentifiably old piece of metal that gives off a mystical light. Might be usable somehow.

name: Sinister Cloth
description: Found long ago in the tomb of a king from a long forgotten desert land.
description_de: Wurde im Grab eines Königs aus einem vergessenen Wüstenland gefunden.
description_fr: Trouvée il y a longtemps dans la tombe du roi d'un désert oublié.
description_es: Se encontró hace tiempo en la tumba de un rey de un desierto olvidado.
description_it: Trovata molto tempo fa nella tomba di un re di una terra desertica.
description_zh: Found long ago in the tomb of a king from a long forgotten desert land.

name: Sinister Darkcloth
description: A burial cloth said to have been used on the ancient king in the desert. Believed to be cursed.
description_de: Angeblich das Grabtuch eines alten Königs aus der Wüste. Man glaubt, es sei verflucht.
description_fr: Suaire sur lequel on aurait couché le défunt roi du désert. On dit aussi qu'il est maudit.
description_es: Mortaja de un rey de la antigüedad en el desierto. Se cree que está maldita.
description_it: Sudario forse appartenuto a un antico re del deserto e considerato maledetto.
description_zh: A burial cloth said to have been used on the ancient king in the desert. Believed to be cursed.

name: Sinister Gloomcloth
description: A cloth worn by a messenger of a far away, long ago underworld. Can supposedly absorb life.
description_de: Soll einem Jenseitsboten aus der Wüste gehört haben. Angeblich absorbiert es Lebenskraft.
description_fr: Étoffe portée par un messager d'un monde enfoui, immémorial et éloigné. Pourrait absorber la vie.
description_es: La portaba hace mucho tiempo un mensajero de un inframundo lejano. Se dice que absorbe vida.
description_it: Usato tanto tempo fa, nelle profondità desertiche degli inferi. Può succhiare via la vita.
description_zh: A cloth worn by a messenger of a far away, long ago underworld. Can supposedly absorb life.

name: Extravagant Artifact
description: Either the burial item of an ancient dynasty, or a cache of pirate treasure. How exciting!
description_de: Entweder die Grabbeigaben einer alten Dynastie oder ein Piraten- schatz. Hochinteressant!
description_fr: Offrande faite à une dynastie antique ou trésor de pirates mis au jour, on ne sait pas trop !
description_es: Objetos funerarios de una antigua dinastía o un tesoro pirata. ¡Qué emocionante!
description_it: Sembrano i doni funerari di un'antica dinastia o un tesoro pirata. Affascinante!
description_zh: Either the burial item of an ancient dynasty, or a cache of pirate treasure. How exciting!

name: Opulent Artifact
description: Some people spend their entire lives looking for this kind of haul.
description_de: Manche Menschen widmen ihr gesamtes Leben der Bergung einer solchen Ladung.
description_fr: Certains consacrent leur vie à la recherche d'un objet comme celui-ci.
description_es: Hay quien dedica toda su vida a buscar botines de este tipo.
description_it: Alcuni individui dedicano la propria vita alla ricerca di tesori come questo.
description_zh: Some people spend their entire lives looking for this kind of haul.

name: Decadent Artifact
description: To gaze upon this dazzling ornament is to gaze upon a star, and have your heart stolen away.
description_de: Legendärer Schatz. Ihn anzusehen ist wie in das Antlitz der Sterne zu schauen.
description_fr: Contempler cet ornement revient à plonger ses yeux dans un astre, et à y laisser son cœur.
description_es: Un ornamento tan complejo como innecesario. Cautiva a quien lo observa con su absurda belleza.
description_it: Oggetti meravigliosi simili a stelle. Le splendide decorazioni ammaliano chiunque le guardi.
description_zh: To gaze upon this dazzling ornament is to gaze upon a star, and have your heart stolen away.

name: Broken Statue
description: An ancient-looking statue. Bears no hints as to when and why it was made, or by whom.
description_de: Alt wirkende Statue. Es ist nicht ersichtlich, wer sie wann und zu welchem Zweck schuf.
description_fr: Statue d'aspect antique. Nul ne sait ni quand, ni pourquoi, ni par qui elle a été faite.
description_es: Estatua de aspecto antiguo. No hay nada que indique cuándo o por qué se creó, o su autor.
description_it: Statua antica. Non presenta segni che aiutino a stabilire provenienza, autore o epoca.
description_zh: An ancient-looking statue. Bears no hints as to when and why it was made, or by whom.

name: Large Broken Statue
description: A massive statue left from an epic time. Has been exposed to the elements for eons.
description_de: Eine riesige Statue aus längst vergangenen Zeiten. War über Äonen den Elementen ausgesetzt.
description_fr: Énorme statue venue du fond des âges, exposée aux outrages du temps et aux intempéries.
description_es: Enorme estatua, resto de una era épica. Ha estado expuesta a los elementos durante eones.
description_it: Statua risalente a un'epoca mitica. È rimasta esposta agli elementi per eoni.
description_zh: A massive statue left from an epic time. Has been exposed to the elements for eons.

name: Broken Cat God Statue
description: A solemn stone cat statue, redolent of history's riddles. A god messenger, or religious icon?
description_de: Rätselhafte Katzenstatue. Stellt sie einen Götterboten oder gar einen Gott dar?
description_fr: Statue solennelle en pierre, chargée d'histoire et de mystère. Ambassadeur céleste ou icône ?
description_es: Solemne y misteriosa estatua de piedra de un gato. ¿Un mensajero divino o una deidad en sí mismo?
description_it: Statua risalente a un'epoca mitica. Il gatto rappresenta le divinità oppure la fede?
description_zh: A solemn stone cat statue, redolent of history's riddles. A god messenger, or religious icon?

name: Dark Piece
description: A mysterious, ominous piece of Dark Stone. Crafting it is a scary proposition.
description_de: Geheimnisvolles Stück eines dunklen Steins. Die Bearbeitung macht Angst.
description_fr: Sinistre morceau de pierre sombre. Faut-il vraiment la travailler ?
description_es: Misterioso y ominoso trozo de piedra oscura. Trabajarlo es una tarea terrorífica.
description_it: Misterioso, sinistro pezzo di pietra oscura. Terribile da lavorare.
description_zh: A mysterious, ominous piece of Dark Stone. Crafting it is a scary proposition.

name: Dark Stone
description: A jet-black stone with an ominous aura. Holding it wraps one in despair.
description_de: Rabenschwarzer Stein mit ominöser Aura. Wer ihn hält, wird in Verzweiflung gehüllt.
description_fr: Pierre d'un noir profond à l'aura sinistre. Provoque le désespoir.
description_es: Piedra negra azabache con un halo de mala fortuna. Sume en la desesperación a quien la tome.
description_it: Pietra nera con un'aura sinistra. Chi la possiede cade nella disperazione.
description_zh: A jet-black stone with an ominous aura. Holding it wraps one in despair.

name: Felyne Kettle
description: A kettle the Felyne have poured their sheer joy into. Don't forget to remove it from the heat!
description_de: Ein Kessel, in dem die Felyne ihre Freude sammelten. Vergiss nicht, ihn vom Feuer zu nehmen.
description_fr: Les Felynes y ont versé le secret de leur félicité. Ne pas exposer à la chaleur !
description_es: Hervidor donde los Felyne han vertido su regocijo. No olvides apartarlo del fuego.
description_it: Bollitore in cui è infusa la gioia dei Felyne. Ricorda di toglierlo dal fuoco!
description_zh: A kettle the Felyne have poured their sheer joy into. Don't forget to remove it from the heat!

name: Yukumo Riceflour
description: An ingredient for making sweets. However, it can become quite hard if prepared incorrectly.
description_de: Eine Zutat für die Zubereitung von Süßigkeiten. Wird bei falscher Anwendung hart.
description_fr: Ingrédient pour créer des bonbons. Devient très dur en cas de mauvaise préparation.
description_es: Ingrediente para hacer dulces. Puede quedar muy dura si no se prepara correctamente.
description_it: Ingrediente per preparare dolci. Usando dosi sbagliate può diventare molto dura.
description_zh: An ingredient for making sweets. However, it can become quite hard if prepared incorrectly.

name: Doll Parts
description: It is usually given as a gift to small children. However, if you give it to an artisan...
description_de: Dient für gewöhnlich als Geschenk für Kinder. Aber wenn du es einem Handwerker gibst...
description_fr: Plutôt un cadeau destiné à de jeunes enfants. Mais confiez-le à un artisan...
description_es: Suele regalársele a niños pequeños. Ahora bien, si se lo dieras a un artesano...
description_it: In genere è un regalo per bambini. Tuttavia, se lo consegni a un artigiano...
description_zh: It is usually given as a gift to small children. However, if you give it to an artisan...

name: Weapon Codex
description: A secret text that describes the crafting process for a weapon from a far-off land.
description_de: Ein Geheimtext, der die Herstellung einer Waffe aus einem fernen Land beschreibt.
description_fr: Texte secret décrivant le processus de fabrication d'une arme venue de terres lointaines.
description_es: Texto secreto que describe el proceso de creación de un arma de una tierra lejana.
description_it: Un testo segreto che descrive il processo di creazione di un'arma esotica.
description_zh: A secret text that describes the crafting process for a weapon from a far-off land.

name: Bowgun Codex
description: A secret text that describes the crafting process for a Bowgun from a far-off land.
description_de: Geheimtext, der die Herstellung dieser Waffe aus einem fernen Land beschreibt.
description_fr: Texte secret décrivant le processus de fabrication de la lointaine fusarbalète.
description_es: Texto secreto que describe el proceso de creación de una ballesta de una tierra lejana.
description_it: Un testo segreto che descrive il processo di creazione di una balestra esotica.
description_zh: A secret text that describes the crafting process for a Bowgun from a far-off land.

name: Deluxe Barrel Timber
description: Unique wood that won't break even when bent, so the barrels it makes can be used as armor.
description_de: Erstklassiges Holz, das auch beim Biegen nicht bricht. Fässer daraus geben gute Rüstungen ab.
description_fr: Bois utilisé dans la fabrication de tonneaux, si solide que ces derniers font de bonnes armures.
description_es: Madera que no se astilla al doblarla. Los barriles hechos con ella sirven hasta de armadura.
description_it: Legno unico nel suo genere, si piega, ma non si spezza. Ideale anche come protezione.
description_zh: Unique wood that won't break even when bent, so the barrels it makes can be used as armor.

name: Ancient Talisman
description: A talisman enshrining the holiness of an eastern god. The Smithy might give you new insight...
description_de: Seil, mit dem Götter des Ostens angebetet wurden. Könnte neue Ausrüstungsideen bringen.
description_fr: Talisman imprégné de l'aura d'un dieu oriental... Un artisan en saura peut-être davantage.
description_es: Objeto de culto a una deidad oriental. Quizá el herrero te pueda contar más...
description_it: Oggetto sacro dedicato agli dei orientali. Può essere utile per un nuovo tipo di forgiatura...
description_zh: A talisman enshrining the holiness of an eastern god. The Smithy might give you new insight...

name: Damaged Amber
description: This strange amber is the subject of ongoing research. It could be used in crafting.
description_de: Rätselhafter Stein, der in einem gewissen Labor untersucht wird. Könnte beim Waffenbau helfen.
description_fr: Ambre étrange faisant l'objet de fiévreuses recherches. Il pourrait constituer un matériau d'artisanat.
description_es: Este extraño ámbar es el objeto de numerosas investigaciones. Sirve para forjar armas.
description_it: In un certo laboratorio si continua a studiare questo materiale misterioso per le armi.
description_zh: This strange amber is the subject of ongoing research. It could be used in crafting.

name: Cloudy Fragment
description: This scale mingles white and black, and gives off an ominous aura. Can be used in crafting.
description_de: Schwarz-weiße Schuppe, die eine düstere Aura ausstrahlt. Taugt als Material für Waffen.
description_fr: Écaille noire et blanche dont émane une aura menaçante. Matériau d'artisanat.
description_es: Esta escama, muy útil en la forja, mezcla vetas blancas y negras. Está rodeada de un halo ominoso.

name: Tomato Juice
description: Delicious and filled with nutrients, this tomato juice is good to drink for those who've lost a lot of blood.
description_de: Köstlich und voller Nährstoffe. Ideal für diejenigen, die eine Menge Blut verloren haben.
description_fr: Délicieux et très nourrissant, ce jus de tomate est parfait quand on a perdu beaucoup de sang.
description_es: Delicioso y cargado de nutrientes, este zumo de tomate es ideal para los que han perdido mucha sangre.
description_it: Salsa al pomodoro gustosa e nutriente, consigliata a chi ha perso molto sangue.
description_zh: Delicious and filled with nutrients, this tomato juice is good to drink for those who've lost a lot of blood.

name: Fairy Tail Mark
description: A Mage Guild mark from lands far away. Proof of friendships that stand the test of time.
description_de: Das Wappen der Magiergilde eines fernen Landes. Ein Symbol ewiger Freundschaft.
description_fr: Symbole d'une guilde magique. Preuve d'une amitié qui résiste à l'épreuve du temps.
description_es: La marca de un gremio de magos de tierras lejanas. Prueba de una amistad duradera.
description_it: Emblema di una gilda di maghi provenienti da terre lontane. Rappresenta l'amicizia eterna.
description_zh: A Mage Guild mark from lands far away. Proof of friendships that stand the test of time.

name: F Pirate Coin J
description: Proof that you've completed a JUMP Quest. It depicts the image of a legendary Felyne pirate.
description_de: Beweis, dass du eine JUMP- Quest gemeistert hast. Zeigt einen legendären Felyne-Piraten.
description_fr: La preuve que vous avez réussi une quête JUMP. Représente un capitaine Felyne de légende.
description_es: Prueba de que has completado una misión JUMP. Presenta la imagen de un pirata Felyne legendario.
description_it: Attesta che hai superato una missione JUMP. Ritrae un grande pirata Felyne.
description_zh: Proof that you've completed a JUMP Quest. It depicts the image of a legendary Felyne pirate.

name: Cardboard
description: Simple cardboard material, yet it has the odd effect of sparking the imagination.
description_de: Dieses einfache Material hat die Kraft, die Kreativität in den Menschen zu wecken.
description_fr: Un matériau léger et rigide, qui peut être utilisé pour fabriquer de nombreuses choses.
description_es: No es más que un cartón, pero tiene el don de hacer volar la imaginación.
description_it: Del semplice cartone che con un po' di immaginazione può dare vita a qualcosa.
description_zh: Simple cardboard material, yet it has the odd effect of sparking the imagination.

name: Uniqlo Coin
description: A Uniqlo coin designed with both form and function in mind.
description_de: Eine Uniqlo-Münze, bei deren Gestaltung sowohl Form als auch Funktion bedacht wurden.
description_fr: Une pièce Uniqlo à la fois jolie et fonctionnelle.
description_es: Moneda de Uniqlo diseñada para tener buen aspecto sin perder la funcionalidad.
description_it: Moneta speciale di Uniqlo che tiene in mente forma e funzione.
description_zh: A Uniqlo coin designed with both form and function in mind.

name: Soulstone
description: A mysterious rock said to house the soul of a monster. This one contains Fire.
description_de: Mysteriöser Stein, in dem die Seele eines Monsters gefangen ist. Enthält die Kraft des Feuers.
description_fr: Une pierre mystérieuse qui abriterait l'âme d'un monstre. Renferme le pouvoir du Feu.
description_es: DUMMY
description_it: DUMMY
description_zh: A mysterious rock said to house the soul of a monster. This one contains Fire.

name: Crows Coin
description: A coin that proves one to be the worst of the worst. The back side has the names of noted thugs.
description_de: Diese Münze beweist, dass man zu den Schlimmsten gehört; auf der Rückseite sind Schläger-Namen.
description_fr: Pièce prouvant qu'on fait partie des pires gredins. Des noms de voyous sont inscrits au verso.
description_es: Moneda que demuestra que uno es lo peor de lo peor. El anverso incluye los nombres de matones famosos.
description_it: Riservata ai peggiori criminali. Sul retro riporta i nomi di famosi teppisti.
description_zh: A coin that proves one to be the worst of the worst. The back side has the names of noted thugs.

name: Bicycle Club Application
description: Proof that one has joined the Bicycle Club. Keep pedaling until you win Nationals!
description_de: Beweis für die Mitgliedschaft im Fahrradclub. Radle weiter, bis du die Meisterschaft gewinnst!
description_fr: Preuve que vous avez rejoint le club de vélo. Continuez de pédaler pour participer au championnat !
description_es: Prueba de pertenencia al club de las bicicletas. ¡Pedalea hasta ganar los Nacionales!
description_it: Attesta l'appartenenza al club della bici. Vinci i campionati nazionali!
description_zh: Proof that one has joined the Bicycle Club. Keep pedaling until you win Nationals!

name: Arena Ticket
description: A ticket for admission to an underground arena where warriors fight to see who's the strongest.
description_de: Ein Schein für den Zugang zu einer unterirdischen Arena, in der die stärksten Krieger kämpfen.
description_fr: Ticket d'entrée dans une arène clandestine où les guerriers se battent pour voir qui est le plus fort.
description_es: Entrada a una arena clandestina en la que los guerreros combaten por ver quién es el más fuerte.
description_it: Consente di accedere a un'arena in cui dimostrare il proprio valore.
description_zh: A ticket for admission to an underground arena where warriors fight to see who's the strongest.

name: Grandpaw Coin
description: A coin from Grandpaw Danger, it can be traded for Palico gear that protects its wearer from danger.
description_de: Kann gegen Kameradenaus- rüstung getauscht werden, die den Träger vor Gefahr schützt.
description_fr: Cette pièce de papy peut être échangée contre de l'équipement de Palico protégeant le porteur.
description_es: Moneda de peligro gatabuelo que puede cambiarse por un equipo de camarada que protege del peligro.
description_it: Moneta di Zampone spericolato con cui ottenere armature per compagni.
description_zh: A coin from Grandpaw Danger, it can be traded for Palico gear that protects its wearer from danger.

name: CoroCoro Ticket
description: A ticket adorned with the CoroCoro dragon, who brings dreams to boys and girls.
description_de: Mit dem CoroCoro-Drachen verziert, der Jungen und Mädchen Träume bringt.
description_fr: Orné du dragon CoroCoro, qui fait rêver les garçons et les filles.
description_es: Ticket adornado con el dragón CoroCoro, que hace realidad los sueños.
description_it: Biglietto decorato con le effigi del drago CoroCoro, che dona sogni ai bambini.
description_zh: A ticket adorned with the CoroCoro dragon, who brings dreams to boys and girls.

name: Ushio Coin
description: An ancient-looking coin containing a deep-seated grudge. It is used for creating demon-slaying gear.
description_de: Eine antik aussehende Münze, die einen Fluch enthält. Damit wird Dämonenjagdausrüstung gefertigt.
description_fr: Pièce ancienne renfermant une immense rancune. Sert à créer de l'équipement tueur de démon.
description_es: Moneda de aspecto antiguo con rencor arraigado. Sirve para crear equipos para matar demonios.
description_it: Moneta in cui alberga un profondo rancore. Usata per creare armi contro i demoni.
description_zh: An ancient-looking coin containing a deep-seated grudge. It is used for creating demon-slaying gear.

name: Magi Coin
description: A coin given to those Magi recognize as worthy. It is used to create weapons imbued with magical power.
description_de: Für Magi, die als würdig angesehen werden. Damit fertigt man Waffen mit magischer Kraft.
description_fr: Pièce donnée à ceux que les mages jugent dignes. Sert à créer des armes magiques.
description_es: Moneda que se entrega a los Magi que la merecen. Sirve para crear armas con poder mágico.
description_it: Moneta donata ai migliori Magi. Consente di creare armi magiche.
description_zh: A coin given to those Magi recognize as worthy. It is used to create weapons imbued with magical power.

name: Pluto Stardust
description: A shooting star fragment used to create Shonen Magazine's special gear.
description_de: Meteoritenfragment zum Her- stellen der Spezialausrüs- tung des Shonen-Magazins.
description_fr: Fragment d'étoile filante servant à créer l'équipement spécial du magazine Shonen.
description_es: Trozo de estrella fugaz usado para el equipo único de Shonen Magazine.
description_it: Frammento di stella cadente usato per creare speciali oggetti di Shonen Magazine.
description_zh: A shooting star fragment used to create Shonen Magazine's special gear.

name: Roll of Fate
description: A trump card that ensures a duel's victory. A magician is beautifully drawn on one side.
description_de: Trumpfkarte, die einen Sieg im Duell sichert. Mit dem Bild eines Magiers auf einer Seite.
description_fr: Atout garantissant la victoire au cours d'un duel. Un superbe magicien est dessiné dessus.
description_es: Carta que garantiza la victoria en un duelo. Hay un bonito dibujo de un mago en un lado.
description_it: Carta che assicura la vittoria. Decorata con il ritratto di un mago.
description_zh: A trump card that ensures a duel's victory. A magician is beautifully drawn on one side.

name: Pirate Ticket J
description: Proof that you've conquered a JUMP Quest. It depicts a captain and his beloved sword.
description_de: Beweis, dass du eine JUMP- Quest gemeistert hast. Zeigt einen Kapitän und sein Schwert.
description_fr: La preuve que vous avez réussi une quête JUMP. Représente un capitaine et son sabre d'abordage.
description_es: Prueba de haber conquistado una misión JUMP. Presenta un capitán y su amada espada.
description_it: Attesta che hai superato una missione JUMP. Ritrae un capitano e la sua spada.
description_zh: Proof that you've conquered a JUMP Quest. It depicts a captain and his beloved sword.

name: Famitsu Ticket
description: Authorizes you to produce a special Famitsu weapon. The word "gavas" is written on it.
description_de: Erlaubt dir die Herstellung einer Famitsu-Waffe. Das Wort "Gavas" steht darauf.
description_fr: Permet de créer une arme Famitsu spéciale. Le mot "gavas" y est inscrit.
description_es: Te permite crear un arma especial Famitsu. Lleva la palabra "gavas" escrita.
description_it: Autorizza a produrre una speciale arma Famitsu. Vi è incisa la parola "Gavas".
description_zh: Authorizes you to produce a special Famitsu weapon. The word "gavas" is written on it.

name: Dengeki Ticket
description: Thanks for participating in our event! Remember to pick up Dengeki Game Magazine!
description_de: Danke für die Teilnahme an diesem Event! Besorge dir das Dengeki Game Magazine!
description_fr: Merci d'avoir participé à l'évènement ! N'oubliez pas de prendre le mag' Dengeki !
description_es: ¡Gracias por participar! ¡No te olvides la revista de juegos Dengeki!
description_it: Grazie per aver partecipato all'evento! E ricorda di leggere Dengeki Game Magazine!
description_zh: Thanks for participating in our event! Remember to pick up Dengeki Game Magazine!

name: Uniqlo Coin S
description: A special Uniqlo coin designed with both form and function in mind.
description_de: Eine besondere Uniqlo-Münze. Form und Funktion waren beim Design gleichermaßen wichtig.
description_fr: Une pièce précieuse Uniqlo à la fois jolie et fonctionnelle.
description_es: Moneda especial de Uniqlo diseñada para tener buen aspecto y funcionalidad.
description_it: Moneta speciale di Uniqlo che tiene in mente forma e funzione.
description_zh: A special Uniqlo coin designed with both form and function in mind.

name: Wind Waker
description: A conductor's baton with the power to control the wind. Given to a legendary hero's successor.
description_de: Ein Stab mit der Kraft, den Wind zu kontrollieren. Für den Nachfolger eines Helden.
description_fr: Baguette ayant le pouvoir d'éveiller le vent. Remise au successeur d'un héros de légende.
description_es: Batuta con capacidad para controlar el viento. Perteneció al sucesor de un héroe legendario.
description_it: Bacchetta che permette di controllare i venti, donata all'erede di un grande eroe.
description_zh: A conductor's baton with the power to control the wind. Given to a legendary hero's successor.

name: Arwing Boarding Pass
description: A boarding pass for a tour on a starship. A weapon blueprint is written on the back.
description_de: Bordkarte für eine Raumschiff- Tour. Auf der Rückseite ist eine Waffen-Blaupause aufgedruckt.
description_fr: Carte d'embarquement à bord d'un vaisseau spatial. Il y a un schéma d'arme au verso.
description_es: Tarjeta de embarque para volar en una nave espacial. Incluye el diseño de un arma en el anverso.
description_it: Consente di volare su una nave spaziale. Ha uno schema per armi sul retro.
description_zh: A boarding pass for a tour on a starship. A weapon blueprint is written on the back.

name: Super Mushroom
description: A red-capped mushroom with white spots. One bite makes you big and tough.
description_de: Ein roter Pilz mit weißen Flecken. Wenn du ihn isst, wirst du groß und stark.
description_fr: Champignon doté d'un chapeau rouge à pois blancs. Une bouchée rend grand et fort.
description_es: Champiñón rojo con puntos blancos. Muérdelo y serás más grande y fuerte.
description_it: Fungo dal cappello rosso e macchie bianche. Chi lo morde diventa grande e forte.
description_zh: A red-capped mushroom with white spots. One bite makes you big and tough.

name: Design Pattern
description: Now you can be a fashion leader just like Isabelle and Mr. Resetti!
description_de: Werde zum modischen Trend- setter - wie Melinda oder Resetti!
description_fr: Vous êtes la nouvelle star de la mode ! Marie et Resetti vont être jaloux !
description_es: ¡Ahora tú también puedes ser una estrella de la moda, como Canela y Rese T. Ado!
description_it: Diventa una star della moda come Fuffi e Resetti.
description_zh: Now you can be a fashion leader just like Isabelle and Mr. Resetti!

name: Triforce
description: Proof that the goddess saw courage in the heart of a young hero clad in green.
description_de: Beweis, dass die Göttinnen Mut im Herzen eines in Grün gekleideten Helden sahen.
description_fr: Preuve que les Déesses ont décelé du courage chez un jeune héros de vert vêtu.
description_es: Prueba que cierta diosa vio valor en el corazón de un joven héroe vestido de verde.
description_it: Prova che la dea ha visto del coraggio nel cuore di un giovane eroe in abiti verdi.
description_zh: Proof that the goddess saw courage in the heart of a young hero clad in green.

name: Samus Coin
description: An ancient coin given to the protectors of the galaxy. A Chozo emblem is carved on one side.
description_de: Eine alte Münze für die Beschützer der Galaxie. Mit eingeprägtem Chozo-Wappen.
description_fr: Pièce antique remise aux protecteurs de la galaxie. Elle arbore un emblème Chozo.
description_es: Moneda antigua que se entregaba a protectores de la galaxia. Presenta un emblema Chozo en una cara.
description_it: Antica moneta conferita ai protettori della galassia. Presenta un emblema Chozo.
description_zh: An ancient coin given to the protectors of the galaxy. A Chozo emblem is carved on one side.

name: Goddess's Grace
description: The power of the Goddess crystallized into a jewel. Grants one eternal peace.
description_de: Die Macht einer Göttin, in einem Juwel kristallisiert. Gewährt ewigen Frieden.
description_fr: Le pouvoir de la déesse cristallisé dans un joyau. Apporte la paix éternelle.
description_es: El poder de la diosa cristalizado en una joya. Concede infinita paz.
description_it: Il potere di una dea, cristallizzata in un gioiello. Dona onore eterno.
description_zh: The power of the Goddess crystallized into a jewel. Grants one eternal peace.

name: Goddess's Embrace
description: The power of the Goddess crystallized into a crown. Grants one eternal honor.
description_de: Die Macht einer Göttin, in einer Krone kristallisiert. Gewährt ewige Ehre.
description_fr: Le pouvoir de la déesse cristallisé dans une couronne. Preuve de l'honneur éternel.
description_es: El poder de la diosa materializado en una corona. Concede honor infinito.
description_it: Il potere di una dea, cristallizzata in una corona. Dona onore eterno.
description_zh: The power of the Goddess crystallized into a crown. Grants one eternal honor.

name: SF Coin
description: Given to martial artists who never miss training, this coin is proof of those seeking new challenges.
description_de: Für Kampfkünstler, die niemals das Training verpassen und neue Herausforderungen suchen.
description_fr: Donnée aux pratiquants des arts martiaux qui ne ratent jamais une séance d'entraînement.
description_es: Para luchadores que nunca faltan al entrenamiento. Símbolo de búsqueda de nuevos retos.
description_it: Riservata agli artisti marziali sempre pronti a raccogliere nuove sfide.
description_zh: Given to martial artists who never miss training, this coin is proof of those seeking new challenges.

name: Red Orb
description: A magical red stone that contains the blood of demons. It makes for quite stylish Palico weapons.
description_de: Ein magischer roter Stein, der das Blut von Dämonen enthält. Für coole Kameradenwaffen.
description_fr: Pierre magique contenant le sang de démons. Permet de créer des armes de Palico très "stylish".
description_es: Piedra roja mágica que contiene sangre de demonio. Ideal para armas de camarada con estilo.
description_it: Pietra magica che contiene sangue di demone. Rende uniche le armi dei compagni.
description_zh: A magical red stone that contains the blood of demons. It makes for quite stylish Palico weapons.

name: Ceratanium
description: A strong, yet light alloy developed by the father of robotics. It is the material used by a special robot.
description_de: Eine vom Vater der Robotik entwickelte Legierung. Benutzt von einem besonderen Roboter.
description_fr: Alliage léger mais très résistant, conçu par le père de la robotique. Utilisé par un robot très spécial.
description_es: Aleación ligera de gran resistencia desarrollada por el padre de la robótica. El material de robots.
description_it: Lega leggera ma resistente utilizzata per realizzare un robot molto speciale.
description_zh: A strong, yet light alloy developed by the father of robotics. It is the material used by a special robot.

name: Hero's Seal
description: An item given to hunters who are passionate about their craft. A true symbol of the art of hunting.
description_de: Wird an Jäger vergeben, die ihrer Berufung mit Leidenschaft nach- gehen. Ein Symbol der Jagdkunst.
description_fr: Objet remis aux chasseurs passionnés. Véritable symbole de l'art de la chasse.
description_es: Objeto entregado a cazadores apasionados por su trabajo. Símbolo del arte de la caza.
description_it: Donato ai cacciatori più esperti. Un simbolo dell'arte della caccia.
description_zh: An item given to hunters who are passionate about their craft. A true symbol of the art of hunting.

name: Baby Journal
description: A journal charting the growth of baby monsters. It includes daily observations and thoughts.
description_de: Ein Tagebuch, das das Wachstum von Babymonstern aufzeichnet. Mit Beobachtungen und Gedanken.
description_fr: Carnet notant la croissance des bébés monstres. Inclut théories et observations quotidiennes.
description_es: Diario para seguir el crecimiento de los cachorros de monstruo. Incluye observaciones y pensamientos.
description_it: Diario su cui sono annotati pensieri sulla crescita dei cuccioli di mostro.
description_zh: A journal charting the growth of baby monsters. It includes daily observations and thoughts.

name: Sunsnug Journal
description: A journal with cute illustrations depicting the daily life of a Felyne living in a Lynian village.
description_de: Ein Tagebuch mit niedlichen Bildern. Zeigt den Alltag einer Felyne in einem Lynian-Dorf.
description_fr: Journal joliment illustré narrant la vie quotidienne d'un Felyne d'un village lynien.
description_es: Diario con ilustraciones que muestran la vida diaria de un Felyne en una aldea Lynian.
description_it: Grazioso diario illustrato sulla vita di un Felyne in un villaggio dei Lynian.
description_zh: A journal with cute illustrations depicting the daily life of a Felyne living in a Lynian village.

name: Fan Club Newsletter
description: A newsletter for all the passionate fan club members.
description_de: Ein Newsletter für alle leidenschaftlichen Mitglieder des Fanclubs.
description_fr: Le bulletin d'informations pour les membres du club.
description_es: Un boletín de noticias para los entusiastas miembros del club de fans oficial.
description_it: Una newsletter per i fan accaniti di Monster Hunter.
description_zh: A newsletter for all the passionate fan club members.

name: Fan Club Application
description: An application form to join the only club for true MH-lovers! Come join the fun!
description_de: Ein Bewerbungsbogen, um DEM Club für echte "MH"-Fans bei- zutreten! Mach doch mit!
description_fr: Formulaire d'adhésion pour rejoindre le seul vrai club des amoureux de MH !
description_es: Formulario de solicitud de entrada al único club de amantes de MH. ¡Únete a la diversión!
description_it: Modulo di adesione al fan club per veri appassionati di MH! Divertiti con noi!
description_zh: An application form to join the only club for true MH-lovers! Come join the fun!

name: Fan Club Invite
description: An invite to a fan club for ardent monster hunters ONLY! Welcome to the gang.
description_de: Einladung zum Fanclub. NUR für glühende Monsterjäger! Willkommen in der Gang.
description_fr: Réservée aux chasseurs de monstres fervents. Bienvenue au club.
description_es: Invitación al club de fans. ¡Para cazadores fanáticos! Bienvenido a la panda.
description_it: Invito di un fan club per i cacciatori più ferventi. Ora sei dei nostri!
description_zh: An invite to a fan club for ardent monster hunters ONLY! Welcome to the gang.

name: Puppet Ticket
description: A ticket stamped with the paw prints of two Felynes.
description_de: Ein mit den Pfotenabdrücken von zwei Felynen gestempelter Schein.
description_fr: Ticket frappé de l'empreinte des pattes de deux Felynes.
description_es: Ticket con las huellas de dos Felyne estampadas.
description_it: Buono su cui sono stampate le impronte delle zampe di due Felyne.
description_zh: A ticket stamped with the paw prints of two Felynes.

name: Great Stone
description: This stone looks normal, but it has an incredible sense of presence and exudes an ancient feel.
description_de: Dieser Stein wirkt normal, strahlt aber eine seltsame Präsenz und ein antikes Gefühl aus.
description_fr: Cette pierre a l'air normale, mais semble très ancienne. On ne peut que remarquer sa présence.
description_es: Esta piedra parece normal, pero tiene un increíble sentido de la presencia y un aire antiguo.
description_it: Sembra una pietra comune, ma emana un potere immenso e antichissimo.
description_zh: This stone looks normal, but it has an incredible sense of presence and exudes an ancient feel.

name: Courier's Letter
description: Neither snow nor rain nor gloom of night stays the Courier from delivering people's dreams.
description_de: Ob Schnee, Regen oder Dunkel- heit, der Kurier liefert immer die Träume der Leute aus.
description_fr: Rien n'empêche le Messager de faire rêver les gens, ni la neige, ni la pluie, ni la nuit.
description_es: Ni la nieve, ni la lluvia, ni la oscuridad impiden al mensajero entregar los sueños de la gente.
description_it: Neppure neve, pioggia o buio impediscono al corriere di effettuare le sue consegne.
description_zh: Neither snow nor rain nor gloom of night stays the Courier from delivering people's dreams.

name: Kaioh Certificate
description: It says "Hunting is a precious skill, a refinement of the heart."
description_de: Darauf steht: „Das Jagen ist eine kostbare Fähigkeit, die den Charakter bildet.“
description_fr: Il y est écrit : "La chasse est un art qui élève l'âme de celui qui la pratique."
description_es: El texto dice: "Cazar es un arte que templa a quien lo practica".
description_it: C'è scritto: "La caccia è un'abilità preziosa, un perfezionamento dell'anima".
description_zh: It says "Hunting is a precious skill, a refinement of the heart."

name: WORST Coin
description: A shabby coin, but proof that you've gone toe to toe with a real monster.
description_de: Eine abgegriffene Münze, aber der Beweis dafür, dass du vor Monstern nicht zurückschreckst.
description_fr: Une vieille pièce, mais qui prouve que vous vous êtes frotté à un vrai monstre.
description_es: Para tipos malos pero nobles: prueba que has vencido a un monstruo.
description_it: Una moneta rovinata, ma che testimonia lo scontro testa a testa con un vero mostro.
description_zh: A shabby coin, but proof that you've gone toe to toe with a real monster.

name: Evidence
description: Evidence left at the scene. We can infer the appearance of the perp via deduction!
description_de: Am Tatort gefundene Beweise. Damit lässt sich die Identität des Täters herleiten!
description_fr: Preuve trouvée sur la scène de crime. On peut en déduire qui est le coupable !
description_es: Prueba hallada en la escena del crimen. Con ella descubrirás al culpable.
description_it: Identificheremo il colpevole grazie alle prove lasciate sui luoghi del delitto!
description_zh: Evidence left at the scene. We can infer the appearance of the perp via deduction!

name: Salaryman Coin
description: Swap for Palico hardware to defend against enraged bosses.
description_de: Damit kannst du Ausrüstung herstellen, die Kameraden vor jedem wütendem Chef schützt.
description_fr: Permet d'obtenir de l'équipement Palico pour se protéger contre son patron.
description_es: Consigue equipo para camaradas. ¡Resistente a monstruos con mala uva!
description_it: Scambiala con armature per compagni e ti difenderanno da un malvagio capo ufficio!
description_zh: Swap for Palico hardware to defend against enraged bosses.

name: Taisha-ryu Codex
description: A swordfighting style permitted only to those who would die for honor.
description_de: Dieser Schwertkampfstil ist nur denen zugänglich, die für die Ehre ihr Leben lassen würden.
description_fr: Une technique réservée à ceux qui sont prêts à mourir pour l'honneur.
description_es: Técnica de esgrima reservada a aquellos dispuestos a morir por honor.
description_it: Uno stile di combattimento adatto a chi difende il suo onore fino alla morte.
description_zh: A swordfighting style permitted only to those who would die for honor.

name: Famitsu Coupon
description: A ticket awarded to skilled hunters that lets you create exclusive Famitsu weapons.
description_de: Wird nur fähigen Jägern verliehen. Lässt dich exklusive Famitsu-Waffen herstellen.
description_fr: Ticket offert aux chasseurs d'exception, permettant de créer des armes Famitsu.
description_es: Un regalo de parte de la revista Famitsu para que forjes equipo especial.
description_it: Biglietto premio per i cacciatori più in gamba, per creare armi Famitsu.
description_zh: A ticket awarded to skilled hunters that lets you create exclusive Famitsu weapons.

name: Dengeki Ticket XX
description: Thanks for taking part in our event! We hope to see you again soon!
description_de: Danke für die Teilnahme an unserer Aktion! Wir hoffen, dich bald wiederzusehen!
description_fr: Merci d'avoir accepté notre quête ! Nous espérons vous revoir bientôt !
description_es: ¡Dengeki te da las gracias por participar en el evento con este fabuloso regalo!
description_it: Grazie per aver accettato la nostra sfida! Speriamo di rivederti presto in azione!
description_zh: Thanks for taking part in our event! We hope to see you again soon!

name: Flying Xin Mark
description: Proof of membership in the elite army unit of a man who would be general.
description_de: Zeichen der Zugehörigkeit zur Eliteeinheit eines Mannes, der danach strebt, General zu sein.
description_fr: Preuve que l'homme qui voulait être général faisait partie d'une unité d'élite.
description_es: Demuestra que perteneces a la élite del ejército de un futuro general.
description_it: Insegna che prova la tua affiliazione all'esercito del futuro generale.
description_zh: Proof of membership in the elite army unit of a man who would be general.

name: Buccaneer Ticket J
description: Proof that you've conquered a Jump Quest. It depicts a captain and his sword.
description_de: Zeigt, dass du eine Jump-Quest gemeistert hast. Darauf zu sehen sind ein Kapitän samt Schwert.
description_fr: Preuve que vous avez réussi une quête de Jump. L'image représente un pirate.
description_es: Prueba de que has completado la misión Jump. Representa a un pirata con su espada.
description_it: La prova che hai superato una missione Jump! raffigura un capitano e la sua spada.
description_zh: Proof that you've conquered a Jump Quest. It depicts a captain and his sword.

name: Magic Realm Key
description: A key to unlock both realms unknown and custom gear from the Shonen Magazine Boss.
description_de: Öffnet den Weg in fremde Lande - und zu besonderer Shonen-Magazin-Ausrüstung.
description_fr: Donne accès à un royaume magique, mais aussi à un équipement Shonen Magazine.
description_es: Sirve para viajar a otros mundos y obtener equipo. Regalo de Shonen Magazine.
description_it: Sblocca regni sconosciuti ed equipaggiamento del direttore di Shonen Magazine.
description_zh: A key to unlock both realms unknown and custom gear from the Shonen Magazine Boss.

name: Zaruba Fragment
description: A piece of a magic ring that exhausted its energy to save its friends. It still glows.
description_de: Splitter eines magischen Rings, der seine Kraft zur Rettung seiner Freunde gab. Leuchtet.
description_fr: Éclat d'un anneau qui a tout donné pour sauver son ami. Brille encore faiblement.
description_es: Fragmento de anillo mágico cuyo poder fue usado para salvar una preciada amistad.
description_it: Pezzo di anello magico che ha esaurito la sua energia per salvare gli amici.
description_zh: A piece of a magic ring that exhausted its energy to save its friends. It still glows.

name: Turnabout Ticket
description: A pass to a heated court battle. Lets you make lawyer gear at the Palico Armory.
description_de: Dieser Schein kann gegen Felyne-Anwaltsausrüstung eingetauscht werden.
description_fr: Pour assister à un procès endiablé ou fabriquer de l'équipement d'avocat.
description_es: El armero Felyne te forjará con él una armadura similar al traje de cierto abogado.
description_it: Buono per una battaglia legale. Puoi creare l'equipaggiamento da avvocato nell'armeria.
description_zh: A pass to a heated court battle. Lets you make lawyer gear at the Palico Armory.

name: Navirou Ticket
description: Lets you create gear resembling a very unique, enigmatic-looking Felyne.
description_de: Damit kannst du Ausrüstung erhalten, die einer mysteriösen Felyne nachempfunden ist.
description_fr: Pour fabriquer l'équipement qui permet de se déguiser en Navirou, un Felyne original.
description_es: Con él podrás forjar una armadura basada en un Felyne de lo más peculiar.
description_it: Puoi creare equipaggiamento somigliante a un Felyne dall'aspetto enigmatico.
description_zh: Lets you create gear resembling a very unique, enigmatic-looking Felyne.

name: F Spirit Stone
description: A monster's spirit seals away the Felyne power in this strange stone.
description_de: Die Seele eines Monsters ruht in diesem Stein und leiht der Felyne ihre Kraft.
description_fr: Pierre étrange renfermant l'âme d'un monstre. Celle-ci renferme l'âme d'un Felyne.
description_es: Gema portentosa que alberga el alma de un monstruo y el poder de un Felyne.
description_it: Strana pietra che racchiude lo spirito di un Felyne.
description_zh: A monster's spirit seals away the Felyne power in this strange stone.

name: Club Promotion
description: Congrats! This proves that you possess true skill. You better not slack off again!
description_de: Glückwunsch! Dieser Schein attestiert dir echtes Können. Ruh dich aber nicht darauf aus!
description_fr: Félicitations, tu as réussi la quête ! Voici la preuve que tu es un fan accompli !
description_es: ¡Enhorabuena! Toma esto para sentirte como un miembro del club de Monster Hunter.
description_it: Congratulazioni! Hai dato prova della tua abilità. Ma non montarti la testa!
description_zh: Congrats! This proves that you possess true skill. You better not slack off again!

name: JDL Badge
description: Proves that you're a member of the Junior Detective League. One truth prevails!
description_de: Weist dich als Mitglied der "Detective Boys" aus. Es gibt immer nur eine Wahrheit!
description_fr: Preuve que vous êtes membre des Détectives Juniors. Faites éclater la vérité !
description_es: ¡Ya eres miembro del Club Juvenil de Detectives! "¡Verdad solo hay una!"
description_it: Prova che "la verità è una sola" ed entra nella Junior Detective League!
description_zh: Proves that you're a member of the Junior Detective League. One truth prevails!

name: Silver Crystal
description: A piece of a crystal filled with the love of a princess for her friends.
description_de: Splitter eines Kristalls, der mit der Liebe einer Prinzessin für ihre Freunde gefüllt ist.
description_fr: Un morceau de cristal qui renferme l'amour d'une princesse pour ses amis.
description_es: Fragmento de cristal que encarna el amor que siente una princesa por sus amigos.
description_it: Un pezzo di cristallo che incarna l'amore di una principessa per un amico.
description_zh: A piece of a crystal filled with the love of a princess for her friends.

name: Zelda Ticket
description: A Triforce fragment proving that your power has been recognized by a goddess.
description_de: Das Triforce-Fragment darauf beweist, dass deine Kraft von einer Göttin anerkannt wurde.
description_fr: Ticket prouvant que votre force a été reconnue par une Déesse.
description_es: Fragmento de la Trifuerza que prueba que una diosa ha reconocido tu poder.
description_it: Frammento di Triforza che testimonia la tua forza eroica.
description_zh: A Triforce fragment proving that your power has been recognized by a goddess.

name: Zelda Ticket G
description: A Triforce fragment proving that your courage has been recognized by a goddess.
description_de: Das Triforce-Fragment darauf beweist, dass dein Mut von einer Göttin anerkannt wurde.
description_fr: Ticket prouvant que votre courage a été reconnu par une Déesse.
description_es: Fragmento de la Trifuerza que prueba que una diosa ha reconocido tu valor.
description_it: Frammento di Triforza che testimonia il tuo coraggio eroico.
description_zh: A Triforce fragment proving that your courage has been recognized by a goddess.

name: Sealing Shield
description: A shield with five shining orbs that conceal a mysterious power, which is said to protect the world from evil.
description_de: Ein Schild mit fünf glitzernden Kugeln, deren mysteriöse Kraft die Welt vor Bösem schützen soll.
description_fr: Écu qui protège le monde des forces du mal, grâce au pouvoir mystérieux de 5 orbes.
description_es: Escudo con cinco orbes brillantes. Encierra un misterioso poder que se cree que protege al mundo del mal.
description_it: Uno scudo che brilla con il potere di cinque gemme, in grado di proteggere dal male.
description_zh: A shield with five shining orbs that conceal a mysterious power, which is said to protect the world from evil.

name: Option
description: A small robot that supports Hiryu on his missions by firing beams or blocking attacks.
description_de: Ein kleiner Roboter, der Hiryu auf dessen Einsätzen offensiv und defensiv unterstützt.
description_fr: Petit robot qui assiste Hiryu lors de ses missions. Peut tirer ou bloquer les attaques.
description_es: Un pequeño robot que presta apoyo a Hiryu disparando o bloqueando ataques.
description_it: Piccolo robot che offre supporto a Hiryu sparando raggi o bloccando attacchi.
description_zh: A small robot that supports Hiryu on his missions by firing beams or blocking attacks.

name: Celestial Scroll
description: A beautifully drawn scroll depicting Amaterasu, the Sun Goddess, in all her divinity.
description_de: Diese wunderschön gemalte Bild- rolle zeigt die Sonnengöttin Amaterasu in ihrer Herrlichkeit.
description_fr: Merveilleux parchemin illustrant la déesse du soleil Amaterasu dans toute sa splendeur.
description_es: Un hermoso pergamino con la imagen de Amaterasu, la diosa del sol, en su divino esplendor.
description_it: Pergamena che raffigura la divina Amaterasus, dea del sole.
description_zh: A beautifully drawn scroll depicting Amaterasu, the Sun Goddess, in all her divinity.

name: Arthur's Armor
description: Knight's armor for the brave and valiant. Chivalrous straw- berry-print boxers included.
description_de: Ritterrüstung für wackere und ehrenhafte Recken. Unterhose mit Erdbeer-Druck inklusive.
description_fr: Pour les preux et ardents chevaliers en herbe. Le caleçon est même inclus.
description_es: Armadura de caballero para los más valientes. Incluye unos bonitos calzoncillos debajo.
description_it: Possente armatura da cavaliere. Incluse nel set, mutande adornate con graziose fragoline.
description_zh: Knight's armor for the brave and valiant. Chivalrous straw- berry-print boxers included.

name: Expert Blade 1
description: A Great Sword authorized only for master hunters. Engraved with the words, "Great job!"

description_it: Spadone riservato ai cacciatori più esperti. L'incisione recita "Ottimo lavoro".

name: Fatalis Fireblade 1
description: The Sword of red fury. This crimson blade's attacks bestow an exquisite despair on its victims.
description_de: Schwert des roten Zorns. Seine Angriffe stürzen die Opfer in äußerste Verzweiflung.
description_fr: L'épée de furie rouge. Ses victimes sombrent dans le plus exquis des désespoirs.
description_es: Espada de ira carmesí. Sume a sus víctimas en la más profunda desesperación.
description_it: Lo spadone della furia rossa, che opprime le sue vittime con la disperazione più profonda.
description_zh: The Sword of red fury. This crimson blade's attacks bestow an exquisite despair on its victims.

name: Fatalis State 2
description: The Fatalis Fireblade's final form sows explosive furies of destruction in its wake.
description_de: Die finale Form der Fatalis-Feuer- klinge hinterlässt explosive Zerstörung, wo auch immer sie trifft.
description_fr: Cette lame explosive sème le chaos sur son passage. Base : Lame volcanique Fatalis
description_es: Forma final de Filo Fatalis. Quien la porte domeñará el alma de sus draconianas presas.
description_it: La forma finale della lamafuoco Fatalis. Sprigiona una furia esplosiva che porta distruzione.
description_zh: The Fatalis Fireblade's final form sows explosive furies of destruction in its wake.

name: Fatalis Vulcania 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Fatalis Fireblade.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe der Fatalis-Feuerklinge.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Lame volcanique Fatalis.
description_es: Forma perfecta Filo Fatalis que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore della lamafuoco Fatalis.
name_zh: 红龙大剑【深红之怒】 - Lv.3
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Fatalis Fireblade.

name: Fatalis Ancestor 1
description: This shining blade illuminates the darkness that lies deep in man's soul.
description_de: Die leuchtende Klinge illuminiert die Dunkelheit in den Tiefen der Menschenseele.
description_fr: La lame blanche scintillante illumine les ténèbres au cœur de l'âme de homme.
description_es: Una hoja blanca brillante que ilumina la oscuridad en lo más profundo del alma de cada hombre.
description_it: La lama bianca scintillante illumina i recessi oscuri nell'anima di un uomo.
description_zh: This shining blade illuminates the darkness that lies deep in man's soul.

name: Fatalis Ancient 2
description: The Fatalis Ancestor's final form. The light unleashed by this blade brings light even to abyssal depths.
description_de: Finale Form des Fatalis-Vorfahrs. Das Licht dieser Klinge erhellt selbst die tiefsten Abgründe.
description_fr: Sa lueur pleine d'espoir est à même de percer les abysses. Base : Ancêtre Fatalis
description_es: Forma final de Ancestro Fatalis. Su reluciente hoja trae esperanza hasta los abismos más profundos.
description_it: La forma finale dell'antenato di Fatalis. Sprigiona una luce che porta speranza nelle tenebre.
description_zh: The Fatalis Ancestor's final form. The light unleashed by this blade brings light even to abyssal depths.

name: Fatalis Legacy 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Fatalis Ancestor.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe des Fatalis-Vorfahrs.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Ancêtre Fatalis.
description_es: Forma perfecta Ancestro Fatalis que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore dell'antenato di Fatalis.
name_zh: 祖龙辉剑【希望之辉】 - Lv.3
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Fatalis Ancestor.

name: Lightbreak Blade 1
description: A Great Sword with tremendous, volatile power that leaves no trace of victims in its wake.
description_de: Ein Großschwert mit volatiler Macht. Lässt keine Spur seiner Opfer zurück.
description_fr: Grande épée à la puissance volatile extrême. Elle ne laisse aucune trace de ses victimes.
description_es: Gran espada con un poder tremendo y volátil que desintegra a sus víctimas completamente.
description_it: Spadone dalla potenza esplosiva che annienta gli avversari senza lasciarne traccia.
description_zh: A Great Sword with tremendous, volatile power that leaves no trace of victims in its wake.

name: Lightbreak Ash 2
description: The Lightbreak Blade's final form. Its explosive power can destroy the world if improperly used.
description_de: Die finale Form der Lichtbruch- Klinge. Unachtsam gehandhabt kann ihre Kraft die Welt zerstören.
description_fr: Un mauvais maniement de cette arme pourrait détruire le monde. Base : Lame de lumière
description_es: Forma final de Filo parteluz. Su fuerza explosiva es capaz de destruir el mundo.
description_it: La forma finale della lama d'alba. Se usata impropriamente, può distruggere il mondo intero.
description_zh: The Lightbreak Blade's final form. Its explosive power can destroy the world if improperly used.

name: Lightbreak Ember 3
description: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Lightbreak Blade.
description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe der Lichtbruch-Klinge.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Lame de lumière.
description_es: Forma perfecta Filo parteluz que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore della lama d'alba.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Lightbreak Blade.

name: Licht/Ombre 1
description: A wicked blade whose Affinity changes when its wielder overcomes the Frenzy.
description_de: Eine üble Klinge, deren Affinität wechselt, wenn ihr Träger die Raserei überwindet.
description_fr: Une lame diabolique dont l'affinité change quand son porteur triomphe du virus de la furie.
description_es: Espada retorcida cuya afinidad cambia cuando su portador supera la cólera.
description_it: Lama malvagia la cui affinità muta quando chi la brandisce debella la frenesia.
description_zh: A wicked blade whose Affinity changes when its wielder overcomes the Frenzy.

name: Düster/Éclat 2
description: The Licht/Ombre's final form. Shows its true potential only to those who would shatter the dark.
description_de: Finale Form von Licht und Schatten. Zeigt ihre wahre Macht jenen, die die Dunkelheit bekämpfen.
description_fr: Ne révèle son véritable potentiel qu'à ceux qui bravent les ténèbres. Base : Licht/Ombre
description_es: Forma final de Licth/Sombra. Muestra su verdadero potencial solo a quienes destruyen la oscuridad.
description_it: La forma finale della Licht-Ombre. Se usata impropriamente, può distruggere il mondo intero.
description_zh: The Licht/Ombre's final form. Shows its true potential only to those who would shatter the dark.

description_de: - Perfekte Form - Die höchste Entwicklungsstufe von Licht und Schatten.
description_fr: == Forme ultime == La forme ultime et convoitée de l'arme : Licht/Ombre.
description_es: Forma perfecta Licht/Sombra que se ha refinado al máximo.
description_it: Forma superiore L'ambita forma superiore della Licht-Ombre.
description_zh: == Ultimate Form == The coveted Ultimate Form of the Licht/Ombre.

name: Quarrel Hornsword 1
description: A wild-looking, considerably powerful blade crafted from Diablos horns.
description_de: Eine gefährlich wirkende Klinge aus Diablos-Hörnern. Sehr schlagkräftig.
description_fr: Épée farouche faite en cornes de Diablos. Très puissante.
description_es: De aspecto feroz. Hecha de cuernos de Diablos. Muy poderosa.
description_it: Lama dall'aspetto selvatico fatta con corna di Diablos. È potentissima.
description_zh: A wild-looking, considerably powerful blade crafted from Diablos horns.

name: Feud Hornsword 2
description: The Quarrel Hornsword's final form. Whatever calls forth its true power must be terrible indeed.
description_de: Finale Form des Streit-Hornschwerts. Was auch immer seine wahre Macht erweckt, muss schrecklich sein.
description_fr: Sa puissance cachée est terrifiante. Base : Épée en corne colère
description_es: Forma final de Espada cuerno riña. El origen de su verdadero poder es espeluznante.
description_it: La forma finale della spada corno alterco. La crudeltà risveglia tutto il suo potere.

name: Icicle Fang 1
description: A blade that freezes foes solid; a manifestation of the white- knight ruler of the Tundra.
description_de: Eine Klinge, die Feinde ge- frieren lässt. Die Manifes- tation des Tundraherrschers.
description_fr: Lame gelant les ennemis. Manifestation du chevalier blanc de la Toundra.
description_es: Espada que congela enemigos. Manifestación del caballero blanco de la tundra.
description_it: Lama che incarna il bianco della tundra e congela nemici in un solido blocco.
description_zh: A blade that freezes foes solid; a manifestation of the white- knight ruler of the Tundra.

name: Paladire 2
description: The Icicle Fang's final form. One strike can freeze the deepest ocean -- and shatter it.
description_de: Finale Form des Eiszapfen-Reißzahns. Ein einziger Schlag gefriert - und zerschmettert - den tiefsten Ozean!
description_fr: On la dit capable de congeler et briser un océan entier. Base : Croc stalactite
description_es: Forma final de Colmillo carámbano. Con un solo golpe congela el mar más profundo... y lo parte en dos.
description_it: La forma finale della zanna di ghiaccio. Un solo colpo può congelare l'oceano più profondo.
description_zh: The Icicle Fang's final form. One strike can freeze the deepest ocean -- and shatter it.

name: Carapace Sword 1
description: A blade shaped like a Barroth's head; it packs nearly as much punch.
description_de: Eine Klinge in Form eines Barroth-Kopfes; sie ist auch beinahe genauso hart.
description_fr: Épée en forme de tête de Barroth. A presque autant de vigueur.
description_es: Con la forma de la cabeza de un Barroth y casi con la misma fuerza.
description_it: Una lama a forma di testa di Barroth e con quasi la stessa forza.
description_zh: A blade shaped like a Barroth's head; it packs nearly as much punch.

description_de: Finale Form des Rückenpanzer- schwerts. Ihre Angriffe durchdringen die Erde - ein Anblick zum Fürchten.
description_fr: La simple vue de cette arme en action suffit à inspirer la terreur. Base : Épée carapace
description_es: Forma final de Espada de caparazón. Su golpe capaz de destrozar la tierra es aterrador.

description: A blade that leverages the Nerscylla's unique materials to exceed Forge limits.
description_de: Überwindet mit einmaligem Nerscylla-Material die Grenzen der Schmiedekunst.
description_fr: Lame à base de Nerscylla qui repousse les limites de la forge.
description_es: Espada que usa el material de Nerscylla para sobrepasar los límites de la forja.
description_it: Sfrutta le proprietà uniche del Nerscylla per superare i limiti della Forgia.

description_de: Finale Form der Immensen Klinge. Ihre Schläge haben die Kraft, die Ziele völlig zu zerfetzen.
description_fr: Rien ne peut résister à son tranchant. Base : Lame du sacrificateur
description_es: Forma final de Espada imponente. Su cortante filo tiene la capacidad de mutilar al adversario.
description_it: Forma finale della lama immane. Possiede un'affilatezza tale da mutilare gli avversari.
