description_it: Dicono che questa bandana rossa migliori il fiuto per i tesori.
description_zh: A bold, crimson bandanna, said to sharpen one's nose for tracking down treasure.

name: F Legendary Helm J
description: A slice of "yo-ho-ho!" that makes Palicoes as jovial as the lord of the Seven Seas.
description_de: Etwas "jo-ho-ho!" macht Kameraden fröhlich wie den Herrn der sieben Meere.
description_fr: Rend votre compagnon aussi jovial que le maître des sept mers.
description_es: Un casco piratesco con el que los camaradas se sienten señores de los siete mares.
description_it: Un capo allegro che rende i compagni gioviali come il signore dei sette mari.
description_zh: A slice of "yo-ho-ho!" that makes Palicoes as jovial as the lord of the Seven Seas.

name: F Greedy Skull J
description: A treasure addict's headwear. Even now, he sails the seas in search of a lost fortune.
description_de: Kopfbedeckung eines Schatz- süchtigen, der auf seiner Suche die Welt umsegelt.
description_fr: Masque d'un accro aux trésors qui parcourt encore les mers en quête d'un butin caché.
description_es: Prenda para los adictos a los tesoros. Incluso ahora sigue navegando buscando fortunas.
description_it: Copricapo di un cacciatore di tesori alla continua ricerca di ricchezze perdute.
description_zh: A treasure addict's headwear. Even now, he sails the seas in search of a lost fortune.

name: F Monqlo Cap
description: A cap from everyone's favorite brand, Monqlo! #1 on the sales charts!
description_de: Eine Kappe von jedermanns Lieblingsmarke, Monqlo! Ein absoluter Verkaufsschlager!
description_fr: La casquette officielle de la marque Monqlo ! Numéro 1 des ventes !
description_es: ¡Una gorra de nuestra marca preferida, Monqlo! ¡Número uno en ventas!
description_it: Berretto ufficiale di Monqlo. Numero uno delle classifiche di vendita.
description_zh: A cap from everyone's favorite brand, Monqlo! #1 on the sales charts!

name: F Baby Tiga Hat
description: Headgear based on a baby Tigrex. The only time it's okay to put your head in a Tigrex's mouth.
description_de: Auf einem Tigrex-Baby basierende Kopfbedeckung. Diesmal darfst du deinen Kopf ins Maul stecken.
description_fr: Casque basé sur la tête d'un bébé Tigrex. Le seul moment où l'on peut mettre la tête dans sa gueule.
description_es: Cubrecabeza inspirado en un cachorro de Tigrex. ¿Te atreves a meter la cabeza en su boca?
description_it: Copricapo ispirato a un cucciolo di Tigrex. L'unico Tigrex che ispira tenerezza.
description_zh: Headgear based on a baby Tigrex. The only time it's okay to put your head in a Tigrex's mouth.

name: F Postman Beret
description: A perfect replica of the Courier's hat. Its horn has been disabled to avoid bothering the neighbors.
description_de: Perfekte Replik der Kuriermütze. Das Horn wurde deaktiviert, um keine Nachbarn zu stören.
description_fr: Réplique parfaite du chapeau du Messager. Son klaxon ne marche plus pour ne pas gêner les voisins.
description_es: Réplica exacta de un sombrero de mensajero. La bocina no funciona para no molestar a los vecinos.
description_it: Cappello da corriere. Il corno è silenziato per non disturbare i vicini.
description_zh: A perfect replica of the Courier's hat. Its horn has been disabled to avoid bothering the neighbors.

name: F Booyah Pompadour
description: A hairstyle for a man's man. Its blond locks exude power and confidence...for a wig.
description_de: Die Frisur eines echten Mannes. Die blonden Locken strahlen Zu- versicht aus... für eine Perücke.
description_fr: Coupe de cheveux pour les hommes, les vrais. Elle en impose vraiment... pour une perruque.
description_es: Peinado para hombre. Sus rizos rubios ofrecen una fuerza impropia para una peluca.
description_it: Acconciatura virile. Sebbene sia una parrucca, dona forza e sicurezza.
description_zh: A hairstyle for a man's man. Its blond locks exude power and confidence...for a wig.

name: F Sohoku Helmet
description: The helmet of a boy who rose against adversity. The glasses put a smile on one's face.
description_de: Der Helm eines Jungen, der sich Widrigkeiten gestellt hat. Die Brille bringt jeden zum Lächeln.
description_fr: Le casque d'un garçon qui a su s'élever face à l'adversité. Les lunettes donnent le sourire.
description_es: Casco de un niño que creció ante la adversidad. Las gafas ponen una sonrisa en la cara.
description_it: Casco di un ragazzo che ha superato le avversità. Gli occhiali trasmettono gioia.
description_zh: The helmet of a boy who rose against adversity. The glasses put a smile on one's face.

name: F Dark Meowgic Hood
description: A black hood worn by a mage who won many duels alongside his master. Tinged with mystery.
description_de: Schwarze Kapuze, getragen von einem Magier, der viele Duelle an Seiten des Meister gewann.
description_fr: Mystérieuse capuche noire ayant appartenu à un mage qui a remporté de nombreux duels.
description_es: Misteriosa capucha negra usada por un mago que ganó muchos duelos junto a su maestro.
description_it: Cappuccio misterioso di un mago che vinse molti duelli insieme al suo maestro.
description_zh: A black hood worn by a mage who won many duels alongside his master. Tinged with mystery.

name: F Booty Crown J
description: A crown found at the end of a long journey. Its decorations speak to the item's value.
description_de: Am Ende einer langen Reise gefundene Krone. Ihre Deko beweist ihren Wert.
description_fr: Couronne trouvée au terme d'un long périple. Ses décorations attestent de sa grande valeur.
description_es: Corona hallada al final de un largo viaje. Sus decoraciones hablan de su valor.
description_it: Corona rinvenuta dopo un lungo viaggio. Decorata con oggetti di valore.
description_zh: A crown found at the end of a long journey. Its decorations speak to the item's value.

name: F Buccaneer Bandanna J
description: A bold, crimson bandanna, said to sharpen one's nose for tracking down treasure.
description_de: Verwegenes rotes Kopftuch. Verleiht angeblich ein gutes Näschen für Schätze.
description_fr: Bandana rouge censé affûter l'aptitude de son porteur à dénicher des trésors.
description_es: Un atrevido pañuelo carmesí del que se dice que afila el olfato buscatesoros.
description_it: Dicono che questa bandana rossa migliori il fiuto per i tesori.
description_zh: A bold, crimson bandanna, said to sharpen one's nose for tracking down treasure.

name: F King Helm J
description: A slice of "yo-ho-ho!" that makes Palicoes as jovial as the lord of the Seven Seas.
description_de: Etwas "jo-ho-ho!" macht Kameraden fröhlich wie den Herrn der sieben Meere.
description_fr: Rend votre compagnon aussi jovial que le maître des sept mers.
description_es: Un casco piratesco con el que los camaradas se sienten señores de los siete mares.
description_it: Un capo allegro che rende i compagni gioviali come il signore dei sette mari.
description_zh: A slice of "yo-ho-ho!" that makes Palicoes as jovial as the lord of the Seven Seas.

name: F Avaricious Skull J
description: A treasure addict's headwear. Even now, he sails the seas in search of a lost fortune.
description_de: Kopfbedeckung eines Schatz- süchtigen, der auf seiner Suche die Welt umsegelt.
description_fr: Masque d'un accro aux trésors qui parcourt encore les mers en quête d'un butin caché.
description_es: Prenda para los adictos a los tesoros. Incluso ahora sigue navegando buscando fortunas.
description_it: Copricapo di un cacciatore di tesori alla continua ricerca di ricchezze perdute.
description_zh: A treasure addict's headwear. Even now, he sails the seas in search of a lost fortune.

name: F Monqlo Cap S
description: A cap from everyone's favorite brand, Monqlo! #1 on the sales charts!
description_de: Eine Kappe von jedermanns Lieblingsmarke, Monqlo! Ein absoluter Verkaufsschlager!
description_fr: La casquette officielle de la marque Monqlo ! Numéro 1 des ventes !
description_es: ¡Una gorra de nuestra marca preferida, Monqlo! ¡Número uno en ventas!
description_it: Berretto ufficiale di Monqlo. Numero uno delle classifiche di vendita.
description_zh: A cap from everyone's favorite brand, Monqlo! #1 on the sales charts!

name: F Link Mask
description: Headwear designed after that of a courageous boy. Houses the wisdom to face all challenges.
description_de: Kopfbedeckung im Design eines mutigen Jungen, mit der man sich Herausforderungen stellen kann.
description_fr: Masque réalisé sur le modèle de celui d'un garçon très courageux. Permet de relever tous les défis.
description_es: Cubrecabeza inspirado en un niño muy valiente. Aloja sabiduría para afrontar cualquier reto.
description_it: Copricapo di un eroe coraggioso. Consente di superare ogni avversità.
description_zh: Headwear designed after that of a courageous boy. Houses the wisdom to face all challenges.

name: F Fox Mic
description: A mic used by a brave galactic pilot. Or at least, a very good replica. "All aircraft repurrt!"
description_de: Von einem tapferen Piloten genutztes Mikrofon. Oder ein richtig guter Nachbau.
description_fr: Micro utilisé par un courageux pilote intergalactique. Ou du moins, sa fidèle reproduction.
description_es: Micro usado por un valiente piloto galáctico. O al menos se le parece mucho. Probando...
description_it: Microfono da pilota. In realtà è solo una copia. "Velivoli a rrrapporto!".
description_zh: A mic used by a brave galactic pilot. Or at least, a very good replica. "All aircraft repurrt!"

name: F Mario Cap
description: A red cap belonging to the world's most famous plumber. Includes a rad 'stache, too!
description_de: Die rote Mütze des welt- berühmten Klempners. Ein Schnurrbart ist auch dabei!
description_fr: Casquette rouge du plombier le plus célèbre au monde. Moustache incluse !
description_es: La gorra roja del fontanero más famoso del mundo. ¡Con bigote incluido!
description_it: Il cappello rosso dell'idraulico più famoso al mondo. I baffi sono inclusi!
description_zh: A red cap belonging to the world's most famous plumber. Includes a rad 'stache, too!

name: F Luigi Cap
description: A green cap belonging to the world's other most famous plumber. 'Stache included!
description_de: Die grüne Mütze des anderen weltberühmten Klempners. Schnurrbart inklusive!
description_fr: Casquette verte du deuxième plombier le plus célèbre au monde. Moustache incluse !
description_es: La gorra verde del segundo fontanero más famoso del mundo. ¡Bigote incluido!
description_it: Il cappello verde del secondo idraulico più famoso al mondo. Baffi inclusi!
description_zh: A green cap belonging to the world's other most famous plumber. 'Stache included!

name: F Helm of Purrity
description: Helm fashioned after one worn by the Palico of Purrity. The crystals protect the wearer.
description_de: Helm, inspiriert von dem des Schnurr-Kameraden. Kristalle beschützen den Träger.
description_fr: Forgé d'après l'armure du Palico de la Pureté. Le cristal protège son porteur.
description_es: Yelmo semejante a uno utilizado por el camarada de la luz. Los cristales protegen al portador.
description_it: Ispirato agli elmi indossati dai compagni della luce. I suoi cristalli proteggono i Felyne.
description_zh: Helm fashioned after one worn by the Palico of Purrity. The crystals protect the wearer.

name: F Chun Chignon
description: Pure white buns that protect the sensitive ears of a Palico. Very cute design.
description_de: Fasertief reine weiße Schützer für die empfindlichen Ohren eines Kameraden.
description_fr: Des petits chignons blancs adorables qui protègent les oreilles sensibles du Palico.
description_es: Recubrimiento de tela blanca para proteger las delicadas orejitas de un camarada. Un diseño precioso.
description_it: Proteggono le sensibili orecchie dei tuoi compagni. Molto carini.
description_zh: Pure white buns that protect the sensitive ears of a Palico. Very cute design.

name: F Dante Wig
description: Silver-colored wig worn by a stylish Palico renowned for its hunting skills. It's showtime!
description_de: Silberne Perücke, von einem schnittigen, für seine Jagdkunst bekannten Kameraden getragen.
description_fr: Une perruque argentée portée par un Palico célèbre pour son élégance. Showtime !
description_es: Peluca plateada, llevada por un camarada con estilo y famoso por sus dotes de caza.
description_it: Parrucca argentea indossata da un compagno famoso per il suo stile.
description_zh: Silver-colored wig worn by a stylish Palico renowned for its hunting skills. It's showtime!

name: F Mega Helmet
description: The helmet worn by a little robot unafraid to face mad scientists if it could save the future.
description_de: Der Helm eines kleinen Roboters, der furchtlos gegen irre Wissen- schaftler kämpft.
description_fr: Le casque porté par les petits robots prêts à affronter les savants fous pour le bien de tous.
description_es: Casco usado por un robot sin miedo a enfrentarse a científicos locos si hiciera falta.
description_it: Casco indossato da un robot che non teme di sfidare gli scienziati folli.
description_zh: The helmet worn by a little robot unafraid to face mad scientists if it could save the future.

name: F Melodic Curls
description: Elegant, flowing locks and whiskers that look just like musical notes.
description_de: Locken und Schnurrhaare, so elegant und fließend wie Musiknoten.
description_fr: Boucles et moustaches souples et élégantes ressemblant à des notes de musique.
description_es: Rizos y bigotes elegantes que parecen notas musicales.
description_it: Baffi e chiome fluenti dal taglio elegante che ricordano note musicali.
description_zh: Elegant, flowing locks and whiskers that look just like musical notes.

name: F Baby Tiga Hat S
name_fr: Chapeau de bébé Tiga F S
description: Headgear based on a baby Tigrex. The only time it's okay to put your head in a Tigrex's mouth.
description_de: Auf einem Tigrex-Baby basierende Kopfbedeckung. Diesmal darfst du deinen Kopf ins Maul stecken.
description_fr: Casque basé sur la tête d'un bébé Tigrex. Le seul moment où l'on peut mettre la tête dans sa gueule.
description_es: Cubrecabeza inspirado en un cachorro de Tigrex. ¿Te atreves a meter la cabeza en su boca?
description_it: Copricapo ispirato a un cucciolo di Tigrex. L'unico Tigrex che ispira tenerezza.
description_zh: Headgear based on a baby Tigrex. The only time it's okay to put your head in a Tigrex's mouth.

name: F Sunsnug Mask
description: A mask based on a Felyne that lives in a legendary village. Talk about culture shock!
description_de: Eine Maske, basierend auf einer Felyne, die in einem legendären Dorf lebt. Kulturschock pur!
description_fr: Masque basé sur un Felyne d'un village légendaire. Bonjour le choc des cultures !
description_es: Máscara basada en un Felyne que vive en esta aldea legendaria. ¡Un auténtico choque de culturas!
description_it: Ispirata a un Felyne che vive in un leggendario villaggio. Paese che vai...
description_zh: A mask based on a Felyne that lives in a legendary village. Talk about culture shock!

name: F Meowniac's Mask
description: Headgear that turns you into Meowniac, the Monster Hunter fan club mascot.
description_de: Kopfbedeckung, um Manya zu werden - das Maskottchen des "Monster Hunter"-Fanclubs.
description_fr: Transforme son porteur en Miaouniak, mascotte du Monster Hunter Fan Club.
description_es: Máscara que te convierte en Miauníaco, la mascota del club de fans de cazadores.
description_it: Trasformati in Miaoniaco, la mascotte ufficiale del fan club di Monster Hunter.
description_zh: Headgear that turns you into Meowniac, the Monster Hunter fan club mascot.

name: F Pep Squad Cap
description: A wild hat the fan club's pep squad uses to encourage hunters in any situation.
description_de: Ein wilder Hut des Fanclub- Anfeuerungstrupps, der Jägern in jeder Situation Mut gibt.
description_fr: Chapeau étrange porté pour encourager les chasseurs en toute situation.
description_es: Sombrero bestial que usan los fans del grupo de animadores para apoyar a los cazadores.
description_it: Un fantastico cappello usato dai tifosi del fan club per incitare i cacciatori.
description_zh: A wild hat the fan club's pep squad uses to encourage hunters in any situation.

name: F Giaprey Helm
description: A snuggly hat for out in the snow. The fluffy material is as soft as can be.
description_de: Fühlt sich gut an und wärmt auch bei heftigen Schneefällen noch.
description_fr: Un casque qui tient bien chaud. Très douillet, il est d'un confort incomparable.
description_es: Casco ideal para la nieve. De tacto mullido y suave, tiene gran calidad.
description_it: Copricapo capace di scaldare anche la neve, fatto di materiale soffice al tatto.
description_zh: A snuggly hat for out in the snow. The fluffy material is as soft as can be.

name: F Conga Steeple
description: A pointed hat whose proud, pink puff makes a Palico feel pretty darned special.
description_de: Spitzer Hut mit rosa Quaste, damit sich der Kamerad als etwas ganz Besonderes fühlt.
description_fr: Chapeau pointu dont la fière houppe rose enhardit le Palico qui le porte.
description_es: Un sombrero picudo cuyo pompón rosa hace que el camarada se sienta divino.
description_it: Cappello lungo con una punta rosa sbarazzina che fa sentire speciale il tuo compagno.
description_zh: A pointed hat whose proud, pink puff makes a Palico feel pretty darned special.

name: F Barroth Helm
description: Outstanding head armor that transforms the wearer into a rock-solid baby Barroth.
description_de: Hervorragender Kopfschutz, der einen zum beinharten Baby-Barroth werden lässt.
description_fr: Casque remarquable qui transforme son porteur en un solide bébé Barroth.
description_es: Casco espectacular que convierte al portador en una cría de Barroth.
description_it: Elmo meraviglioso che trasforma chi lo indossa in un cucciolo di Barroth.
description_zh: Outstanding head armor that transforms the wearer into a rock-solid baby Barroth.

name: F Pleasant Ribbons
description: The Meowstress's hair. A faithful copy of her do, so you'll look just like her!
description_de: Der Frisur der Miausterin nachempfunden. Damit siehst du genauso aus wie sie!
description_fr: Permet de ressembler à Felyndra comme deux gouttes d'eau.
description_es: Tocado para convertirse en Miauestra. Es igualito al de la verdadera.
description_it: Protezione essenziale per una vera miadama, riprodotta fin nei minimi dettagli.
description_zh: The Meowstress's hair. A faithful copy of her do, so you'll look just like her!

name: F Wisdom Hat
description: A splendid hat worn by the Wyventurer. Filled with the spirit of inquiry.
description_de: Diesen prächtigen Hut trägt auch der Wyventeurer. Steckt voller Forschergeist.
description_fr: Chapeau similaire à celui du Wyventurier. Imbu de sa soif de savoir.
description_es: Pieza de cabeza propia del Wyventurero. Querrás ponerte a explorar.
description_it: Splendido copricapo in stile wyvventuriero.
description_zh: A splendid hat worn by the Wyventurer. Filled with the spirit of inquiry.

name: F Basarios Helm
description: Rock-hard head armor. The Palico's pointy ears wreck an otherwise viable disguise.
description_de: Steinharter Kopfschutz. Die spitzen Kameradenohren ver- raten die sonst gute Tarnung.
description_fr: Casque incassable. Seules les oreilles pointues du Palico gâchent ce camouflage.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza durísima. Un disfraz perfecto, excepto por las orejas puntiagudas.
description_it: Elmo duro come roccia. Le orecchie a punta dal compagno ne tradiscono il travestimento.
description_zh: Rock-hard head armor. The Palico's pointy ears wreck an otherwise viable disguise.

name: F Scylla Mask
description: A mask that covers the head. The opaque goggles are too cool for Palico school.
description_de: Maske, die den Kopf bedeckt. Die dunkle Brille steigert die Kameraden-Coolness.
description_fr: Masque couvrant la tête. Les lunettes donnent une classe folle à votre compagnon.
description_es: Pieza de cabeza hecha con partes de araña sombría. Para camaradas elegantes.
description_it: Maschera di scarti Nerscylla. Le lenti opache sono un tocco di classe.
description_zh: A mask that covers the head. The opaque goggles are too cool for Palico school.

name: F Cheerful Cap
description: Headwear for your Palico reminiscent of the Soaratorium Gal. A youthful hat with a fresh design.
description_de: Dem Hut der Aerotorium-Mädel nachempfunden. Lässt Kameraden frisch und jugendlich aussehen.
description_fr: Inspiré de la tenue de la Demoiselle Aérolabo, il a un côté rafraîchissant.
description_es: Prenda para la cabeza inspirada en el uniforme de la chica del Flotatorio. Su diseño es muy original.
description_it: Cappello per i compagni che riproduce lo stile della dama del solcacieli.
description_zh: Headwear for your Palico reminiscent of the Soaratorium Gal. A youthful hat with a fresh design.

name: F Mariner Hood
description: Headwear worn by Tanzia Gong Girls. The hat ribbon completes the look.
description_de: Kopfbedeckung der Tanzia- Gong-Mädel. Das Band an der Haube ist ein echter Hingucker.
description_fr: Basée sur l'uniforme de la Fille du gong Tanzia. Le ruban fait tout son charme.
description_es: Prenda para la cabeza usada por las chicas del gong de Tanzia. El lazo le da el punto perfecto.
description_it: Copricapo in stile donzella del gong di Tanzia. Il fiocco è adorabile.
description_zh: Headwear worn by Tanzia Gong Girls. The hat ribbon completes the look.

name: F Barioth Helm
description: Head armor made from a snow- field predator. So regal, it calms crying children.
description_de: Kopfschutz aus Schneefeld- jäger. So königlich, dass er weinende Kinder beruhigt.
description_fr: À base d'un prédateur des neiges. Si majestueux qu'il calme les pleurs d'enfants.
description_es: Fabricado con un depredador de las nieves. Tan regio que calma a los niños.
description_it: Elmo ricavato dal predatore delle nevi. Così regale da placare il pianto dei bimbi.
description_zh: Head armor made from a snow- field predator. So regal, it calms crying children.

name: F Grav Mask
description: Gloomy headwear that glows from beneath with magma. Lets one navigate toxic gases.
description_de: Düstere Kopfbedeckung, in der Magma leuchtet. Mit ihr kann man Giftgas durchschreiten.
description_fr: Masque funeste dégageant une lueur magmatique. Neutralise les gaz toxiques.
description_es: Máscara sombría que brilla como el magma. Protege de los gases tóxicos.
description_it: Copricapo tetro che emana il bagliore del magma. Protegge dai gas tossici.
description_zh: Gloomy headwear that glows from beneath with magma. Lets one navigate toxic gases.

name: F Diablos Helm
description: Horns full of fighting spirit. In a world of prey, be the predator.
description_de: Ein Helm voll Kampfesmut. Sei in einer Welt voll Beute der Jäger.
description_fr: Corne imprégnée de combativité. Devenez le prédateur.
description_es: Pieza de cabeza de partes de Diablos. No se rompe ni en las más cruentas batallas.
description_it: Copricapo con corno di Diablos, il dominatore delle Piane sabbiose.
description_zh: Horns full of fighting spirit. In a world of prey, be the predator.

name: F Valstrax Helm
description: Head armor for those with the courage to face calamity. It twinkles like the stars.
description_de: Für Helden, die jeder Gefahr trotzen. Glänzt, als sei er aus Sternen geschmiedet.
description_fr: Porté par ceux qui affrontent le Mal, il brille comme s'il était fait d'étoiles.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza para grandes héroes. Brilla como las estrellas.
description_it: Copricapo per chi affronta le calamità. Rilascia un bagliore ultraterreno.
description_zh: Head armor for those with the courage to face calamity. It twinkles like the stars.

name: F Acorn Helm X
description: Entry-level Felyne Palico head armor. The look that defined a generation!
description_de: Felyne-Kameraden-Kopfschutz für Einsteiger. Der Look einer ganzen Generation!
description_fr: Coiffe Felyne basique pour Palico. Le style de toute une génération !
description_es: Armadura de cabeza básica de los camaradas Felyne. ¡Típica de toda una generación!
description_it: Elmo di base per compagni Felyne. Il suo stile ha fatto epoca!
description_zh: Entry-level Felyne Palico head armor. The look that defined a generation!

name: F Bherna Hood X
description: A hat that snugly swaddles the head in protective fabrics. Great for highland work.
description_de: Ein Hut, dessen Stoff den Kopf schützend umhüllt. Ideal für Hochland-Arbeit.
description_fr: Chapeau couvrant la tête de tissus protecteurs. Idéal pour les missions en montagne.
description_es: Pieza de cabeza típica de Bherna ideal para moverse por sus llanuras.
description_it: Pratico copricapo avvolgente in tessuto protettivo. Ideale per le attività montane.
description_zh: A hat that snugly swaddles the head in protective fabrics. Great for highland work.

name: F Gourmet Toque X
description: A chef's hat that matches that of the Gourmew Chef's, right down to its size.
description_de: Eine Kochhaube wie die des Gourmiau-Kochs, sogar in derselben Größe.
description_fr: Toque semblable en tout point à celle du célèbre chef Gourmiaou.
description_es: Gorro de cocinero inspirado en el del Chef Gourmiáu hasta en la talla.
description_it: Cappello da cuoco ispirato a quello dello chef Gourmiao, anche nelle dimensioni.
description_zh: A chef's hat that matches that of the Gourmew Chef's, right down to its size.

name: F Moofy Head X
description: A helmet that looks just like a baby Moofah. Long neck not included.
description_de: Ein Helm, der wie ein Baby- Muufah aussieht. Langer Hals nicht inbegriffen.
description_fr: Casque ressemblant à un bébé Moofah... sans son long cou.
description_es: Tocado para vestirte de cría de Moofah. Aunque el cuello es más corto.
description_it: Elmo che riproduce le fattezze di un cucciolo di Moofah, tranne il collo allungato.
description_zh: A helmet that looks just like a baby Moofah. Long neck not included.

name: F Aptonoth Mask X
description: While handy for Aptonoth cosplaying, this mask also protects the face well.
description_de: Eine Maske zum Verkleiden als Aptonoth, die aber auch das Gesicht schützt.
description_fr: Masque idéal pour se déguiser en Aptonoth, qui protège en outre très bien le visage.
description_es: Para disfrazarse de Aptonoth. Además, protege la cara.
description_it: Un perfetto travestimento da Aptonoth, nonché un'efficace protezione per il volto.
description_zh: While handy for Aptonoth cosplaying, this mask also protects the face well.

name: F Popo Head X
description: These handy tusks work well at scaring off potential predators on the prowl.
description_de: Diese praktischen Hauer vertreiben problemlos umherstreifende Raubtiere.
description_fr: Défenses très pratiques permettant d'effrayer d'éventuels prédateurs.
description_es: Colmillos útiles para asustar a posibles depredadores que merodeen por ahí.
description_it: Le sue zanne terranno alla larga i predatori alla ricerca di cibo.
description_zh: These handy tusks work well at scaring off potential predators on the prowl.

name: F Gargwa Mask X
description: A bird mask that whips up carnivores' appetites. Has high Dragon Resistance.
description_de: Diese Vogelmaske regt den Appetit von Fleischfressern an. Hohe Drachenabwehr.
description_fr: Masque d'oiseau qui donne faim aux carnivores. Bonne résistance aux dragons.
description_es: Su forma de pájaro despierta el apetito a los carnívoros. Resistencia alta al draco.
description_it: Maschera da uccello che attira i carnivori. Fornisce alta resistenza al drago.
description_zh: A bird mask that whips up carnivores' appetites. Has high Dragon Resistance.

name: F Larinoth Mask X
description: This mask's lofty face makes it impossible to tell where the wearer's eyes are.
description_de: Das erhabene Gesicht dieser Maske verbirgt die Augen ihres Trägers voll und ganz.
description_fr: Masque aux traits dédaigneux qui empêche de voir les yeux de son porteur.
description_es: El rostro de esta máscara no permite saber dónde están los ojos del portador.
description_it: La forma allungata di questa maschera nasconde gli occhi di chi la indossa.
description_zh: This mask's lofty face makes it impossible to tell where the wearer's eyes are.

name: F Alloy Helm X
description: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Guaranteed head protection.
description_de: Gefertigt aus Edelerz in drei arbeitsreichen Nächten. Kopfschutz garantiert.
description_fr: Casque en alliage de qualité, qui a nécessité trois nuits de dur labeur et protège bien la tête.
description_es: Un producto de metal de calidad y tres días de trabajo. Su cabeza, a salvo.
description_it: Forgiato con metalli di qualità in tre notti di lavoro. Assicura protezione alla testa.
description_zh: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Guaranteed head protection.

name: F Bone Helm X
description: Head armor made out of a monster skull. Awakens a Palico's wild side.
description_de: Kopfschutz aus einem Monsterschädel. Weckt die Wildheit in jedem Kameraden.
description_fr: Fabriqué à partir d'un crâne de monstre. Révèle le côté sauvage d'un Palico.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza hecha con el cráneo de un monstruo. Para el camarada más salvaje.
description_it: Elmo ricavato da un teschio di mostro. Risveglia il lato selvaggio dei compagni.
description_zh: Head armor made out of a monster skull. Awakens a Palico's wild side.

name: F Alta Hat X
description: There isn't a better friend in the fight against bright sunlight than this hat!
description_de: Es gibt keinen besseren Schutz vor der gleißenden Sonne als diesen Hut!
description_fr: Chapeau sans pareil pour résister aux assauts impitoyables de l'astre solaire !
description_es: ¡No hay mejor amigo contra los rayos del sol que este sombrero!
description_it: Questo cappello è l'alleato ideale per difendersi dai raggi del sole!
description_zh: There isn't a better friend in the fight against bright sunlight than this hat!

name: F Bnaha Cap X
description: Head armor that alleviates the sun's rays AND Dragon and Thunder attacks.
description_de: Dieser Kopfschutz fängt Sonnenstrahlen, Drachen- und Donnerangriffe ab.
description_fr: Protège contre les rayons du soleil ET les attaques de dragon et de foudre.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza que protege contra el sol, ataques de draco y de rayo.
description_it: Elmo che protegge dal sole e dagli attacchi drago e tuono.
description_zh: Head armor that alleviates the sun's rays AND Dragon and Thunder attacks.

name: F Jaggi Helm X
description: Popular head armor made from supple Great Jaggi hide. Affords reliable protection.
description_de: Beliebter Kopfschutz aus weicher Großjaggi-Haut. Bietet zuverlässigen Schutz.
description_fr: Casque populaire à base de cuir souple de Grand Jaggi. Protège efficacement.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza popular hecha de piel de Gran Jaggi. Protección fiable.
description_it: Elmo ricavato dalla pelle elastica del Gran Jaggi. Protezione a basso costo.
description_zh: Popular head armor made from supple Great Jaggi hide. Affords reliable protection.

name: F Rheno Helm X
description: High-tech head armor that fuses metal to Rhenoplos shell. Note the cute face.
description_de: Hightech-Kopfschutz, der Metall an Rhenoplos-Panzer schmiedet. Überaus niedlich.
description_fr: Casque high-tech en métal et carapace de Rhenoplos. N'est-il pas adorable ?
description_es: Casco de alta tecnología que combina metal y corazas de Rhenoplos. Y es adorable.
description_it: Sofisticato elmo di gusci di Rhenoplos e metallo. Dona un'aria simpatica.
description_zh: High-tech head armor that fuses metal to Rhenoplos shell. Note the cute face.

name: F Slagtoth Hood X
description: Hide head armor marketed as a "rainy day requisite." Strong against Water.
description_de: Als "ein Muss bei Regen" beworbener Leder-Kopfschutz. Schützt gut vor Wasser.
description_fr: Indispensable en cas de pluie, cette capuche en peau protège de l'eau.
description_es: Armadura de piel para cabeza, perfecta para los días de lluvia. Protege del agua.
description_it: Elmo di pelle che protegge dalla pioggia. Resistente all'acqua.
description_zh: Hide head armor marketed as a "rainy day requisite." Strong against Water.

name: F Maccao Helm X
description: A stylish feathered helm that takes proper fashion sense to wear well.
description_de: Ein eleganter Helm mit Federn, den nur echte Mode- liebhaber zu tragen wissen.
description_fr: Heaume à plumes élégant, accessoire indispensable des inconditionnels de la mode.
description_es: Elegante sombrero emplumado; solo para quien sepa llevarlo con gracia.
description_it: Elegante elmo piumato che richiede un degno portamento per essere indossato con stile.
description_zh: A stylish feathered helm that takes proper fashion sense to wear well.

name: F Velociprey Helm X
description: A hat that folds up nice and cleanly. Tailor-made for the best fit.
description_de: Ein perfekt zusammenfaltbarer Hut. Maßgeschneidert für einen optimalen Sitz.
description_fr: Heaume qui se plie facilement, fait sur mesure pour un confort optimal.
description_es: Sombrero fácil de doblar. Hecho a medida para que quede perfecto.
description_it: Cappello dalle linee semplici. Confezionato su misura per garantire la massima comodità.
description_zh: A hat that folds up nice and cleanly. Tailor-made for the best fit.

name: F Bulldrome Mask X
description: Head armor that looks ready to charge off one's head. Creates a small stink radius.
description_de: Kopfschutz, der aussieht, als wäre er angriffsbereit. Erzeugt kleinen Stinkradius.
description_fr: Semble prêt à charger sa proie. Entoure son porteur d'un halo nauséabond.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza que parece lista para embestir. Apesta un poco.
description_it: Elmo che sembra pronto a lanciarsi all'attacco. Ti circonda di olezzo.
description_zh: Head armor that looks ready to charge off one's head. Creates a small stink radius.

name: F Arzuros Helm X
description: Head armor that was nearly discontinued after wearers were mistaken for Arzuros.
description_de: Diesen Kopfschutz hätte man fast abgeschafft, weil man Träger für Arzuros hielt.
description_fr: Ses porteurs étant souvent confondus avec Arzuros, sa production a failli cesser.
description_es: Cayó en desuso porque confundían a sus portadores con auténticos Arzuros.
description_it: Elmo quasi bandito per l'eccessiva somiglianza ai veri Arzuros.
description_zh: Head armor that was nearly discontinued after wearers were mistaken for Arzuros.

name: F Giaprey Helm X
description: A snuggly hat for out in the snow. The fluffy material is as soft as can be.
description_de: Ein Hut aus kuschlig weichen Materialien, die im Schnee wunderbar warm halten.
description_fr: Un casque qui tient bien chaud. Très douillet, il est d'un confort incomparable.
description_es: Casco ideal para la nieve. De tacto mullido y suave, tiene gran calidad.
description_it: Copricapo capace di scaldare anche la neve, fatto di materiale soffice al tatto.
description_zh: A snuggly hat for out in the snow. The fluffy material is as soft as can be.

name: F Genprey Helm X
description: A soft, comfy cap that can be worn all sorts of ways, but best with one end up.
description_de: Eine weiche, bequeme Kappe, die vielseitig tragbar ist, am besten mit einem Ende oben.
description_fr: Calot doux et confortable, qui se porte de mille façons. Encore plus seyant avec un côté relevé.
description_es: Una gorra suave, cómoda y muy versátil; recomendamos levantar un extremo.
description_it: Cappello morbido indossabile in più modi, ma che rende al meglio con la punta all'insù.
description_zh: A soft, comfy cap that can be worn all sorts of ways, but best with one end up.

name: F Lagombi Helm X
description: Fur head armor that keeps the wearer's face warm even in sub-zero temperatures.
description_de: Pelz-Kopfschutz, der das Gesicht des Trägers selbst bei Minusgraden warm hält.
description_fr: Casque en fourrure qui garde le visage au chaud même par des températures négatives.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza de piel. Mantiene caliente la cara del portador.
description_it: Elmo di pelliccia che tiene al caldo la testa anche alle basse temperature.
description_zh: Fur head armor that keeps the wearer's face warm even in sub-zero temperatures.

name: F Cephalos Hat X
description: Cephalos headwear with a scarlet ribbon. Full of hope (and food, if hope fails).
description_de: Cephalos-Kopfbedeckung mit rotem Band. Voller Hoffnung (und wenn nötig auch Essen).
description_fr: Couvre-chef Cephalos, à ruban écarlate. Porteur d'espoir (voire de nourriture, au besoin).
description_es: Sombrero de Cephalos con cinta escarlata. Cargado de esperanza (¡y de comida!).
description_it: Copricapo con nastro rosso. È carico di speranza (e cibo, se la speranza non è sufficiente).
description_zh: Cephalos headwear with a scarlet ribbon. Full of hope (and food, if hope fails).

name: F Kut-Ku Mask X
description: A delightful take on the Yian Kut-Ku... Delightful, or just plain creepy.
description_de: Bezaubernde Variante des Yian Kut-Ku. Bezaubernd... oder auch einfach schräg.
description_fr: S'inspire du Yian Kut-Ku. À la fois charmant et terrifiant.
description_es: Una encantadora versión del Yian Kut-Ku... Encantadora o simplemente espeluznante.
description_it: Un delizioso omaggio allo Yian Kut-Ku... Inquietante, più che delizioso.
description_zh: A delightful take on the Yian Kut-Ku... Delightful, or just plain creepy.

name: F Gypceros Crest X
description: August headwear with a wise gaze. The crest is said to glow when the gods return.
description_de: Erhabene Kopfbedeckung mit weisem Blick. Der Kamm glüht bei der Rückkehr der Götter.
description_fr: Masque auguste empreint de sagesse. Censé annoncer le retour des dieux.
description_es: Prenda que da un aire de sabiduría. Dicen que brillará cuando regresen los dioses.
description_it: Copricapo sontuoso che dona un'aria saggia. La cresta saluta raggiante il ritorno degli dei.
description_zh: August headwear with a wise gaze. The crest is said to glow when the gods return.

name: F Cabra Horn X
description: A beefy Tetsucabra horn and fluffy mane. Turns wearers into legendary fiends.
description_de: Ein kräftiges Tetsucabra-Horn mit flauschiger Mähne. Macht aus Trägern wahre Unholde.
description_fr: Corne à l'imposante crinière, qui fait de son porteur un adversaire de légende.
description_es: Recio cuerno y suave crin de Tetsucabra. Su portador es un poderoso enemigo.
description_it: Grosso corno di Tetsucabra con tanto di morbida criniera. Rende feroci come demoni.
description_zh: A beefy Tetsucabra horn and fluffy mane. Turns wearers into legendary fiends.

name: F Daimyo Mask X
description: Headwear made from red, durable plating. The Palico looks out through the mouth.
description_de: Kopfbedeckung aus robusten roten Platten. Der Kamerad schaut durch den Mund heraus.
description_fr: Solide masque de plaque rouge. Permet de voir à travers sa bouche.
description_es: Prenda con una coraza roja y resistente. El camarada ve a través de la boca.
description_it: Copricapo di corazza rossa. La feritoia per gli occhi si trova nella bocca.
description_zh: Headwear made from red, durable plating. The Palico looks out through the mouth.

name: F Ludroth Helm X
description: Solid head armor whose spongy Royal Ludroth bits boost Water Resistance.
description_de: Schwammartiger Kopfschutz, dessen Königs-Ludroth-Teile Wasser abweisen.
description_fr: À base d'éléments de Ludroth royal qui améliorent la résistance à l'eau.
description_es: Yelmo con fragmentos de Ludroth Real que mejoran la resistencia al agua.
description_it: Elmo robusto che protegge dall'acqua grazie alle parti spugnose di Ludroth reale.
description_zh: Solid head armor whose spongy Royal Ludroth bits boost Water Resistance.

name: F Kecha Cap X
description: Woven head armor modeled after the hood worn by one of the Three Meowsketeers.
description_de: Gewobener Kopfschutz nach dem Vorbild der Kapuze einer der Drei Miausketiere.
description_fr: Coiffe tissée s'inspirant de la capuche portée par l'un des trois Miaousquetaires.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza que se parece a la capucha de uno de los tres miausqueteros.
description_it: Elmo intrecciato ispirato al cappuccio appartenuto a uno dei Tre Miaoschettieri.
description_zh: Woven head armor modeled after the hood worn by one of the Three Meowsketeers.

name: F Maiden Hood X
description: A hood modeled after the Kokoto Gal, designed with big ears in mind.
description_de: Eine Kapuze nach dem Vorbild des Kokoto-Mädels, für große Ohren entworfen.
description_fr: Capuchon inspiré par la demoiselle Kokoto. Conçu pour les grandes oreilles.
description_es: Capucha inspirada en la chica de Kokoto, diseñada para orejas grandes.
description_it: Cappuccio ispirato alla dama di Kokoto, di cui riprende le grosse orecchie.
description_zh: A hood modeled after the Kokoto Gal, designed with big ears in mind.

name: F Exquisite Toque
description: A Quest Counter favorite in Yukumo Village. Makes every hunter say, "Hire me!"
description_de: Favorit am Quest-Schalter des Yukumo-Dorfs. Lässt jeden Jäger "Heure mich an!" rufen.
description_fr: Favori du Comptoir des quêtes de Yukumo. Favorise les contrats.
description_es: Gusta mucho en el puesto de misiones de Yukumo. Hace que todos quieran contratarte.
description_it: Un indumento indossato dal personale del banco missioni di Yukumo per attirare cacciatori.
description_zh: A Quest Counter favorite in Yukumo Village. Makes every hunter say, "Hire me!"

name: F Ladybug Cap X
description: Head armor as cute as it is capable. Note the adorable feelers on the top.
description_de: Ein Kopfschutz, niedlich und stark. Beachte die reizenden Fühler ganz oben.
description_fr: Couvre-chef aussi adorable qu'efficace. Ses antennes sont du plus bel effet !
description_es: Armadura de cabeza monísima. ¡Fíjate en lo graciosas que son las antenas de arriba!
description_it: Elmo grazioso ed efficace. Da notare le sue piccole antenne.
description_zh: Head armor as cute as it is capable. Note the adorable feelers on the top.

name: F Odd Acorn Mask
description: The very first kind of mask Shakalaka children make. Makes you understand the mask-obsession.
description_de: Die erste Maske, die Shaka- laka-Kinder herstellen. Das erklärt ihren Maskenwahn.
description_fr: Premier masque fabriqué par les petits Shakalaka. On comprend leur obsession...
description_es: La primera máscara que fabrican los niños Shakalaka. Están obsesionados con ellas.
description_it: La prima maschera creata dai piccoli Shakalaka. Ne spiega l'ossessione per le maschere.
description_zh: The very first kind of mask Shakalaka children make. Makes you understand the mask-obsession.

name: F Odd Pincer Mask
description: A mask made of crab and coconut. Go claw-to-claw with rivals on the open sea!
description_de: Maske aus Krabben und Kokosnuss. Kämpfe Klaue gegen Klaue auf hoher See!
description_fr: Masque en carapace de crabe et noix de coco. Défiez vos rivaux au grand large.
description_es: Máscara hecha con cangrejos y cocos. ¡Para pelear con tus rivales en mar abierto!
description_it: Maschera ricavata da granchi e noci di cocco. Artiglia i nemici in mare aperto!
description_zh: A mask made of crab and coconut. Go claw-to-claw with rivals on the open sea!

name: F Lecturer's Hood X
description: Wear this hood, and just feel the monster smarts come pouring in!
description_de: Trage diese Kapuze, dann fällt dir das Monsterwissen einfach so in den Schoß!
description_fr: Capuchon conférant à son porteur une intelligence hors norme !
description_es: ¡Con este gorro, la sabiduría de los monstruos entra como si nada!
description_it: Indossa questo cappuccio per assorbire tutta l'astuzia del mostro!
description_zh: Wear this hood, and just feel the monster smarts come pouring in!

name: F Stone God Head
description: A mask based on a statue the Meownster Hunters found. Feels positively ancient.
description_de: Eine Maske nach einer von den Miaunster-Jägern gefundenen Statue. Fühlt sich steinalt an.
description_fr: Masque qui s'inspire d'une statue antique trouvée par les Chasseurs de miaonstres.
description_es: Inspirada en una estatua que encontraron los cazamiaunstruos. Parece muy antigua.
description_it: Maschera ricavata da una statua ritrovata dai cacciatori di miaostri. Ha un aspetto antico.
description_zh: A mask based on a statue the Meownster Hunters found. Feels positively ancient.

name: F Venombee Cap X
description: For cool cats too rad to take their sunglasses off indoors, look no further.
description_de: Ideal für alle, die zu cool sind, ihre Sonnenbrille drinnen abzusetzen.
description_fr: Calot idéal pour ceux qui rechignent à retirer leurs lunettes de soleil à l'intérieur.
description_es: Si no te quitas las gafas de sol ni para estar por casa, esto va a ser lo tuyo.
description_it: L'accessorio ideale per i duri che non si sfilano gli occhiali da sole neppure al buio.
description_zh: For cool cats too rad to take their sunglasses off indoors, look no further.

name: F Mosgharl Hat X
description: A get-up rascal Felynes use to spook villagers. Turns out it makes good armor, too!
description_de: Damit erschrecken die Felynen gerne Dorfbewohner. Eignet sich aber auch als Schutz!
description_fr: Permet à la fois de protéger la tête et de faire peur aux villageois.
description_es: Los Felyne más gamberros los usan para asustar a los aldeanos. Buena protección.
description_it: I monelli Felyne lo usano per spaventare i compaesani. È anche un'ottima difesa!
description_zh: A get-up rascal Felynes use to spook villagers. Turns out it makes good armor, too!

name: F Marauder Helm X
description: The helm of a Felyne who sought to rule all. The paw- print boosts Palico morale.
description_de: Der Helm einer Felyne, die alle beherrschen wollte. Der Abdruck fördert Kampfgeist.
description_fr: Casque de Felyne aux grandes ambitions. L'empreinte de patte donne du courage.
description_es: El casco de un Felyne que ansiaba gobernarlo todo. Las huellas suben la moral.
description_it: Elmo di un Felyne bramoso di potere. La zampa solleva il morale dei compagni.
description_zh: The helm of a Felyne who sought to rule all. The paw- print boosts Palico morale.

name: F Pleasant Ribbons X
description: The Meowstress's hair. A faithful copy of her do, so you'll look just like her!
description_de: Der Frisur der Miausterin nachempfunden. Damit siehst du genauso aus wie sie!
description_fr: Permet de ressembler à Felyndra comme deux gouttes d'eau.
description_es: Tocado para convertirse en Miauestra. Es igualito al de la verdadera.
description_it: Protezione essenziale per una vera miadama, riprodotta fin nei minimi dettagli.
description_zh: The Meowstress's hair. A faithful copy of her do, so you'll look just like her!

name: F Wisdom Hat X
description: A splendid hat worn by the Wyventurer. Filled with the spirit of inquiry.
description_de: Diesen prächtigen Hut trägt auch der Wyventeurer. Steckt voller Forschergeist.
description_fr: Chapeau similaire à celui du Wyventurier. Imbu de sa soif de savoir.
description_es: Pieza de cabeza propia del Wyventurero. Querrás ponerte a explorar.
description_it: Splendido copricapo in stile wyvventuriero.
description_zh: A splendid hat worn by the Wyventurer. Filled with the spirit of inquiry.

name: F Postman Beret X
description: A perfect replica of the Courier's hat. Its horn has been disabled to avoid bothering the neighbors.
description_de: Perfekte Replik der Kuriermütze. Das Horn wurde deaktiviert, um keine Nachbarn zu stören.
description_fr: Réplique parfaite du chapeau du Messager. Son klaxon ne marche plus pour ne pas gêner les voisins.
description_es: Réplica exacta de un sombrero de mensajero. La bocina no funciona para no molestar a los vecinos.
description_it: Cappello da corriere. Il corno è silenziato per non disturbare i vicini.
description_zh: A perfect replica of the Courier's hat. Its horn has been disabled to avoid bothering the neighbors.

name: F Ioprey Helm X
description: A hat that can't help but stand out. Ideal for playing pretend as a general.
description_de: Ein Hut, der aus der Menge heraussticht. Ideal, um sich als General auszugeben.
description_fr: Heaume impossible à ne pas remarquer, idéal pour jouer les généraux.
description_es: Llamativo sombrero, ideal para fingir ser general.
description_it: Copricapo che ti metterà al centro dell'attenzione. Ideale per fingersi un generale.
description_zh: A hat that can't help but stand out. Ideal for playing pretend as a general.

name: F Volvi Helm X
description: Shell armor revered as a bearer of Fire. Sells out before every festival.
description_de: Panzer-Schutz, verehrt als Träger des Feuers. Verkauft sich bestens vor Festivals.
description_fr: Ce casque porteur de feu fait l'objet d'un culte. Souvent en rupture de stock.
description_es: Armadura de caparazón del portador del fuego. Todos quieren uno para el festival.
description_it: Elmo di guscio posseduto dal fuoco. Va a ruba prima di ogni sagra.
description_zh: Shell armor revered as a bearer of Fire. Sells out before every festival.

name: F Basarios Helm X
description: Rock-hard head armor. The Palico's pointy ears wreck an otherwise viable disguise.
description_de: Steinharter Kopfschutz. Die spitzen Kameradenohren ver- raten die sonst gute Tarnung.
description_fr: Casque incassable. Seules les oreilles pointues du Palico gâchent ce camouflage.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza durísima. Un disfraz perfecto, excepto por las orejas puntiagudas.
description_it: Elmo duro come roccia. Le orecchie a punta dal compagno ne tradiscono il travestimento.
description_zh: Rock-hard head armor. The Palico's pointy ears wreck an otherwise viable disguise.

name: F Conga Steeple X
description: A pointed hat whose proud, pink puff makes a Palico feel pretty darned special.
description_de: Spitzer Hut mit rosa Quaste, damit sich der Kamerad als etwas ganz Besonderes fühlt.
description_fr: Chapeau pointu dont la fière houppe rose enhardit le Palico qui le porte.
description_es: Un sombrero picudo cuyo pompón rosa hace que el camarada se sienta divino.
description_it: Cappello lungo con una punta rosa sbarazzina che fa sentire speciale il tuo compagno.
description_zh: A pointed hat whose proud, pink puff makes a Palico feel pretty darned special.

name: F Barroth Helm X
description: Outstanding head armor that transforms the wearer into a rock-solid baby Barroth.
description_de: Hervorragender Kopfschutz, der einen zum beinharten Baby-Barroth werden lässt.
description_fr: Casque remarquable qui transforme son porteur en un solide bébé Barroth.
description_es: Casco espectacular que convierte al portador en una cría de Barroth.
description_it: Elmo meraviglioso che trasforma chi lo indossa in un cucciolo di Barroth.
description_zh: Outstanding head armor that transforms the wearer into a rock-solid baby Barroth.

name: F Khezu Catnurse X
description: Head armor that seems too cute to be Khezu. It's hard not to fall in love!
description_de: Kopfschutz, der fast zu süß ist, um aus Khezu zu sein. Man muss ihn einfach lieben!
description_fr: Semble trop mignon pour être à base de Khezu. Comment ne pas tomber sous le charme ?
description_es: Armadura de cabeza tan bonita que no parece hecha de Khezu. ¡Imposible no enamorarse!
description_it: Fin troppo grazioso per essere di Khezu. Non potrai non innamorartene!
description_zh: Head armor that seems too cute to be Khezu. It's hard not to fall in love!

name: F Nibel Helm X
description: Stealth head armor that prevents the climate from foiling Palico missions.
description_de: Tarn-Kopfschutz, der das Klima abhält, Kameraden- Missionen zu sabotieren.
description_fr: Casque de furtivité qui empêche le climat de déjouer les missions d'un compagnon.
description_es: Casco furtivo que evita que el clima fastidie una misión de los camaradas.
description_it: Elmo furtivo che impedisce al clima di ostacolare le missioni dei compagni.
description_zh: Stealth head armor that prevents the climate from foiling Palico missions.

name: F Malfestio Mask X
description: A mask made from Malfestio Scraps. Its eyes are more than a little eerie.
description_de: Eine Maske aus Malfestio- Resten. Die Augen sind mehr als furchterregend.
description_fr: Masque fabriqué à partir de débris Malfestio. Ses yeux sont plus qu'étranges.
description_es: Máscara fabricada con restos de Malfestio. Sus ojos son terriblemente espeluznantes.
description_it: Maschera ricavata da parti di Malfestio. Gli occhi sono decisamente inquietanti.
description_zh: A mask made from Malfestio Scraps. Its eyes are more than a little eerie.

name: F Rathian Helm X
description: A symbol of ferocity and pride that yields remarkable Defense and Fire resistance.
description_de: Ein Symbol von Wildheit und Stolz, mit bemerkenswerter Verteidigung u. Feuerabwehr.
description_fr: Symbole de férocité dont la défense et la résistance au feu sont remarquables.
description_es: Símbolo de ferocidad y de orgullo que aporta mucha defensa y resiste al fuego.
description_it: Simbolo di orgoglio e ferocia che migliora difesa e resistenza al fuoco.
description_zh: A symbol of ferocity and pride that yields remarkable Defense and Fire resistance.

name: F Blango Mask X
description: Dancing with this creepy mask on is thought to ward off evil spirits.
description_de: Das Tanzen mit dieser gruseligen Maske soll böse Geister abwehren.
description_fr: Masque terrifiant qui ferait fuir les mauvais esprits lorsque son porteur danse.
description_es: Se supone que bailar con esta tétrica máscara puesta asusta a los malos espíritus.
description_it: Chi danza con indosso questa orrenda maschera è in grado di scacciare gli spiriti maligni.
description_zh: Dancing with this creepy mask on is thought to ward off evil spirits.

name: F Ceanataur Mask X
description: The Shogun Ceanataur's angular head makes for a tight-fitting mask.
description_de: Aus dem kantigen Kopf des Shogun Ceanataur wird eine eng anliegende Maske.
description_fr: Masque très ajusté, fabriqué à partir de la tête anguleuse d'un Ceanataur Shogun.
description_es: La cabeza angular del Shogun Ceanataur es una máscara que se ajusta como un guante.
description_it: Maschera avvolgente ricavata dal cranio squadrato dello Shogun Ceanataur.
description_zh: The Shogun Ceanataur's angular head makes for a tight-fitting mask.

name: F Scylla Mask X
description: A mask that covers the head. Opaque goggles totally boost your Palico's cool factor.
description_de: Umfasst den gesamten Kopf. Die dunkle Brille gefällt modebewussten Kameraden.
description_fr: Masque couvrant la tête. Les lunettes donnent une classe folle à votre compagnon.
description_es: Pieza de cabeza hecha con partes de araña sombría. Para camaradas elegantes.
description_it: Maschera di scarti Nerscylla. Le lenti opache sono un tocco di classe.
description_zh: A mask that covers the head. Opaque goggles totally boost your Palico's cool factor.

name: F Naja Turban X
description: A turban that makes Palicoes shout, "Come on! Snake my day!" Often ends in tragedy.
description_de: Liegt schwer auf dem Kopf, wie das unsägliche Unge- heuer Leviathan.
description_fr: Donne l'illusion de savoir charmer les serpents. Cause de nombreux accidents.
description_es: Muchos camaradas al ponérselo gritan "¡Dejadme las serpientes a mí!". Y la cosa acaba mal.
description_it: Un turbante che fa esclamare ai compagni: "Ho un serpente per capello!".
description_zh: A turban that makes Palicoes shout, "Come on! Snake my day!" Often ends in tragedy.

name: F Narga Helm X
description: Head armor themed after the black garb of the East. Enables shadowy approaches.
description_de: Kopfschutz im Stil des schwarzen Gewandes. Für schattenhaftes Vorgehen.
description_fr: Inspiré de la tenue noire de l'Orient. Permet une approche furtive.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza inspirada en vestimentas orientales. Te da un aire sombrío.
description_it: Elmo ispirato alle nere vesti d'oriente. Agevola gli approcci furtivi.
description_zh: Head armor themed after the black garb of the East. Enables shadowy approaches.

name: F Zamtrios Helmet X
description: Experimental head armor for harsh climes. Won't cloud up when diving for fish.
description_de: Experimenteller Kopfschutz für raues Klima. Übersteht das Tauchen nach Fischen.
description_fr: Coiffe expérimentale pour climats rudes. Système anti- condensation en plongée.
description_es: Armadura para climas duros. Permite coger con facilidad vid Felyne bajo el agua.
description_it: Elmo sperimentale per climi rigidi. Non si appanna se peschi in immersione.
description_zh: Experimental head armor for harsh climes. Won't cloud up when diving for fish.

name: F Plesioth Cap X
description: A bright red hat that sells even to non-swimmers (and aids in the ensuing rescue).
description_de: Leuchtend rote Kappe, die auch Nichtschwimmer kaufen. (Hilfreich bei der Rettung.)
description_fr: Coiffe rouge vif que s'arrachent même ceux qui ne savent pas nager.
description_es: Un sombrero de color rojo brillante. Lo compran hasta quienes no saben nadar.
description_it: Un capo rosso fuoco molto apprezzato anche da chi non nuota (e dai soccorritori).
description_zh: A bright red hat that sells even to non-swimmers (and aids in the ensuing rescue).

name: F Kut-Ku Mask XR
description: Headgear made from Hyper Yian Kut-Ku Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.
description_de: Eine Kopfbedeckung aus Ferus- Yian-Kut-Ku-Resten, die verstecktes Potenzial zeigt.
description_fr: Masque en hyper débris de Yian Kut-Ku, dont le potentiel caché est entièrement libéré.
description_es: Objeto hecho con Híper restos de Yian Kut-Ku. Su potencial oculto está al máximo.
description_it: Copricapo ricavato da parti iper di Yian Kut-Ku, di cui sfrutta il potenziale nascosto.
description_zh: Headgear made from Hyper Yian Kut-Ku Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.

name: F Kecha Cap XR
description: Headgear made from Hyper Kecha Wacha Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.
description_de: Eine Kopfbedeckung aus Ferus- Kecha-Wacha-Resten, die verstecktes Potenzial zeigt.
description_fr: Coiffe en hyper débris de Kecha Wacha, dont le potentiel caché est entièrement libéré.
description_es: Casco hecho con Híper restos de Kecha Wacha. Su potencial oculto está al máximo.
description_it: Copricapo ricavato da parti iper di Kecha Wacha, di cui sfrutta il potenziale nascosto.
description_zh: Headgear made from Hyper Kecha Wacha Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.

name: F Gypceros Crest XR
description: Headgear made from Hyper Gypceros Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.
description_de: Eine Kopfbedeckung aus Ferus-Gypceros-Resten, die verstecktes Potenzial zeigt.
description_fr: Couvre-chef en hyper débris de Gypceros, dont le potentiel caché est entièrement libéré.
description_es: Casco hecho con Híper restos de Gypceros. Su potencial oculto está al máximo.
description_it: Copricapo ricavato da parti iper di Gypceros, di cui sfrutta il potenziale nascosto.
description_zh: Headgear made from Hyper Gypceros Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.

name: F Cabra Horn XR
description: Headgear made from Hyper Tetsucabra Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.
description_de: Eine Kopfbedeckung aus Ferus-Tetsucabra-Resten, die verstecktes Potenzial zeigt.
description_fr: Couvre-chef en hyper débris de Tetsucabra, dont le potentiel caché est entièrement libéré.
description_es: Casco hecho con Híper restos de Tetsucabra. Su potencial oculto está al máximo.
description_it: Copricapo ricavato da parti iper di Tetsucabra, di cui sfrutta il potenziale nascosto.
description_zh: Headgear made from Hyper Tetsucabra Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.

name: F Daimyo Mask XR
description: Headgear made from Hyper Daimyo Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.
description_de: Eine Kopfbedeckung aus Ferus-Daimyo-Hermitaur-Resten, die verstecktes Potenzial zeigt.
description_fr: Masque en hyper débris de Daimyo, dont le potentiel caché est entièrement libéré.
description_es: Objeto hecho con Híper restos de Daimyo. Su potencial oculto está al máximo.
description_it: Copricapo ricavato da parti iper di Daimyo, di cui sfrutta il potenziale nascosto.
description_zh: Headgear made from Hyper Daimyo Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.

name: F Ludroth Helm XR
description: Headgear made from Hyper Royal Ludroth Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.
description_de: Eine Kopfbedeckung aus Ferus-Königs-Ludroth-Resten, die verstecktes Potenzial zeigt.
description_fr: Couvre-chef en hyper débris de Ludroth royal, dont le potentiel caché est entièrement libéré.
description_es: Casco hecho con Híper restos de Ludroth. Su potencial oculto está al máximo.
description_it: Copricapo ricavato da parti iper di Ludroth reale, di cui sfrutta il potenziale nascosto.
description_zh: Headgear made from Hyper Royal Ludroth Scraps, its hidden potential fully unleashed.

name: F Scholarly Cap X
description: A cap matching the one the Wycademy Gal wears. It simply oozes intelligence.
description_de: Eine Kappe wie die des Wykademie-Mädels. Versprüht ungemeine Intelligenz.
description_fr: Calot assorti à celui porté par la Demoiselle de la Wycadémie. Donne l'air intelligent.
description_es: Gorra como la que lleva la chica de la Wycademia. Exuda inteligencia.
description_it: Simile al cappello indossato dalla dama della Wyccademia. Esprime intelligenza.
description_zh: A cap matching the one the Wycademy Gal wears. It simply oozes intelligence.

name: F Kittendant Hood X
description: A Flight Kittendant cap. Putting it on is sure to make passengers take notice!
description_de: Eine Flug-Katzendanten- kappe. Wer sie trägt, fällt den Passagieren auf!
description_fr: Capuchon de Miaôtesse qui attirera l'œil de plus d'un passager !
description_es: Sombrero de gazafato. ¡Póntelo para llamar la atención de los pasajeros!
description_it: Cappello da miaostess di volo. Senza alcun dubbio, attirerà l'attenzione dei passeggeri!
description_zh: A Flight Kittendant cap. Putting it on is sure to make passengers take notice!

name: F Derring Galea X
description: Glamorous head armor for your Palico's debut. They can wear it with pride.
description_de: Glamouröser Kopfschutz. Kameraden können ihn beim Debüt mit Stolz tragen.
description_fr: Coiffe élégante pour les débuts de votre compagnon. À porter avec fierté.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza inicial sofisticada para tu camarada. Pueden llevarla con orgullo.
description_it: Elmo alla moda per i compagni debuttanti. Li riempirà di orgoglio.
description_zh: Glamorous head armor for your Palico's debut. They can wear it with pride.

name: F Transpurrrrter Kasa
description: The Transpurrter's distinctive hat. Makes Palicoes look dashing while they're...uh, dashing.
description_de: Hut des Transschnurrters. Lässt Kameraden schneidig aussehen beim... Schneiden.
description_fr: Chapeau caractéristique du Transmiauleur. Donne un air chafouin.
description_es: El sombrero de Vagabundo Jack. Queda como un guante cuando el camarada da guantazos.
description_it: L'inconfondibile cappello del Purrrtatore. Rende i compagni ancora più scattanti.
description_zh: The Transpurrter's distinctive hat. Makes Palicoes look dashing while they're...uh, dashing.

name: F Ultimate Mask+
description: A mask Shakalaka spend their lives searching for. Absolute defense, but at what cost?
description_de: Nach ihr suchen Shakalaka ein Leben lang. Absolute Abwehr, aber um welchen Preis?
description_fr: Masque recherché par les Shakalaka. Une défense ultime, mais à quel prix ?
description_es: Los Shakalaka pasan toda la vida buscándola. Defensa total, pero ¿a qué precio?
description_it: Maschera ambita da tutti gli Shakalaka. Una difesa impenetrabile, ma a quale costo?
description_zh: A mask Shakalaka spend their lives searching for. Absolute defense, but at what cost?

name: F Guide's Hood X
description: Headwear worn by the Felyne guides of distant Loc Lac, city of sand.
description_de: Kopfbedeckung der Felyne- Führer aus dem entlegenen Loc Lac, der Sandstadt.
description_fr: Portée par les guides Felynes de Loc Lac, la lointaine cité du sable.
description_es: Muy utilizado por los guías Felyne de las lejanas tierras de Loc Lac, la ciudad arenosa.
description_it: Indossato dalle guide Felyne della lontana Loc Lac, la città della sabbia.
description_zh: Headwear worn by the Felyne guides of distant Loc Lac, city of sand.

name: F Sailor Hat X
description: One look at this hat is all you need to hear the call of the sea in your heart.
description_de: Beim Anblick dieses Huts erklingt in deinem Herzen sofort der Ruf des Meeres.
description_fr: Chapeau qui, dès le premier instant, pousse à répondre à l'appel de la mer.
description_es: Un vistazo a este gorro y sentirás la llamada del mar en tu corazón.
description_it: Posando lo sguardo su questo cappello potrai sentire il richiamo del mare.
description_zh: One look at this hat is all you need to hear the call of the sea in your heart.

name: F Grand Chaos Bulbs
description: Be a vision -- or just see them -- with this beguiling 'shroom and ribbon headband.
description_de: Sei eine Vision - oder sieh sie - dank diesem betörenden Pilz-und-Schleifen-Haarreif.
description_fr: Envoûtante coiffe champi qui fait son effet.
description_es: Sé una visión (o ten visiones) con esta encantadora diadema de champis y lazos.
description_it: Fascia con funghi e nastrini di una bellezza allucinante... letteralmente.
description_zh: Be a vision -- or just see them -- with this beguiling 'shroom and ribbon headband.

name: F Death Stench Hood X
description: A hood so reminiscent of the grim reaper, passers-by make their peace.
description_de: Eine Kapuze, die dem düsteren Sensenmann so gleicht, dass Passanten sich bekreuzigen.
description_fr: Capuchon évoquant la Camarde et rappelant à tous que la vie ne tient qu'à un fil... Brr !
description_es: Una capucha que recuerda tanto a la Parca que quienes la encuentran se confiesan.
description_it: Cappuccio talmente simile a quello del triste mietitore da ammutolire i passanti.
description_zh: A hood so reminiscent of the grim reaper, passers-by make their peace.

name: F El Dora Helm X
name_es: Casco de El Dora F X
description: Any Palico would be proud to wear this feathered Meownster Hunter treasure.
description_de: Jeder Kamerad würde den ge- fiederten Schatz der Miaunster- Jäger mit Stolz tragen.
description_fr: Relique à plumes d'un Chasseur de miaonstres que tout Palico serait fier de porter.
description_es: Todo camarada llevaría con orgullo este tesoro emplumado de los cazamiaunstruos.
description_it: Qualunque compagno vorrebbe indossare questo tesoro piumato dei cacciatori di miaostri.
description_zh: Any Palico would be proud to wear this feathered Meownster Hunter treasure.

name: F Artian Core X
description: A highly sturdy Palico helm made from a mysterious mined metal.
description_de: Sehr robuster Kameradenhelm aus einem geheimnisvollen in den Minen abgebauten Metall.
description_fr: Solide heaume de Palico, fabriqué dans un métal mystérieux.
description_es: Casco de camarada muy recio, fabricado con algún tipo de metal misterioso.
description_it: Elmo per compagni molto robusto ricavato da un misterioso minerale.
description_zh: A highly sturdy Palico helm made from a mysterious mined metal.

name: F Cheerful Cap X
description: Headwear for your Palico reminiscent of the Soaratorium Gal. A hat with a youthful, fresh design.
description_de: Dem Hut der Aerotorium-Mädel nachempfunden. Lässt Kameraden frisch und jugendlich aussehen.
description_fr: Inspiré de la tenue de la Demoiselle Aérolabo, il a un côté rafraîchissant.
description_es: Inspirado en el uniforme de la chica del Flotatorio. Ideal para los Felyne que quieren ir a la última moda.
description_it: Cappello per i compagni che riproduce lo stile della dama del solcacieli.
description_zh: Headwear for your Palico reminiscent of the Soaratorium Gal. A hat with a youthful, fresh design.

name: F Mariner Hood X
description: Headwear worn by Tanzia Gong Girls. The hat ribbon completes the look.
description_de: Kopfbedeckung der Tanzia- Gong-Mädel. Das Band an der Haube ist ein echter Hingucker.
description_fr: Basée sur l'uniforme de la Fille du gong Tanzia. Le ruban fait tout son charme.
description_es: Prenda para la cabeza usada por las chicas del gong de Tanzia. El lazo le da el punto perfecto.
description_it: Copricapo in stile donzella del gong di Tanzia. Il fiocco è adorabile.
description_zh: Headwear worn by Tanzia Gong Girls. The hat ribbon completes the look.

name: F Cute Ribbon
description: A ribbon favored by the Mewstress. Many admirers will be longing to pet the Palico's lovely hair.
description_de: Bringt einem Kameraden bewundernde Blicke ein und verleitet zum Kopfkraulen.
description_fr: Accessoire pour se déguiser en Felyna. Tout le monde a envie de le caresser.
description_es: Adorno para el pelo similar al de la Miauestrilla. Es muy cuco y funcional.
description_it: Serve a diventare come la mialady. Tutti vorranno accarezzare capelli così!
description_zh: A ribbon favored by the Mewstress. Many admirers will be longing to pet the Palico's lovely hair.

name: F Garuga Hood X
description: Sage headwear that a foreign tactician might wear. Not your standard Palico hairdo!
description_de: Weise Kopfbedeckung eines fremdländischen Taktikers. Extravaganz für Kameraden!
description_fr: Masque digne d'un tacticien étranger. Coiffe de Palico plutôt originale.
description_es: Gorro de sabio propio de un estratega extranjero. ¡Tu camarada parecerá otra cosa!
description_it: Simbolo di saggezza di uno stratega straniero. Insolito per un compagno.
description_zh: Sage headwear that a foreign tactician might wear. Not your standard Palico hairdo!

name: F Uragaan Helm X
description: Unparalleled head defense, but it makes reading your Palico's mood a chore.
description_de: Unübertroffener Kopfschutz. Nur die Laune des Kameraden ist schwer zu erkennen.
description_fr: D'une efficacité hors pair, mais rend l'humeur de votre Palico indéchiffrable.
description_es: Otorga una defensa sin par, pero dificulta saber el estado de ánimo del camarada.
description_it: È un'ottima difesa, ma nasconderà anche le emozioni del tuo compagno.
description_zh: Unparalleled head defense, but it makes reading your Palico's mood a chore.

name: F Lava Helm X
description: A helm with a flair for the dramatic that fits snugly on Palico heads.
description_de: Ein Helm mit Gespür für Dramatik, der perfekt auf Kameradenköpfe passt.
description_fr: Heaume des plus impressionnants, qui ira comme un gant à vos Palicos !
description_es: Casco con un aire dramático ideal para cabezas de camarada.
description_it: Elmo particolarmente vistoso che si adatta perfettamente alla testa dei compagni.
description_zh: A helm with a flair for the dramatic that fits snugly on Palico heads.

name: F Lagia Triad X
description: A pirate hat that unleashes a Palico's inner buccaneer. Tends to sell out quickly.
description_de: Piratenhut, der den Freibeuter im Kameraden zum Vorschein bringt. Verkaufsschlager.
description_fr: Révèle l'âme de pirate de votre Palico. Beaucoup de succès en magasin.
description_es: Un sombrero pirata que libera al bucanero interior de todo camarada. Es muy popular.
description_it: Cappello da pirata che esalta il lato piratesco dei compagni. È molto venduto.
description_zh: A pirate hat that unleashes a Palico's inner buccaneer. Tends to sell out quickly.

name: F Glavenus Helm X
description: This helm was forged in such high heat, it'd likely withstand the flames of hell itself.
description_de: Der bei hohen Temperaturen geschmiedete Helm würde wohl selbst Fegefeuer standhalten.
description_fr: Heaume forgé dans une telle fournaise qu'il résisterait même au feu de l'enfer.
description_es: Este casco se forjó con tanto calor que resistiría hasta las llamas del infierno.
description_it: La forgiatura ad altissime temperature gli permette di resistere anche alle fiamme.
description_zh: This helm was forged in such high heat, it'd likely withstand the flames of hell itself.

name: F Astalos Mask X
description: The crevices in this mask allow Palicoes to both see and breathe in it.
description_de: Durch die Spalten in dieser Maske können Kameraden sehen und atmen.
description_fr: Masque dont les fentes permettent aux Palicos de voir et respirer.
description_es: Las grietas de la máscara permiten a los camaradas ver y respirar.
description_it: I fori presenti sulla maschera permettono ai compagni di vedere e respirare.
description_zh: The crevices in this mask allow Palicoes to both see and breathe in it.

name: F Gammoth Collar X
description: This collar is so insulated that the heat it retains travels the whole body.
description_de: Dieser Kragen ist so isoliert, dass die gespeicherte Wärme den ganzen Körper durchfließt.
description_fr: Col protégeant si bien son porteur qu'il réchauffe son corps tout entier.
description_es: Este cuello aísla tanto que el calor que retiene llega a todo el cuerpo.
description_it: Questo collare è talmente ermetico che trasmette al corpo il calore di cui è pervaso.
description_zh: This collar is so insulated that the heat it retains travels the whole body.

name: F Mizutsune Kasa X
description: The distinct conical hat and fetching mask make this a hit at festivals.
description_de: Dank besonderem Hut in Kegelform und reizender Maske ein Festivalhit.
description_fr: Chapeau conique distinctif, au masque assorti, qui fait son effet lors des festivals.
description_es: El clásico sombrero cónico y la llamativa máscara hacen que triunfe en festivales.
description_it: Il cappello a cono e la maschera accattivante sono perfetti per le feste.
description_zh: The distinct conical hat and fetching mask make this a hit at festivals.

name: F Barioth Helm X
description: Head armor made from a snow- field predator. So regal, it calms crying children.
description_de: Kopfschutz aus Schneefeld- jäger. So königlich, dass er weinende Kinder beruhigt.
description_fr: À base d'un prédateur des neiges. Si majestueux qu'il calme les pleurs d'enfants.
description_es: Fabricado con un depredador de las nieves. Tan regio que calma a los niños.
description_it: Elmo ricavato dal predatore delle nevi. Così regale da placare il pianto dei bimbi.
description_zh: Head armor made from a snow- field predator. So regal, it calms crying children.

name: F Rathalos Helm X
description: Head armor as wild and regal as the King of the Skies. Quiets the fiercest of Fire.
description_de: Kopfschutz, majestätisch wie der König der Lüfte. Dämmt selbst wildestes Feuer ein.
description_fr: Aussi sauvage et royal que le roi des cieux. Étouffe le plus violent des feux.
description_es: Casco salvaje y regio como el mismo rey de los cielos. Sofoca cualquier fuego.
description_it: Elmo feroce e regale come il re dei cieli. Estingue anche le fiamme più ardenti.
description_zh: Head armor as wild and regal as the King of the Skies. Quiets the fiercest of Fire.

name: F Zinogre Helm X
description: Head armor that makes every living thing shrink away. Unlock the inner behemoth.
description_de: Kopfschutz, vor dem alles zurückschreckt, was lebt. Erwecke den Koloss in dir.
description_fr: Fait fuir d'effroi tout être vivant. Révèle le béhémoth en chacun de nous.
description_es: Casco que espanta a todo ser vivo. Libera con él a tu titán interior.
description_it: Mette in fuga qualunque creatura. Libera il mostro che è in te.
description_zh: Head armor that makes every living thing shrink away. Unlock the inner behemoth.

name: F Grav Mask X
description: Gloomy headwear that glows from beneath with magma. Lets one navigate toxic gases.
description_de: Düstere Kopfbedeckung, in der Magma leuchtet. Mit ihr kann man Giftgas durchschreiten.
description_fr: Masque funeste dégageant une lueur magmatique. Neutralise les gaz toxiques.
description_es: Máscara sombría que brilla como el magma. Protege de los gases tóxicos.
description_it: Copricapo tetro che emana il bagliore del magma. Protegge dai gas tossici.
description_zh: Gloomy headwear that glows from beneath with magma. Lets one navigate toxic gases.

name: F Gore Horror X
description: Head armor worn during the Magala eclipse. The wearer must face burning despair.
description_de: Kopfschutz, getragen bei der Magala-Finsternis. Ursache brennender Verzweiflung.
description_fr: Portée lors de l'éclipse de Magala. Son porteur est la proie d'un désespoir ardent.
description_es: Armadura de cabeza llevada durante el eclipse de Magala. Para enfrentarse al horror.
description_it: Elmo indossato durante l'eclissi del Magala. Induce una cocente disperazione.
description_zh: Head armor worn during the Magala eclipse. The wearer must face burning despair.

name: F Tigrex Helm X
description: A symbol of the Tigrex's vindictive nature. May even bite the wearer's hand.
description_de: Ein Symbol des Rachedurstes des Tigrex. Beißt eventuell dem Träger in die Hand.
description_fr: Symbole de la nature vindicative du Tigrex. Peut même mordre son porteur.
description_es: Símbolo de la naturaleza rencorosa del Tigrex. Puede llegar a morder al portador.
description_it: Simbolo della natura vendicativa del Tigrex. Attenzione, morde!
description_zh: A symbol of the Tigrex's vindictive nature. May even bite the wearer's hand.

name: F Seltas Head X
description: The perfect topper for a Palico who likes to shout, "And I'll form the head!"
description_de: Perfektes Oberteil für Kameraden, die gerne rufen: "Ich hau dir die Rübe ab!"
description_fr: Couvre-chef idéal pour les compagnons qui ont la grosse tête.
description_es: Ideal para camaradas que disfruten llevando una cabeza más bien llamativa.
description_it: Il copricapo ideale per i compagni che amano vantarsi di essere "tutta testa".
description_zh: The perfect topper for a Palico who likes to shout, "And I'll form the head!"

name: F Kirin Horn X
description: The Palico Kirin equipment hunters have clamored for. Wear the horn with pride!
description_de: Kirin-Kameraden-Ausrüstung, die Jäger schon immer wollten. Trage es mit Stolz!
description_fr: Pièce d'armure de Kirin tant attendue par les chasseurs. Portez-la avec fierté !
description_es: El equipo Kirin de camarada que pedían los cazadores. Lleva el cuerno con orgullo.
description_it: Elmo di Kirin per compagni apprezzato dai cacciatori. Indossalo con orgoglio!
description_zh: The Palico Kirin equipment hunters have clamored for. Wear the horn with pride!

name: F Borealis Crown
description: None may don this crown without the proper resolve. The eyes of the bearer blaze fiercely.
description_de: Kann nur von jenen getragen werden, die für den Kampf bereit sind. Verleiht Entschlossenheit.
description_fr: Couvre-chef réservé à ceux qui sont prêts à combattre. Donne un regard déterminé.
description_es: Solo para aquellos en cuyos ojos brille la determinación y estén dispuestos a todo.
description_it: Può indossarla solo chi ha grinta da vendere. Dona uno sguardo risoluto.
description_zh: None may don this crown without the proper resolve. The eyes of the bearer blaze fiercely.
