description_es: Traje de vuelo inspirado en un piloto que protege la galaxia. La cola causa furor.
description_it: Tuta ispirata a quella di un eroe dello spazio. Include una folta coda.
description_zh: A flight suit based on a pilot that protects the galaxy. The thick tail look is all the rage.

name: F Mario Overalls
description: Duds worn by one of the bros who saved the Mushroom King- dom. They're a little loose.
description_de: Die Hose eines der Brüder, die das Pilzkönigreich retteten. Sie ist ein wenig zu weit.
description_fr: Portée par l'un des frères ayant sauvé le Royaume Champignon. Un peu large.
description_es: Traje de uno de los hermanos que salvaron el Reino Champiñón. Un pelín ancho.
description_it: L'abito di uno dei fratelli che salvarono il Regno dei Funghi. È un po' larga.
description_zh: Duds worn by one of the bros who saved the Mushroom King- dom. They're a little loose.

name: F Luigi Overalls
description: Duds worn by one of the bros who saved the Mushroom King- dom. Note the longer straps.
description_de: Die Hose eines der Brüder, die das Pilzkönigreich retteten. Ihre Träger sind länger.
description_fr: Portée par l'un des frères ayant sauvé le Royaume Champignon. Inusable.
description_es: De uno de los hermanos que salvaron el Reino Champiñón. Con tirantes largos.
description_it: L'abito di un fratello che salvò il Regno dei Funghi. Nota le bretelle più lunghe.
description_zh: Duds worn by one of the bros who saved the Mushroom King- dom. Note the longer straps.

name: F Resetti Guise
description: A Reset Surveillance Center employee costume. There is no Reset button in hunting!
description_de: Kostüm eines Mitarbeiters des Büros für Unerlaubtes Ausschal- ten. Die Jagd kennt kein "Reset"!
description_fr: Costume d'employé du CenSuRe. Les chasseurs ne sont pas réinitialisables !
description_es: Traje de empleado del Centro de Vigilancia de Reseteos. ¡Nada de reinicios!
description_it: Costume da impiegato del Centro Resetti. Nella caccia non si può resettare!
description_zh: A Reset Surveillance Center employee costume. There is no Reset button in hunting!

name: F Isabelle Guise
description: A costume that turns one into an adorable town assistant that hunters love to be around.
description_de: Verwandelt dich in eine liebenswerte Sekretärin, die Jäger gern um sich haben.
description_fr: Costume de l'adorable secrétaire de mairie aimée de tous les chasseurs.
description_es: Adorable traje de la secretaria de cierto ayuntamiento a la que todos los cazadores adoran.
description_it: Costume con cui trasformarsi in una segretaria che fa girare la testa ai cacciatori.
description_zh: A costume that turns one into an adorable town assistant that hunters love to be around.

name: F Armor of Purrity
description: Armor fashioned after one worn by the Palico of Purrity. The crystals protect the wearer.
description_de: Rüstung, inspiriert von der des Schnurr-Kameraden. Kris- talle beschützen den Träger.
description_fr: Forgée d'après l'armure du Palico de la Pureté. Le cristal protège son porteur.
description_es: Armadura semejante a la utilizada por el camarada de la luz. Los cristales protegen al portador.
description_it: Ispirata alle armature indossate dai compagni della luce. I suoi cristalli proteggono i Felyne.
description_zh: Armor fashioned after one worn by the Palico of Purrity. The crystals protect the wearer.

name: F Chun Attire
description: A slitted dress, allowing the wearer to unleash stylish kicks with ease.
description_de: Ein geschlitztes Kleid, das es dem Träger erlaubt, unerhört hohe Tritte auszuführen.
description_fr: Une tenue qui permet à son porteur de donner des coups de pied hyper rapides. Yatta !
description_es: Un vestido abierto que permite a quien lo lleve dar ágiles patadas con facilidad.
description_it: Un vestito tradizionale che permette di calciare grazie alla sua spaccatura.
description_zh: A slitted dress, allowing the wearer to unleash stylish kicks with ease.

name: F Fancy Blanka Wear
description: Tough hide that personifies what it means to be a wild child with a heart of gold.
description_de: Zähe Haut - die Personifizierung eines Wildfangs mit einem Herz aus Gold.
description_fr: Un cuir épais personnifiant un enfant sauvage au cœur d'or.
description_es: Hecha de cuero endurecido: una metáfora de lo que supone ser un niño salvaje con un corazón de oro.
description_it: Di pelle spessa, personificano un selvaggio dal cuore d'oro.
description_zh: Tough hide that personifies what it means to be a wild child with a heart of gold.

name: F Dante Jacket
description: A beautiful red jacket that gives the wearer unparalleled freedom. Keeping it stylin'!
description_de: Wunderschöne rote Jacke, die dem Träger völlige Freiheit gewährt. Stylish!
description_fr: Une belle veste rouge qui offre une liberté de mouvement sans égale. Stylish !
description_es: Elegante chaqueta de color rojo que da al portador libertad sin parangón.
description_it: Una bella giacca rossa che dona grande mobilità... ...e grande stile!
description_zh: A beautiful red jacket that gives the wearer unparalleled freedom. Keeping it stylin'!

name: F Mega Armor
description: Special combat armor designed to stop a mad scientist. It features awesome powers.
description_de: Eine besondere Kampfrüstung, um einen irren Wissenschaftler aufzuhalten. Tolle Kräfte.
description_fr: Armure de combat conçue pour battre un savant fou. Sa puissance est incroyable.
description_es: Armadura de combate especial diseñada por un científico loco. Tiene un poder increíble.
description_it: Corazza con poteri speciali progettata per combattere gli scienziati folli.
description_zh: Special combat armor designed to stop a mad scientist. It features awesome powers.

name: F Melodic Suit
description: Attire covered with musical note patterns. All but screams, "I'm a conductor!"
description_de: Mit Musiknotenmuster. Er schreit geradezu: "Ich bin ein Dirigent!"
description_fr: Tenue couverte de notes de musique. Donne envie de jouer les chefs d'orchestre.
description_es: Atuendo repleto de notas musicales. Para dejar claro quién lleva la voz cantante.
description_it: Completo decorato con note musicali, invero poco adatto a un direttore d'orchestra.
description_zh: Attire covered with musical note patterns. All but screams, "I'm a conductor!"

name: F Baby Tiga Suit S
name_fr: Tenue de bébé Tiga F S
description: Clothing based on a baby Tigrex. Perfect for making Tigrex buddies!
description_de: Auf einem Tigrex-Baby basierende Kleidung. Perfekt, um Tigrex- Freunde zu finden!
description_fr: Tenue basée sur un bébé Tigrex. Parfaite pour se faire des amis Tigrex !
description_es: Ropaje inspirado en un cachorro de Tigrex. ¡Ideal para jugar con otros Tigrex!
description_it: Abito ispirato a un cucciolo di Tigrex. Tutti i Tigrex ti adoreranno!
description_zh: Clothing based on a baby Tigrex. Perfect for making Tigrex buddies!

name: F Sunsnug Vest
description: A vest worn by somebody famous in the legendary Felyne Village. Talk about culture shock!
description_de: Eine Weste, getragen von einer Berühmtheit im legendären Felyne-Dorf. Kulturschock pur!
description_fr: Tunique portée par quelqu'un de célèbre du village des Felynes. Bonjour le choc des cultures !
description_es: Chaleco usado por un Felyne famoso de esta aldea legendaria. ¡Un auténtico choque de culturas!
description_it: Indossata da una celebrità del leggendario villaggio Felyne. Paese che vai...
description_zh: A vest worn by somebody famous in the legendary Felyne Village. Talk about culture shock!

name: F Fan Top
description: A cool pink tracksuit and a bag with a Rathalos scale on it. A fan club original!
description_de: Cooles rosa Oberteil sowie eine Tasche mit Rathalos- Schuppe. Fanclub-Original!
description_fr: Tenue rose avec sac en écailles de Rathalos créée pour le MH Fan Club.
description_es: Chándal rosa con una escama Rathalos. ¡Original del club de fans!
description_it: Splendida tuta rosa con una sacca e una scaglia di Rathalos. Solo per il club!
description_zh: A cool pink tracksuit and a bag with a Rathalos scale on it. A fan club original!

name: F Pep Squad Suit
description: A fan club uniform Palicoes wear beclaws their hunters need a little cheering on.
description_de: Fanclub-Uniform für Kame- raden, deren Jäger etwas angefeuert werden müssen.
description_fr: Uniforme MH Fan Club porté par les Palicos pour encourager les chasseurs.
description_es: Uniforme del club de fans para los camaradas cuyos cazadores necesitan ánimos.
description_it: Divisa da fan club che i compagni indossano per alzare il "miaorale" del cacciatore.
description_zh: A fan club uniform Palicoes wear beclaws their hunters need a little cheering on.

name: F Giaprey Mail
description: Chest armor for cool cats. Purrfect for cosplaying a soldier or the like.
description_de: Diese Rüstung sieht besonders eindrucksvoll aus. Ideal für alle, die gern Soldat spielen.
description_fr: Tenue parfaite pour voyager avec classe. Idéale pour jouer les soldats d'arrière-garde.
description_es: Molona armadura pectoral. Ideal en retaguardia cuando se juega a las batallitas.
description_it: Protezione per chi adora i ruoli di supporto quando si gioca ai soldati.
description_zh: Chest armor for cool cats. Purrfect for cosplaying a soldier or the like.

name: F Conga Fete
description: Mirthful cymbals that say, "Here I come!" and a shroom bag that says, "Here I AM!"
description_de: Die heiteren Zimbeln singen: "Ich komme!", und der Pilz- beutel ruft: "ICH BIN DA!"
description_fr: Joyeuses cymbales accompagnant un sac de champignons...
description_es: Címbalos alegres que dicen "¡Allá voy!" y unas setas que dicen "¡Ya estoy aquí!"
description_it: Dei cimbali gioiosi che pare gridino "Eccoci!" e una borsa per funghi che urla "ECCOMI!"
description_zh: Mirthful cymbals that say, "Here I come!" and a shroom bag that says, "Here I AM!"

name: F Barroth Mail
description: Tremendous body armor that transforms the wearer into a rock-solid baby Barroth.
description_de: Enormer Körperschutz, der den Träger in ein robustes Barroth-Baby verwandelt.
description_fr: Armure phénoménale qui transforme son porteur en un solide bébé Barroth.
description_es: Imponente armadura que convierte al portador en una dura y sólida cría de Barroth.
description_it: Massiccia armatura che tramuta chi la porta in un piccolo, coriaceo Barroth.
description_zh: Tremendous body armor that transforms the wearer into a rock-solid baby Barroth.

name: F Pleasant Dress
description: The Meowstress's dress. Wear to get the same great service you've come to know.
description_de: Kleid der Miausterin. Damit fühlst du dich genauso energetisch wie sie.
description_fr: Permet de ressembler à Felyndra et d'avoir la même ardeur au travail qu'elle.
description_es: Atuendo para convertirse en Miauestra. ¡Te dará ganas de gestionar camaradas!
description_it: Protezione essenziale per una vera miadama, capace di infondere allegria.
description_zh: The Meowstress's dress. Wear to get the same great service you've come to know.

name: F Wisdom Cloak
description: A splendid cloak worn by the Wyventurer. Thick yet light, and a joy to wear.
description_de: Diesen prächtigen Mantel trägt auch der Wyventeurer. Leicht, stabil und äußerst kleidsam.
description_fr: Tenue similaire à celle du Wyventurier. Épaisse, mais légère et confortable.
description_es: Atuendo propio del Wyventurero. Resistente pero cómodo.
description_it: Splendido soprabito in stile wyvventuriero.
description_zh: A splendid cloak worn by the Wyventurer. Thick yet light, and a joy to wear.

name: F Basarios Mail
description: Basarios armor that pretty much turns Palicoes into rocks when they hunch down.
description_de: Basarios-Rüstung, die jeden Kameraden als Stein tarnt, wenn er in die Hocke geht.
description_fr: Armure déséquilibrant les Palicos s'ils commettent l'erreur de se baisser.
description_es: Armadura de Basarios que convierte a los camaradas en rocas cuando se agachan.
description_it: Armatura di Basarios che tramuta i compagni in roccia quando si accovacciano.
description_zh: Basarios armor that pretty much turns Palicoes into rocks when they hunch down.

name: F Scylla Mail
description: A suit that covers the body. Painstakingly crafted, it possesses a wondrous beauty.
description_de: Ein Gewand, das den Körper bedeckt. Penibel gefertigt mit wundersamer Schönheit.
description_fr: Armure couvrant le torse. Allie conception de qualité et beauté enchanteresse.
description_es: Armadura pectoral hecha de partes de araña sombría. Misteriosa y bella a la vez.
description_it: Protezione con scarti di Nerscylla. Una bellezza artificiale e misteriosa.
description_zh: A suit that covers the body. Painstakingly crafted, it possesses a wondrous beauty.

name: F Cheerful Suit
description: Clothes for your Palico reminiscent of the Soaratorium Gal. Shows off both your smarts and liveliness.
description_de: Die Uniform der Aerotorium- Mädel. Für gewitzte und lebhafte Kameraden.
description_fr: Inspirée de la tenue de la Demoiselle Aérolabo, elle donne un air vif et futé.
description_es: Atuendo para camaradas inspirado en el uniforme de la chica del Flotatorio. Sofisticado y con chispa.
description_it: Abito per i compagni che riproduce lo stile della dama del solcacieli.
description_zh: Clothes for your Palico reminiscent of the Soaratorium Gal. Shows off both your smarts and liveliness.

name: F Mariner Suit
description: Body armor worn by Tanzia Gong Girls. Popular for its undeniable cuteness.
description_de: Kleidung der Tanzia-Gong-Mädel. So viel Anmut wissen auch Felyne zu schätzen.
description_fr: Basée sur l'uniforme de la Fille du gong Tanzia. Les Felynes en sont fous.
description_es: Armadura usada por las chicas del gong de Tanzia. Es tan mono... ¡A los Felyne les encanta!
description_it: Abito in stile donzella del gong di Tanzia. Nessun Felyne può resistere!
description_zh: Body armor worn by Tanzia Gong Girls. Popular for its undeniable cuteness.

name: F Barioth Mail
description: Body armor made from an icy predator. The white pelt blends right into the snow.
description_de: Aus einem eisigen Raubtier gemachter Schutz. Der weiße Pelz verschwindet im Schnee.
description_fr: À base d'un prédateur des glaces. Sa peau blanche se fond dans la neige.
description_es: Hecha de restos de un depredador helado. Su pelaje se confunde con la nieve.
description_it: Ricavata da un predatore glaciale. Il cuoio bianco si confonde con la neve.
description_zh: Body armor made from an icy predator. The white pelt blends right into the snow.

name: F Grav Armor
description: Armor that says, "If the Gravios can take a magma bath -- dang it, so can I."
description_de: Rüstung, die verkündet: "Wenn der Gravios in Magma badet, kann ich das auch!"
description_fr: Armure donnant l'impression d'être invincible, même plongée dans le magma.
description_es: Armadura ideal para darse un bañito en el ardiente magma.
description_it: "Se un Gravios può immergersi nel magma... diamine, anch'io posso farlo", dice l'armatura.
description_zh: Armor that says, "If the Gravios can take a magma bath -- dang it, so can I."

name: F Diablos Mail
description: Shell body armor that repels iron blows and renders the wearer a terror of the sand.
description_de: Schalenrüstung, die harte Schläge abwehrt. Ihr Träger ist der Schrecken der Wüste.
description_fr: En carapace. Repousse les coups et fait de son porteur une terreur des sables.
description_es: Repele los golpes potentes y convierte al portador en el terror de las arenas.
description_it: Corazza che respinge il ferro e muta chi la indossa in un terrore delle sabbie.
description_zh: Shell body armor that repels iron blows and renders the wearer a terror of the sand.

name: F Valstrax Mail
description: Chest armor for those with the courage to face calamity. Fills all who see it with awe.
description_de: Für Helden, die jeder Gefahr trotzen. Selbst Meteoriten würden von ihm abprallen.
description_fr: Portée par ceux qui affrontent le Mal, elle inspire un respect incommensurable.
description_es: Armadura pectoral para grandes héroes. Es dura como la roca de estrellas.
description_it: Protezione per chi affronta le calamità. Niente può perforarla.
description_zh: Chest armor for those with the courage to face calamity. Fills all who see it with awe.

name: F Acorn Mail X
description: Entry-level Felyne Palico body armor. An acorn a day keeps the monsters away!
description_de: Einstiegsrüstung für Felyne- Kameraden. Wer Monster nicht mag: eine Eichel pro Tag!
description_fr: Armure Felyne basique pour Palico. Les châtaignes éloignent les monstres !
description_es: Armadura básica de camarada Felyne. ¡Una bellota al día protege con alegría!
description_it: Cotta per compagni Felyne. Una ghianda al giorno toglie i mostri di torno!
description_zh: Entry-level Felyne Palico body armor. An acorn a day keeps the monsters away!

name: F Bherna Mail X
description: Bherna Village-crafted clothing well-renowned for its durability and flexibility.
description_de: Im Dorf Bherna gefertigte Kleidung, berühmt für ihre Haltbarkeit und Elastizität.
description_fr: Cotte du village Bherna, célèbre pour sa résistance et sa polyvalence.
description_es: Armadura pectoral típica de Bherna robusta y cómoda; ideal para salir de viaje.
description_it: Indumento realizzato nel villaggio di Bherna noto per la sua resistenza ed elasticità.
description_zh: Bherna Village-crafted clothing well-renowned for its durability and flexibility.

name: F Gourmet Suit X
description: A chef's getup resembling the Gourmew Chef in his younger days.
description_de: Ein Chefkoch-Outfit wie das des Gourmiau-Kochs, als er noch jung war.
description_fr: Tenue rappelant celle que portait le chef Gourmiaou, du temps de sa jeunesse.
description_es: Bata de cocinero que recuerda al Chef Gourmiáu cuando era joven.
description_it: Tenuta da cuoco ispirata a quella indossata dallo chef Gourmiao in giovane età.
description_zh: A chef's getup resembling the Gourmew Chef in his younger days.

name: F Moofy Suit X
description: Made from so much Moofah cotton that one could easily fall asleep wearing it.
description_de: Aus so viel Muufah-Wolle gemacht, dass es zum Einschlafen verleitet.
description_fr: Tenue tissée avec tant de coton de Moofah, qu'elle ferait une excellente chemise de nuit.
description_es: Atuendo blandito y suave que podría ser el pijama ideal. Muy mullido.
description_it: L'imbottitura di vello di Moofah è così spessa che chi lo indossa rischia di appisolarsi.
description_zh: Made from so much Moofah cotton that one could easily fall asleep wearing it.

name: F Aptonoth Suit X
description: A potentially all too tasty- looking suit. Watch out for monsters nibbling the tail!
description_de: Ein Gewand, das vielleicht zu lecker wirkt. Lass den Schwanz nicht von Monstern anknabbern!
description_fr: Tenue des plus appétissantes. Attention à ne pas vous faire mordre la queue !
description_es: Es posible que con este traje atraigas a más de un depredador. ¡Ten cuidado!
description_it: Abito dall'aspetto sin troppo ghiotto. I mostri tenteranno di morderti la coda!
description_zh: A potentially all too tasty- looking suit. Watch out for monsters nibbling the tail!

name: F Popo Wear X
description: Demand for this armor is high thanks to its simplicity and high maneuverability.
description_de: Diese Rüstung ist gefragt, da sie so einfach und höchst beweglich ist.
description_fr: Armure très populaire, simple et polyvalente, qui a déjà séduit plus d'un guerrier.
description_es: Esta armadura triunfa gracias a su simplicidad y a su gran maniobrabilidad.
description_it: Corazza molto richiesta per la sua fattura semplice che non ostacola i movimenti.
description_zh: Demand for this armor is high thanks to its simplicity and high maneuverability.

name: F Gargwa Vest X
description: Feathered body armor with Dragon Resistance. A.K.A., the "dragon in bird's clothes."
description_de: Federbesetzter Körperschutz mit Drachenabwehr: "Der Drache im Vogelkleid."
description_fr: Armure à plumes qui protège des dragons. Alias le "dragon déguisé en oiseau".
description_es: Armadura emplumada con resistencia a draco. Conocida como "el dragón con plumas".
description_it: Armatura piumata e robusta come un drago. Detta anche "drago in abiti d'uccello".
description_zh: Feathered body armor with Dragon Resistance. A.K.A., the "dragon in bird's clothes."

name: F Larinoth Suit X
description: The Larinoth's time to shine has come at last with this popular, adorable suit.
description_de: Dieses beliebte, hinreißende Gewand lässt Larinoth endlich im rechten Licht erstrahlen.
description_fr: Tenue aussi adorable que populaire, marquant l'heure de gloire tant attendue du Larinoth.
description_es: Gracias a este adorable traje, el Larinoth brillará por fin con luz propia.
description_it: Questo abito di tendenza rende finalmente giustizia al Larinoth.
description_zh: The Larinoth's time to shine has come at last with this popular, adorable suit.

name: F Barrel Body
description: Body armor that the felyne cook used for smuggling. Always snugly smuggly.
description_de: Fass, in dem sich ein blinder Felyne-Passagier versteckte. Riecht nach Abenteuer.
description_fr: Tenue qui évoque le baril dans lequel se cache un cuisinier Felyne discret.
description_es: Inspirado en el barril que utiliza el cocinero Felyne para introducir productos de contrabando.
description_it: Protezione che assomiglia alla botte usata dal cuoco Felyne dell'aeronave.
description_zh: Body armor that the felyne cook used for smuggling. Always snugly smuggly.

name: F Alloy Mail X
description: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Guaranteed body protection.
description_de: Gefertigt aus Edelerz in drei arbeitsreichen Nächten. Körperschutz garantiert.
description_fr: Cotte en alliage de qualité qui, martelée trois nuits entières, s'avère très efficace.
description_es: Lleva tres días fabricarla. Su metal de calidad protege el cuerpo a la perfección.
description_it: Forgiata con metalli di qualità in tre notti di lavoro. Assicura protezione al corpo.
description_zh: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Guaranteed body protection.

name: F Bone Mail X
description: Body armor made of a variety of monster bones. Look wild, smell wild...then go wild!
description_de: Körperschutz aus diversen Monsterknochen. Mit wildem Geruch und Aussehen.
description_fr: À base d'os de monstres. Un look et une odeur sauvages pour des combats sauvages.
description_es: Hecha con diversos huesos de monstruo. Da un aspecto y olor salvajes.
description_it: Armatura fabbricata con ossa di vari mostri. Aspetto feroce... e puzza selvaggia!
description_zh: Body armor made of a variety of monster bones. Look wild, smell wild...then go wild!

name: F Alta Shirt X
description: A breezy tank top perfect for fine weather. Complete with a basket of Thunderbugs.
description_de: Ein luftiges Top, ideal für schönes Wetter. Dazu passend ein Korb Donnerkäfer.
description_fr: Débardeur idéal pour les journées ensoleillées, doté d'un panier de foudrinsectes en accessoire.
description_es: Camiseta muy fresca, ideal para el buen tiempo. Incluye bichos eléctricos.
description_it: Canottiera che mantiene freschi quando il clima è mite. Include un cesto di insetti-tuono.
description_zh: A breezy tank top perfect for fine weather. Complete with a basket of Thunderbugs.

name: F Bnaha Suit X
description: A suit with great mobility. Dance like a butterfly, sting like a Felyne!
description_de: Anzug mit guter Agilität. Tanze wie ein Schmetterling und steche wie eine Felyne!
description_fr: Armure très flexible. Dansez comme un papillon, piquez comme un Felyne !
description_es: Traje con gran movilidad. ¡Baila como una mariposa, pica como un Felyne!
description_it: Abito comodo e flessibile. Danza come una farfalla, pungi come un Felyne!
description_zh: A suit with great mobility. Dance like a butterfly, sting like a Felyne!

name: F Jaggi Mail X
description: Popular body armor made of Great Jaggi hide. Provides mobility and defense.
description_de: Beliebter Körperschutz aus Großjaggi-Lederhaut. Bietet Mobilität und Schutz.
description_fr: Armure populaire en peau de Grand Jaggi. Protège tout en préservant la mobilité.
description_es: Armadura popular hecha con piel de Gran Jaggi. Permite movilidad y defensa.
description_it: Celebre armatura fabbricata con pelle di Gran Jaggi. Un capo agile e resistente.
description_zh: Popular body armor made of Great Jaggi hide. Provides mobility and defense.

name: F Rheno Mail X
description: Revolutionary armor made by fusing metal to Rhenoplos shell. Light, but sturdy.
description_de: Aus Metall und Rhenoplos- Panzer gefertigte Rüstung. Leicht, hart, evolutionär.
description_fr: Armure en métal et carapace de Rhenoplos. Légère, solide et futuriste.
description_es: Armadura que combina metal con coraza de Rhenoplos. Ligera, dura, evolucionada.
description_it: Creata con metallo fuso a una corazza di Rhenoplos. Leggera... e rivoluzionaria!
description_zh: Revolutionary armor made by fusing metal to Rhenoplos shell. Light, but sturdy.

name: F Slagtoth Cape X
description: Hide body armor marketed as "inundation insurance." Strong against Water.
description_de: Als "Flut-Versicherung" beworbener Körperschutz aus Leder. Stark gegen Wasser.
description_fr: Véritable assurance anti- inondations, cette armure en peau protège de l'eau.
description_es: Armadura de piel vendida como "un seguro para inundaciones". Gran protección contra el agua.
description_it: Mantello di pelle per chi ha la fobia delle alluvioni. Resistente all'acqua.
description_zh: Hide body armor marketed as "inundation insurance." Strong against Water.

name: F Maccao Mail X
description: An irresistibly adorable bell and cape combo that's sure to turn heads.
description_de: Eine unglaublich hinreißende Kombination aus Glocke und Cape, die Blicke auf sich zieht.
description_fr: Adorable cape à clochettes qui fera tourner toutes les têtes.
description_es: Conjunto de capa y cascabeles que no pasará desapercibido.
description_it: Adorabile completo composto da cappa e campana. Per chi non vuole passare inosservato.
description_zh: An irresistibly adorable bell and cape combo that's sure to turn heads.

name: F Velociprey Mail X
description: Clean, elegant armor that's perfect for playing pretend as a combat medic.
description_de: Saubere, elegante Rüstung, mit der du dich perfekt als Sanitäter ausgeben kannst.
description_fr: Pièce d'armure propre et élégante, idéale pour jouer les médecins militaires.
description_es: Armadura elegante, perfecta para darse aires de médico de combate.
description_it: Corazza essenziale ed elegante che ti farà sembrare un vero medico da campo.
description_zh: Clean, elegant armor that's perfect for playing pretend as a combat medic.

name: F Bulldrome Vest X
description: Body armor that leverages the Bulldrome's thick skin. Stinks like its namesake.
description_de: Körperschutz, aus der dicken Haut des Bulldrome. Stinkt wie sein Namensgeber.
description_fr: Armure fabriquée en cuir épais de Bulldrome. Odeur pestilentielle incluse.
description_es: Armadura que aprovecha la dura piel del Bulldrome. Apesta como uno de verdad.
description_it: Protezione che sfrutta la spessa pelle del Bulldrome. Peccato puzzi di stalla...
description_zh: Body armor that leverages the Bulldrome's thick skin. Stinks like its namesake.

name: F Arzuros Mail X
description: Body armor that may cause Arzuros to mistake the wearer for its young...
description_de: Körperschutz, der Arzuros glauben lässt, man sei eines seiner Jungen...
description_fr: Attention, Arzuros lui-même pourrait vous prendre pour l'un de ses petits...
description_es: Una armadura para tener cuidado: ¡un Arzuros podría confundir al portador con una de sus crías!
description_it: Armatura che può indurre gli Arzuros a credere di avere di fronte un loro cucciolo.
description_zh: Body armor that may cause Arzuros to mistake the wearer for its young...

name: F Giaprey Mail X
description: Chest armor for cool cats. Purrfect for cosplaying a soldier or the like.
description_de: Besonders imposante Rüstung. Ideal für alle, die gern Soldat spielen.
description_fr: Tenue parfaite pour voyager avec classe. Idéale pour jouer les soldats d'arrière-garde.
description_es: Molona armadura pectoral. Ofrece grandes prestaciones para jugar a las batallitas.
description_it: Protezione per chi adora i ruoli di supporto quando si gioca ai soldati.
description_zh: Chest armor for cool cats. Purrfect for cosplaying a soldier or the like.

name: F Genprey Mail X
description: Armor that comes with a pair of binoculars. Good to play pretend as a scout.
description_de: Rüstung, zu der ein Fernglas gehört. Ideal, um sich als Späher auszugeben.
description_fr: Pièce d'amure munie d'une paire de jumelles. Idéale pour jouer les boy-scouts !
description_es: Armadura que viene con unos prismáticos. Ideal para jugar a exploradores.
description_it: Corazza corredata da un paio di binocoli. Ideale per chi vuole sembrare un esploratore.
description_zh: Armor that comes with a pair of binoculars. Good to play pretend as a scout.

name: F Lagombi Mail X
description: Fur body armor that shuts out cold for toasty hunts even in the worst of climes.
description_de: Fell-Körperschutz, der Kälte verdrängt und auch bei rauem Klima angenehm warm hält.
description_fr: Armure en fourrure qui garantit une chasse torride malgré un climat arctique.
description_es: Armadura de piel con la que el camarada estará calentito hasta con el peor clima.
description_it: Pelliccia che ripara dal freddo. Per cacce bollenti anche in mezzo al gelo!
description_zh: Fur body armor that shuts out cold for toasty hunts even in the worst of climes.

name: F Cephalos Dress X
description: A grand collar that cuts a fine figure, whether sailing open skies or open seas.
description_de: Ein breiter Kragen macht eine gute Figur, ob in luftiger Höhe oder auf offener See.
description_fr: Grand col qui habille à merveille les chasseurs voguant dans les cieux ou sur les mers.
description_es: Bello vestido que estiliza tanto si surcas los cielos como los mares.
description_it: Sontuoso collare che assicura eleganza quando si naviga in mare o nei cieli.
description_zh: A grand collar that cuts a fine figure, whether sailing open skies or open seas.

name: F Kut-Ku Wear X
description: A pint-sized take on the Yian Kut-Ku that's ahead... er, WAY ahead of its time.
description_de: Eine winzige Version des Yian Kut-Ku, die ihrer Zeit weit voraus ist.
description_fr: Version miniature du Yian Kut-Ku. TRÈS en avance sur son temps.
description_es: Versión enana del Yian Kut-Ku, muy adelantada a su tiempo. Quizá demasiado...
description_it: Il minuscolo lascito di uno Yian Kut-Ku molto più avanti del suo tempo.
description_zh: A pint-sized take on the Yian Kut-Ku that's ahead... er, WAY ahead of its time.

name: F Gypceros Cloth X
description: Gypceros armor woven from ancient technology. The trim gives off a divine light.
description_de: Nach alter Technik gewebte Gypceros-Rüstung. Ihr Saum verströmt göttliches Licht.
description_fr: Armure Gypceros conçue par une technologie ancienne. Dégage un éclat divin.
description_es: Armadura de Gypceros tejida con artes antiguas. Tiene un resplandor divino.
description_it: Armatura di Gypceros creata con tecnologie antiche. Le finiture emanano una luce divina.
description_zh: Gypceros armor woven from ancient technology. The trim gives off a divine light.

name: F Cabra Wrap X
description: Fiendish Tetsucabra wear. Count the seconds from when it's seen 'til thunder hits!
description_de: Teuflische Tetsucabra-Kleidung. Beim Anblick vergehen bis zum Donnerschlag nur Sekunden!
description_fr: Terrible pagne, s'il en est. Avec un tel habit, la foudre frappera vite, c'est certain.
description_es: Ropa maligna de Tetsucabra. ¡Cuando la veas, el rayo no se hará esperar!
description_it: Temibile indumento di Tetsucabra. Indossalo per scatenare la furia del tuono!
description_zh: Fiendish Tetsucabra wear. Count the seconds from when it's seen 'til thunder hits!

name: F Daimyo Suit X
description: Presenting the Daimyo Felyne. A Monoblos horn on the sack keeps foes from sneaking up.
description_de: Die Daimyo-Felyne! Ein Mono- blos-Horn verhindert, dass sich Feinde anschleichen.
description_fr: Habit de Felyne de Daimyo. Sa corne de Monoblos dissuade les ennemis d'attaquer.
description_es: ¡Con ustedes, el Felyne Daimyo! Gracias al cuerno de Monoblos, no habrá sorpresas.
description_it: Ecco a voi il Felyne Daimyo. Il corno di Monoblos sullo zaino protegge da attacchi furtivi.
description_zh: Presenting the Daimyo Felyne. A Monoblos horn on the sack keeps foes from sneaking up.

name: F Ludroth Mail X
description: Soft body armor whose spongy Royal Ludroth bits help absorb Water attacks.
description_de: Schwammartiger Panzer aus Königs-Ludroth-Teilen, der Wasserangriffe absorbiert.
description_fr: À base d'éléments spongieux de Ludroth royal aidant à absorber les attaques d'eau.
description_es: Armadura mullida cuyas partes de Ludroth Real absorben ataques de agua.
description_it: Gli spugnosi brandelli di Ludroth reale assorbono gli attacchi d'acqua.
description_zh: Soft body armor whose spongy Royal Ludroth bits help absorb Water attacks.

name: F Kecha Coat X
description: Woven body armor modeled after the coat worn by one of the Three Meowsketeers.
description_de: Gewebter Brustschutz nach Vorbild des Waffenrocks von einem der Drei Miausketiere.
description_fr: Armure tissée s'inspirant du manteau porté par l'un des trois Miaousquetaires.
description_es: Armadura inspirada en la cota de uno de los tres miausqueteros.
description_it: Corazza di maglia ispirata agli abiti di uno dei Tre Miaoschettieri.
description_zh: Woven body armor modeled after the coat worn by one of the Three Meowsketeers.

name: F Maiden Mail X
description: A Palico outfit that proudly declares an interest in artisanal work.
description_de: Kameradenkleidung, die von echtem Interesse an Kunsthandwerk zeugt.
description_fr: Tenue de Palico clamant haut et fort un intérêt marqué pour l'artisanat.
description_es: Traje de camarada que transmite con orgullo interés por el trabajo artesanal.
description_it: Abito per i compagni che amano ostentare la propria passione per il lavoro artigianale.
description_zh: A Palico outfit that proudly declares an interest in artisanal work.

name: F Exquisite Robe
description: A charming robe fashioned after what's worn by the Yukumo Gal. A real hit with Palicoes.
description_de: Bezaubernde Robe nach dem Vorbild der Mode am Quest- Schalter des Yukumo-Dorfs.
description_fr: Jolie robe inspirée de la Demoiselle Yukumo.
description_es: Una toga encantadora parecida a las que visten en el puesto de misiones de Yukumo.
description_it: Indumenti ricercati ispirati nello stile a quelli del banco delle missioni di Yukumo.
description_zh: A charming robe fashioned after what's worn by the Yukumo Gal. A real hit with Palicoes.

name: F Ladybug Wings X
description: Body armor covered in polka dots. Its only downside: You can't fly with it.
description_de: Körperschutz mit Tupfen. Der einzige Nachteil: Man kann damit nicht fliegen.
description_fr: Armure couverte de petits points. Son inconvénient : elle ne permet pas de voler.
description_es: Armadura corporal cubierta de topos. Su único fallo: no se puede volar con ella.
description_it: Protezione a pois per il torace. L'unico problema è che non permette di volare.
description_zh: Body armor covered in polka dots. Its only downside: You can't fly with it.

name: F Hot Shakalaka Duds
description: Shakalaka wear that dares you not to dance in it. Minimal clothing, maximum defense.
description_de: Shakalaka-Kleidung, die zum Tanzen verleitet. Minimale Kleidung, maximale Abwehr.
description_fr: Tenue Shakalaka qui donne envie de se trémousser. Minimaliste, mais résistante.
description_es: Este atuendo te da ganas de bailar. Poquísima tela, defensa a tope.
description_it: Indumento Shakalaka che scatena la tua voglia di ballare. Abiti stringati, difesa assicurata.
description_zh: Shakalaka wear that dares you not to dance in it. Minimal clothing, maximum defense.

name: F Large Straw Raincoat
description: A Shakalaka style-fest made from sparkly shells. Comes with its own funky groove.
description_de: Mantel im Shakalaka-Stil aus funkelnden Muscheln. Hat seinen eigenen Groove.
description_fr: Habit de style Shakalaka à base de coquillages luisants. Donne un certain groove.
description_es: Hecho con brillantes conchas. Lleva el ritmo en el cuerpo... ¡literalmente!
description_it: Un concentrato di stile Shakalaka ricavato da gusci. Trasmette un ritmo unico.
description_zh: A Shakalaka style-fest made from sparkly shells. Comes with its own funky groove.

name: F Lecturer's Suit X
description: Even the Guildmarm this suit's based on is jealous of that sweet frog pack!
description_de: Gewand nach der Gildenjungfer, auf dessen süßen Frosch-Look selbst sie eifersüchtig ist!
description_fr: Tenue avec sac grenouille qui a même rendu jalouse la Guilda dont elle est inspirée.
description_es: ¡Hasta la delegada en la que se basa este traje está celosa de él!
description_it: Persino la dama della Gilda, a cui questo abito è ispirato, è gelosa dell'accessorio rana!
description_zh: Even the Guildmarm this suit's based on is jealous of that sweet frog pack!

name: F Stone God Body
description: Armor made from part of an old stone statue that exudes mysterious power.
description_de: Körperschutz aus einem Teil einer alten Steinstatue mit einer geheimnisvollen Aura.
description_fr: Armure fabriquée à partir d'une statue de pierre antique, qui émet une étrange puissance.
description_es: Armadura fabricada con piedra de una estatua antigua que desprende un misterioso poder.
description_it: Corazza ricavata da una statua antica che emana un potere misterioso.
description_zh: Armor made from part of an old stone statue that exudes mysterious power.

name: F Venombee Wings X
description: The shiny metal stinger looks cool and all -- just try not to poke anybody.
description_de: Der Stachel aus glänzendem Metall wirkt cool - versuch nur, niemanden zu stechen.
description_fr: Dard en métal rutilant qui en impose vraiment. Attention à ne piquer personne !
description_es: El brillante aguijón metálico es lo más; pero intenta no picar a nadie.
description_it: Lo scintillante pungiglione in metallo è fantastico, ma cerca di non infilzare nessuno.
description_zh: The shiny metal stinger looks cool and all -- just try not to poke anybody.

name: F Mosgharl Mail X
description: A get-up that rascal Felynes use to spook villagers...and, as it turns out, monsters!
description_de: Für gemeine Felynen, die Dorfbewohner erschrecken. Und auch Monster!
description_fr: Des Felynes l'utilisent pour faire peur aux villageois... mais aussi aux monstres !
description_es: Los Felyne más gamberros las usan para asustar a la gente... ¡y a los monstruos!
description_it: I monelli Felyne la usano per spaventare i compaesani. E anche i mostri!
description_zh: A get-up that rascal Felynes use to spook villagers...and, as it turns out, monsters!

name: F Marauder Armor X
description: Armor of a Felyne who sought to rule all. The blossom-on- black pattern stirs foes.
description_de: Die Rüstung einer Felyne, die alle beherrschen wollte. Die Blumenzier verwirrt Feinde.
description_fr: Armure de Felyne aux grandes ambitions. Les motifs roses attirent les ennemis.
description_es: Armadura de un Felyne que ansiaba gobernarlos a todos. Con un estampado provocador.
description_it: Armatura di un Felyne bramoso di potere. I fiori su sfondo nero inquietano i nemici.
description_zh: Armor of a Felyne who sought to rule all. The blossom-on- black pattern stirs foes.

name: F Pleasant Dress X
description: The Meowstress's dress. Wear to get the same great service you've come to know.
description_de: Kleid der Miausterin. Damit fühlst du dich genauso energetisch wie sie.
description_fr: Permet de ressembler à Felyndra et d'avoir la même ardeur au travail qu'elle.
description_es: Atuendo para convertirse en Miauestra. ¡Te dará ganas de gestionar camaradas!
description_it: Protezione essenziale per una vera miadama, capace di infondere allegria.
description_zh: The Meowstress's dress. Wear to get the same great service you've come to know.

name: F Wisdom Cloak X
description: A splendid cloak worn by the Wyventurer. Thick yet light, and a joy to wear.
description_de: Diesen prächtigen Mantel trägt auch der Wyventeurer. Leicht, stabil und äußerst kleidsam.
description_fr: Tenue similaire à celle du Wyventurier. Épaisse, mais légère et confortable.
description_es: Atuendo propio del Wyventurero. Resistente pero cómodo.
description_it: Splendido soprabito in stile wyvventuriero.
description_zh: A splendid cloak worn by the Wyventurer. Thick yet light, and a joy to wear.

name: F Postman Suit X
description: Courier attire that's so authentic, you'll find yourself being handed letters to deliver!
description_de: Kurierkleidung, die so authentisch ist, dass dich Jäger bitten werden, ihre Post zu liefern!
description_fr: Tenue du Messager si réaliste que les gens vous demanderont de livrer leur courrier !
description_es: Es tan auténtico que los cazadores te pedirán que repartas sus cartas.
description_it: Sarai talmente simile al corriere che ti chiederanno di consegnare le lettere!
description_zh: Courier attire that's so authentic, you'll find yourself being handed letters to deliver!

name: F Ioprey Mail X
description: A noble looking set of mail befitting one pretending to be a tasty sacrifice.
description_de: Eine edle Panzerkombination, wenn du dich als leckeres Opfer ausgeben willst.
description_fr: Cotte des plus raffinées, idéale pour attirer l'attention d'un ennemi affamé.
description_es: Cota de malla de aspecto noble perfecta para hacerse pasar por un sabroso sacrificio.
description_it: Cotta pregiata che soddisferà le esigenze di chi vuole fingersi una preda appetitosa.
description_zh: A noble looking set of mail befitting one pretending to be a tasty sacrifice.

name: F Volvi Mail X
description: Shell armor that girds the wearer against Fire, which becomes cool to the touch.
description_de: Panzerrüstung, die den Träger gegen Feuer schützt und sich kühl anfühlt.
description_fr: À base de carapace. Protège son porteur du feu, qui devient froid au toucher.
description_es: Coraza que protege al portador contra el fuego, que se vuelve extrañamente frío al tacto.
description_it: Corazza che protegge dal fuoco e rende le fiamme persino fredde al tatto.
description_zh: Shell armor that girds the wearer against Fire, which becomes cool to the touch.

name: F Basarios Mail X
description: Basarios armor that pretty much turns Palicoes into rocks when they hunch down.
description_de: Basarios-Rüstung, die jeden Kameraden als Stein tarnt, wenn er in die Hocke geht.
description_fr: Armure déséquilibrant les Palicos s'ils commettent l'erreur de se baisser.
description_es: Armadura de Basarios que convierte a los camaradas en rocas cuando se agachan.
description_it: Armatura di Basarios che tramuta i compagni in roccia quando si accovacciano.
description_zh: Basarios armor that pretty much turns Palicoes into rocks when they hunch down.

name: F Conga Fete X
description: Mirthful cymbals that say, "Here I come!" and a shroom bag that says, "Here I AM!"
description_de: Die heiteren Zimbeln singen: "Ich komme!", und der Pilz- beutel ruft: "ICH BIN DA!"
description_fr: Joyeuses cymbales accompagnant un sac de champignons...
description_es: Címbalos alegres que dicen "¡Allá voy!" y unas setas que dicen "¡Ya estoy aquí!"
description_it: Dei cimbali gioiosi che pare gridino "Eccoci!" e una borsa per funghi che urla "ECCOMI!"
description_zh: Mirthful cymbals that say, "Here I come!" and a shroom bag that says, "Here I AM!"

name: F Barroth Mail X
description: Tremendous body armor that transforms the wearer into a rock-solid baby Barroth.
description_de: Enormer Körperschutz, der den Träger in ein robustes Barroth-Baby verwandelt.
description_fr: Armure phénoménale qui transforme son porteur en un solide bébé Barroth.
description_es: Imponente armadura que convierte al portador en una dura y sólida cría de Barroth.
description_it: Massiccia armatura che tramuta chi la porta in un piccolo, coriaceo Barroth.
description_zh: Tremendous body armor that transforms the wearer into a rock-solid baby Barroth.

name: F Khezu Smock X
description: Body armor that seems too cute to be Khezu. Here comes the angel of the hunt!
description_de: Scheint fast zu süß, um von Khezu zu stammen. Hier kommt der Engel der Jagd!
description_fr: Semble trop mignon pour être à base de Khezu. Place à l'ange de la chasse !
description_es: Armadura tan graciosa que no parece hecha de Khezu. ¡Aquí llega el ángel de la caza!
description_it: Abito sin troppo carino per essere fatto di Khezu. Ecco l'angelo della caccia!
description_zh: Body armor that seems too cute to be Khezu. Here comes the angel of the hunt!

name: F Nibel Mail X
description: Versatile body armor for getting around undetected. Orders are orders!
description_de: Vielseitiger Körperschutz. Gut, um sich ungesehen zu bewegen. Befehl ist Befehl!
description_fr: Armure polyvalente pour se déplacer sans être vu. Les ordres sont les ordres !
description_es: Armadura versátil pensada para potenciar el sigilo. ¡Órdenes son órdenes!
description_it: Versatile protezione per aggirarsi non visti. Agli ordini non si discute!
description_zh: Versatile body armor for getting around undetected. Orders are orders!

name: F Malfestio Mail X
description: The Malfestio plumage attached to this mail flutters dramatically in the breeze.
description_de: Das Malfestio-Gefieder an diesem Panzer flattert dramatisch im Wind.
description_fr: Cotte dont les plumes de Malfestio virevoltent au moindre souffle de vent.
description_es: El plumaje de Malfestio que lleva esta cota de malla ondea de un modo muy dramático al viento.
description_it: Le piume di Malfestio che la rivestono ondeggiano vistosamente al vento.
description_zh: The Malfestio plumage attached to this mail flutters dramatically in the breeze.

name: F Rathian Mail X
description: Body armor made of strong, supple shell. As unbreakable as a Rathian's spirit.
description_de: Körperschutz aus starker, weicher Schale. So unbeugsam wie der Geist einer Rathian.
description_fr: Armure en carapace souple et solide. Aussi indestructible que l'esprit d'une Rathian.
description_es: Hecha con el duro y flexible caparazón de una Rathian. Irrompible, como su espíritu.
description_it: Agile e resistente corazza di scaglie. Indistruttibile come l'anima di una Rathian.
description_zh: Body armor made of strong, supple shell. As unbreakable as a Rathian's spirit.

name: F Blango Garb X
description: A traditional outfit in cold regions, the drum is needed to keep spirits at bay.
description_de: Traditionelle Kleidung in kal- ten Regionen, die Trommel dient der Geisterabwehr.
description_fr: Costume traditionnel des régions froides. Le tambour tient les esprits à l'écart.
description_es: Traje tradicional en regiones frías. El tambor mantiene alejados a los espíritus.
description_it: Indumento tradizionale delle regioni fredde. Il tamburo protegge dagli spiriti.
description_zh: A traditional outfit in cold regions, the drum is needed to keep spirits at bay.

name: F Ceanataur Suit X
description: This suit not only makes one feel like a boss, it's even got room for a power lunch!
description_de: In diesem Gewand mit Platz für ein stärkendes Mittagessen fühlst du dich wie der Boss!
description_fr: Tenue digne du plus grand des chefs. On peut même y cacher de quoi manger !
description_es: Este traje te hace sentir genial, ¡y además permite llevar un almuerzo rápido!
description_it: Oltre a rendere irresistibili, questo abito permette di portare con sé un lauto pasto!
description_zh: This suit not only makes one feel like a boss, it's even got room for a power lunch!

name: F Scylla Armor X
description: A suit that covers the body. Painstakingly crafted, it possesses a wondrous beauty.
description_de: Bedeckt den gesamten Körper. Die liebevolle Gestaltung verleiht ihr eine mysteriöse Schönheit.
description_fr: Armure couvrant le torse. Allie conception de qualité et beauté enchanteresse.
description_es: Armadura pectoral hecha de partes de araña sombría. Misteriosa y bella a la vez.
description_it: Protezione con scarti di Nerscylla. Una bellezza artificiale e misteriosa.
description_zh: A suit that covers the body. Painstakingly crafted, it possesses a wondrous beauty.

name: F Naja Sirwal X
description: Clothing that makes Palicoes yell, "I'm gonna rattle you, snake!" and then regret it.
description_de: Lässt Kameraden "Ich lass dich klappern, Schlange!" rufen - und es dann bereuen.
description_fr: Donne l'illusion de pouvoir caresser des serpents. Des accidents ont été déplorés.
description_es: Hace gritar: "¡Te machacaré, serpiente!". Todo son risas hasta que llegan los lloros.
description_it: Pantaloni che fanno gridare "Te le suono io, serpente!". Salvo poi pentirsene...
description_zh: Clothing that makes Palicoes yell, "I'm gonna rattle you, snake!" and then regret it.

name: F Narga Mail X
description: Body armor themed after the black garb of the East. Enables silent approaches.
description_de: Der schwarzen Kleidung des Ostens nachempfunden. Macht Anschleichen leichter.
description_fr: Inspirée de la tenue noire orientale. Permet une approche silencieuse.
description_es: Armadura inspirada en negros ropajes orientales. Para enfoques más sigilosos.
description_it: Cotta ispirata alle nere vesti d'oriente. Permette di muoversi nell'ombra.
description_zh: Body armor themed after the black garb of the East. Enables silent approaches.

name: F Zamtrios Suit X
description: Experimental body armor for harsh climes. Makes under- water Felvine easy to grab.
description_de: Experimenteller Körperschutz für raues Klima. Gut, um Wasser-Felvine zu schnappen.
description_fr: Armure expérimentale pour climats rudes. Facilite la récolte de Felvine d'eau.
description_es: Armadura para climas duros. Permite coger con facilidad vid Felyne bajo el agua.
description_it: Protezione sperimentale per i climi più rigidi. Aiuta a ottenere felvina subacquea.
description_zh: Experimental body armor for harsh climes. Makes under- water Felvine easy to grab.

name: F Plesioth Suit X
description: Body armor with a pawprint on the chest that sells even to Palicoes who can't swim.
description_de: Körperschutz mit dem Symbol einer Pfote. Wird sogar von Nichtschwimmern gekauft.

description_es: Tiene una huella en el pecho. La compran incluso camaradas que no saben nadar.
description_it: Mostra sul petto un'impronta di zampa. Anche per compagni che non sanno nuotare.
description_zh: Body armor with a pawprint on the chest that sells even to Palicoes who can't swim.

name: F Scholarly Suit X
description: The Wycademy Guild Gal's uniform. Dressing and talking like her is all the rage now.
description_de: Die Uniform des Wykademie- Gildenmädels. Jeder will jetzt reden und aussehen wie sie.
description_fr: Uniforme de la Demoiselle de la Guilde à la Wycadémie, devenue une vraie star.
description_es: Uniforme de la chica de la la Wycademia. Está de moda hablar y vestir como ella.
description_it: Uniforme simile a quella della dama della Wyccademia. Il suo stile fa tendenza.
description_zh: The Wycademy Guild Gal's uniform. Dressing and talking like her is all the rage now.

name: F Kittendant Suit X
description: The Flight Kittendant's trusty uniform, complete with scarf and armband.
description_de: Die treue Uniform des Flug- Katzendanten, komplett mit Schal und Armband.
description_fr: Uniforme standard des Miaôtesses, avec foulard et brassard.
description_es: El fiel uniforme de todo gazafato, bufanda y pulsera incluidas.
description_it: La classica divisa da miaostess di volo, completa di foulard e fascia intorno al braccio.
description_zh: The Flight Kittendant's trusty uniform, complete with scarf and armband.

name: F Derring Lorica X
description: Vivid orange-and-green body armor for your Palico's debut. Musters courage.
description_de: Leuchtend orange-grüne Rüstung für das Kameraden- Debüt. Weckt Mut.
description_fr: Armure orange et verte pour votre Palico. Insuffle du courage.
description_es: Armadura naranja y verde para el debut de tu camarada. Para armarse de valor.
description_it: Armatura verde e arancio per i compagni meno esperti. Infonde coraggio.
description_zh: Vivid orange-and-green body armor for your Palico's debut. Musters courage.

name: F Transpurrrrter Cape
description: The Transpurrter's slick travel wear, which flaps in the wind and makes soothing bell sounds.
description_de: Reisekleidung des Trans- schnurrters. Flattert im Wind und klingelt angenehm.
description_fr: Super tenue du Transmiauleur dont les clochettes résonnent au gré du vent.
description_es: La ropa de viaje de Vagabundo Jack. Ondea con el viento y hace sonidos relajantes.
description_it: Indumenti da viaggio del Purrrtatore che fluttuano tintinnanti nella brezza.
description_zh: The Transpurrter's slick travel wear, which flaps in the wind and makes soothing bell sounds.

name: F Guide's Suit X
description: Adorable and popular garb worn by the Felyne guides of Loc Lac, city of sand.
description_de: Niedliches und beliebtes Gewand der Felyne-Führer von Loc Lac, der Sandstadt.
description_fr: Adorable tenue portée par les guides Felynes de Loc Lac, la cité du sable.
description_es: Prenda adorable y campechana que visten los guías Felyne de Loc Lac, la ciudad de arena.
description_it: Celebre e delizioso completo indossato dalle guide di Loc Lac, la città della sabbia.
description_zh: Adorable and popular garb worn by the Felyne guides of Loc Lac, city of sand.

name: F Sailor Suit X
description: The Tanzia Sweetheart's getup, restyled for Palicoes. There are no words for this level of cute.
description_de: Für Kameraden neu gestaltete Kleidung des Tanzia-Liebchens. Zu süß für treffende Worte.
description_fr: Costume de Miss Tanzia, repensé pour vos Palicos. Trop choupi !
description_es: Equipo de la Dama de Tanzia, adaptado a camaradas. Tan cuco que no hay palabras.
description_it: La tenuta della dama di Tanzia, adattata per i compagni. La sua bellezza lascia senza parole.
description_zh: The Tanzia Sweetheart's getup, restyled for Palicoes. There are no words for this level of cute.

name: F Grand Chaos Skirt
description: A dress made out of a hollowed mushroom. Just stay away from hungry Mosswine.
description_de: Ein Kleid aus einem hohlen Pilz. Halte dich nur von hungrigen Mosswinen fern.
description_fr: Robe taillée dans un champignon évidé. Attention aux Mosswines affamés.
description_es: Vestido fabricado con una seta hueca. Pero cuidado con los Mosswines hambrientos.
description_it: Abito ricavato dall'involucro di un fungo. Tienilo alla larga dai Mosswine!
description_zh: A dress made out of a hollowed mushroom. Just stay away from hungry Mosswine.

name: F Death Stench Coat X
description: An outfit so spooky it sends chills down the spine of even the stoutest onlooker.
description_de: Beim Anblick dieser Kleidung läuft selbst den Stärksten ein Schauer über den Rücken.
description_fr: Vêtement si effrayant qu'il fait frissonner même les passants les plus endurcis.
description_es: Un traje tan espeluznante que provoca escalofríos hasta a los tipos más duros.
description_it: Indumento talmente inquietante da insinuare terrore persino nei più coraggiosi.
description_zh: An outfit so spooky it sends chills down the spine of even the stoutest onlooker.

name: F El Dora Mail X
description: The studs on this armor give off a resplendent light no Felyne can resist.
description_de: Die Nieten an dieser Rüstung verbreiten strahlenden Glanz, dem keine Felyne widersteht.
description_fr: Armure cloutée qui brille de mille feux. Aucun Felyne ne peut lui résister.
description_es: Los adornos de esta armadura emiten una luz resplandeciente irresistible para los Felyne.
description_it: Nessun Felyne può resistere al fascino delle sue borchie scintillanti.
description_zh: The studs on this armor give off a resplendent light no Felyne can resist.

name: F Artian Gear X
description: The materials in this suit inexplicably magnetize, keeping Palicoes afloat.
description_de: Die Materialien dieses Gewands werden irgendwie so magnetisiert, dass Kameraden schweben können.
description_fr: Arsenal aux composants dont le magnétisme fait flotter les Palicos.
description_es: Los materiales de este traje se magnetizan sin motivo y hacen flotar a los camaradas.
description_it: Le inspiegabili proprietà magnetiche dei suoi materiali fanno levitare i compagni.
description_zh: The materials in this suit inexplicably magnetize, keeping Palicoes afloat.

name: F Cheerful Suit X
description: Clothes for your Palico reminiscent of the Soaratorium Gal. Shows off both your smarts and liveliness.
description_de: Die Uniform der Aerotorium- Mädel. Für gewitzte und lebhafte Kameraden.
description_fr: Inspirée de la tenue de la Demoiselle Aérolabo, elle donne un air vif et futé.
description_es: Atuendo para camaradas inspirado en el uniforme de la chica del Flotatorio. Sofisticado y con chispa.
description_it: Abito per i compagni che riproduce lo stile della dama del solcacieli.
description_zh: Clothes for your Palico reminiscent of the Soaratorium Gal. Shows off both your smarts and liveliness.

name: F Mariner Suit X
description: Armor worn by Tanzia Gong Girls. Popular for its undeniable cuteness.
description_de: Kleidung der Tanzia-Gong-Mädel. So viel Anmut wissen auch Felyne zu schätzen.
description_fr: Basée sur l'uniforme de la Fille du gong Tanzia. Les Felynes en sont fous.
description_es: Armadura usada por las chicas del gong de Tanzia. Es tan mono... ¡A los Felyne les encanta!
description_it: Abito in stile donzella del gong di Tanzia. Nessun Felyne può resistere!
description_zh: Armor worn by Tanzia Gong Girls. Popular for its undeniable cuteness.

name: F Cute Dress
description: A dress favored by the Mewstress. The fluttering scarf will show off the Palico's true, loveliest nature.
description_de: Dieses fröhliche Kleid zeigt die wahre Natur eines Kameraden: Entzückend!
description_fr: Vêtement pour se déguiser en Felyna. L'écharpe donne au Palico un côté adorable.
description_es: Vestido similar al de la Miauestrilla. La ligera bufanda da un toque alegre.
description_it: Serve a diventare come la mialady e mostra un carattere femminile forte.
description_zh: A dress favored by the Mewstress. The fluttering scarf will show off the Palico's true, loveliest nature.

name: F Garuga Robe X
description: A lovely Garuga robe for proud Palicoes who only serve well-mannered hunters.
description_de: Schöne Garuga-Robe für stolze Kameraden, die nur Jägern mit gutem Benehmen dienen.
description_fr: Jolie tunique pour Palicos altiers au service de chasseurs bien élevés.
description_es: Una toga de Garuga para los camaradas que solo sirven a los cazadores más refinados.
description_it: Adorabile veste di Garuga per i nobili compagni al servizio di cacciatori raffinati.
description_zh: A lovely Garuga robe for proud Palicoes who only serve well-mannered hunters.

name: F Uragaan Mail X
description: Unparalleled body defense that wraps your Palico up tight. A pain to put on.
description_de: Ungeschlagener Körperschutz, der Kameraden eng einhüllt. Extrem schwierig anzuziehen!
description_fr: D'une efficacité hors pair, cette armure moule votre Palico au plus près.
description_es: Otorga una defensa sin par y envuelve a la perfección al camarada. Difícil de poner.
description_it: Impareggiabile corazza che avvolge stretti i compagni. Infilarla è un incubo.
description_zh: Unparalleled body defense that wraps your Palico up tight. A pain to put on.

name: F Lava Mail X
description: Protective, yet flexible armor that can rise to the toughest of challenges.
description_de: Schützende, aber auch flexible Rüstung, die auch größten Herausforderungen standhält.
description_fr: Armure efficace et flexible, à la hauteur des défis les plus redoutables.
description_es: Armadura protectora y flexible que no se amedrenta ante nada.
description_it: Corazza resistente eppure flessibile che protegge anche dalle minacce più insidiose.
description_zh: Protective, yet flexible armor that can rise to the toughest of challenges.

name: F Lagia Pirate X
description: Armor that brings out a Palico's inner buccaneer as it flaps in the briny wind.
description_de: Im Salzwind wehende Rüstung, die den Freibeuter im Herzen eines Kameraden erweckt.
description_fr: Révèle l'âme de pirate de votre Palico en volant dans les embruns.
description_es: Libera al bucanero interior de todo camarada en cuanto huela la brisa marina.
description_it: Risveglia il bucaniere sopito nel compagno che vola tra le brezze salmastre.
description_zh: Armor that brings out a Palico's inner buccaneer as it flaps in the briny wind.

name: F Glavenus Mail X
description: Once polished and refined, the Glavenus' tail makes for highly durable armor.
description_de: Poliert und veredelt wird aus dem Glavenus-Schwanz eine sehr robuste Rüstung.
description_fr: Queue de Glavenus qui, une fois polie et affinée, fait une excellente armure.
description_es: Una vez pulida y refinada, la cola de Glavenus es una armadura muy duradera.
description_it: Se lavorata e lucidata, la coda del Glavenus permette di creare armature molto resistenti.
description_zh: Once polished and refined, the Glavenus' tail makes for highly durable armor.

name: F Astalos Suit X
description: While these bug wings can't make Palicoes fly, they sure can make noise!
description_de: Mit diesen Käferflügeln können Kameraden zwar nicht fliegen, aber jede Menge Lärm machen!
description_fr: Élytres qui ne permettront pas à votre Palico de voler très haut, mais gare au bruit !
description_es: Estas alas de insecto no permiten volar a los camaradas, ¡pero qué ruido hacen!
description_it: Le ali di insetto non permettono di volare, ma producono un ronzio assordante!
description_zh: While these bug wings can't make Palicoes fly, they sure can make noise!

name: F Gammoth Coat X
description: A coat made from fur so thick it can handily block cold and attacks alike.
description_de: Waffenrock aus Fell, der so dick ist, dass Kälte und Angriffe abgewehrt werden.
description_fr: Vêtement fait d'une fourrure si épaisse qu'il protège aussi bien du froid que des attaques.
description_es: Abrigo de una piel tan gruesa que detiene tanto el frío como los ataques.
description_it: La pelliccia è talmente spessa che può proteggere sia dal freddo, sia dagli attacchi.
description_zh: A coat made from fur so thick it can handily block cold and attacks alike.

name: F Mizutsune Suit X
description: This traditional Eastern garb is so tricky it takes two Palicoes to put on.
description_de: Dieses traditionelle östliche Gewand lässt sich nur mithilfe zweier Kameraden anziehen.
description_fr: Tenue traditionnelle orientale nécessitant l'aide de deux Palicos pour être enfilée.
description_es: Traje oriental tradicional tan complicado que un camarada no puede ponérselo solo.
description_it: Abito orientale talmente complesso che richiede due compagni per essere indossato.
description_zh: This traditional Eastern garb is so tricky it takes two Palicoes to put on.

name: F Barioth Mail X
description: Body armor made from an icy predator. The white pelt blends right into the snow.
description_de: Aus einem eisigen Raubtier gemachter Schutz. Der weiße Pelz verschwindet im Schnee.
description_fr: À base d'un prédateur des glaces. Sa peau blanche se fond dans la neige.
description_es: Hecha de restos de un depredador helado. Su pelaje se confunde con la nieve.
description_it: Ricavata da un predatore glaciale. Il cuoio bianco si confonde con la neve.
description_zh: Body armor made from an icy predator. The white pelt blends right into the snow.

name: F Rathalos Mail X
description: Body armor made of the King of the Skies' shell, and just as strong and regal.
description_de: So stark und majestätisch wie der Panzer des Königs der Lüfte selbst.
description_fr: Fabriquée avec la carapace du roi des cieux, qui lui confère solidité et majesté.
description_es: Hecha con el caparazón del rey de los cielos. Tan flexible y regia como él.
description_it: Creata con scaglie del sovrano dei cieli, di cui conserva forza e regalità.
description_zh: Body armor made of the King of the Skies' shell, and just as strong and regal.

name: F Zinogre Mail X
description: Body armor that makes every living thing shrink away. Give your prey no quarter.
description_de: Körperschutz, der Furcht ins Herz jedes Wesens trägt. Gib deinen Gegnern kein Pardon!
description_fr: Fait fuir d'effroi tout être vivant. Ne laisse aucune chance à vos proies.
description_es: Armadura que espanta a todo ser vivo. Con ella no darás cuartel a tu presa.
description_it: Protezione che infonde terrore in ogni creatura. La tua preda non avrà scampo.
description_zh: Body armor that makes every living thing shrink away. Give your prey no quarter.

name: F Grav Armor X
description: Armor that says, "If the Gravios can take a magma bath -- dang it, so can I."
description_de: Rüstung, die verkündet: "Wenn der Gravios in Magma badet, kann ich das auch!"
description_fr: Armure donnant l'impression d'être invincible, même plongée dans le magma.
description_es: Armadura ideal para darse un bañito en el ardiente magma.
description_it: "Se un Gravios può immergersi nel magma... diamine, anch'io posso farlo", dice l'armatura.
description_zh: Armor that says, "If the Gravios can take a magma bath -- dang it, so can I."

name: F Gore Ghost X
description: Body armor worn during the Magala eclipse. The wearer gains both victory and loss.
description_de: Getragen während der Magala- Finsternis. Beschert sowohl Gewinn als auch Verlust.
description_fr: Porté lors de l'éclipse de Magala. Son porteur gagne et perd à la fois.
description_es: Armadura llevada durante el eclipse de Magala. Quien la lleva gana y pierde.
description_it: Armatura indossata durante l'eclissi del Magala. Chi la porta vince e perde insieme.
description_zh: Body armor worn during the Magala eclipse. The wearer gains both victory and loss.

name: F Tigrex Mail X
description: A symbol of the Tigrex's earsplitting roar. The world is your stomping ground!
description_de: Symbol des ohrenbetäubenden Gebrülls des Tigrex. Die Welt ist dein Jagdrevier!
description_fr: Symbole du rugissement assourdissant du Tigrex. Le monde vous appartient !
description_es: Símbolo del atronador rugido del Tigrex. ¡El mundo está bajo tus garras!
description_it: Simboleggia il ruggito spaccatimpani del Tigrex. Schiaccia il mondo intero!
description_zh: A symbol of the Tigrex's earsplitting roar. The world is your stomping ground!

name: F Seltas Body X
description: The perfect armor for a Palico who likes to make sudden, janky movements.
description_de: Perfekte Rüstung für Kameraden, die gern schnelle Bewegungen ausführen.
description_fr: Armure idéale pour les compagnons qui aiment faire des gestes brusques.
description_es: Ideal para camaradas de movimientos un tanto bruscos e impredecibles.
description_it: La protezione perfetta per i compagni che amano prodursi in movimenti repentini.
description_zh: The perfect armor for a Palico who likes to make sudden, janky movements.

name: F Kirin Vest X
description: The Palico Kirin equipment hunters have clamored for. Go for a matching look!
description_de: Kirin-Kameraden-Ausrüstung, die Jäger immer wollten. Hol dir den Partnerlook!
description_fr: Pièce d'armure de Kirin tant attendue par les chasseurs. Portez la corne assortie !
description_es: El equipo Kirin para camarada que tantos cazadores esperaban. ¡Lleva el equipo completo!
description_it: La tanto attesa armatura di Kirin per compagni. Cerca di abbinarla a dovere!
description_zh: The Palico Kirin equipment hunters have clamored for. Go for a matching look!

name: F Borealis Mail
description: Body armor for those who have become one with the hunt, the model of a true swordsmaster.
description_de: Für jene, denen die Jagdkunst in Fleisch und Blut überging. Man erkennt sie schon an der Haltung.
description_fr: Armure de ceux qui maîtrisent parfaitement l'art de la chasse.
description_es: La portan cazadores y espadachines experimentados durante las cacerías.
description_it: Rende chi la veste un grande cacciatore con l'aspetto da spadaccino. Aiuta il respiro.
description_zh: Body armor for those who have become one with the hunt, the model of a true swordsmaster.

description_de: Diese Rüstung aus Ferus- Basarios-Resten bietet beispiellose Möglichkeiten.
description_fr: Armure en hyper débris de Basarios. Ses propriétés sont incomparables.
description_es: Prenda especial tejida con Híper restos de Basarios. Mejora la resistencia,
