name: F Guild Suit X
description: Guild-order armor given only to strong hearts who proudly face danger undeterred.
description_de: Gildenrüstung, die nur jene erhalten, die der Gefahr mutig ins Gesicht lachen.
description_fr: Remis aux cœurs d'acier qui bravent le danger avec courage et fierté.
description_es: Prenda del gremio que se da a los fuertes de corazón que se enfrentan al peligro.
description_it: Uniforme della Gilda per i soli valorosi che sfidano il pericolo senza timore.
description_zh: Guild-order armor given only to strong hearts who proudly face danger undeterred.

name: F Ultra Arcadia Robe
description: The solemn attire of a song- stress who could touch the earth and feel life's pulse.
description_de: Feierliche Kleidung einer Sängerin, die den Puls der Erde spüren konnte.
description_fr: Tenue solennelle d'une chanteresse capable d'entrer en communion avec la terre.
description_es: El atuendo solemne de una cantante capaz de sentir la vida de la tierra.
description_it: La solenne divisa di una cantastorie in armonia con il battito vitale della terra.
description_zh: The solemn attire of a song- stress who could touch the earth and feel life's pulse.

name: F Pro Dirty Hakama
description: Includes necklace popularized by certain seafaring ikemen. "Ikemen" means hunk, honto.
description_de: Mit Halskette. Bekannt durch einen Ikemen-Seemann. "Ikemen" heißt "wohlgeformter Kerl".
description_fr: Inclut un collier rendu célèbre par un ikemen marin ou "beau gosse". Honto !
description_es: Incluye el collar que puso de moda cierto "ikemen". "Ikemen" significa "tiarrón".
description_it: Include una collana resa famosa da un ikemen navigatore. "Ikemen" significa bel fusto.
description_zh: Includes necklace popularized by certain seafaring ikemen. "Ikemen" means hunk, honto.

name: F D'Artanyan Hero Cape
description: D'Artanyan's elegant cape, perfect for when you have to make big speeches.
description_de: Elegantes D'Artagnan-Cape. Ideal, wenn du große Reden schwingen musst.
description_fr: Élégante cape de d'Artamiaou, parfait pour qui doit prononcer de longs discours.
description_es: Elegante capa de D'Artamiau, perfecta para discursos ampulosos.
description_it: L'elegante cappa di d'Artamian, perfetta per tenere discorsi solenni.
description_zh: D'Artanyan's elegant cape, perfect for when you have to make big speeches.

name: F Master's Mail X
description: Palico armor or not, this Wyverian mail's defensive prowess is best in class.
description_de: Kameradenrüstung oder nicht, der Wyverianer-Panzer wehrt Angriffe erstklassig ab.
description_fr: Cotte wyverienne pour Palico, certes, mais s'avère la meilleure de sa catégorie.
description_es: Sea de camaradas o no, la capacidad defensiva de esta malla wyveriana es incomparable.
description_it: Questa cotta wyverniana è tra le migliori in assoluto, e non solo tra quelle per compagni.
description_zh: Palico armor or not, this Wyverian mail's defensive prowess is best in class.

name: F Barmaid's Uniform
description: Pub Manager-themed clothes. Their design emits grace and elegance with every gesture.
description_de: Ähnelt der Kleidung der Tavernen- Managerin. Kommt erst bei Bewegung richtig zur Geltung.
description_fr: Inspiré par la Taulière. Gagne en élégance à chaque mouvement.
description_es: Inspirado en el que lleva la dueña de la taberna. Permite moverse con gracia y elegancia.
description_it: Lo stile della manager della taverna guadagna eleganza col movimento.
description_zh: Pub Manager-themed clothes. Their design emits grace and elegance with every gesture.

name: F Barman's Suit
description: Attire favored by the Questender. Guaranteed to arch the backs of every Palico in the room.
description_de: Respekteinflößendes Gewand, das jedem Kameraden das gewisse Etwas verleiht.
description_fr: Hommage au Brasseur de quêtes. Redresse le dos du Palico qui la porte.
description_es: Inspirado en el que lleva el mesionero. Da un aspecto imponente a quien se lo pone.
description_it: Rispecchia lo stile dei missionatori della taverna e fa rizzare la schiena ai compagni felini.
description_zh: Attire favored by the Questender. Guaranteed to arch the backs of every Palico in the room.

name: F Agnaktor Mail X
description: The sign of a pact with the God of Blazes. Worn by the Flameking in a land of fire.
description_de: Das Zeichen eines Pakts mit dem Gott der Lohen. Getragen vom Flammenkönig im Feuerland.
description_fr: Cotte marquant un pacte avec le Dieu de la fournaise. Porté par le Roi-flamme d'une terre de feu.
description_es: Simboliza un pacto con el dios del fuego. Lo llevó el Rey de las Llamas.
description_it: Simbolo di un patto con il dio delle fiamme, che la indossò in una terra infuocata.
description_zh: The sign of a pact with the God of Blazes. Worn by the Flameking in a land of fire.

name: F Duram Mail X
description: Rugged body armor that nails the Duramboros look. Become a walking fortress.
description_de: Stabile Rüstung, imitiert die Gestalt des Duramboros. Sei eine wandelnde Festung!
description_fr: Armure robuste ayant l'apparence du Duramboros. Devenez une forteresse.
description_es: Imponente armadura que clava el aspecto del Duramboros. Serás una fortaleza andante.
description_it: Rugosa armatura che ricalca l'aspetto del Duramboros. Ti muterà in una fortezza.
description_zh: Rugged body armor that nails the Duramboros look. Become a walking fortress.

name: F Seregios Mail X
description: Armor worn by an ancient army. Its unsullied gleam attests to their victories.
description_de: Rüstung einer alten Armee. Ihr unbefleckter Glanz zeugt von ihren Siegen.
description_fr: Armure portée par une armée disparue. Sa pureté témoigne des victoires passées.
description_es: Armadura de un ejército antiguo. Su brillo inmaculado da fe de sus victorias.
description_it: Armatura indossata da un antico esercito. Il bagliore immacolato ne attesta l'invincibilità.
description_zh: Armor worn by an ancient army. Its unsullied gleam attests to their victories.

name: F Diablos Mail X
description: Shell body armor that repels iron blows and renders the wearer a terror of the sand.
description_de: Schalenrüstung, die harte Schläge abwehrt. Ihr Träger ist der Schrecken der Wüste.
description_fr: En carapace. Repousse les coups et fait de son porteur une terreur des sables.
description_es: Repele los golpes potentes y convierte al portador en el terror de las arenas.
description_it: Corazza che respinge il ferro e muta chi la indossa in un terrore delle sabbie.
description_zh: Shell body armor that repels iron blows and renders the wearer a terror of the sand.

name: F Brachy Fists X
description: Knockout body armor for pugilist Palicoes that gets 'em shadowboxing in no time.
description_de: Toller K.-o.-Körperschutz, der Kameraden blitzschnell zu Schattenboxern macht.
description_fr: Idéaux pour les compagnons pugilistes qui boxeront dans le vide en un rien de temps.
description_es: Guantes para camaradas púgiles ansiosos por subirse a un ring y repartir miaus como panes.
description_it: Protezione per compagni amanti del pugilato. Sprona a sferrare pugni alla cieca.
description_zh: Knockout body armor for pugilist Palicoes that gets 'em shadowboxing in no time.

name: F Angel Down X
description: Body armor worn at the gods' resurrection. Wearers gain peace and salvation.
description_de: Bei der Auferstehung der Götter getragen. Beschert Friede und Erlösung.
description_fr: Porté lors de la résurrection des dieux. Offre la paix et le salut.
description_es: Armadura llevada durante la resurrección de los dioses. Da paz y salvación.
description_it: Protezione indossata nella resurrezione degli dei. Conferisce pace e salvezza.
description_zh: Body armor worn at the gods' resurrection. Wearers gain peace and salvation.

name: F Valstrax Mail X
description: Chest armor for those who face calamity. Can withstand the force of an entire sun.
description_de: Für Helden, die jeder Gefahr trotzen. Selbst Meteoriten würden von ihm abprallen.
description_fr: Portée par ceux qui affrontent le Mal, elle inspire un respect incommensurable.
description_es: Armadura pectoral para grandes héroes. Es dura como la roca de estrellas.
description_it: Protezione per chi affronta le calamità. Niente può perforarla.
description_zh: Chest armor for those who face calamity. Can withstand the force of an entire sun.

name: F Puppeteer Garb+
description: Palico attire that asks: How does one catch the eye without being seen?
description_de: Die Antwort auf die Frage: "Wie strahlt man Abwesenheit aus und ist doch präsent?"
description_fr: Tenue de compagnon. Comment attirer les regards en restant invisible ?
description_es: Atuendo camarada que clama: "¿Es posible llamar la atención sin que se te vea un pelo?".
description_it: Abito che pone un dilemma: come si attira l'attenzione senza farsi notare?
description_zh: Palico attire that asks: How does one catch the eye without being seen?

name: F Vangis Mail X
description: Deviljho body armor. The belt marks a tyrant ready to devour his whole kingdom.
description_de: Dämonjho-Körperschutz. Der Gürtel steht für einen sein Reich verzehrenden Tyrannen.
description_fr: À base de Deviljho. La ceinture symbolise un tyran prêt à dévorer son royaume.
description_es: Armadura de Deviljho. El cinturón marca a un tirano listo para devorar su reino.
description_it: Protezione di Deviljho. La cintura spinge i tiranni a distruggere i loro regni.
description_zh: Deviljho body armor. The belt marks a tyrant ready to devour his whole kingdom.

name: F Chaos Cloak
description: Body armor embodying both good and evil. Alienates the wearer from the world.
description_de: Verkörpert sowohl Glück als auch Unglück und lässt den Träger der Welt entrücken.
description_fr: Teintée par le chaos, elle cristallise le bien et le mal, et semble venir d'un autre monde.
description_es: Prenda impregnada de la esencia del caos. Personifica la dualidad del bien y del mal.
description_it: Imbevuto di caos, incarna il bene e il male e separa dal mondo.
description_zh: Body armor embodying both good and evil. Alienates the wearer from the world.

name: F Kushala Vise X
description: Body armor that honors the god of the moon and harvest. Assures bliss after death.
description_de: Rüstung, die den Gott des Mondes und der Ernte ehrt. Gewährt Frieden im Tode.
description_fr: Honore le dieu de la lune et de la moisson. Garantit la félicité après la mort.
description_es: Honra al dios de la luna y la cosecha. Garantiza la dicha tras la muerte.
description_it: Armatura che rende onore al dio della luna e dei campi. Dona l'eterna beatitudine.
description_zh: Body armor that honors the god of the moon and harvest. Assures bliss after death.

name: F Genie Carpet X
description: An exotic item that appears to make the wearer float. Clearly a ruse... CLEARLY.
description_de: Exotischer Gegenstand, der den Träger schweben lässt. Das MUSS ein Trick sein!
description_fr: Objet exotique donnant l'illusion de léviter. Oui, ça doit être une illusion...
description_es: Un objeto exótico que hace levitar al portador. Está claro que tiene truco, ¿no?
description_it: Oggetto esotico che sembra far fluttuare chi lo indossa. Deve esserci il trucco... PER FORZA.
description_zh: An exotic item that appears to make the wearer float. Clearly a ruse... CLEARLY.

name: F Kaiser Panoply X
description: Noble Teostra wear. Only royal blood has rights to this crimson cape.
description_de: Edle Teostra-Kleidung. Nur Adlige dürfen dieses karmesinrote Cape tragen.
description_fr: À base de Teostra. Seuls ceux de lignée royale peuvent y prétendre.
description_es: Vestimenta noble de Teostra. Solo la sangre real puede portar esta capa carmesí.
description_it: Nobile mantello cremisi di Teostra. Può indossarlo solo chi possiede sangue reale.
description_zh: Noble Teostra wear. Only royal blood has rights to this crimson cape.

name: F Husk Suit X
description: Unable to rid itself of past sorrow, these bones now serve a new master.
description_de: Vergangenes Leid lässt diese Knochen nicht los, die jetzt einen neuen Meister haben.
description_fr: Os n'ayant pas su chasser les fantômes du passé et servant désormais un nouveau maître.
description_es: Incapaz de librarse de las penas pasadas, estos huesos ahora sirven a otro amo.
description_it: Queste ossa afflitte da un lutto del passato sono ora al servizio di un nuovo padrone.
description_zh: Unable to rid itself of past sorrow, these bones now serve a new master.

name: F Nakarkos Suit X
description: Having faced the chaos of death, the Felyne wearing this can handle anything.
description_de: Die Felyne, die dieses Gewand trägt, hat dem Tod ins Auge gesehen und bewältigt alles.
description_fr: Ayant affronté le chaos de la mort, le Felyne portant cette tenue n'a plus rien à craindre.
description_es: Tras enfrentarse al caos de la muerte, el Felyne que lo lleve puede con todo.
description_it: Avendo affrontato la follia della morte, il Felyne che lo indossa è pronto a tutto.
description_zh: Having faced the chaos of death, the Felyne wearing this can handle anything.

name: F Neset Mail
description: Armor for a servant of ancient rulers. The all-purpose coffin is good for hiding or taking naps.
description_de: Felyne-Brustschutz des alten Adels. Das Rückenteil schützt und ist bequem zum Schlafen.
description_fr: Armure du Palico d'une ancienne dynastie. Le sarcophage peut servir de cachette ou de lit.
description_es: Perteneció a la realeza. Útil para ocultarse o para echar una cabezadita.
description_it: Abito d'antica famiglia reale per compagni. Nel sarcofago si può dormire o nascondere.
description_zh: Armor for a servant of ancient rulers. The all-purpose coffin is good for hiding or taking naps.
